文件: backend/cmd/server/main.go
================================================================================

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package main
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"log"
    13		"os"
    14		"os/signal"
    15		"syscall"
    16		"time"
    17		"scholar-backend/internal/admin"
    18		"scholar-backend/internal/ai"
    19		"scholar-backend/internal/feedback"
    20		"scholar-backend/internal/common/cache"
    21		"scholar-backend/internal/common/cleanup"
    22		appconfig "scholar-backend/internal/common/config"
    23		"scholar-backend/internal/common/database"
    24		"scholar-backend/internal/common/middleware"
    25		"scholar-backend/internal/common/telemetry"
    26		"scholar-backend/internal/config"
    27		"scholar-backend/internal/conversation"
    28		"scholar-backend/internal/coupon"
    29		"scholar-backend/internal/mcp"
    30		"scholar-backend/internal/order"
    31		"scholar-backend/internal/payment"
    32		"scholar-backend/internal/peerreview"
    33		"scholar-backend/internal/proxy"
    34		"scholar-backend/internal/semanticscholar"
    35		"scholar-backend/internal/subscription"
    36		"scholar-backend/internal/thirdparty"
    37		"scholar-backend/internal/user"
    38		"scholar-backend/internal/wechat"
    39		"scholar-backend/internal/wechatofficial"
    40	
    41		"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    42		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
    43	)
    44	
    45	func main() {
    46		// Load configuration
    47		cfg := appconfig.Load()
    48	
    49		// Initialize OpenTelemetry with SigNoz
    50		ctx := context.Background()
    51		if cfg.SigNoz.EnableTracing || cfg.SigNoz.EnableLogging {
    52			telemetryCfg := &telemetry.Config{
    53				Endpoint:      cfg.SigNoz.Endpoint,
    54				ServiceName:   cfg.SigNoz.ServiceName,
    55				Environment:   cfg.SigNoz.Environment,
    56				EnableTracing: cfg.SigNoz.EnableTracing,
    57				EnableLogging: cfg.SigNoz.EnableLogging,
    58				EnableMetrics: cfg.SigNoz.EnableMetrics,
    59				SamplingRate:  cfg.SigNoz.SamplingRate,
    60			}
    61			
    62			// Set global endpoint for logger
    63			telemetry.SetGlobalEndpoint(telemetryCfg.Endpoint)
    64			
    65			telemetryShutdown, err := telemetry.Initialize(ctx, telemetryCfg)
    66			if err != nil {
    67				log.Printf("Warning: Failed to initialize telemetry: %v", err)
    68			} else {
    69				log.Printf("✓ Telemetry initialized (SigNoz endpoint: %s)", telemetryCfg.Endpoint)
    70				log.Printf("  - Service: %s", telemetryCfg.ServiceName)
    71				log.Printf("  - Environment: %s", telemetryCfg.Environment)
    72				log.Printf("  - Tracing: %v, Logging: %v", telemetryCfg.EnableTracing, telemetryCfg.EnableLogging)
    73				log.Printf("  - Sampling Rate: %.1f%%", telemetryCfg.SamplingRate*100)
    74				
    75				defer func() {
    76					shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
    77					defer cancel()
    78					if err := telemetryShutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
    79						log.Printf("Error shutting down telemetry: %v", err)
    80					}
    81				}()
    82			}
    83		} else {
    84			log.Println("✓ Telemetry disabled by configuration")
    85		}
    86	
    87		// Create logger for main (only if telemetry is enabled)
    88		var logger *telemetry.Logger
    89		if cfg.SigNoz.EnableLogging {
    90			logger = telemetry.NewLogger("main")
    91			logger.Info(ctx, "Starting Scholar Backend Service",
    92				attribute.String("version", "1.0.0"),
    93				attribute.String("environment", cfg.SigNoz.Environment),
    94			)
    95		}
    96	
    97		// Initialize Redis
    98		if err := cache.InitRedis(cfg.Redis.Host, cfg.Redis.Port, cfg.Redis.Password, cfg.Redis.DB); err != nil {
    99			if logger != nil {
   100				logger.Fatal(ctx, "Failed to initialize Redis", err)
   101			}
   102			log.Fatalf("Failed to initialize Redis: %v", err)
   103		}
   104		if logger != nil {
   105			logger.Info(ctx, "Redis initialized successfully")
   106		}
   107		log.Println("✓ Redis initialized successfully")
   108	
   109		// Initialize cache worker pool (prevents goroutine accumulation from async cache writes)
   110		cache.InitWorkerPool(10, 100) // 10 workers, queue size 100
   111	
   112		// Initialize database
   113		if err := database.Initialize(cfg); err != nil {
   114			log.Fatalf("Failed to initialize database: %v", err)
   115		}
   116	
   117		// Initialize cleanup service
   118		cleanupService := cleanup.NewCleanupService(database.GetDB())
   119		cleanupService.Start()
   120	
   121		// Initialize admin module
   122		adminRepo := admin.NewRepository(database.GetDB())
   123		adminService := admin.NewService(adminRepo)
   124		adminHandler := admin.NewHandler(adminService)
   125

   569				// Public recommendations endpoint - for anonymous access to similar papers
   570				publicAPI.GET("/recommendations/papers/:paperId", scholarHandler.GetRecommendationsForPaper)
   571	
   572				// Public author endpoints - for anonymous access from author detail page
   573				publicAPI.GET("/authors/:authorId", scholarHandler.GetAuthor)
   574				publicAPI.GET("/authors/:authorId/papers", scholarHandler.GetAuthorPapers)
   575	
   576				// Public feedback endpoints
   577				publicAPI.POST("/feedback", feedbackHandler.CreateFeedback)
   578				publicAPI.POST("/feedback/upload", feedbackHandler.UploadAttachments)
   579				publicAPI.GET("/feedback/attachment/:id", feedbackHandler.GetAttachment)
   580			}
   581	
   582			// Analysis dimensions routes (protected - requires user authentication)
   583			analysisGroup := api.Group("/analysis")
   584			analysisGroup.Use(middleware.UserAuthMiddleware())
   585			{
   586				// Analyze paper with user's custom dimensions
   587				analysisGroup.POST("/paper", aiHandler.AnalyzePaper)
   588				// Get user's dimensions (custom or system default)
   589				analysisGroup.GET("/dimensions", aiHandler.GetAnalysisDimensions)
   590				// Create custom dimension
   591				analysisGroup.POST("/dimensions", aiHandler.CreateUserDimension)
   592				// Update custom dimension
   593				analysisGroup.PUT("/dimensions/:id", aiHandler.UpdateUserDimension)
   594				// Delete custom dimension
   595				analysisGroup.DELETE("/dimensions/:id", aiHandler.DeleteUserDimension)
   596				// Reset single dimension to default
   597				analysisGroup.DELETE("/dimensions/reset/:dimensionKey", aiHandler.ResetUserDimension)
   598				// Reset all dimensions to default
   599				analysisGroup.DELETE("/dimensions/reset-all", aiHandler.ResetAllUserDimensions)
   600				// Copy system dimensions to user (deprecated, kept for compatibility)
   601				analysisGroup.POST("/dimensions/copy-from-system", aiHandler.CopySystemDimensionsToUser)
   602			}
   603	
   604			// Semantic Scholar API routes (protected - requires user authentication)
   605			scholar := api.Group("/scholar")
   606			scholar.Use(middleware.UserAuthMiddleware())
   607			{
   608				// Paper endpoints
   609				scholar.POST("/papers/search", scholarHandler.SearchPapers) // 学术检索（改为POST）
   610				scholar.GET("/papers/:paperId", scholarHandler.GetPaper)
   611				scholar.POST("/papers/batch", scholarHandler.GetPaperBatch)
   612				scholar.GET("/papers/:paperId/citations", scholarHandler.GetPaperCitations)
   613				scholar.GET("/papers/:paperId/references", scholarHandler.GetPaperReferences)
   614				scholar.GET("/papers/:paperId/authors", scholarHandler.GetPaperAuthors)
   615	
   616				// Author endpoints
   617				scholar.GET("/authors/search", scholarHandler.SearchAuthors)
   618				scholar.GET("/authors/:authorId", scholarHandler.GetAuthor)
   619				scholar.GET("/authors/:authorId/papers", scholarHandler.GetAuthorPapers)
   620	
   621				// Recommendations endpoints
   622				scholar.GET("/recommendations/papers/:paperId", scholarHandler.GetRecommendationsForPaper)
   623				scholar.POST("/recommendations/papers", scholarHandler.GetRecommendations)
   624			}
   625	
   626			// MCP endpoints (protected - requires user authentication)
   627			mcpGroup := api.Group("/mcp")
   628			mcpGroup.Use(middleware.UserAuthMiddleware())
   629			{
   630				mcpGroup.GET("/tools", mcpHandler.ListTools)
   631				mcpGroup.POST("/call", mcpHandler.CallTool)
   632			}
   633	
   634			// Proxy endpoints (protected - requires user authentication)
   635			proxyHandler.RegisterRoutes(api, middleware.UserAuthMiddleware())
   636		}
   637	
   638		// Serve uploaded files (feedback attachments)
   639		router.Static("/uploads", "./uploads")
   640	
   641		// Health check endpoint
   642		router.GET("/health", func(c *gin.Context) {
   643			c.JSON(200, gin.H{
   644				"status": "ok",
   645				"service": "scholar-backend",
   646			})
   647		})
   648	
   649		// Create context for graceful shutdown
   650		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
   651		defer cancel()
   652	
   653		// Start database connection pool monitoring
   654		database.StartConnectionPoolMonitoring(ctx, 5*time.Minute)
   655	
   656		// Start background tasks
   657		// Record online user snapshots every 5 minutes
   658		go func() {
   659			ticker := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Minute)
   660			defer ticker.Stop()
   661	
   662			log.Println("Online user snapshot task started")
   663	
   664			// Record initial snapshot
   665			if err := userService.RecordOnlineUserSnapshot(); err != nil {
   666				log.Printf("Failed to record initial online user snapshot: %v", err)
   667			}
   668	
   669			for {
   670				select {
   671				case <-ticker.C:
   672					if err := userService.RecordOnlineUserSnapshot(); err != nil {
   673						log.Printf("Failed to record online user snapshot: %v", err)
   674					}
   675				case <-ctx.Done():
   676					log.Println("Online user snapshot task stopped")
   677					return
   678				}
   679			}
   680		}()
   681	
   682		// Setup graceful shutdown
   683		quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
   684		signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
   685	
   686		// Start server in a goroutine
   687		addr := ":" + cfg.Server.Port
   688		log.Printf("Server starting on %s", addr)
   689	
   690		go func() {
   691			if err := router.Run(addr); err != nil {
   692				log.Fatalf("Failed to start server: %v", err)
   693			}
   694		}()
   695	
   696		// Wait for interrupt signal
   697		<-quit
   698		log.Println("Shutting down server...")
   699	
   700		// Cancel context to stop background tasks
   701		cancel()
   702	
   703		// Shutdown cache worker pool gracefully
   704		cache.ShutdownGlobalPool()
   705	
   706		// Give background tasks time to cleanup
   707		time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
   708	
   709		log.Println("Server stopped")
   710	}
   711	
   712	// feedbackUserRepoAdapter adapts user.Repository to feedback.UserRepository interface
   713	type feedbackUserRepoAdapter struct {
   714		userRepo *user.Repository
   715	}
   716	
   717	func (a *feedbackUserRepoAdapter) FindByID(id uint) (*feedback.UserInfo, error) {
   718		u, err := a.userRepo.FindByID(id)
   719		if err != nil || u == nil {
   720			return nil, err
   721		}
   722		return &feedback.UserInfo{
   723			ID:        u.ID,
   724			Username:  u.Username,
   725			Email:     u.Email,
   726			Phone:     u.Phone,
   727			AvatarURL: u.AvatarURL,
   728		}, nil
   729	}
   730	
   731	func (a *feedbackUserRepoAdapter) FindByIDs(ids []uint) (map[uint]*feedback.UserInfo, error) {
   732		users, err := a.userRepo.FindByIDs(ids)
   733		if err != nil {
   734			return nil, err
   735		}
   736		result := make(map[uint]*feedback.UserInfo)
   737		for id, u := range users {
   738			result[id] = &feedback.UserInfo{
   739				ID:        u.ID,
   740				Username:  u.Username,
   741				Email:     u.Email,
   742				Phone:     u.Phone,
   743				AvatarURL: u.AvatarURL,
   744			}
   745		}
   746		return result, nil
   747	}

    29	// DashboardStatistics represents overall dashboard statistics
    30	type DashboardStatistics struct {
    31		// 用户统计
    32		TotalUsers       int64               `json:"total_users"`        // 总用户数
    33		ActiveUsers30d   int64               `json:"active_users_30d"`   // 30天活跃用户
    34		NewUsersToday    int64               `json:"new_users_today"`    // 今日新增
    35		NewUsers7d       int64               `json:"new_users_7d"`       // 7天新增
    36		NewUsers30d      int64               `json:"new_users_30d"`      // 30天新增
    37		OnlineUsers      int64               `json:"online_users"`       // 当前在线用户
    38	
    39		// 订单统计
    40		TotalOrders      int64               `json:"total_orders"`       // 总订单数
    41		PendingOrders    int64               `json:"pending_orders"`     // 待支付订单
    42		PaidOrders       int64               `json:"paid_orders"`        // 已支付订单
    43		TotalRevenue     float64             `json:"total_revenue"`      // 总收入
    44		RevenueToday     float64             `json:"revenue_today"`      // 今日收入
    45		Revenue7d        float64             `json:"revenue_7d"`         // 7天收入
    46		Revenue30d       float64             `json:"revenue_30d"`        // 30天收入
    47	
    48		// 订阅统计
    49		ActiveSubscriptions int64            `json:"active_subscriptions"` // 活跃订阅数
    50		FreeUsers           int64            `json:"free_users"`           // 免费用户
    51		PaidUsers           int64            `json:"paid_users"`           // 付费用户
    52	
    53		// 优惠券统计
    54		TotalCoupons        int64            `json:"total_coupons"`        // 总优惠券数
    55		UsedCoupons         int64            `json:"used_coupons"`         // 已使用
    56		UnusedCoupons       int64            `json:"unused_coupons"`       // 未使用
    57		ExpiredCoupons      int64            `json:"expired_coupons"`      // 已过期
    58	
    59		// 会话统计
    60		TotalConversations  int64            `json:"total_conversations"`  // 总对话数
    61		ConversationsToday  int64            `json:"conversations_today"`  // 今日对话
    62		TotalMessages       int64            `json:"total_messages"`       // 总消息数

    80	// GetDashboardStatistics handles GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/statistics
    81	func (h *DashboardHandler) GetDashboardStatistics(c *gin.Context) {
    82		stats := &DashboardStatistics{}
    83		now := time.Now()
    84		today := now.Format("2006-01-02")
    85		date7dAgo := now.AddDate(0, 0, -7).Format("2006-01-02")
    86		date30dAgo := now.AddDate(0, 0, -30).Format("2006-01-02")
    87	
    88		// ============================================
    89		// 用户统计
    90		// ============================================
    91	
    92		// 总用户数
    93		h.db.Table("users").Count(&stats.TotalUsers)
    94	
    95		// 今日新增用户
    96		h.db.Table("users").
    97			Where("DATE(created_at) = ?", today).
    98			Count(&stats.NewUsersToday)
    99	
   100		// 7天新增用户
   101		h.db.Table("users").
   102			Where("DATE(created_at) >= ?", date7dAgo).
   103			Count(&stats.NewUsers7d)
   104	
   105		// 30天新增用户
   106		h.db.Table("users").
   107			Where("DATE(created_at) >= ?", date30dAgo).
   108			Count(&stats.NewUsers30d)
   109	
   110		// 30天活跃用户 (有登录记录)
   111		h.db.Table("user_sessions").
   112			Where("last_active_at >= ?", time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -30)).
   113			Distinct("user_id").
   114			Count(&stats.ActiveUsers30d)
   115	
   116		// 当前在线用户 (5分钟内活跃)
   117		h.db.Table("user_sessions").
   118			Where("last_active_at >= ?", time.Now().Add(-5*time.Minute)).
   119			Count(&stats.OnlineUsers)
   120	
   121		// ============================================
   122		// 订单统计
   123		// ============================================
   124	
   125		// 总订单数
   126		h.db.Table("orders").Count(&stats.TotalOrders)
   127	
   128		// 待支付订单
   129		h.db.Table("orders").
   130			Where("status = ?", "pending").
   131			Count(&stats.PendingOrders)
   132	
   133		// 已支付订单
   134		h.db.Table("orders").
   135			Where("status = ?", "paid").
   136			Count(&stats.PaidOrders)
   137	
   138		// 总收入
   139		h.db.Table("orders").
   140			Where("status = ?", "paid").
   141			Select("COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0)").
   142			Scan(&stats.TotalRevenue)
   143	
   144		// 今日收入
   145		h.db.Table("orders").
   146			Where("status = ? AND DATE(paid_at) = ?", "paid", today).
   147			Select("COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0)").
   148			Scan(&stats.RevenueToday)
   149	
   150		// 7天收入
   151		h.db.Table("orders").
   152			Where("status = ? AND DATE(paid_at) >= ?", "paid", date7dAgo).
   153			Select("COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0)").
   154			Scan(&stats.Revenue7d)
   155	
   156		// 30天收入
   157		h.db.Table("orders").
   158			Where("status = ? AND DATE(paid_at) >= ?", "paid", date30dAgo).
   159			Select("COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0)").
   160			Scan(&stats.Revenue30d)
   161	
   162		// ============================================
   163		// 订阅统计
   164		// ============================================
   165	
   166		// 活跃订阅数 (未过期)
   167		h.db.Table("user_subscriptions").
   168			Where("status = ? AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > ?)", "active", now).
   169			Count(&stats.ActiveSubscriptions)
   170	
   171		// 免费用户 (订阅计划为免费)
   172		h.db.Table("user_subscriptions").
   173			Joins("JOIN subscription_plans ON user_subscriptions.plan_id = subscription_plans.id").
   174			Where("subscription_plans.price = 0 AND user_subscriptions.status = ?", "active").
   175			Count(&stats.FreeUsers)
   176	
   177		// 付费用户
   178		h.db.Table("user_subscriptions").
   179			Joins("JOIN subscription_plans ON user_subscriptions.plan_id = subscription_plans.id").
   180			Where("subscription_plans.price > 0 AND user_subscriptions.status = ?", "active").
   181			Count(&stats.PaidUsers)
   182	
   183		// ============================================
   184		// 优惠券统计
   185		// ============================================
   186	
   187		// 总优惠券数
   188		h.db.Table("user_coupons").Count(&stats.TotalCoupons)
   189	
   190		// 已使用优惠券
   191		h.db.Table("user_coupons").
   192			Where("status = ?", "used").
   193			Count(&stats.UsedCoupons)
   194	
   195		// 未使用优惠券
   196		h.db.Table("user_coupons").
   197			Where("status = ?", "unused").
   198			Count(&stats.UnusedCoupons)
   199	
   200		// 已过期优惠券
   201		h.db.Table("user_coupons").
   202			Where("status = ?", "expired").
   203			Count(&stats.ExpiredCoupons)
   204	
   205		// ============================================
   206		// 会话统计
   207		// ============================================
   208	
   209		// 总对话数
   210		h.db.Table("conversations").Count(&stats.TotalConversations)
   211	
   212		// 今日对话数
   213		h.db.Table("conversations").
   214			Where("DATE(created_at) = ?", today).
   215			Count(&stats.ConversationsToday)
   216	
   217		// 总消息数
   218		h.db.Table("conversation_messages").Count(&stats.TotalMessages)
   219	
   220		// ============================================
   221		// 系统统计
   222		// ============================================
   223	
   224		// 第三方账号数
   225		h.db.Table("third_party_accounts").Count(&stats.ThirdPartyAccounts)
   226	
   227		// 提示词模板数
   228		h.db.Table("prompt_templates").Count(&stats.PromptTemplates)
   229	
   230		// ============================================
   231		// 趋势图表数据
   232		// ============================================
   233	
   234		// 用户增长趋势 (最近30天)
   235		stats.UserGrowthChart = h.getUserGrowthChart(30)
   236	
   237		// 订单趋势 (最近30天)
   238		stats.OrderTrendChart = h.getOrderTrendChart(30)
   239	
   240		// 收入趋势 (最近30天)
   241		stats.RevenueTrendChart = h.getRevenueTrendChart(30)
   242	
   243		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Dashboard statistics retrieved successfully", stats)
   244	}
   245	
   246	// getUserGrowthChart 获取用户增长趋势图表数据
   247	func (h *DashboardHandler) getUserGrowthChart(days int) []ChartDataPoint {
   248		var results []struct {
   249			Date  string
   250			Count int64
   251		}
   252	
   253		h.db.Table("users").
   254			Select("DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count").
   255			Where("created_at >= ?", time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -days)).
   256			Group("DATE(created_at)").
   257			Order("date ASC").
   258			Scan(&results)
   259	
   260		chart := make([]ChartDataPoint, 0, len(results))
   261		for _, r := range results {
   262			chart = append(chart, ChartDataPoint{
   263				Date:  r.Date,
   264				Value: float64(r.Count),
   265			})
   266		}
   267	
   268		return chart
   269	}
   270	
   271	// getOrderTrendChart 获取订单趋势图表数据
   272	func (h *DashboardHandler) getOrderTrendChart(days int) []ChartDataPoint {
   273		var results []struct {
   274			Date  string
   275			Count int64
   276		}
   277	
   278		h.db.Table("orders").
   279			Select("DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count").
   280			Where("created_at >= ? AND status = ?", time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -days), "paid").
   281			Group("DATE(created_at)").
   282			Order("date ASC").
   283			Scan(&results)
   284	
   285		chart := make([]ChartDataPoint, 0, len(results))
   286		for _, r := range results {
   287			chart = append(chart, ChartDataPoint{
   288				Date:  r.Date,
   289				Value: float64(r.Count),
   290			})
   291		}
   292	
   293		return chart
   294	}
   295	
   296	// getRevenueTrendChart 获取收入趋势图表数据
   297	func (h *DashboardHandler) getRevenueTrendChart(days int) []ChartDataPoint {
   298		var results []struct {
   299			Date   string
   300			Amount float64
   301		}
   302	
   303		h.db.Table("orders").
   304			Select("DATE(paid_at) as date, COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) as amount").
   305			Where("paid_at >= ? AND status = ?", time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -days), "paid").
   306			Group("DATE(paid_at)").
   307			Order("date ASC").
   308			Scan(&results)
   309	
   310		chart := make([]ChartDataPoint, 0, len(results))
   311		for _, r := range results {
   312			chart = append(chart, ChartDataPoint{
   313				Date:  r.Date,
   314				Value: r.Amount,
   315			})
   316		}
   317	
   318		return chart
   319	}

     8	package admin
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"scholar-backend/internal/common/utils"
    12	
    13		"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    14	)
    15	
    16	// Handler handles HTTP requests for admin operations
    17	type Handler struct {
    18		service *Service
    19	}
    20	
    21	// NewHandler creates a new admin handler
    22	func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
    23		return &Handler{service: service}
    24	}
    25	
    26	// LoginRequest represents a login request
    27	type LoginRequest struct {
    28		Username string `json:"username" binding:"required"`
    29		Password string `json:"password" binding:"required"`
    30	}
    31	
    32	// LoginResponse represents a login response
    33	type LoginResponse struct {
    34		Token string     `json:"token"`
    35		Admin *AdminUser `json:"admin"`
    36	}
    37	
    38	// UpdatePasswordRequest represents an update password request
    39	type UpdatePasswordRequest struct {
    40		OldPassword string `json:"old_password" binding:"required"`
    41		NewPassword string `json:"new_password" binding:"required,min=8"`
    42	}
    43	
    44	// VerifyPasswordRequest represents a verify password request
    45	type VerifyPasswordRequest struct {
    46		Password string `json:"password" binding:"required"`
    47	}
    48	
    49	// Login handles admin login
    50	func (h *Handler) Login(c *gin.Context) {
    51		var req LoginRequest
    52		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    53			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
    54			return
    55		}
    56	
    57		admin, token, err := h.service.Login(req.Username, req.Password)
    58		if err != nil {
    59			utils.Error(c, 1001, err.Error())
    60			return
    61		}
    62	
    63		utils.Success(c, LoginResponse{
    64			Token: token,
    65			Admin: admin,
    66		})
    67	}
    68	
    69	// GetProfile handles getting admin profile
    70	func (h *Handler) GetProfile(c *gin.Context) {
    71		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    72		if !exists {
    73			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
    74			return
    75		}
    76	
    77		admin, err := h.service.GetProfile(userID.(uint))
    78		if err != nil {
    79			utils.Error(c, 1002, "Failed to get profile")
    80			return
    81		}
    82	
    83		if admin == nil {
    84			utils.Error(c, 1003, "Admin not found")
    85			return
    86		}
    87	
    88		utils.Success(c, admin)
    89	}
    90	
    91	// UpdatePassword handles updating admin password
    92	func (h *Handler) UpdatePassword(c *gin.Context) {
    93		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    94		if !exists {
    95			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
    96			return
    97		}
    98	
    99		var req UpdatePasswordRequest
   100		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   101			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   102			return
   103		}
   104	
   105		err := h.service.UpdatePassword(userID.(uint), req.OldPassword, req.NewPassword)
   106		if err != nil {
   107			utils.Error(c, 1004, err.Error())
   108			return
   109		}
   110	
   111		utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "Password updated successfully", nil)
   112	}
   113	
   114	// VerifyPassword handles verifying admin password (for sensitive operations)
   115	func (h *Handler) VerifyPassword(c *gin.Context) {
   116		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   117		if !exists {
   118			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
   119			return
   120		}
   121	
   122		var req VerifyPasswordRequest
   123		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   124			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   125			return
   126		}
   127	
   128		valid, err := h.service.VerifyPassword(userID.(uint), req.Password)
   129		if err != nil {
   130			utils.Error(c, 1005, err.Error())
   131			return
   132		}
   133	
   134		if !valid {
   135			utils.Error(c, 1006, "Invalid password")
   136			return
   137		}
   138	
   139		utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "Password verified successfully", nil)
   140	}

   145		{
   146			admin.POST("/login", h.Login)
   147			// Protected routes (require authentication)
   148			// These will be added in the main server setup with middleware
   149		}

    17	// Repository handles database operations for admin users
    18	type Repository struct {
    19		db *gorm.DB
    20	}
    21	
    22	// NewRepository creates a new admin repository
    23	func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
    24		return &Repository{db: db}
    25	}
    26	
    27	// FindByUsername finds an admin user by username
    28	func (r *Repository) FindByUsername(username string) (*AdminUser, error) {
    29		var admin AdminUser
    30		err := r.db.Where("username = ?", username).First(&admin).Error
    31		if err != nil {
    32			if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
    33				return nil, nil
    34			}
    35			return nil, err
    36		}
    37		return &admin, nil
    38	}
    39	
    40	// FindByID finds an admin user by ID
    41	func (r *Repository) FindByID(id uint) (*AdminUser, error) {
    42		var admin AdminUser
    43		err := r.db.First(&admin, id).Error
    44		if err != nil {
    45			if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
    46				return nil, nil
    47			}
    48			return nil, err
    49		}
    50		return &admin, nil
    51	}
    52	
    53	// Create creates a new admin user
    54	func (r *Repository) Create(admin *AdminUser) error {
    55		return r.db.Create(admin).Error
    56	}
    57	
    58	// Update updates an admin user
    59	func (r *Repository) Update(admin *AdminUser) error {
    60		return r.db.Save(admin).Error
    61	}
    62	
    63	// UpdatePassword updates an admin user's password
    64	func (r *Repository) UpdatePassword(id uint, passwordHash string) error {
    65		return r.db.Model(&AdminUser{}).Where("id = ?", id).Update("password_hash", passwordHash).Error
    66	}
    67	
    68	// UpdateLastLogin updates the last login timestamp
    69	func (r *Repository) UpdateLastLogin(id uint) error {
    70		now := time.Now()
    71		return r.db.Model(&AdminUser{}).Where("id = ?", id).Update("last_login_at", now).Error
    72	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package admin
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"errors"
    12		"scholar-backend/internal/common/utils"
    13	)
    14	
    15	// Service handles business logic for admin operations
    16	type Service struct {
    17		repo *Repository
    18	}
    19	
    20	// NewService creates a new admin service
    21	func NewService(repo *Repository) *Service {
    22		return &Service{repo: repo}
    23	}
    24	
    25	// Login authenticates an admin user
    26	func (s *Service) Login(username, password string) (*AdminUser, string, error) {
    27		admin, err := s.repo.FindByUsername(username)
    28		if err != nil {
    29			return nil, "", err
    30		}
    31	
    32		if admin == nil {
    33			return nil, "", errors.New("invalid username or password")
    34		}
    35	
    36		if admin.Status != 1 {
    37			return nil, "", errors.New("account is inactive")
    38		}
    39	
    40		if !utils.CheckPassword(password, admin.PasswordHash) {
    41			return nil, "", errors.New("invalid username or password")
    42		}
    43	
    44		// Generate JWT token
    45		token, err := utils.GenerateToken(admin.ID, admin.Username, "admin")
    46		if err != nil {
    47			return nil, "", err
    48		}
    49	
    50		// Update last login time
    51		_ = s.repo.UpdateLastLogin(admin.ID)
    52	
    53		return admin, token, nil
    54	}
    55	
    56	// UpdatePassword updates an admin user's password
    57	func (s *Service) UpdatePassword(id uint, oldPassword, newPassword string) error {
    58		admin, err := s.repo.FindByID(id)
    59		if err != nil {
    60			return err
    61		}
    62	
    63		if admin == nil {
    64			return errors.New("admin user not found")
    65		}
    66	
    67		if !utils.CheckPassword(oldPassword, admin.PasswordHash) {
    68			return errors.New("invalid old password")
    69		}
    70	
    71		hashedPassword, err := utils.HashPassword(newPassword)
    72		if err != nil {
    73			return err
    74		}
    75	
    76		return s.repo.UpdatePassword(id, hashedPassword)
    77	}
    78	
    79	// VerifyPassword verifies an admin user's password (for sensitive operations)
    80	func (s *Service) VerifyPassword(id uint, password string) (bool, error) {
    81		admin, err := s.repo.FindByID(id)
    82		if err != nil {
    83			return false, err
    84		}
    85	
    86		if admin == nil {
    87			return false, errors.New("admin user not found")
    88		}
    89	
    90		return utils.CheckPassword(password, admin.PasswordHash), nil
    91	}
    92	
    93	// GetProfile gets an admin user's profile
    94	func (s *Service) GetProfile(id uint) (*AdminUser, error) {
    95		return s.repo.FindByID(id)
    96	}
    97	
    98	// InitializeDefaultAdmin creates the default admin user if not exists
    99	func (s *Service) InitializeDefaultAdmin(username, password string) error {
   100		existing, err := s.repo.FindByUsername(username)
   101		if err != nil {
   102			return err
   103		}
   104	
   105		if existing != nil {
   106			// Default admin already exists
   107			return nil
   108		}
   109	
   110		hashedPassword, err := utils.HashPassword(password)
   111		if err != nil {
   112			return err
   113		}
   114	
   115		admin := &AdminUser{
   116			Username:     username,
   117			PasswordHash: hashedPassword,
   118			Status:       1,
   119		}
   120	
   121		return s.repo.Create(admin)
   122	}

    58	// CreatePromptTemplate creates a new prompt template
    59	func (h *Handler) CreatePromptTemplate(c *gin.Context) {
    60		var req struct {
    61			Name        string `json:"name" binding:"required"`
    62			Key         string `json:"key" binding:"required"`
    63			Template    string `json:"template" binding:"required"`
    64			Description string `json:"description"`
    65			IsActive    bool   `json:"is_active"` // Frontend sends bool, we'll convert
    66		}
    67	
    68		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    69			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
    70			return
    71		}

    73		isActive := 0
    74		if req.IsActive {
    75			isActive = 1
    76		}
    77	
    78		template := &PromptTemplate{
    79			Name:        req.Name,
    80			Key:         req.Key,
    81			Template:    req.Template,
    82			Description: req.Description,
    83			IsActive:    isActive,
    84		}
    85	
    86		if err := h.service.CreatePromptTemplate(template); err != nil {
    87			utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to create template: "+err.Error())
    88			return
    89		}
    90	
    91		utils.Success(c, template)
    92	}

   100		}
   101

   105			Description string `json:"description"`

   154	// AnalyzePaperRequest 论文分析请求结构
   155	type AnalyzePaperRequest struct {
   156		PaperID  string `json:"paperId"`                       // 论文ID，用于数据库缓存
   157		Title    string `json:"title"`
   158		Abstract string `json:"abstract" binding:"required"`
   159	}
   160	
   161	// AnalyzePaper 分析论文摘要，提取结构化信息
   162	// POST /api/v1/public/papers/analyze (公共接口，使用系统默认维度)
   163	// POST /api/v1/analysis/paper (需登录，使用用户自定义维度)
   164	// 优先从数据库缓存获取，如果没有则调用AI分析并保存结果
   165	func (h *Handler) AnalyzePaper(c *gin.Context) {
   166		var req AnalyzePaperRequest
   167		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   168			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   169			return
   170		}
   171	
   172		if req.Abstract == "" {
   173			utils.Error(c, 400, "Abstract is required for analysis")
   174			return
   175		}
   176	
   177		// 限制摘要长度，避免过长的请求
   178		if len(req.Abstract) > 5000 {
   179			utils.Error(c, 400, "Abstract exceeds 5000 characters limit")
   180			return
   181		}
   182	
   183		// 尝试从上下文获取用户ID（公共接口为nil，使用系统默认维度）
   184		var userID *uint
   185		if uid, exists := c.Get("user_id"); exists {
   186			if id, ok := uid.(uint); ok && id > 0 {
   187				userID = &id
   188			}
   189		}
   190	
   191		result, err := h.service.AnalyzePaperAbstract(req.PaperID, req.Title, req.Abstract, userID)
   192		if err != nil {
   193			utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to analyze paper: "+err.Error())
   194			return
   195		}
   196	
   197		utils.Success(c, result)
   198	}
   199	
   200	// GetAnalysisDimensions 获取分析维度列表
   201	// GET /api/v1/public/analysis/dimensions - 公共接口，返回系统默认维度
   202	// GET /api/v1/analysis/dimensions - 需登录，返回用户自定义维度或系统默认维度
   203	func (h *Handler) GetAnalysisDimensions(c *gin.Context) {
   204		// 尝试从上下文获取用户ID
   205		var userID *uint
   206		if uid, exists := c.Get("user_id"); exists {
   207			if id, ok := uid.(uint); ok && id > 0 {
   208				userID = &id
   209			}
   210		}
   211	
   212		result, err := h.service.GetAnalysisDimensions(userID)
   213		if err != nil {
   214			utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to get dimensions: "+err.Error())
   215			return
   216		}
   217	
   218		// 计算用户新增的自定义维度数量（不包括对系统维度的修改）
   219		customCount := 0
   220		if userID != nil {
   221			systemDimensions, _ := h.service.GetSystemDimensions()
   222			systemKeySet := make(map[string]bool)
   223			for _, sd := range systemDimensions {
   224				systemKeySet[sd.DimensionKey] = true
   225			}
   226			for _, d := range result.Dimensions {
   227				if d.UserID > 0 && !systemKeySet[d.DimensionKey] {
   228					customCount++
   229				}
   230			}
   231		}
   232	
   233		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
   234			"dimensions":    result.Dimensions,
   235			"total":         len(result.Dimensions),
   236			"isCustom":      result.IsCustom,
   237			"maxDimensions": MaxUserDimensions, // 最大维度数量
   238			"customCount":   customCount,       // 用户新增的自定义维度数量
   239		})
   240	}

   249		}

   255	}

   296	// UpdateUserDimension 更新用户自定义维度
   297	// PUT /api/v1/analysis/dimensions/:id
   298	func (h *Handler) UpdateUserDimension(c *gin.Context) {
   299		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   300		if !exists {
   301			utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
   302			return
   303		}
   304	
   305		dimensionID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
   306		if err != nil {
   307			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid dimension ID")
   308			return
   309		}
   310	
   311		var req UpdateUserDimensionRequest

     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

     8	package ai
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"net/http"
    12		"time"
    13	)
    14	
    15	var (
    16		// sharedTransport is the shared transport with connection pooling
    17		sharedTransport = &http.Transport{
    18			// Connection pool settings
    19			MaxIdleConns:          100,              // Maximum idle connections across all hosts
    20			MaxIdleConnsPerHost:   10,               // Maximum idle connections per host
    21			MaxConnsPerHost:       50,               // Maximum connections per host
    22			IdleConnTimeout:       90 * time.Second, // Idle connection timeout
    23			TLSHandshakeTimeout:   10 * time.Second, // TLS handshake timeout
    24			ExpectContinueTimeout: 1 * time.Second,  // Expect: 100-continue timeout
    25			DisableKeepAlives:     false,            // Enable HTTP Keep-Alive
    26			DisableCompression:    false,            // Enable compression
    27			ResponseHeaderTimeout: 60 * time.Second, // Wait for response headers (not body)
    28		}
    29	
    30		// defaultHTTPClient is a singleton HTTP client with connection pooling enabled
    31		// This client is shared across all AI service requests to reuse TCP connections
    32		// and avoid the overhead of establishing new connections for each request.
    33		// Note: Timeout is set to 5 minutes for non-streaming requests
    34		defaultHTTPClient = &http.Client{
    35			Timeout:   5 * time.Minute,
    36			Transport: sharedTransport,
    37		}
    38	
    39		// streamingHTTPClient is for streaming requests that may take longer
    40		// No overall timeout since streaming responses can take a long time
    41		// The ResponseHeaderTimeout in transport ensures we don't wait forever for the initial response
    42		streamingHTTPClient = &http.Client{
    43			Timeout:   0, // No timeout for streaming - response can take as long as needed
    44			Transport: sharedTransport,
    45		}
    46	)
    47	
    48	// GetHTTPClient returns the shared HTTP client for AI service requests.
    49	// This client has connection pooling enabled and should be used for all
    50	// external API calls to maximize performance.
    51	func GetHTTPClient() *http.Client {
    52		return defaultHTTPClient
    53	}
    54	
    55	// GetStreamingHTTPClient returns a HTTP client optimized for streaming requests.
    56	// This client has no overall timeout since streaming responses can take a long time.
    57	func GetStreamingHTTPClient() *http.Client {
    58		return streamingHTTPClient
    59	}

    17	type TemplateVariables map[string]interface{}
    18	
    19	// Scan implements sql.Scanner for Variables field
    20	func (v *TemplateVariables) Scan(value interface{}) error {
    21		if value == nil {
    22			*v = nil
    23			return nil
    24		}
    25	
    26		bytes, ok := value.([]byte)
    27		if !ok {
    28			return nil
    29		}
    30	
    31		return json.Unmarshal(bytes, v)
    32	}
    33	
    34	// Value implements driver.Valuer for Variables field
    35	func (v TemplateVariables) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
    36		if v == nil {
    37			return nil, nil
    38		}
    39		return json.Marshal(v)
    40	}

    32	// min returns the smaller of two integers
    33	func min(a, b int) int {
    34		if a < b {
    35			return a
    36		}
    37		return b
    38	}

    40	type Service struct {
    41		db             *gorm.DB
    42		accountService *thirdparty.Service
    43	}
    44	
    45	func NewService(db *gorm.DB, accountService *thirdparty.Service) *Service {
    46		return &Service{
    47			db:             db,
    48			accountService: accountService,
    49		}

    52	// AI 重试相关常量
    53	const AIMaxRetries = 5
    54	
    55	// isAIRetryableError 检查是否是可重试的 AI 错误
    56	// 只要是 API 错误（非 200 响应）都应该重试，切换到其他账号
    57	func isAIRetryableError(err error) bool {
    58		if err == nil {
    59			return false
    60		}
    61		errStr := err.Error()
    62		// 所有 "API error (status xxx)" 格式的错误都是非200响应，都应该重试
    63		// 这包括 401/403/429/500/502/503 等所有非 200 错误
    64		return strings.Contains(errStr, "API error (status")
    65	}
    66	
    67	// RetryableError 包装可重试的错误，用于告诉熔断器这不应该计入失败
    68	type RetryableError struct {
    69		Err error
    70	}
    71	
    72	func (e *RetryableError) Error() string {
    73		return e.Err.Error()
    74	}
    75	
    76	// wrapRetryableError 将可重试的错误包装，避免触发熔断器
    77	func wrapRetryableError(err error) error {
    78		if isAIRetryableError(err) {
    79			return &RetryableError{Err: err}
    80		}
    81		return err
    82	}
    83	
    84	// TranslateToEnglish 将查询翻译成英文学术术语（实现 QueryTranslator 接口）
    85	// 使用Redis缓存避免重复翻译，缓存时间12小时
    86	// 如果查询本身已经是英文，返回空字符串（不需要翻译）
    87	func (s *Service) TranslateToEnglish(query string) (string, error) {
    88		ctx := context.Background()
    89		
    90		// 1. 生成缓存key（使用MD5避免特殊字符）
    91		cacheKey := generateTranslationCacheKey(query)
    92		
    93		// 2. 尝试从Redis缓存获取
    94		// 使用特殊标记区分"未缓存"和"缓存了空值"
    95		translationCache := cache.NewQueryCache("translation", 12*time.Hour)
    96		var cachedResult translationCacheResult
    97		err := translationCache.Get(ctx, cacheKey, &cachedResult)
    98		if err == nil && cachedResult.Cached {
    99			if cachedResult.Translation == "" {
   100				fmt.Printf("[Translation Cache] Hit for query: '%s' -> (empty, no translation needed)\n", query)
   101			} else {
   102				fmt.Printf("[Translation Cache] Hit for query: '%s' -> '%s'\n", query, cachedResult.Translation)
   103			}
   104			return cachedResult.Translation, nil
   105		}
   106		
   107		fmt.Printf("[Translation Cache] Miss for query: '%s', calling AI...\n", query)
   108		
   109		// 3. 缓存未命中，调用AI翻译
   110		// 优先从数据库读取提示词模版，本地兜底
   111		var translatePrompt string
   112		
   113		// 尝试从数据库获取提示词模版
   114		renderedPrompt, template, err := s.GetAndRenderPrompt("search_term_translation", map[string]string{
   115			"query": query,
   116		})
   117		
   118		if err != nil || template == nil {
   119			// 数据库获取失败，使用本地兜底提示词
   120			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get prompt template from DB: %v, using fallback\n", err)
   121			translatePrompt = fmt.Sprintf(`你是一个专业的学术翻译助手。请将以下查询关键词翻译成准确的英文学术术语。
   122	
   123	要求：
   124	1. 如果查询已经是纯英文（包括英文单词、缩写、专有名词等），直接返回空内容，不要返回任何文字
   125	2. 如果查询包含非英文内容（如中文、日文等），将其翻译成准确的英文学术术语
   126	3. 只返回翻译后的英文，不要有任何额外说明
   127	4. 保持学术专业性
   128	
   129	查询：%s
   130	
   131	翻译（如果是英文则返回空）：`, query)
   132		} else {
   133			// 成功从数据库获取提示词模版
   134			translatePrompt = renderedPrompt
   135			fmt.Printf("[INFO] Using prompt template from DB: '%s' (ID: %d)\n", template.Name, template.ID)
   136		}
   137	
   138		messages := []ChatMessage{
   139			{
   140				Role:    "user",
   141				Content: translatePrompt,
   142			},
   143		}
   144	
   145		// 使用low级别模型调用AI
   146		response, err := s.ChatCompletionWithTools(messages, nil, "", thirdparty.ModelLevelLow)
   147		if err != nil {
   148			return "", fmt.Errorf("AI translation failed: %w", err)
   149		}
   150		
   151		if len(response.Choices) == 0 {
   152			return "", fmt.Errorf("no response from AI")
   153		}
   154	
   155		translatedText := strings.TrimSpace(response.Choices[0].Message.Content)
   156		
   157		// 4. 存入Redis缓存（异步，失败不影响返回）
   158		// 使用结构体缓存，支持缓存空值
   159		go func() {
   160			cacheResult := translationCacheResult{
   161				Cached:      true,
   162				Translation: translatedText,
   163			}
   164			if err := translationCache.Set(context.Background(), cacheKey, cacheResult); err != nil {
   165				fmt.Printf("[Translation Cache] Failed to cache translation: %v\n", err)
   166			} else {
   167				if translatedText == "" {
   168					fmt.Printf("[Translation Cache] Cached: '%s' -> (empty, no translation needed)\n", query)
   169				} else {
   170					fmt.Printf("[Translation Cache] Cached: '%s' -> '%s'\n", query, translatedText)
   171				}
   172			}
   173		}()
   174	
   175		return translatedText, nil
   176	}
   177	
   178	// translationCacheResult 翻译缓存结果结构体
   179	// 用于区分"未缓存"和"缓存了空值"的情况
   180	type translationCacheResult struct {
   181		Cached      bool   `json:"cached"`      // 是否已缓存
   182		Translation string `json:"translation"` // 翻译结果，空字符串表示不需要翻译
   183	}
   184	
   185	// generateTranslationCacheKey 生成翻译缓存的key
   186	// 使用MD5哈希避免特殊字符和长度问题
   187	func generateTranslationCacheKey(query string) string {
   188		hash := md5.Sum([]byte(strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(query))))
   189		return hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
   190	}

   222	func (s *Service) GetPromptTemplate(key string) (*PromptTemplate, error) {
   223		var template PromptTemplate
   224		err := s.db.Where("`key` = ? AND is_active = 1", key).First(&template).Error
   225		if err != nil {
   226			return nil, err
   227		}
   228		return &template, nil

   231	// RenderPrompt renders a template with variables
   232	func (s *Service) RenderPrompt(template string, variables map[string]string) string {
   233		result := template
   234		for key, value := range variables {
   235			placeholder := fmt.Sprintf("{{%s}}", key)
   236			result = strings.ReplaceAll(result, placeholder, value)
   237		}
   238		return result
   239	}
   240	
   241	// GetAndRenderPrompt gets a prompt template by key and renders it with variables
   242	// Returns the rendered prompt and the template (for fallback scenarios)
   243	func (s *Service) GetAndRenderPrompt(key string, variables map[string]string) (string, *PromptTemplate, error) {
   244		template, err := s.GetPromptTemplate(key)
   245		if err != nil {
   246			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get prompt template '%s': %w", key, err)
   247		}
   248	
   249		rendered := s.RenderPrompt(template.Template, variables)
   250		return rendered, template, nil
   251	}

   253	// ChatCompletionWithTools sends a chat completion request with tools (non-streaming)
   254	// Includes automatic retry logic with account switching on 403/429 errors
   255	func (s *Service) ChatCompletionWithTools(messages []ChatMessage, tools []Tool, toolChoice string, modelLevel thirdparty.ModelLevel) (*ChatCompletionResponse, error) {
   256		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] ChatCompletionWithTools called, messages: %d, tools: %d, modelLevel: %s\n", len(messages), len(tools), modelLevel)
   257	
   258		var lastErr error
   259		var excludeAccountIDs []uint
   260	
   261		for attempt := 0; attempt <= AIMaxRetries; attempt++ {
   262			// Get AI model config by level, excluding previously failed accounts
   263			config, accountID, err := s.accountService.GetRandomAIModelConfigByLevelExcluding(modelLevel, excludeAccountIDs)
   264			if err != nil {
   265				fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Attempt %d: Failed to get AI config: %v\n", attempt+1, err)
   266				lastErr = err
   267				continue
   268			}
   269	
   270			if attempt > 0 {
   271				fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Attempt %d/%d with account ID: %d, model: %s\n", attempt+1, AIMaxRetries+1, accountID, config.ModelLow)
   272			} else {
   273				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Got AI config, BaseURL: %s, Model: %s, AccountID: %d\n", config.BaseURL, config.ModelLow, accountID)
   274			}
   275	
   276			// ModelLow field contains the actual model code for the requested level
   277			modelCode := config.ModelLow
   278			if modelCode == "" {
   279				modelCode = "gpt-3.5-turbo" // Final fallback
   280			}
   281	
   282			// Prepare request
   283			reqBody := ChatCompletionRequest{
   284				Model:       modelCode,
   285				Messages:    messages,
   286				Tools:       tools,
   287				ToolChoice:  toolChoice,
   288				Stream:      false,
   289				Temperature: 0.7,
   290				MaxTokens:   4096, // 确保有足够的输出 token
   291			}
   292	
   293			jsonData, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
   294			if err != nil {
   295				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request: %w", err)
   296			}
   297	
   298			// Debug: Print tool request details
   299			if attempt == 0 {
   300				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call request body (first 500 chars): %s\n", string(jsonData[:min(500, len(jsonData))]))
   301				if len(tools) > 0 {
   302					fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] First tool: name=%s, description=%s\n", tools[0].Function.Name, tools[0].Function.Description)
   303				}
   304			}
   305	
   306			// Create HTTP request
   307			url := strings.TrimSuffix(config.BaseURL, "/") + "/v1/chat/completions"
   308			req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(jsonData))
   309			if err != nil {
   310				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
   311			}
   312	
   313			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   314			req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+config.APIKey)
   315	
   316			// Send request using shared HTTP client for connection pooling with circuit breaker protection
   317			client := GetHTTPClient()
   318	
   319			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Sending tool call request to: %s, model: %s\n", url, modelCode)
   320	
   321			// Execute with circuit breaker protection
   322			resultInterface, err := circuitbreaker.AIServiceBreaker.Execute(func() (interface{}, error) {
   323				resp, err := client.Do(req)
   324				if err != nil {
   325					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Tool call request failed: %v\n", err)
   326					return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to send request: %w", err)
   327				}
   328				defer resp.Body.Close()
   329				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call response status: %d\n", resp.StatusCode)
   330	
   331				if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
   332					body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   333					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Tool call API error, status %d: %s\n", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
   334					return nil, fmt.Errorf("API error (status %d): %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
   335				}
   336	
   337				// Parse response
   338				var result ChatCompletionResponse
   339				if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result); err != nil {
   340					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Failed to decode tool call response: %v\n", err)
   341					return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode response: %w", err)
   342				}
   343	
   344				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call completed successfully, got %d choices\n", len(result.Choices))
   345				if len(result.Choices) > 0 {
   346					fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] First choice has %d tool calls\n", len(result.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls))
   347					// Debug: Print the AI's response message
   348					if result.Choices[0].Message.Content != "" {
   349						fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] AI response content (no tool call): %s\n", result.Choices[0].Message.Content[:min(200, len(result.Choices[0].Message.Content))])
   350					}
   351				}
   352	
   353				return &result, nil
   354			})
   355	
   356			if err != nil {
   357				lastErr = err
   358	
   359				// Check if circuit breaker is open
   360				if circuitbreaker.IsCircuitBreakerError(err) {
   361					return nil, fmt.Errorf("AI service temporarily unavailable (circuit breaker open): %w", err)
   362				}
   363	
   364				// Check if error is retryable (403/429)
   365				if isAIRetryableError(err) {
   366					fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Retryable error (403/429) with account %d: %v\n", accountID, err)
   367					excludeAccountIDs = append(excludeAccountIDs, accountID)
   368					continue
   369				}
   370	
   371				// Non-retryable error, return immediately
   372				fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Non-retryable AI error: %v\n", err)
   373				return nil, err
   374			}
   375	
   376			// Success
   377			return resultInterface.(*ChatCompletionResponse), nil
   378		}
   379	
   380		return nil, fmt.Errorf("all %d AI retry attempts failed, last error: %w", AIMaxRetries+1, lastErr)
   381	}

   383	// StreamChatCompletionWithLevel sends a streaming chat completion request with a specific model level
   384	// Includes automatic retry logic with account switching on 403/429 errors
   385	func (s *Service) StreamChatCompletionWithLevel(messages []ChatMessage, writer io.Writer, modelLevel thirdparty.ModelLevel) error {
   386		var lastErr error
   387		var excludeAccountIDs []uint
   388	
   389		for attempt := 0; attempt <= AIMaxRetries; attempt++ {
   390			// Get AI model config by level, excluding previously failed accounts
   391			config, accountID, err := s.accountService.GetRandomAIModelConfigByLevelExcluding(modelLevel, excludeAccountIDs)
   392			if err != nil {
   393				fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Attempt %d: Failed to get AI config: %v\n", attempt+1, err)
   394				lastErr = err
   395				continue
   396			}
   397	
   398			if attempt > 0 {
   399				fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Attempt %d/%d with account ID: %d, model: %s\n", attempt+1, AIMaxRetries+1, accountID, config.ModelLow)
   400			}
   401	
   402			// Prepare request - ModelLow field contains the actual model code for this level
   403			modelCode := config.ModelLow
   404			if modelCode == "" {
   405				modelCode = "gpt-3.5-turbo"
   406			}
   407	
   408			reqBody := ChatCompletionRequest{
   409				Model:       modelCode,
   410				Messages:    messages,
   411				Stream:      true,
   412				Temperature: 0.7,
   413			}
   414	
   415			jsonData, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
   416			if err != nil {
   417				return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request: %w", err)
   418			}
   419	
   420			// Create HTTP request
   421			url := strings.TrimSuffix(config.BaseURL, "/") + "/v1/chat/completions"
   422			req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(jsonData))
   423			if err != nil {
   424				return fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
   425			}
   426	
   427			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   428			req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+config.APIKey)
   429	
   430			// Send request using streaming HTTP client (no timeout) for long-running streaming requests
   431			client := GetStreamingHTTPClient()
   432	
   433			// Execute with circuit breaker protection
   434			_, err = circuitbreaker.AIServiceBreaker.Execute(func() (interface{}, error) {
   435				resp, err := client.Do(req)
   436				if err != nil {
   437					return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to send request: %w", err)
   438				}
   439				defer resp.Body.Close()
   440	
   441				if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
   442					body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   443					return nil, fmt.Errorf("API error (status %d): %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
   444				}
   445	
   446				// Stream response
   447				return nil, s.streamResponse(resp.Body, writer)
   448			})
   449	
   450			if err != nil {
   451				lastErr = err
   452	
   453				// Check if circuit breaker is open
   454				if circuitbreaker.IsCircuitBreakerError(err) {
   455					return fmt.Errorf("AI service temporarily unavailable (circuit breaker open): %w", err)
   456				}
   457	
   458				// Check if error is retryable (403/429)
   459				if isAIRetryableError(err) {
   460					fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Retryable error (403/429) with account %d: %v\n", accountID, err)
   461					excludeAccountIDs = append(excludeAccountIDs, accountID)
   462					continue
   463				}
   464	
   465				// Non-retryable error, return immediately
   466				return err
   467			}
   468	
   469			// Success
   470			return nil
   471		}
   472	
   473		return fmt.Errorf("all %d AI retry attempts failed, last error: %w", AIMaxRetries+1, lastErr)
   474	}

   531			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Creating request to URL: %s\n", url)

   536			}
   537			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] HTTP request created successfully\n")
   538

   540			req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+config.APIKey)
   541

   543			client := GetStreamingHTTPClient()
   544	
   545			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Sending AI request, model: %s, url: %s, level: %s\n", reqBody.Model, url, modelLevel)
   546	
   547			// Execute with circuit breaker protection
   548			resultInterface, err := circuitbreaker.AIServiceBreaker.Execute(func() (interface{}, error) {
   549				resp, err := client.Do(req)
   550				if err != nil {
   551					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI request failed: %v\n", err)
   552					return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to send request: %w", err)
   553				}
   554				defer resp.Body.Close()
   555	
   556				if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
   557					body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   558					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI API returned status %d, model: %s, body: %s\n", resp.StatusCode, reqBody.Model, string(body))
   559					return nil, fmt.Errorf("API error (status %d): %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
   560				}
   561	
   562				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] AI API call successful, model: %s, starting to stream response\n", reqBody.Model)
   563				// Stream response and collect content
   564				return s.streamResponseAndCollect(resp.Body, writer)
   565			})
   566	
   567			if err != nil {
   568				lastErr = err
   569	
   570				// Check if circuit breaker is open
   571				if circuitbreaker.IsCircuitBreakerError(err) {
   572					return "", fmt.Errorf("AI service temporarily unavailable (circuit breaker open): %w", err)
   573				}
   574	
   575				// Check if error is retryable (403/429)
   576				if isAIRetryableError(err) {
   577					fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Retryable error (403/429) with account %d: %v\n", accountID, err)
   578					excludeAccountIDs = append(excludeAccountIDs, accountID)
   579					continue
   580				}
   581	
   582				// Non-retryable error, return immediately
   583				return "", err
   584			}
   585	
   586			// Success
   587			return resultInterface.(string), nil
   588		}
   589	
   590		return "", fmt.Errorf("all %d AI retry attempts failed, last error: %w", AIMaxRetries+1, lastErr)
   591	}

   600	// streamResponse reads SSE stream and writes to output
   601	func (s *Service) streamResponse(reader io.Reader, writer io.Writer) error {
   602		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(reader)
   603		// Increase buffer size to handle large SSE messages (1MB)
   604		const maxScannerBuffer = 1024 * 1024
   605		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, maxScannerBuffer), maxScannerBuffer)
   606	
   607		for scanner.Scan() {
   608			line := scanner.Text()
   609	
   610			// Skip empty lines
   611			if line == "" {
   612				continue
   613			}
   614	
   615			// Check for SSE data line
   616			if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: ") {
   617				continue
   618			}
   619	
   620			data := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: ")
   621	
   622			// Check for stream end
   623			if data == "[DONE]" {
   624				break
   625			}
   626	
   627			// Parse JSON chunk
   628			var chunk ChatCompletionChunk
   629			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(data), &chunk); err != nil {
   630				// Log error but continue
   631				fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to parse chunk: %v\n", err)
   632				continue
   633			}
   634	
   635			// Extract content and forward the entire chunk as JSON
   636			if len(chunk.Choices) > 0 && chunk.Choices[0].Delta.Content != "" {
   637				// Marshal the chunk back to JSON
   638				chunkJSON, err := json.Marshal(chunk)
   639				if err != nil {
   640					fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to marshal chunk: %v\n", err)
   641					continue
   642				}
   643	
   644				// Write SSE formatted data
   645				_, err = fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: %s\n\n", string(chunkJSON))
   646				if err != nil {
   647					return err
   648				}
   649	
   650				// Flush if writer is a flusher
   651				if flusher, ok := writer.(http.Flusher); ok {
   652					flusher.Flush()
   653				}
   654			}
   655		}
   656	
   657		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
   658			return fmt.Errorf("error reading stream: %w", err)
   659		}
   660	
   661		return nil
   662	}
   663	
   664	// streamResponseAndCollect reads SSE stream, writes to output, and collects full content
   665	func (s *Service) streamResponseAndCollect(reader io.Reader, writer io.Writer) (string, error) {
   666		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(reader)
   667		// Increase buffer size to handle large SSE messages (1MB)
   668		const maxScannerBuffer = 1024 * 1024
   669		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, maxScannerBuffer), maxScannerBuffer)
   670		var fullContent strings.Builder
   671	
   672		for scanner.Scan() {
   673			line := scanner.Text()
   674	
   675			// Skip empty lines
   676			if line == "" {
   677				continue
   678			}
   679	
   680			// Check for SSE data line
   681			if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: ") {
   682				continue
   683			}
   684	
   685			data := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: ")
   686	
   687			// Check for stream end
   688			if data == "[DONE]" {
   689				break
   690			}
   691	
   692			// Parse JSON chunk
   693			var chunk ChatCompletionChunk
   694			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(data), &chunk); err != nil {
   695				// Log error but continue
   696				fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to parse chunk: %v\n", err)
   697				continue
   698			}
   699	
   700			// Extract content and forward the entire chunk as JSON
   701			if len(chunk.Choices) > 0 && chunk.Choices[0].Delta.Content != "" {
   702				content := chunk.Choices[0].Delta.Content
   703	
   704				// Collect content
   705				fullContent.WriteString(content)
   706	
   707				// Marshal the chunk back to JSON
   708				chunkJSON, err := json.Marshal(chunk)
   709				if err != nil {
   710					fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to marshal chunk: %v\n", err)
   711					continue
   712				}
   713	
   714				// Write SSE formatted data
   715				_, err = fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: %s\n\n", string(chunkJSON))
   716				if err != nil {
   717					return "", err
   718				}
   719	
   720				// Flush if writer is a flusher
   721				if flusher, ok := writer.(http.Flusher); ok {
   722					flusher.Flush()
   723				}
   724			}
   725		}
   726	
   727		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
   728			return "", fmt.Errorf("error reading stream: %w", err)
   729		}
   730	
   731		return fullContent.String(), nil
   732	}
   733	
   734	// ConvertMCPToolsToOpenAIFormat converts MCP tools to OpenAI function calling format
   735	func ConvertMCPToolsToOpenAIFormat(mcpTools []mcp.Tool) []Tool {
   736		tools := make([]Tool, 0, len(mcpTools))
   737	
   738		for _, mcpTool := range mcpTools {
   739			tool := Tool{
   740				Type: "function",
   741				Function: ToolFunction{
   742					Name:        mcpTool.Name,
   743					Description: mcpTool.Description,
   744					Parameters:  mcpTool.InputSchema,
   745				},
   746			}
   747			tools = append(tools, tool)
   748		}
   749	
   750		return tools
   751	}

   753	// FormatPapersForPrompt formats papers list for prompt with flexible limits
   754	func FormatPapersForPrompt(papers []map[string]interface{}) string {
   755		return FormatPapersForPromptWithLimit(papers, 20, 300)
   756	}
   757	
   758	// FormatPapersForPromptWithLimit formats papers with custom limits
   759	func FormatPapersForPromptWithLimit(papers []map[string]interface{}, maxPapers int, maxAbstractLen int) string {
   760		var builder strings.Builder
   761	
   762		for i, paper := range papers {
   763			if i >= maxPapers {
   764				break
   765			}
   766	
   767			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n### %d. ", i+1))
   768	
   769			// Title
   770			if title, ok := paper["title"].(string); ok {
   771				builder.WriteString(title)
   772			}
   773			builder.WriteString("\n")
   774	
   775			// Authors (limit to first 3 for brevity)
   776			if authors, ok := paper["authors"].([]interface{}); ok && len(authors) > 0 {
   777				builder.WriteString("**作者**: ")
   778				authorNames := make([]string, 0, len(authors))
   779				maxAuthors := 3
   780				for j, author := range authors {
   781					if j >= maxAuthors {
   782						authorNames = append(authorNames, "等")
   783						break
   784					}
   785					if authorMap, ok := author.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   786						if name, ok := authorMap["name"].(string); ok {
   787							authorNames = append(authorNames, name)
   788						}
   789					}
   790				}
   791				builder.WriteString(strings.Join(authorNames, ", "))
   792				builder.WriteString("\n")
   793			}
   794	
   795			// Year and venue
   796			if year, ok := paper["year"].(float64); ok {
   797				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**年份**: %.0f  ", year))
   798			}
   799			if venue, ok := paper["venue"].(string); ok && venue != "" {
   800				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**期刊/会议**: %s  ", venue))
   801			}
   802			if citationCount, ok := paper["citationCount"].(float64); ok {
   803				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**引用次数**: %.0f", citationCount))
   804			}
   805			builder.WriteString("\n")
   806	
   807			// Abstract
   808			if abstract, ok := paper["abstract"].(string); ok && abstract != "" {
   809				// Limit abstract length
   810				if len(abstract) > maxAbstractLen {
   811					abstract = abstract[:maxAbstractLen] + "..."
   812				}
   813				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**摘要**: %s\n", abstract))
   814			}
   815	
   816			builder.WriteString("\n")
   817		}
   818	
   819		return builder.String()
   820	}
   821	
   822	// TruncateContextForLimit truncates context messages to fit within token limit
   823	// Priority: Keep system messages, current query, and current papers; truncate old messages
   824	func TruncateContextForLimit(messages []ChatMessage, maxChars int) []ChatMessage {
   825		const avgCharsPerToken = 4 // Rough estimate: 1 token ≈ 4 characters for mixed content
   826		maxContextChars := maxChars - 20000 // Reserve space for response
   827	
   828		// Helper function to get content length
   829		getContentLength := func(content MessageContent) int {
   830			if content == nil {
   831				return 0
   832			}
   833			// Handle string content
   834			if strContent, ok := content.(string); ok {
   835				return len(strContent)
   836			}
   837			// Estimate length for other types (rough estimate)
   838			return 100
   839		}
   840	
   841		// Helper function to get content as string for checking
   842		getContentString := func(content MessageContent) string {
   843			if strContent, ok := content.(string); ok {
   844				return strContent
   845			}
   846			return ""
   847		}
   848	
   849		// Calculate total length
   850		totalChars := 0
   851		for _, msg := range messages {
   852			totalChars += getContentLength(msg.Content)
   853		}
   854	
   855		// If within limit, return as is
   856		if totalChars <= maxContextChars {
   857			return messages
   858		}
   859	
   860		// Strategy: Keep first (system) and last messages, truncate middle
   861		var result []ChatMessage
   862	
   863		// Always keep system message if exists
   864		startIdx := 0
   865		if len(messages) > 0 && messages[0].Role == "system" {
   866			result = append(result, messages[0])
   867			startIdx = 1
   868			maxContextChars -= getContentLength(messages[0].Content)
   869		}
   870	
   871		// Keep last few messages (current conversation)
   872		keepLast := 2 // Keep last 2 messages (user query + current context)
   873		if len(messages)-startIdx > keepLast {
   874			// Add truncation notice
   875			result = append(result, ChatMessage{
   876				Role:    "assistant",
   877				Content: "[之前的对话历史已被截断以节省空间]",
   878			})
   879	
   880			// Add last messages
   881			for i := len(messages) - keepLast; i < len(messages); i++ {
   882				msg := messages[i]
   883				contentStr := getContentString(msg.Content)
   884	
   885				// If message contains papers, truncate them
   886				if strings.Contains(contentStr, "### 1.") && len(contentStr) > 10000 {
   887					// This is likely a paper list, truncate it
   888					truncated := contentStr[:5000] + "\n\n[...论文列表已截断...]"
   889					msg.Content = truncated
   890				}
   891				result = append(result, msg)
   892			}
   893		} else {
   894			// Keep all if not many messages
   895			result = append(result, messages[startIdx:]...)
   896		}
   897	
   898		return result
   899	}

   901	
   902	// 论文分析重试次数
   903	const AnalysisMaxRetries = 3
   904	
   905	// 分批请求时每批的维度数量
   906	const DimensionsPerBatch = 4
   907	
   908	// AnalyzePaperAbstract 分析论文摘要，提取结构化信息
   909	// 使用low级别模型进行分析，根据用户的分析维度动态生成提示词
   910	// 优先从数据库缓存获取，如果没有则调用AI分析并保存结果
   911	// 当JSON解析失败时，最多重试3次；如果仍然失败，则按维度分批请求
   912	// userID: 用户ID，用于获取用户自定义的分析维度（nil表示使用系统默认）
   913	func (s *Service) AnalyzePaperAbstract(paperId string, paperTitle string, abstract string, userID *uint) (*PaperAnalysisResult, error) {
   914		if abstract == "" {
   915			return nil, fmt.Errorf("abstract is required for analysis")
   916		}
   917	
   918		// 1. 获取用户的分析维度
   919		dimensionResult, err := s.GetAnalysisDimensions(userID)
   920		if err != nil {
   921			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get analysis dimensions: %w", err)
   922		}
   923	
   924		dimensions := dimensionResult.Dimensions
   925		if len(dimensions) == 0 {
   926			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no active analysis dimensions found")
   927		}
   928	
   929		// 生成维度的哈希值，用于缓存key
   930		dimensionHash := s.generateDimensionHash(dimensions)
   931	
   932		// 2. 检查数据库缓存（需要匹配维度哈希）
   933		if paperId != "" {
   934			var cachedAnalysis PaperAnalysis
   935			if err := s.db.Where("paper_id = ? AND dimension_hash = ?", paperId, dimensionHash).First(&cachedAnalysis).Error; err == nil {
   936				// 找到匹配的缓存，直接返回
   937				fmt.Printf("[INFO] Found cached analysis for paper: %s (dimension_hash: %s)\n", paperId, dimensionHash)
   938				return s.convertCachedAnalysisToResult(cachedAnalysis, dimensions), nil
   939			}
   940			// 没找到匹配的缓存，继续调用AI分析
   941			fmt.Printf("[INFO] No cached analysis found for paper: %s with dimension_hash: %s, calling AI...\n", paperId, dimensionHash)
   942		}
   943	
   944		// 3. 首先尝试一次性分析所有维度（带重试）
   945		resultMap, parseSuccess := s.analyzeWithRetry(paperTitle, abstract, dimensions, paperId)
   946		
   947		// 4. 如果一次性分析失败，尝试分批请求
   948		if !parseSuccess {
   949			fmt.Printf("[INFO] Full analysis failed, trying batch analysis for paper: %s\n", paperId)
   950			resultMap, parseSuccess = s.analyzeInBatches(paperTitle, abstract, dimensions, paperId)
   951		}
   952	
   953		// 5. 只有解析成功才保存到数据库
   954		if parseSuccess && paperId != "" {
   955			analysisDataJSON, _ := json.Marshal(resultMap)
   956			
   957			paperAnalysis := PaperAnalysis{
   958				PaperID:       paperId,
   959				PaperTitle:    paperTitle,
   960				DimensionHash: dimensionHash,
   961				AnalysisData:  string(analysisDataJSON),
   962			}
   963			
   964			if err := s.db.Where("paper_id = ? AND dimension_hash = ?", paperId, dimensionHash).
   965				Assign(paperAnalysis).FirstOrCreate(&paperAnalysis).Error; err != nil {
   966				fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save paper analysis to database: %v\n", err)
   967			} else {
   968				fmt.Printf("[INFO] Saved paper analysis to database for paper: %s (dimension_hash: %s)\n", paperId, dimensionHash)
   969			}
   970		} else if !parseSuccess {
   971			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Analysis failed for paper: %s, not saving to database\n", paperId)
   972		}
   973	
   974		// 6. 转换为 PaperAnalysisResult 返回
   975		result := s.convertMapToResult(resultMap, dimensions)
   976		return result, nil
   977	}
   978	
   979	// analyzeWithRetry 带重试的分析，返回结果map和是否解析成功
   980	func (s *Service) analyzeWithRetry(paperTitle, abstract string, dimensions []AnalysisDimension, paperId string) (map[string]string, bool) {
   981		prompt := s.buildAnalysisPrompt(paperTitle, abstract, dimensions)
   982		messages := []ChatMessage{
   983			{
   984				Role:    "user",
   985				Content: prompt,
   986			},
   987		}
   988	
   989		for attempt := 1; attempt <= AnalysisMaxRetries; attempt++ {
   990			if attempt > 1 {
   991				fmt.Printf("[Analysis Retry] Attempt %d/%d for paper: %s\n", attempt, AnalysisMaxRetries, paperId)
   992			}
   993			
   994			response, err := s.ChatCompletionWithTools(messages, nil, "", thirdparty.ModelLevelLow)
   995			if err != nil {
   996				fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI analysis failed on attempt %d: %v\n", attempt, err)
   997				continue
   998			}
   999	
  1000			if len(response.Choices) == 0 {
  1001				fmt.Printf("[ERROR] No response from AI on attempt %d\n", attempt)
  1002				continue
  1003			}
  1004	
  1005			content := strings.TrimSpace(response.Choices[0].Message.Content)
  1006			content = s.extractJSONFromContent(content)
  1007	
  1008			resultMap := make(map[string]string)
  1009			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &resultMap); err != nil {
  1010				fmt.Printf("[WARN] Attempt %d: Failed to parse AI response as JSON: %v\n", attempt, err)
  1011				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Raw content length: %d\n", len(content))
  1012				if len(content) > 0 {
  1013					fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Raw content (first 2000 chars): %s\n", content[:min(2000, len(content))])
  1014				}
  1015				continue
  1016			}
  1017	
  1018			// 解析成功
  1019			if attempt > 1 {
  1020				fmt.Printf("[Analysis Retry] Successfully parsed on attempt %d for paper: %s\n", attempt, paperId)
  1021			}
  1022			return resultMap, true
  1023		}
  1024	
  1025		// 所有重试都失败
  1026		fmt.Printf("[ERROR] All %d attempts failed for paper: %s\n", AnalysisMaxRetries, paperId)
  1027		return nil, false
  1028	}
  1029	
  1030	// analyzeInBatches 分批分析维度，每批最多4个维度
  1031	func (s *Service) analyzeInBatches(paperTitle, abstract string, dimensions []AnalysisDimension, paperId string) (map[string]string, bool) {
  1032		resultMap := make(map[string]string)
  1033		allSuccess := true
  1034		
  1035		// 将维度分成多个批次
  1036		for i := 0; i < len(dimensions); i += DimensionsPerBatch {
  1037			end := i + DimensionsPerBatch
  1038			if end > len(dimensions) {
  1039				end = len(dimensions)
  1040			}
  1041			
  1042			batchDimensions := dimensions[i:end]
  1043			batchNum := (i / DimensionsPerBatch) + 1
  1044			totalBatches := (len(dimensions) + DimensionsPerBatch - 1) / DimensionsPerBatch
  1045			
  1046			fmt.Printf("[Batch Analysis] Processing batch %d/%d (%d dimensions) for paper: %s\n", 
  1047				batchNum, totalBatches, len(batchDimensions), paperId)
  1048			
  1049			// 对每个批次进行分析（带重试）
  1050			batchResult, success := s.analyzeWithRetry(paperTitle, abstract, batchDimensions, paperId)
  1051			
  1052			if success {
  1053				// 合并结果
  1054				for k, v := range batchResult {
  1055					resultMap[k] = v
  1056				}
  1057			} else {
  1058				// 批次失败，标记对应维度为解析失败
  1059				allSuccess = false
  1060				for _, dim := range batchDimensions {
  1061					resultMap[dim.DimensionKey] = "解析失败"
  1062				}
  1063				fmt.Printf("[WARN] Batch %d failed for paper: %s\n", batchNum, paperId)
  1064			}
  1065		}
  1066		
  1067		if allSuccess {
  1068			fmt.Printf("[Batch Analysis] All batches completed successfully for paper: %s\n", paperId)
  1069		} else {
  1070			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Some batches failed for paper: %s\n", paperId)
  1071		}
  1072		
  1073		// 只要有部分成功就返回true（部分结果总比没有好）
  1074		hasAnySuccess := false
  1075		for _, v := range resultMap {
  1076			if v != "解析失败" {
  1077				hasAnySuccess = true
  1078				break
  1079			}
  1080		}
  1081		
  1082		return resultMap, hasAnySuccess
  1083	}
  1084	
  1085	// extractJSONFromContent 从AI响应中提取JSON内容
  1086	func (s *Service) extractJSONFromContent(content string) string {
  1087		if strings.Contains(content, "```json") {
  1088			start := strings.Index(content, "```json") + 7
  1089			end := strings.LastIndex(content, "```")
  1090			if end > start {
  1091				return strings.TrimSpace(content[start:end])
  1092			}
  1093		} else if strings.Contains(content, "```") {
  1094			start := strings.Index(content, "```") + 3
  1095			end := strings.LastIndex(content, "```")
  1096			if end > start {
  1097				return strings.TrimSpace(content[start:end])
  1098			}
  1099		}
  1100		return content
  1101	}

  1103	// PaperAnalysisResult 论文分析结果结构（动态维度）
  1104	type PaperAnalysisResult struct {
  1105		// 动态维度数据，key为dimension_key，value为分析结果
  1106		Data map[string]string `json:"data"`
  1107		// 维度元信息，用于前端显示
  1108		Dimensions []DimensionInfo `json:"dimensions"`
  1109	}
  1110	
  1111	// DimensionInfo 维度信息（用于前端显示）
  1112	type DimensionInfo struct {
  1113		Key   string `json:"key"`
  1114		Name  string `json:"name"`
  1115		Value string `json:"value"`
  1116	}
  1117	
  1118	// generateDimensionHash 生成维度配置的哈希值
  1119	// 用于判断缓存是否匹配当前维度配置
  1120	func (s *Service) generateDimensionHash(dimensions []AnalysisDimension) string {
  1121		// 将维度的key和description拼接后计算MD5
  1122		var sb strings.Builder
  1123		for _, dim := range dimensions {
  1124			sb.WriteString(dim.DimensionKey)
  1125			sb.WriteString(":")
  1126			sb.WriteString(dim.Description)
  1127			sb.WriteString(";")
  1128		}
  1129		hash := md5.Sum([]byte(sb.String()))
  1130		return hex.EncodeToString(hash[:8]) // 只取前8字节，生成16位哈希
  1131	}
