  1133	// buildAnalysisPrompt 动态构建分析提示词
  1134	// 优先从数据库获取提示词模板，本地兜底
  1135	func (s *Service) buildAnalysisPrompt(paperTitle, abstract string, dimensions []AnalysisDimension) string {
  1136		// 1. 构建维度列表字符串
  1137		dimensionList := s.buildDimensionListString(dimensions)
  1138		
  1139		// 2. 构建JSON输出格式字符串
  1140		jsonFormat := s.buildJSONFormatString(dimensions)
  1141		
  1142		// 3. 尝试从数据库获取提示词模板
  1143		renderedPrompt, template, err := s.GetAndRenderPrompt("dimensions_paper_analysis", map[string]string{
  1144			"paper_title":    paperTitle,
  1145			"abstract":       abstract,
  1146			"dimension_list": dimensionList,
  1147			"json_format":    jsonFormat,
  1148		})
  1149		
  1150		if err != nil || template == nil {
  1151			// 数据库获取失败，使用本地兜底提示词
  1152			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get prompt template 'dimensions_paper_analysis' from DB: %v, using fallback\n", err)
  1153			return s.buildAnalysisPromptFallback(paperTitle, abstract, dimensionList, jsonFormat)
  1154		}
  1155		
  1156		fmt.Printf("[INFO] Using prompt template from DB: '%s' (ID: %d)\n", template.Name, template.ID)
  1157		return renderedPrompt
  1158	}
  1159	
  1160	// buildDimensionListString 构建维度列表字符串
  1161	func (s *Service) buildDimensionListString(dimensions []AnalysisDimension) string {
  1162		var sb strings.Builder
  1163		for i, dim := range dimensions {
  1164			sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%d. %s（%s）\n", i+1, dim.Name, dim.DimensionKey))
  1165			sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("分析指示：%s\n\n", dim.Description))
  1166		}
  1167		return sb.String()
  1168	}
  1169	
  1170	// buildJSONFormatString 构建JSON输出格式字符串
  1171	func (s *Service) buildJSONFormatString(dimensions []AnalysisDimension) string {
  1172		var sb strings.Builder
  1173		sb.WriteString("{\n")
  1174		for i, dim := range dimensions {
  1175			if i < len(dimensions)-1 {
  1176				sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  \"%s\": \"%s分析结果\",\n", dim.DimensionKey, dim.Name))
  1177			} else {
  1178				sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  \"%s\": \"%s分析结果\"\n", dim.DimensionKey, dim.Name))
  1179			}
  1180		}
  1181		sb.WriteString("}")
  1182		return sb.String()
  1183	}
  1184	
  1185	// buildAnalysisPromptFallback 本地兜底提示词
  1186	func (s *Service) buildAnalysisPromptFallback(paperTitle, abstract, dimensionList, jsonFormat string) string {
  1187		var sb strings.Builder
  1188		
  1189		sb.WriteString("请你阅读以下论文摘要，并严格根据摘要内容进行分析。\n\n")
  1190		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("论文标题：%s\n\n", paperTitle))
  1191		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("论文摘要：%s\n\n", abstract))
  1192		
  1193		sb.WriteString("为确保输出稳定性、可控性与准确性，请遵守以下规则：\n")
  1194		sb.WriteString("【核心规则】\n")
  1195		sb.WriteString("1. 必须先在内部逐步推理，但不要展示推理过程，只输出最终结果。\n")
  1196		sb.WriteString("2. 所有分类必须完全基于摘要原文，不允许推断、不允许类比、不允许编造。\n")
  1197		sb.WriteString("3. 允许所有维度的结果为空。如果摘要中完全没有对应信息，请回答：未提及。\n")
  1198		sb.WriteString("4. 当摘要极短、极度模糊、非学术化、甚至不含任何可分析内容时，你必须保持结构完整，但允许全部返回未提及。\n")
  1199		sb.WriteString("5. 不要引入摘要中没有的技术、领域、理论、国家、组织、数据、研究方法等信息。\n")
  1200		sb.WriteString("6. 每一项结论都必须在摘要中找到明确对应的词句；若无法定位对应内容，必须回答：未提及。\n\n")
  1201		
  1202		sb.WriteString("【分析维度】\n")
  1203		sb.WriteString(dimensionList)
  1204		
  1205		sb.WriteString("【输出格式】\n")
  1206		sb.WriteString("请严格使用以下JSON格式输出，不得增删字段：\n")
  1207		sb.WriteString(jsonFormat)
  1208		sb.WriteString("\n\n所有维度都必须输出，即使内容全部为\"未提及\"。")
  1209		
  1210		return sb.String()
  1211	}

  1213	// convertCachedAnalysisToResult 将缓存的分析结果转换为返回结构
  1214	func (s *Service) convertCachedAnalysisToResult(cached PaperAnalysis, dimensions []AnalysisDimension) *PaperAnalysisResult {
  1215		// 解析存储的JSON数据
  1216		var dataMap map[string]string
  1217		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(cached.AnalysisData), &dataMap); err != nil {
  1218			dataMap = make(map[string]string)
  1219		}
  1220		
  1221		return s.convertMapToResult(dataMap, dimensions)
  1222	}
  1223	
  1224	// convertMapToResult 将map数据转换为返回结构
  1225	func (s *Service) convertMapToResult(dataMap map[string]string, dimensions []AnalysisDimension) *PaperAnalysisResult {
  1226		result := &PaperAnalysisResult{
  1227			Data:       dataMap,
  1228			Dimensions: make([]DimensionInfo, 0, len(dimensions)),
  1229		}
  1230		
  1231		for _, dim := range dimensions {
  1232			value := dataMap[dim.DimensionKey]
  1233			if value == "" {
  1234				value = "未提及"
  1235			}
  1236			result.Dimensions = append(result.Dimensions, DimensionInfo{
  1237				Key:   dim.DimensionKey,
  1238				Name:  dim.Name,
  1239				Value: value,
  1240			})
  1241		}
  1242		
  1243		return result
  1244	}

  1246	// ChatCompletionWithLevel calls AI model without streaming and returns the complete response
  1247	// Used for non-streaming operations like generating follow-up questions
  1248	// Includes automatic retry logic with account switching on 403/429 errors
  1249	func (s *Service) ChatCompletionWithLevel(messages []ChatMessage, modelLevel thirdparty.ModelLevel) (string, error) {
  1250		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] ChatCompletionWithLevel called, modelLevel: %s, messages count: %d\n", modelLevel, len(messages))
  1251	
  1252		var lastErr error
  1253		var excludeAccountIDs []uint
  1254	
  1255		for attempt := 0; attempt <= AIMaxRetries; attempt++ {
  1256			// Get AI model config by level, excluding previously failed accounts
  1257			config, accountID, err := s.accountService.GetRandomAIModelConfigByLevelExcluding(modelLevel, excludeAccountIDs)
  1258			if err != nil {
  1259				fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Attempt %d: Failed to get AI config: %v\n", attempt+1, err)
  1260				lastErr = err
  1261				continue
  1262			}
  1263	
  1264			if attempt > 0 {
  1265				fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Attempt %d/%d with account ID: %d, model: %s\n", attempt+1, AIMaxRetries+1, accountID, config.ModelLow)
  1266			}
  1267	
  1268			// ModelLow field now contains the actual model code for the requested level
  1269			modelCode := config.ModelLow
  1270			if modelCode == "" {
  1271				modelCode = "gpt-3.5-turbo" // Final fallback
  1272			}
  1273	
  1274			// Prepare request (NO streaming)
  1275			reqBody := ChatCompletionRequest{
  1276				Model:       modelCode,
  1277				Messages:    messages,
  1278				Stream:      false, // Non-streaming
  1279				Temperature: 0.7,
  1280			}
  1281	
  1282			jsonData, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
  1283			if err != nil {
  1284				return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request: %w", err)
  1285			}
  1286	
  1287			// Create HTTP request
  1288			url := strings.TrimSuffix(config.BaseURL, "/") + "/v1/chat/completions"
  1289			req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(jsonData))
  1290			if err != nil {
  1291				return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
  1292			}
  1293	
  1294			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  1295			req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+config.APIKey)
  1296	
  1297			// Send request using shared HTTP client with circuit breaker protection
  1298			client := GetHTTPClient()
  1299	
  1300			// Execute with circuit breaker protection
  1301			resultInterface, err := circuitbreaker.AIServiceBreaker.Execute(func() (interface{}, error) {
  1302				resp, err := client.Do(req)
  1303				if err != nil {
  1304					return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to send request: %w", err)
  1305				}
  1306				defer resp.Body.Close()
  1307	
  1308				if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
  1309					body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  1310					return nil, fmt.Errorf("API error (status %d): %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
  1311				}
  1312	
  1313				// Parse non-streaming response
  1314				var response ChatCompletionResponse
  1315				if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&response); err != nil {
  1316					return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode response: %w", err)
  1317				}
  1318	
  1319				if len(response.Choices) == 0 {
  1320					return nil, fmt.Errorf("no response choices returned")
  1321				}
  1322	
  1323				return response.Choices[0].Message.Content, nil
  1324			})
  1325	
  1326			if err != nil {
  1327				lastErr = err
  1328	
  1329				// Check if circuit breaker is open
  1330				if circuitbreaker.IsCircuitBreakerError(err) {
  1331					return "", fmt.Errorf("AI service temporarily unavailable (circuit breaker open): %w", err)
  1332				}
  1333	
  1334				// Check if error is retryable (403/429)
  1335				if isAIRetryableError(err) {
  1336					fmt.Printf("[AI Retry] Retryable error (403/429) with account %d: %v\n", accountID, err)
  1337					excludeAccountIDs = append(excludeAccountIDs, accountID)
  1338					continue
  1339				}
  1340	
  1341				// Non-retryable error, return immediately
  1342				return "", err
  1343			}
  1344	
  1345			// Success
  1346			return resultInterface.(string), nil
  1347		}
  1348	
  1349		return "", fmt.Errorf("all %d AI retry attempts failed, last error: %w", AIMaxRetries+1, lastErr)
  1350	}
  1351	
  1352	// GetAnalysisDimensions 获取用户的分析维度
  1353	// 采用覆盖式设计：系统默认维度 + 用户自定义维度（用户自定义覆盖同dimension_key的系统默认）
  1354	// GetAnalysisDimensionsResult 返回维度列表和是否自定义的标志
  1355	type GetAnalysisDimensionsResult struct {
  1356		Dimensions []AnalysisDimension
  1357		IsCustom   bool // 是否包含用户自定义维度
  1358	}
  1359	
  1360	func (s *Service) GetAnalysisDimensions(userID *uint) (*GetAnalysisDimensionsResult, error) {
  1361		// 1. 获取系统默认维度（user_id = -1 表示系统级）
  1362		var systemDimensions []AnalysisDimension
  1363		err := s.db.Where("user_id = -1 AND is_active = ?", true).
  1364			Order("sort_order ASC").
  1365			Find(&systemDimensions).Error
  1366		if err != nil {
  1367			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get system dimensions: %w", err)
  1368		}
  1369	
  1370		// 如果没有用户ID，直接返回系统默认维度
  1371		if userID == nil || *userID == 0 {
  1372			fmt.Printf("[INFO] Using %d system default dimensions (no user)\n", len(systemDimensions))
  1373			return &GetAnalysisDimensionsResult{
  1374				Dimensions: systemDimensions,
  1375				IsCustom:   false,
  1376			}, nil
  1377		}
  1378	
  1379		// 2. 获取用户自定义维度
  1380		var userDimensions []AnalysisDimension
  1381		err = s.db.Where("user_id = ?", *userID).
  1382			Find(&userDimensions).Error
  1383		if err != nil {
  1384			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get user dimensions: %w", err)
  1385		}
  1386	
  1387		// 如果用户没有任何自定义维度，直接返回系统默认
  1388		if len(userDimensions) == 0 {
  1389			fmt.Printf("[INFO] Using %d system default dimensions for user %d (no customization)\n", len(systemDimensions), *userID)
  1390			return &GetAnalysisDimensionsResult{
  1391				Dimensions: systemDimensions,
  1392				IsCustom:   false,
  1393			}, nil
  1394		}
  1395	
  1396		// 3. 合并：用户自定义覆盖系统默认（按dimension_key匹配）
  1397		userDimMap := make(map[string]AnalysisDimension)
  1398		for _, ud := range userDimensions {
  1399			userDimMap[ud.DimensionKey] = ud
  1400		}
  1401	
  1402		var mergedDimensions []AnalysisDimension
  1403		customCount := 0
  1404		for _, sd := range systemDimensions {
  1405			if ud, exists := userDimMap[sd.DimensionKey]; exists {
  1406				// 用户有自定义，检查是否启用
  1407				if ud.IsActive {
  1408					mergedDimensions = append(mergedDimensions, ud)
  1409					customCount++
  1410				}
  1411				// 如果用户自定义为停用，则该维度不显示
  1412			} else {
  1413				// 用户没有自定义，使用系统默认
  1414				mergedDimensions = append(mergedDimensions, sd)
  1415			}
  1416		}
  1417	
  1418		// 4. 检查用户是否有额外的自定义维度（不在系统默认中的）
  1419		systemKeySet := make(map[string]bool)
  1420		for _, sd := range systemDimensions {
  1421			systemKeySet[sd.DimensionKey] = true
  1422		}
  1423		for _, ud := range userDimensions {
  1424			if !systemKeySet[ud.DimensionKey] && ud.IsActive {
  1425				// 用户新增的维度
  1426				mergedDimensions = append(mergedDimensions, ud)
  1427				customCount++
  1428			}
  1429		}
  1430	
  1431		// 按sort_order排序
  1432		sort.Slice(mergedDimensions, func(i, j int) bool {
  1433			return mergedDimensions[i].SortOrder < mergedDimensions[j].SortOrder
  1434		})
  1435	
  1436		fmt.Printf("[INFO] Merged dimensions for user %d: %d total (%d customized)\n", *userID, len(mergedDimensions), customCount)
  1437		return &GetAnalysisDimensionsResult{
  1438			Dimensions: mergedDimensions,
  1439			IsCustom:   customCount > 0, // 只有当实际有自定义维度时才为true
  1440		}, nil
  1441	}
  1442	
  1443	// GetSystemDimensions 获取系统默认维度（user_id = -1 表示系统级）
  1444	func (s *Service) GetSystemDimensions() ([]AnalysisDimension, error) {
  1445		var dimensions []AnalysisDimension
  1446		err := s.db.Where("user_id = -1 AND is_active = ?", true).
  1447			Order("sort_order ASC").
  1448			Find(&dimensions).Error
  1449		if err != nil {
  1450			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get system dimensions: %w", err)

  1452		return dimensions, nil

  1455	// GetUserDimensions 获取用户自定义维度
  1456	func (s *Service) GetUserDimensions(userID uint) ([]AnalysisDimension, error) {
  1457		var dimensions []AnalysisDimension
  1458		err := s.db.Where("user_id = ? AND is_active = ?", userID, true).
  1459			Order("sort_order ASC").
  1460			Find(&dimensions).Error
  1461		if err != nil {
  1462			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get user dimensions: %w", err)
  1463		}
  1464		return dimensions, nil
  1465	}
  1466	
  1467	// 用户维度数量限制
  1468	const MaxUserDimensions = 15
  1469	
  1470	// CreateUserDimension 创建或更新用户自定义维度
  1471	// 如果用户已有该dimension_key的自定义，则更新；否则创建新的
  1472	// 维度总数限制为15个（系统维度 + 用户新增的自定义维度）
  1473	func (s *Service) CreateUserDimension(userID uint, dimensionKey, name, description string, sortOrder int) (*AnalysisDimension, error) {
  1474		// 检查用户是否已有该dimension_key的自定义
  1475		var existingDimension AnalysisDimension
  1476		err := s.db.Where("user_id = ? AND dimension_key = ?", userID, dimensionKey).First(&existingDimension).Error
  1477		
  1478		if err == nil {
  1479			// 已存在，更新（修改系统维度或更新已有自定义维度，不计入数量限制）
  1480			existingDimension.Name = name
  1481			existingDimension.Description = description
  1482			existingDimension.SortOrder = sortOrder
  1483			existingDimension.IsActive = true
  1484			
  1485			if err := s.db.Save(&existingDimension).Error; err != nil {
  1486				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update dimension: %w", err)
  1487			}
  1488			fmt.Printf("[INFO] Updated user dimension: %s for user %d\n", dimensionKey, userID)
  1489			return &existingDimension, nil
  1490		}
  1491	
  1492		// 不存在，需要创建新的
  1493		// 检查是否是修改系统维度（dimension_key已存在于系统维度中）
  1494		var systemDimension AnalysisDimension
  1495		isModifyingSystemDimension := s.db.Where("user_id = -1 AND dimension_key = ?", dimensionKey).First(&systemDimension).Error == nil
  1496	
  1497		// 只有新增自定义维度（非修改系统维度）才需要检查数量限制
  1498		if !isModifyingSystemDimension {
  1499			// 计算用户当前的维度总数
  1500			currentCount, err := s.GetUserDimensionCount(userID)
  1501			if err != nil {
  1502				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to check dimension count: %w", err)
  1503			}
  1504	
  1505			if currentCount >= MaxUserDimensions {
  1506				return nil, fmt.Errorf("已达到维度数量上限（%d个），请删除部分自定义维度后再添加", MaxUserDimensions)
  1507			}
  1508		}
  1509	
  1510		// 创建新的维度记录
  1511		dimension := &AnalysisDimension{
  1512			UserID:       int64(userID),
  1513			DimensionKey: dimensionKey,
  1514			Name:         name,
  1515			Description:  description,
  1516			SortOrder:    sortOrder,
  1517			IsActive:     true,
  1518		}
  1519	
  1520		if err := s.db.Create(dimension).Error; err != nil {
  1521			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create dimension: %w", err)
  1522		}
  1523	
  1524		if isModifyingSystemDimension {
  1525			fmt.Printf("[INFO] Created user override for system dimension: %s for user %d\n", dimensionKey, userID)
  1526		} else {
  1527			fmt.Printf("[INFO] Created new user dimension: %s for user %d\n", dimensionKey, userID)
  1528		}
  1529		return dimension, nil
  1530	}
  1531	
  1532	// GetUserDimensionCount 获取用户的维度总数
  1533	// 计算逻辑：系统维度数量 + 用户新增的自定义维度数量（不包括用户对系统维度的修改）
  1534	func (s *Service) GetUserDimensionCount(userID uint) (int, error) {
  1535		// 获取系统维度
  1536		systemDimensions, err := s.GetSystemDimensions()
  1537		if err != nil {
  1538			return 0, err
  1539		}
  1540		systemKeySet := make(map[string]bool)
  1541		for _, sd := range systemDimensions {
  1542			systemKeySet[sd.DimensionKey] = true
  1543		}
  1544	
  1545		// 获取用户自定义维度
  1546		userDimensions, err := s.GetUserDimensions(userID)
  1547		if err != nil {
  1548			return 0, err
  1549		}
  1550	
  1551		// 计算用户新增的维度数量（不在系统维度中的）
  1552		customCount := 0
  1553		for _, ud := range userDimensions {
  1554			if !systemKeySet[ud.DimensionKey] {
  1555				customCount++
  1556			}
  1557		}
  1558	
  1559		// 总数 = 系统维度数量 + 用户新增的自定义维度数量
  1560		totalCount := len(systemDimensions) + customCount
  1561		fmt.Printf("[INFO] User %d dimension count: %d (system: %d, custom: %d)\n", 
  1562			userID, totalCount, len(systemDimensions), customCount)
  1563		return totalCount, nil
  1564	}

  1645	// UpdateSystemDimension 更新系统默认维度（管理员接口）
  1646	func (s *Service) UpdateSystemDimension(dimensionID uint, name, description string, sortOrder int, isActive bool) (*AnalysisDimension, error) {
  1647		var dimension AnalysisDimension
  1648		// 只能更新系统默认维度（user_id = -1）
  1649		if err := s.db.Where("id = ? AND user_id = -1", dimensionID).First(&dimension).Error; err != nil {
  1650			return nil, fmt.Errorf("system dimension not found: %w", err)
  1651		}
  1652	
  1653		dimension.Name = name
  1654		dimension.Description = description
  1655		dimension.SortOrder = sortOrder
  1656		dimension.IsActive = isActive
  1657	
  1658		if err := s.db.Save(&dimension).Error; err != nil {
  1659			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update dimension: %w", err)
  1660		}
  1661	
  1662		fmt.Printf("[INFO] Updated system dimension: %s (ID: %d)\n", dimension.DimensionKey, dimension.ID)
  1663		return &dimension, nil
  1664	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package cache
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"encoding/json"
    13		"fmt"
    14		"time"
    15	)
    16	
    17	// QueryCache 提供通用的查询结果缓存
    18	type QueryCache struct {
    19		prefix string
    20		ttl    time.Duration
    21	}
    22	
    23	// NewQueryCache 创建新的查询缓存
    24	func NewQueryCache(prefix string, ttl time.Duration) *QueryCache {
    25		return &QueryCache{
    26			prefix: prefix,
    27			ttl:    ttl,
    28		}
    29	}
    30	
    31	// Get 从缓存获取查询结果
    32	func (qc *QueryCache) Get(ctx context.Context, key string, result interface{}) error {
    33		cacheKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", qc.prefix, key)
    34	
    35		data, err := GetRedis().Get(ctx, cacheKey).Bytes()
    36		if err != nil {
    37			return err
    38		}
    39	
    40		return json.Unmarshal(data, result)
    41	}
    42	
    43	// Set 设置查询结果到缓存
    44	func (qc *QueryCache) Set(ctx context.Context, key string, value interface{}) error {
    45		cacheKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", qc.prefix, key)
    46	
    47		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
    48		if err != nil {
    49			return err
    50		}
    51	
    52		return GetRedis().Set(ctx, cacheKey, data, qc.ttl).Err()
    53	}
    54	
    55	// Delete 删除缓存
    56	func (qc *QueryCache) Delete(ctx context.Context, key string) error {
    57		cacheKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", qc.prefix, key)
    58		return GetRedis().Del(ctx, cacheKey).Err()
    59	}
    60	
    61	// DeletePattern 批量删除匹配模式的缓存
    62	func (qc *QueryCache) DeletePattern(ctx context.Context, pattern string) error {
    63		fullPattern := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", qc.prefix, pattern)
    64	
    65		var cursor uint64
    66		var keys []string
    67	
    68		// 使用SCAN命令避免阻塞
    69		for {
    70			var batch []string
    71			var err error
    72			batch, cursor, err = GetRedis().Scan(ctx, cursor, fullPattern, 100).Result()
    73			if err != nil {
    74				return err
    75			}
    76			keys = append(keys, batch...)
    77			if cursor == 0 {
    78				break
    79			}
    80		}
    81	
    82		if len(keys) > 0 {
    83			return GetRedis().Del(ctx, keys...).Err()
    84		}
    85	
    86		return nil
    87	}
    88	
    89	// CachedQuery 带缓存的查询执行器
    90	// 先尝试从缓存获取,如果miss则执行查询函数并缓存结果
    91	func (qc *QueryCache) CachedQuery(ctx context.Context, key string, result interface{}, queryFunc func() (interface{}, error)) error {
    92		// 尝试从缓存获取
    93		err := qc.Get(ctx, key, result)
    94		if err == nil {
    95			return nil // 缓存命中
    96		}
    97	
    98		// 缓存miss,执行查询
    99		data, err := queryFunc()
   100		if err != nil {
   101			return err
   102		}
   103	
   104		// 缓存结果
   105		if err := qc.Set(ctx, key, data); err != nil {
   106			// 缓存失败不影响业务,只记录日志
   107			// log.Printf("Failed to cache query result: %v", err)
   108		}
   109	
   110		// 将查询结果复制到result
   111		jsonData, err := json.Marshal(data)
   112		if err != nil {
   113			return err
   114		}
   115		return json.Unmarshal(jsonData, result)
   116	}
   117	
   118	// 预定义的常用缓存实例
   119	var (
   120		// 用户信息缓存 - 5分钟
   121		UserCache = NewQueryCache("user", 5*time.Minute)
   122	
   123		// 对话列表缓存 - 2分钟
   124		ConversationListCache = NewQueryCache("conv_list", 2*time.Minute)
   125	
   126		// 论文详情缓存 - 30分钟
   127		PaperCache = NewQueryCache("paper", 30*time.Minute)
   128	
   129		// 订阅信息缓存 - 5分钟
   130		SubscriptionCache = NewQueryCache("subscription", 5*time.Minute)
   131	)

    21	// InitRedis initializes the Redis client
    22	func InitRedis(host string, port string, password string, db int) error {
    23		addr := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", host, port)
    24	
    25		rdb = redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{
    26			Addr:         addr,
    27			Password:     password,
    28			DB:           db,
    29			DialTimeout:  5 * time.Second,
    30			ReadTimeout:  10 * time.Second,  // Increased from 3s to prevent premature timeouts
    31			WriteTimeout: 10 * time.Second,  // Increased from 3s to prevent premature timeouts
    32			PoolSize:     100,               // Increased from 10 to match database connection pool scale
    33			MinIdleConns: 25,                // Increased from 5 to keep more warm connections
    34		})
    35	
    36		// Test connection
    37		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
    38		defer cancel()
    39	
    40		if err := rdb.Ping(ctx).Err(); err != nil {
    41			return fmt.Errorf("failed to connect to Redis: %w", err)
    42		}
    43	
    44		fmt.Printf("✓ Redis connected successfully at %s\n", addr)
    45		return nil
    46	}

    51	}

    53	// Set sets a key-value pair with expiration

    56		if err != nil {
    57			return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal value: %w", err)
    58		}
    59	
    60		return rdb.Set(ctx, key, data, expiration).Err()
    61	}

    64	func Get(ctx context.Context, key string, result interface{}) error {
    65		val, err := rdb.Get(ctx, key).Result()
    66		if err != nil {
    67			return err
    68		}
    69	
    70		return json.Unmarshal([]byte(val), result)
    71	}

    75		return rdb.Del(ctx, key).Err()
    76	}

    79	func Exists(ctx context.Context, key string) (bool, error) {
    80		count, err := rdb.Exists(ctx, key).Result()
    81		return count > 0, err
    82	}

    87	}

    91		return rdb.Get(ctx, key).Result()
    92	}

    94	// GetOrSet retrieves from cache or fetches and caches the value with distributed locking
    95	func GetOrSet(ctx context.Context, key string, expiration time.Duration, fetch func() (interface{}, error), result interface{}) error {
    96		// Try to get from cache
    97		err := Get(ctx, key, result)
    98		if err == nil {
    99			return nil // Cache hit
   100		}
   101	
   102		if err != redis.Nil {
   103			// Redis error, not a cache miss
   104			return fmt.Errorf("redis error: %w", err)
   105		}
   106	
   107		// Cache miss - use distributed lock to prevent stampede
   108		lockKey := "lock:" + key
   109		lockValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
   110		lockExpiration := 10 * time.Second
   111	
   112		// Try to acquire lock
   113		acquired, err := SetNX(ctx, lockKey, lockValue, lockExpiration)
   114		if err != nil {
   115			return fmt.Errorf("lock error: %w", err)
   116		}
   117	
   118		if !acquired {
   119			// Another process is fetching, wait and retry cache read
   120			time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
   121			err := Get(ctx, key, result)
   122			if err == nil {
   123				return nil
   124			}
   125			// If still not cached, proceed to fetch
   126		}
   127	
   128		// Ensure lock is released
   129		defer Delete(ctx, lockKey)
   130	
   131		// Fetch the value
   132		value, err := fetch()
   133		if err != nil {
   134			return fmt.Errorf("fetch error: %w", err)
   135		}
   136	
   137		// Store in cache
   138		if err := Set(ctx, key, value, expiration); err != nil {
   139			// Log error but don't fail the request
   140			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to cache value for key %s: %v\n", key, err)
   141		}
   142	
   143		// Marshal and unmarshal to populate result
   144		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
   145		if err != nil {
   146			return fmt.Errorf("marshal error: %w", err)
   147		}
   148	
   149		return json.Unmarshal(data, result)
   150	}
   151	
   152	// InvalidatePattern deletes all keys matching a pattern
   153	func InvalidatePattern(ctx context.Context, pattern string) error {
   154		iter := rdb.Scan(ctx, 0, pattern, 0).Iterator()
   155		for iter.Next(ctx) {
   156			if err := rdb.Del(ctx, iter.Val()).Err(); err != nil {
   157				return err
   158			}
   159		}
   160		return iter.Err()
   161	}
   162	
   163	// SetNX sets a key only if it doesn't exist (used for distributed locks)
   164	func SetNX(ctx context.Context, key string, value string, expiration time.Duration) (bool, error) {
   165		return rdb.SetNX(ctx, key, value, expiration).Result()
   166	}
   167	
   168	// Incr increments a counter
   169	func Incr(ctx context.Context, key string) (int64, error) {
   170		return rdb.Incr(ctx, key).Result()
   171	}
   172	
   173	// Expire sets expiration on an existing key
   174	func Expire(ctx context.Context, key string, expiration time.Duration) error {
   175		return rdb.Expire(ctx, key, expiration).Err()
   176	}
   177	
   178	// TTL returns the remaining time to live of a key
   179	func TTL(ctx context.Context, key string) (time.Duration, error) {
   180		return rdb.TTL(ctx, key).Result()
   181	}
   182	
   183	// SAdd adds members to a set
   184	func SAdd(ctx context.Context, key string, members ...interface{}) error {
   185		return rdb.SAdd(ctx, key, members...).Err()
   186	}

     1	// ============================================================================

     8	package cache
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"crypto/md5"
    13		"encoding/hex"
    14		"fmt"
    15		"time"
    16	)
    17	
    18	const (
    19		scholarSearchPrefix = "scholar:search"
    20		scholarPaperPrefix  = "scholar:paper"
    21		scholarAuthorPrefix = "scholar:author"
    22	
    23		// Cache TTL settings
    24		searchCacheTTL = 24 * time.Hour // 搜索结果缓存1天
    25		paperCacheTTL  = 7 * 24 * time.Hour  // 论文详情缓存7天（论文信息变化慢）
    26		authorCacheTTL = 3 * 24 * time.Hour  // 作者信息缓存3天
    27	)
    28	
    29	// GenerateCacheKey generates a cache key from query parameters
    30	// Uses MD5 hash of parameters for consistent key generation
    31	func GenerateCacheKey(prefix string, params map[string]interface{}) string {
    32		// Create a stable string representation
    33		paramStr := fmt.Sprintf("%v", params)
    34	
    35		// Generate MD5 hash
    36		hash := md5.Sum([]byte(paramStr))
    37		hashStr := hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
    38	
    39		return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", prefix, hashStr)
    40	}
    41	
    42	// CacheSearchResult caches a search result
    43	// params should include: query, year, limit, offset, fields, etc.
    44	func CacheSearchResult(ctx context.Context, params map[string]interface{}, result interface{}) error {
    45		key := GenerateCacheKey(scholarSearchPrefix, params)
    46		return Set(ctx, key, result, searchCacheTTL)
    47	}
    48	
    49	// GetCachedSearchResult retrieves a cached search result
    50	// Returns (found, error) - found=true if cache hit, found=false if cache miss
    51	func GetCachedSearchResult(ctx context.Context, params map[string]interface{}, result interface{}) (bool, error) {
    52		key := GenerateCacheKey(scholarSearchPrefix, params)
    53	
    54		err := Get(ctx, key, result)
    55		if err != nil {
    56			if err.Error() == "redis: nil" {
    57				// Cache miss - caller should use GetOrSetSearchResult for stampede protection
    58				return false, nil
    59			}
    60			// Redis error
    61			return false, err
    62		}
    63	
    64		// Cache hit
    65		return true, nil
    66	}
    67	
    68	// GetOrSetSearchResult retrieves from cache or fetches with stampede protection
    69	// This prevents multiple concurrent requests from hitting the API on cache miss
    70	func GetOrSetSearchResult(ctx context.Context, params map[string]interface{}, fetchFn func() (interface{}, error), result interface{}) error {
    71		key := GenerateCacheKey(scholarSearchPrefix, params)
    72		return GetOrSet(ctx, key, searchCacheTTL, fetchFn, result)
    73	}

    75	// CachePaperDetails caches paper details by paperId and fields

    79			"paperId": paperId,
    80			"fields":  fields,
    81		}

    83		return Set(ctx, key, paper, paperCacheTTL)

    87	// Only returns cached data if the exact same fields were requested

    89		params := map[string]interface{}{
    90			"paperId": paperId,
    91			"fields":  fields,
    92		}
    93		key := GenerateCacheKey(scholarPaperPrefix, params)
    94	
    95		err := Get(ctx, key, result)
    96		if err != nil {
    97			if err.Error() == "redis: nil" {
    98				return false, nil
    99			}
   100			return false, err
   101		}
   102	
   103		return true, nil
   104	}

   109		params := map[string]interface{}{

   113		key := GenerateCacheKey(scholarPaperPrefix, params)

   162	// GetCacheStats returns cache statistics (for debugging/monitoring)
   163	func GetCacheStats(ctx context.Context) (map[string]int64, error) {
   164		stats := make(map[string]int64)
   165	
   166		// Count keys for each prefix
   167		prefixes := []string{scholarSearchPrefix, scholarPaperPrefix, scholarAuthorPrefix}
   168	
   169		for _, prefix := range prefixes {
   170			pattern := fmt.Sprintf("%s:*", prefix)
   171	
   172			count := int64(0)
   173			iter := GetRedis().Scan(ctx, 0, pattern, 0).Iterator()
   174			for iter.Next(ctx) {
   175				count++
   176			}
   177	
   178			if err := iter.Err(); err != nil {
   179				return nil, err
   180			}
   181	
   182			stats[prefix] = count
   183		}
   184	
   185		return stats, nil
   186	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package cache
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"fmt"
    13		"time"
    14	)
    15	
    16	const (
    17		verificationCodePrefix = "verification_code"
    18		verificationCodeTTL    = 10 * time.Minute // 验证码10分钟过期
    19	)
    20	
    21	// VerificationCode represents a verification code in Redis
    22	type VerificationCode struct {
    23		Email   string `json:"email"`
    24		Code    string `json:"code"`
    25		Purpose string `json:"purpose"` // register, login, reset_password
    26	}
    27	
    28	// SaveVerificationCode saves a verification code to Redis
    29	// Key format: verification_code:{email}:{purpose}
    30	// TTL: 10 minutes (auto-cleanup)
    31	func SaveVerificationCode(ctx context.Context, email, code, purpose string) error {
    32		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s", verificationCodePrefix, email, purpose)
    33	
    34		vc := VerificationCode{
    35			Email:   email,
    36			Code:    code,
    37			Purpose: purpose,
    38		}
    39	
    40		return Set(ctx, key, vc, verificationCodeTTL)
    41	}
    42	
    43	// VerifyCode verifies a verification code and deletes it if valid
    44	// Returns true if code is valid, false otherwise
    45	func VerifyCode(ctx context.Context, email, code, purpose string) (bool, error) {
    46		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s", verificationCodePrefix, email, purpose)
    47	
    48		var vc VerificationCode
    49		err := Get(ctx, key, &vc)
    50		if err != nil {
    51			// Code not found or expired
    52			return false, nil
    53		}
    54	
    55		// Check if code matches
    56		if vc.Code != code {
    57			return false, nil
    58		}
    59	
    60		// Delete the code after verification (one-time use)
    61		if err := Delete(ctx, key); err != nil {
    62			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to delete verification code %s: %v\n", key, err)
    63		}
    64	
    65		return true, nil
    66	}
    67	
    68	// GetVerificationCode retrieves a verification code (for debugging only)
    69	func GetVerificationCode(ctx context.Context, email, purpose string) (*VerificationCode, error) {
    70		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s", verificationCodePrefix, email, purpose)
    71	
    72		var vc VerificationCode
    73		err := Get(ctx, key, &vc)
    74		if err != nil {
    75			return nil, err
    76		}
    77	
    78		return &vc, nil
    79	}
    80	
    81	// DeleteVerificationCode deletes a verification code
    82	func DeleteVerificationCode(ctx context.Context, email, purpose string) error {
    83		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s", verificationCodePrefix, email, purpose)
    84		return Delete(ctx, key)
    85	}
    86	
    87	// GetVerificationCodeTTL returns the remaining TTL of a verification code
    88	func GetVerificationCodeTTL(ctx context.Context, email, purpose string) (time.Duration, error) {
    89		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s", verificationCodePrefix, email, purpose)
    90		return TTL(ctx, key)
    91	}

文件: backend/internal/common/cache/workerpool.go

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package cache
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"log"
    13		"sync"
    14	)
    15	
    16	// CacheJob represents a cache write job
    17	type CacheJob struct {
    18		Ctx   context.Context
    19		Fn    func() error
    20		ErrCh chan error // Optional error channel for callers who want to wait
    21	}
    22	
    23	// WorkerPool manages a pool of workers for async cache operations
    24	type WorkerPool struct {
    25		workers int
    26		jobs    chan CacheJob
    27		wg      sync.WaitGroup
    28		once    sync.Once
    29	}
    30	
    31	var globalWorkerPool *WorkerPool
    32	
    33	// InitWorkerPool initializes the global worker pool
    34	// Should be called once at application startup
    35	func InitWorkerPool(workerCount int, queueSize int) {
    36		globalWorkerPool = &WorkerPool{
    37			workers: workerCount,
    38			jobs:    make(chan CacheJob, queueSize),
    39		}
    40		globalWorkerPool.Start()
    41	}
    42	
    43	// GetWorkerPool returns the global worker pool instance
    44	func GetWorkerPool() *WorkerPool {
    45		if globalWorkerPool == nil {
    46			// Fallback: create a default pool if not initialized
    47			log.Println("Warning: WorkerPool not initialized, creating default pool")
    48			InitWorkerPool(10, 100)
    49		}
    50		return globalWorkerPool
    51	}
    52	
    53	// Start starts the worker pool
    54	func (wp *WorkerPool) Start() {
    55		wp.once.Do(func() {
    56			for i := 0; i < wp.workers; i++ {
    57				wp.wg.Add(1)
    58				go wp.worker(i)
    59			}
    60			log.Printf("✓ Cache worker pool started with %d workers", wp.workers)
    61		})
    62	}
    63	
    64	// worker processes cache jobs from the queue
    65	func (wp *WorkerPool) worker(id int) {
    66		defer wp.wg.Done()
    67	
    68		for job := range wp.jobs {
    69			// Check if context is already cancelled
    70			select {
    71			case <-job.Ctx.Done():
    72				if job.ErrCh != nil {
    73					job.ErrCh <- job.Ctx.Err()
    74				}
    75				continue
    76			default:
    77			}
    78	
    79			// Execute the cache operation
    80			err := job.Fn()
    81			if err != nil {
    82				log.Printf("Worker %d: cache operation failed: %v", id, err)
    83			}
    84	
    85			// Send result to error channel if provided
    86			if job.ErrCh != nil {
    87				job.ErrCh <- err
    88			}
    89		}
    90	}
    91	
    92	// Submit submits a cache job to the worker pool (fire-and-forget)
    93	// Returns immediately without waiting for completion
    94	func (wp *WorkerPool) Submit(ctx context.Context, fn func() error) {
    95		select {
    96		case wp.jobs <- CacheJob{Ctx: ctx, Fn: fn}:
    97			// Job queued successfully
    98		default:
    99			// Queue is full, log warning and drop the job
   100			log.Println("Warning: Cache worker pool queue is full, dropping cache write")
   101		}
   102	}
   103	
   104	// SubmitWithResult submits a cache job and returns a channel to wait for the result
   105	// Caller can optionally wait on the error channel
   106	func (wp *WorkerPool) SubmitWithResult(ctx context.Context, fn func() error) <-chan error {
   107		errCh := make(chan error, 1)
   108		job := CacheJob{
   109			Ctx:   ctx,
   110			Fn:    fn,
   111			ErrCh: errCh,
   112		}
   113	
   114		select {
   115		case wp.jobs <- job:
   116			// Job queued successfully
   117		default:
   118			// Queue is full
   119			errCh <- ErrQueueFull
   120		}
   121	
   122		return errCh
   123	}
   124	
   125	// Shutdown gracefully shuts down the worker pool
   126	// Should be called during application shutdown
   127	func (wp *WorkerPool) Shutdown() {
   128		close(wp.jobs)
   129		wp.wg.Wait()
   130		log.Println("✓ Cache worker pool shut down gracefully")
   131	}
   132	
   133	// ShutdownGlobalPool shuts down the global worker pool
   134	func ShutdownGlobalPool() {
   135		if globalWorkerPool != nil {
   136			globalWorkerPool.Shutdown()
   137		}
   138	}
   139	
   140	// Error definitions
   141	var (
   142		ErrQueueFull = &WorkerPoolError{"cache worker pool queue is full"}
   143	)
   144	
   145	type WorkerPoolError struct {
   146		msg string
   147	}
   148	
   149	func (e *WorkerPoolError) Error() string {
   150		return e.msg
   151	}

---------------------------- 文件结束 ----------------------------

    15	
    16	var (
    17		// SemanticScholarBreaker protects Semantic Scholar API calls
    18		// Prevents cascading failures when the external service is down
    19		SemanticScholarBreaker = gobreaker.NewCircuitBreaker(gobreaker.Settings{
    20			Name:        "SemanticScholar",
    21			MaxRequests: 3,                // Maximum requests allowed in half-open state
    22			Interval:    time.Minute,      // Statistical window
    23			Timeout:     30 * time.Second, // Time to wait before trying again after open
    24			ReadyToTrip: func(counts gobreaker.Counts) bool {
    25				// Trip (open circuit) if 60% failure rate with at least 3 requests
    26				failureRatio := float64(counts.TotalFailures) / float64(counts.Requests)
    27				return counts.Requests >= 3 && failureRatio >= 0.6
    28			},
    29			OnStateChange: func(name string, from gobreaker.State, to gobreaker.State) {
    30				// Log state changes for monitoring
    31				// In production, send metrics to monitoring system
    32				// log.Printf("[Circuit Breaker] %s: %s -> %s\n", name, from, to)
    33			},
    34		})
    35	
    36		// AIServiceBreaker protects AI service API calls
    37		// 注意：由于我们有账号切换重试机制，熔断器配置需要更宽松
    38		// 避免在切换账号重试时过早触发熔断
    39		AIServiceBreaker = gobreaker.NewCircuitBreaker(gobreaker.Settings{
    40			Name:        "AIService",
    41			MaxRequests: 10,                // 半开状态允许更多请求通过测试
    42			Interval:    time.Minute,       // 统计窗口
    43			Timeout:     30 * time.Second,  // 熔断后等待时间缩短，更快恢复
    44			ReadyToTrip: func(counts gobreaker.Counts) bool {
    45				// 只有在连续失败次数达到阈值时才触发熔断
    46				// 提高阈值，因为账号切换重试会产生多次失败
    47				// 需要至少 10 次请求且 80% 失败率才触发
    48				failureRatio := float64(counts.TotalFailures) / float64(counts.Requests)
    49				return counts.Requests >= 10 && failureRatio >= 0.8
    50			},
    51			OnStateChange: func(name string, from gobreaker.State, to gobreaker.State) {
    52				// log.Printf("[Circuit Breaker] %s: %s -> %s\n", name, from, to)
    53			},
    54		})
    55	
    56		// ProxyServiceBreaker protects proxy API calls
    57		ProxyServiceBreaker = gobreaker.NewCircuitBreaker(gobreaker.Settings{
    58			Name:        "ProxyService",
    59			MaxRequests: 10,
    60			Interval:    time.Minute,
    61			Timeout:     30 * time.Second,
    62			ReadyToTrip: func(counts gobreaker.Counts) bool {
    63				failureRatio := float64(counts.TotalFailures) / float64(counts.Requests)
    64				return counts.Requests >= 10 && failureRatio >= 0.7
    65			},
    66			OnStateChange: func(name string, from gobreaker.State, to gobreaker.State) {
    67				// log.Printf("[Circuit Breaker] %s: %s -> %s\n", name, from, to)
    68			},
    69		})
    70	)
    71	
    72	// IsCircuitBreakerError checks if an error is from circuit breaker being open
    73	func IsCircuitBreakerError(err error) bool {
    74		return err == gobreaker.ErrOpenState || err == gobreaker.ErrTooManyRequests
    75	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package cleanup
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"fmt"
    13		"log"
    14		"time"
    15	
    16		"gorm.io/gorm"
    17	)
    18	
    19	// CleanupService handles periodic database cleanup tasks
    20	type CleanupService struct {
    21		db     *gorm.DB
    22		ctx    context.Context
    23		cancel context.CancelFunc
    24	}
    25	
    26	// NewCleanupService creates a new cleanup service
    27	func NewCleanupService(db *gorm.DB) *CleanupService {
    28		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
    29		return &CleanupService{
    30			db:     db,
    31			ctx:    ctx,
    32			cancel: cancel,
    33		}
    34	}
    35	
    36	// Start starts all cleanup tasks as background goroutines
    37	func (s *CleanupService) Start() {
    38		log.Println("Starting cleanup service...")
    39	
    40		// Clean expired sessions every hour
    41		go s.runPeriodic("expired_sessions", 1*time.Hour, s.cleanExpiredSessions)
    42	
    43		// Clean old snapshots every day at 3 AM
    44		go s.runDaily("old_snapshots", 3, 0, s.cleanOldSnapshots)
    45	
    46		log.Println("✓ Cleanup service started")
    47	}
    48	
    49	// Stop gracefully stops all cleanup tasks
    50	func (s *CleanupService) Stop() {
    51		log.Println("Stopping cleanup service...")
    52		s.cancel()
    53		log.Println("✓ Cleanup service stopped")
    54	}
    55	
    56	// runPeriodic runs a cleanup task at regular intervals
    57	func (s *CleanupService) runPeriodic(name string, interval time.Duration, task func() error) {
    58		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
    59		defer ticker.Stop()
    60	
    61		// Run immediately on start
    62		if err := task(); err != nil {
    63			log.Printf("Warning: cleanup task '%s' failed: %v\n", name, err)
    64		}
    65	
    66		for {
    67			select {
    68			case <-ticker.C:
    69				if err := task(); err != nil {
    70					log.Printf("Warning: cleanup task '%s' failed: %v\n", name, err)
    71				}
    72			case <-s.ctx.Done():
    73				log.Printf("Cleanup task '%s' stopped\n", name)
    74				return
    75			}
    76		}
    77	}
    78	
    79	// runDaily runs a cleanup task daily at a specific time
    80	func (s *CleanupService) runDaily(name string, hour, minute int, task func() error) {
    81		for {
    82			now := time.Now()
    83			next := time.Date(now.Year(), now.Month(), now.Day(), hour, minute, 0, 0, now.Location())
    84	
    85			// If the scheduled time has passed today, schedule for tomorrow
    86			if next.Before(now) {
    87				next = next.Add(24 * time.Hour)
    88			}
    89	
    90			duration := time.Until(next)
    91			log.Printf("Next '%s' cleanup scheduled at: %s (in %v)\n", name, next.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"), duration)
    92	
    93			// Use a timer with context cancellation support
    94			timer := time.NewTimer(duration)
    95			select {
    96			case <-timer.C:
    97				if err := task(); err != nil {
    98					log.Printf("Warning: cleanup task '%s' failed: %v\n", name, err)
    99				}
   100			case <-s.ctx.Done():
   101				timer.Stop()
   102				log.Printf("Cleanup task '%s' stopped\n", name)
   103				return
   104			}
   105			timer.Stop()
   106		}
   107	}
   108	
   109	// cleanExpiredSessions removes expired user sessions
   110	// Keeps sessions for 30 days after expiration for audit purposes
   111	func (s *CleanupService) cleanExpiredSessions() error {
   112		cutoffTime := time.Now().Add(-30 * 24 * time.Hour)
   113	
   114		result := s.db.Exec(`
   115			DELETE FROM user_sessions
   116			WHERE expires_at < ?
   117		`, cutoffTime)
   118	
   119		if result.Error != nil {
   120			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clean expired sessions: %w", result.Error)
   121		}
   122	
   123		if result.RowsAffected > 0 {
   124			log.Printf("✓ Cleaned %d expired user sessions\n", result.RowsAffected)
   125		}
   126	
   127		return nil
   128	}
   129	
   130	// cleanOldSnapshots removes old online user snapshots
   131	// Keeps only last 30 days of data
   132	func (s *CleanupService) cleanOldSnapshots() error {
   133		cutoffTime := time.Now().Add(-30 * 24 * time.Hour)
   134	
   135		result := s.db.Exec(`
   136			DELETE FROM online_user_snapshots
   137			WHERE timestamp < ?
   138		`, cutoffTime)
   139	
   140		if result.Error != nil {
   141			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clean old snapshots: %w", result.Error)
   142		}
   143	
   144		if result.RowsAffected > 0 {
   145			log.Printf("✓ Cleaned %d old online user snapshots (older than 30 days)\n", result.RowsAffected)
   146		}
   147	
   148		return nil
   149	}
   150	
   151	// CleanExpiredSessionsNow runs the expired sessions cleanup immediately
   152	func (s *CleanupService) CleanExpiredSessionsNow() error {
   153		log.Println("Running manual cleanup: expired sessions")
   154		return s.cleanExpiredSessions()
   155	}
   156	
   157	// CleanOldSnapshotsNow runs the old snapshots cleanup immediately
   158	func (s *CleanupService) CleanOldSnapshotsNow() error {
   159		log.Println("Running manual cleanup: old snapshots")
   160		return s.cleanOldSnapshots()
   161	}
   162	
   163	// GetCleanupStats returns statistics about data to be cleaned
   164	func (s *CleanupService) GetCleanupStats() (map[string]interface{}, error) {
   165		stats := make(map[string]interface{})
   166	
   167		// Count expired sessions
   168		var expiredSessionsCount int64
   169		cutoffTime := time.Now().Add(-30 * 24 * time.Hour)
   170		if err := s.db.Model(&struct {
   171			TableName string `gorm:"-" json:"-"`
   172		}{}).
   173			Table("user_sessions").
   174			Where("expires_at < ?", cutoffTime).
   175			Count(&expiredSessionsCount).Error; err != nil {
   176			return nil, err
   177		}
   178		stats["expired_sessions_count"] = expiredSessionsCount
   179	
   180		// Count old snapshots
   181		var oldSnapshotsCount int64
   182		snapshotCutoff := time.Now().Add(-30 * 24 * time.Hour)
   183		if err := s.db.Model(&struct {
   184			TableName string `gorm:"-" json:"-"`
   185		}{}).
   186			Table("online_user_snapshots").
   187			Where("timestamp < ?", snapshotCutoff).
   188			Count(&oldSnapshotsCount).Error; err != nil {
   189			return nil, err
   190		}
   191		stats["old_snapshots_count"] = oldSnapshotsCount
   192	
   193		// Total sessions count
   194		var totalSessionsCount int64
   195		if err := s.db.Model(&struct {
   196			TableName string `gorm:"-" json:"-"`
   197		}{}).
   198			Table("user_sessions").
   199			Count(&totalSessionsCount).Error; err != nil {
   200			return nil, err
   201		}
   202		stats["total_sessions_count"] = totalSessionsCount
   203	
   204		// Total snapshots count
   205		var totalSnapshotsCount int64
   206		if err := s.db.Model(&struct {
   207			TableName string `gorm:"-" json:"-"`
   208		}{}).
   209			Table("online_user_snapshots").
   210			Count(&totalSnapshotsCount).Error; err != nil {
   211			return nil, err
   212		}
   213		stats["total_snapshots_count"] = totalSnapshotsCount
   214	
   215		return stats, nil
   216	}

   111	func getEnv(key, defaultValue string) string {
   112		value := os.Getenv(key)
   113		if value == "" {
   114			return defaultValue
   115		}
   116		return value
   117	}
   118	
   119	func getEnvAsInt(key string, defaultValue int) int {
   120		valueStr := os.Getenv(key)
   121		if valueStr == "" {
   122			return defaultValue
   123		}
   124		value, err := strconv.Atoi(valueStr)
   125		if err != nil {
   126			return defaultValue
   127		}
   128		return value
   129	}
   130	
   131	func getEnvAsBool(key string, defaultValue bool) bool {
   132		valueStr := os.Getenv(key)
   133		if valueStr == "" {
   134			return defaultValue
   135		}
   136		value, err := strconv.ParseBool(valueStr)
   137		if err != nil {
   138			return defaultValue
   139		}
   140		return value
   141	}
   142	
   143	func getEnvAsFloat(key string, defaultValue float64) float64 {
   144		valueStr := os.Getenv(key)
   145		if valueStr == "" {
   146			return defaultValue
   147		}
   148		value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(valueStr, 64)
   149		if err != nil {
   150			return defaultValue
   151		}
   152		return value
   153	}

     1	// ============================================================================

     8	package database
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"fmt"
    13		"log"
    14		"os"
    15		"scholar-backend/internal/common/config"
    16		"time"
    17	
    18		"gorm.io/driver/mysql"
    19		"gorm.io/gorm"
    20		"gorm.io/gorm/logger"
    21	)
    22	
    23	var DB *gorm.DB
    24	
    25	// Initialize initializes the database connection
    26	func Initialize(cfg *config.Config) error {
    27		dsn := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s@tcp(%s:%s)/%s?charset=utf8mb4&parseTime=True&loc=Local",
    28			cfg.Database.User,
    29			cfg.Database.Password,
    30			cfg.Database.Host,
    31			cfg.Database.Port,
    32			cfg.Database.DBName,
    33		)
    34	
    35		// Custom logger with slow query detection
    36		newLogger := logger.New(
    37			log.New(os.Stdout, "\r\n", log.LstdFlags),
    38			logger.Config{
    39				SlowThreshold:             200 * time.Millisecond, // Log queries slower than 200ms
    40				LogLevel:                  logger.Warn,            // Only log warnings and errors (including slow queries)
    41				IgnoreRecordNotFoundError: true,                   // Don't log "record not found" as errors
    42				Colorful:                  true,                   // Colorful output for better readability
    43			},
    44		)
    45	
    46		var err error
    47		DB, err = gorm.Open(mysql.Open(dsn), &gorm.Config{
    48			Logger: newLogger,
    49			// 性能优化配置
    50			PrepareStmt:            true, // 预编译SQL语句,提升性能
    51			SkipDefaultTransaction: true, // 跳过默认事务,读操作更快
    52		})
    53	
    54		if err != nil {
    55			return fmt.Errorf("failed to connect to database: %w", err)
    56		}
    57	
    58		sqlDB, err := DB.DB()
    59		if err != nil {
    60			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get database instance: %w", err)
    61		}
    62	
    63		// Set connection pool settings - 优化为更高的并发能力
    64		sqlDB.SetMaxIdleConns(25)                   // 增加空闲连接数,减少连接建立开销
    65		sqlDB.SetMaxOpenConns(200)                  // 增加最大连接数,支持更高并发
    66		sqlDB.SetConnMaxLifetime(time.Hour)         // 连接最大生命周期
    67		sqlDB.SetConnMaxIdleTime(10 * time.Minute) // 空闲连接最大存活时间
    68	
    69		log.Println("Database connection established successfully with optimized pool settings")
    70		return nil
    71	}
    72	
    73	// GetDB returns the database instance
    74	func GetDB() *gorm.DB {
    75		return DB
    76	}
    77	
    78	// StartConnectionPoolMonitoring starts a goroutine that logs connection pool stats
    79	func StartConnectionPoolMonitoring(ctx context.Context, interval time.Duration) {
    80		sqlDB, err := DB.DB()
    81		if err != nil {
    82			log.Printf("Warning: Failed to get database instance for monitoring: %v", err)
    83			return
    84		}
    85	
    86		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
    87		go func() {
    88			defer ticker.Stop()
    89			for {
    90				select {
    91				case <-ticker.C:
    92					stats := sqlDB.Stats()
    93					log.Printf("[DB Pool Stats] Open: %d/%d | InUse: %d | Idle: %d | WaitCount: %d | WaitDuration: %s | MaxIdleClosed: %d | MaxLifetimeClosed: %d",
    94						stats.OpenConnections,
    95						stats.MaxOpenConnections,
    96						stats.InUse,
    97						stats.Idle,
    98						stats.WaitCount,
    99						stats.WaitDuration,
   100						stats.MaxIdleClosed,
   101						stats.MaxLifetimeClosed,
   102					)
   103	
   104					// Alert if pool is under stress
   105					if stats.WaitCount > 0 {
   106						log.Printf("⚠️  [DB Pool Alert] Connection pool has %d waiting requests, consider increasing MaxOpenConns", stats.WaitCount)
   107					}
   108					if int(stats.OpenConnections) >= int(float64(stats.MaxOpenConnections)*0.9) {
   109						log.Printf("⚠️  [DB Pool Alert] Connection pool is at %d%% capacity (%d/%d)",
   110							int(float64(stats.OpenConnections)/float64(stats.MaxOpenConnections)*100),
   111							stats.OpenConnections,
   112							stats.MaxOpenConnections,
   113						)
   114					}
   115				case <-ctx.Done():
   116					log.Println("✓ Database connection pool monitoring stopped")
   117					return
   118				}
   119			}
   120		}()
   121	
   122		log.Printf("✓ Database connection pool monitoring started (interval: %s)", interval)
   123	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package middleware
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"scholar-backend/internal/common/utils"
    12		"strings"
    13	
    14		"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    15	)
    16	
    17	// AuthMiddleware validates JWT tokens
    18	func AuthMiddleware(requiredType string) gin.HandlerFunc {
    19		return func(c *gin.Context) {
    20			var token string
    21	
    22			// Try to get token from Authorization header first
    23			authHeader := c.GetHeader("Authorization")
    24			if authHeader != "" {
    25				// Extract token from "Bearer <token>"
    26				parts := strings.SplitN(authHeader, " ", 2)
    27				if len(parts) == 2 && parts[0] == "Bearer" {
    28					token = parts[1]
    29				}
    30			}
    31	
    32			// Fallback to query parameter (for SSE/EventSource support)
    33			if token == "" {
    34				token = c.Query("token")
    35			}
    36	
    37			if token == "" {
    38				utils.Unauthorized(c, "Authorization header or token query parameter is required")
    39				c.Abort()
    40				return
    41			}
    42			claims, err := utils.ParseToken(token)
    43			if err != nil {
    44				utils.Unauthorized(c, "Invalid or expired token")
    45				c.Abort()
    46				return
    47			}
    48	
    49			// Check user type if required
    50			if requiredType != "" && claims.Type != requiredType {
    51				utils.Unauthorized(c, "Insufficient permissions")
    52				c.Abort()
    53				return
    54			}
    55	
    56			// Store claims in context
    57			c.Set("user_id", claims.UserID)
    58			c.Set("username", claims.Username)
    59			c.Set("user_type", claims.Type)
    60	
    61			c.Next()
    62		}
    63	}
    64	
    65	// AdminAuthMiddleware validates admin JWT tokens
    66	func AdminAuthMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
    67		return AuthMiddleware("admin")
    68	}
    69	
    70	// UserAuthMiddleware validates user JWT tokens
    71	func UserAuthMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
    72		return AuthMiddleware("user")
    73	}

    18			c.Writer.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true")

    21	
    22			if c.Request.Method == "OPTIONS" {
    23				c.AbortWithStatus(204)
    24				return
    25			}
    26	
    27			c.Next()
    28		}
    29	}

    33					c.Request.URL.Path,
    34					duration,
    35					c.Writer.Status(),
    36				)
    37			}
    38	
    39			// 添加响应时间到header (方便调试)
    40			c.Header("X-Response-Time", duration.String())
    41		}
    42	}

================================================================================
文件: backend/internal/common/middleware/ratelimit.go
================================================================================

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package middleware
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"sync"
    13		"time"
    14	
    15		"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    16	)
    17	
    18	// clientLimiter tracks request counts for a single client
    19	type clientLimiter struct {
    20		count      int
    21		lastReset  time.Time
    22		windowSize time.Duration
    23		maxRequests int
    24	}
    25	
    26	// RateLimiter manages rate limiting for different clients using sliding window
    27	type RateLimiter struct {
    28		clients     map[string]*clientLimiter
    29		mu          sync.RWMutex
    30		windowSize  time.Duration
    31		maxRequests int
    32		stopCleanup chan struct{} // Channel to signal cleanup goroutine to stop
    33	}
    34	
    35	// NewRateLimiter creates a new rate limiter
    36	// maxRequests: maximum requests allowed per window
    37	// windowSize: time window duration (e.g., 1 second)
    38	func NewRateLimiter(maxRequests int, windowSize time.Duration) *RateLimiter {
    39		return &RateLimiter{
    40			clients:     make(map[string]*clientLimiter),
    41			windowSize:  windowSize,
    42			maxRequests: maxRequests,
    43			stopCleanup: make(chan struct{}),
    44		}
    45	}
    46	
    47	// Allow checks if a request is allowed for the given key
    48	func (rl *RateLimiter) Allow(key string) bool {
    49		rl.mu.Lock()
    50		defer rl.mu.Unlock()
    51	
    52		now := time.Now()
    53		client, exists := rl.clients[key]
    54	
    55		if !exists {
    56			// First request from this client
    57			rl.clients[key] = &clientLimiter{
    58				count:       1,
    59				lastReset:   now,
    60				windowSize:  rl.windowSize,
    61				maxRequests: rl.maxRequests,
    62			}
    63			return true
    64		}
    65	
    66		// Check if window has expired
    67		if now.Sub(client.lastReset) >= client.windowSize {
    68			// Reset the window
    69			client.count = 1
    70			client.lastReset = now
    71			return true
    72		}
    73	
    74		// Within the same window
    75		if client.count < client.maxRequests {
    76			client.count++
    77			return true
    78		}
    79	
    80		// Rate limit exceeded
    81		return false
    82	}
    83	
    84	// Cleanup removes old client entries
    85	func (rl *RateLimiter) Cleanup() {
    86		rl.mu.Lock()
    87		defer rl.mu.Unlock()
    88	
    89		now := time.Now()
    90		for key, client := range rl.clients {
    91			// Remove clients whose window has expired by more than 5 minutes
    92			if now.Sub(client.lastReset) > client.windowSize+5*time.Minute {
    93				delete(rl.clients, key)
    94			}
    95		}
    96	}
    97	
    98	// StartCleanup periodically cleans up old entries
    99	func (rl *RateLimiter) StartCleanup(interval time.Duration) {
   100		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
   101		go func() {
   102			defer ticker.Stop()
   103			for {
   104				select {
   105				case <-ticker.C:
   106					rl.Cleanup()
   107				case <-rl.stopCleanup:
   108					return
   109				}
   110			}
   111		}()
   112	}
   113	
   114	// StartCleanupWithContext periodically cleans up old entries, respecting context cancellation
   115	func (rl *RateLimiter) StartCleanupWithContext(ctx context.Context, interval time.Duration) {
   116		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
   117		go func() {
   118			defer ticker.Stop()
   119			for {
   120				select {
   121				case <-ticker.C:
   122					rl.Cleanup()
   123				case <-ctx.Done():
   124					return
   125				case <-rl.stopCleanup:
   126					return
   127				}
   128			}
   129		}()
   130	}
   131	
   132	// StopCleanup signals the cleanup goroutine to stop
   133	func (rl *RateLimiter) StopCleanup() {
   134		close(rl.stopCleanup)
   135	}
   136	
   137	// RateLimitMiddleware creates a rate limiting middleware
   138	// Example: RateLimitMiddleware(100, 1*time.Second) allows 100 req/s
   139	func RateLimitMiddleware(maxRequests int, windowSize time.Duration) gin.HandlerFunc {
   140		rl := NewRateLimiter(maxRequests, windowSize)
   141	
   142		// Start cleanup goroutine
   143		rl.StartCleanup(5 * time.Minute)
   144	
   145		return func(c *gin.Context) {
   146			// Use IP address as key
   147			key := c.ClientIP()
   148	
   149			if !rl.Allow(key) {
   150				c.JSON(429, gin.H{
   151					"code":    429,
   152					"message": "Too many requests",
   153					"error":   "Rate limit exceeded. Please slow down your requests.",
   154				})
   155				c.Abort()
   156				return
   157			}
   158	
   159			c.Next()
   160		}
   161	}
   162	
   163	// UserRateLimitMiddleware creates user-specific rate limiting
   164	// This should be used after authentication middleware
   165	func UserRateLimitMiddleware(maxRequests int, windowSize time.Duration) gin.HandlerFunc {
   166		rl := NewRateLimiter(maxRequests, windowSize)
   167		rl.StartCleanup(5 * time.Minute)
   168	
   169		return func(c *gin.Context) {
   170			// Try to get user ID from context (set by auth middleware)
   171			userIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   172			var key string
   173	
   174			if exists {
   175				// Use user ID if authenticated
   176				switch v := userIDInterface.(type) {
   177				case string:
   178					key = v
   179				case uint:
   180					key = string(rune(v))
   181				default:
   182					key = c.ClientIP()
   183				}
   184			} else {
   185				// Fall back to IP if user not authenticated
   186				key = c.ClientIP()
   187			}
   188	
   189			if !rl.Allow(key) {
   190				c.JSON(429, gin.H{
   191					"code":    429,
   192					"message": "Too many requests",
   193					"error":   "Rate limit exceeded. Please slow down your requests.",
   194				})
   195				c.Abort()
   196				return
   197			}
   198	
   199			c.Next()
   200		}
   201	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package middleware
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"bytes"
    12		"context"
    13		"fmt"
    14		"io"
    15		"time"
    16	
    17		"scholar-backend/internal/common/telemetry"
    18		
    19		"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    20		"github.com/google/uuid"
    21		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
    22		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
    23		"go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/github.com/gin-gonic/gin/otelgin"
    24	)
    25	
    26	// TelemetryMiddleware provides comprehensive request logging and tracing
    27	func TelemetryMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
    28		logger := telemetry.NewLogger("http.middleware")
    29		tracer := telemetry.GetTracer()
    30		
    31		return func(c *gin.Context) {
    32			// Generate request ID
    33			requestID := uuid.New().String()
    34			c.Set("RequestID", requestID)
    35			c.Header("X-Request-ID", requestID)
    36			
    37			// Start span
    38			ctx := c.Request.Context()
    39			spanName := fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", c.Request.Method, c.FullPath())
    40			if spanName == " " {
    41				spanName = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", c.Request.Method, c.Request.URL.Path)
    42			}
    43			
    44			ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, spanName,
    45				trace.WithSpanKind(trace.SpanKindServer),
    46				trace.WithAttributes(
    47					attribute.String("http.method", c.Request.Method),
    48					attribute.String("http.url", c.Request.URL.String()),
    49					attribute.String("http.target", c.Request.URL.Path),
    50					attribute.String("http.host", c.Request.Host),
    51					attribute.String("http.scheme", c.Request.URL.Scheme),
    52					attribute.String("http.user_agent", c.Request.UserAgent()),
    53					attribute.String("request.id", requestID),
    54				),
    55			)
    56			defer span.End()
    57			
    58			// Update request context
    59			c.Request = c.Request.WithContext(ctx)
    60			
    61			// Capture request body for logging (if needed)
    62			var requestBody []byte
    63			if c.Request.Body != nil && shouldLogBody(c.Request.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
    64				requestBody, _ = io.ReadAll(c.Request.Body)
    65				c.Request.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewBuffer(requestBody))
    66			}
    67			
    68			// Create response writer wrapper to capture response size
    69			blw := &bodyLogWriter{body: bytes.NewBufferString(""), ResponseWriter: c.Writer}
    70			c.Writer = blw
    71			
    72			// Record start time
    73			startTime := time.Now()
    74			
    75			// Get client IP
    76			clientIP := c.ClientIP()
    77			if realIP := c.Request.Header.Get("X-Real-IP"); realIP != "" {
    78				clientIP = realIP
    79			} else if forwardedFor := c.Request.Header.Get("X-Forwarded-For"); forwardedFor != "" {
    80				clientIP = forwardedFor
    81			}
    82			
    83			// Process request
    84			c.Next()
    85			
    86			// Calculate latency
    87			latency := time.Since(startTime)
    88			
    89			// Get user ID from context if available
    90			userID := ""
    91			if uid, exists := c.Get("userID"); exists {
    92				userID = fmt.Sprintf("%v", uid)
    93				span.SetAttributes(attribute.String("user.id", userID))
    94			}
    95			
    96			// Set span attributes
    97			span.SetAttributes(
    98				attribute.Int("http.status_code", c.Writer.Status()),
    99				attribute.Int64("http.request_content_length", c.Request.ContentLength),
   100				attribute.Int64("http.response_content_length", int64(blw.body.Len())),
   101				attribute.Float64("http.latency_ms", float64(latency.Milliseconds())),
   102				attribute.String("client.ip", clientIP),
   103			)
   104			
   105			// Prepare log entry
   106			logEntry := &telemetry.LogEntry{
   107				Level:        telemetry.LogLevelInfo,
   108				Message:      fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %s %s", c.Request.Method, c.Request.URL.Path),
   109				Method:       c.Request.Method,
   110				Path:         c.Request.URL.Path,
   111				StatusCode:   c.Writer.Status(),
   112				Latency:      latency,
   113				ClientIP:     clientIP,
   114				UserAgent:    c.Request.UserAgent(),
   115				RefererURL:   c.Request.Referer(),
   116				RequestSize:  c.Request.ContentLength,
   117				ResponseSize: int64(blw.body.Len()),
   118				UserID:       userID,
   119				RequestID:    requestID,
   120				TraceID:      span.SpanContext().TraceID().String(),
   121				SpanID:       span.SpanContext().SpanID().String(),
   122			}
   123			
   124			// Add custom attributes based on endpoint
   125			attrs := []attribute.KeyValue{
   126				attribute.String("endpoint.path", c.FullPath()),
   127				attribute.String("endpoint.handler", c.HandlerName()),
   128			}
   129			
   130			// Add query parameters if present
   131			if c.Request.URL.RawQuery != "" {
   132				attrs = append(attrs, attribute.String("http.query", c.Request.URL.RawQuery))
   133			}
   134			
   135			// Add request body size if present
   136			if len(requestBody) > 0 {
   137				attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int("http.request_body_size", len(requestBody)))
   138				// For debugging, optionally log small request bodies
   139				if len(requestBody) < 1024 && c.Writer.Status() >= 400 {
   140					attrs = append(attrs, attribute.String("http.request_body", string(requestBody)))
   141				}
   142			}
   143			
   144			// Check for errors
   145			if len(c.Errors) > 0 {
   146				logEntry.Level = telemetry.LogLevelError
   147				logEntry.Error = c.Errors.Last().Err
   148				logEntry.Message = fmt.Sprintf("Request failed: %s", c.Errors.Last().Error())
   149				
   150			// Log all errors
   151			for _, e := range c.Errors {
   152				logger.Error(ctx, e.Error(), e.Err,
   153					attribute.String("error.type", fmt.Sprintf("%d", e.Type)),
   154					attribute.String("error.meta", fmt.Sprintf("%v", e.Meta)),
   155				)
   156			}
   157			}
   158			
   159			// Add response headers for debugging
   160			if c.Writer.Status() >= 400 {
   161				for key, values := range c.Writer.Header() {
   162					if len(values) > 0 {
   163						attrs = append(attrs, attribute.String(fmt.Sprintf("response.header.%s", key), values[0]))
   164					}
   165				}
   166			}
   167			
   168			logEntry.Attributes = attrs
   169			
   170			// Log the request
   171			logger.LogRequest(ctx, logEntry)
   172			
   173			// Log slow queries separately
   174			if latency > 1*time.Second {
   175				logger.Warn(ctx, "Slow API request detected",
   176					attribute.String("method", c.Request.Method),
   177					attribute.String("path", c.Request.URL.Path),
   178					attribute.Float64("latency_seconds", latency.Seconds()),
   179					attribute.String("client_ip", clientIP),
   180					attribute.String("user_id", userID),
   181				)
   182			}
   183			
   184			// Log specific endpoint metrics for monitoring
   185			logEndpointSpecificMetrics(ctx, logger, c, latency)
   186		}
   187	}
   188	
   189	// OpenTelemetryGinMiddleware wraps the otelgin middleware for additional setup
   190	func OpenTelemetryGinMiddleware(serviceName string) gin.HandlerFunc {
   191		return otelgin.Middleware(serviceName)
   192	}
   193	
   194	// bodyLogWriter wraps gin.ResponseWriter to capture response body size
   195	type bodyLogWriter struct {
   196		gin.ResponseWriter
   197		body *bytes.Buffer
   198	}
   199	
   200	func (w bodyLogWriter) Write(b []byte) (int, error) {
   201		w.body.Write(b)
   202		return w.ResponseWriter.Write(b)
   203	}
   204	
   205	// shouldLogBody determines if request body should be logged based on content type
   206	func shouldLogBody(contentType string) bool {
   207		// Only log JSON and form data bodies, skip binary data
   208		return contentType == "application/json" || 
   209		       contentType == "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" ||
   210		       contentType == "text/plain"
   211	}
   212	
   213	// logEndpointSpecificMetrics logs metrics specific to certain endpoints
   214	func logEndpointSpecificMetrics(ctx context.Context, logger *telemetry.Logger, c *gin.Context, latency time.Duration) {
   215		path := c.FullPath()
   216		
   217		// Log metrics for specific critical endpoints
   218		switch path {
   219		case "/api/v1/user/login", "/api/v1/user/register":
   220			logger.Info(ctx, "Authentication endpoint accessed",
   221				attribute.String("endpoint", path),
   222				attribute.String("method", c.Request.Method),
   223				attribute.Bool("success", c.Writer.Status() < 400),
   224				attribute.Float64("latency_ms", float64(latency.Milliseconds())),
   225			)
   226			
   227		case "/api/v1/scholar/papers/search":
   228			// Log search metrics
   229			logger.Info(ctx, "Search endpoint accessed",
   230				attribute.String("endpoint", path),
   231				attribute.Int("result_count", c.Writer.Size()),
   232				attribute.Float64("latency_ms", float64(latency.Milliseconds())),
   233			)
   234			
   235		case "/api/v1/payment/alipay/create", "/api/v1/payment/wechat/create":
   236			// Log payment metrics with extra care
   237			logger.Info(ctx, "Payment endpoint accessed",
   238				attribute.String("endpoint", path),
   239				attribute.String("payment_method", getPaymentMethod(path)),
   240				attribute.Bool("success", c.Writer.Status() < 400),
   241				attribute.Float64("latency_ms", float64(latency.Milliseconds())),
   242			)
   243			
   244		case "/api/v1/conversations/chat/stream":
   245			// Log AI chat metrics
   246			logger.Info(ctx, "AI chat endpoint accessed",
   247				attribute.String("endpoint", path),
   248				attribute.Float64("latency_ms", float64(latency.Milliseconds())),
   249				attribute.Bool("streaming", true),
   250			)
   251		}
   252		
   253		// Log admin operations
   254		if len(path) > 13 && path[:13] == "/api/v1/admin" {
   255			logger.Info(ctx, "Admin operation",
   256				attribute.String("endpoint", path),
   257				attribute.String("method", c.Request.Method),
   258				attribute.String("admin_user", c.GetString("adminID")),
   259				attribute.Bool("success", c.Writer.Status() < 400),
   260			)
   261		}
   262	}
   263	
   264	// getPaymentMethod extracts payment method from path
   265	func getPaymentMethod(path string) string {
   266		if bytes.Contains([]byte(path), []byte("alipay")) {
   267			return "alipay"
   268		}
   269		if bytes.Contains([]byte(path), []byte("wechat")) {
   270			return "wechat"
   271		}
   272		return "unknown"
   273	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package middleware
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"time"
    13	
    14		"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    15	)
    16	
    17	// TimeoutMiddleware adds request timeout to all requests
    18	// This prevents hanging requests and ensures better resource control
    19	//
    20	// IMPORTANT: This implementation has a known limitation where handler goroutines
    21	// may continue running after timeout. The context cancellation propagates to handlers
    22	// that properly respect context, but handlers that don't check context.Done() may leak.
    23	// This is a known Go timeout pattern limitation. Ensure all long-running operations
    24	// in handlers properly check and respond to context cancellation.
    25	func TimeoutMiddleware(timeout time.Duration) gin.HandlerFunc {
    26		return func(c *gin.Context) {
    27			// Create a context with timeout
    28			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(c.Request.Context(), timeout)
    29			defer cancel()
    30	
    31			// Replace request context with timeout context
    32			// This propagates cancellation to handlers that respect context
    33			c.Request = c.Request.WithContext(ctx)
    34	
    35			// Channel to signal when request processing is done
    36			done := make(chan struct{})
    37			panicChan := make(chan interface{}, 1)
    38	
    39			// Process request in goroutine
    40			go func() {
    41				defer func() {
    42					if p := recover(); p != nil {
    43						panicChan <- p
    44					}
    45				}()
    46				c.Next()
    47				close(done)
    48			}()
    49	
    50			// Wait for either completion or timeout
    51			select {
    52			case p := <-panicChan:
    53				// Handler panicked, re-panic after cleanup
    54				panic(p)
    55			case <-done:
    56				// Request completed successfully
    57				return
    58			case <-ctx.Done():
    59				// Timeout occurred
    60				// Note: The handler goroutine may still be running. Context cancellation
    61				// should trigger cleanup in well-behaved handlers that check ctx.Done().
    62				if ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded {
    63					c.JSON(408, gin.H{
    64						"code":    408,
    65						"message": "Request timeout",
    66						"error":   "The request took too long to process and was cancelled",
    67					})
    68					c.Abort()
    69				}
    70				// Give handler a brief moment to clean up
    71				// This doesn't fully solve goroutine leaks but allows context-aware handlers to exit
    72				time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
    73			}
    74		}
    75	}
    76	
    77	// APITimeoutMiddleware provides different timeouts for different API types
    78	func APITimeoutMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
    79		return func(c *gin.Context) {
    80			// Determine timeout based on endpoint
    81			var timeout time.Duration
    82	
    83			// Streaming endpoints need longer timeout
    84			if c.GetHeader("Accept") == "text/event-stream" ||
    85				c.Request.URL.Path == "/api/v1/conversation/messages/stream" ||
    86				c.Request.URL.Path == "/api/v1/conversation/messages/advanced-search/stream" {
    87				timeout = 5 * time.Minute // 5 minutes for streaming
    88			} else if c.Request.Method == "POST" || c.Request.Method == "PUT" {
    89				timeout = 30 * time.Second // 30 seconds for write operations
    90			} else {
    91				timeout = 15 * time.Second // 15 seconds for read operations
    92			}
    93	
    94			// Create context with timeout
    95			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(c.Request.Context(), timeout)
    96			defer cancel()
    97	
    98			// Replace request context
    99			c.Request = c.Request.WithContext(ctx)
   100	
   101			// Continue with request
   102			c.Next()
   103		}
   104	}

     1	// ============================================================================

     8	package telemetry
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"bytes"
    12		"context"

    14		"fmt"

    25	// LogLevel represents the severity of a log entry
    26	type LogLevel string
    27	
    28	const (
    29		LogLevelDebug LogLevel = "DEBUG"
    30		LogLevelInfo  LogLevel = "INFO"
    31		LogLevelWarn  LogLevel = "WARN"
    32		LogLevelError LogLevel = "ERROR"
    33		LogLevelFatal LogLevel = "FATAL"
    34	)
    35	
    36	// Logger provides structured logging with SigNoz integration
    37	type Logger struct {
    38		logger   *logrus.Logger
    39		tracer   trace.Tracer
    40		endpoint string
    41	}

    43	var globalEndpoint string
    44	
    45	// SetGlobalEndpoint sets the global SigNoz endpoint
    46	func SetGlobalEndpoint(endpoint string) {
    47		globalEndpoint = endpoint
    48	}

    50	// NewLogger creates a new logger instance
    51	func NewLogger(name string) *Logger {
    52		logger := logrus.New()
    53		logger.SetFormatter(&logrus.JSONFormatter{
    54			TimestampFormat: time.RFC3339Nano,
    55		})
    56		
    57		return &Logger{
    58			logger:   logger,
    59			tracer:   GetTracer(),
    60			endpoint: globalEndpoint,
    61		}
    62	}
