    64	// LogEntry represents a structured log entry
    65	type LogEntry struct {
    66		Level        LogLevel
    67		Message      string
    68		Attributes   []attribute.KeyValue
    69		Error        error
    70		Timestamp    time.Time
    71		TraceID      string
    72		SpanID       string
    73		UserID       string
    74		RequestID    string
    75		Method       string
    76		Path         string
    77		StatusCode   int
    78		Latency      time.Duration
    79		ClientIP     string
    80		UserAgent    string
    81		RefererURL   string
    82		RequestSize  int64
    83		ResponseSize int64
    84	}

    86	// Debug logs a debug message
    87	func (l *Logger) Debug(ctx context.Context, msg string, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) {
    88		l.log(ctx, LogLevelDebug, msg, nil, attrs...)
    89	}
    90	
    91	// Info logs an info message
    92	func (l *Logger) Info(ctx context.Context, msg string, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) {
    93		l.log(ctx, LogLevelInfo, msg, nil, attrs...)
    94	}
    95	
    96	// Warn logs a warning message
    97	func (l *Logger) Warn(ctx context.Context, msg string, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) {
    98		l.log(ctx, LogLevelWarn, msg, nil, attrs...)
    99	}
   100	
   101	// Error logs an error message
   102	func (l *Logger) Error(ctx context.Context, msg string, err error, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) {
   103		l.log(ctx, LogLevelError, msg, err, attrs...)
   104		
   105		// Also record error in span if exists
   106		span := trace.SpanFromContext(ctx)
   107		if span.IsRecording() && err != nil {
   108			span.RecordError(err)
   109			span.SetStatus(codes.Error, msg)
   110		}
   111	}
   112	
   113	// Fatal logs a fatal message
   114	func (l *Logger) Fatal(ctx context.Context, msg string, err error, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) {
   115		l.log(ctx, LogLevelFatal, msg, err, attrs...)
   116	}
   117	
   118	// LogRequest logs an HTTP request with detailed information
   119	func (l *Logger) LogRequest(ctx context.Context, entry *LogEntry) {
   120		attrs := []attribute.KeyValue{
   121			attribute.String("http.method", entry.Method),
   122			attribute.String("http.path", entry.Path),
   123			attribute.Int("http.status_code", entry.StatusCode),
   124			attribute.Float64("http.latency_ms", float64(entry.Latency.Milliseconds())),
   125			attribute.String("http.client_ip", entry.ClientIP),
   126			attribute.String("http.user_agent", entry.UserAgent),
   127			attribute.String("http.referer", entry.RefererURL),
   128			attribute.Int64("http.request_size", entry.RequestSize),
   129			attribute.Int64("http.response_size", entry.ResponseSize),
   130		}
   131		
   132		if entry.UserID != "" {
   133			attrs = append(attrs, attribute.String("user.id", entry.UserID))
   134		}
   135		
   136		if entry.RequestID != "" {
   137			attrs = append(attrs, attribute.String("request.id", entry.RequestID))
   138		}
   139		
   140		// Add custom attributes
   141		attrs = append(attrs, entry.Attributes...)
   142		
   143		// Determine log level based on status code
   144		level := LogLevelInfo
   145		if entry.StatusCode >= 500 {
   146			level = LogLevelError
   147		} else if entry.StatusCode >= 400 {
   148			level = LogLevelWarn
   149		}
   150		
   151		// Log with appropriate level
   152		l.log(ctx, level, entry.Message, entry.Error, attrs...)
   153		
   154		// For slow requests, add additional warning
   155		if entry.Latency > 1*time.Second {
   156			l.Warn(ctx, "Slow request detected", 
   157				attribute.String("http.method", entry.Method),
   158				attribute.String("http.path", entry.Path),
   159				attribute.Float64("http.latency_seconds", entry.Latency.Seconds()),
   160			)
   161		}
   162	}
   163	
   164	// log is the internal logging method
   165	func (l *Logger) log(ctx context.Context, level LogLevel, msg string, err error, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) {
   166		// Get trace and span IDs from context
   167		span := trace.SpanFromContext(ctx)
   168		spanCtx := span.SpanContext()
   169		
   170		// Prepare log fields
   171		fields := logrus.Fields{
   172			"level":   string(level),
   173			"message": msg,
   174		}
   175		
   176		// Add trace context
   177		if spanCtx.HasTraceID() {
   178			fields["trace.id"] = spanCtx.TraceID().String()
   179		}
   180		if spanCtx.HasSpanID() {
   181			fields["span.id"] = spanCtx.SpanID().String()
   182		}
   183		
   184		// Add attributes
   185		for _, attr := range attrs {
   186			fields[string(attr.Key)] = attr.Value.AsInterface()
   187		}
   188		
   189		// Add error if present
   190		if err != nil {
   191			fields["error.type"] = fmt.Sprintf("%T", err)
   192			fields["error.message"] = err.Error()
   193			
   194			// Add stack trace for errors
   195			if level == LogLevelError || level == LogLevelFatal {
   196				fields["error.stack"] = getStackTrace()
   197			}
   198		}
   199		
   200		// Log to local logger
   201		entry := l.logger.WithFields(fields)
   202		switch level {
   203		case LogLevelDebug:
   204			entry.Debug(msg)
   205		case LogLevelInfo:
   206			entry.Info(msg)
   207		case LogLevelWarn:
   208			entry.Warn(msg)
   209		case LogLevelError:
   210			entry.Error(msg)
   211		case LogLevelFatal:
   212			entry.Fatal(msg)
   213		}
   214		
   215		// Send to SigNoz if endpoint is configured
   216		if l.endpoint != "" {
   217			go l.sendToSigNoz(fields)
   218		}
   219	}
   220	
   221	// sendToSigNoz sends log to SigNoz via HTTP
   222	func (l *Logger) sendToSigNoz(fields logrus.Fields) {
   223		// Convert to JSON
   224		data, err := json.Marshal(fields)
   225		if err != nil {
   226			return
   227		}
   228		
   229		// Send HTTP request
   230		client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
   231		req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", l.endpoint+"/v1/logs", bytes.NewBuffer(data))
   232		if err != nil {
   233			return
   234		}
   235		
   236		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   237		_, _ = client.Do(req)
   238	}
   239	
   240	// getStackTrace returns the current stack trace
   241	func getStackTrace() string {
   242		buf := make([]byte, 1024*16)
   243		n := runtime.Stack(buf, false)
   244		return string(buf[:n])
   245	}
   246	
   247	// WithAttributes adds attributes to the logger context
   248	func WithAttributes(ctx context.Context, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) context.Context {
   249		type contextKey string
   250		const attributesKey contextKey = "logger.attributes"
   251		
   252		existing, _ := ctx.Value(attributesKey).([]attribute.KeyValue)
   253		return context.WithValue(ctx, attributesKey, append(existing, attrs...))
   254	}
   255	
   256	// GetAttributes retrieves attributes from context
   257	func GetAttributes(ctx context.Context) []attribute.KeyValue {
   258		type contextKey string
   259		const attributesKey contextKey = "logger.attributes"
   260		
   261		if attrs, ok := ctx.Value(attributesKey).([]attribute.KeyValue); ok {
   262			return attrs
   263		}
   264		return nil
   265	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package telemetry
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"fmt"
    13		"time"
    14	
    15		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel"
    16		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
    17		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
    18		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
    19		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation"
    20		sdktrace "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
    21		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
    22		semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.21.0"
    23		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
    24	)
    25	
    26	var (
    27		tracer trace.Tracer
    28	)
    29	
    30	// Initialize sets up OpenTelemetry with SigNoz
    31	func Initialize(ctx context.Context, cfg *Config) (shutdown func(context.Context) error, err error) {
    32		// Create resource
    33		res, err := newResource(cfg)
    34		if err != nil {
    35			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create resource: %w", err)
    36		}
    37	
    38		// Initialize tracing if enabled
    39		var tracerShutdown func(context.Context) error
    40		if cfg.EnableTracing {
    41			tracerShutdown, err = initTracing(ctx, cfg, res)
    42			if err != nil {
    43				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize tracing: %w", err)
    44			}
    45		}
    46	
    47		// Create composite shutdown function
    48		shutdown = func(ctx context.Context) error {
    49			if tracerShutdown != nil {
    50				return tracerShutdown(ctx)
    51			}
    52			return nil
    53		}
    54	
    55		return shutdown, nil
    56	}
    57	
    58	// initTracing initializes OpenTelemetry tracing
    59	func initTracing(ctx context.Context, cfg *Config, res *resource.Resource) (func(context.Context) error, error) {
    60		// Create OTLP trace exporter with retry configuration
    61		traceExporter, err := otlptrace.New(
    62			ctx,
    63			otlptracehttp.NewClient(
    64				otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(cfg.Endpoint),
    65				otlptracehttp.WithInsecure(),
    66				otlptracehttp.WithTimeout(30*time.Second),
    67				otlptracehttp.WithRetry(otlptracehttp.RetryConfig{
    68					Enabled:         true,
    69					InitialInterval: 1 * time.Second,
    70					MaxInterval:     10 * time.Second,
    71					MaxElapsedTime:  1 * time.Minute,
    72				}),
    73				// Add compression to reduce payload size
    74				otlptracehttp.WithCompression(1), // 1 = gzip compression
    75			),
    76		)
    77		if err != nil {
    78			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create trace exporter: %w", err)
    79		}
    80	
    81		// Create trace provider with optimized batch settings
    82		tp := sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(
    83			sdktrace.WithBatcher(
    84				traceExporter,
    85				sdktrace.WithMaxExportBatchSize(512),      // Batch up to 512 spans
    86				sdktrace.WithBatchTimeout(5*time.Second),  // Export every 5 seconds
    87				sdktrace.WithMaxQueueSize(2048),           // Queue up to 2048 spans
    88			),
    89			sdktrace.WithResource(res),
    90			sdktrace.WithSampler(sdktrace.TraceIDRatioBased(cfg.SamplingRate)),
    91		)
    92	
    93		// Set global trace provider
    94		otel.SetTracerProvider(tp)
    95		
    96		// Set global propagator
    97		otel.SetTextMapPropagator(
    98			propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(
    99				propagation.TraceContext{},
   100				propagation.Baggage{},
   101			),
   102		)
   103	
   104		// Get tracer
   105		tracer = tp.Tracer("scholar-backend")
   106	
   107		return tp.Shutdown, nil
   108	}
   109	
   110	// newResource creates a new resource with service information
   111	func newResource(cfg *Config) (*resource.Resource, error) {
   112		// Create resource with attributes (without specifying SchemaURL to avoid conflicts)
   113		res := resource.NewWithAttributes(
   114			"", // Empty schema URL to avoid version conflicts
   115			semconv.ServiceName(cfg.ServiceName),
   116			semconv.ServiceVersion("1.0.0"),
   117			attribute.String("environment", cfg.Environment),
   118			attribute.String("service.namespace", "scholar"),
   119		)
   120		
   121		// Merge with default resource (without SchemaURL)
   122		defaultRes, err := resource.New(context.Background())
   123		if err != nil {
   124			return res, nil // Return custom resource if default fails
   125		}
   126		
   127		return resource.Merge(defaultRes, res)
   128	}
   129	
   130	// GetTracer returns the global tracer
   131	func GetTracer() trace.Tracer {
   132		if tracer == nil {
   133			// Return a no-op tracer if not initialized
   134			return otel.Tracer("scholar-backend")
   135		}
   136		return tracer
   137	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package turnstile
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"bytes"
    12		"encoding/json"
    13		"fmt"
    14		"io"
    15		"net/http"
    16		"os"
    17		"scholar-backend/internal/common/model"
    18		"time"
    19	)
    20	
    21	// VerifyRequest represents the Turnstile verification request
    22	type VerifyRequest struct {
    23		Secret   string `json:"secret"`
    24		Response string `json:"response"` // The token from frontend
    25		RemoteIP string `json:"remoteip,omitempty"`
    26	}
    27	
    28	// VerifyResponse represents the Turnstile verification response
    29	type VerifyResponse struct {
    30		Success     bool     `json:"success"`
    31		ChallengeTS string   `json:"challenge_ts,omitempty"`
    32		Hostname    string   `json:"hostname,omitempty"`
    33		ErrorCodes  []string `json:"error-codes,omitempty"`
    34		Action      string   `json:"action,omitempty"`
    35		CData       string   `json:"cdata,omitempty"`
    36	}
    37	
    38	const (
    39		verifyURL = "https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify"
    40	)
    41	
    42	var httpClient = &http.Client{
    43		Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
    44	}
    45	
    46	// VerifyToken verifies a Turnstile token with Cloudflare
    47	func VerifyToken(token string, remoteIP string) (*VerifyResponse, error) {
    48		secretKey := os.Getenv("TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY")
    49		if secretKey == "" {
    50			// For testing: use test secret key that always passes
    51			secretKey = "1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA"
    52		}
    53	
    54		reqBody := VerifyRequest{
    55			Secret:   secretKey,
    56			Response: token,
    57			RemoteIP: remoteIP,
    58		}
    59	
    60		jsonData, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
    61		if err != nil {
    62			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request: %w", err)
    63		}
    64	
    65		req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", verifyURL, bytes.NewBuffer(jsonData))
    66		if err != nil {
    67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
    68		}
    69	
    70		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    71	
    72		resp, err := httpClient.Do(req)
    73		if err != nil {
    74			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to send request: %w", err)
    75		}
    76		defer resp.Body.Close()
    77	
    78		body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    79		if err != nil {
    80			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response: %w", err)
    81		}
    82	
    83		var verifyResp VerifyResponse
    84		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &verifyResp); err != nil {
    85			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
    86		}
    87	
    88		return &verifyResp, nil
    89	}
    90	
    91	// Verify is a convenience function that returns true if token is valid
    92	func Verify(token string, remoteIP string) (bool, error) {
    93		if token == "" {
    94			return false, fmt.Errorf("turnstile token is required")
    95		}
    96	
    97		resp, err := VerifyToken(token, remoteIP)
    98		if err != nil {
    99			return false, err
   100		}
   101	
   102		if !resp.Success {
   103			if len(resp.ErrorCodes) > 0 {
   104				return false, fmt.Errorf("turnstile verification failed: %v", resp.ErrorCodes)
   105			}
   106			return false, fmt.Errorf("turnstile verification failed")
   107		}
   108	
   109		return true, nil
   110	}
   111	
   112	// VerifyWithConfig verifies a Turnstile token using system configuration
   113	// If systemConfig is nil or EnableTurnstile is false, verification is skipped and returns true
   114	func VerifyWithConfig(token string, remoteIP string, systemConfig *model.SystemConfig) (bool, error) {
   115		// If system config is nil or Turnstile is disabled, skip verification
   116		if systemConfig == nil || !systemConfig.EnableTurnstile {
   117			return true, nil
   118		}
   119	
   120		// If Turnstile is enabled but no token provided, return error
   121		if token == "" {
   122			return false, fmt.Errorf("人机验证码不能为空")
   123		}
   124	
   125		// Use configured secret key
   126		secretKey := systemConfig.TurnstileSecretKey
   127		if secretKey == "" {
   128			// Fallback to test key for development
   129			secretKey = "1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA"
   130		}
   131	
   132		// Verify token using configured secret key
   133		reqBody := VerifyRequest{
   134			Secret:   secretKey,
   135			Response: token,
   136			RemoteIP: remoteIP,
   137		}
   138	
   139		jsonData, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
   140		if err != nil {
   141			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request: %w", err)
   142		}
   143	
   144		req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", verifyURL, bytes.NewBuffer(jsonData))
   145		if err != nil {
   146			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
   147		}
   148	
   149		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   150	
   151		resp, err := httpClient.Do(req)
   152		if err != nil {
   153			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to send request: %w", err)
   154		}
   155		defer resp.Body.Close()
   156	
   157		body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   158		if err != nil {
   159			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response: %w", err)
   160		}
   161	
   162		var verifyResp VerifyResponse
   163		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &verifyResp); err != nil {
   164			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
   165		}
   166	
   167		if !verifyResp.Success {
   168			if len(verifyResp.ErrorCodes) > 0 {
   169				return false, fmt.Errorf("人机验证失败: %v", verifyResp.ErrorCodes)
   170			}
   171			return false, fmt.Errorf("人机验证失败")
   172		}
   173	
   174		return true, nil
   175	}

     1	// ============================================================================

     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

     8	package utils
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"crypto/tls"
    12		"fmt"
    13		"net"
    14		"net/smtp"
    15	)
    16	
    17	// EmailConfig represents email configuration
    18	type EmailConfig struct {
    19		SMTPHost     string
    20		SMTPPort     int
    21		SMTPUser     string
    22		SMTPPassword string
    23		FromEmail    string
    24		FromName     string
    25	}
    26	
    27	// SendEmailWithTLS sends email with TLS/SSL support
    28	// Supports both STARTTLS (port 587) and SMTPS (port 465)
    29	func SendEmailWithTLS(config EmailConfig, to []string, subject, body string) error {
    30		addr := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", config.SMTPHost, config.SMTPPort)
    31	
    32		// Prepare email message
    33		message := fmt.Sprintf("To: %s\r\n"+
    34			"From: %s <%s>\r\n"+
    35			"Subject: %s\r\n"+
    36			"MIME-version: 1.0;\r\n"+
    37			"Content-Type: text/html; charset=\"UTF-8\";\r\n"+
    38			"\r\n"+
    39			"%s\r\n",
    40			to[0], config.FromName, config.FromEmail, subject, body)
    41	
    42		// TLS configuration
    43		tlsConfig := &tls.Config{
    44			ServerName: config.SMTPHost,
    45		}
    46	
    47		// Port 465: Use SMTPS (SSL from start)
    48		if config.SMTPPort == 465 {
    49			conn, err := tls.Dial("tcp", addr, tlsConfig)
    50			if err != nil {
    51				return fmt.Errorf("failed to connect via SSL: %w", err)
    52			}
    53			defer conn.Close()
    54	
    55			client, err := smtp.NewClient(conn, config.SMTPHost)
    56			if err != nil {
    57				return fmt.Errorf("failed to create SMTP client: %w", err)
    58			}
    59			defer client.Close()
    60	
    61			// Authenticate
    62			auth := smtp.PlainAuth("", config.SMTPUser, config.SMTPPassword, config.SMTPHost)
    63			if err = client.Auth(auth); err != nil {
    64				return fmt.Errorf("authentication failed: %w", err)
    65			}
    66	
    67			// Set sender
    68			if err = client.Mail(config.FromEmail); err != nil {
    69				return fmt.Errorf("failed to set sender: %w", err)
    70			}
    71	
    72			// Set recipients
    73			for _, recipient := range to {
    74				if err = client.Rcpt(recipient); err != nil {
    75					return fmt.Errorf("failed to set recipient: %w", err)
    76				}
    77			}
    78	
    79			// Send message
    80			w, err := client.Data()
    81			if err != nil {
    82				return fmt.Errorf("failed to send DATA command: %w", err)
    83			}
    84			_, err = w.Write([]byte(message))
    85			if err != nil {
    86				return fmt.Errorf("failed to write message: %w", err)
    87			}
    88			err = w.Close()
    89			if err != nil {
    90				return fmt.Errorf("failed to close message writer: %w", err)
    91			}
    92	
    93			return client.Quit()
    94		}
    95	
    96		// Port 587 or others: Use STARTTLS
    97		conn, err := net.Dial("tcp", addr)
    98		if err != nil {
    99			return fmt.Errorf("failed to connect: %w", err)
   100		}
   101		defer conn.Close()
   102	
   103		client, err := smtp.NewClient(conn, config.SMTPHost)
   104		if err != nil {
   105			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create SMTP client: %w", err)
   106		}
   107		defer client.Close()
   108	
   109		// Start TLS
   110		if err = client.StartTLS(tlsConfig); err != nil {
   111			return fmt.Errorf("failed to start TLS: %w", err)
   112		}
   113	
   114		// Authenticate
   115		auth := smtp.PlainAuth("", config.SMTPUser, config.SMTPPassword, config.SMTPHost)
   116		if err = client.Auth(auth); err != nil {
   117			return fmt.Errorf("authentication failed (user: %s, host: %s, port: %d): %w", config.SMTPUser, config.SMTPHost, config.SMTPPort, err)
   118		}
   119	
   120		// Set sender
   121		if err = client.Mail(config.FromEmail); err != nil {
   122			return fmt.Errorf("failed to set sender: %w", err)
   123		}
   124	
   125		// Set recipients
   126		for _, recipient := range to {
   127			if err = client.Rcpt(recipient); err != nil {
   128				return fmt.Errorf("failed to set recipient: %w", err)
   129			}
   130		}
   131	
   132		// Send message
   133		w, err := client.Data()
   134		if err != nil {
   135			return fmt.Errorf("failed to send DATA command: %w", err)
   136		}
   137		_, err = w.Write([]byte(message))
   138		if err != nil {
   139			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write message: %w", err)
   140		}
   141		err = w.Close()
   142		if err != nil {
   143			return fmt.Errorf("failed to close message writer: %w", err)
   144		}
   145	
   146		return client.Quit()
   147	}

    21	// IPLocation represents IP geolocation information
    22	type IPLocation struct {
    23		Country     string `json:"country"`
    24		Province    string `json:"province"`
    25		City        string `json:"city"`
    26		ISP         string `json:"isp"`
    27		CountryCode string `json:"country_code"`
    28	}
    29	
    30	// IP API 响应结构 (ip-api.com)
    31	type IPAPIResponse struct {
    32		Status      string  `json:"status"`
    33		Message     string  `json:"message"` // For error responses
    34		Country     string  `json:"country"`
    35		CountryCode string  `json:"countryCode"`
    36		Region      string  `json:"region"`
    37		RegionName  string  `json:"regionName"`
    38		City        string  `json:"city"`
    39		ISP         string  `json:"isp"`
    40		Org         string  `json:"org"`
    41		As          string  `json:"as"`
    42		Query       string  `json:"query"`
    43		Lat         float64 `json:"lat"`
    44		Lon         float64 `json:"lon"`
    45		Timezone    string  `json:"timezone"`
    46		Zip         string  `json:"zip"`
    47	}
    48	
    49	var (
    50		// IP 解析缓存
    51		ipAPICache     = make(map[string]*IPLocation)
    52		ipAPICacheLock sync.RWMutex
    53		
    54		// HTTP 客户端
    55		httpClient = &http.Client{
    56			Timeout: 5 * time.Second,
    57		}
    58		
    59		// API 限流（ip-api.com 免费版限制：45次/分钟）
    60		apiRateLimiter = make(chan struct{}, 45)
    61		rateLimitOnce  sync.Once
    62	)
    63	
    64	// initRateLimiter 初始化 API 限流器
    65	func initRateLimiter() {
    66		rateLimitOnce.Do(func() {
    67			// 填充令牌桶
    68			for i := 0; i < 45; i++ {
    69				apiRateLimiter <- struct{}{}
    70			}
    71			
    72			// 每分钟补充令牌
    73			go func() {
    74				ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Minute)
    75				defer ticker.Stop()
    76				for range ticker.C {
    77					// 补充令牌到45个
    78					for len(apiRateLimiter) < 45 {
    79						select {
    80						case apiRateLimiter <- struct{}{}:
    81						default:
    82							return
    83						}
    84					}
    85				}
    86			}()
    87		})
    88	}

    90	// ParseIPLocation parses IP address to location using ip-api.com
    91	func ParseIPLocation(ip string) *IPLocation {
    92		// Remove port if present
    93		if strings.Contains(ip, ":") {
    94			host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(ip)
    95			if err == nil {
    96				ip = host
    97			}
    98		}
    99	
   100		// Parse the IP
   101		parsedIP := net.ParseIP(ip)
   102		if parsedIP == nil {
   103			return &IPLocation{
   104				Country:     "未知",
   105				Province:    "",
   106				City:        "",
   107				ISP:         "",
   108				CountryCode: "UNKNOWN",
   109			}
   110		}
   111	
   112		// Check for local/private IPs
   113		if isPrivateIP(parsedIP) {
   114			return &IPLocation{
   115				Country:     "本地",
   116				Province:    "",
   117				City:        "",
   118				ISP:         "局域网",
   119				CountryCode: "LOCAL",
   120			}
   121		}
   122	
   123		// Check cache first
   124		ipAPICacheLock.RLock()
   125		if cached, ok := ipAPICache[ip]; ok {
   126			ipAPICacheLock.RUnlock()
   127			return cached
   128		}
   129		ipAPICacheLock.RUnlock()
   130	
   131		// Query API
   132		location := queryIPAPI(ip)
   133		
   134		// Cache the result
   135		if location != nil && location.Country != "未知" {
   136			ipAPICacheLock.Lock()
   137			ipAPICache[ip] = location
   138			ipAPICacheLock.Unlock()
   139		}
   140	
   141		return location
   142	}
   143	
   144	// queryIPAPI queries ip-api.com for IP location
   145	func queryIPAPI(ip string) *IPLocation {
   146		// Initialize rate limiter
   147		initRateLimiter()
   148		
   149		// Try to get a token (with timeout)
   150		select {
   151		case <-apiRateLimiter:
   152			// Got token, proceed
   153		case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
   154			// Timeout, use fallback
   155			return parseIPFallback(ip)
   156		}
   157	
   158		// Build API URL (with Chinese language support)
   159		apiURL := fmt.Sprintf("http://ip-api.com/json/%s?lang=zh-CN&fields=status,message,country,countryCode,region,regionName,city,isp,org,as,query", ip)
   160	
   161		// Make HTTP request
   162		resp, err := httpClient.Get(apiURL)
   163		if err != nil {
   164			return parseIPFallback(ip)
   165		}
   166		defer resp.Body.Close()
   167	
   168		// Read response body
   169		body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   170		if err != nil {
   171			return parseIPFallback(ip)
   172		}
   173	
   174		// Parse JSON response
   175		var apiResp IPAPIResponse
   176		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &apiResp); err != nil {
   177			return parseIPFallback(ip)
   178		}
   179	
   180		// Check if query was successful
   181		if apiResp.Status != "success" {
   182			return parseIPFallback(ip)
   183		}
   184	
   185		// Convert to our location format
   186		return &IPLocation{
   187			Country:     apiResp.Country,
   188			Province:    apiResp.RegionName,
   189			City:        apiResp.City,
   190			ISP:         apiResp.ISP,
   191			CountryCode: apiResp.CountryCode,
   192		}
   193	}
   194	
   195	// parseIPFallback provides a simple fallback when API is not available
   196	func parseIPFallback(ip string) *IPLocation {
   197		// Simple heuristic based on IP ranges (very limited, for fallback only)
   198		
   199		octets := strings.Split(ip, ".")
   200		if len(octets) != 4 {
   201			// IPv6 or invalid
   202			return &IPLocation{
   203				Country:     "未知地区",
   204				Province:    "",
   205				City:        "",
   206				ISP:         "",
   207				CountryCode: "UNKNOWN",
   208			}
   209		}
   210	
   211		// Parse first octet for basic region detection
   212		firstOctet := octets[0]
   213		
   214		// China common IP ranges (major ISPs)
   215		chinaRanges := map[string]bool{
   216			"1": true, "14": true, "27": true, "36": true, "42": true,
   217			"58": true, "60": true, "61": true, "101": true, "106": true,
   218			"110": true, "111": true, "112": true, "113": true, "114": true,
   219			"115": true, "116": true, "117": true, "118": true, "119": true,
   220			"120": true, "121": true, "122": true, "123": true, "124": true,
   221			"125": true, "180": true, "183": true, "202": true, "203": true,
   222			"210": true, "211": true, "218": true, "219": true, "220": true,
   223			"221": true, "222": true, "223": true,
   224		}
   225		
   226		if chinaRanges[firstOctet] {
   227			return &IPLocation{
   228				Country:     "中国",
   229				Province:    "",
   230				City:        "",
   231				ISP:         "",
   232				CountryCode: "CN",
   233			}
   234		}
   235		
   236		// Try to identify some common international ranges
   237		location := detectInternationalIP(ip, firstOctet)
   238		if location != nil {
   239			return location
   240		}
   241		
   242		// Default to international for other IPs
   243		return &IPLocation{
   244			Country:     "国际",
   245			Province:    "",
   246			City:        "",
   247			ISP:         "",
   248			CountryCode: "INTL",
   249		}
   250	}
   251	
   252	// detectInternationalIP tries to detect international IP ranges
   253	func detectInternationalIP(ip, firstOctet string) *IPLocation {
   254		// Common cloud providers and CDNs (easily identifiable)
   255		// These are very simplified checks
   256		
   257		// Cloudflare: 104.x, 172.64-172.71
   258		if firstOctet == "104" {
   259			return &IPLocation{
   260				Country:     "美国",
   261				Province:    "",
   262				City:        "",
   263				ISP:         "Cloudflare",
   264				CountryCode: "US",
   265			}
   266		}
   267		
   268		// Google Cloud: 34.x, 35.x
   269		if firstOctet == "34" || firstOctet == "35" {
   270			return &IPLocation{
   271				Country:     "美国",
   272				Province:    "",
   273				City:        "",
   274				ISP:         "Google Cloud",
   275				CountryCode: "US",
   276			}
   277		}
   278		
   279		// AWS: 3.x, 13.x, 18.x, 52.x, 54.x
   280		if firstOctet == "3" || firstOctet == "13" || firstOctet == "18" || 
   281		   firstOctet == "52" || firstOctet == "54" {
   282			return &IPLocation{
   283				Country:     "美国",
   284				Province:    "",
   285				City:        "",
   286				ISP:         "Amazon AWS",
   287				CountryCode: "US",
   288			}
   289		}
   290		
   291		// Microsoft Azure: 20.x, 40.x, 51.x
   292		if firstOctet == "20" || firstOctet == "40" || firstOctet == "51" {
   293			return &IPLocation{
   294				Country:     "美国",
   295				Province:    "",
   296				City:        "",
   297				ISP:         "Microsoft Azure",
   298				CountryCode: "US",
   299			}
   300		}
   301		
   302		// Common Asian ranges
   303		// Japan: 126.x, 133.x, 153.x, 160.x, 163.x
   304		if firstOctet == "126" || firstOctet == "133" || firstOctet == "153" ||
   305		   firstOctet == "160" || firstOctet == "163" {
   306			return &IPLocation{
   307				Country:     "日本",
   308				Province:    "",
   309				City:        "",
   310				ISP:         "",
   311				CountryCode: "JP",
   312			}
   313		}
   314		
   315		// South Korea: 59.x, 175.x
   316		if firstOctet == "59" || firstOctet == "175" {
   317			return &IPLocation{
   318				Country:     "韩国",
   319				Province:    "",
   320				City:        "",
   321				ISP:         "",
   322				CountryCode: "KR",
   323			}
   324		}
   325		
   326		// Singapore: 103.x
   327		if firstOctet == "103" {
   328			return &IPLocation{
   329				Country:     "新加坡",
   330				Province:    "",
   331				City:        "",
   332				ISP:         "",
   333				CountryCode: "SG",
   334			}
   335		}
   336		
   337		// Hong Kong: 43.x
   338		if firstOctet == "43" {
   339			return &IPLocation{
   340				Country:     "中国香港",
   341				Province:    "香港",
   342				City:        "",
   343				ISP:         "",
   344				CountryCode: "HK",
   345			}
   346		}
   347		
   348		return nil
   349	}

   351	// isPrivateIP checks if an IP is private/local
   352	func isPrivateIP(ip net.IP) bool {
   353		if ip.IsLoopback() || ip.IsLinkLocalUnicast() || ip.IsLinkLocalMulticast() {
   354			return true
   355		}
   356	
   357		// Check for private IP ranges
   358		privateRanges := []string{
   359			"10.0.0.0/8",
   360			"172.16.0.0/12",
   361			"192.168.0.0/16",
   362			"fc00::/7",
   363		}
   364	
   365		for _, cidr := range privateRanges {
   366			_, block, _ := net.ParseCIDR(cidr)
   367			if block.Contains(ip) {
   368				return true
   369			}
   370		}
   371	
   372		return false
   373	}

   375	// GetLocationString returns a formatted location string
   376	func GetLocationString(location *IPLocation) string {
   377		if location == nil {
   378			return "未知"
   379		}
   380	
   381		if location.CountryCode == "LOCAL" {
   382			return "本地"
   383		}
   384	
   385		parts := []string{}
   386		
   387		if location.Country != "" && location.Country != "未知" {
   388			parts = append(parts, location.Country)
   389		}
   390		
   391		if location.Province != "" {
   392			parts = append(parts, location.Province)
   393		}
   394		
   395		if location.City != "" {
   396			parts = append(parts, location.City)
   397		}
   398	
   399		if len(parts) == 0 {
   400			return "未知"
   401		}
   402	
   403		result := strings.Join(parts, " ")
   404		
   405		// Add ISP if available
   406		if location.ISP != "" {
   407			result += " (" + location.ISP + ")"
   408		}
   409	
   410		return result
   411	}
   412	
   413	// GetSimpleLocationString returns a shorter location description without ISP
   414	func GetSimpleLocationString(location *IPLocation) string {
   415		if location == nil {
   416			return "未知"
   417		}
   418	
   419		if location.CountryCode == "LOCAL" {
   420			return "本地"
   421		}
   422	
   423		parts := []string{}
   424		
   425		if location.Country != "" && location.Country != "未知" {
   426			parts = append(parts, location.Country)
   427		}
   428		
   429		if location.Province != "" {
   430			parts = append(parts, location.Province)
   431		}
   432		
   433		if location.City != "" {
   434			parts = append(parts, location.City)
   435		}
   436	
   437		if len(parts) == 0 {
   438			return "未知"
   439		}
   440	
   441		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
   442	}

   444	// ClearCache clears the IP location cache
   445	func ClearIPLocationCache() {
   446		ipAPICacheLock.Lock()
   447		defer ipAPICacheLock.Unlock()
   448		ipAPICache = make(map[string]*IPLocation)
   449	}
   450	
   451	// GetCacheSize returns the current cache size
   452	func GetIPLocationCacheSize() int {
   453		ipAPICacheLock.RLock()
   454		defer ipAPICacheLock.RUnlock()
   455		return len(ipAPICache)
   456	}

    17	
    18	type Claims struct {
    19		UserID   uint   `json:"user_id"`
    20		Username string `json:"username"`
    21		Type     string `json:"type"` // "admin" or "user"
    22		jwt.RegisteredClaims
    23	}
    24	
    25	// GenerateToken generates a JWT token
    26	func GenerateToken(userID uint, username, userType string) (string, error) {
    27		claims := Claims{
    28			UserID:   userID,
    29			Username: username,
    30			Type:     userType,
    31			RegisteredClaims: jwt.RegisteredClaims{
    32				ExpiresAt: jwt.NewNumericDate(time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour)),
    33				IssuedAt:  jwt.NewNumericDate(time.Now()),
    34				NotBefore: jwt.NewNumericDate(time.Now()),
    35			},
    36		}
    37	
    38		token := jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, claims)
    39		return token.SignedString([]byte(config.AppConfig.JWT.Secret))
    40	}
    41	
    42	// ParseToken parses and validates a JWT token
    43	func ParseToken(tokenString string) (*Claims, error) {
    44		token, err := jwt.ParseWithClaims(tokenString, &Claims{}, func(token *jwt.Token) (interface{}, error) {
    45			return []byte(config.AppConfig.JWT.Secret), nil
    46		})
    47	
    48		if err != nil {
    49			return nil, err
    50		}
    51	
    52		if claims, ok := token.Claims.(*Claims); ok && token.Valid {
    53			return claims, nil
    54		}
    55	
    56		return nil, errors.New("invalid token")
    57	}

    10	import (
    11		"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
    12	)
    13	
    14	// HashPassword hashes a password using bcrypt
    15	func HashPassword(password string) (string, error) {
    16		bytes, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
    17		return string(bytes), err
    18	}
    19	
    20	// CheckPassword compares a password with a hash
    21	func CheckPassword(password, hash string) bool {
    22		err := bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(hash), []byte(password))
    23		return err == nil
    24	}

    23	// SMSConfig represents Aliyun SMS configuration
    24	type SMSConfig struct {
    25		AccessKeyID     string
    26		AccessSecret    string
    27		SignName        string
    28		TemplateCode    string
    29		TemplateContent string // 模板内容,如: 您的验证码是${code},有效期为5分钟
    30		Endpoint        string
    31	}
    32	
    33	// ExtractTemplateVariables extracts variable names from template content
    34	// Example: "您的验证码是${code},有效期${min}分钟" -> ["code", "min"]
    35	func ExtractTemplateVariables(templateContent string) []string {
    36		re := regexp.MustCompile(`\$\{([^}]+)\}`)
    37		matches := re.FindAllStringSubmatch(templateContent, -1)
    38	
    39		variables := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
    40		seen := make(map[string]bool)
    41	
    42		for _, match := range matches {
    43			if len(match) > 1 {
    44				varName := match[1]
    45				if !seen[varName] {
    46					variables = append(variables, varName)
    47					seen[varName] = true
    48				}
    49			}
    50		}
    51	
    52		return variables
    53	}
    54	
    55	// BuildTemplateParams builds template parameters JSON from variable map
    56	// Example: {"code": "123456", "min": "5"} -> {"code":"123456","min":"5"}
    57	func BuildTemplateParams(params map[string]string) (string, error) {
    58		if len(params) == 0 {
    59			return "{}", nil
    60		}
    61	
    62		jsonBytes, err := json.Marshal(params)
    63		if err != nil {
    64			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal template params: %w", err)
    65		}
    66	
    67		return string(jsonBytes), nil
    68	}

    70	// CreateSMSClient creates an Aliyun SMS client
    71	func CreateSMSClient(accessKeyID, accessSecret, endpoint string) (*dysmsapi.Client, error) {
    72		// Trim any whitespace from credentials
    73		accessKeyID = strings.TrimSpace(accessKeyID)
    74		accessSecret = strings.TrimSpace(accessSecret)
    75		endpoint = strings.TrimSpace(endpoint)
    76	
    77		log.Printf("[SMS] Creating client with endpoint: %s, AccessKeyID length: %d", endpoint, len(accessKeyID))
    78	
    79		config := &openapi.Config{
    80			AccessKeyId:     tea.String(accessKeyID),
    81			AccessKeySecret: tea.String(accessSecret),
    82			Endpoint:        tea.String(endpoint),
    83		}
    84	
    85		client, err := dysmsapi.NewClient(config)
    86		if err != nil {
    87			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create SMS client: %w", err)
    88		}
    89	
    90		log.Printf("[SMS] Client created successfully")
    91		return client, nil
    92	}

    94	// SendSMS sends SMS with dynamic template parameters
    95	// params: map of template variables, e.g., map[string]string{"code": "123456", "min": "5"}
    96	func SendSMS(config SMSConfig, phoneNumber string, params map[string]string) error {
    97		// Create SMS client
    98		client, err := CreateSMSClient(config.AccessKeyID, config.AccessSecret, config.Endpoint)
    99		if err != nil {
   100			return err
   101		}
   102	
   103		// Build template parameters JSON
   104		templateParam, err := BuildTemplateParams(params)
   105		if err != nil {
   106			return err
   107		}
   108	
   109		log.Printf("[SMS] Sending SMS to: %s", phoneNumber)
   110		log.Printf("[SMS] SignName: %s (len: %d)", config.SignName, len(config.SignName))
   111		log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateCode: %s (len: %d, bytes: %v)", config.TemplateCode, len(config.TemplateCode), []byte(config.TemplateCode))
   112		log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateParam: %s", templateParam)
   113		log.Printf("[SMS] Endpoint: %s", config.Endpoint)
   114	
   115		// Check if TemplateCode needs SMS_ prefix
   116		templateCode := config.TemplateCode
   117		// If template code is purely numeric and doesn't start with SMS_, log a warning
   118		if len(templateCode) > 0 && templateCode[0] >= '0' && templateCode[0] <= '9' {
   119			log.Printf("[SMS] Note: TemplateCode is numeric (%s). If this fails, you may need to use format SMS_%s", templateCode, templateCode)
   120		}
   121	
   122		// Create request
   123		request := &dysmsapi.SendSmsRequest{
   124			PhoneNumbers:  tea.String(phoneNumber),
   125			SignName:      tea.String(config.SignName),
   126			TemplateCode:  tea.String(templateCode),
   127			TemplateParam: tea.String(templateParam),
   128		}
   129	
   130		// Log the actual values being sent
   131		log.Printf("[SMS] ========== Request Details ==========")
   132		log.Printf("[SMS] PhoneNumbers: %v", tea.StringValue(request.PhoneNumbers))
   133		log.Printf("[SMS] SignName: %v", tea.StringValue(request.SignName))
   134		log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateCode: %v", tea.StringValue(request.TemplateCode))
   135		log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateParam: %v", tea.StringValue(request.TemplateParam))
   136		log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateParam bytes: %v", []byte(tea.StringValue(request.TemplateParam)))
   137		log.Printf("[SMS] ==========================================")
   138	
   139		runtime := &util.RuntimeOptions{}
   140	
   141		// Send SMS
   142		resp, err := client.SendSmsWithOptions(request, runtime)
   143		if err != nil {
   144			log.Printf("[SMS] Send failed with error: %v", err)
   145			return fmt.Errorf("failed to send SMS: %w", err)
   146		}
   147	
   148		// Log detailed response
   149		log.Printf("[SMS] ========== Aliyun SMS Response ==========")
   150		if resp != nil {
   151			if resp.Body != nil {
   152				log.Printf("[SMS] Response Body:")
   153				log.Printf("[SMS]   - Code: %s", tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Code))
   154				log.Printf("[SMS]   - Message: %s", tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Message))
   155				log.Printf("[SMS]   - RequestId: %s", tea.StringValue(resp.Body.RequestId))
   156				log.Printf("[SMS]   - BizId: %s", tea.StringValue(resp.Body.BizId))
   157			}
   158			log.Printf("[SMS] Status Code: %d", tea.Int32Value(resp.StatusCode))
   159		}
   160		log.Printf("[SMS] ===========================================")
   161	
   162		// Check if SMS was actually sent successfully
   163		if resp.Body != nil && resp.Body.Code != nil {
   164			code := tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Code)
   165			if code != "OK" {
   166				log.Printf("[SMS] Warning: SMS may not have been sent successfully. Code: %s, Message: %s",
   167					code, tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Message))
   168				return fmt.Errorf("SMS sending failed with code: %s, message: %s",
   169					code, tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Message))
   170			}
   171		}
   172	
   173		log.Printf("[SMS] Send successful!")
   174		return nil
   175	}

   221		apiParams := &openapi.Params{
   222			Action:      tea.String("SendSmsVerifyCode"),
   223			Version:     tea.String("2017-05-25"),
   224			Protocol:    tea.String("HTTPS"),
   225			Method:      tea.String("POST"),
   226			AuthType:    tea.String("AK"),
   227			Style:       tea.String("RPC"),
   228			Pathname:    tea.String("/"),
   229			ReqBodyType: tea.String("json"),

   237			"TemplateCode":  config.TemplateCode,

   250		log.Printf("[PNS] TemplateCode: %s", config.TemplateCode)

   273					message := bodyMap["Message"]

   276				}
   277			}

   282	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

     8	package utils
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"strings"
    12	
    13		"github.com/mileusna/useragent"
    14	)
    15	
    16	// DeviceInfo represents parsed user agent information
    17	type DeviceInfo struct {
    18		DeviceType string `json:"device_type"` // Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, Bot
    19		OS         string `json:"os"`          // Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, etc.
    20		OSVersion  string `json:"os_version"`
    21		Browser    string `json:"browser"`      // Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.
    22		BrowserVersion string `json:"browser_version"`
    23		Platform   string `json:"platform"`     // windows, mac, linux, ios, android
    24		IsBot      bool   `json:"is_bot"`
    25		IsMobile   bool   `json:"is_mobile"`
    26		IsTablet   bool   `json:"is_tablet"`
    27		IsDesktop  bool   `json:"is_desktop"`
    28	}
    29	
    30	// ParseUserAgent parses user agent string into structured device info
    31	func ParseUserAgent(uaString string) *DeviceInfo {
    32		if uaString == "" {
    33			return &DeviceInfo{
    34				DeviceType: "未知",
    35				OS:         "未知",
    36				Browser:    "未知",
    37				Platform:   "unknown",
    38			}
    39		}
    40	
    41		ua := useragent.Parse(uaString)
    42	
    43		deviceType := "桌面"
    44		if ua.Bot {
    45			deviceType = "机器人"
    46		} else if ua.Mobile {
    47			deviceType = "手机"
    48		} else if ua.Tablet {
    49			deviceType = "平板"
    50		} else if ua.Desktop {
    51			deviceType = "桌面"
    52		}
    53	
    54		// Get OS name in Chinese
    55		osName := getOSName(ua.OS, ua.OSVersion)
    56		
    57		// Get browser name
    58		browserName := getBrowserName(ua.Name, ua.Version)
    59	
    60		return &DeviceInfo{
    61			DeviceType:     deviceType,
    62			OS:             osName,
    63			OSVersion:      ua.OSVersion,
    64			Browser:        browserName,
    65			BrowserVersion: ua.Version,
    66			Platform:       strings.ToLower(ua.OS),
    67			IsBot:          ua.Bot,
    68			IsMobile:       ua.Mobile,
    69			IsTablet:       ua.Tablet,
    70			IsDesktop:      ua.Desktop,
    71		}
    72	}
    73	
    74	// getOSName returns Chinese OS name
    75	func getOSName(os, version string) string {
    76		osLower := strings.ToLower(os)
    77		
    78		switch {
    79		case strings.Contains(osLower, "windows"):
    80			if version != "" {
    81				// Map Windows versions
    82				switch {
    83				case strings.Contains(version, "10"):
    84					return "Windows 10"
    85				case strings.Contains(version, "11"):
    86					return "Windows 11"
    87				case strings.Contains(version, "8"):
    88					return "Windows 8"
    89				case strings.Contains(version, "7"):
    90					return "Windows 7"
    91				default:
    92					return "Windows " + version
    93				}
    94			}
    95			return "Windows"
    96		case strings.Contains(osLower, "mac") || strings.Contains(osLower, "darwin"):
    97			return "macOS"
    98		case strings.Contains(osLower, "ios"):
    99			if version != "" {
   100				return "iOS " + version
   101			}
   102			return "iOS"
   103		case strings.Contains(osLower, "android"):
   104			if version != "" {
   105				return "Android " + version
   106			}
   107			return "Android"
   108		case strings.Contains(osLower, "linux"):
   109			return "Linux"
   110		case strings.Contains(osLower, "ubuntu"):
   111			return "Ubuntu"
   112		case strings.Contains(osLower, "chromeos"):
   113			return "Chrome OS"
   114		default:
   115			if os != "" {
   116				return os
   117			}
   118			return "未知系统"
   119		}
   120	}
   121	
   122	// getBrowserName returns browser display name
   123	func getBrowserName(browser, version string) string {
   124		browserLower := strings.ToLower(browser)
   125		
   126		var displayName string
   127		switch {
   128		case strings.Contains(browserLower, "chrome"):
   129			displayName = "Chrome"
   130		case strings.Contains(browserLower, "firefox"):
   131			displayName = "Firefox"
   132		case strings.Contains(browserLower, "safari"):
   133			displayName = "Safari"
   134		case strings.Contains(browserLower, "edge"):
   135			displayName = "Edge"
   136		case strings.Contains(browserLower, "opera"):
   137			displayName = "Opera"
   138		case strings.Contains(browserLower, "ie") || strings.Contains(browserLower, "internet explorer"):
   139			displayName = "IE"
   140		case strings.Contains(browserLower, "wechat"):
   141			displayName = "微信浏览器"
   142		case strings.Contains(browserLower, "qq"):
   143			displayName = "QQ浏览器"
   144		default:
   145			if browser != "" {
   146				displayName = browser
   147			} else {
   148				displayName = "未知浏览器"
   149			}
   150		}
   151	
   152		// Add version if available and major version only
   153		if version != "" {
   154			// Extract major version (first number before dot)
   155			majorVersion := strings.Split(version, ".")[0]
   156			return displayName + " " + majorVersion
   157		}
   158	
   159		return displayName
   160	}
   161	
   162	// GetDeviceString returns a formatted device string for display
   163	func GetDeviceString(info *DeviceInfo) string {
   164		if info == nil {
   165			return "未知设备"
   166		}
   167	
   168		if info.IsBot {
   169			return "机器人"
   170		}
   171	
   172		// Format: "设备类型 | 操作系统 | 浏览器"
   173		parts := []string{}
   174		
   175		if info.DeviceType != "" && info.DeviceType != "未知" {
   176			parts = append(parts, info.DeviceType)
   177		}
   178		
   179		if info.OS != "" && info.OS != "未知系统" {
   180			parts = append(parts, info.OS)
   181		}
   182		
   183		if info.Browser != "" && info.Browser != "未知浏览器" {
   184			parts = append(parts, info.Browser)
   185		}
   186	
   187		if len(parts) == 0 {
   188			return "未知设备"
   189		}
   190	
   191		return strings.Join(parts, " | ")
   192	}
   193	
   194	// GetSimpleDeviceString returns a shorter device description
   195	func GetSimpleDeviceString(info *DeviceInfo) string {
   196		if info == nil {
   197			return "未知"
   198		}
   199	
   200		if info.IsBot {
   201			return "机器人"
   202		}
   203	
   204		// Format: "操作系统 浏览器"
   205		os := info.OS
   206		if os == "未知系统" || os == "" {
   207			os = info.DeviceType
   208		}
   209	
   210		browser := info.Browser
   211		if browser == "未知浏览器" || browser == "" {
   212			return os
   213		}
   214	
   215		return os + " " + browser
   216	}

   146	// UpdateEmailConfig handles updating email configuration (admin only)
   147	func (h *Handler) UpdateEmailConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   148		var req UpdateEmailConfigRequest
   149		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   150			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   151			return
   152		}
   153	
   154		// Get existing config to check if this is an update
   155		existingConfig, err := h.service.GetActiveEmailConfig()
   156		if err != nil {
   157			utils.Error(c, 3002, "Failed to get existing email configuration")
   158			return
   159		}
   160	
   161		// If password is empty and config exists, keep the old password
   162		password := req.SMTPPassword
   163		if password == "" && existingConfig != nil {
   164			password = existingConfig.SMTPPassword
   165		} else if password == "" && existingConfig == nil {
   166			// New config must have password
   167			utils.BadRequest(c, "Password is required for new email configuration")
   168			return
   169		}
   170	
   171		config := &model.EmailConfig{
   172			SMTPHost:     req.SMTPHost,
   173			SMTPPort:     req.SMTPPort,
   174			SMTPUser:     req.SMTPUser,
   175			SMTPPassword: password,
   176			FromEmail:    req.FromEmail,
   177			FromName:     req.FromName,
   178			IsActive:     true,
   179		}
   180	
   181		err = h.service.CreateEmailConfig(config)
   182		if err != nil {
   183			utils.Error(c, 3002, "Failed to update email configuration")
   184			return
   185		}
   186	
   187		utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "Email configuration updated successfully", config)
   188	}

   258	// GetSystemConfig handles getting system configuration
   259	func (h *Handler) GetSystemConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   260		config, err := h.service.GetSystemConfig()
   261		if err != nil {
   262			utils.Error(c, 3003, "Failed to get system configuration")
   263			return
   264		}
   265	
   266		if config == nil {
   267			// Return default if not found
   268			config = &model.SystemConfig{
   269				RequireEmailVerification: true,
   270			}
   271		}
   272	
   273		// Get GitHub OAuth configuration
   274		githubConfig, err := h.service.GetGithubOAuthConfig()
   275		if err != nil {
   276			// Log error but don't fail the request
   277			// GitHub config is optional
   278			githubConfig = nil
   279		}
   280	
   281		// Build response with system config and GitHub config
   282		response := map[string]interface{}{
   283			"id":                         config.ID,
   284			"require_email_verification": config.RequireEmailVerification,
   285			"enable_turnstile":           config.EnableTurnstile,
   286			"turnstile_site_key":         config.TurnstileSiteKey,
   287			"turnstile_secret_key":       config.TurnstileSecretKey,
   288			"created_at":                 config.CreatedAt,
   289			"updated_at":                 config.UpdatedAt,
   290		}
   291	
   292		// Add GitHub client_id if configured and enabled
   293		if githubConfig != nil && githubConfig.Enabled && githubConfig.ClientID != "" {
   294			response["github_client_id"] = githubConfig.ClientID
   295		}
   296	
   297		utils.Success(c, response)
   298	}

   405			SignName:        strings.TrimSpace(req.SignName),
   406			TemplateCode:    strings.TrimSpace(req.TemplateCode),
   407			TemplateContent: strings.TrimSpace(req.TemplateContent),
   408			Endpoint:        strings.TrimSpace(endpoint),
   409			IsActive:        true,

   433	// TestSMSConfig handles testing SMS configuration by sending a test SMS
   434	func (h *Handler) TestSMSConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   435		var req TestSMSConfigRequest
   436		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   437			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   438			return
   439		}
   440	
   441		var smsConfig utils.SMSConfig
   442		var templateContent string
   443	
   444		// If using saved config, load from database
   445		if req.UseSavedConfig || req.AccessSecret == "" || req.AccessSecret == "********" {
   446			savedConfig, err := h.service.GetActiveSMSConfig()
   447			if err != nil {
   448				utils.Error(c, 3010, "Failed to get saved SMS configuration")
   449				return
   450			}
   451			if savedConfig == nil {
   452				utils.Error(c, 3011, "No saved SMS configuration found")
   453				return
   454			}
   455	
   456			// Use saved config
   457			endpoint := savedConfig.Endpoint
   458			if endpoint == "" {
   459				endpoint = "dypnsapi.aliyuncs.com"
   460			}
   461	
   462			smsConfig = utils.SMSConfig{
   463				AccessKeyID:     savedConfig.AccessKeyID,
   464				AccessSecret:    savedConfig.AccessSecret, // Use real secret from DB
   465				SignName:        savedConfig.SignName,
   466				TemplateCode:    savedConfig.TemplateCode,
   467				TemplateContent: savedConfig.TemplateContent,
   468				Endpoint:        endpoint,
   469			}
   470			templateContent = savedConfig.TemplateContent
   471		} else {
   472			// Use provided config (editing mode)
   473			endpoint := req.Endpoint
   474			if endpoint == "" {
   475				endpoint = "dypnsapi.aliyuncs.com"
   476			}
   477	
   478			smsConfig = utils.SMSConfig{
   479				AccessKeyID:     req.AccessKeyID,
   480				AccessSecret:    req.AccessSecret,
   481				SignName:        req.SignName,
   482				TemplateCode:    req.TemplateCode,
   483				TemplateContent: req.TemplateContent,
   484				Endpoint:        endpoint,
   485			}
   486			templateContent = req.TemplateContent
   487		}
   488	
   489		// Extract template variables from template content
   490		variables := utils.ExtractTemplateVariables(templateContent)
   491	
   492		// Build test parameters based on detected variables
   493		testParams := make(map[string]string)
   494		for _, varName := range variables {
   495			switch varName {
   496			case "code":
   497				testParams["code"] = "123456"
   498			case "min", "minute", "minutes":
   499				testParams[varName] = "5"
   500			case "product":
   501				testParams["product"] = "Scholay"
   502			default:
   503				// For unknown variables, use a placeholder
   504				testParams[varName] = "测试值"
   505			}
   506		}
   507	
   508		// Send test SMS using PNS CallApi method
   509		err := utils.SendSMSVerifyCodePNS(smsConfig, req.PhoneNumber, testParams)
   510		if err != nil {
   511			utils.Error(c, 3009, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to send test SMS: %v", err))
   512			return
   513		}
   514	
   515		utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "Test SMS sent successfully", nil)
   516	}
   517	
   518	// ============================================
   519	// GitHub OAuth Configuration Handlers
   520	// ============================================
   521	
   522	// GetGithubOAuthConfig handles getting GitHub OAuth configuration
   523	func (h *Handler) GetGithubOAuthConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   524		config, err := h.service.GetGithubOAuthConfig()
   525		if err != nil {
   526			utils.Error(c, 3020, "Failed to get GitHub OAuth configuration")
   527			return
   528		}
   529	
   530		if config == nil {
   531			// Return default empty config if not found
   532			config = &model.GithubOAuthConfig{
   533				ClientID:     "",
   534				ClientSecret: "",
   535				RedirectURI:  "",
   536				Enabled:      false,
   537			}
   538		}
   539	
   540		utils.Success(c, config)
   541	}
   542	
   543	// UpdateGithubOAuthConfigRequest represents an update GitHub OAuth config request
   544	type UpdateGithubOAuthConfigRequest struct {
   545		ClientID     string `json:"client_id"`
   546		ClientSecret string `json:"client_secret"`
   547		RedirectURI  string `json:"redirect_uri"`
   548		Enabled      bool   `json:"enabled"`
   549	}
   550	
   551	// UpdateGithubOAuthConfig handles updating GitHub OAuth configuration (admin only)
   552	func (h *Handler) UpdateGithubOAuthConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   553		var req UpdateGithubOAuthConfigRequest
   554		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   555			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   556			return
   557		}
   558	
   559		// Generate full callback URL from base domain
   560		callbackURL := req.RedirectURI
   561		if callbackURL != "" && !strings.HasSuffix(callbackURL, "/github/callback") {
   562			callbackURL = strings.TrimSuffix(callbackURL, "/") + "/github/callback"
   563		}
   564	
   565		err := h.service.UpdateGithubOAuthConfig(req.ClientID, req.ClientSecret, callbackURL, req.Enabled)
   566		if err != nil {
   567			utils.Error(c, 3021, "Failed to update GitHub OAuth configuration")
   568			return
   569		}
   570	
   571		utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "GitHub OAuth configuration updated successfully", nil)
   572	}
   573	
   574	// RegisterRoutes registers config routes
   575	func (h *Handler) RegisterRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
   576		config := router.Group("/config")
   577		{
   578			// Public endpoints
   579			config.GET("/privacy-policy", h.GetPrivacyPolicy)
   580			config.GET("/terms-of-service", h.GetTermsOfService)
   581			config.GET("/system", h.GetSystemConfig)
   582		}
   583	}

   120	// UpdateSystemConfig updates system configuration
   121	// SystemConfigPartialUpdate represents a partial update request for system config
   122	type SystemConfigPartialUpdate struct {
   123		RequireEmailVerification *bool
   124		EnableTurnstile          *bool
   125		TurnstileSiteKey         *string
   126		TurnstileSecretKey       *string
   127	}
   128	
   129	// UpdateSystemConfigPartial updates system configuration with partial update support
   130	// Only non-nil fields in the request will be updated
   131	func (s *Service) UpdateSystemConfigPartial(req *SystemConfigPartialUpdate) error {
   132		config, err := s.repo.GetSystemConfig()
   133		if err != nil {
   134			return err
   135		}
   136	
   137		if config == nil {
   138			// Create new config with provided values (use defaults for nil fields)
   139			config = &model.SystemConfig{
   140				RequireEmailVerification: true, // default
   141			}
   142		}
   143	
   144		// Update only non-nil fields (partial update)
   145		if req.RequireEmailVerification != nil {
   146			config.RequireEmailVerification = *req.RequireEmailVerification
   147		}
   148		if req.EnableTurnstile != nil {
   149			config.EnableTurnstile = *req.EnableTurnstile
   150		}
   151		if req.TurnstileSiteKey != nil {
   152			config.TurnstileSiteKey = *req.TurnstileSiteKey
   153		}
   154		if req.TurnstileSecretKey != nil {
   155			config.TurnstileSecretKey = *req.TurnstileSecretKey
   156		}
   157	
   158		if config.ID == 0 {
   159			return s.repo.CreateSystemConfig(config)
   160		}
   161		return s.repo.UpdateSystemConfig(config)
   162	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package conversation
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"fmt"
    12		"net/http"
    13		"scholar-backend/internal/common/utils"
    14		"scholar-backend/internal/thirdparty"
    15		"strconv"
    16	
    17		"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    18	)
    19	
    20	type Handler struct {
    21		service *Service
    22	}
    23	
    24	func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
    25		return &Handler{service: service}
    26	}
    27	
    28	// CreateConversation creates a new conversation
    29	func (h *Handler) CreateConversation(c *gin.Context) {
    30		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    31		if !exists {
    32			utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
    33			return
    34		}
    35	
    36		var req CreateConversationRequest
    37		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    38			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
    39			return
    40		}
    41	
    42		// Default to search type if not provided
    43		conversationType := req.ConversationType
    44		if conversationType == "" {
    45			conversationType = ConversationTypeSearch
    46		}
    47	
    48		conversation, err := h.service.CreateConversation(userID.(uint), req.Title, conversationType)
    49		if err != nil {
    50			utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to create conversation: "+err.Error())
    51			return
    52		}
    53	
    54		utils.Success(c, conversation)
    55	}
    56	
    57	// GetUserConversations gets all conversations for the current user
    58	func (h *Handler) GetUserConversations(c *gin.Context) {
    59		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    60		if !exists {
    61			utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
    62			return
    63		}
    64	
    65		page, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page", "1"))
    66		pageSize, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page_size", "20"))
    67	
    68		// Optional conversation_type filter
    69		var conversationType *ConversationType
    70		if typeParam := c.Query("conversation_type"); typeParam != "" {
    71			convType := ConversationType(typeParam)
    72			conversationType = &convType
    73		}
    74	
    75		result, err := h.service.GetUserConversations(userID.(uint), page, pageSize, conversationType)
    76		if err != nil {
    77			utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to get conversations: "+err.Error())
    78			return
    79		}
    80	
    81		utils.Success(c, result)
    82	}
    83	
    84	// GetConversation gets a conversation with all its messages
    85	func (h *Handler) GetConversation(c *gin.Context) {
    86		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    87		if !exists {
    88			utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
    89			return
    90		}
    91	
    92		conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
    93		if err != nil {
    94			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid conversation ID")
    95			return
    96		}
    97	
    98		conversation, err := h.service.GetConversationWithMessages(uint(conversationID), userID.(uint))
    99		if err != nil {
   100			utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to get conversation: "+err.Error())
   101			return
   102		}
   103	
   104		utils.Success(c, conversation)
   105	}
   106	
   107	// DeleteConversation deletes a conversation
   108	func (h *Handler) DeleteConversation(c *gin.Context) {
   109		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   110		if !exists {
   111			utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
   112			return
   113		}
   114	
   115		conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
   116		if err != nil {
   117			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid conversation ID")
   118			return
   119		}
   120	
   121		if err := h.service.DeleteConversation(uint(conversationID), userID.(uint)); err != nil {
   122			utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to delete conversation: "+err.Error())
   123			return
   124		}
   125	
   126		utils.Success(c, gin.H{"message": "Conversation deleted successfully"})
   127	}

   188	// StreamAdvancedSearch 处理基于AI的智能分析请求（使用MCP工具）
   189	func (h *Handler) StreamAdvancedSearch(c *gin.Context) {
   190		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   191		if !exists {
   192			utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
   193			return
   194		}
   195	
   196		conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
   197		if err != nil {
   198			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid conversation ID")
   199			return
   200		}
   201	
   202		messageID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("messageId"), 10, 32)
   203		if err != nil {
   204			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid message ID")
   205			return
   206		}
   207	
   208		// Get model level from query parameter (default to "mid")
   209		modelLevelParam := c.DefaultQuery("model_level", "mid")
   210		var modelLevel string
   211		switch modelLevelParam {
   212		case "low", "mid", "high":
   213			modelLevel = modelLevelParam
   214		default:
   215			modelLevel = "mid"
   216		}
   217	
   218		// Verify conversation belongs to user
   219		conversation, err := h.service.GetConversationWithMessages(uint(conversationID), userID.(uint))
   220		if err != nil {
   221			utils.Error(c, 404, "Conversation not found")
   222			return
   223		}
   224	
   225		// Find the target message
   226		var targetMessage *ConversationMessage
   227		for i := range conversation.Messages {
   228			if conversation.Messages[i].ID == uint(messageID) {
   229				targetMessage = &conversation.Messages[i]
   230				break
   231			}
   232		}
   233	
   234		if targetMessage == nil {
   235			utils.Error(c, 404, "Message not found")
   236			return
   237		}
   238	
   239		// Check quota BEFORE setting SSE headers to return proper HTTP error
   240		var featureType string
   241		switch modelLevel {
   242		case "low":
   243			featureType = "advanced_search_low"
   244		case "mid":
   245			featureType = "advanced_search_mid"
   246		case "high":
   247			featureType = "advanced_search_high"
   248		default:
   249			featureType = "advanced_search_mid"
   250		}
   251	
   252		// Perform quota check before SSE stream starts
   253		// Use the conversation service's subscription service to check quota
   254		hasQuota, err := h.service.subscriptionService.CheckQuota(userID.(uint), featureType)
   255		if err != nil {
   256			utils.Error(c, 500, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check quota: %s", err.Error()))
   257			return
   258		}
   259		if !hasQuota {
   260			utils.Error(c, 403, "配额不足，请升级订阅")
   261			return
   262		}
   263	
   264		// Set headers for SSE
   265		c.Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
   266		c.Header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
   267		c.Header("Connection", "keep-alive")
   268		c.Header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
   269	
   270		// 执行智能分析并流式返回结果（使用指定的模型级别）
   271		err = h.service.AdvancedSearchAndAnalyze(
   272			uint(conversationID),
   273			targetMessage.SearchQuery,
   274			c.Writer,
   275			userID.(uint),
   276			thirdparty.ModelLevel(modelLevel),
   277		)
   278		if err != nil {
   279			// Error handling for streaming - write error as SSE
   280			c.Writer.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("data: [ERROR] %s\n\n", err.Error())))
   281			c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
   282			return
   283		}
   284	
   285		// Send done signal
   286		c.Writer.Write([]byte("data: [DONE]\n\n"))
   287		c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
   288	}
   289	
   290	// StreamContinueConversation handles continuing the conversation with context
   291	func (h *Handler) StreamContinueConversation(c *gin.Context) {
   292		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   293		if !exists {
   294			utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
   295			return
   296		}
   297	
   298		conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
   299		if err != nil {
   300			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid conversation ID")
   301			return
   302		}
   303	
   304		var req struct {
   305			Query      string `json:"query" binding:"required"`
   306			ModelLevel string `json:"model_level"` // Optional, defaults to "mid"
   307		}
   308		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   309			utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   310			return
   311		}
   312	
   313		// Validate and default model level
   314		modelLevel := req.ModelLevel
   315		if modelLevel == "" {
   316			modelLevel = "mid"
   317		}
   318		switch modelLevel {
   319		case "low", "mid", "high":
   320			// Valid model level
   321		default:
   322			modelLevel = "mid"
   323		}
   324	
   325		// Verify conversation belongs to user
   326		conversation, err := h.service.GetConversationWithMessages(uint(conversationID), userID.(uint))
   327		if err != nil {
   328			utils.Error(c, 404, "Conversation not found")
   329			return
   330		}
   331	
   332		// Verify the conversation exists
   333		if conversation == nil {
   334			utils.Error(c, 404, "Conversation not found")
   335			return
   336		}
   337	
   338		// Set headers for SSE
   339		c.Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
   340		c.Header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
   341		c.Header("Connection", "keep-alive")
   342		c.Header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
   343	
   344		// Continue the conversation with specified model level
   345		err = h.service.ContinueConversation(
   346			uint(conversationID),
   347			req.Query,
   348			c.Writer,
   349			userID.(uint),
   350			thirdparty.ModelLevel(modelLevel),
   351		)
   352		if err != nil {
   353			// Error handling for streaming - write error as SSE
   354			c.Writer.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("data: [ERROR] %s\n\n", err.Error())))
   355			c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
   356			return
   357		}
   358	
   359		// Send done signal
   360		c.Writer.Write([]byte("data: [DONE]\n\n"))
   361		c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
   362	}

    29	// NewChatHandler creates a new chat handler
    30	func NewChatHandler(repo *Repository, aiService *ai.Service, service *Service, subscriptionService interface {
    31		CheckQuota(userID uint, featureType string) (bool, error)
    32		IncrementUsage(userID uint, featureType string) error
    33		CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID uint, featureType string) error
    34	}) *ChatHandler {
    35		chatService := NewChatService(repo, aiService)
    36		chatService.SetSubscriptionService(subscriptionService)
    37		return &ChatHandler{
    38			chatService: chatService,
    39			service:     service,
    40		}
    41	}

    43	// StreamChatMessage handles streaming chat requests
    44	// POST /api/v1/conversations/:id/chat/stream
    45	func (h *ChatHandler) StreamChatMessage(c *gin.Context) {
    46		userID := c.GetUint("user_id")
    47	
    48		// Parse conversation ID
    49		conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
    50		if err != nil {
    51			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid conversation ID")
    52			return
    53		}
    54	
    55		// Parse request body
    56		var req ChatRequest
    57		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    58			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
    59			return
    60		}
    61	
    62		req.ConversationID = uint(conversationID)
    63	
    64		// Set headers for Server-Sent Events
    65		c.Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
    66		c.Header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
    67		c.Header("Connection", "keep-alive")
    68		c.Header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no") // Disable nginx buffering
    69	
    70		// Create context with timeout
    71		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(c.Request.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
    72		defer cancel()
    73	
    74		// Stream the chat
    75		if err := h.chatService.StreamChat(ctx, userID, req, c.Writer); err != nil {
    76			log.Printf("Stream chat error: %v", err)
    77			// Error already sent via SSE
    78			return
    79		}
    80	
    81		c.Status(http.StatusOK)
    82	}

   202	// CreateConversationAndChat creates a new conversation and starts chatting
   203	// POST /api/v1/conversations/chat/new
   204	func (h *ChatHandler) CreateConversationAndChat(c *gin.Context) {
   205		userID := c.GetUint("user_id")
   206	
   207		var req struct {
   208			Title      string `json:"title"`
   209			Content    string `json:"content" binding:"required"`
   210			ModelLevel string `json:"model_level,omitempty"` // "low", "mid", "high"
   211		}
   212	
   213		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   214			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   215			return
   216		}
   217	
   218		// Generate title from first message if not provided
   219		title := req.Title
   220		if title == "" {
   221			title = h.generateTitle(req.Content)
   222		}
   223	
   224		// Create conversation with chat type
   225		conversation, err := h.service.CreateConversation(userID, title, ConversationTypeChat)
   226		if err != nil {
   227			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create conversation")
   228			return
   229		}
   230	
   231		// Set SSE headers
   232		c.Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
   233		c.Header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
   234		c.Header("Connection", "keep-alive")
   235		c.Header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
   236	
   237		// Send conversation ID first
   238		h.chatService.sendEvent(c.Writer, ChatResponse{
   239			Type: "conversation_created",
   240			Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
   241				"conversation_id": conversation.ID,
   242				"title":           conversation.Title,
   243			},
   244		})
   245	
   246		// Start chat
   247		chatReq := ChatRequest{
   248			ConversationID:  conversation.ID,
   249			Content:         req.Content,
   250			ParentMessageID: nil,
   251			ModelLevel:      req.ModelLevel, // Pass model level to chat service
   252		}
   253	
   254		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(c.Request.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
   255		defer cancel()
   256	
   257		if err := h.chatService.StreamChat(ctx, userID, chatReq, c.Writer); err != nil {
   258			log.Printf("Stream chat error: %v", err)
   259			return
   260		}
   261	
   262		c.Status(http.StatusOK)
   263	}

   265	// generateTitle generates a conversation title from the first message
   266	func (h *ChatHandler) generateTitle(content string) string {
   267		// Take first 50 characters or first sentence
   268		title := content
   269		if len(title) > 50 {
   270			title = title[:50] + "..."
   271		}
   272		return title
   273	}

   305	// GetSiblingMessages returns all sibling messages (same parent) for branch navigation
   306	// GET /api/v1/conversations/messages/:messageId/siblings
   307	func (h *ChatHandler) GetSiblingMessages(c *gin.Context) {
   308		messageID := c.Param("messageId")
   309	
   310		if messageID == "" {
   311			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Message ID is required")
   312			return
   313		}
   314	
   315		siblings, err := h.chatService.repo.GetSiblingMessages(messageID)
   316		if err != nil {
   317			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
   318			return
   319		}
   320	
   321		// Calculate current index
   322		currentIndex := 0
   323		for i, msg := range siblings {
   324			if msg.MessageID == messageID {
   325				currentIndex = i
   326				break
   327			}
   328		}
   329	
   330		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Siblings retrieved successfully", gin.H{
   331			"siblings":      siblings,
   332			"current_index": currentIndex,
   333			"total":         len(siblings),
   334		})
   335	}
   336	
   337	// GetBranchChain returns the complete chain from root to leaf for a specific branch
   338	// GET /api/v1/conversations/messages/:messageId/branch
   339	func (h *ChatHandler) GetBranchChain(c *gin.Context) {
   340		userID := c.GetUint("user_id")
   341		messageID := c.Param("messageId")
   342	
   343		if messageID == "" {
   344			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Message ID is required")
   345			return
   346		}
   347	
   348		// Get complete branch chain
   349		chain, err := h.chatService.GetBranchChain(messageID, userID)
   350		if err != nil {
   351			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
   352			return
   353		}
   354	
   355		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Branch chain retrieved successfully", chain)
   356	}

    47	// SearchResults represents Semantic Scholar search results stored as JSON
    48	type SearchResults []map[string]interface{}
    49	
    50	// Scan implements sql.Scanner interface
    51	func (s *SearchResults) Scan(value interface{}) error {
    52		if value == nil {
    53			*s = nil
    54			return nil
    55		}
    56	
    57		bytes, ok := value.([]byte)
    58		if !ok {
    59			return nil
    60		}
    61	
    62		return json.Unmarshal(bytes, s)
    63	}
    64	
    65	// Value implements driver.Valuer interface
    66	func (s SearchResults) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
    67		if s == nil {
    68			return nil, nil
    69		}
    70		return json.Marshal(s)
    71	}

    37	// GetUserConversations gets all conversations for a user, optionally filtered by type
    38	func (r *Repository) GetUserConversations(userID uint, limit, offset int, conversationType *ConversationType) ([]Conversation, int64, error) {
    39		var conversations []Conversation
    40		var total int64
    41	
    42		// Build base query
    43		query := r.db.Model(&Conversation{}).Where("user_id = ?", userID)
    44	
    45		// Add conversation type filter if provided
    46		if conversationType != nil {
    47			query = query.Where("conversation_type = ?", *conversationType)
    48		}
    49	
    50		// Get total count
    51		if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
    52			return nil, 0, err
    53		}
    54	
    55		// Get conversations ordered by updated_at DESC
    56		err := query.Order("updated_at DESC").
    57			Limit(limit).
    58			Offset(offset).
    59			Find(&conversations).Error
    60	
    61		if err != nil {
    62			return nil, 0, err
    63		}
    64	
    65		return conversations, total, nil
    66	}
