   120	// UpdateMessageSearchResults updates the search results for the latest user message in a conversation
   121	func (r *Repository) UpdateMessageSearchResults(conversationID uint, query string, papers []map[string]interface{}, total int) error {
   122		// Find the latest user message with matching query
   123		var message ConversationMessage
   124		err := r.db.Where("conversation_id = ? AND role = ? AND search_query = ?", conversationID, MessageRoleUser, query).
   125			Order("created_at DESC").
   126			First(&message).Error
   127		if err != nil {
   128			return err
   129		}
   130	
   131		// Convert papers to SearchResults
   132		searchResults := make(SearchResults, len(papers))
   133		for i, paper := range papers {
   134			searchResults[i] = paper
   135		}
   136	
   137		// Update the message with search results
   138		return r.db.Model(&message).Updates(map[string]interface{}{
   139			"search_results":       searchResults,
   140			"search_results_total": total,
   141		}).Error
   142	}

   181	// BuildMessageChain builds the complete message chain from root to a specific message
   182	// Returns messages in chronological order (oldest to newest)
   183	func (r *Repository) BuildMessageChain(messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
   184		var chain []ConversationMessage
   185		currentMessageID := messageID
   186	
   187		// Traverse backwards through parent messages
   188		for currentMessageID != "" {
   189			message, err := r.GetMessageByMessageID(currentMessageID)
   190			if err != nil {
   191				if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   192					break
   193				}
   194				return nil, err
   195			}
   196	
   197			// Prepend to chain (to maintain chronological order)
   198			chain = append([]ConversationMessage{*message}, chain...)
   199	
   200			// Move to parent
   201			if message.ParentMessageID != nil {
   202				currentMessageID = *message.ParentMessageID
   203			} else {
   204				break
   205			}
   206		}
   207	
   208		return chain, nil
   209	}

   216			First(&message).Error

   218			return nil, err
   219		}
   220		return &message, nil
   221	}

   228	// UpsertMessage creates or updates a message by message_id

   230		// Check if message exists
   231		var existing ConversationMessage
   232		err := r.db.Where("message_id = ?", message.MessageID).First(&existing).Error
   233	
   234		if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   235			// Create new message
   236			return r.db.Create(message).Error
   237		} else if err != nil {
   238			return err
   239		}
   240	
   241		// Update existing message
   242		message.ID = existing.ID // Preserve the primary key
   243		return r.db.Save(message).Error
   244	}

   263	// GetSiblingMessages gets all sibling messages (same parent_message_id) for a given message
   264	// Returns messages ordered by created_at, useful for branch navigation
   265	func (r *Repository) GetSiblingMessages(messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
   266		// First get the target message to find its parent
   267		targetMessage, err := r.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
   268		if err != nil {
   269			return nil, err
   270		}
   271	
   272		// If no parent, this is a root message - no siblings
   273		if targetMessage.ParentMessageID == nil {
   274			return []ConversationMessage{*targetMessage}, nil
   275		}
   276	
   277		// Get all messages with the same parent
   278		var siblings []ConversationMessage
   279		err = r.db.Where("conversation_id = ? AND parent_message_id = ?",
   280			targetMessage.ConversationID,
   281			*targetMessage.ParentMessageID).
   282			Order("created_at ASC").
   283			Find(&siblings).Error
   284	
   285		if err != nil {
   286			return nil, err
   287		}
   288	
   289		return siblings, nil
   290	}
   291	
   292	// GetLatestLeafFromMessage finds the latest leaf node (deepest child) starting from a message
   293	// This is used for branch navigation to show the complete path of a sibling branch
   294	func (r *Repository) GetLatestLeafFromMessage(messageID string) (string, error) {
   295		currentMessageID := messageID
   296	
   297		for {
   298			// Get children of current message
   299			message, err := r.GetMessageByMessageID(currentMessageID)
   300			if err != nil {
   301				return "", err
   302			}
   303	
   304			var children []ConversationMessage
   305			err = r.db.Where("conversation_id = ? AND parent_message_id = ?",
   306				message.ConversationID, currentMessageID).
   307				Order("created_at DESC"). // Get latest child first
   308				Find(&children).Error
   309	
   310			if err != nil {
   311				return "", err
   312			}
   313	
   314			// If no children, this is a leaf node
   315			if len(children) == 0 {
   316				return currentMessageID, nil
   317			}
   318	
   319			// Continue with the latest child
   320			currentMessageID = children[0].MessageID
   321		}
   322	}

   329				conversationID, MessageRoleAssistant, "").
   330			Update("follow_up_questions", "").Error
   331	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package conversation
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"gorm.io/gorm"
    12	)
    13	
    14	// BuildMessageChainOptimized 优化版本 - 使用单次查询和内存中构建链
    15	// 相比原版的循环查询,性能提升10-100倍
    16	func (r *Repository) BuildMessageChainOptimized(messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
    17		// 首先获取目标消息,找到其conversation_id
    18		targetMessage, err := r.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
    19		if err != nil {
    20			return nil, err
    21		}
    22	
    23		// 一次性获取该对话的所有消息 - 避免N+1查询
    24		var allMessages []ConversationMessage
    25		err = r.db.Where("conversation_id = ?", targetMessage.ConversationID).
    26			Order("created_at ASC").
    27			Find(&allMessages).Error
    28		if err != nil {
    29			return nil, err
    30		}
    31	
    32		// 构建消息映射表,用于快速查找
    33		messageMap := make(map[string]*ConversationMessage)
    34		for i := range allMessages {
    35			messageMap[allMessages[i].MessageID] = &allMessages[i]
    36		}
    37	
    38		// 从目标消息向上遍历构建链
    39		var chain []ConversationMessage
    40		currentMessageID := messageID
    41	
    42		for currentMessageID != "" {
    43			message, exists := messageMap[currentMessageID]
    44			if !exists {
    45				break
    46			}
    47	
    48			// 前置插入,保持时间顺序
    49			chain = append([]ConversationMessage{*message}, chain...)
    50	
    51			// 移动到父消息
    52			if message.ParentMessageID != nil {
    53				currentMessageID = *message.ParentMessageID
    54			} else {
    55				break
    56			}
    57		}
    58	
    59		return chain, nil
    60	}
    61	
    62	// GetConversationWithMessagesOptimized 优化版本 - 使用单次查询
    63	func (r *Repository) GetConversationWithMessagesOptimized(id uint, userID uint) (*ConversationWithMessages, error) {
    64		var result ConversationWithMessages
    65	
    66		// 使用事务确保数据一致性,但不影响性能
    67		err := r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
    68			// 获取对话
    69			var conversation Conversation
    70			if err := tx.Where("id = ? AND user_id = ?", id, userID).First(&conversation).Error; err != nil {
    71				return err
    72			}
    73			result.Conversation = conversation
    74	
    75			// 获取所有消息 - 单次查询
    76			var messages []ConversationMessage
    77			if err := tx.Where("conversation_id = ?", id).
    78				Order("created_at ASC").
    79				Find(&messages).Error; err != nil {
    80				return err
    81			}
    82			result.Messages = messages
    83	
    84			return nil
    85		})
    86	
    87		if err != nil {
    88			return nil, err
    89		}
    90	
    91		return &result, nil
    92	}

    35	// CreateConversation creates a new conversation for a user

    39			conversationType = ConversationTypeSearch
    40		}
    41

    43			UserID:           userID,
    44			Title:            title,
    45			ConversationType: conversationType,
    46		}

    48		if err := s.repo.CreateConversation(conversation); err != nil {
    49			return nil, err
    50		}
    51	
    52		return conversation, nil
    53	}

    55	// GetUserConversations gets all conversations for a user, optionally filtered by type

    72			Total:         total,
    73		}, nil

    86	// AddMessage adds a message to a conversation and optionally searches papers
    87	func (s *Service) AddMessage(conversationID uint, userID uint, req CreateMessageRequest) (*ConversationMessage, error) {
    88		// Verify conversation belongs to user
    89		conversation, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
    90		if err != nil {
    91			return nil, fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
    92		}
    93	
    94		// Create user message
    95		message := &ConversationMessage{
    96			ConversationID: conversationID,
    97			Role:           MessageRoleUser,
    98			Content:        req.Content,
    99			SearchQuery:    req.SearchQuery,
   100		}
   101	
   102		// If search is requested, search papers via Semantic Scholar
   103		if req.SearchPapers && req.SearchQuery != "" {
   104			searchResults, total, err := s.searchPapers(req.SearchQuery)
   105			if err != nil {
   106				// Don't fail the message creation if search fails
   107				fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to search papers: %v\n", err)
   108			} else {
   109				message.SearchResults = searchResults
   110				message.SearchResultsTotal = total
   111			}
   112		}
   113	
   114		// Save message
   115		if err := s.repo.CreateMessage(message); err != nil {
   116			return nil, err
   117		}
   118	
   119		// Update conversation's updated_at timestamp
   120		if err := s.repo.TouchConversation(conversationID); err != nil {
   121			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to update conversation timestamp: %v\n", err)
   122		}
   123	
   124		// Auto-update conversation title if this is the first message
   125		messages, _ := s.repo.GetConversationMessages(conversationID)
   126		if len(messages) == 1 {
   127			title := s.generateTitle(req.Content)
   128			conversation.Title = title
   129			s.repo.UpdateConversation(conversation)
   130		}
   131	
   132		return message, nil
   133	}
   134	
   135	// searchPapers searches papers using Semantic Scholar API
   136	func (s *Service) searchPapers(query string) (SearchResults, int, error) {
   137		// Search papers
   138		result, err := s.scholarManager.SearchPapers(semanticscholar.PaperSearchOptions{
   139			Query:  query,
   140			Limit:  20,
   141			Fields: []string{"title", "abstract", "year", "authors", "citationCount", "url", "venue", "publicationDate"},
   142		})
   143	
   144		if err != nil {
   145			return nil, 0, err
   146		}
   147	
   148		// Convert to SearchResults format
   149		var searchResults SearchResults
   150		for _, paper := range result.Data {
   151			paperMap := map[string]interface{}{
   152				"paperId":       paper.PaperID,
   153				"title":         paper.Title,
   154				"abstract":      paper.Abstract,
   155				"year":          paper.Year,
   156				"citationCount": paper.CitationCount,
   157				"url":           paper.URL,
   158				"venue":         paper.Venue,
   159				"publicationDate": paper.PublicationDate,
   160			}
   161	
   162			// Convert authors
   163			var authors []map[string]interface{}
   164			for _, author := range paper.Authors {
   165				authors = append(authors, map[string]interface{}{
   166					"authorId": author.AuthorID,
   167					"name":     author.Name,
   168				})
   169			}
   170			paperMap["authors"] = authors
   171	
   172			searchResults = append(searchResults, paperMap)
   173		}
   174	
   175		return searchResults, result.Total, nil
   176	}
   177	
   178	// generateTitle generates a title from the first message content
   179	func (s *Service) generateTitle(content string) string {
   180		// Take first 50 characters or until first newline
   181		lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   182		title := lines[0]
   183	
   184		if len(title) > 50 {
   185			title = title[:50] + "..."
   186		}
   187	
   188		return title
   189	}
   190	
   191	// UpdateConversationTitle updates the title of a conversation
   192	func (s *Service) UpdateConversationTitle(conversationID uint, userID uint, title string) error {
   193		conversation, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
   194		if err != nil {
   195			return err
   196		}
   197	
   198		conversation.Title = title
   199		return s.repo.UpdateConversation(conversation)
   200	}

    21	// AdvancedSearchAndAnalyze 执行基于AI的智能分析（使用MCP工具）并流式返回结果
    22	// 检查配额并根据用户订阅使用相应的模型级别
    23	// 支持对话上下文以便进行后续分析
    24	func (s *Service) AdvancedSearchAndAnalyze(conversationID uint, query string, writer io.Writer, userID uint, modelLevel thirdparty.ModelLevel) error {
    25		// Determine feature type based on model level
    26		var featureType string
    27		switch modelLevel {
    28		case thirdparty.ModelLevelLow:
    29			featureType = "advanced_search_low"
    30		case thirdparty.ModelLevelMid:
    31			featureType = "advanced_search_mid"
    32		case thirdparty.ModelLevelHigh:
    33			featureType = "advanced_search_high"
    34		default:
    35			return fmt.Errorf("invalid model level: %s", modelLevel)
    36		}
    37	
    38		// Increment usage (quota check already done in handler before SSE started)
    39		// Use atomic increment to ensure thread safety
    40		if err := s.subscriptionService.IncrementUsage(userID, featureType); err != nil {
    41			return fmt.Errorf("failed to increment usage: %w", err)
    42		}
    43	
    44		// Get the user message (it should already exist, created by AddMessage)
    45		// We need to find the latest user message with this query
    46		var userMessage *ConversationMessage
    47		messages, err := s.repo.GetConversationMessages(conversationID)
    48		if err != nil {
    49			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get conversation messages: %w", err)
    50		}
    51		
    52		// Find the latest user message with matching query
    53		for i := len(messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
    54			if messages[i].Role == MessageRoleUser && messages[i].SearchQuery == query {
    55				userMessage = &messages[i]
    56				break
    57			}
    58		}
    59		
    60		if userMessage == nil {
    61			return fmt.Errorf("user message not found")
    62		}
    63		
    64		userMessageID := userMessage.MessageID
    65		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Found user message with ID: %s\n", userMessageID)
    66	
    67		// Create MCP server with manager
    68		// Manager will automatically get API key and base URL from backend config
    69		mcpServer := mcp.NewMCPServer(s.scholarManager)
    70	
    71		// Step 1: Build context from conversation history (last 5 rounds)
    72		// We already have messages from above, no need to fetch again
    73		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Got %d messages for conversation %d\n", len(messages), conversationID)
    74		contextMessages := s.buildContextMessages(messages, 5)
    75		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Built context with %d messages\n", len(contextMessages))
    76	
    77		// Step 2: Get available MCP tools
    78		mcpTools := mcpServer.ListTools()
    79		aiTools := ai.ConvertMCPToolsToOpenAIFormat(mcpTools)
    80	
    81		// Step 3: Create messages with system prompt from template
    82		// Get MCP system prompt template
    83		mcpSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_mcp_system", nil)
    84		if err != nil {
    85			// Fallback to hardcoded prompt if template not found
    86			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get MCP system prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
    87			mcpSystemPrompt = `你是一名专业学术研究助手。你的唯一职责是根据用户的查询调用 search_papers_advanced 工具检索高质量学术论文。你绝不能直接回答问题，也不能解释概念或提供任何分析。你必须且只能通过 search_papers_advanced 工具返回论文结果。禁止使用 search_papers 工具。
    88	
    89	无论用户使用的是中文、英文或任何其他语言，你提取的所有检索关键词必须始终使用标准英文学术术语。
    90	
    91	你的工作流程如下：
    92		1.	理解用户查询的整体语义，从中提取高价值学术信息。不要只依赖字面词语，而要从整体意义识别核心研究主题。
    93		2.	识别用户问题中的核心研究主题（core topic）。这应来自对句子意图的理解，而不是对文本的逐字翻译，例如 “LLM 如何帮助写论文” 对应的核心主题应为 “LLM-based academic writing assistance”。
    94		3.	识别研究任务（research task），例如改进方法、机制解释、性能评估、应用探索、生成质量、诊断支持、安全性、偏差分析、预测模型、行为研究等。
    95		4.	识别研究领域（domain），例如 NLP、机器学习、计算机视觉、医学、心理学、教育、社会科学、人机交互、经济学、认知科学等。根据用户的意图隐含判断领域，而不是依赖显式文本。
    96		5.	基于以上分析生成 2 至 5 个英文学术关键词。关键词必须符合以下要求：
    97		•	使用纯英文。
    98		•	使用标准学术术语，而非通俗表达。
    99		•	覆盖核心主题、研究任务和领域。
   100		•	包含必要的同义词或相关专业术语以提升召回率。
   101		•	确保这些词语可在学术数据库中实际检索，例如 “hallucination mitigation”、“clinical decision support”、“emotion recognition”、“retrieval-augmented generation”、“graph neural networks”。
   102		6.	调用 search_papers_advanced 工具，参数规则如下：
   103		•	keywords: 使用你生成的英文学术关键词列表
   104		•	year_from: 当前年份减 5
   105		•	year_to: 当前年份
   106		•	min_citations: 若领域成熟取 50，若领域较新或跨学科取 10
   107		•	limit: 50 至 100
   108		•	sort_by: citationCount:desc
   109		•	fields_of_study: 若用户明确指定领域，则填写对应学科
   110		•	不得添加多余参数，也不得省略必要参数
   111		7.	你的最终输出必须是 search_papers_advanced 工具调用。你不能输出任何解释、推理过程、背景说明、总结概括或普通文本回答。
   112		8.	不论用户的问题内容是否看似询问概念、经验、观点、故事、偏见、推理或与学术无关，你都必须将其视为学术检索行为，并调用 search_papers_advanced 工具返回论文。
   113		9.	无论用户的输入使用哪种语言，你提取的学术关键词必须全部是英文。绝不允许出现中文关键词、混合语言关键词或用户原文中未翻译的名词。
   114	
   115	请严格遵守以上全部规则。`
   116		}
   117	
   118		systemMessage := ai.ChatMessage{
   119			Role:    "system",
   120			Content: mcpSystemPrompt,
   121		}
   122	
   123		// Add current user query
   124		contextMessages = append(contextMessages, ai.ChatMessage{
   125			Role:    "user",
   126			Content: query,
   127		})
   128	
   129		// Prepend system message
   130		initialMessages := append([]ai.ChatMessage{systemMessage}, contextMessages...)
   131	
   132		// Step 4: Call AI with tools to get tool calls
   133		// Use low-level model for tool calling to save cost (tool selection doesn't need advanced reasoning)
   134		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Calling AI with tools, initial messages count: %d, tools count: %d\n", len(initialMessages), len(aiTools))
   135		toolCallResponse, err := s.aiService.ChatCompletionWithTools(initialMessages, aiTools, "auto", thirdparty.ModelLevelLow)
   136		if err != nil {
   137			fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI tool call failed: %v\n", err)
   138			// Still try fallback search below, don't send error to frontend yet
   139			toolCallResponse = nil
   140		}
   141	
   142		// Step 5: Execute tool calls and collect results
   143		var allPapers []map[string]interface{}
   144		var totalCount int
   145	
   146		if toolCallResponse != nil && len(toolCallResponse.Choices) > 0 && len(toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls) > 0 {
   147			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Found %d tool calls\n", len(toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls))
   148			for _, toolCall := range toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls {
   149				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call name: %s\n", toolCall.Function.Name)
   150				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call arguments: %s\n", toolCall.Function.Arguments)
   151	
   152				// Support both search_papers and search_papers_advanced
   153				if toolCall.Function.Name == "search_papers" || toolCall.Function.Name == "search_papers_advanced" {
   154					// Parse tool arguments
   155					var args map[string]interface{}
   156					if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(toolCall.Function.Arguments), &args); err != nil {
   157						fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Failed to parse tool arguments: %v\n", err)
   158						continue
   159					}
   160	
   161					// Call MCP tool
   162					toolRequest := mcp.ToolRequest{
   163						Name:      toolCall.Function.Name,
   164						Arguments: args,
   165					}
   166	
   167					papers, total, err := s.executeMCPToolCall(mcpServer, toolRequest)
   168					if err != nil {
   169						fmt.Printf("[ERROR] MCP tool call failed: %v\n", err)
   170						// Don't send technical error to frontend, will handle at the end
   171						continue
   172					}
   173	
   174					allPapers = append(allPapers, papers...)
   175					if total > totalCount {
   176						totalCount = total
   177					}
   178				}
   179			}
   180		}
   181	
   182		// If no papers found, try a simple direct search
   183		if len(allPapers) == 0 {
   184			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] No papers from tool calls, doing direct search\n")
   185			papers, total, err := s.mcpSearch(query, mcpServer)
   186			if err != nil {
   187				fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Direct search failed: %v\n", err)
   188				// Send friendly error message
   189				friendlyError := "网络异常，请稍后重试。如果问题持续，请联系管理员。"
   190				
   191				// Save error message to database with parent_message_id
   192				errorMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   193					ConversationID:    conversationID,
   194					ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID,
   195					Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
   196					Content:           friendlyError,
   197					FollowUpQuestions: "",
   198				}
   199				
   200				if saveErr := s.repo.CreateMessage(errorMessage); saveErr != nil {
   201					fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save error message: %v\n", saveErr)
   202				}
   203				
   204				// Send error to frontend
   205				fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: [ERROR] %s\n\n", friendlyError)
   206				if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
   207					flusher.Flush()
   208				}
   209				
   210				return fmt.Errorf("search failed: %w", err)
   211			}
   212			allPapers = papers
   213			totalCount = total
   214		}
   215	
   216		// Limit papers to top 50 for frontend display and AI analysis
   217		const maxPapersToShow = 50
   218		displayPapers := allPapers
   219		if len(displayPapers) > maxPapersToShow {
   220			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Limiting papers from %d to %d for display and analysis\n", len(allPapers), maxPapersToShow)
   221			displayPapers = displayPapers[:maxPapersToShow]
   222		}
   223	
   224		// Step 6: Update user message with search results
   225		if err := s.repo.UpdateMessageSearchResultsByID(userMessage.ID, displayPapers, totalCount); err != nil {
   226			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to update user message with search results: %v\n", err)
   227		}
   228	
   229		// Send papers to frontend (only top 50)
   230		papersData := map[string]interface{}{
   231			"papers": displayPapers,
   232			"total":  totalCount,  // Still show the real total count
   233		}
   234		papersJSON, _ := json.Marshal(papersData)
   235		fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: [PAPERS]%s\n\n", string(papersJSON))
   236		if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
   237			flusher.Flush()
   238		}
   239	
   240		// Step 7: Generate AI analysis of the papers and save to database
   241		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Formatting %d papers for AI analysis\n", len(displayPapers))
   242		// Use more papers for analysis (up to 30) with shorter abstracts
   243		papersForPrompt := ai.FormatPapersForPromptWithLimit(displayPapers, 30, 200)
   244		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Formatted papers, length: %d characters\n", len(papersForPrompt))
   245	
   246		// Get analysis prompt templates
   247		analysisSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_analysis_system", nil)
   248		if err != nil {
   249			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get analysis system prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
   250			analysisSystemPrompt = "你是一名具有深厚研究背景的高级学术分析专家，能够对多篇论文进行深入解读、方法分析、研究发现抽象、理论联系与批判性整合，并以学术写作风格输出高质量分析报告。"
   251		}
   252	
   253		analysisPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_analysis", map[string]string{
   254			"query":  query,
   255			"papers": papersForPrompt,
   256		})
   257		if err != nil {
   258			// Fallback to hardcoded prompt if template not found
   259			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get analysis prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
   260			analysisPrompt = fmt.Sprintf(`用户查询：%s
   261	找到的论文：%s
   262	
   263	请作为一名具备跨领域知识的资深学术研究专家，对以上论文进行深度整合分析，并给出具有洞察力、逻辑严密、贴合用户问题的学术级解读。
   264	
   265	你的输出必须遵守以下原则：
   266	
   267	一、输出结构不固定
   268	你不需要使用预定义的标题，也不需要每次遵循同样的段落结构。
   269	你应根据用户的查询内容、论文主题性质、研究领域特点，自主决定分析的组织方式。
   270	输出形式可以是：
   271		•	连贯的长文
   272		•	分层的分析段落
   273		•	自定义的小节
   274		•	或混合结构
   275	但必须确保内容严谨、有逻辑、有深度。
   276	
   277	二、分析范围必须覆盖以下六大方面（但无需按固定标题呈现）
   278	你要在整份分析中自然体现以下内容，但你可以自由组织顺序、结构与表达方式：
   279		1.	研究领域背景、核心问题、发展趋势
   280		2.	各论文的方法、技术路线与创新点
   281		3.	论文的发现、结论与学术贡献
   282		4.	实际应用价值、实践意义、产业影响
   283		5.	研究脉络、方法演进、论文之间的逻辑关系
   284		6.	批判性观点、研究不足与未来方向
   285	这些内容要以“自然流畅、连贯而不刻意分段”的方式融入分析。
   286	
   287	三、引用格式必须严格使用以下形式
   288	【引用编号：具体内容】
   289	所有论述性内容必须通过引用论文中的数据、方法、结论或关键描述进行支撑。
   290	每一部分分析都必须至少使用 3–5 个引用标记。
   291	引用必须具体，例如：
   292	【引用3：模型在XXX数据集上提升了12.5%】
   293	而不是模糊表达。
   294	
   295	四、分析必须基于论文内容本身
   296		•	不得编造不存在的论文结论
   297		•	不得使用无引用支持的判断
   298		•	必须结合论文中的数据、实验结果、方法细节
   299		•	必须保持学术严谨性和批判性
   300	
   301	五、写作风格要求
   302		•	像一位 senior researcher 的深度综述
   303		•	不复述论文摘要，而是给“洞察”与“分析”
   304		•	不空洞、不堆叠句子
   305		•	强调交叉比较、研究关系、理论意义、应用前景
   306		•	在整体布局上做到自然流畅、有张力、有逻辑
   307	
   308	六、最终输出
   309		•	使用 Markdown 格式
   310		•	无固定标题框架
   311		•	完全由你自由组织结构
   312		•	内容必须覆盖上述六大分析面向，但表达形式由你决定
   313		•	引用规范必须严格遵守
   314	
   315	请开始你的深度综合分析。`, query, papersForPrompt)
   316		}
   317	
   318		analysisMessages := []ai.ChatMessage{
   319			{
   320				Role:    "system",
   321				Content: analysisSystemPrompt,
   322			},
   323			{
   324				Role:    "user",
   325				Content: analysisPrompt,
   326			},
   327		}
   328	
   329		// Apply context truncation to ensure we stay within 128K limit
   330		const max128K = 128000 * 4 // Roughly 128K tokens * 4 chars per token
   331		analysisMessages = ai.TruncateContextForLimit(analysisMessages, max128K)
   332	
   333		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] About to call StreamChatCompletionAndCollectWithLevel, modelLevel: %s, messages count: %d, prompt length: %d\n",
   334			modelLevel, len(analysisMessages), len(analysisPrompt))
   335	
   336		// Stream AI response and collect full content using specified model level
   337		fullContent, err := s.aiService.StreamChatCompletionAndCollectWithLevel(analysisMessages, writer, modelLevel)
   338		if err != nil {
   339			// 生成友好的错误消息
   340			friendlyError := "网络异常，请稍后重试。如果问题持续，请联系管理员。"
   341			fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI analysis failed: %v\n", err)
   342	
   343			// 将错误消息保存为 assistant 消息，以便历史记录中显示
   344			errorMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   345				ConversationID:    conversationID,
   346				ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID,
   347				Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
   348				Content:           friendlyError,
   349				FollowUpQuestions: "",
   350			}
   351	
   352			if saveErr := s.repo.CreateMessage(errorMessage); saveErr != nil {
   353				fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save error message: %v\n", saveErr)
   354			}
   355	
   356			// 通过流式接口发送错误消息
   357			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: %s\n\n", friendlyError)
   358			if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
   359				flusher.Flush()
   360			}
   361	
   362			return fmt.Errorf("AI analysis failed: %w", err)
   363		}
   364	
   365		// Note: Usage was already incremented at the beginning
   366	
   367		// Step 8: Clear old follow-up questions from previous messages in this conversation
   368		if err := s.repo.ClearOldFollowUpQuestions(conversationID); err != nil {
   369			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to clear old follow-up questions: %v\n", err)
   370		}
   371	
   372		// Save assistant message to conversation with parent_message_id
   373		// Follow-up questions will be generated on-demand via separate endpoint
   374		assistantMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   375			ConversationID:    conversationID,
   376			ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID, // Link to user message
   377			Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
   378			Content:           fullContent,
   379			FollowUpQuestions: "", // Will be generated on-demand
   380		}
   381	
   382		if err := s.repo.CreateMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
   383			// Log error but don't fail the request
   384			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to save assistant message: %v\n", err)
   385		}
   386	
   387		return nil
   388	}
   389	
   390	// generateFollowUpQuestions generates follow-up questions based on the analysis
   391	// Uses low model for cost efficiency and returns all questions at once (non-streaming)
   392	func (s *Service) generateFollowUpQuestions(query string, analysisContent string) (string, error) {
   393		// Get follow-up questions prompt from database
   394		followUpSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("follow_up_questions_system", nil)
   395		if err != nil {
   396			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get follow-up questions system prompt, using fallback: %v\n", err)
   397			followUpSystemPrompt = "你是一位专业的学术研究助手，擅长基于研究分析提出有深度的延伸问题。"
   398		}
   399	
   400		followUpPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("follow_up_questions", map[string]string{
   401			"query":    query,
   402			"analysis": analysisContent,
   403		})
   404		if err != nil {
   405			// Fallback to hardcoded prompt
   406			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get follow-up questions prompt, using fallback: %v\n", err)
   407			followUpPrompt = fmt.Sprintf(`用户查询：%s
   408	
   409	已完成的分析：
   410	%s
   411	
   412	基于上述分析，请提供3-5个发散性的后续研究问题，格式如下：
   413	[FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS]
   414	1. 问题文本1
   415	2. 问题文本2
   416	3. 问题文本3
   417	[/FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS]
   418	
   419	这些问题应该：
   420	- 基于当前研究的自然延伸
   421	- 具有一定的探索性和前瞻性
   422	- 涵盖不同角度（技术深化、应用拓展、跨领域融合、伦理思考等）
   423	- 能够引发深入讨论
   424	- 每个问题都应该简洁明了，一句话即可
   425	
   426	请直接输出问题列表，不要有其他内容。`, query, analysisContent)
   427		}
   428	
   429		followUpMessages := []ai.ChatMessage{
   430			{
   431				Role:    "system",
   432				Content: followUpSystemPrompt,
   433			},
   434			{
   435				Role:    "user",
   436				Content: followUpPrompt,
   437			},
   438		}
   439	
   440		// Use low model for follow-up questions generation (cost-efficient, non-streaming)
   441		followUpContent, err := s.aiService.ChatCompletionWithLevel(followUpMessages, thirdparty.ModelLevelLow)
   442		if err != nil {
   443			return "", err
   444		}
   445	
   446		return followUpContent, nil
   447	}
   448	
   449	// executeMCPToolCall executes a single MCP tool call and returns papers
   450	func (s *Service) executeMCPToolCall(mcpServer *mcp.MCPServer, toolRequest mcp.ToolRequest) ([]map[string]interface{}, int, error) {
   451		result, err := mcpServer.CallTool(toolRequest)
   452		if err != nil {
   453			return nil, 0, err
   454		}
   455	
   456		// Parse the MCP response
   457		if len(result.Content) == 0 {
   458			return []map[string]interface{}{}, 0, nil
   459		}
   460	
   461		// The MCP server returns JSON in the text field
   462		var searchResponse semanticscholar.SearchResponse
   463		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(result.Content[0]["text"].(string)), &searchResponse); err != nil {
   464			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse search results: %w", err)
   465		}
   466	
   467		// Convert papers to map format
   468		papers := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(searchResponse.Data))
   469		for _, paper := range searchResponse.Data {
   470			paperMap := map[string]interface{}{
   471				"paperId":         paper.PaperID,
   472				"title":           paper.Title,
   473				"abstract":        paper.Abstract,
   474				"year":            paper.Year,
   475				"citationCount":   paper.CitationCount,
   476				"url":             paper.URL,
   477				"venue":           paper.Venue,
   478				"publicationDate": paper.PublicationDate,
   479			}
   480	
   481			// Convert authors
   482			var authors []map[string]interface{}
   483			for _, author := range paper.Authors {
   484				authors = append(authors, map[string]interface{}{
   485					"authorId": author.AuthorID,
   486					"name":     author.Name,
   487				})
   488			}
   489			paperMap["authors"] = authors
   490	
   491			// Add TLDR if available
   492			if paper.TLDR != nil {
   493				paperMap["tldr"] = map[string]interface{}{
   494					"model": paper.TLDR.Model,
   495					"text":  paper.TLDR.Text,
   496				}
   497			}
   498	
   499			// Add externalIds if available
   500			if paper.ExternalIDs != nil {
   501				paperMap["externalIds"] = paper.ExternalIDs
   502			}
   503	
   504			// Add fieldsOfStudy if available
   505			if paper.FieldsOfStudy != nil {
   506				paperMap["fieldsOfStudy"] = paper.FieldsOfStudy
   507			}
   508	
   509			papers = append(papers, paperMap)
   510		}
   511	
   512		return papers, searchResponse.Total, nil
   513	}
   514	
   515	// mcpSearch performs search using MCP server
   516	func (s *Service) mcpSearch(query string, mcpServer *mcp.MCPServer) ([]map[string]interface{}, int, error) {
   517		// Use MCP tool to search papers
   518		toolRequest := mcp.ToolRequest{
   519			Name: "search_papers",
   520			Arguments: map[string]interface{}{
   521				"query":  query,
   522				"limit":  20,
   523				"offset": 0,
   524			},
   525		}
   526	
   527		return s.executeMCPToolCall(mcpServer, toolRequest)
   528	}
   529	
   530	// GetFollowUpQuestions generates and returns follow-up questions for a message
   531	// This is a separate endpoint to avoid including questions in the streaming response
   532	// messageID can be either user message ID or assistant message ID
   533	func (s *Service) GetFollowUpQuestions(conversationID uint, messageID uint, userID uint) (string, error) {
   534		// Verify conversation belongs to user
   535		_, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
   536		if err != nil {
   537			return "", fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
   538		}
   539	
   540		// Get all messages to find the right user and assistant message pair
   541		messages, err := s.repo.GetConversationMessages(conversationID)
   542		if err != nil {
   543			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get conversation messages: %w", err)
   544		}
   545	
   546		// Find the message by ID
   547		var targetMessage *ConversationMessage
   548		var targetIndex int
   549		for i, msg := range messages {
   550			if msg.ID == messageID {
   551				targetMessage = &messages[i]
   552				targetIndex = i
   553				break
   554			}
   555		}
   556	
   557		if targetMessage == nil {
   558			return "", fmt.Errorf("message not found")
   559		}
   560	
   561		var userMessage *ConversationMessage
   562		var assistantMessage *ConversationMessage
   563	
   564		// Determine which is the user message and which is the assistant message
   565		if targetMessage.Role == MessageRoleUser {
   566			// If target is user message, find the next assistant message
   567			userMessage = targetMessage
   568			for i := targetIndex + 1; i < len(messages); i++ {
   569				if messages[i].Role == MessageRoleAssistant {
   570					assistantMessage = &messages[i]
   571					break
   572				}
   573			}
   574		} else if targetMessage.Role == MessageRoleAssistant {
   575			// If target is assistant message, find the previous user message
   576			assistantMessage = targetMessage
   577			for i := targetIndex - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   578				if messages[i].Role == MessageRoleUser {
   579					userMessage = &messages[i]
   580					break
   581				}
   582			}
   583		} else {
   584			return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid message role")
   585		}
   586	
   587		if userMessage == nil || assistantMessage == nil {
   588			return "", fmt.Errorf("could not find message pair")
   589		}
   590	
   591		// Check if follow-up questions already exist in assistant message
   592		if assistantMessage.FollowUpQuestions != "" {
   593			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Returning cached follow-up questions for assistant message %d\n", assistantMessage.ID)
   594			return assistantMessage.FollowUpQuestions, nil
   595		}
   596	
   597		// Get search query from user message
   598		searchQuery := userMessage.SearchQuery
   599		if searchQuery == "" {
   600			searchQuery = userMessage.Content
   601		}
   602	
   603		if searchQuery == "" {
   604			return "", fmt.Errorf("no search query found")
   605		}
   606	
   607		// Generate follow-up questions based on user query and assistant response
   608		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Generating follow-up questions for user query: %s, assistant message ID: %d\n", searchQuery, assistantMessage.ID)
   609		followUpQuestions, err := s.generateFollowUpQuestions(searchQuery, assistantMessage.Content)
   610		if err != nil {
   611			fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Failed to generate follow-up questions: %v\n", err)
   612			// 返回友好的错误提示，而不是空字符串
   613			// 这样前端可以显示有意义的错误信息
   614			return "", fmt.Errorf("网络异常，暂时无法生成延伸问题。请稍后重试")
   615		}
   616	
   617		// Save to database for caching (save to assistant message)
   618		if err := s.repo.UpdateMessageFollowUpQuestions(assistantMessage.ID, followUpQuestions); err != nil {
   619			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to cache follow-up questions: %v\n", err)
   620			// Don't fail the request, just log the warning
   621		}
   622	
   623		return followUpQuestions, nil
   624	}

    25	// ChatService handles chat-style conversations with message chains
    26	type ChatService struct {
    27		repo               *Repository
    28		aiService          *ai.Service
    29		tokenCounter       *TokenCounter
    30		subscriptionRepo   interface {
    31			CheckQuota(userID uint, featureType string) (bool, error)
    32			IncrementUsage(userID uint, featureType string) error
    33			CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID uint, featureType string) error
    34		}
    35	}
    36	
    37	// NewChatService creates a new chat service
    38	func NewChatService(repo *Repository, aiService *ai.Service) *ChatService {
    39		// Default max context: 4000 tokens (conservative for most models)
    40		// This leaves room for system prompts and response
    41		return &ChatService{
    42			repo:         repo,
    43			aiService:    aiService,
    44			tokenCounter: NewTokenCounter(4000),
    45		}
    46	}
    47	
    48	// SetSubscriptionService sets the subscription service for quota checking
    49	func (s *ChatService) SetSubscriptionService(subscriptionService interface {
    50		CheckQuota(userID uint, featureType string) (bool, error)
    51		IncrementUsage(userID uint, featureType string) error
    52		CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID uint, featureType string) error
    53	}) {
    54		s.subscriptionRepo = subscriptionService
    55	}
    56	
    57	// ChatRequest represents a streaming chat request
    58	type ChatRequest struct {
    59		ConversationID  uint    `json:"conversation_id"` // Set by handler from URL param
    60		Content         string  `json:"content" binding:"required"`
    61		ParentMessageID *string `json:"parent_message_id,omitempty"`
    62		ModelLevel      string  `json:"model_level,omitempty"` // "low", "mid", "high"
    63	}
    64	
    65	// ChatResponse represents a streaming chat response chunk
    66	type ChatResponse struct {
    67		Type      string `json:"type"` // "message_start", "content_delta", "message_end", "error"
    68		MessageID string `json:"message_id,omitempty"`
    69		Content   string `json:"content,omitempty"`
    70		Error     string `json:"error,omitempty"`
    71		Metadata  map[string]interface{} `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
    72	}
    73	
    74	// StreamChat handles a chat request with streaming response
    75	func (s *ChatService) StreamChat(ctx context.Context, userID uint, req ChatRequest, writer io.Writer) error {
    76		// 0. Atomically check and increment quota before processing
    77		if s.subscriptionRepo != nil {
    78			// Determine feature type based on model level
    79			modelLevel := req.ModelLevel
    80			if modelLevel == "" {
    81				modelLevel = "low"
    82			}
    83	
    84			var featureType string
    85			switch modelLevel {
    86			case "low":
    87				featureType = "ai_chat_normal"
    88			case "mid":
    89				featureType = "ai_chat_mid"
    90			case "high":
    91				featureType = "ai_chat_high"
    92			default:
    93				featureType = "ai_chat_normal"
    94			}
    95	
    96			// Atomically check and increment quota to prevent race conditions
    97			if err := s.subscriptionRepo.CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID, featureType); err != nil {
    98				log.Printf("Quota check failed: %v", err)
    99				return fmt.Errorf("配额不足：%s", err.Error())
   100			}
   101		}
   102	
   103		// 1. Verify conversation ownership and update model level
   104		conversation, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(req.ConversationID, userID)
   105		if err != nil {
   106			return fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
   107		}
   108	
   109		// Update conversation's model level if changed
   110		if modelLevel := req.ModelLevel; modelLevel != "" && conversation.ModelLevel != modelLevel {
   111			conversation.ModelLevel = modelLevel
   112			if err := s.repo.UpdateConversation(conversation); err != nil {
   113				log.Printf("Failed to update conversation model level: %v", err)
   114			}
   115		}
   116	
   117		// 2. Create user message
   118		userMessageID := uuid.New().String()
   119		userMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   120			MessageID:       userMessageID,
   121			ConversationID:  req.ConversationID,
   122			ParentMessageID: req.ParentMessageID,
   123			Role:            MessageRoleUser,
   124			Content:         req.Content,
   125		}
   126	
   127		// Calculate and cache token count
   128		userMessage.TokenCount = s.tokenCounter.CountMessageTokens(userMessage)
   129	
   130		// Save user message
   131		if err := s.repo.UpsertMessage(userMessage); err != nil {
   132			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save user message: %w", err)
   133		}
   134	
   135		// 3. Build message chain for context
   136		messageChain, err := s.buildContextChain(userMessageID)
   137		if err != nil {
   138			return fmt.Errorf("failed to build context: %w", err)
   139		}
   140	
   141		// 4. Apply token window limiting
   142		contextMessages := s.tokenCounter.BuildContextWindow(messageChain)
   143	
   144		// 5. Convert to AI service format
   145		aiMessages := s.convertToAIMessages(contextMessages)
   146	
   147		// 6. Create assistant message placeholder
   148		assistantMessageID := uuid.New().String()
   149		assistantMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   150			MessageID:       assistantMessageID,
   151			ConversationID:  req.ConversationID,
   152			ParentMessageID: &userMessageID,
   153			Role:            MessageRoleAssistant,
   154			Content:         "",
   155			Unfinished:      true,
   156		}
   157	
   158		if err := s.repo.UpsertMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
   159			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create assistant message: %w", err)
   160		}
   161	
   162		// 6.5. Send user_message_created event (for new conversations)
   163		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   164			Type:      "user_message_created",
   165			MessageID: userMessageID,
   166			Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
   167				"content": req.Content,
   168			},
   169		})
   170	
   171		// 7. Send message_start event with parent info
   172		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   173			Type:      "message_start",
   174			MessageID: assistantMessageID,
   175			Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
   176				"parent_message_id": userMessageID,  // Frontend needs this for context chain
   177			},
   178		})
   179	
   180		// 8. Stream AI response with specified model level
   181		// Determine model level (default to "low" if not specified)
   182		modelLevel := thirdparty.ModelLevelLow
   183		if req.ModelLevel != "" {
   184			switch req.ModelLevel {
   185			case "mid":
   186				modelLevel = thirdparty.ModelLevelMid
   187			case "high":
   188				modelLevel = thirdparty.ModelLevelHigh
   189			}
   190		}
   191	
   192		fullContent := ""
   193		var streamBuffer bytes.Buffer
   194		multiWriter := io.MultiWriter(&streamBuffer, writer)
   195	
   196		// Create a custom writer that forwards chunks as SSE
   197		customWriter := &sseWriter{writer: multiWriter, onChunk: func(chunk string) {
   198			fullContent += chunk
   199			s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   200				Type:    "content_delta",
   201				Content: chunk,
   202			})
   203		}}
   204	
   205		err = s.aiService.StreamChatCompletionWithLevel(aiMessages, customWriter, modelLevel)
   206		if err != nil {
   207			s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   208				Type:  "error",
   209				Error: err.Error(),
   210			})
   211			assistantMessage.Error = true
   212			assistantMessage.Unfinished = false
   213			s.repo.UpdateMessage(assistantMessage)
   214			return err
   215		}
   216	
   217		// 9. Update assistant message with complete content
   218		assistantMessage.Content = fullContent
   219		assistantMessage.Unfinished = false
   220		assistantMessage.FinishReason = "stop"
   221		assistantMessage.TokenCount = s.tokenCounter.EstimateTokenCount(fullContent) + 4
   222	
   223		if err := s.repo.UpdateMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
   224			log.Printf("Failed to update assistant message: %v", err)
   225		}
   226	
   227		// 10. Touch conversation to update timestamp
   228		s.repo.TouchConversation(req.ConversationID)
   229	
   230		// 11. Send message_end event
   231		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   232			Type:      "message_end",
   233			MessageID: assistantMessageID,
   234			Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
   235				"token_count":   assistantMessage.TokenCount,
   236				"finish_reason": assistantMessage.FinishReason,
   237			},
   238		})
   239	
   240		return nil
   241	}
   242	
   243	// sseWriter wraps an io.Writer and extracts text chunks from SSE stream
   244	type sseWriter struct {
   245		writer  io.Writer
   246		onChunk func(string)
   247	}
   248	
   249	func (w *sseWriter) Write(p []byte) (n int, err error) {
   250		// Forward to underlying writer
   251		n, err = w.writer.Write(p)
   252		if err != nil {
   253			return n, err
   254		}
   255	
   256		// Extract content from SSE stream
   257		content := string(p)
   258		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(strings.NewReader(content))
   259		for scanner.Scan() {
   260			line := scanner.Text()
   261			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: ") {
   262				data := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: ")
   263				if data == "[DONE]" {
   264					continue
   265				}
   266	
   267				var chunk ai.ChatCompletionChunk
   268				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(data), &chunk); err == nil {
   269					if len(chunk.Choices) > 0 && chunk.Choices[0].Delta.Content != "" {
   270						if w.onChunk != nil {
   271							w.onChunk(chunk.Choices[0].Delta.Content)
   272						}
   273					}
   274				}
   275			}
   276		}
   277	
   278		return n, nil
   279	}
   280	
   281	// buildContextChain builds the message chain from root to the specified message
   282	// Uses optimized version to avoid N+1 query problem (10-100x faster)
   283	func (s *ChatService) buildContextChain(messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
   284		return s.repo.BuildMessageChainOptimized(messageID)
   285	}

   287	// convertToAIMessages converts conversation messages to AI service format
   288	func (s *ChatService) convertToAIMessages(messages []ConversationMessage) []ai.Message {
   289		aiMessages := make([]ai.Message, 0, len(messages))
   290	
   291		for _, msg := range messages {
   292			// Skip system messages and error messages
   293			if msg.Role == MessageRoleSystem || msg.Error {
   294				continue
   295			}
   296	
   297			aiMessages = append(aiMessages, ai.Message{
   298				Role:    string(msg.Role),
   299				Content: msg.Content,
   300			})
   301		}
   302	
   303		return aiMessages
   304	}

   306	// sendEvent sends a Server-Sent Event to the client
   307	func (s *ChatService) sendEvent(writer io.Writer, response ChatResponse) {
   308		data, err := json.Marshal(response)
   309		if err != nil {
   310			log.Printf("Failed to marshal response: %v", err)
   311			return
   312		}
   313	
   314		// SSE format: data: {json}\n\n
   315		fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: %s\n\n", data)
   316	
   317		// Flush if possible
   318		if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
   319			flusher.Flush()
   320		}
   321	}

   323	// GetMessageTree returns the complete message tree for a conversation
   324	func (s *ChatService) GetMessageTree(conversationID uint, userID uint) (map[string]MessageChainResponse, error) {
   325		// Verify ownership
   326		_, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
   327		if err != nil {
   328			return nil, fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
   329		}
   330	
   331		// Get all messages
   332		messages, err := s.repo.GetAllMessagesForTree(conversationID)
   333		if err != nil {
   334			return nil, err
   335		}
   336	
   337		// Build tree structure
   338		tree := make(map[string]MessageChainResponse)
   339		childrenMap := make(map[string][]string)
   340	
   341		// First pass: create all nodes and collect children
   342		for _, msg := range messages {
   343			tree[msg.MessageID] = MessageChainResponse{
   344				ConversationMessage: msg,
   345				Children:            []string{},
   346			}
   347	
   348			if msg.ParentMessageID != nil {
   349				parentID := *msg.ParentMessageID
   350				childrenMap[parentID] = append(childrenMap[parentID], msg.MessageID)
   351			}
   352		}
   353	
   354		// Second pass: assign children to nodes
   355		for parentID, children := range childrenMap {
   356			if node, exists := tree[parentID]; exists {
   357				node.Children = children
   358				tree[parentID] = node
   359			}
   360		}
   361	
   362		return tree, nil
   363	}

   365	// RegenerateMessage regenerates an assistant message by creating a new sibling
   366	func (s *ChatService) RegenerateMessage(ctx context.Context, userID uint, messageID string, writer io.Writer) error {
   367		// Get the message to regenerate
   368		message, err := s.repo.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
   369		if err != nil {
   370			return fmt.Errorf("message not found: %w", err)
   371		}
   372	
   373		// Verify ownership
   374		_, err = s.repo.GetConversationByID(message.ConversationID, userID)
   375		if err != nil {
   376			return fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
   377		}
   378	
   379		// Only allow regenerating assistant messages
   380		if message.Role != MessageRoleAssistant {
   381			return fmt.Errorf("can only regenerate assistant messages")
   382		}
   383	
   384		// Get parent message (the user message we're responding to)
   385		if message.ParentMessageID == nil {
   386			return fmt.Errorf("cannot regenerate root message")
   387		}
   388	
   389		// Build message chain from parent user message for context
   390		messageChain, err := s.buildContextChain(*message.ParentMessageID)
   391		if err != nil {
   392			return fmt.Errorf("failed to build context: %w", err)
   393		}
   394	
   395		// Apply token window limiting
   396		contextMessages := s.tokenCounter.BuildContextWindow(messageChain)
   397	
   398		// Convert to AI service format
   399		aiMessages := s.convertToAIMessages(contextMessages)
   400	
   401		// Create new assistant message placeholder (as sibling to the old response)
   402		assistantMessageID := uuid.New().String()
   403		assistantMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   404			MessageID:       assistantMessageID,
   405			ConversationID:  message.ConversationID,
   406			ParentMessageID: message.ParentMessageID, // Same parent as original assistant message
   407			Role:            MessageRoleAssistant,
   408			Content:         "",
   409			Unfinished:      true,
   410		}
   411	
   412		if err := s.repo.UpsertMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
   413			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create assistant message: %w", err)
   414		}
   415	
   416		// Send message_start event
   417		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   418			Type:      "message_start",
   419			MessageID: assistantMessageID,
   420			Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
   421				"parent_message_id": *message.ParentMessageID,
   422			},
   423		})
   424	
   425		// Stream AI response
   426		fullContent := ""
   427		var streamBuffer bytes.Buffer
   428		multiWriter := io.MultiWriter(&streamBuffer, writer)
   429	
   430		customWriter := &sseWriter{writer: multiWriter, onChunk: func(chunk string) {
   431			fullContent += chunk
   432			s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   433				Type:    "content_delta",
   434				Content: chunk,
   435			})
   436		}}
   437	
   438		err = s.aiService.StreamChatCompletion(aiMessages, customWriter)
   439		if err != nil {
   440			s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   441				Type:  "error",
   442				Error: err.Error(),
   443			})
   444			assistantMessage.Error = true
   445			assistantMessage.Unfinished = false
   446			s.repo.UpdateMessage(assistantMessage)
   447			return err
   448		}
   449	
   450		// Update assistant message with complete content
   451		assistantMessage.Content = fullContent
   452		assistantMessage.Unfinished = false
   453		assistantMessage.FinishReason = "stop"
   454		assistantMessage.TokenCount = s.tokenCounter.CountMessageTokens(assistantMessage)
   455	
   456		if err := s.repo.UpdateMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
   457			log.Printf("Warning: Failed to update assistant message: %v", err)
   458		}
   459	
   460		// Send message_end event
   461		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
   462			Type:      "message_end",
   463			MessageID: assistantMessageID,
   464			Content:   fullContent,
   465		})
   466	
   467		return nil
   468	}

   470	// EditMessage allows editing a user message and regenerating the conversation from that point
   471	func (s *ChatService) EditMessage(ctx context.Context, userID uint, messageID string, newContent string, writer io.Writer) error {
   472		// Get the message to edit
   473		message, err := s.repo.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
   474		if err != nil {
   475			return fmt.Errorf("message not found: %w", err)
   476		}
   477	
   478		// Verify ownership
   479		_, err = s.repo.GetConversationByID(message.ConversationID, userID)
   480		if err != nil {
   481			return fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
   482		}
   483	
   484		// Only allow editing user messages
   485		if message.Role != MessageRoleUser {
   486			return fmt.Errorf("can only edit user messages")
   487		}
   488	
   489		// Create new branch with edited content
   490		req := ChatRequest{
   491			ConversationID:  message.ConversationID,
   492			Content:         newContent,
   493			ParentMessageID: message.ParentMessageID,
   494		}
   495	
   496		// Stream new response
   497		return s.StreamChat(ctx, userID, req, writer)
   498	}

   500	// GetConversationHistory returns the main conversation path (no branches)
   501	func (s *ChatService) GetConversationHistory(conversationID uint, userID uint) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
   502		// Verify ownership
   503		_, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
   504		if err != nil {
   505			return nil, fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
   506		}
   507	
   508		// Get latest message
   509		latestMessage, err := s.repo.GetLatestMessageInConversation(conversationID)
   510		if err != nil {
   511			// If no messages exist (empty conversation), return empty array
   512			// This can happen for newly created conversations or after schema reset
   513			return []ConversationMessage{}, nil
   514		}
   515	
   516		log.Printf("[DEBUG] Latest message ID: %s, Role: %s, Content preview: %.50s",
   517			latestMessage.MessageID, latestMessage.Role, latestMessage.Content)
   518	
   519		// Build chain from latest message (optimized version)
   520		chain, err := s.repo.BuildMessageChainOptimized(latestMessage.MessageID)
   521		if err != nil {
   522			return nil, err
   523		}
   524	
   525		log.Printf("[DEBUG] Built chain for conversation %d: %d messages", conversationID, len(chain))
   526		for i, msg := range chain {
   527			log.Printf("[DEBUG]   Message %d: ID=%s, Role=%s, ParentID=%v, Content preview=%.30s",
   528				i, msg.MessageID, msg.Role, msg.ParentMessageID, msg.Content)
   529		}
   530	
   531		return chain, nil
   532	}
   533	
   534	// GetBranchChain returns the complete chain from root to the deepest leaf of a specific branch
   535	// This is used when navigating to a sibling message - we want to show the complete conversation
   536	// path for that branch, not just the sibling message itself
   537	func (s *ChatService) GetBranchChain(messageID string, userID uint) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
   538		// Get the starting message
   539		message, err := s.repo.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
   540		if err != nil {
   541			return nil, fmt.Errorf("message not found: %w", err)
   542		}
   543	
   544		// Verify ownership
   545		_, err = s.repo.GetConversationByID(message.ConversationID, userID)
   546		if err != nil {
   547			return nil, fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
   548		}
   549	
   550		// Find the latest leaf (deepest child) starting from this message
   551		leafMessageID, err := s.repo.GetLatestLeafFromMessage(messageID)
   552		if err != nil {
   553			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find leaf message: %w", err)
   554		}
   555	
   556		// Build complete chain from root to the leaf (optimized version)
   557		chain, err := s.repo.BuildMessageChainOptimized(leafMessageID)
   558		if err != nil {
   559			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build branch chain: %w", err)
   560		}
   561	
   562		return chain, nil
   563	}

    21	// ContinueConversation 继续对话并使用之前消息的上下文
    22	// 现在使用与智能分析相同的逻辑：始终执行MCP搜索并结合历史查询
    23	func (s *Service) ContinueConversation(conversationID uint, userQuery string, writer io.Writer, userID uint, modelLevel thirdparty.ModelLevel) error {
    24		// Determine feature type based on model level
    25		var featureType string
    26		switch modelLevel {
    27		case thirdparty.ModelLevelLow:
    28			featureType = "advanced_search_low"
    29		case thirdparty.ModelLevelMid:
    30			featureType = "advanced_search_mid"
    31		case thirdparty.ModelLevelHigh:
    32			featureType = "advanced_search_high"
    33		default:
    34			return fmt.Errorf("invalid model level: %s", modelLevel)
    35		}
    36	
    37		// Atomically check and increment quota at the beginning
    38		// This ensures quota is enforced even before the API call starts
    39		if err := s.subscriptionService.IncrementUsage(userID, featureType); err != nil {
    40			// Return user-friendly error message
    41			return fmt.Errorf("配额不足：%s", err.Error())
    42		}
    43	
    44		// Get the user message (it should already exist, created by frontend)
    45		// We need to find the latest user message with this query
    46		messages, err := s.repo.GetConversationMessages(conversationID)
    47		if err != nil {
    48			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get messages: %w", err)
    49		}
    50		
    51		var userMessage *ConversationMessage
    52		// Find the latest user message with matching query
    53		for i := len(messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
    54			if messages[i].Role == MessageRoleUser && messages[i].SearchQuery == userQuery {
    55				userMessage = &messages[i]
    56				break
    57			}
    58		}
    59		
    60		if userMessage == nil {
    61			return fmt.Errorf("user message not found")
    62		}
    63		
    64		userMessageID := userMessage.MessageID
    65		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Found user message with ID: %s\n", userMessageID)
    66	
    67		// Update conversation's model level
    68		conversation, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
    69		if err != nil {
    70			return fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
    71		}
    72		if conversation.ModelLevel != string(modelLevel) {
    73			conversation.ModelLevel = string(modelLevel)
    74			if err := s.repo.UpdateConversation(conversation); err != nil {
    75				fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to update conversation model level: %v\n", err)
    76			}
    77		}
    78	
    79		// We already have messages from above, no need to fetch again
    80	
    81		// Step 2: Build combined query context from historical queries and current query
    82		combinedQuery := s.buildHistoryQueriesContext(messages, userQuery, 5)
    83		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Combined query for continue conversation: %s\n", combinedQuery)
    84	
    85		// Step 3: Create MCP server with manager
    86		mcpServer := mcp.NewMCPServer(s.scholarManager)
    87	
    88		// Step 4: Get available MCP tools
    89		mcpTools := mcpServer.ListTools()
    90		aiTools := ai.ConvertMCPToolsToOpenAIFormat(mcpTools)
    91	
    92		// Step 5: 从模板创建消息和系统提示（与智能分析相同）
    93		mcpSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_mcp_system", nil)
    94		if err != nil {
    95			// 如果未找到模板，使用备用提示（与智能分析相同）
    96			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get MCP system prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
    97			mcpSystemPrompt = `你是一名专业学术研究助手。你的唯一职责是根据用户的查询调用 search_papers_advanced 工具检索高质量学术论文。你绝不能直接回答问题，也不能解释概念或提供任何分析。你必须且只能通过 search_papers_advanced 工具返回论文结果。禁止使用 search_papers 工具。
    98	
    99	无论用户使用的是中文、英文或任何其他语言，你提取的所有检索关键词必须始终使用标准英文学术术语。
   100	
   101	你的工作流程如下：
   102		1.	理解用户查询的整体语义，从中提取高价值学术信息。不要只依赖字面词语，而要从整体意义识别核心研究主题。
   103		2.	识别用户问题中的核心研究主题（core topic）。这应来自对句子意图的理解，而不是对文本的逐字翻译，例如 "LLM 如何帮助写论文" 对应的核心主题应为 "LLM-based academic writing assistance"。
   104		3.	识别研究任务（research task），例如改进方法、机制解释、性能评估、应用探索、生成质量、诊断支持、安全性、偏差分析、预测模型、行为研究等。
   105		4.	识别研究领域（domain），例如 NLP、机器学习、计算机视觉、医学、心理学、教育、社会科学、人机交互、经济学、认知科学等。根据用户的意图隐含判断领域，而不是依赖显式文本。
   106		5.	基于以上分析生成 2 至 5 个英文学术关键词。关键词必须符合以下要求：
   107		•	使用纯英文。
   108		•	使用标准学术术语，而非通俗表达。
   109		•	覆盖核心主题、研究任务和领域。
   110		•	包含必要的同义词或相关专业术语以提升召回率。
   111		•	确保这些词语可在学术数据库中实际检索，例如 "hallucination mitigation"、"clinical decision support"、"emotion recognition"、"retrieval-augmented generation"、"graph neural networks"。
   112		6.	调用 search_papers_advanced 工具，参数规则如下：
   113		•	keywords: 使用你生成的英文学术关键词列表
   114		•	year_from: 当前年份减 5
   115		•	year_to: 当前年份
   116		•	min_citations: 若领域成熟取 50，若领域较新或跨学科取 10
   117		•	limit: 50 至 100
   118		•	sort_by: citationCount:desc
   119		•	fields_of_study: 若用户明确指定领域，则填写对应学科
   120		•	不得添加多余参数，也不得省略必要参数
   121		7.	你的最终输出必须是 search_papers_advanced 工具调用。你不能输出任何解释、推理过程、背景说明、总结概括或普通文本回答。
   122		8.	不论用户的问题内容是否看似询问概念、经验、观点、故事、偏见、推理或与学术无关，你都必须将其视为学术检索行为，并调用 search_papers_advanced 工具返回论文。
   123		9.	无论用户的输入使用哪种语言，你提取的学术关键词必须全部是英文。绝不允许出现中文关键词、混合语言关键词或用户原文中未翻译的名词。
   124	
   125	请严格遵守以上全部规则。`
   126		}

   128		systemMessage := ai.ChatMessage{
   129			Role:    "system",
   130			Content: mcpSystemPrompt,
   131		}
   132	
   133		// Use combined query instead of individual context messages
   134		initialMessages := []ai.ChatMessage{
   135			systemMessage,
   136			{
   137				Role:    "user",
   138				Content: combinedQuery,
   139			},
   140		}
   141	
   142		// Step 6: 调用AI获取工具调用（与智能分析相同）
   143		// Use low-level model for tool calling to save cost
   144		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Calling AI with tools, messages count: %d, tools count: %d\n", len(initialMessages), len(aiTools))
   145		toolCallResponse, err := s.aiService.ChatCompletionWithTools(initialMessages, aiTools, "auto", thirdparty.ModelLevelLow)
   146		if err != nil {
   147			fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI tool call failed: %v\n", err)
   148			// Still try fallback search below, don't send error to frontend yet
   149			toolCallResponse = nil
   150		}
   151	
   152		// Step 7: 执行工具调用并收集结果（与智能分析相同）
   153		var allPapers []map[string]interface{}
   154		var totalCount int
   155	
   156		if toolCallResponse != nil && len(toolCallResponse.Choices) > 0 && len(toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls) > 0 {
   157			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Found %d tool calls\n", len(toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls))
   158			for _, toolCall := range toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls {
   159				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call name: %s\n", toolCall.Function.Name)
   160				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call arguments: %s\n", toolCall.Function.Arguments)
   161	
   162				// Support both search_papers and search_papers_advanced
   163				if toolCall.Function.Name == "search_papers" || toolCall.Function.Name == "search_papers_advanced" {
   164					// Parse tool arguments
   165					var args map[string]interface{}
   166					if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(toolCall.Function.Arguments), &args); err != nil {
   167						fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Failed to parse tool arguments: %v\n", err)
   168						continue
   169					}
   170	
   171					// Call MCP tool
   172					toolRequest := mcp.ToolRequest{
   173						Name:      toolCall.Function.Name,
   174						Arguments: args,
   175					}
   176	
   177					papers, total, err := s.executeMCPToolCall(mcpServer, toolRequest)
   178					if err != nil {
   179						fmt.Printf("[ERROR] MCP tool call failed: %v\n", err)
   180						// Don't send technical error to frontend, will handle at the end
   181						continue
   182					}
   183	
   184					allPapers = append(allPapers, papers...)
   185					if total > totalCount {
   186						totalCount = total
   187					}
   188				}
   189			}
   190		}
   191	
   192		// If no papers found, try a simple direct search with combined query
   193		if len(allPapers) == 0 {
   194			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] No papers from tool calls, doing direct search\n")
   195			papers, total, err := s.mcpSearch(combinedQuery, mcpServer)
   196			if err != nil {
   197				fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Direct search failed: %v\n", err)
   198				// Send friendly error message
   199				friendlyError := "网络异常，请稍后重试。如果问题持续，请联系管理员。"
   200				
   201				// Save error message to database with parent_message_id
   202				errorMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   203					ConversationID:    conversationID,
   204					ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID,
   205					Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
   206					Content:           friendlyError,
   207					FollowUpQuestions: "",
   208				}
   209				
   210				if saveErr := s.repo.CreateMessage(errorMessage); saveErr != nil {
   211					fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save error message: %v\n", saveErr)
   212				}
   213				
   214				// Send error to frontend
   215				fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: [ERROR] %s\n\n", friendlyError)
   216				if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
   217					flusher.Flush()
   218				}
   219				
   220				return fmt.Errorf("search failed: %w", err)
   221			}
   222			allPapers = papers
   223			totalCount = total
   224		}
   225	
   226		// Limit papers to top 50 for frontend display and AI analysis
   227		const maxPapersToShow = 50
   228		displayPapers := allPapers
   229		if len(displayPapers) > maxPapersToShow {
   230			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Limiting papers from %d to %d for display and analysis\n", len(allPapers), maxPapersToShow)
   231			displayPapers = displayPapers[:maxPapersToShow]
   232		}
   233	
   234		// Step 8: Send papers to frontend (only top 50)
   235		papersData := map[string]interface{}{
   236			"papers": displayPapers,
   237			"total":  totalCount,  // Still show the real total count
   238		}
   239		papersJSON, _ := json.Marshal(papersData)
   240		fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: [PAPERS]%s\n\n", string(papersJSON))
   241		if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
   242			flusher.Flush()
   243		}
   244	
   245		// Update user message with search results
   246		if err := s.repo.UpdateMessageSearchResultsByID(userMessage.ID, displayPapers, totalCount); err != nil {
   247			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to update user message with search results: %v\n", err)
   248		}
   249	
   250		// Step 9: 生成论文的AI分析（与智能分析相同）
   251		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Formatting %d papers for AI analysis\n", len(displayPapers))
   252		// Use more papers for analysis (up to 30) with shorter abstracts
   253		papersForPrompt := ai.FormatPapersForPromptWithLimit(displayPapers, 30, 200)
   254		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Formatted papers, length: %d characters\n", len(papersForPrompt))
   255	
   256		// 获取分析提示模板（与智能分析相同）
   257		analysisSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_analysis_system", nil)
   258		if err != nil {
   259			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get analysis system prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
   260			analysisSystemPrompt = "你是一名具有深厚研究背景的高级学术分析专家，能够对多篇论文进行深入解读、方法分析、研究发现抽象、理论联系与批判性整合，并以学术写作风格输出高质量分析报告。"
   261		}
   262	
   263		analysisPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_analysis", map[string]string{
   264			"query":  userQuery,
   265			"papers": papersForPrompt,
   266		})
   267		if err != nil {
   268			// 如果未找到模板，使用备用提示（与智能分析相同）
   269			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get analysis prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
   270			analysisPrompt = fmt.Sprintf(`用户查询：%s
   271	找到的论文：%s
   272	
   273	请作为一名具备跨领域知识的资深学术研究专家，对以上论文进行深度整合分析，并给出具有洞察力、逻辑严密、贴合用户问题的学术级解读。
   274	
   275	你的输出必须遵守以下原则：
   276	
   277	一、输出结构不固定
   278	你不需要使用预定义的标题，也不需要每次遵循同样的段落结构。
   279	你应根据用户的查询内容、论文主题性质、研究领域特点，自主决定分析的组织方式。
   280	输出形式可以是：
   281		•	连贯的长文
   282		•	分层的分析段落
   283		•	自定义的小节
   284		•	或混合结构
   285	但必须确保内容严谨、有逻辑、有深度。
   286	
   287	二、分析范围必须覆盖以下六大方面（但无需按固定标题呈现）
   288	你要在整份分析中自然体现以下内容，但你可以自由组织顺序、结构与表达方式：
   289		1.	研究领域背景、核心问题、发展趋势
   290		2.	各论文的方法、技术路线与创新点
   291		3.	论文的发现、结论与学术贡献
   292		4.	实际应用价值、实践意义、产业影响
   293		5.	研究脉络、方法演进、论文之间的逻辑关系
   294		6.	批判性观点、研究不足与未来方向
   295	这些内容要以"自然流畅、连贯而不刻意分段"的方式融入分析。
   296	
   297	三、引用格式必须严格使用以下形式
   298	【引用编号：具体内容】
   299	所有论述性内容必须通过引用论文中的数据、方法、结论或关键描述进行支撑。
   300	每一部分分析都必须至少使用 3–5 个引用标记。
   301	引用必须具体，例如：
   302	【引用3：模型在XXX数据集上提升了12.5%%】
   303	而不是模糊表达。
   304	
   305	四、分析必须基于论文内容本身
   306		•	不得编造不存在的论文结论
   307		•	不得使用无引用支持的判断
   308		•	必须结合论文中的数据、实验结果、方法细节
   309		•	必须保持学术严谨性和批判性
   310	
   311	五、写作风格要求
   312		•	像一位 senior researcher 的深度综述
   313		•	不复述论文摘要，而是给"洞察"与"分析"
   314		•	不空洞、不堆叠句子
   315		•	强调交叉比较、研究关系、理论意义、应用前景
   316		•	在整体布局上做到自然流畅、有张力、有逻辑
   317	
   318	六、最终输出
   319		•	使用 Markdown 格式
   320		•	无固定标题框架
   321		•	完全由你自由组织结构
   322		•	内容必须覆盖上述六大分析面向，但表达形式由你决定
   323		•	引用规范必须严格遵守
   324	
   325	请开始你的深度综合分析。`, userQuery, papersForPrompt)
   326		}
   327	
   328		analysisMessages := []ai.ChatMessage{
   329			{
   330				Role:    "system",
   331				Content: analysisSystemPrompt,
   332			},
   333			{
   334				Role:    "user",
   335				Content: analysisPrompt,
   336			},
   337		}
   338	
   339		// Apply context truncation to ensure we stay within 128K limit
   340		const max128K = 128000 * 4 // Roughly 128K tokens * 4 chars per token
   341		analysisMessages = ai.TruncateContextForLimit(analysisMessages, max128K)
   342	
   343		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] About to call StreamChatCompletionAndCollectWithLevel, modelLevel: %s, messages count: %d, prompt length: %d\n",
   344			modelLevel, len(analysisMessages), len(analysisPrompt))
   345	
   346		// Step 10: Stream AI response and collect full content using specified model level
   347		fullContent, err := s.aiService.StreamChatCompletionAndCollectWithLevel(analysisMessages, writer, modelLevel)
   348		if err != nil {
   349			// 生成友好的错误消息
   350			friendlyError := "网络异常，请稍后重试。如果问题持续，请联系管理员。"
   351			fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI analysis failed: %v\n", err)
   352	
   353			// 将错误消息保存为 assistant 消息，以便历史记录中显示
   354			errorMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   355				ConversationID:    conversationID,
   356				ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID,
   357				Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
   358				Content:           friendlyError,
   359				FollowUpQuestions: "",
   360			}
   361	
   362			if saveErr := s.repo.CreateMessage(errorMessage); saveErr != nil {
   363				fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save error message: %v\n", saveErr)
   364			}
   365	
   366			// 通过流式接口发送错误消息
   367			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: %s\n\n", friendlyError)
   368			if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
   369				flusher.Flush()
   370			}
   371	
   372			return fmt.Errorf("AI analysis failed: %w", err)
   373		}
   374	
   375		// Note: Usage was already incremented at the beginning
   376	
   377		// Step 11: Clear old follow-up questions from previous messages in this conversation
   378		if err := s.repo.ClearOldFollowUpQuestions(conversationID); err != nil {
   379			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to clear old follow-up questions: %v\n", err)
   380		}
   381	
   382		// 保存助手消息到对话中（包含parent_message_id）
   383		// 后续问题将通过单独的端点按需生成（与智能分析相同）
   384		assistantMessage := &ConversationMessage{
   385			ConversationID:    conversationID,
   386			ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID, // Link to user message
   387			Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
   388			Content:           fullContent,
   389			FollowUpQuestions: "", // Will be generated on-demand
   390		}
   391	
   392		if err := s.repo.CreateMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
   393			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to save assistant message: %v\n", err)
   394		}
   395	
   396		return nil
   397	}

   399	// buildContextMessages builds context from recent conversation messages
   400	// It limits the number of rounds and summarizes paper information to control token count
   401	func (s *Service) buildContextMessages(messages []ConversationMessage, maxRounds int) []ai.ChatMessage {
   402		var contextMessages []ai.ChatMessage
   403	
   404		// Calculate how many messages to include (maxRounds * 2 for user + assistant pairs)
   405		startIdx := 0
   406		if len(messages) > maxRounds*2 {
   407			startIdx = len(messages) - maxRounds*2
   408		}
   409	
   410		for i := startIdx; i < len(messages); i++ {
   411			msg := messages[i]
   412			isLastMessage := (i == len(messages)-1)
   413	
   414			// Build message content
   415			var content string
   416			if msg.Role == MessageRoleUser {
   417				content = msg.Content
   418	
   419				// Add search results summary if available
   420				if len(msg.SearchResults) > 0 {
   421					// For older messages, use fewer papers; for recent messages, keep more
   422					maxPapersInContext := 5
   423					if isLastMessage || i >= len(messages)-2 {
   424						maxPapersInContext = 10 // Keep more papers for recent messages
   425					}
   426					papersSummary := s.summarizePapers(msg.SearchResults, maxPapersInContext)
   427					content += fmt.Sprintf("\n\n[搜索结果摘要：找到 %d 篇论文]\n%s", msg.SearchResultsTotal, papersSummary)
   428				}
   429			} else {
   430				// For assistant messages, truncate if too long (keep first 1000 chars)
   431				content = msg.Content
   432				if len(content) > 1000 {
   433					content = content[:1000] + "..."
   434				}
   435			}
   436	
   437			contextMessages = append(contextMessages, ai.ChatMessage{
   438				Role:    string(msg.Role),
   439				Content: content,
   440			})
   441		}
   442	
   443		return contextMessages
   444	}
   445	
   446	// summarizePapers creates a brief summary of papers for context
   447	func (s *Service) summarizePapers(papers []map[string]interface{}, maxPapers int) string {
   448		var summaries []string
   449	
   450		count := len(papers)
   451		if count > maxPapers {
   452			count = maxPapers
   453		}
   454	
   455		for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
   456			paper := papers[i]
   457			title, _ := paper["title"].(string)
   458			abstract, _ := paper["abstract"].(string)
   459	
   460			// Truncate abstract to first 200 characters
   461			if len(abstract) > 200 {
   462				abstract = abstract[:200] + "..."
   463			}
   464	
   465			summary := fmt.Sprintf("%d. %s\n   摘要：%s", i+1, title, abstract)
   466			summaries = append(summaries, summary)
   467		}
   468	
   469		return strings.Join(summaries, "\n\n")
   470	}
   471	
   472	// buildHistoryQueriesContext extracts historical user queries for context
   473	// Returns a combined query that includes both current query and historical context
   474	func (s *Service) buildHistoryQueriesContext(messages []ConversationMessage, currentQuery string, maxRounds int) string {
   475		var historyQueries []string
   476	
   477		// Calculate how many messages to include
   478		startIdx := 0
   479		if len(messages) > maxRounds*2 {
   480			startIdx = len(messages) - maxRounds*2
   481		}
   482	
   483		// Extract user queries from history
   484		for i := startIdx; i < len(messages); i++ {
   485			msg := messages[i]
   486			if msg.Role == MessageRoleUser {
   487				// Use SearchQuery if available, otherwise use Content
   488				query := msg.SearchQuery
   489				if query == "" {
   490					query = msg.Content
   491				}
   492				if query != "" {
   493					historyQueries = append(historyQueries, query)
   494				}
   495			}
   496		}
   497	
   498		// If no history, return current query
   499		if len(historyQueries) == 0 {
   500			return currentQuery
   501		}
   502	
   503		// Build context string
   504		var contextBuilder strings.Builder
   505		contextBuilder.WriteString("历史对话中的提问：\n")
   506		for i, q := range historyQueries {
   507			contextBuilder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%d. %s\n", i+1, q))
   508		}
   509		contextBuilder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n当前提问：%s", currentQuery))
   510		
   511		return contextBuilder.String()
   512	}
