    10	import (
    11		"strings"
    12		"unicode"
    13	)
    14	
    15	// TokenCounter provides methods for counting tokens in messages
    16	// This is a simplified implementation. For production, consider using tiktoken or similar libraries
    17	type TokenCounter struct {
    18		maxContextTokens int
    19	}
    20	
    21	// NewTokenCounter creates a new token counter with a maximum context window
    22	func NewTokenCounter(maxContextTokens int) *TokenCounter {
    23		return &TokenCounter{
    24			maxContextTokens: maxContextTokens,
    25		}
    26	}
    27	
    28	// EstimateTokenCount estimates the number of tokens in a text
    29	// Simplified approximation: ~4 characters per token for English text
    30	// For more accurate counting, integrate tiktoken or similar library
    31	func (tc *TokenCounter) EstimateTokenCount(text string) int {
    32		if text == "" {
    33			return 0
    34		}
    35	
    36		// Count words as a more accurate baseline
    37		words := strings.FieldsFunc(text, func(r rune) bool {
    38			return unicode.IsSpace(r) || unicode.IsPunct(r)
    39		})
    40	
    41		// Approximate: 1.3 tokens per word on average
    42		// Add some overhead for punctuation and special characters
    43		tokenCount := int(float64(len(words)) * 1.3)
    44	
    45		// Minimum 1 token for non-empty text
    46		if tokenCount == 0 && len(text) > 0 {
    47			tokenCount = 1
    48		}
    49	
    50		return tokenCount
    51	}
    52	
    53	// CountMessageTokens counts tokens for a single message including role
    54	func (tc *TokenCounter) CountMessageTokens(message *ConversationMessage) int {
    55		// Count content tokens
    56		contentTokens := tc.EstimateTokenCount(message.Content)
    57	
    58		// Add overhead for message structure (role, formatting, etc.)
    59		// Typical overhead: ~4 tokens per message for formatting
    60		overhead := 4
    61	
    62		return contentTokens + overhead
    63	}
    64	
    65	// GetMessagesWithinTokenLimit returns messages that fit within the token limit
    66	// Messages are processed from newest to oldest, maintaining context window
    67	func (tc *TokenCounter) GetMessagesWithinTokenLimit(messages []ConversationMessage, tokenLimit int) []ConversationMessage {
    68		if len(messages) == 0 {
    69			return messages
    70		}
    71	
    72		var result []ConversationMessage
    73		totalTokens := 0
    74	
    75		// Process messages from newest to oldest
    76		for i := len(messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
    77			message := messages[i]
    78	
    79			// Calculate or use cached token count
    80			if message.TokenCount == 0 {
    81				message.TokenCount = tc.CountMessageTokens(&message)
    82			}
    83	
    84			// Check if adding this message would exceed limit
    85			if totalTokens+message.TokenCount > tokenLimit {
    86				break
    87			}
    88	
    89			totalTokens += message.TokenCount
    90			// Prepend to maintain chronological order
    91			result = append([]ConversationMessage{message}, result...)
    92		}
    93	
    94		return result
    95	}
    96	
    97	// BuildContextWindow builds a context window from a message chain
    98	// Applies token limiting while maintaining the most recent context
    99	func (tc *TokenCounter) BuildContextWindow(chain []ConversationMessage) []ConversationMessage {
   100		return tc.GetMessagesWithinTokenLimit(chain, tc.maxContextTokens)
   101	}
   102	
   103	// ShouldTruncateContext determines if the context needs truncation
   104	func (tc *TokenCounter) ShouldTruncateContext(messages []ConversationMessage) bool {
   105		totalTokens := 0
   106		for i := range messages {
   107			if messages[i].TokenCount == 0 {
   108				messages[i].TokenCount = tc.CountMessageTokens(&messages[i])
   109			}
   110			totalTokens += messages[i].TokenCount
   111		}
   112		return totalTokens > tc.maxContextTokens
   113	}
   114	
   115	// GetTotalTokens calculates total tokens for all messages
   116	func (tc *TokenCounter) GetTotalTokens(messages []ConversationMessage) int {
   117		totalTokens := 0
   118		for i := range messages {
   119			if messages[i].TokenCount == 0 {
   120				messages[i].TokenCount = tc.CountMessageTokens(&messages[i])
   121			}
   122			totalTokens += messages[i].TokenCount
   123		}
   124		return totalTokens
   125	}
   126	
   127	// CalculateAndCacheTokens calculates token counts for messages and caches them
   128	func (tc *TokenCounter) CalculateAndCacheTokens(messages []ConversationMessage) {
   129		for i := range messages {
   130			if messages[i].TokenCount == 0 {
   131				messages[i].TokenCount = tc.CountMessageTokens(&messages[i])
   132			}
   133		}
   134	}

    23	func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
    24		return &Handler{service: service}

    31	// CreateTemplate 创建折扣券模板
    32	func (h *Handler) CreateTemplate(c *gin.Context) {
    33		var req CreateCouponTemplateRequest
    34		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    35			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
    36			return
    37		}
    38	
    39		// 获取管理员ID
    40		adminIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    41		if !exists {
    42			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
    43			return
    44		}
    45		adminID := adminIDInterface.(uint)
    46	
    47		template, err := h.service.CreateTemplate(&req, uint64(adminID))
    48		if err != nil {
    49			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
    50			return
    51		}
    52	
    53		utils.Success(c, template)
    54	}

    56	// UpdateTemplate 更新折扣券模板
    57	func (h *Handler) UpdateTemplate(c *gin.Context) {
    58		id, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 64)
    59		if err != nil {
    60			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid template ID")
    61			return
    62		}
    63	
    64		var req UpdateCouponTemplateRequest
    65		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    66			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
    67			return
    68		}
    69	
    70		if err := h.service.UpdateTemplate(id, &req); err != nil {
    71			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
    72			return
    73		}
    74	
    75		utils.Success(c, gin.H{"message": "Template updated successfully"})
    76	}

    95	// ListTemplates 获取模板列表
    96	func (h *Handler) ListTemplates(c *gin.Context) {
    97		page, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page", "1"))
    98		pageSize, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page_size", "20"))
    99	
   100		// 可选过滤参数
   101		var status *TemplateStatus
   102		if s := c.Query("status"); s != "" {
   103			templateStatus := TemplateStatus(s)
   104			status = &templateStatus
   105		}
   106	
   107		var distributionType *DistributionType
   108		if dt := c.Query("distribution_type"); dt != "" {
   109			distType := DistributionType(dt)
   110			distributionType = &distType
   111		}
   112	
   113		templates, total, err := h.service.ListTemplates(status, distributionType, page, pageSize)
   114		if err != nil {
   115			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
   116			return
   117		}
   118	
   119		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
   120			"templates": templates,
   121			"total":     total,
   122			"page":      page,
   123			"page_size": pageSize,
   124		})
   125	}

   175	// AdminListAllDistributedCoupons 管理员获取所有已发放折扣券列表
   176	func (h *Handler) AdminListAllDistributedCoupons(c *gin.Context) {
   177		page, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page", "1"))
   178		pageSize, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page_size", "20"))
   179	
   180		// 可选过滤参数
   181		var templateID *uint64
   182		if tidStr := c.Query("template_id"); tidStr != "" {
   183			tid, err := strconv.ParseUint(tidStr, 10, 64)
   184			if err == nil {
   185				templateID = &tid
   186			}
   187		}
   188	
   189		var status *CouponStatus
   190		if s := c.Query("status"); s != "" {
   191			couponStatus := CouponStatus(s)
   192			status = &couponStatus
   193		}
   194	
   195		userEmail := c.Query("user_email")
   196	
   197		coupons, total, err := h.service.AdminListAllDistributedCoupons(templateID, status, userEmail, page, pageSize)
   198		if err != nil {
   199			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
   200			return
   201		}
   202	
   203		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
   204			"coupons":   coupons,
   205			"total":     total,
   206			"page":      page,
   207			"page_size": pageSize,
   208		})
   209	}

   356	// CalculateDiscount 计算折扣（预览）
   357	func (h *Handler) CalculateDiscount(c *gin.Context) {
   358		userIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   359		if !exists {
   360			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
   361			return
   362		}
   363		userID := userIDInterface.(uint)
   364	
   365		couponID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Query("coupon_id"), 10, 64)
   366		if err != nil {
   367			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid coupon ID")
   368			return
   369		}
   370	
   371		amount, err := strconv.ParseFloat(c.Query("amount"), 64)
   372		if err != nil {
   373			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid amount")
   374			return
   375		}
   376	
   377		// 获取折扣券信息
   378		coupons, _, err := h.service.GetUserCoupons(uint64(userID), nil, 1, 1000)
   379		if err != nil {
   380			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
   381			return
   382		}
   383	
   384		var targetCoupon *UserCoupon
   385		for _, coupon := range coupons {
   386			if coupon.ID == couponID {
   387				targetCoupon = coupon
   388				break
   389			}
   390		}
   391	
   392		if targetCoupon == nil {
   393			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusNotFound, "Coupon not found")
   394			return
   395		}
   396	
   397		// 验证并计算折扣
   398		if targetCoupon.Status != CouponStatusUnused {
   399			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Coupon is not available")
   400			return
   401		}
   402	
   403		if !IsValidTime(targetCoupon.ValidFrom, targetCoupon.ValidUntil) {
   404			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Coupon has expired")
   405			return
   406		}
   407	
   408		if !IsValidAmount(targetCoupon.MinPurchaseAmount, amount) {
   409			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Amount does not meet minimum requirement")
   410			return
   411		}
   412	
   413		discountAmount := CalculateDiscount(
   414			DiscountType(targetCoupon.DiscountType),
   415			targetCoupon.DiscountValue,
   416			amount,
   417		)
   418	
   419		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
   420			"original_amount": amount,
   421			"discount_amount": discountAmount,
   422			"final_amount":    amount - discountAmount,
   423			"coupon":          targetCoupon,
   424		})
   425	}

    15	
    16	// DiscountType 折扣类型
    17	type DiscountType string
    18	
    19	const (
    20		DiscountTypePercentage DiscountType = "percentage" // 百分比折扣
    21		DiscountTypeFixed      DiscountType = "fixed"      // 固定金额
    22		DiscountTypePriceOff   DiscountType = "price_off"  // 减免金额
    23	)

    69	// JSONArray 用于处理JSON数组
    70	type JSONArray []interface{}
    71	
    72	// Value 实现 driver.Valuer 接口
    73	func (j JSONArray) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
    74		if j == nil {
    75			return nil, nil
    76		}
    77		return json.Marshal(j)
    78	}
    79	
    80	// Scan 实现 sql.Scanner 接口
    81	func (j *JSONArray) Scan(value interface{}) error {
    82		if value == nil {
    83			*j = nil
    84			return nil
    85		}
    86		bytes, ok := value.([]byte)
    87		if !ok {
    88			return nil
    89		}
    90		return json.Unmarshal(bytes, j)
    91	}
    92	
    93	// JSONMap 用于处理JSON对象
    94	type JSONMap map[string]interface{}
    95	
    96	// Value 实现 driver.Valuer 接口
    97	func (j JSONMap) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
    98		if j == nil {
    99			return nil, nil
   100		}
   101		return json.Marshal(j)
   102	}
   103	
   104	// Scan 实现 sql.Scanner 接口
   105	func (j *JSONMap) Scan(value interface{}) error {
   106		if value == nil {
   107			*j = nil
   108			return nil
   109		}
   110		bytes, ok := value.([]byte)
   111		if !ok {
   112			return nil
   113		}
   114		return json.Unmarshal(bytes, j)
   115	}

    10	import (
    11		"fmt"

    16	
    17	type Repository struct {
    18		db *gorm.DB
    19	}
    20	
    21	func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
    22		return &Repository{db: db}
    23	}
    24	
    25	// ============================================
    26	// 折扣券模板相关
    27	// ============================================
    28	
    29	// CreateTemplate 创建折扣券模板
    30	func (r *Repository) CreateTemplate(template *CouponTemplate) error {
    31		return r.db.Create(template).Error
    32	}
    33	
    34	// GetTemplateByID 通过ID获取模板
    35	func (r *Repository) GetTemplateByID(id uint64) (*CouponTemplate, error) {
    36		var template CouponTemplate
    37		err := r.db.Where("id = ?", id).First(&template).Error
    38		if err != nil {
    39			return nil, err
    40		}
    41		return &template, nil
    42	}
    43	
    44	// GetTemplateByCode 通过代码获取模板
    45	func (r *Repository) GetTemplateByCode(code string) (*CouponTemplate, error) {
    46		var template CouponTemplate
    47		err := r.db.Where("code = ?", code).First(&template).Error
    48		if err != nil {
    49			return nil, err
    50		}
    51		return &template, nil
    52	}
    53	
    54	// GetActiveTemplateByCode 获取活动状态的模板
    55	func (r *Repository) GetActiveTemplateByCode(code string) (*CouponTemplate, error) {
    56		var template CouponTemplate
    57		err := r.db.Where("code = ? AND status = ?", code, TemplateStatusActive).First(&template).Error
    58		if err != nil {
    59			return nil, err
    60		}
    61		return &template, nil
    62	}
    63	
    64	// UpdateTemplate 更新模板
    65	func (r *Repository) UpdateTemplate(id uint64, updates map[string]interface{}) error {
    66		return r.db.Model(&CouponTemplate{}).Where("id = ?", id).Updates(updates).Error
    67	}
    68	
    69	// ListTemplates 获取模板列表
    70	func (r *Repository) ListTemplates(status *TemplateStatus, distributionType *DistributionType, offset, limit int) ([]*CouponTemplate, int64, error) {
    71		query := r.db.Model(&CouponTemplate{})
    72	
    73		if status != nil {
    74			query = query.Where("status = ?", *status)
    75		}
    76		if distributionType != nil {
    77			query = query.Where("distribution_type = ?", *distributionType)
    78		}
    79	
    80		var total int64
    81		if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
    82			return nil, 0, err
    83		}
    84	
    85		var templates []*CouponTemplate
    86		err := query.Order("created_at DESC").Offset(offset).Limit(limit).Find(&templates).Error
    87		return templates, total, err
    88	}
    89	
    90	// GetAutoDistributionTemplates 获取自动发放的模板
    91	func (r *Repository) GetAutoDistributionTemplates(distributionType DistributionType) ([]*CouponTemplate, error) {
    92		var templates []*CouponTemplate
    93		err := r.db.Where("distribution_type = ? AND status = ?", distributionType, TemplateStatusActive).
    94			Find(&templates).Error
    95		return templates, err
    96	}
    97	
    98	// DeleteTemplate 删除模板（软删除）
    99	func (r *Repository) DeleteTemplate(id uint64) error {
   100		// 检查是否有用户已经领取了该模板的券
   101		var userCouponCount int64
   102		if err := r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).Where("template_id = ?", id).Count(&userCouponCount).Error; err != nil {
   103			return err
   104		}
   105		if userCouponCount > 0 {
   106			return fmt.Errorf("无法删除：该折扣券已发放给 %d 位用户，请先暂停该折扣券", userCouponCount)
   107		}
   108	
   109		// 检查是否有批次发放记录关联
   110		var batchCount int64
   111		if err := r.db.Model(&CouponBatch{}).Where("template_id = ?", id).Count(&batchCount).Error; err != nil {
   112			return err
   113		}
   114		if batchCount > 0 {
   115			return fmt.Errorf("无法删除：该折扣券有 %d 个批次发放记录，请先删除相关批次", batchCount)
   116		}
   117	
   118		return r.db.Delete(&CouponTemplate{}, id).Error
   119	}

   203	// GetAvailableCoupons 获取用户可用的折扣券
   204	func (r *Repository) GetAvailableCoupons(userID uint64, amount float64) ([]*UserCoupon, error) {
   205		now := time.Now()
   206		var coupons []*UserCoupon
   207	
   208		err := r.db.Preload("Template").
   209			Joins("JOIN coupon_templates ON user_coupons.template_id = coupon_templates.id").
   210			Where("user_coupons.user_id = ? AND user_coupons.status = ? AND user_coupons.valid_from <= ? AND user_coupons.valid_until >= ?",
   211				userID, CouponStatusUnused, now, now).
   212			Where("user_coupons.min_purchase_amount <= ?", amount).
   213			Where("coupon_templates.status = ?", TemplateStatusActive).
   214			Order("user_coupons.discount_value DESC").
   215			Find(&coupons).Error
   216	
   217		return coupons, err
   218	}

   225	// UseCoupon 使用折扣券 (accepts both unused and reserved status)
   226	func (r *Repository) UseCoupon(couponID uint64, orderID uint64) error {
   227		now := time.Now()
   228		return r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).
   229			Where("id = ? AND status IN (?)", couponID, []CouponStatus{CouponStatusUnused, CouponStatusReserved}).
   230			Updates(map[string]interface{}{
   231				"status":        CouponStatusUsed,
   232				"used_at":       now,
   233				"used_order_id": orderID,
   234			}).Error
   235	}

   237	// ExpireCoupons 过期折扣券
   238	func (r *Repository) ExpireCoupons() (int64, error) {
   239		now := time.Now()
   240		result := r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).
   241			Where("status = ? AND valid_until < ?", CouponStatusUnused, now).
   242			Update("status", CouponStatusExpired)
   243		return result.RowsAffected, result.Error
   244	}

   403	// GetStatistics 获取统计信息
   404	func (r *Repository) GetStatistics() (*CouponStatistics, error) {
   405		var stats CouponStatistics
   406	
   407		// 统计模板数量
   408		r.db.Model(&CouponTemplate{}).Count(&stats.TotalTemplates)
   409		r.db.Model(&CouponTemplate{}).Where("status = ?", TemplateStatusActive).Count(&stats.ActiveTemplates)
   410	
   411		// 统计发放和使用数量
   412		r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).Count(&stats.TotalDistributed)
   413		r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).Where("status = ?", CouponStatusUsed).Count(&stats.TotalUsed)
   414	
   415		// 计算使用率
   416		if stats.TotalDistributed > 0 {
   417			stats.UsageRate = float64(stats.TotalUsed) / float64(stats.TotalDistributed) * 100
   418		}
   419	
   420		// 统计折扣总金额
   421		var discountAmount float64
   422		r.db.Model(&CouponUsageLog{}).Where("status = ?", "confirmed").
   423			Select("COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0)").Scan(&discountAmount)
   424		stats.TotalDiscountAmount = discountAmount
   425	
   426		return &stats, nil
   427	}

   429	// Transaction 执行事务
   430	func (r *Repository) Transaction(fn func(*Repository) error) error {
   431		return r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
   432			txRepo := &Repository{db: tx}
   433			return fn(txRepo)
   434		})
   435	}

     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

     7	
     8	package coupon
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"log"
    12		"time"
    13	)
    14	
    15	// Scheduler 定时任务调度器
    16	type Scheduler struct {
    17		service *Service
    18		stopCh  chan struct{}
    19	}
    20	
    21	// NewScheduler 创建新的调度器
    22	func NewScheduler(service *Service) *Scheduler {
    23		return &Scheduler{
    24			service: service,
    25			stopCh:  make(chan struct{}),
    26		}
    27	}
    28	
    29	// Start 启动调度器
    30	func (s *Scheduler) Start() {
    31		log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] Starting coupon scheduler...")
    32	
    33		// 启动过期券清理任务（每小时执行一次）
    34		go s.runExpireCouponsTask()
    35	
    36		// 启动月度优惠券发放任务（每天检查一次）
    37		go s.runMonthlyDistributionTask()
    38	
    39		// 启动定期批次执行任务（每10分钟检查一次）
    40		go s.runScheduledBatchTask()
    41	
    42		log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] Coupon scheduler started successfully")
    43	}
    44	
    45	// Stop 停止调度器
    46	func (s *Scheduler) Stop() {
    47		close(s.stopCh)
    48		log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] Coupon scheduler stopped")
    49	}
    50	
    51	// runExpireCouponsTask 运行过期券清理任务
    52	func (s *Scheduler) runExpireCouponsTask() {
    53		ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Hour)
    54		defer ticker.Stop()
    55	
    56		// 立即执行一次
    57		s.executeExpireCoupons()
    58	
    59		for {
    60			select {
    61			case <-ticker.C:
    62				s.executeExpireCoupons()
    63			case <-s.stopCh:
    64				return
    65			}
    66		}
    67	}
    68	
    69	// executeExpireCoupons 执行过期券清理
    70	func (s *Scheduler) executeExpireCoupons() {
    71		count, err := s.service.ExpireOutdatedCoupons()
    72		if err != nil {
    73			log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to expire coupons: %v", err)
    74			return
    75		}
    76		if count > 0 {
    77			log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Expired %d coupons", count)
    78		}
    79	}
    80	
    81	// runMonthlyDistributionTask 运行月度优惠券发放任务
    82	func (s *Scheduler) runMonthlyDistributionTask() {
    83		ticker := time.NewTicker(24 * time.Hour)
    84		defer ticker.Stop()
    85	
    86		// 立即执行一次检查
    87		s.executeMonthlyDistribution()
    88	
    89		for {
    90			select {
    91			case <-ticker.C:
    92				s.executeMonthlyDistribution()
    93			case <-s.stopCh:
    94				return
    95			}
    96		}
    97	}
    98	
    99	// executeMonthlyDistribution 执行月度优惠券发放
   100	func (s *Scheduler) executeMonthlyDistribution() {
   101		now := time.Now()
   102	
   103		// 检查是否是每月1号
   104		if now.Day() != 1 {
   105			return
   106		}
   107	
   108		log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] Executing monthly coupon distribution...")
   109	
   110		// 获取所有标记为月度自动发放的模板
   111		templates, err := s.service.GetAutoDistributionTemplates("monthly")
   112		if err != nil {
   113			log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to get monthly templates: %v", err)
   114			return
   115		}
   116	
   117		if len(templates) == 0 {
   118			log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] No monthly distribution templates found")
   119			return
   120		}
   121	
   122		// 为每个模板创建批次并执行
   123		for _, template := range templates {
   124			if template.Status != TemplateStatusActive {
   125				continue
   126			}
   127	
   128			// 创建月度发放批次
   129			batchName := time.Now().Format("2006年1月月度优惠券")
   130			batch, err := s.service.CreateBatch(
   131				template.ID,
   132				batchName,
   133				"all", // 发放给所有用户
   134				0,     // 不限制数量
   135				0,     // 系统自动创建
   136			)
   137			if err != nil {
   138				log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to create monthly batch for template %d: %v", template.ID, err)
   139				continue
   140			}
   141	
   142			// 执行批次发放
   143			if err := s.service.ExecuteBatch(batch.ID); err != nil {
   144				log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to execute monthly batch %d: %v", batch.ID, err)
   145				continue
   146			}
   147	
   148			log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Successfully distributed monthly coupons for template %s (batch: %d)", template.Name, batch.ID)
   149		}
   150	}
   151	
   152	// runScheduledBatchTask 运行定时批次任务
   153	func (s *Scheduler) runScheduledBatchTask() {
   154		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Minute)
   155		defer ticker.Stop()
   156	
   157		// 立即执行一次
   158		s.executeScheduledBatches()
   159	
   160		for {
   161			select {
   162			case <-ticker.C:
   163				s.executeScheduledBatches()
   164			case <-s.stopCh:
   165				return
   166			}
   167		}
   168	}
   169	
   170	// executeScheduledBatches 执行定时批次
   171	func (s *Scheduler) executeScheduledBatches() {
   172		batches, err := s.service.GetScheduledBatches()
   173		if err != nil {
   174			log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to get scheduled batches: %v", err)
   175			return
   176		}
   177	
   178		now := time.Now()
   179		for _, batch := range batches {
   180			// 检查是否到达执行时间
   181			if batch.ScheduledAt != nil && batch.ScheduledAt.Before(now) {
   182				log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Executing scheduled batch %d (%s)", batch.ID, batch.Name)
   183	
   184				if err := s.service.ExecuteBatch(batch.ID); err != nil {
   185					log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to execute scheduled batch %d: %v", batch.ID, err)
   186				} else {
   187					log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Successfully executed scheduled batch %d", batch.ID)
   188				}
   189			}
   190		}
   191	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     5	// All Rights Reserved.
     6	// ============================================================================
     7	
     8	package coupon
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"errors"
    12		"fmt"
    13		"time"
    14	
    15		"scholar-backend/internal/user"
    16	
    17		"github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
    18		"gorm.io/gorm"
    19	)
    20	
    21	type Service struct {
    22		repo       *Repository
    23		userRepo   *user.Repository
    24		cache      *redis.Client
    25		baseURL    string // 用于生成邀请链接
    26	}
    27	
    28	func NewService(db *gorm.DB, userRepo *user.Repository, cache *redis.Client, baseURL string) *Service {
    29		return &Service{
    30			repo:     NewRepository(db),
    31			userRepo: userRepo,
    32			cache:    cache,
    33			baseURL:  baseURL,
    34		}
    35	}

    41	// CreateTemplate 创建折扣券模板
    42	func (s *Service) CreateTemplate(req *CreateCouponTemplateRequest, createdBy uint64) (*CouponTemplate, error) {
    43		// 如果没有提供编码，自动生成
    44		code := req.Code
    45		if code == "" {
    46			code = GenerateTemplateCode(req.DistributionType)
    47			// 确保生成的编码不重复
    48			for {
    49				existingTemplate, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByCode(code)
    50				if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
    51					return nil, err
    52				}
    53				if existingTemplate == nil {
    54					break // 编码可用
    55				}
    56				// 编码已存在，重新生成
    57				code = GenerateTemplateCode(req.DistributionType)
    58			}
    59		} else {
    60			// 如果提供了编码，检查是否已存在
    61			existingTemplate, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByCode(code)
    62			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
    63				return nil, err
    64			}
    65			if existingTemplate != nil {
    66				return nil, errors.New("template code already exists")
    67			}
    68		}
    69	
    70		template := &CouponTemplate{
    71			Code:              code,
    72			Name:              req.Name,
    73			Description:       req.Description,
    74			Type:              req.Type,
    75			DiscountValue:     req.DiscountValue,
    76			MinPurchaseAmount: req.MinPurchaseAmount,
    77			DistributionType:  req.DistributionType,
    78			ValidDays:         req.ValidDays,
    79			FixedValidStart:   req.FixedValidStart,
    80			FixedValidEnd:     req.FixedValidEnd,
    81			MaxUsageTotal:     req.MaxUsageTotal,
    82			MaxUsagePerUser:   req.MaxUsagePerUser,
    83			FirstPurchaseOnly: req.FirstPurchaseOnly,
    84			NewUserOnly:       req.NewUserOnly,
    85			IsInviteCoupon:    req.IsInviteCoupon,
    86			Status:            TemplateStatusDraft,
    87			Priority:          0,
    88			CreatedBy:         &createdBy,
    89		}
    90	
    91		// 处理JSON字段
    92		if len(req.ApplicablePlans) > 0 {
    93			plans := make(JSONArray, len(req.ApplicablePlans))
    94			for i, plan := range req.ApplicablePlans {
    95				plans[i] = plan
    96			}
    97			template.ApplicablePlans = plans
    98		}
    99	
   100		if len(req.ApplicableProducts) > 0 {
   101			products := make(JSONArray, len(req.ApplicableProducts))
   102			for i, product := range req.ApplicableProducts {
   103				products[i] = product
   104			}
   105			template.ApplicableProducts = products
   106		}
   107	
   108		if req.InviterBenefit != nil {
   109			template.InviterBenefit = JSONMap(req.InviterBenefit)
   110		}
   111	
   112		if err := s.repo.CreateTemplate(template); err != nil {
   113			return nil, err
   114		}
   115	
   116		return template, nil
   117	}
   118	
   119	// UpdateTemplate 更新模板
   120	func (s *Service) UpdateTemplate(id uint64, req *UpdateCouponTemplateRequest) error {
   121		// 获取原模板
   122		template, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByID(id)
   123		if err != nil {
   124			return err
   125		}
   126	
   127		// 构建更新字段
   128		updates := make(map[string]interface{})
   129		if req.Name != "" {
   130			updates["name"] = req.Name
   131		}
   132		if req.Description != "" {
   133			updates["description"] = req.Description
   134		}
   135		updates["min_purchase_amount"] = req.MinPurchaseAmount
   136		updates["valid_days"] = req.ValidDays
   137		updates["max_usage_per_user"] = req.MaxUsagePerUser
   138		updates["first_purchase_only"] = req.FirstPurchaseOnly
   139		updates["new_user_only"] = req.NewUserOnly
   140		updates["priority"] = req.Priority
   141	
   142		if req.Status != "" {
   143			// 状态变更验证
   144			if template.Status == TemplateStatusExpired {
   145				return errors.New("cannot update expired template")
   146			}
   147			updates["status"] = req.Status
   148		}
   149	
   150		if req.FixedValidStart != nil {
   151			updates["fixed_valid_start"] = req.FixedValidStart
   152		}
   153		if req.FixedValidEnd != nil {
   154			updates["fixed_valid_end"] = req.FixedValidEnd
   155		}
   156		if req.MaxUsageTotal != nil {
   157			updates["max_usage_total"] = req.MaxUsageTotal
   158		}
   159	
   160		// 处理JSON字段
   161		if req.ApplicablePlans != nil {
   162			plans := make(JSONArray, len(req.ApplicablePlans))
   163			for i, plan := range req.ApplicablePlans {
   164				plans[i] = plan
   165			}
   166			updates["applicable_plans"] = plans
   167		}
   168	
   169		if req.ApplicableProducts != nil {
   170			products := make(JSONArray, len(req.ApplicableProducts))
   171			for i, product := range req.ApplicableProducts {
   172				products[i] = product
   173			}
   174			updates["applicable_products"] = products
   175		}
   176	
   177		return s.repo.UpdateTemplate(id, updates)
   178	}

   213			page = 1
   214		}

   216			pageSize = 20
   217		}

   226	// DistributeCoupons 发放折扣券
   227	func (s *Service) DistributeCoupons(req *DistributeCouponRequest) error {
   228		// 获取模板
   229		template, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByID(req.TemplateID)
   230		if err != nil {
   231			return err
   232		}
   233	
   234		if template.Status != TemplateStatusActive {
   235			return errors.New("template is not active")
   236		}
   237	
   238		// 检查发放限制
   239		if template.MaxUsageTotal != nil {
   240			// TODO: 检查总使用量
   241		}
   242	
   243		// 批量创建用户折扣券
   244		coupons := make([]*UserCoupon, 0, len(req.UserIDs))
   245		now := time.Now()
   246		validUntil := CalculateExpiry(template)
   247	
   248		for _, userID := range req.UserIDs {
   249			// 检查用户是否已达到领取限制
   250			count, err := s.repo.CountUserCouponUsage(userID, template.ID)
   251			if err != nil {
   252				return err
   253			}
   254			if int(count) >= template.MaxUsagePerUser {
   255				continue // 跳过已达限制的用户
   256			}
   257	
   258			coupon := &UserCoupon{
   259				UserID:            userID,
   260				TemplateID:        template.ID,
   261				CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(template.Code),
   262				SourceType:        req.SourceType,
   263				SourceID:          req.SourceID,
   264				ValidFrom:         now,
   265				ValidUntil:        validUntil,
   266				Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
   267				DiscountType:      string(template.Type),
   268				DiscountValue:     template.DiscountValue,
   269				MinPurchaseAmount: template.MinPurchaseAmount,
   270			}
   271	
   272			coupons = append(coupons, coupon)
   273		}
   274	
   275		if len(coupons) == 0 {
   276			return errors.New("no coupons to distribute")
   277		}
   278	
   279		return s.repo.CreateUserCoupons(coupons)
   280	}

   282	// ClaimCoupon 用户领取折扣券
   283	func (s *Service) ClaimCoupon(userID uint64, code string) (*UserCoupon, error) {
   284		// 获取模板
   285		template, err := s.repo.GetActiveTemplateByCode(code)
   286		if err != nil {
   287			if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
   288				return nil, errors.New("invalid or inactive coupon code")
   289			}
   290			return nil, err
   291		}
   292	
   293		// 检查用户资格
   294		userInfo, err := s.userRepo.FindByID(uint(userID))
   295		if err != nil {
   296			return nil, err
   297		}
   298	
   299		isNewUser := userInfo.CreatedAt.After(time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -30)) // 30天内注册的算新用户
   300		isFirstPurchase := false                                             // TODO: 从订单系统获取
   301	
   302		if !IsValidForUser(template, isNewUser, isFirstPurchase) {
   303			return nil, errors.New("you are not eligible for this coupon")
   304		}
   305	
   306		// 检查领取限制
   307		count, err := s.repo.CountUserCouponUsage(userID, template.ID)
   308		if err != nil {
   309			return nil, err
   310		}
   311		if int(count) >= template.MaxUsagePerUser {
   312			return nil, errors.New("you have reached the maximum claim limit for this coupon")
   313		}
   314	
   315		// 创建用户折扣券
   316		now := time.Now()
   317		validUntil := CalculateExpiry(template)
   318	
   319		coupon := &UserCoupon{
   320			UserID:            userID,
   321			TemplateID:        template.ID,
   322			CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(template.Code),
   323			SourceType:        SourceTypeManual,
   324			ValidFrom:         now,
   325			ValidUntil:        validUntil,
   326			Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
   327			DiscountType:      string(template.Type),
   328			DiscountValue:     template.DiscountValue,
   329			MinPurchaseAmount: template.MinPurchaseAmount,
   330		}
   331	
   332		if err := s.repo.CreateUserCoupon(coupon); err != nil {
   333			return nil, err
   334		}
   335	
   336		coupon.Template = template
   337		return coupon, nil
   338	}

   351	// ApplyCoupon 应用折扣券
   352	func (s *Service) ApplyCoupon(userID uint64, couponID uint64, orderID uint64, orderAmount float64) (*CouponUsageLog, error) {
   353		// 获取折扣券
   354		coupon, err := s.repo.GetUserCouponByID(couponID)
   355		if err != nil {
   356			return nil, err
   357		}
   358	
   359		// 验证所有权
   360		if coupon.UserID != userID {
   361			return nil, errors.New("coupon does not belong to you")
   362		}
   363	
   364		// 验证状态
   365		if coupon.Status != CouponStatusUnused {
   366			return nil, errors.New("coupon is not available")
   367		}
   368	
   369		// 验证时间
   370		if !IsValidTime(coupon.ValidFrom, coupon.ValidUntil) {
   371			return nil, errors.New("coupon has expired")
   372		}
   373	
   374		// 验证金额
   375		if !IsValidAmount(coupon.MinPurchaseAmount, orderAmount) {
   376			return nil, fmt.Errorf("minimum purchase amount is %.2f", coupon.MinPurchaseAmount)
   377		}
   378	
   379		// 计算折扣
   380		discountAmount := CalculateDiscount(
   381			DiscountType(coupon.DiscountType),
   382			coupon.DiscountValue,
   383			orderAmount,
   384		)
   385		finalAmount := orderAmount - discountAmount
   386	
   387		// 使用事务
   388		err = s.repo.Transaction(func(txRepo *Repository) error {
   389			// 使用折扣券
   390			if err := txRepo.UseCoupon(couponID, orderID); err != nil {
   391				return err
   392			}
   393	
   394			// 创建使用记录
   395			usageLog := &CouponUsageLog{
   396				UserCouponID:   couponID,
   397				UserID:         userID,
   398				OrderID:        orderID,
   399				OriginalAmount: orderAmount,
   400				DiscountAmount: discountAmount,
   401				FinalAmount:    finalAmount,
   402				Status:         "applied",
   403			}
   404	
   405			if err := txRepo.CreateUsageLog(usageLog); err != nil {
   406				return err
   407			}
   408	
   409			return nil
   410		})
   411	
   412		if err != nil {
   413			return nil, err
   414		}
   415	
   416		return &CouponUsageLog{
   417			UserCouponID:   couponID,
   418			UserID:         userID,
   419			OrderID:        orderID,
   420			OriginalAmount: orderAmount,
   421			DiscountAmount: discountAmount,
   422			FinalAmount:    finalAmount,
   423			Status:         "applied",
   424		}, nil
   425	}

   431	// GenerateInvitation 生成邀请码和链接
   432	func (s *Service) GenerateInvitation(userID uint64) (*UserInvitation, error) {
   433		// 检查是否已有邀请信息
   434		existing, err := s.repo.GetUserInvitation(userID)
   435		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
   436			return nil, err
   437		}
   438	
   439		if existing != nil {
   440			// 如果已存在但未激活，重新激活
   441			if !existing.IsActive {
   442				updates := map[string]interface{}{
   443					"is_active": true,
   444				}
   445				if err := s.repo.UpdateUserInvitation(userID, updates); err != nil {
   446					return nil, err
   447				}
   448				existing.IsActive = true
   449			}
   450			return existing, nil
   451		}
   452	
   453		// 创建新的邀请信息
   454		invitationCode := GenerateInvitationCode()
   455		invitationURL := BuildInvitationURL(s.baseURL, invitationCode)
   456	
   457		invitation := &UserInvitation{
   458			UserID:         userID,
   459			InvitationCode: invitationCode,
   460			InvitationURL:  invitationURL,
   461			IsActive:       true,
   462		}
   463	
   464		if err := s.repo.CreateUserInvitation(invitation); err != nil {
   465			return nil, err
   466		}
   467	
   468		return invitation, nil
   469	}

   473		return s.repo.GetUserInvitation(userID)
   474	}

   476	// RegisterWithInvitation 通过邀请码注册
   477	func (s *Service) RegisterWithInvitation(invitationCode string, inviteeID uint64) error {
   478		// 获取邀请信息
   479		invitation, err := s.repo.GetUserInvitationByCode(invitationCode)
   480		if err != nil {
   481			if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
   482				return errors.New("invalid invitation code")
   483			}
   484			return err
   485		}
   486	
   487		// 检查是否已有邀请关系
   488		existing, err := s.repo.GetInvitationRelationship(inviteeID)
   489		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
   490			return err
   491		}
   492		if existing != nil {
   493			return errors.New("user already has an inviter")
   494		}
   495	
   496		// 使用事务处理
   497		return s.repo.Transaction(func(txRepo *Repository) error {
   498			// 创建邀请关系
   499			relationship := &InvitationRelationship{
   500				InviterID:      invitation.UserID,
   501				InviteeID:      inviteeID,
   502				InvitationCode: invitationCode,
   503				Status:         "registered",
   504				RegisteredAt:   &[]time.Time{time.Now()}[0],
   505			}
   506	
   507			if err := txRepo.CreateInvitationRelationship(relationship); err != nil {
   508				return err
   509			}
   510	
   511			// 更新邀请统计
   512			if err := txRepo.IncrementInvitationCount(invitation.UserID, "total_invites"); err != nil {
   513				return err
   514			}
   515			if err := txRepo.IncrementInvitationCount(invitation.UserID, "successful_invites"); err != nil {
   516				return err
   517			}
   518	
   519			// 查找并发放邀请折扣券
   520			templates, err := txRepo.GetAutoDistributionTemplates(DistributionTypeAutoInvite)
   521			if err != nil {
   522				return err
   523			}
   524	
   525			for _, template := range templates {
   526				if !template.IsInviteCoupon {
   527					continue
   528				}
   529	
   530				// 为被邀请人创建折扣券
   531				now := time.Now()
   532				validUntil := CalculateExpiry(template)
   533	
   534				coupon := &UserCoupon{
   535					UserID:            inviteeID,
   536					TemplateID:        template.ID,
   537					CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(template.Code),
   538					SourceType:        SourceTypeInvite,
   539					SourceID:          fmt.Sprintf("%d", invitation.UserID),
   540					SourceDetail:      JSONMap{"inviter_id": invitation.UserID, "invitation_code": invitationCode},
   541					ValidFrom:         now,
   542					ValidUntil:        validUntil,
   543					Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
   544					DiscountType:      string(template.Type),
   545					DiscountValue:     template.DiscountValue,
   546					MinPurchaseAmount: template.MinPurchaseAmount,
   547				}
   548	
   549				if err := txRepo.CreateUserCoupon(coupon); err != nil {
   550					return err
   551				}
   552	
   553				// 更新关系记录
   554				updates := map[string]interface{}{
   555					"invitee_coupon_id": coupon.ID,
   556				}
   557				if err := txRepo.UpdateInvitationRelationship(relationship.ID, updates); err != nil {
   558					return err
   559				}
   560			}
   561	
   562			return nil
   563		})
   564	}

   566	// GetInvitationStatistics 获取邀请统计
   567	func (s *Service) GetInvitationStatistics(userID uint64) (*UserInvitation, []*InvitationRelationship, error) {
   568		invitation, err := s.repo.GetUserInvitation(userID)
   569		if err != nil {
   570			return nil, nil, err
   571		}
   572	
   573		relationships, _, err := s.repo.ListInvitationRelationships(userID, nil, 0, 1000)
   574		if err != nil {
   575			return nil, nil, err
   576		}
   577	
   578		return invitation, relationships, nil
   579	}

   581	// DistributeRegisterCoupons 为新注册用户发放注册自动折扣券
   582	func (s *Service) DistributeRegisterCoupons(userID uint64) error {
   583		// 获取所有注册自动发放的活跃模板
   584		templates, err := s.repo.GetAutoDistributionTemplates(DistributionTypeAutoRegister)
   585		if err != nil {
   586			return err
   587		}
   588	
   589		if len(templates) == 0 {
   590			return nil // 没有配置注册自动发放的折扣券
   591		}
   592	
   593		now := time.Now()
   594	
   595		for _, template := range templates {
   596			// 检查用户是否已领取过该模板的券
   597			count, err := s.repo.CountUserCouponUsage(userID, template.ID)
   598			if err != nil {
   599				continue // 跳过错误，继续处理其他模板
   600			}
   601			if int(count) >= template.MaxUsagePerUser {
   602				continue // 已达到领取限制
   603			}
   604	
   605			// 计算过期时间
   606			validUntil := CalculateExpiry(template)
   607	
   608			// 创建用户折扣券
   609			coupon := &UserCoupon{
   610				UserID:            userID,
   611				TemplateID:        template.ID,
   612				CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(template.Code),
   613				SourceType:        SourceTypeRegister,
   614				SourceDetail:      JSONMap{"auto_distribute": true, "distribute_type": "register"},
   615				ValidFrom:         now,
   616				ValidUntil:        validUntil,
   617				Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
   618				DiscountType:      string(template.Type),
   619				DiscountValue:     template.DiscountValue,
   620				MinPurchaseAmount: template.MinPurchaseAmount,
   621			}
   622	
   623			if err := s.repo.CreateUserCoupon(coupon); err != nil {
   624				// 记录错误但继续处理
   625				fmt.Printf("Failed to distribute register coupon (template %d) to user %d: %v\n", template.ID, userID, err)
   626				continue
   627			}
   628		}
   629	
   630		return nil
   631	}
   632	
   633	// OnUserFirstPurchase 用户首次购买时的处理
   634	func (s *Service) OnUserFirstPurchase(userID uint64, orderID uint64) error {
   635		// 获取邀请关系
   636		relationship, err := s.repo.GetInvitationRelationship(userID)
   637		if err != nil {
   638			if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
   639				return nil // 没有邀请关系，直接返回
   640			}
   641			return err
   642		}
   643	
   644		if relationship.Status == "activated" || relationship.Status == "rewarded" {
   645			return nil // 已处理过
   646		}
   647	
   648		// 更新关系状态
   649		now := time.Now()
   650		updates := map[string]interface{}{
   651			"status":       "activated",
   652			"activated_at": now,
   653		}
   654	
   655		if err := s.repo.UpdateInvitationRelationship(relationship.ID, updates); err != nil {
   656			return err
   657		}
   658	
   659		// 更新邀请人的付费邀请数
   660		return s.repo.IncrementInvitationCount(relationship.InviterID, "paid_invites")
   661	}

   667	// CreateBatchFromRequest 从请求创建批次
   668	func (s *Service) CreateBatchFromRequest(req *CreateBatchRequest, createdBy uint64) (*CouponBatch, error) {
   669		// 验证模板存在
   670		template, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByID(req.TemplateID)
   671		if err != nil {
   672			return nil, errors.New("template not found")
   673		}
   674	
   675		if template.Status != TemplateStatusActive {
   676			return nil, errors.New("template is not active")
   677		}
   678	
   679		// 转换目标用户
   680		var targetUsers JSONArray
   681		if req.TargetUsers != nil && len(req.TargetUsers) > 0 {
   682			targetUsers = make(JSONArray, len(req.TargetUsers))
   683			for i, uid := range req.TargetUsers {
   684				targetUsers[i] = uid
   685			}
   686		}
   687	
   688		// 转换条件
   689		var targetConditions JSONMap
   690		if req.TargetConditions != nil {
   691			targetConditions = JSONMap(req.TargetConditions)
   692		}
   693	
   694		batch := &CouponBatch{
   695			BatchCode:        req.BatchCode,
   696			TemplateID:       req.TemplateID,
   697			Name:             req.Name,
   698			Description:      req.Description,
   699			TargetType:       req.TargetType,
   700			TargetUsers:      targetUsers,
   701			TargetConditions: targetConditions,
   702			TotalQuantity:    req.TotalQuantity,
   703			Status:           "draft",
   704			ScheduledAt:      req.ScheduledAt,
   705			CreatedBy:        &createdBy,
   706		}
   707	
   708		if err := s.repo.CreateBatch(batch); err != nil {
   709			return nil, err
   710		}
   711	
   712		return batch, nil
   713	}

   716	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(templateID uint64, name string, targetType string, totalQuantity int, createdBy uint64) (*CouponBatch, error) {
   717		batch := &CouponBatch{
   718			BatchCode:     GenerateBatchCode(),
   719			TemplateID:    templateID,
   720			Name:          name,
   721			TargetType:    targetType,
   722			TotalQuantity: totalQuantity,
   723			Status:        "draft",
   724			CreatedBy:     &createdBy,
   725		}
   726	
   727		if err := s.repo.CreateBatch(batch); err != nil {
   728			return nil, err
   729		}
   730	
   731		return batch, nil
   732	}

   745	// ExecuteBatch 执行批次发放
   746	func (s *Service) ExecuteBatch(batchID uint64) error {
   747		batch, err := s.repo.GetBatchByID(batchID)
   748		if err != nil {
   749			return err
   750		}
   751	
   752		if batch.Status != "draft" {
   753			return errors.New("batch is not in draft status")
   754		}
   755	
   756		// 更新批次状态为处理中
   757		now := time.Now()
   758		if err := s.repo.UpdateBatch(batchID, map[string]interface{}{
   759			"status":     "processing",
   760			"started_at": now,
   761		}); err != nil {
   762			return err
   763		}
   764	
   765		// 根据目标类型获取用户列表
   766		userIDs, err := s.getTargetUsers(batch)
   767		if err != nil {
   768			s.repo.UpdateBatch(batchID, map[string]interface{}{
   769				"status": "cancelled",
   770			})
   771			return err
   772		}
   773	
   774		// 如果指定了数量限制，只取前N个用户
   775		if batch.TotalQuantity > 0 && len(userIDs) > batch.TotalQuantity {
   776			userIDs = userIDs[:batch.TotalQuantity]
   777		}
   778	
   779		// 批量发放折扣券
   780		distributedCount := 0
   781		for _, userID := range userIDs {
   782			// 检查用户是否已经领取过此模板的券
   783			usageCount, _ := s.repo.CountUserCouponUsage(userID, batch.TemplateID)
   784			if usageCount >= int64(batch.Template.MaxUsagePerUser) {
   785				continue
   786			}
   787	
   788			// 创建用户券
   789			coupon := &UserCoupon{
   790				UserID:            userID,
   791				TemplateID:        batch.TemplateID,
   792				CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(batch.BatchCode),
   793				SourceType:        SourceTypeBatch,
   794				SourceID:          fmt.Sprintf("%d", batchID),
   795				SourceDetail:      JSONMap{"batch_code": batch.BatchCode, "batch_name": batch.Name},
   796				ValidFrom:         now,
   797				ValidUntil:        now.AddDate(0, 0, batch.Template.ValidDays),
   798				Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
   799				DiscountType:      string(batch.Template.Type),
   800				DiscountValue:     batch.Template.DiscountValue,
   801				MinPurchaseAmount: batch.Template.MinPurchaseAmount,
   802			}
   803	
   804			if err := s.repo.CreateUserCoupon(coupon); err != nil {
   805				// 记录错误但继续处理
   806				continue
   807			}
   808	
   809			distributedCount++
   810		}
   811	
   812		// 更新批次完成状态
   813		completedAt := time.Now()
   814		if err := s.repo.UpdateBatch(batchID, map[string]interface{}{
   815			"status":               "completed",
   816			"distributed_quantity": distributedCount,
   817			"completed_at":         completedAt,
   818		}); err != nil {
   819			return err
   820		}
   821	
   822		return nil
   823	}
   824	
   825	// getTargetUsers 根据批次目标类型获取用户ID列表
   826	func (s *Service) getTargetUsers(batch *CouponBatch) ([]uint64, error) {
   827		switch batch.TargetType {
   828		case "all":
   829			// 获取所有用户
   830			return s.getAllUsers()
   831		case "new_users":
   832			// 获取新注册用户（比如最近30天）
   833			return s.getNewUsers(30)
   834		case "paid_users":
   835			// 获取付费用户
   836			return s.getPaidUsers()
   837		case "specific_users":
   838			// 指定的用户列表
   839			if batch.TargetUsers == nil || len(batch.TargetUsers) == 0 {
   840				return nil, errors.New("no target users specified")
   841			}
   842			userIDs := make([]uint64, 0, len(batch.TargetUsers))
   843			for _, v := range batch.TargetUsers {
   844				if uid, ok := v.(float64); ok {
   845					userIDs = append(userIDs, uint64(uid))
   846				}
   847			}
   848			return userIDs, nil
   849		case "user_group":
   850			// 根据条件筛选用户组
   851			return s.getUsersByConditions(batch.TargetConditions)
   852		default:
   853			return nil, errors.New("unsupported target type")
   854		}
   855	}
   856	
   857	// getAllUsers 获取所有用户ID
   858	func (s *Service) getAllUsers() ([]uint64, error) {
   859		var userIDs []uint64
   860		err := s.repo.db.Table("users").
   861			Where("deleted_at IS NULL").
   862			Pluck("id", &userIDs).Error
   863		return userIDs, err
   864	}
   865	
   866	// getNewUsers 获取最近N天注册的新用户
   867	func (s *Service) getNewUsers(days int) ([]uint64, error) {
   868		var userIDs []uint64
   869		since := time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -days)
   870		err := s.repo.db.Table("users").
   871			Where("deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= ?", since).
   872			Pluck("id", &userIDs).Error
   873		return userIDs, err
   874	}
   875	
   876	// getPaidUsers 获取付费用户
   877	func (s *Service) getPaidUsers() ([]uint64, error) {
   878		var userIDs []uint64
   879		err := s.repo.db.Table("orders").
   880			Where("status = ?", "paid").
   881			Distinct("user_id").
   882			Pluck("user_id", &userIDs).Error
   883		return userIDs, err
   884	}
   885	
   886	// getUsersByConditions 根据条件获取用户
   887	func (s *Service) getUsersByConditions(conditions JSONMap) ([]uint64, error) {
   888		// 基于条件构建查询
   889		query := s.repo.db.Table("users").Where("deleted_at IS NULL")
   890	
   891		// 示例条件处理
   892		if registeredAfter, ok := conditions["registered_after"].(string); ok {
   893			query = query.Where("created_at >= ?", registeredAfter)
   894		}
   895		if registeredBefore, ok := conditions["registered_before"].(string); ok {
   896			query = query.Where("created_at <= ?", registeredBefore)
   897		}
   898	
   899		var userIDs []uint64
   900		err := query.Pluck("id", &userIDs).Error
   901		return userIDs, err
   902	}
   903	
   904	// CancelBatch 取消批次
   905	func (s *Service) CancelBatch(batchID uint64) error {
   906		batch, err := s.repo.GetBatchByID(batchID)
   907		if err != nil {
   908			return err
   909		}
   910	
   911		if batch.Status != "draft" && batch.Status != "processing" {
   912			return errors.New("batch cannot be cancelled")
   913		}
   914	
   915		return s.repo.UpdateBatch(batchID, map[string]interface{}{
   916			"status": "cancelled",
   917		})
   918	}

    18	// GenerateCouponCode 生成折扣券唯一码
    19	func GenerateCouponCode(prefix string) string {
    20		const charset = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
    21		const length = 8
    22	
    23		b := make([]byte, length)
    24		for i := range b {
    25			n, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(charset))))
    26			b[i] = charset[n.Int64()]
    27		}
    28	
    29		if prefix != "" {
    30			return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", strings.ToUpper(prefix), string(b))
    31		}
    32		return string(b)
    33	}

    35	// GenerateInvitationCode 生成邀请码
    36	func GenerateInvitationCode() string {
    37		const charset = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
    38		const length = 6
    39	
    40		b := make([]byte, length)
    41		for i := range b {
    42			n, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(charset))))
    43			b[i] = charset[n.Int64()]
    44		}
    45	
    46		return string(b)
    47	}

    49	// GenerateBatchCode 生成批次号
    50	func GenerateBatchCode() string {
    51		timestamp := time.Now().Format("20060102150405")
    52		randomPart := GenerateCouponCode("")[:4]
    53		return fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s", timestamp, randomPart)
    54	}

    56	// GenerateTemplateCode 生成模板编码
    57	func GenerateTemplateCode(distributionType DistributionType) string {
    58		const charset = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
    59		const length = 6
    60	
    61		b := make([]byte, length)
    62		for i := range b {
    63			n, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(charset))))
    64			b[i] = charset[n.Int64()]
    65		}
    66	
    67		// 根据发放类型添加前缀
    68		var prefix string
    69		switch distributionType {
    70		case DistributionTypeAutoRegister:
    71			prefix = "REG"
    72		case DistributionTypeAutoInvite:
    73			prefix = "INV"
    74		case DistributionTypeManual:
    75			prefix = "MAN"
    76		case DistributionTypeBatch:
    77			prefix = "BAT"
    78		case DistributionTypeTargeted:
    79			prefix = "TGT"
    80		default:
    81			prefix = "CPN"
    82		}
    83	
    84		return fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", prefix, string(b))
    85	}

    87	// GenerateRandomCode 生成随机验证码
    88	func GenerateRandomCode(length int) string {
    89		const charset = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
    90	
    91		b := make([]byte, length)
    92		for i := range b {
    93			n, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(charset))))
    94			b[i] = charset[n.Int64()]
    95		}
    96	
    97		return string(b)
    98	}

   100	// CalculateExpiry 计算过期时间
   101	func CalculateExpiry(template *CouponTemplate) time.Time {
   102		now := time.Now()
   103	
   104		// 如果有固定结束时间，使用固定结束时间
   105		if template.FixedValidEnd != nil {
   106			return *template.FixedValidEnd
   107		}
   108	
   109		// 否则使用有效天数计算
   110		if template.ValidDays > 0 {
   111			return now.AddDate(0, 0, template.ValidDays)
   112		}
   113	
   114		// 默认30天
   115		return now.AddDate(0, 0, 30)
   116	}
   117	
   118	// CalculateDiscount 计算折扣金额
   119	// 返回值是折扣金额,即原价减去的部分
   120	func CalculateDiscount(discountType DiscountType, discountValue float64, originalAmount float64) float64 {
   121		switch discountType {
   122		case DiscountTypePercentage:
   123			// 百分比折扣: 例如20%折扣,原价100,折扣金额20,最终支付80
   124			return originalAmount * (discountValue / 100)
   125		case DiscountTypeFixed:
   126			// 固定金额支付: 例如固定支付99元,原价100,折扣金额1,最终支付99
   127			// 如果固定金额大于原价,则折扣金额为0(按原价支付)
   128			if discountValue >= originalAmount {
   129				return 0
   130			}
   131			return originalAmount - discountValue
   132		case DiscountTypePriceOff:
   133			// 减免金额: 例如减免20元,原价100,折扣金额20,最终支付80
   134			// 最多减免到0元
   135			if discountValue > originalAmount {
   136				return originalAmount
   137			}
   138			return discountValue
   139		default:
   140			return 0
   141		}
   142	}
   143	
   144	// IsValidForUser 检查折扣券是否对用户有效
   145	func IsValidForUser(template *CouponTemplate, isNewUser bool, isFirstPurchase bool) bool {
   146		// 检查新用户限制
   147		if template.NewUserOnly && !isNewUser {
   148			return false
   149		}
   150	
   151		// 检查首购限制
   152		if template.FirstPurchaseOnly && !isFirstPurchase {
   153			return false
   154		}
   155	
   156		return true
   157	}
   158	
   159	// IsValidAmount 检查金额是否满足要求
   160	func IsValidAmount(minPurchaseAmount float64, orderAmount float64) bool {
   161		return orderAmount >= minPurchaseAmount
   162	}
   163	
   164	// IsValidTime 检查时间是否有效
   165	func IsValidTime(validFrom, validUntil time.Time) bool {
   166		now := time.Now()
   167		return now.After(validFrom) && now.Before(validUntil)
   168	}

   170	// BuildInvitationURL 构建邀请链接
   171	func BuildInvitationURL(baseURL string, invitationCode string) string {
   172		if !strings.HasSuffix(baseURL, "/") {
   173			baseURL += "/"
   174		}
   175		return fmt.Sprintf("%sregister?invite=%s", baseURL, invitationCode)
   176	}

    24	// Handler 反馈处理器
    25	type Handler struct {
    26		service *Service
    27	}
    28	
    29	// NewHandler 创建反馈处理器
    30	func NewHandler(service *Service, uploadPath string) *Handler {
    31		handler := &Handler{
    32			service: service,
    33		}
    34	
    35		// 启动定时清理未使用附件的任务
    36		go handler.startCleanupTask()
    37	
    38		return handler
    39	}
    40	
    41	// startCleanupTask 启动清理未使用附件的定时任务
    42	func (h *Handler) startCleanupTask() {
    43		// 启动时先执行一次清理
    44		h.cleanupUnusedAttachments()
    45	
    46		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Minute) // 每10分钟检查一次
    47		defer ticker.Stop()
    48	
    49		for range ticker.C {
    50			h.cleanupUnusedAttachments()
    51		}
    52	}
    53	
    54	// cleanupUnusedAttachments 清理游离附件（未绑定反馈的附件）
    55	func (h *Handler) cleanupUnusedAttachments() {
    56		// 策略1: 删除创建超过1小时且未绑定反馈的附件（用户上传后1小时内未提交反馈）
    57		olderThan := time.Now().Add(-1 * time.Hour).Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
    58		count, err := h.service.CleanupOrphanAttachments(olderThan)
    59		if err != nil {
    60			log.Printf("Failed to cleanup orphan attachments: %v", err)
    61			return
    62		}
    63	
    64		if count > 0 {
    65			log.Printf("Cleaned up %d orphan attachments from database (older than 1 hour)", count)
    66		}
    67	
    68		// 策略2: 如果游离附件总数超过限制，删除最旧的
    69		maxOrphanCount := 100 // 最多保留100个游离附件
    70		excessCount, err := h.service.CleanupExcessOrphanAttachments(maxOrphanCount)
    71		if err != nil {
    72			log.Printf("Failed to cleanup excess orphan attachments: %v", err)
    73			return
    74		}
    75	
    76		if excessCount > 0 {
    77			log.Printf("Cleaned up %d excess orphan attachments (limit: %d)", excessCount, maxOrphanCount)
    78		}
    79	}
    80	
    81	// 文件上传限制
    82	const (
    83		MaxFileCount  = 2        // 最大文件数量
    84		MaxImageCount = 10       // 最大图片数量
    85		MaxFileSize   = 10 << 20 // 单个文件最大10MB
    86		MaxTotalSize  = 50 << 20 // 总文件大小最大50MB
    87	)
    88	
    89	// 允许的文件类型
    90	var allowedImageTypes = map[string]bool{
    91		"image/jpeg": true,
    92		"image/png":  true,
    93		"image/gif":  true,
    94		"image/webp": true,
    95	}
    96	
    97	var allowedFileTypes = map[string]bool{
    98		"application/pdf":                                                        true,
    99		"application/msword":                                                     true,
   100		"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": true,
   101		"application/vnd.ms-excel":                                               true,
   102		"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet":      true,
   103		"text/plain":                                                             true,
   104		"application/zip":                                                        true,
   105		"application/x-rar-compressed":                                           true,
   106		"application/x-zip-compressed":                                           true,
   107	}

   113		AttachmentsKey string `json:"attachmentsKey"` // 上传附件时返回的key

   134		if err != nil {
   135			utils.Error(c, 5001, "创建反馈失败: "+err.Error())
   136			return
   137		}
   138	
   139		utils.Success(c, feedback)
   140	}

   175	// UploadAttachments 上传附件（公共接口）
   176	// POST /api/v1/public/feedback/upload
   177	func (h *Handler) UploadAttachments(c *gin.Context) {
   178		// 解析multipart表单
   179		if err := c.Request.ParseMultipartForm(MaxTotalSize); err != nil {
   180			utils.Error(c, 4002, "文件过大或格式错误")
   181			return
   182		}
   183	
   184		form := c.Request.MultipartForm
   185		if form == nil || form.File == nil {
   186			utils.Error(c, 4003, "没有上传文件")
   187			return
   188		}
   189	
   190		// 获取或生成上传批次key
   191		uploadKey := c.PostForm("uploadKey")
   192		if uploadKey == "" {
   193			uploadKey = uuid.New().String()
   194		}
   195	
   196		var savedAttachments []FeedbackAttachment
   197		var imageCount, fileCount int
   198		var totalSize int64
   199	
   200		// 处理文件
   201		files := form.File["files"]
   202		for _, fileHeader := range files {
   203			// 检查文件大小
   204			if fileHeader.Size > MaxFileSize {
   205				utils.Error(c, 4004, fmt.Sprintf("文件 %s 超过10MB限制", fileHeader.Filename))
   206				return
   207			}
   208			totalSize += fileHeader.Size
   209	
   210			// 检查总大小
   211			if totalSize > MaxTotalSize {
   212				utils.Error(c, 4005, "文件总大小超过50MB限制")
   213				return
   214			}
   215	
   216			// 打开文件
   217			file, err := fileHeader.Open()
   218			if err != nil {
   219				utils.Error(c, 5002, "打开文件失败")
   220				return
   221			}
   222			defer file.Close()
   223	
   224			// 读取整个文件到内存
   225			fileData, err := io.ReadAll(file)
   226			if err != nil {
   227				utils.Error(c, 5003, "读取文件失败")
   228				return
   229			}
   230	
   231			// 检测文件类型
   232			contentType := http.DetectContentType(fileData)
   233	
   234			// 判断是图片还是文件
   235			isImage := allowedImageTypes[contentType]
   236			isFile := allowedFileTypes[contentType]
   237	
   238			if !isImage && !isFile {
   239				utils.Error(c, 4006, fmt.Sprintf("不支持的文件类型: %s", contentType))
   240				return
   241			}
   242	
   243			// 检查数量限制
   244			if isImage {
   245				imageCount++
   246				if imageCount > MaxImageCount {
   247					utils.Error(c, 4007, fmt.Sprintf("图片数量超过%d张限制", MaxImageCount))
   248					return
   249				}
   250			} else {
   251				fileCount++
   252				if fileCount > MaxFileCount {
   253					utils.Error(c, 4008, fmt.Sprintf("文件数量超过%d个限制", MaxFileCount))
   254					return
   255				}
   256			}
   257	
   258			fileType := "file"
   259			if isImage {
   260				fileType = "image"
   261			}
   262	
   263			// 保存到数据库
   264			attachment := &FeedbackAttachment{
   265				UploadKey:    uploadKey,
   266				OriginalName: fileHeader.Filename,
   267				FileData:     fileData,
   268				FileSize:     fileHeader.Size,
   269				FileType:     fileType,
   270				MimeType:     contentType,
   271				IsUsed:       false,
   272			}
   273	
   274			if err := h.service.SaveAttachment(attachment); err != nil {
   275				utils.Error(c, 5007, "保存附件失败: "+err.Error())
   276				return
   277			}
   278	
   279			savedAttachments = append(savedAttachments, *attachment)
   280		}
   281	
   282		// 转换为前端期望的格式
   283		var attachments []Attachment
   284		for _, att := range savedAttachments {
   285			attachments = append(attachments, att.ToAttachment())
   286		}
   287	
   288		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
   289			"attachmentsKey": uploadKey,
   290			"uploadKey":      uploadKey,
   291			"attachments":    attachments,
   292			"files":          attachments, // 兼容前端期望的字段名
   293		})
   294	}
   295	
   296	// GetAttachment 获取附件（公共接口，用于下载/预览）
   297	// GET /api/v1/public/feedback/attachment/:id
   298	func (h *Handler) GetAttachment(c *gin.Context) {
   299		idStr := c.Param("id")
   300		id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 32)
   301		if err != nil {
   302			utils.Error(c, 4001, "无效的附件ID")
   303			return
   304		}
   305	
   306		attachment, err := h.service.GetAttachmentByID(uint(id))
   307		if err != nil {
   308			utils.Error(c, 5001, "附件不存在")
   309			return
   310		}
   311	
   312		// 设置响应头
   313		c.Header("Content-Type", attachment.MimeType)
   314		c.Header("Content-Length", strconv.FormatInt(attachment.FileSize, 10))
   315	
   316		// 如果是文件类型，设置下载头
   317		if attachment.FileType == "file" {
   318			c.Header("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=\"%s\"", attachment.OriginalName))
   319		} else {
   320			// 图片类型，设置为内联显示
   321			c.Header("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("inline; filename=\"%s\"", attachment.OriginalName))
   322		}
   323	
   324		// 写入文件数据
   325		c.Data(http.StatusOK, attachment.MimeType, attachment.FileData)
   326	}

    10	import (
    11		"fmt"

    15	// FeedbackStatus 反馈状态
    16	type FeedbackStatus string
    17	
    18	const (
    19		StatusPending   FeedbackStatus = "pending"   // 待处理
    20		StatusProcessed FeedbackStatus = "processed" // 已处理
    21		StatusReplied   FeedbackStatus = "replied"   // 已回复
    22		StatusClosed    FeedbackStatus = "closed"    // 已关闭
    23	)
    24	
    25	// Feedback 反馈模型
    26	type Feedback struct {
    27		ID          uint           `gorm:"primarykey" json:"id"`
    28		Email       string         `gorm:"size:255;not null;index" json:"email"`                   // 反馈者邮箱
    29		Content     string         `gorm:"type:text;not null" json:"content"`                      // 反馈内容
    30		Attachments string         `gorm:"type:text" json:"attachments"`                           // 附件列表（JSON格式）
    31		UserID      *uint          `gorm:"index" json:"userId"`                                    // 用户ID（登录用户）
    32		Username    string         `gorm:"size:100" json:"username"`                               // 用户名（登录用户）
    33		IP          string         `gorm:"size:45" json:"ip"`                                      // 反馈者IP
    34		IPLocation  string         `gorm:"size:255" json:"ipLocation"`                             // IP归属地
    35		Status      FeedbackStatus `gorm:"size:20;default:pending;index" json:"status"`            // 状态
    36		ReplyContent string        `gorm:"type:text" json:"replyContent"`                          // 回复内容
    37		RepliedAt   *time.Time     `json:"repliedAt"`                                              // 回复时间
    38		RepliedBy   string         `gorm:"size:100" json:"repliedBy"`                              // 回复人
    39		CreatedAt   time.Time      `gorm:"index" json:"createdAt"`
    40		UpdatedAt   time.Time      `json:"updatedAt"`
    41	}
    42	
    43	// TableName 指定表名
    44	func (Feedback) TableName() string {
    45		return "feedbacks"
    46	}
    47	
    48	// Attachment 附件信息（用于JSON序列化，兼容旧数据）
    49	type Attachment struct {
    50		Name string `json:"name"` // 文件名
    51		URL  string `json:"url"`  // 文件URL
    52		Size int64  `json:"size"` // 文件大小（字节）
    53		Type string `json:"type"` // 文件类型（image/file）
    54	}
    55	
    56	// FeedbackAttachment 反馈附件数据库模型
    57	type FeedbackAttachment struct {
    58		ID           uint      `gorm:"primarykey" json:"id"`
    59		UploadKey    string    `gorm:"size:36;not null;index" json:"uploadKey"`       // 上传批次key
    60		FeedbackID   *uint     `gorm:"index" json:"feedbackId"`                       // 关联的反馈ID
    61		OriginalName string    `gorm:"size:255;not null" json:"originalName"`         // 原始文件名
    62		FileData     []byte    `gorm:"type:longblob;not null" json:"-"`               // 文件二进制数据（不返回给前端）
    63		FileSize     int64     `gorm:"not null" json:"fileSize"`                      // 文件大小
    64		FileType     string    `gorm:"size:20;not null" json:"fileType"`              // 文件类型 image/file
    65		MimeType     string    `gorm:"size:100;not null" json:"mimeType"`             // MIME类型
    66		IsUsed       bool      `gorm:"default:false;index" json:"isUsed"`             // 是否已使用
    67		CreatedAt    time.Time `json:"createdAt"`
    68		UpdatedAt    time.Time `json:"updatedAt"`
    69	}
    70	
    71	// TableName 指定表名
    72	func (FeedbackAttachment) TableName() string {
    73		return "feedback_attachments"
    74	}

    76	// ToAttachment 转换为Attachment格式（用于响应，URL指向下载接口）
    77	func (fa *FeedbackAttachment) ToAttachment() Attachment {
    78		return Attachment{
    79			Name: fa.OriginalName,
    80			URL:  fmt.Sprintf("/api/v1/public/feedback/attachment/%d", fa.ID),
    81			Size: fa.FileSize,
    82			Type: fa.FileType,
    83		}
    84	}

   125		Processed int64 `json:"processed"`
   126		Replied   int64 `json:"replied"`
   127		Closed    int64 `json:"closed"`
   128	}

    49	// List 获取反馈列表
    50	func (r *Repository) List(req *FeedbackListRequest) (*FeedbackListResponse, error) {
    51		var feedbacks []Feedback
    52		var total int64
    53	
    54		query := r.db.Model(&Feedback{})
    55	
    56		// 状态筛选
    57		if req.Status != "" {
    58			query = query.Where("status = ?", req.Status)
    59		}
    60	
    61		// 邮箱筛选
    62		if req.Email != "" {
    63			query = query.Where("email LIKE ?", "%"+req.Email+"%")
    64		}
    65	
    66		// 关键词搜索（搜索内容和邮箱）
    67		if req.Keyword != "" {
    68			query = query.Where("content LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?", "%"+req.Keyword+"%", "%"+req.Keyword+"%")
    69		}
    70	
    71		// 日期范围筛选
    72		if req.StartDate != "" {
    73			query = query.Where("created_at >= ?", req.StartDate+" 00:00:00")
    74		}
    75		if req.EndDate != "" {
    76			query = query.Where("created_at <= ?", req.EndDate+" 23:59:59")
    77		}
    78	
    79		// 获取总数
    80		if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
    81			return nil, err
    82		}
    83	
    84		// 分页
    85		offset := (req.Page - 1) * req.PageSize
    86		if err := query.Order("created_at DESC").Offset(offset).Limit(req.PageSize).Find(&feedbacks).Error; err != nil {
    87			return nil, err
    88		}
    89	
    90		return &FeedbackListResponse{
    91			List:     feedbacks,
    92			Total:    total,
    93			Page:     req.Page,
    94			PageSize: req.PageSize,
    95		}, nil
    96	}

    98	// GetStats 获取反馈统计
    99	func (r *Repository) GetStats() (*FeedbackStats, error) {
   100		var stats FeedbackStats
   101	
   102		// 总数
   103		if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Count(&stats.Total).Error; err != nil {
   104			return nil, err
   105		}
   106	
   107		// 各状态数量
   108		if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("status = ?", StatusPending).Count(&stats.Pending).Error; err != nil {
   109			return nil, err
   110		}
   111		if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("status = ?", StatusProcessed).Count(&stats.Processed).Error; err != nil {
   112			return nil, err
   113		}
   114		if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("status = ?", StatusReplied).Count(&stats.Replied).Error; err != nil {
   115			return nil, err
   116		}
   117		if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("status = ?", StatusClosed).Count(&stats.Closed).Error; err != nil {
   118			return nil, err
   119		}
   120	
   121		return &stats, nil
   122	}

   162	// BindAttachmentsToFeedback 将附件绑定到反馈

   172	// DeleteOrphanAttachments 删除游离附件（未绑定反馈且创建超过指定时间的），返回删除数量
   173	func (r *Repository) DeleteOrphanAttachments(olderThan string) (int64, error) {
   174		// 删除 feedback_id IS NULL 且创建时间超过指定时间的附件
   175		result := r.db.Where("feedback_id IS NULL AND created_at < ?", olderThan).Delete(&FeedbackAttachment{})
   176		return result.RowsAffected, result.Error
   177	}
   178	
   179	// DeleteExcessOrphanAttachments 删除超出限制的游离附件（保留最新的maxCount个）
   180	func (r *Repository) DeleteExcessOrphanAttachments(maxCount int) (int64, error) {
   181		// 获取游离附件总数（feedback_id IS NULL）
   182		var totalCount int64
   183		if err := r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).Where("feedback_id IS NULL").Count(&totalCount).Error; err != nil {
   184			return 0, err
   185		}
   186	
   187		// 如果未超过限制，不需要删除
   188		if totalCount <= int64(maxCount) {
   189			return 0, nil
   190		}
   191	
   192		// 计算需要删除的数量
   193		deleteCount := totalCount - int64(maxCount)
   194	
   195		// 获取需要删除的附件ID（最旧的）
   196		var idsToDelete []uint
   197		if err := r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).
   198			Select("id").
   199			Where("feedback_id IS NULL").
   200			Order("created_at ASC").
   201			Limit(int(deleteCount)).
   202			Pluck("id", &idsToDelete).Error; err != nil {
   203			return 0, err
   204		}
   205	
   206		// 删除这些附件
   207		if len(idsToDelete) > 0 {
   208			result := r.db.Where("id IN ?", idsToDelete).Delete(&FeedbackAttachment{})
   209			return result.RowsAffected, result.Error
   210		}
   211	
   212		return 0, nil
   213	}
   214	
   215	// GetOrphanAttachmentStats 获取游离附件的统计信息
   216	func (r *Repository) GetOrphanAttachmentStats() (count int64, totalSize int64, err error) {
   217		err = r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).
   218			Where("feedback_id IS NULL").
   219			Count(&count).Error
   220		if err != nil {
   221			return
   222		}
   223	
   224		// 获取总大小
   225		var result struct {
   226			TotalSize int64
   227		}
   228		err = r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).
   229			Select("COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) as total_size").
   230			Where("feedback_id IS NULL").
   231			Scan(&result).Error
   232		totalSize = result.TotalSize
   233		return
   234	}
   235	
   236	// DeleteAttachmentsByFeedbackID 删除反馈相关的所有附件记录
   237	func (r *Repository) DeleteAttachmentsByFeedbackID(feedbackID uint) ([]FeedbackAttachment, error) {
   238		var attachments []FeedbackAttachment
   239		// 先查询要删除的附件
   240		err := r.db.Where("feedback_id = ?", feedbackID).Find(&attachments).Error
   241		if err != nil {
   242			return nil, err
   243		}
   244		
   245		// 删除数据库记录
   246		if len(attachments) > 0 {
   247			err = r.db.Where("feedback_id = ?", feedbackID).Delete(&FeedbackAttachment{}).Error
   248		}
   249		
   250		return attachments, err
   251	}

    21		GetActiveEmailConfig() (*model.EmailConfig, error)
    22	}
    23	
    24	// UserRepository 用户仓库接口（用于查询用户信息）
    25	type UserRepository interface {
    26		FindByID(id uint) (*UserInfo, error)
    27		FindByIDs(ids []uint) (map[uint]*UserInfo, error)
    28	}
    29	
    30	// UserInfo 用户信息（简化版，用于反馈显示）
    31	type UserInfo struct {
    32		ID        uint    `json:"id"`
    33		Username  *string `json:"username"`
    34		Email     *string `json:"email"`
    35		Phone     *string `json:"phone"`
    36		AvatarURL *string `json:"avatar_url"`
    37	}

    63	// CreateFeedback 创建反馈
    64	func (s *Service) CreateFeedback(req *CreateFeedbackRequest, userID *uint, username, ip string, attachments []Attachment) (*Feedback, error) {
    65		// 序列化附件
    66		attachmentsJSON := ""
    67		if len(attachments) > 0 {
    68			data, err := json.Marshal(attachments)
    69			if err != nil {
    70				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to serialize attachments: %v", err)
    71			}
    72			attachmentsJSON = string(data)
    73		}
    74	
    75		// 获取IP归属地
    76		ipLocation := ""
    77		if ip != "" {
    78			loc := utils.ParseIPLocation(ip)
    79			if loc != nil {
    80				ipLocation = utils.GetSimpleLocationString(loc)
    81			}
    82		}
    83	
    84		feedback := &Feedback{
    85			Email:       req.Email,
    86			Content:     req.Content,
    87			Attachments: attachmentsJSON,
    88			UserID:      userID,
    89			Username:    username,
    90			IP:          ip,
    91			IPLocation:  ipLocation,
    92			Status:      StatusPending,
    93		}
    94	
    95		if err := s.repo.Create(feedback); err != nil {
    96			return nil, err
    97		}
    98	
    99		return feedback, nil
   100	}
   101	
   102	// GetFeedback 获取反馈详情
   103	func (s *Service) GetFeedback(id uint) (*Feedback, error) {
   104		feedback, err := s.repo.GetByID(id)
   105		if err != nil {
   106			return nil, err
   107		}
   108	
   109		// 填充附件信息到 Attachments 字段（JSON格式）
   110		attachments, _ := s.GetAttachments(feedback)
   111		if len(attachments) > 0 {
   112			data, _ := json.Marshal(attachments)
   113			feedback.Attachments = string(data)
   114		}
   115	
   116		// 如果有 user_id，查询用户信息填充 username
   117		if feedback.UserID != nil && s.userRepo != nil {
   118			if userInfo, err := s.userRepo.FindByID(*feedback.UserID); err == nil && userInfo != nil {
   119				if userInfo.Username != nil && *userInfo.Username != "" {
   120					feedback.Username = *userInfo.Username
   121				}
   122			}
   123		}
   124	
   125		return feedback, nil
   126	}

   128	// ListFeedbacks 获取反馈列表
   129	func (s *Service) ListFeedbacks(req *FeedbackListRequest) (*FeedbackListResponse, error) {
   130		// 设置默认值
   131		if req.Page <= 0 {
   132			req.Page = 1
   133		}
   134		if req.PageSize <= 0 {
   135			req.PageSize = 20
   136		}
   137		result, err := s.repo.List(req)
   138		if err != nil {
   139			return nil, err
   140		}
   141	
   142		// 收集所有需要查询的 user_id
   143		userIDs := make([]uint, 0)
   144		for _, fb := range result.List {
   145			if fb.UserID != nil {
   146				userIDs = append(userIDs, *fb.UserID)
   147			}
   148		}
   149	
   150		// 批量查询用户信息
   151		var userMap map[uint]*UserInfo
   152		if len(userIDs) > 0 && s.userRepo != nil {
   153			userMap, _ = s.userRepo.FindByIDs(userIDs)
   154		}
   155	
   156		// 为每个反馈填充附件信息和用户信息
   157		for i := range result.List {
   158			// 填充附件
   159			attachments, _ := s.GetAttachments(&result.List[i])
   160			if len(attachments) > 0 {
   161				data, _ := json.Marshal(attachments)
   162				result.List[i].Attachments = string(data)
   163			}
   164	
   165			// 填充用户名（如果 username 为空但有 user_id）
   166			if result.List[i].UserID != nil && userMap != nil {
   167				if userInfo, ok := userMap[*result.List[i].UserID]; ok && userInfo != nil {
   168					if userInfo.Username != nil && *userInfo.Username != "" {
   169						result.List[i].Username = *userInfo.Username
   170					}
   171				}
   172			}
   173		}
   174	
   175		return result, nil
   176	}

   188	// ReplyFeedback 回复反馈
   189	func (s *Service) ReplyFeedback(id uint, replyContent, repliedBy string) error {
   190		feedback, err := s.repo.GetByID(id)
   191		if err != nil {
   192			return err
   193		}
   194	
   195		// 更新反馈信息
   196		now := time.Now()
   197		feedback.ReplyContent = replyContent
   198		feedback.RepliedAt = &now
   199		feedback.RepliedBy = repliedBy
   200		feedback.Status = StatusReplied
   201	
   202		if err := s.repo.Update(feedback); err != nil {
   203			return err
   204		}
   205	
   206		// 发送回复邮件
   207		fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Starting email send process for feedback #%d to %s\n", id, feedback.Email)
   208		
   209		if s.configService != nil {
   210			fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] ConfigService is available, getting email config...\n")
   211			emailConfig, err := s.configService.GetActiveEmailConfig()
   212			if err != nil {
   213				fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Error getting email config: %v\n", err)
   214			} else if emailConfig == nil {
   215				fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Email config is nil (not configured)\n")
   216			} else {
   217				fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Email config loaded: host=%s, port=%d, from=%s\n", 
   218					emailConfig.SMTPHost, emailConfig.SMTPPort, emailConfig.FromEmail)
   219				
   220				subject := "您的反馈已收到回复 - Scholay"
   221				body := s.buildReplyEmailBody(feedback, replyContent)
   222	
   223				config := utils.EmailConfig{
   224					SMTPHost:     emailConfig.SMTPHost,
   225					SMTPPort:     emailConfig.SMTPPort,
   226					SMTPUser:     emailConfig.SMTPUser,
   227					SMTPPassword: emailConfig.SMTPPassword,
   228					FromEmail:    emailConfig.FromEmail,
   229					FromName:     emailConfig.FromName,
   230				}
   231	
   232				fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Sending email to %s...\n", feedback.Email)
   233				if err := utils.SendEmailWithTLS(config, []string{feedback.Email}, subject, body); err != nil {
   234					// 记录错误但不影响主流程
   235					fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] ✗ Failed to send reply email to %s: %v\n", feedback.Email, err)
   236				} else {
   237					fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] ✓ Reply email sent successfully to %s for feedback #%d\n", feedback.Email, id)
   238				}
   239			}
   240		} else {
   241			fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] ✗ ConfigService not set, skipping reply email for feedback #%d\n", id)
   242		}
   243	
   244		return nil
   245	}
