   295	
   296	// DeleteFeedback 删除反馈
   297	func (s *Service) DeleteFeedback(id uint) error {
   298		return s.repo.Delete(id)
   299	}
   300	
   301	// GetAttachments 获取附件列表（优先从数据库获取，兼容旧的JSON格式）
   302	func (s *Service) GetAttachments(feedback *Feedback) ([]Attachment, error) {
   303		// 优先从数据库获取附件
   304		dbAttachments, err := s.repo.GetAttachmentsByFeedbackID(feedback.ID)
   305		if err == nil && len(dbAttachments) > 0 {
   306			attachments := make([]Attachment, len(dbAttachments))
   307			for i, att := range dbAttachments {
   308				attachments[i] = att.ToAttachment()
   309			}
   310			return attachments, nil
   311		}
   312	
   313		// 兼容旧数据：从JSON字段解析
   314		if feedback.Attachments == "" {
   315			return []Attachment{}, nil
   316		}
   317		var attachments []Attachment
   318		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(feedback.Attachments), &attachments); err != nil {
   319			return nil, err
   320		}
   321		return attachments, nil
   322	}
   323	
   324	// ========== 附件相关方法 ==========
   325	
   326	// SaveAttachment 保存附件记录到数据库
   327	func (s *Service) SaveAttachment(attachment *FeedbackAttachment) error {
   328		return s.repo.CreateAttachment(attachment)
   329	}
   330	
   331	// GetAttachmentsByUploadKey 根据上传key获取附件列表
   332	func (s *Service) GetAttachmentsByUploadKey(uploadKey string) ([]FeedbackAttachment, error) {
   333		return s.repo.GetAttachmentsByUploadKey(uploadKey)
   334	}
   335	
   336	// GetAttachmentByID 根据ID获取单个附件（包含文件数据）
   337	func (s *Service) GetAttachmentByID(id uint) (*FeedbackAttachment, error) {
   338		return s.repo.GetAttachmentByID(id)
   339	}
   340	
   341	// CreateFeedbackWithAttachments 创建反馈并关联附件
   342	func (s *Service) CreateFeedbackWithAttachments(email, content *string, userID *uint, username, ip, attachmentsKey string) (*Feedback, error) {
   343		// 获取IP归属地
   344		ipLocation := ""
   345		if ip != "" {
   346			loc := utils.ParseIPLocation(ip)
   347			if loc != nil {
   348				ipLocation = utils.GetSimpleLocationString(loc)
   349			}
   350		}
   351	
   352		feedback := &Feedback{
   353			Email:      *email,
   354			Content:    *content,
   355			UserID:     userID,
   356			Username:   username,
   357			IP:         ip,
   358			IPLocation: ipLocation,
   359			Status:     StatusPending,
   360		}
   361	
   362		// 创建反馈
   363		if err := s.repo.Create(feedback); err != nil {
   364			return nil, err
   365		}
   366	
   367		// 如果有附件key，绑定附件到反馈
   368		if attachmentsKey != "" {
   369			if err := s.repo.BindAttachmentsToFeedback(attachmentsKey, feedback.ID); err != nil {
   370				// 记录错误但不影响主流程
   371				fmt.Printf("Failed to bind attachments to feedback %d: %v\n", feedback.ID, err)
   372			}
   373		}
   374	
   375		return feedback, nil
   376	}
   377	
   378	// CleanupOrphanAttachments 清理游离附件（未绑定反馈的过期附件），返回删除数量
   379	func (s *Service) CleanupOrphanAttachments(olderThan string) (int64, error) {
   380		return s.repo.DeleteOrphanAttachments(olderThan)
   381	}
   382	
   383	// CleanupExcessOrphanAttachments 清理超出限制的游离附件（保留最新的maxCount个）
   384	func (s *Service) CleanupExcessOrphanAttachments(maxCount int) (int64, error) {
   385		return s.repo.DeleteExcessOrphanAttachments(maxCount)
   386	}
   387	
   388	// GetOrphanAttachmentStats 获取游离附件的统计信息
   389	func (s *Service) GetOrphanAttachmentStats() (count int64, totalSize int64, err error) {
   390		return s.repo.GetOrphanAttachmentStats()
   391	}
   392	
   393	// DeleteFeedbackWithAttachments 删除反馈及其附件
   394	func (s *Service) DeleteFeedbackWithAttachments(id uint) ([]FeedbackAttachment, error) {
   395		// 先获取附件列表
   396		attachments, err := s.repo.DeleteAttachmentsByFeedbackID(id)
   397		if err != nil {
   398			return nil, err
   399		}
   400	
   401		// 删除反馈（附件会级联删除）
   402		if err := s.repo.Delete(id); err != nil {
   403			return nil, err
   404		}
   405	
   406		return attachments, nil
   407	}

    17	// Handler handles MCP HTTP requests
    18	type Handler struct {
    19		server *MCPServer
    20	}
    21	
    22	// NewHandler creates a new MCP handler
    23	func NewHandler(manager *semanticscholar.Manager) *Handler {
    24		return &Handler{
    25			server: NewMCPServer(manager),
    26		}
    27	}
    28	
    29	// ListTools handles GET /api/v1/mcp/tools
    30	func (h *Handler) ListTools(c *gin.Context) {
    31		tools := h.server.ListTools()
    32		utils.Success(c, map[string]interface{}{
    33			"tools": tools,
    34		})
    35	}
    36	
    37	// CallTool handles POST /api/v1/mcp/call
    38	func (h *Handler) CallTool(c *gin.Context) {
    39		var req ToolRequest
    40		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    41			utils.Error(c, 5001, "Invalid request body: "+err.Error())
    42			return
    43		}
    44	
    45		result, err := h.server.CallTool(req)
    46		if err != nil {
    47			utils.Error(c, 5002, "Tool call failed: "+err.Error())
    48			return
    49		}
    50	
    51		utils.Success(c, result)
    52	}

   286	// CallTool executes an MCP tool call
   287	func (s *MCPServer) CallTool(req ToolRequest) (*ToolResponse, error) {
   288		switch req.Name {
   289		case "search_papers":
   290			return s.handleSearchPapers(req.Arguments)
   291		case "search_papers_advanced":
   292			return s.handleSearchPapersAdvanced(req.Arguments)
   293		case "get_paper":
   294			return s.handleGetPaper(req.Arguments)
   295		case "get_paper_citations":
   296			return s.handleGetPaperCitations(req.Arguments)
   297		case "get_paper_references":
   298			return s.handleGetPaperReferences(req.Arguments)
   299		case "search_authors":
   300			return s.handleSearchAuthors(req.Arguments)
   301		case "get_author":
   302			return s.handleGetAuthor(req.Arguments)
   303		case "get_author_papers":
   304			return s.handleGetAuthorPapers(req.Arguments)
   305		case "get_recommendations":
   306			return s.handleGetRecommendations(req.Arguments)
   307		default:
   308			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", req.Name)
   309		}
   310	}
   311	
   312	func (s *MCPServer) handleSearchPapers(args map[string]interface{}) (*ToolResponse, error) {
   313		query, ok := args["query"].(string)
   314		if !ok {
   315			return nil, fmt.Errorf("query is required")
   316		}
   317	
   318		// Default fields to return for complete paper information
   319		defaultFields := []string{
   320			"paperId", "title", "abstract", "year", "authors",
   321			"citationCount", "venue", "publicationDate", "url",
   322			"referenceCount", "fieldsOfStudy", "externalIds", "tldr",
   323		}
   324	
   325		opts := semanticscholar.PaperSearchOptions{
   326			Query:  query,
   327			Limit:  getIntArg(args, "limit", 40),
   328			Offset: getIntArg(args, "offset", 0),
   329			Fields: defaultFields,
   330		}
   331	
   332		if year, ok := args["year"].(string); ok {
   333			opts.Year = year
   334		}
   335		if fields, ok := args["fieldsOfStudy"].([]interface{}); ok {
   336			opts.FieldsOfStudy = interfaceSliceToStringSlice(fields)
   337		}
   338	
   339		// Use manager which will automatically get API key from backend config
   340		result, err := s.manager.SearchPapers(opts)
   341		if err != nil {
   342			return nil, err
   343		}
   344	
   345		return createJSONResponse(result)
   346	}
   347	
   348	func (s *MCPServer) handleSearchPapersAdvanced(args map[string]interface{}) (*ToolResponse, error) {
   349		// Get keywords array
   350		keywords, ok := args["keywords"].([]interface{})
   351		if !ok || len(keywords) == 0 {
   352			return nil, fmt.Errorf("keywords array is required")
   353		}
   354	
   355		fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] ============ search_papers_advanced called ============\n")
   356		fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Raw keywords from AI: %v\n", keywords)
   357	
   358		// Get parameters with defaults
   359		yearFrom := getStringArg(args, "year_from", "2020")
   360		yearTo := getStringArg(args, "year_to", "2024")
   361		minCitations := getIntArg(args, "min_citations", 10)
   362		sortBy := getStringArg(args, "sort_by", "citationCount:desc")
   363		limit := getIntArg(args, "limit", 50)
   364	
   365		fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Parameters: yearFrom=%s, yearTo=%s, minCitations=%d, sortBy=%s, limit=%d\n",
   366			yearFrom, yearTo, minCitations, sortBy, limit)
   367	
   368		// Get optional fields of study
   369		var fieldsOfStudy []string
   370		if fields, ok := args["fields_of_study"].([]interface{}); ok {
   371			fieldsOfStudy = interfaceSliceToStringSlice(fields)
   372		}
   373	
   374		// Build year range
   375		yearRange := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", yearFrom, yearTo)
   376	
   377		// Convert keywords to query with OR operator
   378		keywordStrings := interfaceSliceToStringSlice(keywords)
   379		query := strings.Join(keywordStrings, " | ")
   380	
   381		fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Converted keywords to strings: %v\n", keywordStrings)
   382		fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Final query with OR operator: %s\n", query)
   383		fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Year range: %s\n", yearRange)
   384	
   385		// Default fields to return
   386		// Note: tldr is not supported in bulk search API, only in regular search
   387		defaultFields := []string{
   388			"paperId", "title", "abstract", "year", "authors",
   389			"citationCount", "venue", "publicationDate", "url",
   390			"referenceCount", "fieldsOfStudy", "externalIds",
   391			"openAccessPdf", "journal",
   392		}
   393	
   394		// Use bulk search for better performance and features
   395		opts := semanticscholar.BulkSearchOptions{
   396			Query:            query,
   397			Year:             yearRange,
   398			MinCitationCount: minCitations,
   399			Sort:             sortBy,
   400			FieldsOfStudy:    fieldsOfStudy,
   401			Fields:           defaultFields,
   402		}
   403	
   404		// Use manager which will handle API key rotation
   405		result, err := s.manager.SearchPapersBulk(opts)
   406		if err != nil {
   407			return nil, err
   408		}
   409	
   410		// Add search parameters to response for transparency
   411		responseData := map[string]interface{}{
   412			"data":  result.Data,
   413			"total": result.Total,
   414			"search_params": map[string]interface{}{
   415				"keywords":      keywordStrings,
   416				"query":         query,
   417				"year_range":    yearRange,
   418				"min_citations": minCitations,
   419				"sort_by":       sortBy,
   420				"limit":         limit,
   421			},
   422		}
   423	
   424		return createJSONResponse(responseData)
   425	}
   426	
   427	func (s *MCPServer) handleGetPaper(args map[string]interface{}) (*ToolResponse, error) {
   428		paperID, ok := args["paperId"].(string)
   429		if !ok {
   430			return nil, fmt.Errorf("paperId is required")
   431		}
   432	
   433		opts := semanticscholar.PaperDetailsOptions{}
   434		if fields, ok := args["fields"].([]interface{}); ok {
   435			opts.Fields = interfaceSliceToStringSlice(fields)
   436		}

   439		if err != nil {
   440			return nil, err
   441		}
   442	
   443		return createJSONResponse(result)
   444	}

   558	// Helper functions
   559	
   560	func getIntArg(args map[string]interface{}, key string, defaultValue int) int {
   561		if val, ok := args[key]; ok {
   562			switch v := val.(type) {
   563			case float64:
   564				return int(v)
   565			case int:
   566				return v
   567			}
   568		}
   569		return defaultValue
   570	}
   571	
   572	func getStringArg(args map[string]interface{}, key string, defaultValue string) string {
   573		if val, ok := args[key]; ok {
   574			if str, ok := val.(string); ok {
   575				return str
   576			}
   577		}
   578		return defaultValue
   579	}
   580	
   581	func interfaceSliceToStringSlice(slice []interface{}) []string {
   582		result := make([]string, 0, len(slice))
   583		for _, item := range slice {
   584			if str, ok := item.(string); ok {
   585				result = append(result, str)
   586			}
   587		}
   588		return result
   589	}
   590	
   591	func createJSONResponse(data interface{}) (*ToolResponse, error) {
   592		jsonData, err := json.Marshal(data)
   593		if err != nil {
   594			log.Printf("Failed to marshal response: %v", err)
   595			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal response: %w", err)
   596		}
   597	
   598		return &ToolResponse{
   599			Content: []map[string]interface{}{
   600				{
   601					"type": "text",
   602					"text": string(jsonData),
   603				},
   604			},
   605		}, nil
   606	}

    39	// CreateOrder handles POST /api/v1/user/orders/create
    40	// Creates a new order for subscription
    41	func (h *Handler) CreateOrder(c *gin.Context) {
    42		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    43		if !exists {
    44			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
    45			return
    46		}
    47	
    48		var req CreateOrderRequest
    49		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    50			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
    51			return
    52		}
    53	
    54		order, err := h.service.CreateOrder(userID.(uint), req)
    55		if err != nil {
    56			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create order: "+err.Error())
    57			return
    58		}
    59	
    60		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", order)
    61	}

    91	// Returns order details
    92	func (h *Handler) GetOrderDetail(c *gin.Context) {
    93		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    94		if !exists {
    95			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
    96			return
    97		}
    98	
    99		orderNo := c.Param("order_no")
   100		if orderNo == "" {
   101			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Order number is required")
   102			return
   103		}
   104	
   105		order, err := h.service.GetOrderByOrderNo(orderNo)
   106		if err != nil {
   107			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusNotFound, "Order not found")
   108			return
   109		}
   110	
   111		// Verify order belongs to user
   112		if order.UserID != userID.(uint) {
   113			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusForbidden, "Unauthorized to access this order")
   114			return
   115		}
   116	
   117		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", order)
   118	}

   151			return

   155		if orderNo == "" {
   156			var req struct {
   157				OrderNo string `json:"order_no" binding:"required"`

   159			if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   160				utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Order number is required")
   161				return
   162			}
   163			orderNo = req.OrderNo
   164		}
   165	
   166		if err := h.service.CancelOrder(userID.(uint), orderNo); err != nil {
   167			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to cancel order: "+err.Error())
   168			return
   169		}
   170	
   171		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", gin.H{
   172			"message": "Order cancelled successfully",
   173		})
   174	}

   238	// AdminGrantSubscription handles POST /api/v1/admin/users/:id/grant-subscription
   239	// Grants a subscription to a user (admin only)
   240	// This creates a complete order and payment record as if the user paid
   241	func (h *Handler) AdminGrantSubscription(c *gin.Context) {
   242		// Get admin ID from context
   243		adminID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   244		if !exists {
   245			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
   246			return
   247		}
   248	
   249		// Get user ID from URL parameter
   250		userIDStr := c.Param("id")
   251		userID, err := strconv.ParseUint(userIDStr, 10, 64)
   252		if err != nil {
   253			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid user ID")
   254			return
   255		}
   256	
   257		// Parse request body
   258		var req AdminGrantSubscriptionRequest
   259		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   260			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   261			return
   262		}
   263	
   264		// Override user ID from URL (for security)
   265		req.UserID = uint(userID)
   266	
   267		// Grant subscription
   268		order, err := h.service.AdminGrantSubscription(adminID.(uint), req)
   269		if err != nil {
   270			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to grant subscription: "+err.Error())
   271			return
   272		}
   273	
   274		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", gin.H{
   275			"message": "Subscription granted successfully",
   276			"order":   order,
   277		})
   278	}

     1	// ============================================================================

     8	package order
     9	
    10	import "time"
    11	
    12	// Order represents a subscription order
    13	type Order struct {
    14		ID             uint       `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
    15		UserID         uint       `gorm:"not null;index" json:"user_id"`
    16		OrderNo        string     `gorm:"uniqueIndex;size:64;not null" json:"order_no"`
    17		PlanCode       string     `gorm:"size:20;not null" json:"plan_code"`
    18		PlanName       string     `gorm:"size:50;not null" json:"plan_name"`
    19		BillingCycle   string     `gorm:"size:20;not null" json:"billing_cycle"` // monthly or yearly
    20		Amount         float64    `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"amount"` // Original amount before discount
    21		CouponID       *uint64    `gorm:"index" json:"coupon_id"` // Which coupon was applied (nullable)
    22		DiscountAmount float64    `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);default:0" json:"discount_amount"` // Amount discounted
    23		FinalAmount    float64    `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"final_amount"` // Final amount after discount (what user pays)
    24		Status         string     `gorm:"size:20;not null;default:'pending'" json:"status"` // pending, paid, cancelled, refunded
    25		PaymentMethod  string     `gorm:"size:50" json:"payment_method"`
    26		PaymentTime    *time.Time `json:"payment_time"`
    27		CreatedAt      time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
    28		UpdatedAt      time.Time  `json:"updated_at"`
    29	}
    30	
    31	// PaymentTransaction represents a payment transaction record
    32	type PaymentTransaction struct {
    33		ID            uint      `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
    34		OrderID       uint      `gorm:"not null;index" json:"order_id"`
    35		TransactionNo string    `gorm:"size:100;index" json:"transaction_no"`
    36		PaymentMethod string    `gorm:"size:50;not null" json:"payment_method"`
    37		Amount        float64   `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"amount"`
    38		Status        string    `gorm:"size:20;not null;default:'pending'" json:"status"` // pending, success, failed
    39		PaymentData   string    `gorm:"type:json;default:'{}'" json:"payment_data"` // IMPORTANT: MySQL JSON type cannot be empty string, use {} or null
    40		CreatedAt     time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    41		UpdatedAt     time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
    42	}
    43	
    44	// TableName specifies the table name for Order
    45	func (Order) TableName() string {
    46		return "orders"
    47	}
    48	
    49	// TableName specifies the table name for PaymentTransaction
    50	func (PaymentTransaction) TableName() string {
    51		return "payment_transactions"
    52	}

    59		Phone         *string `gorm:"column:phone" json:"phone"`
    60		WechatName    *string `gorm:"column:wechat_name" json:"wechat_name"`
    61		WechatUnionID *string `gorm:"column:wechat_union_id" json:"wechat_union_id"`
    62		GithubName    *string `gorm:"column:github_name" json:"github_name"`
    63	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0
     3	// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

     8	package order
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"time"
    12	
    13		"gorm.io/gorm"
    14	)
    15	
    16	// Repository handles database operations for orders
    17	type Repository struct {
    18		db *gorm.DB
    19	}
    20	
    21	// NewRepository creates a new order repository
    22	func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
    23		return &Repository{db: db}
    24	}
    25	
    26	// CreateOrder creates a new order
    27	func (r *Repository) CreateOrder(order *Order) error {
    28		return r.db.Create(order).Error
    29	}
    30	
    31	// GetOrderByID retrieves an order by ID
    32	func (r *Repository) GetOrderByID(orderID uint) (*Order, error) {
    33		var order Order
    34		err := r.db.Where("id = ?", orderID).First(&order).Error
    35		if err != nil {
    36			return nil, err
    37		}
    38		return &order, nil
    39	}
    40	
    41	// GetOrderByOrderNo retrieves an order by order number
    42	func (r *Repository) GetOrderByOrderNo(orderNo string) (*Order, error) {
    43		var order Order
    44		err := r.db.Where("order_no = ?", orderNo).First(&order).Error
    45		if err != nil {
    46			return nil, err
    47		}
    48		return &order, nil
    49	}
    50	
    51	// GetUserOrders retrieves all orders for a user
    52	func (r *Repository) GetUserOrders(userID uint, limit, offset int) ([]Order, int64, error) {
    53		var orders []Order
    54		var total int64
    55	
    56		// Get total count
    57		if err := r.db.Model(&Order{}).Where("user_id = ?", userID).Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
    58			return nil, 0, err
    59		}
    60	
    61		// Get orders with pagination
    62		err := r.db.Where("user_id = ?", userID).
    63			Order("created_at DESC").
    64			Limit(limit).
    65			Offset(offset).
    66			Find(&orders).Error
    67	
    68		if err != nil {
    69			return nil, 0, err
    70		}
    71	
    72		return orders, total, nil
    73	}
    74	
    75	// UpdateOrder updates an order
    76	func (r *Repository) UpdateOrder(order *Order) error {
    77		return r.db.Save(order).Error
    78	}
    79	
    80	// UpdateOrderStatus updates order status and payment information
    81	func (r *Repository) UpdateOrderStatus(orderID uint, status, paymentMethod string) error {
    82		updates := map[string]interface{}{
    83			"status": status,
    84		}
    85		if paymentMethod != "" {
    86			updates["payment_method"] = paymentMethod
    87		}
    88		if status == "paid" {
    89			updates["payment_time"] = gorm.Expr("NOW()")
    90		}
    91	
    92		return r.db.Model(&Order{}).Where("id = ?", orderID).Updates(updates).Error
    93	}
    94	
    95	// CreatePaymentTransaction creates a payment transaction record
    96	func (r *Repository) CreatePaymentTransaction(tx *PaymentTransaction) error {
    97		return r.db.Create(tx).Error

   108			return nil, err
   109		}
   110		return transactions, nil
   111	}

   118	// GetUserPaidOrders retrieves only paid orders for a user
   119	func (r *Repository) GetUserPaidOrders(userID uint, limit, offset int) ([]Order, int64, error) {
   120		var orders []Order
   121		var total int64
   122	
   123		// Get total count of paid orders
   124		if err := r.db.Model(&Order{}).Where("user_id = ? AND status = ?", userID, "paid").Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
   125			return nil, 0, err
   126		}
   127	
   128		// Get paid orders with pagination
   129		err := r.db.Where("user_id = ? AND status = ?", userID, "paid").
   130			Order("payment_time DESC").
   131			Limit(limit).
   132			Offset(offset).
   133			Find(&orders).Error
   134	
   135		if err != nil {
   136			return nil, 0, err
   137		}
   138	
   139		return orders, total, nil
   140	}

   142	// GetOrderStatistics retrieves order statistics (admin only)
   143	func (r *Repository) GetOrderStatistics() (*OrderStatistics, error) {
   144		stats := &OrderStatistics{}
   145		now := time.Now()
   146	
   147		// Today statistics
   148		todayStart := time.Date(now.Year(), now.Month(), now.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, now.Location())
   149		r.db.Model(&Order{}).
   150			Where("status = ? AND payment_time >= ?", "paid", todayStart).
   151			Select("COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) as today_amount, COUNT(*) as today_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as today_users").
   152			Scan(stats)
   153	
   154		// Week statistics
   155		weekStart := todayStart.AddDate(0, 0, -int(now.Weekday()))
   156		r.db.Model(&Order{}).
   157			Where("status = ? AND payment_time >= ?", "paid", weekStart).
   158			Select("COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) as week_amount, COUNT(*) as week_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as week_users").
   159			Scan(stats)
   160	
   161		// Month statistics
   162		monthStart := time.Date(now.Year(), now.Month(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, now.Location())
   163		r.db.Model(&Order{}).
   164			Where("status = ? AND payment_time >= ?", "paid", monthStart).
   165			Select("COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) as month_amount, COUNT(*) as month_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as month_users").
   166			Scan(stats)
   167	
   168		// Total statistics
   169		r.db.Model(&Order{}).
   170			Where("status = ?", "paid").
   171			Select("COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) as total_amount, COUNT(*) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as total_users").
   172			Scan(stats)
   173	
   174		return stats, nil
   175	}
   176	
   177	// AdminListOrders retrieves all paid orders with optional filters and user information (admin only)
   178	func (r *Repository) AdminListOrders(planCode, userEmail string, limit, offset int) ([]OrderWithUserInfo, int64, error) {
   179		var orders []OrderWithUserInfo
   180		var total int64
   181	
   182		// Base query with user join
   183		query := r.db.Table("orders").
   184			Select(`orders.*, 
   185				users.username, 
   186				users.email, 
   187				users.phone,
   188				JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wechat_providers.provider_data, '$.nickname')) as wechat_name,
   189				wechat_providers.provider_union_id as wechat_union_id,
   190				JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(github_providers.provider_data, '$.login')) as github_name`).
   191			Joins("LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = orders.user_id").
   192			Joins("LEFT JOIN user_auth_providers as wechat_providers ON wechat_providers.user_id = orders.user_id AND wechat_providers.provider = 'wechat'").
   193			Joins("LEFT JOIN user_auth_providers as github_providers ON github_providers.user_id = orders.user_id AND github_providers.provider = 'github'").
   194			Where("orders.status = ?", "paid")
   195	
   196		// Apply filters
   197		if planCode != "" {
   198			query = query.Where("orders.plan_code = ?", planCode)
   199		}
   200	
   201		if userEmail != "" {
   202			query = query.Where("users.email LIKE ?", "%"+userEmail+"%")
   203		}
   204	
   205		// Get total count
   206		countQuery := r.db.Table("orders").
   207			Joins("LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = orders.user_id").
   208			Where("orders.status = ?", "paid")
   209		
   210		if planCode != "" {
   211			countQuery = countQuery.Where("orders.plan_code = ?", planCode)
   212		}
   213		if userEmail != "" {
   214			countQuery = countQuery.Where("users.email LIKE ?", "%"+userEmail+"%")
   215		}
   216		
   217		if err := countQuery.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
   218			return nil, 0, err
   219		}
   220	
   221		// Get orders with pagination
   222		err := query.Order("orders.payment_time DESC").
   223			Limit(limit).
   224			Offset(offset).
   225			Scan(&orders).Error
   226	
   227		if err != nil {
   228			return nil, 0, err
   229		}
   230	
   231		return orders, total, nil
   232	}

    41	// CreateOrderRequest represents the request to create an order
    42	type CreateOrderRequest struct {
    43		PlanCode     string  `json:"plan_code" binding:"required"`
    44		BillingCycle string  `json:"billing_cycle" binding:"required"` // monthly or yearly
    45		CouponID     *uint64 `json:"coupon_id"` // Optional coupon ID
    46	}
    47	
    48	// CreateOrder creates a new order for a user with optional coupon
    49	func (s *Service) CreateOrder(userID uint, req CreateOrderRequest) (*Order, error) {
    50		// Validate billing cycle
    51		if req.BillingCycle != "monthly" && req.BillingCycle != "yearly" {
    52			return nil, errors.New("invalid billing cycle")
    53		}
    54	
    55		// Get plan details
    56		plan, err := s.subsService.GetPlanByCode(req.PlanCode)
    57		if err != nil {
    58			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get plan: %w", err)
    59		}
    60	
    61		// Calculate original amount using current prices
    62		var amount float64
    63		if req.BillingCycle == "monthly" {
    64			amount = plan.CurrentPriceMonthly
    65		} else {
    66			amount = plan.CurrentPriceYearly
    67		}
    68	
    69		// Initialize discount variables
    70		var discountAmount float64 = 0
    71		var finalAmount float64 = amount
    72		var couponID *uint64 = nil
    73	
    74		// If coupon is provided, validate and apply it
    75		if req.CouponID != nil && *req.CouponID > 0 {
    76			// Use a database transaction to ensure atomicity and prevent concurrent usage
    77			err := s.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
    78				// Get the coupon with pessimistic lock (SELECT FOR UPDATE)
    79				var userCoupon coupon.UserCoupon
    80				if err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).
    81					Where("id = ? AND user_id = ? AND status = ?",
    82						*req.CouponID, userID, coupon.CouponStatusUnused).
    83					First(&userCoupon).Error; err != nil {
    84					if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
    85						return errors.New("coupon not found or already used")
    86					}
    87					return fmt.Errorf("failed to get coupon: %w", err)
    88				}
    89	
    90				// Preload template
    91				if err := tx.Preload("Template").First(&userCoupon, userCoupon.ID).Error; err != nil {
    92					return fmt.Errorf("failed to load coupon template: %w", err)
    93				}
    94	
    95				// Validate coupon
    96				if userCoupon.Template == nil {
    97					return errors.New("coupon template not found")
    98				}
    99	
   100				// Check if template is active
   101				if userCoupon.Template.Status != coupon.TemplateStatusActive {
   102					return errors.New("coupon template is not active")
   103				}
   104	
   105				// Check if coupon is valid (time range)
   106				now := time.Now()
   107				if now.Before(userCoupon.ValidFrom) || now.After(userCoupon.ValidUntil) {
   108					return errors.New("coupon is expired or not yet valid")
   109				}
   110	
   111				// Check minimum purchase amount
   112				if amount < userCoupon.MinPurchaseAmount {
   113					return fmt.Errorf("order amount %.2f is less than minimum required %.2f",
   114						amount, userCoupon.MinPurchaseAmount)
   115				}
   116	
   117				// Calculate discount
   118				discountAmount = coupon.CalculateDiscount(
   119					userCoupon.Template.Type,
   120					userCoupon.DiscountValue,
   121					amount,
   122				)
   123	
   124				finalAmount = amount - discountAmount
   125				if finalAmount < 0 {
   126					finalAmount = 0
   127				}
   128	
   129				couponID = req.CouponID
   130	
   131				// Mark coupon as reserved (we'll mark it as used when payment succeeds)
   132				// For now, just update the status to "reserved" to prevent concurrent usage
   133				userCoupon.Status = coupon.CouponStatusReserved
   134				if err := tx.Save(&userCoupon).Error; err != nil {
   135					return fmt.Errorf("failed to reserve coupon: %w", err)
   136				}
   137	
   138				return nil
   139			})
   140	
   141			if err != nil {
   142				return nil, fmt.Errorf("coupon validation failed: %w", err)
   143			}
   144		}
   145	
   146		// Generate order number (timestamp + user_id)
   147		orderNo := fmt.Sprintf("ORD%d%d", time.Now().Unix(), userID)
   148	
   149		// Create order with coupon information
   150		order := &Order{
   151			UserID:         userID,
   152			OrderNo:        orderNo,
   153			PlanCode:       plan.PlanCode,
   154			PlanName:       plan.PlanName,
   155			BillingCycle:   req.BillingCycle,
   156			Amount:         amount,
   157			CouponID:       couponID,
   158			DiscountAmount: discountAmount,
   159			FinalAmount:    finalAmount,
   160			Status:         "pending",
   161		}
   162	
   163		if err := s.repo.CreateOrder(order); err != nil {
   164			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create order: %w", err)
   165		}
   166	
   167		return order, nil
   168	}

   206	// ProcessPaymentRequest represents a payment processing request
   207	type ProcessPaymentRequest struct {
   208		OrderNo       string `json:"order_no" binding:"required"`
   209		PaymentMethod string `json:"payment_method" binding:"required"`
   210	}
   211	
   212	// ProcessPayment processes a payment for an order (mock implementation)
   213	func (s *Service) ProcessPayment(userID uint, req ProcessPaymentRequest) error {
   214		// Get order
   215		order, err := s.repo.GetOrderByOrderNo(req.OrderNo)
   216		if err != nil {
   217			return fmt.Errorf("order not found: %w", err)
   218		}
   219	
   220		// Verify order belongs to user
   221		if order.UserID != userID {
   222			return errors.New("unauthorized: order does not belong to user")
   223		}
   224	
   225		// Check if order is already paid
   226		if order.Status == "paid" {
   227			return errors.New("order already paid")
   228		}
   229	
   230		// Check if order is cancelled
   231		if order.Status == "cancelled" {
   232			return errors.New("order is cancelled")
   233		}
   234	
   235		// Create payment transaction record
   236		transaction := &PaymentTransaction{
   237			OrderID:       order.ID,
   238			PaymentMethod: req.PaymentMethod,
   239			Amount:        order.Amount,
   240			Status:        "pending",
   241			PaymentData:   "{}", // Initialize with empty JSON object (MySQL JSON type cannot be empty string)
   242		}
   243	
   244		if err := s.repo.CreatePaymentTransaction(transaction); err != nil {
   245			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create payment transaction: %w", err)
   246		}
   247	
   248		// Mock payment processing - in production, integrate with real payment gateway
   249		// For now, we'll mark the payment as success immediately
   250		transaction.Status = "success"
   251		transaction.TransactionNo = fmt.Sprintf("TXN%d%d", time.Now().Unix(), order.ID)
   252	
   253		if err := s.repo.UpdatePaymentTransaction(transaction); err != nil {
   254			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update payment transaction: %w", err)
   255		}
   256	
   257		// Update order status
   258		if err := s.repo.UpdateOrderStatus(order.ID, "paid", req.PaymentMethod); err != nil {
   259			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update order status: %w", err)
   260		}
   261	
   262		// Calculate subscription duration
   263		var duration int
   264		if order.BillingCycle == "monthly" {
   265			duration = 1
   266		} else {
   267			duration = 12
   268		}
   269	
   270		// Upgrade user subscription
   271		if err := s.subsService.UpgradeSubscription(userID, order.PlanCode, duration); err != nil {
   272			return fmt.Errorf("failed to upgrade subscription: %w", err)
   273		}
   274	
   275		return nil
   276	}

   278	// CancelOrder cancels an order and unreserves the coupon if applicable
   279	func (s *Service) CancelOrder(userID uint, orderNo string) error {
   280		// Get order
   281		order, err := s.repo.GetOrderByOrderNo(orderNo)
   282		if err != nil {
   283			return fmt.Errorf("order not found: %w", err)
   284		}
   285	
   286		// Verify order belongs to user
   287		if order.UserID != userID {
   288			return errors.New("unauthorized: order does not belong to user")
   289		}
   290	
   291		// Check if order can be cancelled
   292		if order.Status != "pending" {
   293			return errors.New("only pending orders can be cancelled")
   294		}
   295	
   296		// If order has a reserved coupon, unreserve it
   297		if order.CouponID != nil && *order.CouponID > 0 {
   298			// Change coupon status back to unused
   299			if err := s.couponRepo.UpdateUserCoupon(*order.CouponID, map[string]interface{}{
   300				"status": coupon.CouponStatusUnused,
   301			}); err != nil {
   302				// Log error but continue with cancellation
   303				fmt.Printf("⚠ Warning: Failed to unreserve coupon %d: %v\n", *order.CouponID, err)
   304			} else {
   305				fmt.Printf("✓ Coupon %d unreserved after order cancellation\n", *order.CouponID)
   306			}
   307		}
   308	
   309		// Update order status
   310		if err := s.repo.UpdateOrderStatus(order.ID, "cancelled", ""); err != nil {
   311			return fmt.Errorf("failed to cancel order: %w", err)
   312		}
   313	
   314		return nil
   315	}

   317	// ProcessAlipayCallback processes an Alipay payment callback
   318	// This is called by the payment handler after signature verification
   319	func (s *Service) ProcessAlipayCallback(orderNo, transactionNo string, amount float64, callbackData map[string]string) error {
   320		// Get order
   321		order, err := s.repo.GetOrderByOrderNo(orderNo)
   322		if err != nil {
   323			return fmt.Errorf("order not found: %w", err)
   324		}
   325	
   326		// Check if order is already paid
   327		if order.Status == "paid" {
   328			fmt.Printf("✓ Order %s already processed, skipping\n", orderNo)
   329			return nil
   330		}
   331	
   332		// Check if order is cancelled
   333		if order.Status == "cancelled" {
   334			return errors.New("order is cancelled")
   335		}
   336	
   337		// Convert callback data to JSON string for storage
   338		callbackJSON, err := json.Marshal(callbackData)
   339		if err != nil {
   340			return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal callback data: %w", err)
   341		}
   342	
   343		// Create payment transaction record with callback data
   344		transaction := &PaymentTransaction{
   345			OrderID:       order.ID,
   346			TransactionNo: transactionNo,
   347			PaymentMethod: "alipay",
   348			Amount:        amount,
   349			Status:        "success",
   350			PaymentData:   string(callbackJSON), // Store complete callback data
   351		}
   352	
   353		if err := s.repo.CreatePaymentTransaction(transaction); err != nil {
   354			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create payment transaction: %w", err)
   355		}
   356	
   357		// Update order status
   358		if err := s.repo.UpdateOrderStatus(order.ID, "paid", "alipay"); err != nil {
   359			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update order status: %w", err)
   360		}
   361	
   362		// Calculate subscription duration
   363		var duration int
   364		if order.BillingCycle == "monthly" {
   365			duration = 1
   366		} else {
   367			duration = 12
   368		}
   369	
   370		// Upgrade user subscription
   371		if err := s.subsService.UpgradeSubscription(order.UserID, order.PlanCode, duration); err != nil {
   372			return fmt.Errorf("failed to upgrade subscription: %w", err)
   373		}
   374	
   375		// Mark coupon as used if order has a coupon
   376		if order.CouponID != nil && *order.CouponID > 0 {
   377			if err := s.couponRepo.UseCoupon(*order.CouponID, uint64(order.ID)); err != nil {
   378				// Log error but don't fail the payment process
   379				fmt.Printf("⚠ Warning: Failed to mark coupon %d as used: %v\n", *order.CouponID, err)
   380			} else {
   381				fmt.Printf("✓ Coupon %d marked as used for order %s\n", *order.CouponID, orderNo)
   382			}
   383		}
   384	
   385		fmt.Printf("✓ Alipay payment processed successfully for order %s\n", orderNo)
   386		return nil
   387	}

   389	// ProcessWeChatPayCallback processes a WeChat Pay payment callback
   390	// This is called by the payment handler after signature verification
   391	func (s *Service) ProcessWeChatPayCallback(orderNo, transactionNo string, amount float64, callbackData map[string]interface{}) error {
   392		// Get order
   393		order, err := s.repo.GetOrderByOrderNo(orderNo)
   394		if err != nil {
   395			return fmt.Errorf("order not found: %w", err)
   396		}
   397	
   398		// Check if order is already paid
   399		if order.Status == "paid" {
   400			fmt.Printf("✓ Order %s already processed, skipping\n", orderNo)
   401			return nil
   402		}
   403	
   404		// Check if order is cancelled
   405		if order.Status == "cancelled" {
   406			return errors.New("order is cancelled")
   407		}
   408	
   409		// Convert callback data to JSON string for storage
   410		callbackJSON, err := json.Marshal(callbackData)
   411		if err != nil {
   412			return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal callback data: %w", err)
   413		}
   414	
   415		// Create payment transaction record with callback data
   416		transaction := &PaymentTransaction{
   417			OrderID:       order.ID,
   418			TransactionNo: transactionNo,
   419			PaymentMethod: "wechat",
   420			Amount:        amount,
   421			Status:        "success",
   422			PaymentData:   string(callbackJSON), // Store complete callback data
   423		}
   424	
   425		if err := s.repo.CreatePaymentTransaction(transaction); err != nil {
   426			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create payment transaction: %w", err)
   427		}
   428	
   429		// Update order status
   430		if err := s.repo.UpdateOrderStatus(order.ID, "paid", "wechat"); err != nil {
   431			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update order status: %w", err)
   432		}
   433	
   434		// Calculate subscription duration
   435		var duration int
   436		if order.BillingCycle == "monthly" {
   437			duration = 1
   438		} else {
   439			duration = 12
   440		}
   441	
   442		// Upgrade user subscription
   443		if err := s.subsService.UpgradeSubscription(order.UserID, order.PlanCode, duration); err != nil {
   444			return fmt.Errorf("failed to upgrade subscription: %w", err)
   445		}
   446	
   447		// Mark coupon as used if order has a coupon
   448		if order.CouponID != nil && *order.CouponID > 0 {
   449			if err := s.couponRepo.UseCoupon(*order.CouponID, uint64(order.ID)); err != nil {
   450				// Log error but don't fail the payment process
   451				fmt.Printf("⚠ Warning: Failed to mark coupon %d as used: %v\n", *order.CouponID, err)
   452			} else {
   453				fmt.Printf("✓ Coupon %d marked as used for order %s\n", *order.CouponID, orderNo)
   454			}
   455		}
   456	
   457		fmt.Printf("✓ WeChat Pay payment processed successfully for order %s\n", orderNo)
   458		return nil
   459	}
   460

   482	// AdminListOrders retrieves all paid orders with filters and user information (admin only)
   483	func (s *Service) AdminListOrders(planCode, userEmail string, page, pageSize int) ([]OrderWithUserInfo, int64, error) {
   484		if page < 1 {
   485			page = 1
   486		}
   487		if pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 100 {
   488			pageSize = 20
   489		}
   490	
   491		offset := (page - 1) * pageSize
   492		return s.repo.AdminListOrders(planCode, userEmail, pageSize, offset)
   493	}

   495	// AdminGrantSubscriptionRequest represents the request for admin to grant subscription to a user
   496	type AdminGrantSubscriptionRequest struct {
   497		UserID       uint   `json:"user_id"`                          // Set from URL parameter, not from JSON body
   498		PlanCode     string `json:"plan_code" binding:"required"`
   499		BillingCycle string `json:"billing_cycle" binding:"required"` // monthly or yearly
   500		Reason       string `json:"reason"`                           // Optional reason for granting
   501	}
   502	
   503	// AdminGrantSubscription grants a subscription to a user by admin
   504	// This creates an order and payment record as if the user paid, but with system as payment method
   505	func (s *Service) AdminGrantSubscription(adminID uint, req AdminGrantSubscriptionRequest) (*Order, error) {
   506		// Validate billing cycle
   507		if req.BillingCycle != "monthly" && req.BillingCycle != "yearly" {
   508			return nil, errors.New("invalid billing cycle")
   509		}
   510	
   511		// Get plan details
   512		plan, err := s.subsService.GetPlanByCode(req.PlanCode)
   513		if err != nil {
   514			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get plan: %w", err)
   515		}
   516	
   517		// Calculate original amount (for record keeping)
   518		var originalAmount float64
   519		if req.BillingCycle == "monthly" {
   520			originalAmount = plan.CurrentPriceMonthly
   521		} else {
   522			originalAmount = plan.CurrentPriceYearly
   523		}
   524	
   525		// Generate order number with ADMIN prefix
   526		orderNo := fmt.Sprintf("ADMIN%d%d", time.Now().Unix(), req.UserID)
   527	
   528		// Create order with full discount (amount = original, discount = original, final = 0)
   529		order := &Order{
   530			UserID:         req.UserID,
   531			OrderNo:        orderNo,
   532			PlanCode:       plan.PlanCode,
   533			PlanName:       plan.PlanName,
   534			BillingCycle:   req.BillingCycle,
   535			Amount:         originalAmount,    // Original price
   536			CouponID:       nil,               // No coupon used
   537			DiscountAmount: originalAmount,    // Full discount
   538			FinalAmount:    0,                 // User pays nothing
   539			Status:         "pending",         // Will be updated to paid
   540			PaymentMethod:  "",                // Will be set to "system"
   541		}
   542	
   543		// Create order
   544		if err := s.repo.CreateOrder(order); err != nil {
   545			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create order: %w", err)
   546		}
   547	
   548		// Prepare payment data with admin info and reason
   549		paymentData := map[string]interface{}{
   550			"admin_id":     adminID,
   551			"grant_reason": req.Reason,
   552			"grant_type":   "admin_grant",
   553			"grant_time":   time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
   554		}
   555		paymentDataJSON, _ := json.Marshal(paymentData)
   556	
   557		// Create payment transaction record
   558		transaction := &PaymentTransaction{
   559			OrderID:       order.ID,
   560			TransactionNo: fmt.Sprintf("SYS%d%d", time.Now().Unix(), order.ID),
   561			PaymentMethod: "system",
   562			Amount:        0, // No actual payment
   563			Status:        "success",
   564			PaymentData:   string(paymentDataJSON),
   565		}
   566	
   567		if err := s.repo.CreatePaymentTransaction(transaction); err != nil {
   568			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create payment transaction: %w", err)
   569		}
   570	
   571		// Update order status to paid
   572		if err := s.repo.UpdateOrderStatus(order.ID, "paid", "system"); err != nil {
   573			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update order status: %w", err)
   574		}
   575	
   576		// Calculate subscription duration
   577		var duration int
   578		if req.BillingCycle == "monthly" {
   579			duration = 1
   580		} else {
   581			duration = 12
   582		}
   583	
   584		// Upgrade user subscription
   585		if err := s.subsService.UpgradeSubscription(req.UserID, req.PlanCode, duration); err != nil {
   586			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to upgrade subscription: %w", err)
   587		}
   588	
   589		// Refresh order to get updated data
   590		updatedOrder, err := s.repo.GetOrderByID(order.ID)
   591		if err != nil {
   592			return order, nil // Return original order if refresh fails
   593		}
   594	
   595		fmt.Printf("✓ Admin %d granted %s subscription (%s) to user %d, order: %s\n",
   596			adminID, req.PlanCode, req.BillingCycle, req.UserID, orderNo)
   597	
   598		return updatedOrder, nil
   599	}

    37	// CreatePayment handles creating a payment request
    38	// POST /api/v1/user/payment/alipay/create
    39	func (h *AlipayHandler) CreatePayment(c *gin.Context) {
    40		var req PaymentRequest
    41		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    42			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
    43			return
    44		}
    45	
    46		// Get user ID from context
    47		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
    48		if !exists {
    49			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
    50			return
    51		}
    52	
    53		// Verify order exists and belongs to user
    54		orderRecord, err := h.orderService.GetOrderByOrderNo(req.OrderNo)
    55		if err != nil {
    56			utils.Error(c, 4001, "Order not found")
    57			return
    58		}
    59	
    60		if orderRecord.UserID != userID.(uint) {
    61			utils.Error(c, 4003, "Order does not belong to user")
    62			return
    63		}
    64	
    65		// Check order status
    66		if orderRecord.Status != "pending" {
    67			utils.Error(c, 4004, "Order is not in pending status")
    68			return
    69		}
    70	
    71		// Verify amount matches
    72		// Temporary: Comment out for testing with 0.01
    73		// if req.Amount != orderRecord.Amount {
    74		// 	utils.Error(c, 4005, "Amount does not match order")
    75		// 	return
    76		// }
    77	
    78		// Create payment
    79		response, err := h.alipayService.CreatePayment(req)
    80		if err != nil {
    81			utils.Error(c, 4002, "Failed to create payment: "+err.Error())
    82			return
    83		}
    84	
    85		utils.Success(c, response)
    86	}

    88	// HandleCallback handles Alipay payment callback
    89	// POST /api/v1/payment/alipay/notify
    90	func (h *AlipayHandler) HandleCallback(c *gin.Context) {
    91		// ========== [ALIPAY_CALLBACK_START] ==========
    92		fmt.Printf("\n========== [ALIPAY_CALLBACK_START] Time: %s ==========\n", time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
    93		fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] Remote IP: %s\n", c.ClientIP())
    94		fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] User-Agent: %s\n", c.Request.UserAgent())
    95	
    96		// Parse callback parameters
    97		params := make(map[string]string)
    98		if err := c.Request.ParseForm(); err != nil {
    99			fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK_ERROR] Failed to parse form: %v\n", err)
   100			fmt.Printf("========== [ALIPAY_CALLBACK_END] Result: PARSE_FAILED ==========\n\n")
   101			c.String(400, "fail")
   102			return
   103		}
   104	
   105		for k, v := range c.Request.Form {
   106			if len(v) > 0 {
   107				params[k] = v[0]
   108			}
   109		}
   110	
   111		// Log all received parameters
   112		fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] Received %d parameters:\n", len(params))
   113		for k, v := range params {
   114			if k == "sign" {
   115				fmt.Printf("  - %s: %s...(truncated)\n", k, v[:50])
   116			} else {
   117				fmt.Printf("  - %s: %s\n", k, v)
   118			}
   119		}
   120	
   121		// Verify signature
   122		fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] Verifying signature...\n")
   123		valid, err := h.alipayService.VerifyCallback(params)
   124		if err != nil || !valid {
   125			fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK_ERROR] Signature verification failed: %v\n", err)
   126			fmt.Printf("========== [ALIPAY_CALLBACK_END] Result: VERIFY_FAILED ==========\n\n")
   127			c.String(400, "fail")
   128			return
   129		}
   130		fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] Signature verified successfully ✓\n")
   131	
   132		// Extract payment information
   133		orderNo := params["out_trade_no"]
   134		tradeNo := params["trade_no"]
   135		tradeStatus := params["trade_status"]
   136		totalAmount := params["total_amount"]
   137	
   138		fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] Payment Info:\n")
   139		fmt.Printf("  - Order No: %s\n", orderNo)
   140		fmt.Printf("  - Trade No: %s\n", tradeNo)
   141		fmt.Printf("  - Trade Status: %s\n", tradeStatus)
   142		fmt.Printf("  - Total Amount: %s\n", totalAmount)
   143	
   144		// Check trade status
   145		if tradeStatus == "TRADE_SUCCESS" || tradeStatus == "TRADE_FINISHED" {
   146			fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] Processing successful payment...\n")
   147			// Process successful payment with complete callback data
   148			if err := h.processSuccessfulPayment(orderNo, tradeNo, totalAmount, params); err != nil {
   149				fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK_ERROR] Failed to process payment: %v\n", err)
   150				fmt.Printf("========== [ALIPAY_CALLBACK_END] Result: PROCESS_FAILED ==========\n\n")
   151				c.String(500, "fail")
   152				return
   153			}
   154			fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] Payment processed successfully ✓\n")
   155			fmt.Printf("========== [ALIPAY_CALLBACK_END] Result: SUCCESS ==========\n\n")
   156		} else {
   157			fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_CALLBACK] Trade status is %s, not processing\n", tradeStatus)
   158			fmt.Printf("========== [ALIPAY_CALLBACK_END] Result: STATUS_IGNORED ==========\n\n")
   159		}
   160	
   161		// Return success response to Alipay
   162		c.String(200, "success")
   163	}
   164	
   165	// processSuccessfulPayment processes a successful payment from Alipay callback
   166	func (h *AlipayHandler) processSuccessfulPayment(orderNo, transactionNo, amountStr string, callbackData map[string]string) error {
   167		// Get order
   168		orderRecord, err := h.orderService.GetOrderByOrderNo(orderNo)
   169		if err != nil {
   170			return fmt.Errorf("order not found: %w", err)
   171		}
   172	
   173		// Check if already processed
   174		if orderRecord.Status == "paid" {
   175			fmt.Printf("✓ Order %s already processed\n", orderNo)
   176			return nil
   177		}
   178	
   179		// Verify amount - CRITICAL SECURITY CHECK
   180		amount, err := strconv.ParseFloat(amountStr, 64)
   181		if err != nil {
   182			return fmt.Errorf("invalid amount: %w", err)
   183		}
   184	
   185		// Compare amounts with final amount (after coupon discount) with 0.01 tolerance for floating point precision
   186		if math.Abs(amount-orderRecord.FinalAmount) > 0.01 {
   187			return fmt.Errorf("amount mismatch: expected %.2f, got %.2f", orderRecord.FinalAmount, amount)
   188		}
   189	
   190		// Process Alipay callback using the dedicated method
   191		// This will create a payment transaction record with complete callback data
   192		if err := h.orderService.ProcessAlipayCallback(orderNo, transactionNo, amount, callbackData); err != nil {
   193			return fmt.Errorf("failed to process payment: %w", err)
   194		}
   195	
   196		fmt.Printf("✓ Payment processed successfully for order %s\n", orderNo)
   197		return nil
   198	}

   255	// CreateConfig creates a new Alipay configuration (Admin only)
   256	// POST /api/v1/admin/payment/alipay/config
   257	func (h *AlipayHandler) CreateConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   258		var req CreateConfigRequest
   259		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   260			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   261			return
   262		}
   263	
   264		// Determine gateway URL based on sandbox flag
   265		gatewayURL := "https://openapi.alipay.com/gateway.do"
   266		if req.IsSandbox {
   267			gatewayURL = "https://openapi.alipaydev.com/gateway.do"
   268		}
   269	
   270		config := &model.AlipayConfig{
   271			AppID:           req.AppID,
   272			PrivateKey:      req.PrivateKey,
   273			AlipayPublicKey: req.AlipayPublicKey,
   274			GatewayURL:      gatewayURL,
   275			NotifyURL:       req.NotifyURL,
   276			ReturnURL:       req.ReturnURL,
   277			IsSandbox:       req.IsSandbox,
   278			IsActive:        req.IsActive,
   279		}
   280	
   281		if err := h.alipayService.CreateConfig(config); err != nil {
   282			utils.Error(c, 5001, "Failed to create configuration: "+err.Error())
   283			return
   284		}
   285	
   286		// Mask sensitive information before returning
   287		config.PrivateKey = "********"
   288		config.AlipayPublicKey = "********"
   289	
   290		utils.Success(c, config)
   291	}

   304	// UpdateConfig updates an Alipay configuration (Admin only)
   305	// PUT /api/v1/admin/payment/alipay/config/:id
   306	func (h *AlipayHandler) UpdateConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   307		idStr := c.Param("id")
   308		id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 32)
   309		if err != nil {
   310			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid configuration ID")
   311			return
   312		}
   313	
   314		var req UpdateConfigRequest
   315		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   316			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   317			return
   318		}
   319	
   320		// Get existing config
   321		config, err := h.alipayService.GetActiveConfig()
   322		if err != nil {
   323			utils.Error(c, 4404, "Configuration not found")
   324			return
   325		}
   326	
   327		// Update fields
   328		if req.AppID != "" {
   329			config.AppID = req.AppID
   330		}
   331		if req.PrivateKey != "" {
   332			config.PrivateKey = req.PrivateKey
   333		}
   334		if req.AlipayPublicKey != "" {
   335			config.AlipayPublicKey = req.AlipayPublicKey
   336		}
   337		if req.NotifyURL != "" {
   338			config.NotifyURL = req.NotifyURL
   339		}
   340		if req.ReturnURL != "" {
   341			config.ReturnURL = req.ReturnURL
   342		}
   343		if req.IsSandbox != nil {
   344			config.IsSandbox = *req.IsSandbox
   345			// Update gateway URL based on sandbox flag
   346			if config.IsSandbox {
   347				config.GatewayURL = "https://openapi.alipaydev.com/gateway.do"
   348			} else {
   349				config.GatewayURL = "https://openapi.alipay.com/gateway.do"
   350			}
   351		}
   352		if req.IsActive != nil {
   353			config.IsActive = *req.IsActive
   354		}
   355	
   356		config.ID = uint(id)
   357	
   358		if err := h.alipayService.UpdateConfig(config); err != nil {
   359			utils.Error(c, 5002, "Failed to update configuration: "+err.Error())
   360			return
   361		}
   362	
   363		// Mask sensitive information before returning
   364		config.PrivateKey = "********"
   365		config.AlipayPublicKey = "********"
   366	
   367		utils.Success(c, config)
   368	}

   388	// SetActiveConfig sets a specific configuration as active (Admin only)
   389	// POST /api/v1/admin/payment/alipay/config/:id/activate
   390	func (h *AlipayHandler) SetActiveConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   391		idStr := c.Param("id")
   392		id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 32)
   393		if err != nil {
   394			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid configuration ID")
   395			return
   396		}
   397	
   398		if err := h.alipayService.SetActiveConfig(uint(id)); err != nil {
   399			utils.Error(c, 5004, "Failed to set active configuration: "+err.Error())
   400			return
   401		}
   402	
   403		utils.Success(c, gin.H{"message": "Configuration activated successfully"})
   404	}
   405	
   406	// SimulatePayment simulates a successful payment for development/testing
   407	// POST /api/v1/user/payment/simulate
   408	func (h *AlipayHandler) SimulatePayment(c *gin.Context) {
   409		var req struct {
   410			OrderNo string  `json:"order_no" binding:"required"`
   411			Amount  float64 `json:"amount" binding:"required,gt=0"`
   412		}
   413	
   414		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   415			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   416			return
   417		}
   418	
   419		// Get user ID from context
   420		userIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   421		if !exists {
   422			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
   423			return
   424		}
   425		userID := userIDInterface.(uint)
   426	
   427		// Verify order exists and belongs to user
   428		orderRecord, err := h.orderService.GetOrderByOrderNo(req.OrderNo)
   429		if err != nil {
   430			utils.Error(c, 4001, "Order not found")
   431			return
   432		}
   433	
   434		if orderRecord.UserID != userID {
   435			utils.Error(c, 4003, "Order does not belong to user")
   436			return
   437		}
   438	
   439		// Check order status
   440		if orderRecord.Status != "pending" {
   441			utils.Error(c, 4004, "Order is not in pending status")
   442			return
   443		}
   444	
   445		// Verify amount matches final amount (with coupon discount) (with 0.01 tolerance)
   446		if math.Abs(req.Amount-orderRecord.FinalAmount) > 0.01 {
   447			utils.Error(c, 4005, fmt.Sprintf("Amount mismatch: expected %.2f, got %.2f", orderRecord.FinalAmount, req.Amount))
   448			return
   449		}
   450	
   451		// Generate a mock transaction number
   452		mockTransactionNo := fmt.Sprintf("MOCK_%s_%d", req.OrderNo, time.Now().Unix())
   453	
   454		// Create mock callback data
   455		mockCallbackData := map[string]string{
   456			"out_trade_no": req.OrderNo,
   457			"trade_no":     mockTransactionNo,
   458			"trade_status": "TRADE_SUCCESS",
   459			"total_amount": fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", req.Amount),
   460			"notify_time":  time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
   461			"notify_type":  "trade_status_sync",
   462			"app_id":       "MOCK_DEV_APP",
   463			"seller_id":    "MOCK_SELLER",
   464			"buyer_id":     "MOCK_BUYER",
   465			"receipt_amount": fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", req.Amount),
   466		}
   467	
   468		// Process the simulated payment
   469		fmt.Printf("\n========== [SIMULATE_PAYMENT_START] Time: %s ==========\n", time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   470		fmt.Printf("[SIMULATE_PAYMENT] Order No: %s\n", req.OrderNo)
   471		fmt.Printf("[SIMULATE_PAYMENT] Amount: %.2f\n", req.Amount)
   472		fmt.Printf("[SIMULATE_PAYMENT] Mock Transaction No: %s\n", mockTransactionNo)
   473	
   474		if err := h.orderService.ProcessAlipayCallback(req.OrderNo, mockTransactionNo, req.Amount, mockCallbackData); err != nil {
   475			fmt.Printf("[SIMULATE_PAYMENT_ERROR] Failed to process: %v\n", err)
   476			fmt.Printf("========== [SIMULATE_PAYMENT_END] Result: FAILED ==========\n\n")
   477			utils.Error(c, 5000, "Failed to simulate payment: "+err.Error())
   478			return
   479		}
   480	
   481		fmt.Printf("[SIMULATE_PAYMENT] Payment processed successfully ✓\n")
   482		fmt.Printf("========== [SIMULATE_PAYMENT_END] Result: SUCCESS ==========\n\n")
   483	
   484		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
   485			"message":        "Payment simulated successfully",
   486			"order_no":       req.OrderNo,
   487			"transaction_no": mockTransactionNo,
   488			"status":         "paid",
   489		})
   490	}

    26	// GetActiveConfig retrieves the active Alipay configuration
    27	func (r *AlipayRepository) GetActiveConfig() (*model.AlipayConfig, error) {
    28		var config model.AlipayConfig
    29		err := r.db.Where("is_active = ?", true).First(&config).Error
    30		if err != nil {
    31			return nil, err
    32		}
    33		return &config, nil
    34	}

    41			return nil, err
    42		}
    43		return &config, nil
    44	}

    47	func (r *AlipayRepository) ListConfigs() ([]model.AlipayConfig, error) {
    48		var configs []model.AlipayConfig
    49		err := r.db.Order("created_at DESC").Find(&configs).Error
    50		return configs, err
    51	}

    53	// CreateConfig creates a new Alipay configuration
    54	func (r *AlipayRepository) CreateConfig(config *model.AlipayConfig) error {
    55		return r.db.Create(config).Error
    56	}
    57	
    58	// UpdateConfig updates an Alipay configuration
    59	func (r *AlipayRepository) UpdateConfig(config *model.AlipayConfig) error {
    60		// Use Updates instead of Save to avoid updating created_at
    61		// and to allow selective field updates
    62		updates := map[string]interface{}{
    63			"app_id":     config.AppID,
    64			"notify_url": config.NotifyURL,
    65			"return_url": config.ReturnURL,
    66			"is_sandbox": config.IsSandbox,
    67			"is_active":  config.IsActive,
    68		}
    69	
    70		// Only update private_key if it's not empty
    71		if config.PrivateKey != "" {
    72			updates["private_key"] = config.PrivateKey
    73		}
    74	
    75		// Only update alipay_public_key if it's not empty
    76		if config.AlipayPublicKey != "" {
    77			updates["alipay_public_key"] = config.AlipayPublicKey
    78		}
    79	
    80		return r.db.Model(&model.AlipayConfig{}).Where("id = ?", config.ID).Updates(updates).Error
    81	}
    82	
    83	// DeleteConfig deletes an Alipay configuration
    84	func (r *AlipayRepository) DeleteConfig(id uint) error {
    85		return r.db.Delete(&model.AlipayConfig{}, id).Error
    86	}
    87	
    88	// DeactivateAllConfigs deactivates all Alipay configurations
    89	func (r *AlipayRepository) DeactivateAllConfigs() error {
    90		return r.db.Model(&model.AlipayConfig{}).Where("is_active = ?", true).Update("is_active", false).Error
    91	}
    92	
    93	// SetActiveConfig sets a specific configuration as active (and deactivates others)
    94	func (r *AlipayRepository) SetActiveConfig(id uint) error {
    95		return r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
    96			// Deactivate all configs
    97			if err := tx.Model(&model.AlipayConfig{}).Where("is_active = ?", true).Update("is_active", false).Error; err != nil {
    98				return err
    99			}
   100			// Activate the specified config
   101			return tx.Model(&model.AlipayConfig{}).Where("id = ?", id).Update("is_active", true).Error
   102		})
   103	}

    42	// PaymentRequest represents a payment request
    43	type PaymentRequest struct {
    44		OrderNo     string  `json:"order_no" binding:"required"`
    45		Subject     string  `json:"subject" binding:"required"`
    46		Amount      float64 `json:"amount" binding:"required"`
    47		ReturnURL   string  `json:"return_url"`
    48		Description string  `json:"description"`
    49	}
    50	
    51	// PaymentResponse represents the Alipay payment response
    52	type PaymentResponse struct {
    53		PaymentURL string `json:"payment_url"`
    54		OrderNo    string `json:"order_no"`
    55	}
    56	
    57	// CreatePayment creates a payment request and returns the payment URL
    58	func (s *AlipayService) CreatePayment(req PaymentRequest) (*PaymentResponse, error) {
    59		// Get active Alipay configuration
    60		config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
    61		if err != nil {
    62			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no active Alipay configuration found: %w", err)
    63		}
    64	
    65		// Build payment parameters
    66		// Note: sign_type must be included in params for signing
    67		params := map[string]string{
    68			"app_id":      config.AppID,
    69			"method":      "alipay.trade.page.pay",
    70			"charset":     "utf-8",
    71			"sign_type":   "RSA2",
    72			"timestamp":   time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
    73			"version":     "1.0",
    74			"notify_url":  config.NotifyURL,
    75			"biz_content": s.buildBizContent(req),
    76		}
    77	
    78		// Add return URL if provided
    79		if req.ReturnURL != "" {
    80			params["return_url"] = req.ReturnURL
    81		} else if config.ReturnURL != "" {
    82			params["return_url"] = config.ReturnURL
    83		}
    84	
    85		// Sign the request
    86		sign, err := s.signParams(params, config.PrivateKey)
    87		if err != nil {
    88			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to sign request: %w", err)
    89		}
    90		params["sign"] = sign
    91	
    92		// Build payment URL
    93		paymentURL := s.buildPaymentURL(config.GatewayURL, params)
    94	
    95		return &PaymentResponse{
    96			PaymentURL: paymentURL,
    97			OrderNo:    req.OrderNo,
    98		}, nil
    99	}

   101	// VerifyCallback verifies the Alipay callback signature
   102	func (s *AlipayService) VerifyCallback(params map[string]string) (bool, error) {
   103		// Get active Alipay configuration
   104		config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
   105		if err != nil {
   106			return false, fmt.Errorf("no active Alipay configuration found: %w", err)
   107		}
   108	
   109		// Extract sign from params
   110		sign, exists := params["sign"]
   111		if !exists {
   112			return false, errors.New("sign parameter not found")
   113		}
   114	
   115		// IMPORTANT: Remove both "sign" and "sign_type" before building sign content
   116		// According to Alipay docs, these two params should NOT be included in verification
   117		delete(params, "sign")
   118		delete(params, "sign_type")
   119	
   120		// Build sign content
   121		signContent := s.buildSignContent(params)
   122	
   123		fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_VERIFY] Sign content: %s\n", signContent)
   124		fmt.Printf("[ALIPAY_VERIFY] Sign to verify: %s...\n", sign[:50])
   125	
   126		// Verify signature
   127		return s.verifySign(signContent, sign, config.AlipayPublicKey)
   128	}

   140	// CreateConfig creates a new Alipay configuration
   141	func (s *AlipayService) CreateConfig(config *model.AlipayConfig) error {
   142		// Validate keys
   143		if err := s.validatePrivateKey(config.PrivateKey); err != nil {
   144			return fmt.Errorf("invalid private key: %w", err)
   145		}
   146		if err := s.validatePublicKey(config.AlipayPublicKey); err != nil {
   147			return fmt.Errorf("invalid Alipay public key: %w", err)
   148		}
   149	
   150		// If this is set as active, deactivate others
   151		if config.IsActive {
   152			if err := s.repo.DeactivateAllConfigs(); err != nil {
   153				return fmt.Errorf("failed to deactivate existing configs: %w", err)
   154			}
   155		}
   156	
   157		return s.repo.CreateConfig(config)
   158	}

   160	// UpdateConfig updates an Alipay configuration
   161	func (s *AlipayService) UpdateConfig(config *model.AlipayConfig) error {
   162		// Validate keys if they are being updated
   163		if config.PrivateKey != "" {
   164			if err := s.validatePrivateKey(config.PrivateKey); err != nil {
   165				return fmt.Errorf("invalid private key: %w", err)
   166			}
   167		}
   168		if config.AlipayPublicKey != "" {
   169			if err := s.validatePublicKey(config.AlipayPublicKey); err != nil {
   170				return fmt.Errorf("invalid Alipay public key: %w", err)
   171			}
   172		}
   173	
   174		// If this is set as active, deactivate others
   175		if config.IsActive {
   176			if err := s.repo.SetActiveConfig(config.ID); err != nil {
   177				return fmt.Errorf("failed to set active config: %w", err)
   178			}
   179		}
   180	
   181		return s.repo.UpdateConfig(config)
   182	}

   194	// buildBizContent builds the biz_content JSON string
   195	func (s *AlipayService) buildBizContent(req PaymentRequest) string {
   196		return fmt.Sprintf(`{"out_trade_no":"%s","product_code":"FAST_INSTANT_TRADE_PAY","total_amount":"%.2f","subject":"%s","body":"%s"}`,
   197			req.OrderNo,
   198			req.Amount,
   199			req.Subject,
   200			req.Description,
   201		)
   202	}
   203	
   204	// buildSignContent builds the content to be signed
   205	// Note: According to Alipay docs, only "sign" is excluded from signing, "sign_type" must be included
   206	func (s *AlipayService) buildSignContent(params map[string]string) string {
   207		var keys []string
   208		for k := range params {
   209			// Only exclude "sign" parameter, include "sign_type"
   210			if k != "sign" && params[k] != "" {
   211				keys = append(keys, k)
   212			}
   213		}
   214		sort.Strings(keys)
   215	
   216		var signParts []string
   217		for _, k := range keys {
   218			signParts = append(signParts, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", k, params[k]))
   219		}
   220		return strings.Join(signParts, "&")
   221	}
   222	
   223	// signParams signs the parameters using RSA2 (SHA256)
   224	func (s *AlipayService) signParams(params map[string]string, privateKeyStr string) (string, error) {
   225		// Build sign content
   226		signContent := s.buildSignContent(params)
   227	
   228		// Debug: Print sign content and its length
   229		fmt.Printf("🔐 Sign content (%d bytes): %s\n", len(signContent), signContent)
   230		fmt.Printf("🔐 Sign content (first 100 chars): %s\n", signContent[:min(100, len(signContent))])
   231	
   232		// Parse private key
   233		privateKey, err := s.parsePrivateKey(privateKeyStr)
   234		if err != nil {
   235			return "", err
   236		}
   237	
   238		// Hash the content
   239		hash := sha256.New()
   240		hash.Write([]byte(signContent))
   241		hashed := hash.Sum(nil)
   242		fmt.Printf("🔐 SHA256 hash: %x\n", hashed)
   243	
   244		// Sign with RSA
   245		signature, err := rsa.SignPKCS1v15(rand.Reader, privateKey, crypto.SHA256, hashed)
   246		if err != nil {
   247			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to sign: %w", err)
   248		}
   249	
   250		// Encode to base64
   251		signStr := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(signature)
   252		fmt.Printf("🔐 Generated signature (%d chars): %s...\n", len(signStr), signStr[:min(50, len(signStr))])
   253		return signStr, nil
   254	}
   255	
   256	func min(a, b int) int {
   257		if a < b {
   258			return a
   259		}
   260		return b
   261	}
   262	
   263	// verifySign verifies the signature using Alipay's public key
   264	func (s *AlipayService) verifySign(content, sign, publicKeyStr string) (bool, error) {
   265		// Parse public key
   266		publicKey, err := s.parsePublicKey(publicKeyStr)
   267		if err != nil {
   268			return false, err
   269		}
   270	
   271		// Decode signature
   272		signBytes, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(sign)
   273		if err != nil {
   274			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode signature: %w", err)
   275		}
   276	
   277		// Hash the content
   278		hash := sha256.New()
   279		hash.Write([]byte(content))
   280		hashed := hash.Sum(nil)
   281	
   282		// Verify signature
   283		err = rsa.VerifyPKCS1v15(publicKey, crypto.SHA256, hashed, signBytes)
   284		return err == nil, nil
   285	}
   286	
   287	// buildPaymentURL builds the complete payment URL
   288	func (s *AlipayService) buildPaymentURL(gateway string, params map[string]string) string {
   289		// Sort keys to maintain consistent order
   290		var keys []string
   291		for k := range params {
   292			keys = append(keys, k)
   293		}
   294		sort.Strings(keys)
   295	
   296		var urlParams []string
   297		for _, k := range keys {
   298			// URL encode both key and value
   299			encodedValue := url.QueryEscape(params[k])
   300			urlParams = append(urlParams, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", k, encodedValue))
   301	
   302			// Debug: Show encoding
   303			if params[k] != encodedValue {
   304				fmt.Printf("🔗 URL encoding: %s = %s -> %s\n", k, params[k], encodedValue)
   305			}
   306		}
   307	
   308		fullURL := gateway + "?" + strings.Join(urlParams, "&")
   309		fmt.Printf("🔗 Payment URL length: %d\n", len(fullURL))
   310		return fullURL
   311	}
   312	
   313	// parsePrivateKey parses a PEM-encoded private key
   314	func (s *AlipayService) parsePrivateKey(privateKeyStr string) (*rsa.PrivateKey, error) {
   315		// Remove header/footer if present
   316		privateKeyStr = strings.TrimSpace(privateKeyStr)
   317		if !strings.HasPrefix(privateKeyStr, "-----BEGIN") {
   318			privateKeyStr = "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\n" + privateKeyStr + "\n-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----"
   319		}
   320	
   321		block, _ := pem.Decode([]byte(privateKeyStr))
   322		if block == nil {
   323			return nil, errors.New("failed to decode PEM block")
   324		}
   325	
   326		// Try PKCS1 format first
   327		privateKey, err := x509.ParsePKCS1PrivateKey(block.Bytes)
   328		if err == nil {
   329			return privateKey, nil
   330		}
   331	
   332		// Try PKCS8 format
   333		key, err := x509.ParsePKCS8PrivateKey(block.Bytes)
   334		if err != nil {
   335			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse private key: %w", err)
   336		}
   337	
   338		rsaKey, ok := key.(*rsa.PrivateKey)
   339		if !ok {
   340			return nil, errors.New("not an RSA private key")
   341		}
   342	
   343		return rsaKey, nil
   344	}
   345	
   346	// parsePublicKey parses a PEM-encoded public key
   347	func (s *AlipayService) parsePublicKey(publicKeyStr string) (*rsa.PublicKey, error) {
   348		// Remove header/footer if present
   349		publicKeyStr = strings.TrimSpace(publicKeyStr)
   350		if !strings.HasPrefix(publicKeyStr, "-----BEGIN") {
   351			publicKeyStr = "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\n" + publicKeyStr + "\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----"
   352		}
   353	
   354		block, _ := pem.Decode([]byte(publicKeyStr))
   355		if block == nil {
   356			return nil, errors.New("failed to decode PEM block")
   357		}
   358	
   359		// Try PKIX format
   360		key, err := x509.ParsePKIXPublicKey(block.Bytes)
   361		if err != nil {
   362			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse public key: %w", err)
   363		}
   364	
   365		rsaKey, ok := key.(*rsa.PublicKey)
   366		if !ok {
   367			return nil, errors.New("not an RSA public key")
   368		}
   369	
   370		return rsaKey, nil
   371	}
   372	
   373	// validatePrivateKey validates if the private key is valid
   374	func (s *AlipayService) validatePrivateKey(privateKeyStr string) error {
   375		_, err := s.parsePrivateKey(privateKeyStr)
   376		return err
   377	}
   378	
   379	// validatePublicKey validates if the public key is valid
   380	func (s *AlipayService) validatePublicKey(publicKeyStr string) error {
   381		_, err := s.parsePublicKey(publicKeyStr)
   382		return err
   383	}
   384	
   385	// ParseCallbackParams parses callback parameters from io.Reader
   386	func ParseCallbackParams(body io.Reader) (map[string]string, error) {
   387		data, err := io.ReadAll(body)
   388		if err != nil {
   389			return nil, err
   390		}
   391	
   392		values, err := url.ParseQuery(string(data))
   393		if err != nil {
   394			return nil, err
   395		}
   396	
   397		params := make(map[string]string)
   398		for k, v := range values {
   399			if len(v) > 0 {
   400				params[k] = v[0]
   401			}
   402		}
   403		return params, nil
   404	}
