   112	func (r *Repository) UpdateUsageQuota(quota *UsageQuota) error {
   113		return r.db.Save(quota).Error
   114	}
   115	
   116	// IncrementUsage increments a specific usage counter atomically to prevent race conditions
   117	func (r *Repository) IncrementUsage(userID uint, date string, usageType string) error {
   118		// First ensure the quota record exists for today
   119		_, err := r.GetTodayUsageQuota(userID, date)
   120		if err != nil {
   121			return err
   122		}
   123	
   124		// Use atomic UPDATE with database-level increment to prevent race conditions
   125		// This ensures that even with concurrent requests, the count is accurate
   126		var columnName string
   127		switch usageType {
   128		case "normal_search":
   129			columnName = "normal_search_count"
   130		case "advanced_search_low":
   131			columnName = "advanced_search_low_count"
   132		case "advanced_search_mid":
   133			columnName = "advanced_search_mid_count"
   134		case "advanced_search_high":
   135			columnName = "advanced_search_high_count"
   136		case "ai_chat_normal":
   137			columnName = "ai_chat_normal_count"
   138		case "ai_chat_mid":
   139			columnName = "ai_chat_mid_count"
   140		case "ai_chat_high":
   141			columnName = "ai_chat_high_count"
   142		default:
   143			return fmt.Errorf("invalid usage type: %s", usageType)
   144		}
   145	
   146		// Atomic increment at database level
   147		result := r.db.Model(&UsageQuota{}).
   148			Where("user_id = ? AND quota_date = ?", userID, date).
   149			Update(columnName, gorm.Expr(columnName+" + ?", 1))
   150	
   151		return result.Error
   152	}
   153	
   154	// CheckAndIncrementQuota atomically checks if user has quota and increments if available
   155	// This prevents race conditions in concurrent scenarios
   156	func (r *Repository) CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID uint, date string, usageType string, limit int) error {
   157		// Map usage type to column name
   158		var columnName string
   159		switch usageType {
   160		case "normal_search":
   161			columnName = "normal_search_count"
   162		case "advanced_search_low":
   163			columnName = "advanced_search_low_count"
   164		case "advanced_search_mid":
   165			columnName = "advanced_search_mid_count"
   166		case "advanced_search_high":
   167			columnName = "advanced_search_high_count"
   168		case "ai_chat_normal":
   169			columnName = "ai_chat_normal_count"
   170		case "ai_chat_mid":
   171			columnName = "ai_chat_mid_count"
   172		case "ai_chat_high":
   173			columnName = "ai_chat_high_count"
   174		default:
   175			return fmt.Errorf("invalid usage type: %s", usageType)
   176		}
   177	
   178		// Use transaction to ensure atomicity
   179		return r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
   180			// First ensure the quota record exists
   181			var quota UsageQuota
   182			err := tx.Where("user_id = ? AND quota_date = ?", userID, date).First(&quota).Error
   183			if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   184				// Create new quota record
   185				quota = UsageQuota{
   186					UserID:    userID,
   187					QuotaDate: date,
   188				}
   189				if err := tx.Create(&quota).Error; err != nil {
   190					return err
   191				}
   192			} else if err != nil {
   193				return err
   194			}
   195	
   196			// Check current count using FOR UPDATE to lock the row
   197			var currentCount int
   198			err = tx.Model(&UsageQuota{}).
   199				Where("user_id = ? AND quota_date = ?", userID, date).
   200				Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).
   201				Pluck(columnName, &currentCount).Error
   202			if err != nil {
   203				return err
   204			}
   205	
   206			// Check if quota exceeded
   207			if currentCount >= limit {
   208				return fmt.Errorf("quota exceeded for %s: %d/%d used", usageType, currentCount, limit)
   209			}
   210	
   211			// Increment atomically
   212			result := tx.Model(&UsageQuota{}).
   213				Where("user_id = ? AND quota_date = ?", userID, date).
   214				Update(columnName, gorm.Expr(columnName+" + ?", 1))
   215	
   216			return result.Error
   217		})
   218	}

    31	// GetAllPlans retrieves all active subscription plans with parsed features
    32	func (s *Service) GetAllPlans() ([]map[string]interface{}, error) {
    33		plans, err := s.repo.GetAllPlans()
    34		if err != nil {
    35			return nil, err
    36		}
    37	
    38		result := make([]map[string]interface{}, len(plans))
    39		for i, plan := range plans {
    40			var features PlanFeatures
    41			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(plan.Features), &features); err != nil {
    42				return nil, err
    43			}
    44	
    45			result[i] = map[string]interface{}{
    46				"id":                       plan.ID,
    47				"plan_code":                plan.PlanCode,
    48				"plan_name":                plan.PlanName,
    49				"price_monthly":            plan.PriceMonthly,
    50				"current_price_monthly":    plan.CurrentPriceMonthly,
    51				"price_yearly":             plan.PriceYearly,
    52				"current_price_yearly":     plan.CurrentPriceYearly,
    53				"yearly_discount_enabled":  plan.YearlyDiscountEnabled,
    54				"yearly_discount_percent":  plan.YearlyDiscountPercent,
    55				"features":                 features,
    56				"is_active":                plan.IsActive,
    57				"sort_order":               plan.SortOrder,
    58			}
    59		}
    60	
    61		return result, nil
    62	}

    69	// GetUserSubscription retrieves the user's current subscription info
    70	func (s *Service) GetUserSubscription(userID uint) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
    71		subscription, err := s.repo.GetUserActiveSubscription(userID)
    72		if err != nil {
    73			if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
    74				// User has no active subscription, return free plan
    75				return map[string]interface{}{
    76					"plan_code":  "free",
    77					"plan_name":  "FREE",
    78					"status":     "active",
    79					"start_date": nil,
    80					"end_date":   nil,
    81					"auto_renew": false,
    82				}, nil
    83			}
    84			return nil, err
    85		}
    86	
    87		// Get plan details
    88		plan, err := s.repo.GetPlanByCode(subscription.PlanCode)
    89		if err != nil {
    90			return nil, err
    91		}
    92	
    93		var features PlanFeatures
    94		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(plan.Features), &features); err != nil {
    95			return nil, err
    96		}
    97	
    98		return map[string]interface{}{
    99			"plan_code":     subscription.PlanCode,
   100			"plan_name":     plan.PlanName,
   101			"status":        subscription.Status,
   102			"start_date":    subscription.StartDate,
   103			"end_date":      subscription.EndDate,
   104			"auto_renew":    subscription.AutoRenew,
   105			"price_monthly": plan.PriceMonthly,
   106			"price_yearly":  plan.PriceYearly,
   107			"features":      features,
   108		}, nil
   109	}

   111	// GetUserUsageQuota retrieves the user's current usage quota
   112	func (s *Service) GetUserUsageQuota(userID uint) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
   113		today := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")
   114		quota, err := s.repo.GetTodayUsageQuota(userID, today)
   115		if err != nil {
   116			return nil, err
   117		}
   118	
   119		// Get user's subscription plan
   120		subscription, err := s.GetUserSubscription(userID)
   121		if err != nil {
   122			return nil, err
   123		}
   124	
   125		planCode := subscription["plan_code"].(string)
   126		plan, err := s.repo.GetPlanByCode(planCode)
   127		if err != nil {
   128			return nil, err
   129		}
   130	
   131		var features PlanFeatures
   132		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(plan.Features), &features); err != nil {
   133			return nil, err
   134		}
   135	
   136		return map[string]interface{}{
   137			"quota_date": quota.QuotaDate,
   138			"usage": map[string]interface{}{
   139				"normal_search":         quota.NormalSearchCount,
   140				"advanced_search_low":   quota.AdvancedSearchLowCount,
   141				"advanced_search_mid":   quota.AdvancedSearchMidCount,
   142				"advanced_search_high":  quota.AdvancedSearchHighCount,
   143				"ai_chat_normal":        quota.AIChatNormalCount,
   144				"ai_chat_mid":           quota.AIChatMidCount,
   145				"ai_chat_high":          quota.AIChatHighCount,
   146			},
   147			"limits": map[string]interface{}{
   148				"normal_search":         features.NormalSearch,
   149				"advanced_search_low":   features.AdvancedSearchLow,
   150				"advanced_search_mid":   features.AdvancedSearchMid,
   151				"advanced_search_high":  features.AdvancedSearchHigh,
   152				"ai_chat_normal":        features.AIChatNormal,
   153				"ai_chat_mid":           features.AIChatMid,
   154				"ai_chat_high":          features.AIChatHigh,
   155			},
   156		}, nil
   157	}

   159	// CheckQuota checks if user has remaining quota for a specific feature
   160	func (s *Service) CheckQuota(userID uint, featureType string) (bool, error) {
   161		today := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")
   162		quota, err := s.repo.GetTodayUsageQuota(userID, today)
   163		if err != nil {
   164			return false, err
   165		}
   166	
   167		// Get user's subscription plan
   168		subscription, err := s.repo.GetUserActiveSubscription(userID)
   169		planCode := "free"
   170		if err == nil && subscription != nil {
   171			planCode = subscription.PlanCode
   172		}
   173	
   174		plan, err := s.repo.GetPlanByCode(planCode)
   175		if err != nil {
   176			return false, err
   177		}
   178	
   179		var features PlanFeatures
   180		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(plan.Features), &features); err != nil {
   181			return false, err
   182		}
   183	
   184		// Check if quota is exceeded
   185		switch featureType {
   186		case "normal_search":
   187			if features.NormalSearch.Limit == -1 {
   188				return true, nil
   189			}
   190			return quota.NormalSearchCount < features.NormalSearch.Limit, nil
   191		case "advanced_search_low":
   192			if features.AdvancedSearchLow.Limit == -1 {
   193				return true, nil
   194			}
   195			return quota.AdvancedSearchLowCount < features.AdvancedSearchLow.Limit, nil
   196		case "advanced_search_mid":
   197			if features.AdvancedSearchMid.Limit == -1 {
   198				return true, nil
   199			}
   200			return quota.AdvancedSearchMidCount < features.AdvancedSearchMid.Limit, nil
   201		case "advanced_search_high":
   202			if features.AdvancedSearchHigh.Limit == -1 {
   203				return true, nil
   204			}
   205			return quota.AdvancedSearchHighCount < features.AdvancedSearchHigh.Limit, nil
   206		case "ai_chat_normal":
   207			if features.AIChatNormal.Limit == -1 {
   208				return true, nil
   209			}
   210			return quota.AIChatNormalCount < features.AIChatNormal.Limit, nil
   211		case "ai_chat_mid":
   212			if features.AIChatMid.Limit == -1 {
   213				return true, nil
   214			}
   215			return quota.AIChatMidCount < features.AIChatMid.Limit, nil
   216		case "ai_chat_high":
   217			if features.AIChatHigh.Limit == -1 {
   218				return true, nil
   219			}
   220			return quota.AIChatHighCount < features.AIChatHigh.Limit, nil
   221		}
   222	
   223		return false, errors.New("invalid feature type")
   224	}
   225	
   226	// IncrementUsage increments usage count for a specific feature
   227	func (s *Service) IncrementUsage(userID uint, featureType string) error {
   228		today := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")
   229		return s.repo.IncrementUsage(userID, today, featureType)
   230	}
   231	
   232	// CheckAndIncrementQuota atomically checks quota and increments usage in a single transaction
   233	// This prevents race conditions where multiple concurrent requests might exceed the quota
   234	func (s *Service) CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID uint, featureType string) error {
   235		today := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")
   236	
   237		// Get user's subscription plan
   238		subscription, err := s.repo.GetUserActiveSubscription(userID)
   239		planCode := "FREE"
   240		if err == nil && subscription != nil {
   241			planCode = subscription.PlanCode
   242		}
   243	
   244		plan, err := s.repo.GetPlanByCode(planCode)
   245		if err != nil {
   246			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get plan: %w", err)
   247		}
   248	
   249		var features PlanFeatures
   250		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(plan.Features), &features); err != nil {
   251			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse plan features: %w", err)
   252		}
   253	
   254		// Get the limit for this feature
   255		var limit int
   256		switch featureType {
   257		case "normal_search":
   258			limit = features.NormalSearch.Limit
   259		case "advanced_search_low":
   260			limit = features.AdvancedSearchLow.Limit
   261		case "advanced_search_mid":
   262			limit = features.AdvancedSearchMid.Limit
   263		case "advanced_search_high":
   264			limit = features.AdvancedSearchHigh.Limit
   265		case "ai_chat_normal":
   266			limit = features.AIChatNormal.Limit
   267		case "ai_chat_mid":
   268			limit = features.AIChatMid.Limit
   269		case "ai_chat_high":
   270			limit = features.AIChatHigh.Limit
   271		default:
   272			return fmt.Errorf("invalid feature type: %s", featureType)
   273		}
   274	
   275		// -1 means unlimited
   276		if limit == -1 {
   277			// Still increment for statistics
   278			return s.repo.IncrementUsage(userID, today, featureType)
   279		}
   280	
   281		// Use transaction to atomically check and increment
   282		return s.repo.CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID, today, featureType, limit)
   283	}
   284	
   285	// UpgradeSubscription upgrades or downgrades a user's subscription
   286	func (s *Service) UpgradeSubscription(userID uint, newPlanCode string, duration int) error {
   287		// Validate plan exists
   288		plan, err := s.repo.GetPlanByCode(newPlanCode)
   289		if err != nil {
   290			return err
   291		}
   292		if plan == nil {
   293			return errors.New("invalid plan code")
   294		}
   295	
   296		// Cancel existing active subscription if exists
   297		existingSub, err := s.repo.GetUserActiveSubscription(userID)
   298		if err == nil && existingSub != nil {
   299			existingSub.Status = "cancelled"
   300			if err := s.repo.UpdateSubscription(existingSub); err != nil {
   301				return err
   302			}
   303		}
   304	
   305		// Create new subscription
   306		startDate := time.Now()
   307		var endDate *time.Time
   308		if duration > 0 {
   309			end := startDate.AddDate(0, duration, 0)
   310			endDate = &end
   311		}
   312	
   313		newSub := &UserSubscription{
   314			UserID:    userID,
   315			PlanCode:  newPlanCode,
   316			StartDate: startDate,
   317			EndDate:   endDate,
   318			Status:    "active",
   319			AutoRenew: false,
   320		}
   321	
   322		return s.repo.CreateSubscription(newSub)
   323	}
   324	
   325	// UpdatePlan updates a subscription plan
   326	func (s *Service) UpdatePlan(planID uint, planName string, priceMonthly, currentPriceMonthly, priceYearly, currentPriceYearly float64, yearlyDiscountEnabled bool, yearlyDiscountPercent float64, features PlanFeatures) error {
   327		// Get the plan
   328		plan, err := s.repo.GetPlanByID(planID)
   329		if err != nil {
   330			return fmt.Errorf("plan not found: %w", err)
   331		}
   332	
   333		// Update fields
   334		plan.PlanName = planName
   335		plan.PriceMonthly = priceMonthly
   336		plan.CurrentPriceMonthly = currentPriceMonthly
   337		plan.PriceYearly = priceYearly
   338		plan.CurrentPriceYearly = currentPriceYearly
   339		plan.YearlyDiscountEnabled = yearlyDiscountEnabled
   340		plan.YearlyDiscountPercent = yearlyDiscountPercent
   341	
   342		// Marshal features to JSON
   343		featuresJSON, err := json.Marshal(features)
   344		if err != nil {
   345			return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal features: %w", err)
   346		}
   347		plan.Features = string(featuresJSON)
   348	
   349		// Save to database
   350		return s.repo.UpdatePlan(plan)
   351	}

    17	// Handler handles HTTP requests for third-party accounts
    18	type Handler struct {
    19		service *Service
    20	}
    21	
    22	// NewHandler creates a new handler
    23	func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
    24		return &Handler{service: service}
    25	}
    26	
    27	// CreateAccountRequest represents the request body for creating an account
    28	type CreateAccountRequest struct {
    29		Name     string        `json:"name" binding:"required"`
    30		Type     AccountType   `json:"type" binding:"required"`
    31		Config   AccountConfig `json:"config" binding:"required"`
    32		Priority int           `json:"priority"` // 优先级，数字越小优先级越高
    33	}
    34	
    35	// UpdateAccountRequest represents the request body for updating an account
    36	type UpdateAccountRequest struct {
    37		Name     string        `json:"name"`
    38		Config   AccountConfig `json:"config"`
    39		Status   *int          `json:"status"`
    40		Priority *int          `json:"priority"` // 优先级，数字越小优先级越高
    41	}
    42	
    43	// CreateAccount handles POST /api/v1/admin/third-party-accounts
    44	func (h *Handler) CreateAccount(c *gin.Context) {
    45		var req CreateAccountRequest
    46		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
    47			utils.Error(c, 6001, "Invalid request body: "+err.Error())
    48			return
    49		}
    50	
    51		account, err := h.service.CreateAccountWithPriority(req.Name, req.Type, req.Config, req.Priority)
    52		if err != nil {
    53			utils.Error(c, 6002, "Failed to create account: "+err.Error())
    54			return
    55		}
    56	
    57		utils.Success(c, account)
    58	}
    59	
    60	// GetAccount handles GET /api/v1/admin/third-party-accounts/:id
    61	func (h *Handler) GetAccount(c *gin.Context) {
    62		idStr := c.Param("id")
    63		id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 32)
    64		if err != nil {
    65			utils.Error(c, 6003, "Invalid account ID")
    66			return
    67		}
    68	
    69		account, err := h.service.GetAccount(uint(id))
    70		if err != nil {
    71			utils.Error(c, 6004, "Failed to get account: "+err.Error())
    72			return
    73		}
    74	
    75		utils.Success(c, account)
    76	}

    78	// ListAccounts handles GET /api/v1/admin/third-party-accounts
    79	func (h *Handler) ListAccounts(c *gin.Context) {
    80		accountType := AccountType(c.Query("type"))
    81		activeOnly := c.Query("active") == "true"
    82	
    83		accounts, err := h.service.ListAccounts(accountType, activeOnly)
    84		if err != nil {
    85			utils.Error(c, 6005, "Failed to list accounts: "+err.Error())
    86			return
    87		}
    88	
    89		utils.Success(c, map[string]interface{}{
    90			"accounts": accounts,
    91			"total":    len(accounts),
    92		})
    93	}
    94	
    95	// UpdateAccount handles PUT /api/v1/admin/third-party-accounts/:id
    96	func (h *Handler) UpdateAccount(c *gin.Context) {
    97		idStr := c.Param("id")
    98		id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 32)
    99		if err != nil {
   100			utils.Error(c, 6006, "Invalid account ID")
   101			return
   102		}
   103	
   104		var req UpdateAccountRequest
   105		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   106			utils.Error(c, 6007, "Invalid request body: "+err.Error())
   107			return
   108		}
   109	
   110		status := -1
   111		if req.Status != nil {
   112			status = *req.Status
   113		}
   114	
   115		priority := -1
   116		if req.Priority != nil {
   117			priority = *req.Priority
   118		}
   119	
   120		account, err := h.service.UpdateAccountWithPriority(uint(id), req.Name, req.Config, status, priority)
   121		if err != nil {
   122			utils.Error(c, 6008, "Failed to update account: "+err.Error())
   123			return
   124		}
   125	
   126		utils.Success(c, account)
   127	}
   128	
   129	// DeleteAccount handles DELETE /api/v1/admin/third-party-accounts/:id
   130	func (h *Handler) DeleteAccount(c *gin.Context) {
   131		idStr := c.Param("id")
   132		id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 32)
   133		if err != nil {
   134			utils.Error(c, 6009, "Invalid account ID")
   135			return
   136		}
   137	
   138		if err := h.service.DeleteAccount(uint(id)); err != nil {
   139			utils.Error(c, 6010, "Failed to delete account: "+err.Error())
   140			return
   141		}
   142	
   143		utils.Success(c, map[string]interface{}{
   144			"message": "Account deleted successfully",
   145		})
   146	}

   151		if err != nil {
   152			utils.Error(c, 6011, "Failed to get stats: "+err.Error())
   153			return
   154		}

    17	// AccountType represents the type of third-party account

    21		AccountTypeSemanticScholar AccountType = "semantic_scholar"
    22		AccountTypeAIModel         AccountType = "ai_model"
    23	)
    24	
    25	// ModelLevel represents the AI model capability level
    26	type ModelLevel string
    27	
    28	const (
    29		ModelLevelLow  ModelLevel = "low"
    30		ModelLevelMid  ModelLevel = "mid"
    31		ModelLevelHigh ModelLevel = "high"
    32	)
    33	
    34	// AccountConfig represents the configuration stored in JSON
    35	type AccountConfig map[string]interface{}
    36	
    37	// Value implements driver.Valuer interface for JSON marshaling
    38	func (c AccountConfig) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
    39		return json.Marshal(c)
    40	}
    41	
    42	// Scan implements sql.Scanner interface for JSON unmarshaling
    43	func (c *AccountConfig) Scan(value interface{}) error {
    44		bytes, ok := value.([]byte)
    45		if !ok {
    46			return fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal JSON value: %v", value)
    47		}
    48		return json.Unmarshal(bytes, c)
    49	}

    51	// ThirdPartyAccount represents a third-party API account configuration
    52	type ThirdPartyAccount struct {
    53		ID          uint          `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
    54		Name        string        `gorm:"type:varchar(100);not null" json:"name"`
    55		Type        AccountType   `gorm:"type:varchar(50);not null;index:idx_type_status" json:"type"`
    56		Config      AccountConfig `gorm:"type:json;not null" json:"config"`
    57		Status      int           `gorm:"default:1;index:idx_type_status" json:"status"` // 1=active, 0=inactive
    58		Priority    int           `gorm:"default:0" json:"priority"`                     // 优先级，数字越小优先级越高
    59		UsageCount  uint64        `gorm:"default:0" json:"usage_count"`
    60		LastUsedAt  *time.Time    `json:"last_used_at,omitempty"`
    61		CreatedAt   time.Time     `json:"created_at"`
    62		UpdatedAt   time.Time     `json:"updated_at"`
    63	}
    64	
    65	// TableName specifies the table name for GORM
    66	func (ThirdPartyAccount) TableName() string {
    67		return "third_party_accounts"
    68	}
    69	
    70	// SemanticScholarConfig represents the config structure for Semantic Scholar
    71	type SemanticScholarConfig struct {
    72		APIKey  string `json:"api_key"`
    73		BaseURL string `json:"base_url,omitempty"` // Optional: custom base URL (e.g., for proxies)
    74	}
    75	
    76	// AIModelConfig represents the config structure for AI models
    77	// One account can configure three different model codes for low/mid/high levels
    78	type AIModelConfig struct {
    79		BaseURL  string `json:"base_url"`
    80		APIKey   string `json:"api_key"`
    81		ModelLow string `json:"model_low,omitempty"`  // Model code for low-level tasks
    82		ModelMid string `json:"model_mid,omitempty"`  // Model code for mid-level tasks
    83		ModelHigh string `json:"model_high,omitempty"` // Model code for high-level tasks
    84	}
    85	
    86	// GetSemanticScholarConfig extracts Semantic Scholar config
    87	func (a *ThirdPartyAccount) GetSemanticScholarConfig() (*SemanticScholarConfig, error) {
    88		if a.Type != AccountTypeSemanticScholar {
    89			return nil, fmt.Errorf("account type is not semantic_scholar")
    90		}
    91	
    92		var config SemanticScholarConfig
    93		configBytes, err := json.Marshal(a.Config)
    94		if err != nil {
    95			return nil, err
    96		}
    97	
    98		if err := json.Unmarshal(configBytes, &config); err != nil {
    99			return nil, err
   100		}
   101	
   102		return &config, nil
   103	}
   104	
   105	// GetAIModelConfig extracts AI model config
   106	func (a *ThirdPartyAccount) GetAIModelConfig() (*AIModelConfig, error) {
   107		if a.Type != AccountTypeAIModel {
   108			return nil, fmt.Errorf("account type is not ai_model")
   109		}
   110	
   111		var config AIModelConfig
   112		configBytes, err := json.Marshal(a.Config)
   113		if err != nil {
   114			return nil, err
   115		}
   116	
   117		if err := json.Unmarshal(configBytes, &config); err != nil {
   118			return nil, err
   119		}
   120	
   121		return &config, nil
   122	}
   123	
   124	// GetModelCodeByLevel returns the model code for a specific level from AI model config
   125	func (a *ThirdPartyAccount) GetModelCodeByLevel(level ModelLevel) (string, error) {
   126		config, err := a.GetAIModelConfig()
   127		if err != nil {
   128			return "", err
   129		}
   130	
   131		switch level {
   132		case ModelLevelLow:
   133			if config.ModelLow == "" {
   134				return "", fmt.Errorf("model_low not configured")
   135			}
   136			return config.ModelLow, nil
   137		case ModelLevelMid:
   138			if config.ModelMid == "" {
   139				return "", fmt.Errorf("model_mid not configured")
   140			}
   141			return config.ModelMid, nil
   142		case ModelLevelHigh:
   143			if config.ModelHigh == "" {
   144				return "", fmt.Errorf("model_high not configured")
   145			}
   146			return config.ModelHigh, nil
   147		default:
   148			return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid model level: %s", level)
   149		}
   150	}

    18	// Repository handles database operations for third-party accounts

    20		db *gorm.DB

    23	// NewRepository creates a new repository
    24	func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
    25		return &Repository{db: db}
    26	}
    27	
    28	// Create creates a new third-party account
    29	func (r *Repository) Create(account *ThirdPartyAccount) error {
    30		return r.db.Create(account).Error
    31	}
    32	
    33	// GetByID retrieves an account by ID
    34	func (r *Repository) GetByID(id uint) (*ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    35		var account ThirdPartyAccount
    36		err := r.db.First(&account, id).Error
    37		if err != nil {
    38			if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
    39				return nil, nil
    40			}
    41			return nil, err
    42		}
    43		return &account, nil
    44	}
    45	
    46	// GetAll retrieves all accounts with optional filtering
    47	func (r *Repository) GetAll(accountType AccountType, activeOnly bool) ([]ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    48		query := r.db.Model(&ThirdPartyAccount{})
    49	
    50		if accountType != "" {
    51			query = query.Where("type = ?", accountType)
    52		}
    53	
    54		if activeOnly {
    55			query = query.Where("status = ?", 1)
    56		}
    57	
    58		var accounts []ThirdPartyAccount
    59		err := query.Order("created_at DESC").Find(&accounts).Error
    60		return accounts, err
    61	}
    62	
    63	// GetActiveByType retrieves all active accounts of a specific type
    64	// Sorted by priority (ascending, lower number = higher priority), then by usage_count (ascending)
    65	func (r *Repository) GetActiveByType(accountType AccountType) ([]ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    66		var accounts []ThirdPartyAccount
    67		err := r.db.Where("type = ? AND status = ?", accountType, 1).
    68			Order("priority ASC, usage_count ASC"). // First by priority, then by usage count
    69			Find(&accounts).Error
    70		return accounts, err
    71	}

    74	// Kept for backwards compatibility but will always return error

    76		return nil, fmt.Errorf("GetActiveByTypeAndLevel is deprecated - use GetActiveByType and check model configs instead")
    77	}

    89	// IncrementUsage increments the usage count and updates last used time

    93			Where("id = ?", id).
    94			Updates(map[string]interface{}{
    95				"usage_count":  gorm.Expr("usage_count + ?", 1),
    96				"last_used_at": now,
    97			}).Error
    98	}

   107	// TypeStats 按类型的统计信息
   108	type TypeStats struct {
   109		Type        string     `json:"type"`
   110		TypeName    string     `json:"type_name"`    // 类型名称（中文）
   111		TotalCount  int64      `json:"total_count"`  // 该类型的账号总数
   112		ActiveCount int64      `json:"active_count"` // 该类型的启用账号数
   113		TotalUsage  uint64     `json:"total_usage"`  // 该类型的总请求次数
   114		LastUsedAt  *time.Time `json:"last_used_at"` // 该类型的最后使用时间
   115	}
   116	
   117	// GetStats retrieves usage statistics
   118	func (r *Repository) GetStats() (map[string]interface{}, error) {
   119		// 按类型统计（这是最准确的统计方式）
   120		typeStats, err := r.GetStatsByType()
   121		if err != nil {
   122			return nil, err
   123		}
   124	
   125		// 从类型统计中汇总
   126		var total int64
   127		var activeCount int64
   128		var totalUsage uint64
   129		var semanticScholarTotal int64
   130		var semanticScholarActive int64
   131		var aiModelTotal int64
   132		var aiModelActive int64
   133	
   134		for _, ts := range typeStats {
   135			total += ts.TotalCount
   136			activeCount += ts.ActiveCount
   137			totalUsage += ts.TotalUsage
   138	
   139			switch ts.Type {
   140			case string(AccountTypeSemanticScholar):
   141				semanticScholarTotal = ts.TotalCount
   142				semanticScholarActive = ts.ActiveCount
   143			case string(AccountTypeAIModel):
   144				aiModelTotal = ts.TotalCount
   145				aiModelActive = ts.ActiveCount
   146			}
   147		}
   148	
   149		return map[string]interface{}{
   150			"total":                          total,
   151			"active_count":                   activeCount,
   152			"semantic_scholar_count":         semanticScholarActive, // 保持兼容：启用数
   153			"semantic_scholar_total":         semanticScholarTotal,  // 新增：总数
   154			"ai_model_count":                 aiModelActive,         // 保持兼容：启用数
   155			"ai_model_total":                 aiModelTotal,          // 新增：总数
   156			"total_usage":                    totalUsage,
   157			"type_stats":                     typeStats,
   158		}, nil
   159	}
   160	
   161	// GetStatsByType 按类型获取统计信息
   162	func (r *Repository) GetStatsByType() ([]TypeStats, error) {
   163		types := []AccountType{AccountTypeSemanticScholar, AccountTypeAIModel}
   164		typeNames := map[AccountType]string{
   165			AccountTypeSemanticScholar: "Semantic Scholar",
   166			AccountTypeAIModel:         "AI模型",
   167		}
   168		result := make([]TypeStats, 0, len(types))
   169	
   170		for _, accountType := range types {
   171			var typeStats TypeStats
   172			typeStats.Type = string(accountType)
   173			typeStats.TypeName = typeNames[accountType]
   174	
   175			// 总账号数
   176			if err := r.db.Model(&ThirdPartyAccount{}).
   177				Where("type = ?", accountType).
   178				Count(&typeStats.TotalCount).Error; err != nil {
   179				return nil, err
   180			}
   181	
   182			// 启用账号数
   183			if err := r.db.Model(&ThirdPartyAccount{}).
   184				Where("type = ? AND status = ?", accountType, 1).
   185				Count(&typeStats.ActiveCount).Error; err != nil {
   186				return nil, err
   187			}
   188	
   189			// 总请求次数
   190			var usageResult struct {
   191				TotalUsage uint64
   192			}
   193			if err := r.db.Model(&ThirdPartyAccount{}).
   194				Where("type = ?", accountType).
   195				Select("COALESCE(SUM(usage_count), 0) as total_usage").
   196				Scan(&usageResult).Error; err != nil {
   197				return nil, err
   198			}
   199			typeStats.TotalUsage = usageResult.TotalUsage
   200	
   201			// 最后使用时间（取所有该类型账号中最晚的时间）
   202			var lastUsedResult struct {
   203				LastUsedAt *time.Time
   204			}
   205			if err := r.db.Model(&ThirdPartyAccount{}).
   206				Where("type = ? AND last_used_at IS NOT NULL", accountType).
   207				Select("MAX(last_used_at) as last_used_at").
   208				Scan(&lastUsedResult).Error; err != nil {
   209				return nil, err
   210			}
   211			typeStats.LastUsedAt = lastUsedResult.LastUsedAt
   212	
   213			result = append(result, typeStats)
   214		}
   215	
   216		return result, nil
   217	}
   218	
   219	// ValidateConfig validates the account configuration based on type
   220	func ValidateConfig(accountType AccountType, config AccountConfig) error {
   221		switch accountType {
   222		case AccountTypeSemanticScholar:
   223			apiKey, ok := config["api_key"].(string)
   224			if !ok || apiKey == "" {
   225				return fmt.Errorf("api_key is required for semantic_scholar type")
   226			}
   227		case AccountTypeAIModel:
   228			baseURL, ok := config["base_url"].(string)
   229			if !ok || baseURL == "" {
   230				return fmt.Errorf("base_url is required for ai_model type")
   231			}
   232			apiKey, ok := config["api_key"].(string)
   233			if !ok || apiKey == "" {
   234				return fmt.Errorf("api_key is required for ai_model type")
   235			}
   236		default:
   237			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported account type: %s", accountType)
   238		}
   239		return nil
   240	}

     1	// ============================================================================
     2	// Scholay学术 V1.0

     4	// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

     8	package thirdparty
     9	
    10	import (
    11		"context"
    12		"fmt"
    13		"math/rand"
    14		"sync"
    15		"time"
    16	)
    17	
    18	// Service handles business logic for third-party accounts
    19	type Service struct {
    20		repo   *Repository
    21		mu     sync.RWMutex
    22		cache  map[AccountType][]ThirdPartyAccount // Cached active accounts
    23		ctx    context.Context
    24		cancel context.CancelFunc
    25	}
    26	
    27	// NewService creates a new service
    28	func NewService(repo *Repository) *Service {
    29		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
    30		return &Service{
    31			repo:   repo,
    32			cache:  make(map[AccountType][]ThirdPartyAccount),
    33			ctx:    ctx,
    34			cancel: cancel,
    35		}
    36	}
    37	
    38	// CreateAccount creates a new third-party account
    39	func (s *Service) CreateAccount(name string, accountType AccountType, config AccountConfig) (*ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    40		return s.CreateAccountWithPriority(name, accountType, config, 0)
    41	}
    42	
    43	// CreateAccountWithPriority creates a new third-party account with priority
    44	func (s *Service) CreateAccountWithPriority(name string, accountType AccountType, config AccountConfig, priority int) (*ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    45		// Validate configuration
    46		if err := ValidateConfig(accountType, config); err != nil {
    47			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid configuration: %w", err)
    48		}
    49	
    50		account := &ThirdPartyAccount{
    51			Name:     name,
    52			Type:     accountType,
    53			Config:   config,
    54			Status:   1, // Active by default
    55			Priority: priority,
    56		}
    57	
    58		if err := s.repo.Create(account); err != nil {
    59			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create account: %w", err)
    60		}
    61	
    62		// Invalidate cache
    63		s.invalidateCache(accountType)
    64	
    65		return account, nil
    66	}
    67	
    68	// GetAccount retrieves an account by ID
    69	func (s *Service) GetAccount(id uint) (*ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    70		account, err := s.repo.GetByID(id)
    71		if err != nil {
    72			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get account: %w", err)
    73		}
    74		if account == nil {
    75			return nil, fmt.Errorf("account not found")
    76		}
    77		return account, nil
    78	}
    79	
    80	// ListAccounts lists all accounts with optional filtering
    81	func (s *Service) ListAccounts(accountType AccountType, activeOnly bool) ([]ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    82		accounts, err := s.repo.GetAll(accountType, activeOnly)
    83		if err != nil {
    84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list accounts: %w", err)
    85		}
    86		return accounts, nil
    87	}
    88	
    89	// UpdateAccount updates an account
    90	func (s *Service) UpdateAccount(id uint, name string, config AccountConfig, status int) (*ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    91		return s.UpdateAccountWithPriority(id, name, config, status, -1)
    92	}
    93	
    94	// UpdateAccountWithPriority updates an account with priority
    95	func (s *Service) UpdateAccountWithPriority(id uint, name string, config AccountConfig, status int, priority int) (*ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
    96		account, err := s.repo.GetByID(id)
    97		if err != nil {
    98			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get account: %w", err)
    99		}
   100		if account == nil {
   101			return nil, fmt.Errorf("account not found")
   102		}
   103	
   104		// Validate configuration if provided
   105		if config != nil {
   106			if err := ValidateConfig(account.Type, config); err != nil {
   107				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid configuration: %w", err)
   108			}
   109			account.Config = config
   110		}
   111	
   112		if name != "" {
   113			account.Name = name
   114		}
   115	
   116		if status >= 0 {
   117			account.Status = status
   118		}
   119	
   120		if priority >= 0 {
   121			account.Priority = priority
   122		}
   123	
   124		if err := s.repo.Update(account); err != nil {
   125			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update account: %w", err)
   126		}
   127	
   128		// Invalidate cache
   129		s.invalidateCache(account.Type)
   130	
   131		return account, nil
   132	}

   134	// DeleteAccount deletes an account
   135	func (s *Service) DeleteAccount(id uint) error {
   136		account, err := s.repo.GetByID(id)
   137		if err != nil {
   138			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get account: %w", err)
   139		}
   140		if account == nil {
   141			return fmt.Errorf("account not found")
   142		}
   143	
   144		if err := s.repo.Delete(id); err != nil {
   145			return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete account: %w", err)
   146		}
   147	
   148		// Invalidate cache
   149		s.invalidateCache(account.Type)
   150	
   151		return nil
   152	}

   154	// GetRandomAPIKey gets a random API key of the specified type (with usage tracking)
   155	func (s *Service) GetRandomAPIKey(accountType AccountType) (string, uint, error) {
   156		accounts, err := s.getActiveAccounts(accountType)
   157		if err != nil {
   158			return "", 0, err
   159		}
   160	
   161		if len(accounts) == 0 {
   162			return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("no active %s accounts found", accountType)
   163		}
   164	
   165		// Use weighted random selection based on inverse usage count
   166		// Accounts with lower usage_count have higher probability of being selected
   167		selected := s.weightedRandomSelect(accounts)
   168	
   169		// Increment usage count
   170		if err := s.repo.IncrementUsage(selected.ID); err != nil {
   171			// Log error but don't fail the request
   172			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to increment usage count for account %d: %v\n", selected.ID, err)
   173		}
   174	
   175		// Extract API key based on type
   176		var apiKey string
   177		switch accountType {
   178		case AccountTypeSemanticScholar:
   179			config, err := selected.GetSemanticScholarConfig()
   180			if err != nil {
   181				return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse config: %w", err)
   182			}
   183			apiKey = config.APIKey
   184		case AccountTypeAIModel:
   185			config, err := selected.GetAIModelConfig()
   186			if err != nil {
   187				return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse config: %w", err)
   188			}
   189			apiKey = config.APIKey
   190		default:
   191			return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("unsupported account type: %s", accountType)
   192		}
   193	
   194		return apiKey, selected.ID, nil
   195	}
   196	
   197	// GetRandomAIModelConfig gets a random AI model configuration
   198	func (s *Service) GetRandomAIModelConfig() (*AIModelConfig, uint, error) {
   199		accounts, err := s.getActiveAccounts(AccountTypeAIModel)
   200		if err != nil {
   201			return nil, 0, err
   202		}

   204		if len(accounts) == 0 {
   205			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("no active ai_model accounts found")
   206		}

   208		// Use weighted random selection

   210	
   211		// Increment usage count

   214		}
   215

   219		}

   222	}

   224	// priorityRandomSelect selects an account based on priority
   225	// 1. First, find the highest priority (lowest number) among all accounts
   226	// 2. Filter accounts with the same highest priority
   227	// 3. Among those, randomly select one (weighted by inverse usage_count)
   228	func (s *Service) priorityRandomSelect(accounts []ThirdPartyAccount) *ThirdPartyAccount {
   229		if len(accounts) == 0 {
   230			return nil
   231		}
   232		if len(accounts) == 1 {
   233			return &accounts[0]
   234		}
   235	
   236		// Find the highest priority (lowest number)
   237		highestPriority := accounts[0].Priority
   238		for _, account := range accounts {
   239			if account.Priority < highestPriority {
   240				highestPriority = account.Priority
   241			}
   242		}
   243	
   244		// Filter accounts with the highest priority
   245		var highPriorityAccounts []ThirdPartyAccount
   246		for _, account := range accounts {
   247			if account.Priority == highestPriority {
   248				highPriorityAccounts = append(highPriorityAccounts, account)
   249			}
   250		}
   251	
   252		// If only one account with highest priority, return it
   253		if len(highPriorityAccounts) == 1 {
   254			return &highPriorityAccounts[0]
   255		}
   256	
   257		// Among accounts with same priority, use weighted random selection based on usage_count
   258		return s.weightedRandomSelectFromList(highPriorityAccounts)
   259	}
   260	
   261	// weightedRandomSelectFromList selects an account with probability inversely proportional to usage_count
   262	func (s *Service) weightedRandomSelectFromList(accounts []ThirdPartyAccount) *ThirdPartyAccount {
   263		if len(accounts) == 0 {
   264			return nil
   265		}
   266		if len(accounts) == 1 {
   267			return &accounts[0]
   268		}
   269	
   270		// Calculate weights (inverse of usage_count + 1 to avoid division by zero)
   271		weights := make([]float64, len(accounts))
   272		totalWeight := 0.0
   273	
   274		for i, account := range accounts {
   275			// Weight = 1 / (usage_count + 1)
   276			// Add 1 to avoid division by zero and ensure new accounts get used
   277			weight := 1.0 / float64(account.UsageCount+1)
   278			weights[i] = weight
   279			totalWeight += weight
   280		}
   281	
   282		// Random selection based on weights
   283		r := rand.Float64() * totalWeight
   284		cumulative := 0.0
   285	
   286		for i, weight := range weights {
   287			cumulative += weight
   288			if r <= cumulative {
   289				return &accounts[i]
   290			}
   291		}
   292	
   293		// Fallback (should not reach here)
   294		return &accounts[len(accounts)-1]
   295	}
   296	
   297	// weightedRandomSelect is kept for backwards compatibility, now uses priorityRandomSelect
   298	func (s *Service) weightedRandomSelect(accounts []ThirdPartyAccount) *ThirdPartyAccount {
   299		return s.priorityRandomSelect(accounts)
   300	}

   302	// getActiveAccounts retrieves active accounts from cache or database
   303	func (s *Service) getActiveAccounts(accountType AccountType) ([]ThirdPartyAccount, error) {
   304		s.mu.RLock()
   305		cached, exists := s.cache[accountType]
   306		s.mu.RUnlock()
   307	
   308		if exists && len(cached) > 0 {
   309			return cached, nil
   310		}
   311	
   312		// Fetch from database
   313		accounts, err := s.repo.GetActiveByType(accountType)
   314		if err != nil {
   315			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get active accounts: %w", err)
   316		}
   317	
   318		// Update cache
   319		s.mu.Lock()
   320		s.cache[accountType] = accounts
   321		s.mu.Unlock()
   322	
   323		return accounts, nil
   324	}
   325	
   326	// invalidateCache invalidates the cache for a specific account type
   327	func (s *Service) invalidateCache(accountType AccountType) {
   328		s.mu.Lock()
   329		delete(s.cache, accountType)
   330		s.mu.Unlock()
   331	}
   332	
   333	// RefreshCache refreshes the cache for all account types
   334	func (s *Service) RefreshCache() error {
   335		types := []AccountType{AccountTypeSemanticScholar, AccountTypeAIModel}
   336	
   337		for _, accountType := range types {
   338			accounts, err := s.repo.GetActiveByType(accountType)
   339			if err != nil {
   340				return fmt.Errorf("failed to refresh cache for %s: %w", accountType, err)
   341			}
   342	
   343			s.mu.Lock()
   344			s.cache[accountType] = accounts
   345			s.mu.Unlock()
   346		}
   347	
   348		return nil
   349	}
   350	
   351	// GetStats retrieves usage statistics
   352	func (s *Service) GetStats() (map[string]interface{}, error) {
   353		return s.repo.GetStats()
   354	}
   355	
   356	// StartCacheRefreshTask starts a background task to refresh cache periodically
   357	func (s *Service) StartCacheRefreshTask(interval time.Duration) {
   358		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
   359		go func() {
   360			defer ticker.Stop()
   361			fmt.Println("Third-party account cache refresh task started")
   362	
   363			for {
   364				select {
   365				case <-ticker.C:
   366					if err := s.RefreshCache(); err != nil {
   367						fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to refresh account cache: %v\n", err)
   368					}
   369				case <-s.ctx.Done():
   370					fmt.Println("Third-party account cache refresh task stopped")
   371					return
   372				}
   373			}
   374		}()
   375	}
   376	
   377	// Stop gracefully stops the cache refresh task
   378	func (s *Service) Stop() {
   379		fmt.Println("Stopping third-party service...")
   380		s.cancel()
   381		fmt.Println("✓ Third-party service stopped")
   382	}

   389	// GetRandomAIModelConfigByLevel gets a random AI model configuration and returns the model code for the specified level
   390	// Now each AI account can contain three model codes (low/mid/high), so we select an account and return the appropriate model code
   391	func (s *Service) GetRandomAIModelConfigByLevel(modelLevel ModelLevel) (*AIModelConfig, uint, error) {
   392		return s.GetRandomAIModelConfigByLevelExcluding(modelLevel, nil)
   393	}
   394	
   395	// GetRandomAIModelConfigByLevelExcluding gets a random AI model configuration excluding specific account IDs
   396	// This is used for retry logic - when an account fails, we exclude it and try another one
   397	func (s *Service) GetRandomAIModelConfigByLevelExcluding(modelLevel ModelLevel, excludeIDs []uint) (*AIModelConfig, uint, error) {
   398		// Get all active AI model accounts
   399		accounts, err := s.getActiveAccounts(AccountTypeAIModel)
   400		if err != nil {
   401			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to get active AI model accounts: %w", err)
   402		}
   403	
   404		if len(accounts) == 0 {
   405			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("no active ai_model accounts found")
   406		}
   407	
   408		// Build exclude map for O(1) lookup
   409		excludeMap := make(map[uint]bool)
   410		for _, id := range excludeIDs {
   411			excludeMap[id] = true
   412		}
   413	
   414		// Filter accounts that have the requested model level configured and are not excluded
   415		var validAccounts []ThirdPartyAccount
   416		for _, account := range accounts {
   417			// Skip excluded accounts
   418			if excludeMap[account.ID] {
   419				continue
   420			}
   421			modelCode, err := account.GetModelCodeByLevel(modelLevel)
   422			if err == nil && modelCode != "" {
   423				validAccounts = append(validAccounts, account)
   424			}
   425		}
   426	
   427		if len(validAccounts) == 0 {
   428			if len(excludeIDs) > 0 {
   429				return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("no more ai_model accounts available for level %s (all tried)", modelLevel)
   430			}
   431			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("no active ai_model accounts found with %s model configured", modelLevel)
   432		}
   433	
   434		// Use priority-based random selection
   435		selected := s.priorityRandomSelect(validAccounts)
   436		if selected == nil {
   437			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to select AI model account")
   438		}
   439	
   440		// Increment usage count
   441		if err := s.repo.IncrementUsage(selected.ID); err != nil {
   442			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to increment usage count for account %d: %v\n", selected.ID, err)
   443		}
   444	
   445		config, err := selected.GetAIModelConfig()
   446		if err != nil {
   447			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse config: %w", err)
   448		}
   449	
   450		// Get the specific model code for this level
   451		modelCode, err := selected.GetModelCodeByLevel(modelLevel)
   452		if err != nil {
   453			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to get model code for level %s: %w", modelLevel, err)
   454		}
   455	
   456		// Return a simplified config with BaseURL, APIKey, and the specific model code in ModelLow field
   457		// (AI service will use ModelLow as the actual model parameter)
   458		levelConfig := &AIModelConfig{
   459			BaseURL:   config.BaseURL,
   460			APIKey:    config.APIKey,
   461			ModelLow:  modelCode, // The actual model code to use for this request
   462			ModelMid:  "",        // Not used
   463			ModelHigh: "",        // Not used
   464		}
   465	
   466		return levelConfig, selected.ID, nil
   467	}
   468	
   469	// GetRandomAPIKeyByLevel gets a random AI model API key that has the specified level configured (with usage tracking)
   470	func (s *Service) GetRandomAPIKeyByLevel(modelLevel ModelLevel) (string, uint, error) {
   471		// Get all active AI model accounts
   472		accounts, err := s.getActiveAccounts(AccountTypeAIModel)
   473		if err != nil {
   474			return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to get active AI model accounts: %w", err)
   475		}
   476	
   477		if len(accounts) == 0 {
   478			return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("no active ai_model accounts found")
   479		}
   480	
   481		// Filter accounts that have the requested model level configured
   482		var validAccounts []ThirdPartyAccount
   483		for _, account := range accounts {
   484			modelCode, err := account.GetModelCodeByLevel(modelLevel)
   485			if err == nil && modelCode != "" {
   486				validAccounts = append(validAccounts, account)
   487			}
   488		}
   489	
   490		if len(validAccounts) == 0 {
   491			return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("no active ai_model accounts found with %s model configured", modelLevel)
   492		}
   493	
   494		// Use weighted random selection
   495		selected := s.weightedRandomSelect(validAccounts)
   496	
   497		// Increment usage count
   498		if err := s.repo.IncrementUsage(selected.ID); err != nil {
   499			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to increment usage count for account %d: %v\n", selected.ID, err)
   500		}
   501	
   502		config, err := selected.GetAIModelConfig()
   503		if err != nil {
   504			return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse config: %w", err)
   505		}
   506	
   507		return config.APIKey, selected.ID, nil
   508	}

    27	// GithubUser represents GitHub user info from API
    28	type GithubUser struct {
    29		ID        int64  `json:"id"`
    30		Login     string `json:"login"`
    31		Name      string `json:"name"`
    32		Email     string `json:"email"`
    33		AvatarURL string `json:"avatar_url"`
    34		Bio       string `json:"bio"`
    35		Location  string `json:"location"`
    36		Blog      string `json:"blog"`
    37	}

    39	// GithubTokenResponse represents GitHub OAuth token response
    40	type GithubTokenResponse struct {
    41		AccessToken string `json:"access_token"`
    42		TokenType   string `json:"token_type"`
    43		Scope       string `json:"scope"`
    44	}

    46	// GetGithubLoginURL generates GitHub OAuth login URL
    47	func (h *Handler) GetGithubLoginURL(c *gin.Context) {
    48		// Get GitHub OAuth config from dedicated table
    49		githubConfig, err := h.configRepo.GetGithubOAuthConfig()
    50		if err != nil {
    51			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get GitHub OAuth config")
    52			return
    53		}
    54	
    55		if githubConfig == nil || githubConfig.ClientID == "" {
    56			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "GitHub login is not configured. Please configure Client ID in admin settings.")
    57			return
    58		}
    59	
    60		// Use configured redirect URI or fallback to default
    61		redirectURI := githubConfig.RedirectURI
    62		if redirectURI == "" {
    63			// Get origin from request header
    64			origin := c.GetHeader("Origin")
    65			if origin == "" {
    66				origin = c.GetHeader("Referer")
    67			}
    68			if origin != "" {
    69				redirectURI = origin + "/github/callback"
    70			} else {
    71				utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "GitHub redirect URI is not configured")
    72				return
    73			}
    74		}
    75	
    76		// Generate state token for CSRF protection
    77		state := utils.GenerateRandomString(32)
    78	
    79		// Build GitHub OAuth URL
    80		authURL := fmt.Sprintf(
    81			"https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?client_id=%s&redirect_uri=%s&state=%s&scope=user:email",
    82			url.QueryEscape(githubConfig.ClientID),
    83			url.QueryEscape(redirectURI),
    84			state,
    85		)
    86	
    87		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", gin.H{
    88			"url":   authURL,
    89			"state": state,
    90		})
    91	}
    92	
    93	// GithubCallback handles GitHub OAuth callback
    94	func (h *Handler) GithubCallback(c *gin.Context) {
    95		code := c.Query("code")
    96		// state parameter is validated by frontend
    97		// state := c.Query("state")
    98		invitationCode := c.Query("invitation_code") // 获取邀请码参数
    99	
   100		if code == "" {
   101			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authorization code is required")
   102			return
   103		}
   104	
   105		// Get GitHub OAuth config
   106		githubConfig, err := h.configRepo.GetGithubOAuthConfig()
   107		if err != nil {
   108			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get GitHub OAuth config")
   109			return
   110		}
   111	
   112		if githubConfig == nil || githubConfig.ClientID == "" || githubConfig.ClientSecret == "" {
   113			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "GitHub login is not configured properly")
   114			return
   115		}
   116	
   117		// Exchange code for access token
   118		accessToken, err := h.exchangeGithubCode(code, githubConfig)
   119		if err != nil {
   120			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to exchange code: %v", err))
   121			return
   122		}
   123	
   124		// Get user info from GitHub
   125		githubUser, err := h.getGithubUserInfo(accessToken)
   126		if err != nil {
   127			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to get user info: %v", err))
   128			return
   129		}
   130	
   131		// Find or create user (with invitation code support)
   132		ip := c.ClientIP()
   133		user, isNewUser, err := h.findOrCreateGithubUser(githubUser, invitationCode, ip)
   134		if err != nil {
   135			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to process user: %v", err))
   136			return
   137		}
   138	
   139		// Generate JWT token
   140		username := ""
   141		if user.Username != nil {
   142			username = *user.Username
   143		}
   144		token, err := utils.GenerateToken(user.ID, username, "user")
   145		if err != nil {
   146			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to generate token")
   147			return
   148		}
   149	
   150		// Update last login time and IP
   151		_ = h.userRepo.UpdateLastLoginWithIP(user.ID, ip)
   152	
   153		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", gin.H{
   154			"token":       token,
   155			"user":        user,
   156			"is_new_user": isNewUser,
   157		})
   158	}
   159	
   160	// exchangeGithubCode exchanges authorization code for access token
   161	func (h *Handler) exchangeGithubCode(code string, config *model.GithubOAuthConfig) (string, error) {
   162		data := url.Values{}
   163		data.Set("client_id", config.ClientID)
   164		data.Set("client_secret", config.ClientSecret)
   165		data.Set("code", code)
   166		data.Set("redirect_uri", config.RedirectURI)
   167	
   168		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(
   169			context.Background(),
   170			"POST",
   171			"https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token",
   172			strings.NewReader(data.Encode()),
   173		)
   174		if err != nil {
   175			return "", err
   176		}
   177	
   178		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
   179		req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
   180	
   181		client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
   182		resp, err := client.Do(req)
   183		if err != nil {
   184			return "", err
   185		}
   186		defer resp.Body.Close()
   187	
   188		if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
   189			body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   190			return "", fmt.Errorf("github token exchange failed: %s", string(body))
   191		}
   192	
   193		var tokenResp GithubTokenResponse
   194		if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&tokenResp); err != nil {
   195			return "", err
   196		}
   197	
   198		return tokenResp.AccessToken, nil
   199	}
   200	
   201	// getGithubUserInfo gets user info from GitHub API
   202	func (h *Handler) getGithubUserInfo(accessToken string) (*GithubUser, error) {
   203		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(
   204			context.Background(),
   205			"GET",
   206			"https://api.github.com/user",
   207			nil,
   208		)
   209		if err != nil {
   210			return nil, err
   211		}
   212	
   213		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+accessToken)
   214		req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/vnd.github.v3+json")
   215	
   216		client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
   217		resp, err := client.Do(req)
   218		if err != nil {
   219			return nil, err
   220		}
   221		defer resp.Body.Close()
   222	
   223		if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
   224			body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   225			return nil, fmt.Errorf("github user info failed: %s", string(body))
   226		}
   227	
   228		var githubUser GithubUser
   229		if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&githubUser); err != nil {
   230			return nil, err
   231		}
   232	
   233		// If primary email is not public, fetch it from emails endpoint
   234		if githubUser.Email == "" {
   235			email, err := h.getGithubUserEmail(accessToken)
   236			if err == nil && email != "" {
   237				githubUser.Email = email
   238			}
   239		}
   240	
   241		return &githubUser, nil
   242	}
   243	
   244	// getGithubUserEmail fetches user's primary email from GitHub
   245	func (h *Handler) getGithubUserEmail(accessToken string) (string, error) {
   246		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(
   247			context.Background(),
   248			"GET",
   249			"https://api.github.com/user/emails",
   250			nil,
   251		)
   252		if err != nil {
   253			return "", err
   254		}
   255	
   256		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+accessToken)
   257		req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/vnd.github.v3+json")
   258	
   259		client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
   260		resp, err := client.Do(req)
   261		if err != nil {
   262			return "", err
   263		}
   264		defer resp.Body.Close()
   265	
   266		if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
   267			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get emails")
   268		}
   269	
   270		var emails []struct {
   271			Email    string `json:"email"`
   272			Primary  bool   `json:"primary"`
   273			Verified bool   `json:"verified"`
   274		}
   275	
   276		if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&emails); err != nil {
   277			return "", err
   278		}
   279	
   280		// Find primary verified email
   281		for _, email := range emails {
   282			if email.Primary && email.Verified {
   283				return email.Email, nil
   284			}
   285		}
   286	
   287		// Fallback to first verified email
   288		for _, email := range emails {
   289			if email.Verified {
   290				return email.Email, nil
   291			}
   292		}
   293	
   294		return "", fmt.Errorf("no verified email found")
   295	}
   296	
   297	// findOrCreateGithubUser finds existing user or creates new one
   298	func (h *Handler) findOrCreateGithubUser(githubUser *GithubUser, invitationCode string, ip string) (*User, bool, error) {
   299		// Check if user already exists with this GitHub ID
   300		providerUserID := fmt.Sprintf("%d", githubUser.ID)
   301		authProvider, err := h.userRepo.FindAuthProvider("github", providerUserID)
   302	
   303		if err != nil && err != gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   304			return nil, false, err
   305		}
   306	
   307		// User exists, return it
   308		if authProvider != nil {
   309			user, err := h.userRepo.FindByID(authProvider.UserID)
   310			if err != nil {
   311				return nil, false, err
   312			}
   313			return user, false, nil
   314		}
   315	
   316		// New user - check if email already exists
   317		var user *User
   318		if githubUser.Email != "" {
   319			user, _ = h.userRepo.FindByEmail(githubUser.Email)
   320		}
   321	
   322		isNewUser := false
   323	
   324		// Create new user if doesn't exist
   325		if user == nil {
   326			isNewUser = true
   327	
   328			// Generate username from GitHub login
   329			username := githubUser.Login
   330			// Ensure username is unique
   331			existingUser, _ := h.userRepo.FindByUsername(username)
   332			if existingUser != nil {
   333				username = fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d", username, time.Now().Unix())
   334			}
   335	
   336			email := githubUser.Email
   337			avatarURL := githubUser.AvatarURL
   338			bio := githubUser.Bio
   339	
   340			user = &User{
   341				Username:      &username,
   342				Email:         &email,
   343				AvatarURL:     &avatarURL,
   344				Bio:           &bio,
   345				Status:        1,
   346				EmailVerified: githubUser.Email != "", // GitHub emails are already verified
   347			}
   348	
   349			if err := h.userRepo.Create(user); err != nil {
   350				return nil, false, err
   351			}
   352	
   353			// 处理邀请码 - 如果是新用户且有邀请码
   354			if invitationCode != "" {
   355				if err := h.service.ProcessInvitationForOAuth(user.ID, invitationCode, ip); err != nil {
   356					// 邀请码处理失败不影响注册，只记录日志
   357					fmt.Printf("Failed to process invitation code for GitHub user %d: %v\n", user.ID, err)
   358				}
   359			}
   360	
   361			// 发放注册自动折扣券给新用户
   362			if h.service.GetCouponService() != nil {
   363				go func(uid uint) {
   364					_ = h.service.GetCouponService().DistributeRegisterCoupons(uint64(uid))
   365				}(user.ID)
   366			}
   367			// Note: last login time and IP will be updated in GithubCallback after this function returns
   368		}
   369		// Note: last login time and IP will be updated in GithubCallback after this function returns
   370	
   371		// Create auth provider link
   372		providerDataJSON := fmt.Sprintf(`{"login":"%s","name":"%s","avatar_url":"%s"}`,
   373			githubUser.Login, githubUser.Name, githubUser.AvatarURL)
   374	
   375		authProvider = &UserAuthProvider{
   376			UserID:         user.ID,
   377			Provider:       "github",
   378			ProviderUserID: providerUserID,
   379			ProviderData:   &providerDataJSON,
   380		}
   381	
   382		if err := h.userRepo.CreateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
   383			return nil, isNewUser, err
   384		}
   385	
   386		return user, isNewUser, nil
   387	}

   389	// BindGitHubRequest represents GitHub account binding request
   390	type BindGitHubRequest struct {
   391		Code  string `json:"code" binding:"required"`
   392		State string `json:"state" binding:"required"`
   393	}
   394	
   395	// BindGitHubAccount handles GitHub account binding for existing users
   396	func (h *Handler) BindGitHubAccount(c *gin.Context) {
   397		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   398		if !exists {
   399			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
   400			return
   401		}
   402	
   403		var req BindGitHubRequest
   404		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   405			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   406			return
   407		}
   408	
   409		// Get GitHub OAuth config
   410		githubConfig, err := h.configRepo.GetGithubOAuthConfig()
   411		if err != nil {
   412			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get GitHub OAuth config")
   413			return
   414		}
   415	
   416		if githubConfig == nil || githubConfig.ClientID == "" || githubConfig.ClientSecret == "" {
   417			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "GitHub login is not configured properly")
   418			return
   419		}
   420	
   421		// Exchange code for access token
   422		accessToken, err := h.exchangeGithubCode(req.Code, githubConfig)
   423		if err != nil {
   424			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to exchange code: %v", err))
   425			return
   426		}
   427	
   428		// Get GitHub user info
   429		githubUser, err := h.getGithubUserInfo(accessToken)
   430		if err != nil {
   431			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to get user info: %v", err))
   432			return
   433		}
   434	
   435		// Bind GitHub to current user
   436		if err := h.bindGitHubToUser(userID.(uint), githubUser); err != nil {
   437			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to bind GitHub: %v", err))
   438			return
   439		}
   440	
   441		utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "GitHub account bound successfully", nil)
   442	}
   443	
   444	// bindGitHubToUser binds a GitHub account to an existing user
   445	func (h *Handler) bindGitHubToUser(userID uint, githubUser *GithubUser) error {
   446		// Check if GitHub is already bound to another user
   447		providerUserID := fmt.Sprintf("%d", githubUser.ID)
   448		existing, err := h.userRepo.FindAuthProvider("github", providerUserID)
   449	
   450		if err != nil && err != gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   451			return err
   452		}
   453	
   454		if existing != nil && existing.UserID != userID {
   455			return errors.New("该 GitHub 账号已被其他账号绑定")
   456		}
   457	
   458		// Get current user
   459		user, err := h.userRepo.FindByID(userID)
   460		if err != nil {
   461			return err
   462		}
   463	
   464		if user == nil {
   465			return errors.New("user not found")
   466		}
   467	
   468		// Update username and avatar if not set
   469		if user.Username == nil || *user.Username == "" {
   470			username := githubUser.Login
   471			user.Username = &username
   472		}
   473		if user.AvatarURL == nil || *user.AvatarURL == "" {
   474			user.AvatarURL = &githubUser.AvatarURL
   475		}
   476	
   477		if err := h.userRepo.Update(user); err != nil {
   478			return err
   479		}
   480	
   481		// Create or update auth provider entry
   482		authProvider, err := h.userRepo.FindAuthProviderByUserAndProvider(userID, "github")
   483		if err != nil && err != gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   484			return err
   485		}
   486	
   487		providerDataJSON := fmt.Sprintf(`{"login":"%s","name":"%s","avatar_url":"%s"}`,
   488			githubUser.Login, githubUser.Name, githubUser.AvatarURL)
   489	
   490		if authProvider == nil {
   491			// Create new auth provider
   492			authProvider = &UserAuthProvider{
   493				UserID:         userID,
   494				Provider:       "github",
   495				ProviderUserID: providerUserID,
   496				ProviderData:   &providerDataJSON,
   497			}
   498			if err := h.userRepo.CreateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
   499				return err
   500			}
   501		} else {
   502			// Update existing auth provider
   503			authProvider.ProviderUserID = providerUserID
   504			authProvider.ProviderData = &providerDataJSON
   505			if err := h.userRepo.UpdateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
   506				return err
   507			}
   508		}
   509	
   510		return nil
   511	}

   198	// Register handles user registration
   199	func (h *Handler) Register(c *gin.Context) {
   200		var req RegisterRequest
   201		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   202			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   203			return
   204		}
   205	
   206		// Get system configuration
   207		systemConfig, err := h.service.GetSystemConfig()
   208		if err != nil {
   209			utils.Error(c, 5000, "Failed to get system configuration")
   210			return
   211		}
   212	
   213		// Verify Turnstile token (if enabled)
   214		ip := c.ClientIP()
   215		if valid, err := turnstile.VerifyWithConfig(req.TurnstileToken, ip, systemConfig); !valid {
   216			errMsg := "人机验证失败"
   217			if err != nil {
   218				errMsg = err.Error()
   219			}
   220			utils.Error(c, 4001, errMsg)
   221			return
   222		}
   223	
   224		user, token, err := h.service.RegisterWithEmailAndInvitation(req.Email, req.Password, req.Code, req.InvitationCode, ip)
   225		if err != nil {
   226			utils.Error(c, 2002, err.Error())
   227			return
   228		}
   229	
   230		// Create session for the new user
   231		userAgent := c.GetHeader("User-Agent")
   232		_ = h.service.CreateSession(user.ID, token, ip, userAgent, 24*7*time.Hour) // 7 days
   233	
   234		utils.Success(c, AuthResponse{
   235			Token: token,
   236			User:  user,
   237		})
   238	}

   240	// Login handles user login
   241	func (h *Handler) Login(c *gin.Context) {
   242		var req LoginRequest
   243		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   244			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   245			return
   246		}
   247	
   248		// Get system configuration
   249		systemConfig, err := h.service.GetSystemConfig()
   250		if err != nil {
   251			utils.Error(c, 5000, "Failed to get system configuration")
   252			return
   253		}
   254	
   255		// Verify Turnstile token (if enabled)
   256		ip := c.ClientIP()
   257		if valid, err := turnstile.VerifyWithConfig(req.TurnstileToken, ip, systemConfig); !valid {
   258			errMsg := "人机验证失败"
   259			if err != nil {
   260				errMsg = err.Error()
   261			}
   262			utils.Error(c, 4001, errMsg)
   263			return
   264		}
   265	
   266		user, token, err := h.service.LoginWithEmail(req.Email, req.Password, ip)
   267		if err != nil {
   268			utils.Error(c, 2003, err.Error())
   269			return
   270		}
   271	
   272		// Create session for the user
   273		userAgent := c.GetHeader("User-Agent")
   274		_ = h.service.CreateSession(user.ID, token, ip, userAgent, 24*7*time.Hour) // 7 days
   275	
   276		utils.Success(c, AuthResponse{
   277			Token: token,
   278			User:  user,
   279		})
   280	}

   282	// GetProfile handles getting user profile
   283	func (h *Handler) GetProfile(c *gin.Context) {
   284		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
   285		if !exists {
   286			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
   287			return
   288		}
   289	
   290		user, err := h.service.GetProfile(userID.(uint))
   291		if err != nil {
   292			utils.Error(c, 2004, "Failed to get profile")
   293			return
   294		}
   295	
   296		if user == nil {
   297			utils.Error(c, 2005, "User not found")
   298			return
   299		}
   300	
   301		// Check if WeChat is bound
   302		var wechatOpenID *string
   303		var wechatName *string
   304		wechatProvider, err := h.service.repo.FindAuthProviderByUserAndProvider(userID.(uint), "wechat")
   305		if err == nil && wechatProvider != nil {
   306			wechatOpenID = &wechatProvider.ProviderUserID
   307			// Try to get WeChat nickname from provider_data first
   308			if wechatProvider.ProviderData != nil {
   309				// Parse JSON to extract nickname field
   310				// Expected format: {"nickname":"xxx","avatar_url":"xxx"}
   311				var providerData map[string]interface{}
   312				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(*wechatProvider.ProviderData), &providerData); err == nil {
   313					if nickname, ok := providerData["nickname"].(string); ok && nickname != "" {
   314						wechatName = &nickname
   315					}
   316				}
   317			}
   318			// Fallback to username if provider_data doesn't have nickname
   319			if wechatName == nil && user.Username != nil && *user.Username != "" {
   320				wechatName = user.Username
   321			}
   322		}
   323	
   324		// Check if GitHub is bound
   325		var githubID *string
   326		var githubLogin *string
   327		githubProvider, err := h.service.repo.FindAuthProviderByUserAndProvider(userID.(uint), "github")
   328		if err == nil && githubProvider != nil {
   329			githubID = &githubProvider.ProviderUserID
   330			// Try to extract GitHub login from provider_data JSON
   331			if githubProvider.ProviderData != nil {
   332				// Parse JSON to extract login field
   333				// Expected format: {"login":"username","name":"Full Name","avatar_url":"..."}
   334				var providerData map[string]interface{}
   335				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(*githubProvider.ProviderData), &providerData); err == nil {
   336					if login, ok := providerData["login"].(string); ok && login != "" {
   337						githubLogin = &login
   338					}
   339				}
   340			}
   341		}
   342	
   343		// Build extended response
   344		response := UserProfileResponse{
   345			ID:            user.ID,
   346			Username:      user.Username,
   347			Email:         user.Email,
   348			Phone:         user.Phone,
   349			AvatarURL:     user.AvatarURL,
   350			Bio:           user.Bio,
   351			Status:        user.Status,
   352			EmailVerified: user.EmailVerified,
   353			PhoneVerified: user.PhoneVerified,
   354			WeChatOpenID:  wechatOpenID,
   355			WeChatName:    wechatName,
   356			GitHubID:      githubID,
   357			GitHubLogin:   githubLogin,
   358			LastLoginAt:   user.LastLoginAt,
   359			CreatedAt:     user.CreatedAt,
   360			UpdatedAt:     user.UpdatedAt,
   361		}
   362	
   363		utils.Success(c, response)
   364	}
