   612	// GetUserList handles getting paginated user list (admin only)
   613	func (h *Handler) GetUserList(c *gin.Context) {
   614		page, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page", "1"))
   615		pageSize, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page_size", "20"))
   616		sortBy := c.DefaultQuery("sort_by", "last_login_at")   // 排序字段: last_login_at, created_at
   617		sortOrder := c.DefaultQuery("sort_order", "desc")       // 排序方向: asc, desc
   618	
   619		if page < 1 {
   620			page = 1
   621		}
   622		if pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 100 {
   623			pageSize = 20
   624		}
   625	
   626		// 验证排序字段
   627		validSortFields := map[string]bool{"last_login_at": true, "created_at": true}
   628		if !validSortFields[sortBy] {
   629			sortBy = "last_login_at"
   630		}
   631		if sortOrder != "asc" && sortOrder != "desc" {
   632			sortOrder = "desc"
   633		}
   634	
   635		users, total, err := h.service.GetUserListWithSort(page, pageSize, sortBy, sortOrder)
   636		if err != nil {
   637			utils.Error(c, 2008, "Failed to get user list")
   638			return
   639		}
   640	
   641		// Get user IDs for fetching auth providers
   642		userIDs := make([]uint, len(users))
   643		for i, user := range users {
   644			userIDs[i] = user.ID
   645		}
   646	
   647		// Fetch auth providers (including WeChat) for all users
   648		authProviders, err := h.service.repo.GetUserAuthProviders(userIDs)
   649		if err != nil {
   650			// Log error but continue without provider info
   651			authProviders = make(map[uint][]UserAuthProvider)
   652		}
   653	
   654		// Build response with auth provider info and subscription info
   655		type SubscriptionInfo struct {
   656			PlanCode      string     `json:"plan_code"`
   657			PlanName      string     `json:"plan_name"`
   658			Status        string     `json:"status"`
   659			EndDate       *time.Time `json:"end_date,omitempty"`
   660			RemainingDays int        `json:"remaining_days"`
   661			AutoRenew     bool       `json:"auto_renew"`
   662		}
   663	
   664		type InviterInfo struct {
   665			UserID   uint    `json:"user_id"`
   666			Username *string `json:"username"`
   667		}
   668	
   669		type UserResponse struct {
   670			User
   671			WeChatOpenID     string            `json:"wechat_openid,omitempty"`
   672			WeChatUnionID    string            `json:"wechat_union_id,omitempty"`
   673			WeChatName       string            `json:"wechat_name,omitempty"`
   674			GithubLogin      string            `json:"github_login,omitempty"`
   675			Subscription     *SubscriptionInfo `json:"subscription,omitempty"`
   676			LastLoginIPInfo  string            `json:"last_login_ip_info,omitempty"`   // IP归属地信息
   677			InvitedBy        *InviterInfo      `json:"invited_by,omitempty"`           // 邀请者信息
   678		}
   679	
   680		// Get subscriptions for all users
   681		var subscriptions []struct {
   682			UserID    uint       `gorm:"column:user_id"`
   683			PlanCode  string     `gorm:"column:plan_code"`
   684			PlanName  string     `gorm:"column:plan_name"`
   685			Status    string     `gorm:"column:status"`
   686			EndDate   *time.Time `gorm:"column:end_date"`
   687			AutoRenew bool       `gorm:"column:auto_renew"`
   688		}
   689		h.service.repo.GetDB().Table("user_subscriptions").
   690			Select("user_subscriptions.user_id, user_subscriptions.plan_code, subscription_plans.plan_name, user_subscriptions.status, user_subscriptions.end_date, user_subscriptions.auto_renew").
   691			Joins("LEFT JOIN subscription_plans ON user_subscriptions.plan_code = subscription_plans.plan_code").
   692			Where("user_subscriptions.user_id IN ? AND user_subscriptions.status = ?", userIDs, "active").
   693			Scan(&subscriptions)
   694	
   695		// Map subscriptions by user ID
   696		subscriptionMap := make(map[uint]*SubscriptionInfo)
   697		for _, sub := range subscriptions {
   698			remainingDays := 0
   699			if sub.EndDate != nil {
   700				remainingDays = int(time.Until(*sub.EndDate).Hours() / 24)
   701				if remainingDays < 0 {
   702					remainingDays = 0
   703				}
   704			}
   705			subscriptionMap[sub.UserID] = &SubscriptionInfo{
   706				PlanCode:      sub.PlanCode,
   707				PlanName:      sub.PlanName,
   708				Status:        sub.Status,
   709				EndDate:       sub.EndDate,
   710				RemainingDays: remainingDays,
   711				AutoRenew:     sub.AutoRenew,
   712			}
   713		}
   714	
   715		// Get inviter info for all users
   716		var inviterRelations []struct {
   717			InviteeID uint    `gorm:"column:invitee_id"`
   718			InviterID uint    `gorm:"column:inviter_id"`
   719			Username  *string `gorm:"column:username"`
   720		}
   721		h.service.repo.GetDB().Table("invitation_relationships").
   722			Select("invitation_relationships.invitee_id, invitation_relationships.inviter_id, users.username").
   723			Joins("LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = invitation_relationships.inviter_id").
   724			Where("invitation_relationships.invitee_id IN ?", userIDs).
   725			Scan(&inviterRelations)
   726	
   727		// Map inviters by invitee user ID
   728		inviterMap := make(map[uint]*InviterInfo)
   729		for _, rel := range inviterRelations {
   730			if rel.InviterID > 0 {
   731				inviterMap[rel.InviteeID] = &InviterInfo{
   732					UserID:   rel.InviterID,
   733					Username: rel.Username,
   734				}
   735			}
   736		}
   737	
   738		userResponses := make([]UserResponse, len(users))
   739		for i, user := range users {
   740			response := UserResponse{User: user}
   741	
   742			// Add subscription info
   743			if subInfo, ok := subscriptionMap[user.ID]; ok {
   744				response.Subscription = subInfo
   745			}
   746	
   747			// Add inviter info
   748			if inviter, ok := inviterMap[user.ID]; ok {
   749				response.InvitedBy = inviter
   750			}
   751	
   752			// Parse IP location
   753			if user.LastLoginIP != nil && *user.LastLoginIP != "" {
   754				location := utils.ParseIPLocation(*user.LastLoginIP)
   755				response.LastLoginIPInfo = utils.GetLocationString(location)
   756			}
   757	
   758			// Find auth providers
   759			if providers, ok := authProviders[user.ID]; ok {
   760				for _, provider := range providers {
   761					if provider.Provider == "wechat" {
   762						response.WeChatOpenID = provider.ProviderUserID
   763						if provider.ProviderUnionID != nil {
   764							response.WeChatUnionID = *provider.ProviderUnionID
   765						}
   766						// Extract nickname from provider_data
   767						if provider.ProviderData != nil {
   768							var providerData map[string]interface{}
   769							if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(*provider.ProviderData), &providerData); err == nil {
   770								if nickname, ok := providerData["nickname"].(string); ok {
   771									response.WeChatName = nickname
   772								}
   773							}
   774						}
   775					} else if provider.Provider == "github" {
   776						// Extract GitHub login from provider_data
   777						if provider.ProviderData != nil {
   778							var providerData map[string]interface{}
   779							if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(*provider.ProviderData), &providerData); err == nil {
   780								if login, ok := providerData["login"].(string); ok {
   781									response.GithubLogin = login
   782								}
   783							}
   784						}
   785					}
   786				}
   787			}
   788	
   789			userResponses[i] = response
   790		}
   791	
   792		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
   793			"users": userResponses,
   794			"total": total,
   795			"page":  page,
   796			"page_size": pageSize,
   797		})
   798	}

   848	// ChangePassword handles user password change

   854		}
   855	
   856		var req struct {
   857			CurrentPassword string `json:"current_password" binding:"required"`

   862			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())

   866		err := h.service.ChangePassword(userID.(uint), req.CurrentPassword, req.NewPassword)
   867		if err != nil {

   869				utils.Error(c, 2012, "Current password is incorrect")
   870				return
   871			}

   873			return
   874		}
   875	
   876		utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "Password changed successfully", nil)
   877	}

   879	// Heartbeat handles heartbeat requests to update session activity
   880	func (h *Handler) Heartbeat(c *gin.Context) {
   881		// Get token from Authorization header
   882		token := c.GetHeader("Authorization")
   883		if token == "" {
   884			utils.Unauthorized(c, "No token provided")
   885			return
   886		}
   887	
   888		// Remove "Bearer " prefix if present
   889		if len(token) > 7 && token[:7] == "Bearer " {
   890			token = token[7:]
   891		}
   892	
   893		// Get client IP
   894		ip := c.ClientIP()
   895	
   896		// Update session activity and user's last login IP
   897		err := h.service.UpdateSessionActivity(token, ip)
   898		if err != nil {
   899			utils.Error(c, 2011, "Failed to update session activity")
   900			return
   901		}
   902	
   903		utils.Success(c, map[string]interface{}{
   904			"timestamp": time.Now(),
   905		})
   906	}
   907	
   908	// GetUserStatisticsChart handles getting user statistics chart data (admin only)
   909	// 支持自定义时间范围和时间粒度
   910	// Query params:
   911	//   - start_time: 开始时间 (格式: 2006-01-02 15:04:05)
   912	//   - end_time: 结束时间 (格式: 2006-01-02 15:04:05)
   913	//   - granularity: 时间粒度 (hour, day, week, month)
   914	func (h *Handler) GetUserStatisticsChart(c *gin.Context) {
   915		// 解析时间范围参数
   916		startTimeStr := c.Query("start_time")
   917		endTimeStr := c.Query("end_time")
   918		granularity := c.Query("granularity")
   919	
   920		// 默认值：最近30天，按天统计
   921		if granularity == "" {
   922			granularity = "day"
   923		}
   924	
   925		// 验证粒度参数
   926		validGranularities := map[string]bool{"hour": true, "day": true, "week": true, "month": true}
   927		if !validGranularities[granularity] {
   928			utils.Error(c, 2012, "Invalid granularity, must be one of: hour, day, week, month")
   929			return
   930		}
   931	
   932		var startTime, endTime time.Time
   933		var err error
   934		loc := time.Local
   935	
   936		if startTimeStr != "" {
   937			startTime, err = time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02 15:04:05", startTimeStr, loc)
   938			if err != nil {
   939				utils.Error(c, 2012, "Invalid start_time format, expected: 2006-01-02 15:04:05")
   940				return
   941			}
   942		} else {
   943			// 默认开始时间：30天前
   944			startTime = time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -29)
   945			startTime = time.Date(startTime.Year(), startTime.Month(), startTime.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, loc)
   946		}
   947	
   948		if endTimeStr != "" {
   949			endTime, err = time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02 15:04:05", endTimeStr, loc)
   950			if err != nil {
   951				utils.Error(c, 2012, "Invalid end_time format, expected: 2006-01-02 15:04:05")
   952				return
   953			}
   954		} else {
   955			// 默认结束时间：当前时间
   956			endTime = time.Now()
   957		}
   958	
   959		// 验证时间范围
   960		if endTime.Before(startTime) {
   961			utils.Error(c, 2012, "end_time must be after start_time")
   962			return
   963		}
   964	
   965		data, err := h.service.GetUserStatisticsChartWithGranularity(startTime, endTime, granularity)
   966		if err != nil {
   967			utils.Error(c, 2012, "Failed to get user statistics: "+err.Error())
   968			return
   969		}
   970	
   971		utils.Success(c, map[string]interface{}{
   972			"statistics":  data,
   973			"start_time":  startTime.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
   974			"end_time":    endTime.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
   975			"granularity": granularity,
   976		})
   977	}
   978	
   979	// GetOnlineUserChart handles getting online user chart data (admin only)
   980	// 支持自定义时间范围和时间粒度
   981	// Query params:
   982	//   - start_time: 开始时间 (格式: 2006-01-02 15:04:05)
   983	//   - end_time: 结束时间 (格式: 2006-01-02 15:04:05)
   984	//   - granularity: 时间粒度 (5min, hour)
   985	//   - hours: 兼容旧接口，查询最近N小时的数据
   986	func (h *Handler) GetOnlineUserChart(c *gin.Context) {
   987		// 解析时间范围参数
   988		startTimeStr := c.Query("start_time")
   989		endTimeStr := c.Query("end_time")
   990		granularity := c.Query("granularity")
   991	
   992		// 默认值
   993		if granularity == "" {
   994			granularity = "5min"
   995		}
   996	
   997		// 验证粒度参数
   998		validGranularities := map[string]bool{"5min": true, "hour": true}
   999		if !validGranularities[granularity] {
  1000			utils.Error(c, 2013, "Invalid granularity, must be one of: 5min, hour")
  1001			return
  1002		}
  1003	
  1004		var startTime, endTime time.Time
  1005		var err error
  1006		loc := time.Local
  1007	
  1008		// 兼容旧接口：如果没有提供 start_time/end_time，使用 hours 参数
  1009		if startTimeStr == "" && endTimeStr == "" {
  1010			hours := 24
  1011			if hoursParam := c.Query("hours"); hoursParam != "" {
  1012				if parsedHours, err := strconv.Atoi(hoursParam); err == nil && parsedHours > 0 {
  1013					hours = parsedHours
  1014				}
  1015			}
  1016			endTime = time.Now()
  1017			startTime = endTime.Add(-time.Duration(hours) * time.Hour)
  1018		} else {
  1019			if startTimeStr != "" {
  1020				startTime, err = time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02 15:04:05", startTimeStr, loc)
  1021				if err != nil {
  1022					utils.Error(c, 2013, "Invalid start_time format, expected: 2006-01-02 15:04:05")
  1023					return
  1024				}
  1025			} else {
  1026				startTime = time.Now().Add(-24 * time.Hour)
  1027			}
  1028	
  1029			if endTimeStr != "" {
  1030				endTime, err = time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02 15:04:05", endTimeStr, loc)
  1031				if err != nil {
  1032					utils.Error(c, 2013, "Invalid end_time format, expected: 2006-01-02 15:04:05")
  1033					return
  1034				}
  1035			} else {
  1036				endTime = time.Now()
  1037			}
  1038		}
  1039	
  1040		// 验证时间范围
  1041		if endTime.Before(startTime) {
  1042			utils.Error(c, 2013, "end_time must be after start_time")
  1043			return
  1044		}
  1045	
  1046		data, err := h.service.GetOnlineUserChartDataWithGranularity(startTime, endTime, granularity)
  1047		if err != nil {
  1048			utils.Error(c, 2013, "Failed to get online user chart data: "+err.Error())
  1049			return
  1050		}
  1051	
  1052		utils.Success(c, map[string]interface{}{
  1053			"snapshots":   data,
  1054			"start_time":  startTime.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
  1055			"end_time":    endTime.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
  1056			"granularity": granularity,
  1057		})
  1058	}

  1122	// LoginWithCode handles login with email verification code
  1123	func (h *Handler) LoginWithCode(c *gin.Context) {
  1124		var req LoginWithCodeRequest
  1125		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
  1126			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
  1127			return
  1128		}
  1129	
  1130		// Get system configuration
  1131		systemConfig, err := h.service.GetSystemConfig()
  1132		if err != nil {
  1133			utils.Error(c, 5000, "Failed to get system configuration")
  1134			return
  1135		}
  1136	
  1137		// Verify Turnstile token (if enabled)
  1138		ip := c.ClientIP()
  1139		if valid, err := turnstile.VerifyWithConfig(req.TurnstileToken, ip, systemConfig); !valid {
  1140			errMsg := "人机验证失败"
  1141			if err != nil {
  1142				errMsg = err.Error()
  1143			}
  1144			utils.Error(c, 4001, errMsg)
  1145			return
  1146		}
  1147	
  1148		user, token, err := h.service.LoginWithEmailCode(req.Email, req.Code, ip)
  1149		if err != nil {
  1150			utils.Error(c, 2016, err.Error())
  1151			return
  1152		}
  1153	
  1154		// Create session for the user
  1155		userAgent := c.GetHeader("User-Agent")
  1156		_ = h.service.CreateSession(user.ID, token, ip, userAgent, 24*7*time.Hour) // 7 days
  1157	
  1158		utils.Success(c, AuthResponse{
  1159			Token: token,
  1160			User:  user,
  1161		})
  1162	}

  1206	// RegisterRoutes registers user routes
  1207	func (h *Handler) RegisterRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
  1208		user := router.Group("/user")
  1209		{
  1210			// Email-based auth
  1211			user.POST("/check-email", h.CheckEmail)
  1212			user.POST("/send-code", h.SendVerificationCode)
  1213			user.POST("/register", h.Register)
  1214			user.POST("/login", h.Login)
  1215			user.POST("/login-with-code", h.LoginWithCode)
  1216			user.POST("/reset-password", h.ResetPassword)
  1217	
  1218			// Phone-based auth
  1219			user.POST("/check-phone", h.CheckPhone)
  1220			user.POST("/send-phone-code", h.SendPhoneVerificationCode)
  1221			user.POST("/register-phone", h.RegisterWithPhone)
  1222			user.POST("/login-phone", h.LoginWithPhone)
  1223			user.POST("/login-phone-with-code", h.LoginPhoneWithCode)
  1224			user.POST("/reset-password-phone", h.ResetPasswordPhone)
  1225	
  1226			// Protected routes will be added in the main server setup with middleware
  1227		}
  1228	}

  1230	// WeChatCallbackRequest represents WeChat OAuth callback request
  1231	type WeChatCallbackRequest struct {
  1232		Code           string `json:"code" binding:"required"`
  1233		State          string `json:"state" binding:"required"`
  1234		InvitationCode string `json:"invitation_code"` // 邀请码（可选）
  1235	}
  1236	
  1237	// WeChatCallback handles WeChat OAuth callback for login/register
  1238	// POST /api/v1/user/wechat/callback
  1239	func (h *Handler) WeChatCallback(c *gin.Context) {
  1240		var req WeChatCallbackRequest
  1241		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
  1242			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
  1243			return
  1244		}
  1245	
  1246		// Get WeChat service (needs to be injected)
  1247		wechatService := h.wechatService
  1248		if wechatService == nil {
  1249			utils.Error(c, 5000, "微信服务暂不可用")
  1250			return
  1251		}
  1252	
  1253		// Exchange code for access token
  1254		accessToken, openID, unionID1, err := wechatService.GetAccessToken(req.Code)
  1255		if err != nil {
  1256			utils.Error(c, 5001, "获取微信访问令牌失败："+err.Error())
  1257			return
  1258		}
  1259	
  1260		// Get user info
  1261		nickname, headImgURL, unionID2, err := wechatService.GetUserInfo(accessToken, openID)
  1262		if err != nil {
  1263			utils.Error(c, 5002, "获取微信用户信息失败："+err.Error())
  1264			return
  1265		}
  1266	
  1267		// Use unionID from GetUserInfo if available, otherwise from GetAccessToken
  1268		unionID := unionID2
  1269		if unionID == "" {
  1270			unionID = unionID1
  1271		}
  1272	
  1273		// Login or register user
  1274		ip := c.ClientIP()
  1275		user, token, isNewUser, err := h.service.LoginOrRegisterWithWeChat(
  1276			openID,
  1277			unionID,
  1278			nickname,
  1279			headImgURL,
  1280			ip,
  1281			req.InvitationCode, // 传递邀请码
  1282		)
  1283		if err != nil {
  1284			utils.Error(c, 5003, "微信登录失败："+err.Error())
  1285			return
  1286		}
  1287	
  1288		// Create session
  1289		userAgent := c.GetHeader("User-Agent")
  1290		_ = h.service.CreateSession(user.ID, token, ip, userAgent, 24*7*time.Hour)
  1291	
  1292		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
  1293			"token":       token,
  1294			"user":        user,
  1295			"is_new_user": isNewUser,
  1296		})
  1297	}

  1305	// BindWeChatAccount binds WeChat account to current user
  1306	// POST /api/v1/user/bind-wechat
  1307	func (h *Handler) BindWeChatAccount(c *gin.Context) {
  1308		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
  1309		if !exists {
  1310			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
  1311			return
  1312		}
  1313	
  1314		var req BindWeChatRequest
  1315		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
  1316			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
  1317			return
  1318		}
  1319	
  1320		// Get WeChat service
  1321		wechatService := h.wechatService
  1322		if wechatService == nil {
  1323			utils.Error(c, 5000, "微信服务暂不可用")
  1324			return
  1325		}
  1326	
  1327		// Exchange code for access token
  1328		accessToken, openID, unionID1, err := wechatService.GetAccessToken(req.Code)
  1329		if err != nil {
  1330			utils.Error(c, 5001, "获取微信访问令牌失败："+err.Error())
  1331			return
  1332		}
  1333	
  1334		// Get user info
  1335		nickname, headImgURL, unionID2, err := wechatService.GetUserInfo(accessToken, openID)
  1336		if err != nil {
  1337			utils.Error(c, 5002, "获取微信用户信息失败："+err.Error())
  1338			return
  1339		}
  1340	
  1341		// Use unionID from GetUserInfo if available, otherwise from GetAccessToken
  1342		unionID := unionID2
  1343		if unionID == "" {
  1344			unionID = unionID1
  1345		}
  1346	
  1347		// Bind WeChat to user
  1348		if err := h.service.BindWeChat(
  1349			userID.(uint),
  1350			openID,
  1351			unionID,
  1352			nickname,
  1353			headImgURL,
  1354		); err != nil {
  1355			utils.Error(c, 5003, err.Error())
  1356			return
  1357		}
  1358	
  1359		utils.Success(c, gin.H{"message": "WeChat account bound successfully"})
  1360	}

  1442	// CheckEmailAvailabilityRequest represents email availability check request
  1443	type CheckEmailAvailabilityRequest struct {
  1444		Email string `json:"email" binding:"required,email"`
  1445	}
  1446	
  1447	// CheckEmailAvailability checks if an email is available for binding
  1448	func (h *Handler) CheckEmailAvailability(c *gin.Context) {
  1449		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
  1450		if !exists {
  1451			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
  1452			return
  1453		}
  1454	
  1455		var req CheckEmailAvailabilityRequest
  1456		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
  1457			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
  1458			return
  1459		}
  1460	
  1461		available, err := h.service.CheckEmailAvailability(req.Email, userID.(uint))
  1462		if err != nil {
  1463			utils.Error(c, 2029, "Failed to check email availability")
  1464			return
  1465		}
  1466	
  1467		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
  1468			"available": available,
  1469			"email":     req.Email,
  1470		})
  1471	}
  1472	
  1473	// CheckPhoneAvailabilityRequest represents phone availability check request
  1474	type CheckPhoneAvailabilityRequest struct {
  1475		Phone string `json:"phone" binding:"required,len=11"`
  1476	}
  1477	
  1478	// CheckPhoneAvailability checks if a phone is available for binding
  1479	func (h *Handler) CheckPhoneAvailability(c *gin.Context) {
  1480		userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
  1481		if !exists {
  1482			utils.Unauthorized(c, "User not authenticated")
  1483			return
  1484		}
  1485	
  1486		var req CheckPhoneAvailabilityRequest
  1487		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
  1488			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
  1489			return
  1490		}
  1491	
  1492		available, err := h.service.CheckPhoneAvailability(req.Phone, userID.(uint))
  1493		if err != nil {
  1494			utils.Error(c, 2030, "Failed to check phone availability")
  1495			return
  1496		}
  1497	
  1498		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
  1499			"available": available,
  1500			"phone":     req.Phone,
  1501		})
  1502	}

    14	// User represents a user in the system
    15	type User struct {
    16		ID            uint       `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
    17		Username      *string    `gorm:"unique;size:50" json:"username"`
    18		Email         *string    `gorm:"unique;size:100" json:"email"`
    19		Phone         *string    `gorm:"unique;size:20" json:"phone"`
    20		PasswordHash  *string    `gorm:"size:255" json:"-"`
    21		AvatarURL     *string    `gorm:"size:255" json:"avatar_url"`
    22		Bio           *string    `gorm:"type:text" json:"bio"`
    23		Status        int8       `gorm:"not null;default:1" json:"status"` // 1=active, 0=inactive, 2=suspended
    24		EmailVerified bool       `gorm:"not null;default:false" json:"email_verified"`
    25		PhoneVerified bool       `gorm:"not null;default:false" json:"phone_verified"`
    26		LastLoginAt   *time.Time `json:"last_login_at"`
    27		LastLoginIP   *string    `gorm:"size:45" json:"last_login_ip"` // 最后登录IP
    28		CreatedAt     time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
    29		UpdatedAt     time.Time  `json:"updated_at"`
    30	}
    31

    33	func (User) TableName() string {
    34		return "users"
    35	}

    38	type UserAuthProvider struct {
    39		ID              uint      `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
    40		UserID          uint      `gorm:"not null" json:"user_id"`
    41		Provider        string    `gorm:"not null;size:20" json:"provider"` // email, phone, wechat, google, etc.
    42		ProviderUserID  string    `gorm:"not null;size:255" json:"provider_user_id"` // 微信为 openID
    43		ProviderUnionID *string   `gorm:"size:255" json:"provider_union_id"` // 微信 UnionID，用于跨应用识别
    44		ProviderData    *string   `gorm:"type:json" json:"provider_data"`
    45		CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    46		UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
    47	}

    63	// FindByIDs finds users by IDs and returns a map

    65		if len(ids) == 0 {
    66			return make(map[uint]*User), nil
    67		}
    68	
    69		var users []User
    70		err := r.db.Where("id IN ?", ids).Find(&users).Error
    71		if err != nil {
    72			return nil, err
    73		}
    74	
    75		result := make(map[uint]*User)
    76		for i := range users {
    77			result[users[i].ID] = &users[i]
    78		}
    79		return result, nil
    80	}

   186	// GetUserList returns a paginated list of users
   187	func (r *Repository) GetUserList(offset, limit int) ([]User, int64, error) {
   188		var users []User
   189		var total int64
   190	
   191		// Get total count
   192		if err := r.db.Model(&User{}).Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
   193			return nil, 0, err
   194		}
   195	
   196		// Get paginated users
   197		err := r.db.Order("created_at DESC").
   198			Offset(offset).
   199			Limit(limit).
   200			Find(&users).Error
   201	
   202		return users, total, err
   203	}

   205	// GetUserListWithSort returns a paginated list of users with sorting
   206	func (r *Repository) GetUserListWithSort(offset, limit int, sortBy, sortOrder string) ([]User, int64, error) {
   207		var users []User
   208		var total int64
   209	
   210		// Get total count
   211		if err := r.db.Model(&User{}).Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
   212			return nil, 0, err
   213		}
   214	
   215		// Build order string
   216		orderStr := fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", sortBy, sortOrder)
   217	
   218		// Get paginated users with sorting
   219		err := r.db.Order(orderStr).
   220			Offset(offset).
   221			Limit(limit).
   222			Find(&users).Error
   223	
   224		return users, total, err
   225	}

   247	// UpdateSessionActivity updates the last activity time of a session and user's last login time and IP
   248	func (r *Repository) UpdateSessionActivity(token, ip string) error {
   249		// Get session to find user_id
   250		var session model.UserSession
   251		if err := r.db.Where("token = ?", token).First(&session).Error; err != nil {
   252			return err
   253		}
   254	
   255		// Use transaction to update both session and user
   256		return r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
   257			// Update session last_activity and IP
   258			if err := tx.Model(&model.UserSession{}).
   259				Where("token = ?", token).
   260				Updates(map[string]interface{}{
   261					"last_activity": time.Now(),
   262					"ip":            ip,
   263				}).Error; err != nil {
   264				return err
   265			}
   266	
   267			// Update user's last_login_at and last_login_ip
   268			if err := tx.Model(&User{}).
   269				Where("id = ?", session.UserID).
   270				Updates(map[string]interface{}{
   271					"last_login_at": time.Now(),
   272					"last_login_ip": ip,
   273				}).Error; err != nil {
   274				return err
   275			}
   276	
   277			return nil
   278		})
   279	}

   306	// GetOnlineUsers returns list of currently online users with their session info
   307	// A user is considered online if they have an active session with activity in the last 2 minutes
   308	func (r *Repository) GetOnlineUsers() ([]map[string]interface{}, error) {
   309		type OnlineUserRaw struct {
   310			ID           uint      `json:"id"`
   311			Email        *string   `json:"email"`
   312			Username     *string   `json:"username"`
   313			LastActivity time.Time `json:"last_activity"`
   314			IP           string    `json:"ip"`
   315			UserAgent    string    `json:"user_agent"`
   316		}
   317	
   318		var rawResults []OnlineUserRaw
   319	
   320		// Consider a user online if they had activity in the last 2 minutes
   321		onlineThreshold := time.Now().Add(-2 * time.Minute)
   322	
   323		err := r.db.Raw(`
   324			SELECT
   325				u.id,
   326				u.email,
   327				u.username,
   328				s2.last_activity,
   329				s2.ip,
   330				s2.user_agent
   331			FROM users u
   332			INNER JOIN (
   333				SELECT
   334					user_id,
   335					last_activity,
   336					ip,
   337					user_agent
   338				FROM user_sessions
   339				WHERE expires_at > ? AND last_activity > ?
   340				ORDER BY last_activity DESC
   341			) s2 ON u.id = s2.user_id
   342			GROUP BY u.id, s2.last_activity, s2.ip, s2.user_agent
   343			ORDER BY s2.last_activity DESC
   344		`, time.Now(), onlineThreshold).Scan(&rawResults).Error
   345	
   346		if err != nil {
   347			return nil, err
   348		}
   349	
   350		// Convert to map and add parsed information
   351		results := make([]map[string]interface{}, len(rawResults))
   352		for i, raw := range rawResults {
   353			result := map[string]interface{}{
   354				"id":            raw.ID,
   355				"email":         raw.Email,
   356				"username":      raw.Username,
   357				"last_activity": raw.LastActivity,
   358				"ip":            raw.IP,
   359				"user_agent":    raw.UserAgent,
   360			}
   361	
   362			// Parse IP location
   363			location := utils.ParseIPLocation(raw.IP)
   364			result["location"] = utils.GetLocationString(location)
   365			result["location_detail"] = location
   366	
   367			// Parse user agent
   368			deviceInfo := utils.ParseUserAgent(raw.UserAgent)
   369			result["device"] = utils.GetSimpleDeviceString(deviceInfo)
   370			result["device_detail"] = deviceInfo
   371	
   372			results[i] = result
   373		}
   374	
   375		return results, nil
   376	}

   390		err := r.db.Where("date = ?", date).First(&stats).Error

   393			if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
   394				// Create new record

   396				stats.NewUsers = 0
   397				stats.TotalUsers = 0
   398				stats.PeakOnlineUsers = 0
   399				if err := r.db.Create(&stats).Error; err != nil {
   400					return nil, err
   401				}
   402				return &stats, nil
   403			}
   404			return nil, err
   405		}
   406	
   407		return &stats, nil
   408	}

   460		var user User
   461		err := r.db.Where("phone = ?", phone).First(&user).Error
   462		if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   463			return nil, nil
   464		}
   465		return &user, err
   466	}
   467	
   468	// FindAuthProviderByUserAndProvider finds auth provider by user ID and provider type
   469	func (r *Repository) FindAuthProviderByUserAndProvider(userID uint, provider string) (*UserAuthProvider, error) {
   470		var authProvider UserAuthProvider
   471		err := r.db.Where("user_id = ? AND provider = ?", userID, provider).First(&authProvider).Error
   472		if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   473			return nil, nil
   474		}
   475		return &authProvider, err
   476	}

   489	func (r *Repository) FindAuthProviderByProviderAndProviderUserID(provider, providerUserID string) (*UserAuthProvider, error) {

   499	func (r *Repository) FindAuthProviderByUnionID(provider, unionID string) (*UserAuthProvider, error) {
   500		var authProvider UserAuthProvider
   501		err := r.db.Where("provider = ? AND provider_union_id = ?", provider, unionID).First(&authProvider).Error
   502		if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
   503			return nil, nil
   504		}
   505		return &authProvider, err
   506	}
   507	
   508	// DeleteUser deletes a user and all associated data (except statistics)
   509	// This method performs a cascading delete for all user-related data
   510	func (r *Repository) DeleteUser(userID uint) error {
   511		return r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
   512			// 1. Delete usage quotas (not cascaded by FK)
   513			if err := tx.Where("user_id = ?", userID).Delete(&subscriptionModel.UsageQuota{}).Error; err != nil {
   514				return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete usage quotas: %w", err)
   515			}
   516	
   517			// 2. Delete conversation messages (not directly cascaded)
   518			// First get all conversation IDs for this user
   519			var conversationIDs []uint
   520			if err := tx.Model(&conversationModel.Conversation{}).
   521				Where("user_id = ?", userID).
   522				Pluck("id", &conversationIDs).Error; err != nil {
   523				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get conversation IDs: %w", err)
   524			}
   525	
   526			// Delete all messages for these conversations
   527			if len(conversationIDs) > 0 {
   528				if err := tx.Where("conversation_id IN ?", conversationIDs).
   529					Delete(&conversationModel.ConversationMessage{}).Error; err != nil {
   530					return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete conversation messages: %w", err)
   531				}
   532			}
   533	
   534			// 3. Delete the user (this will cascade delete the following via FK constraints):
   535			//    - user_auth_providers (ON DELETE CASCADE)
   536			//    - user_sessions (ON DELETE CASCADE)
   537			//    - conversations (ON DELETE CASCADE)
   538			//    - user_subscriptions (ON DELETE CASCADE)
   539			//    - orders (ON DELETE CASCADE)
   540			//    - payment_transactions (via orders ON DELETE CASCADE)
   541			if err := tx.Delete(&User{}, userID).Error; err != nil {
   542				return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete user: %w", err)
   543			}
   544	
   545			// Note: user_statistics and online_user_snapshots are intentionally NOT deleted
   546			// as they are kept for historical statistical analysis
   547	
   548			return nil
   549		})
   550	}

    77	// CheckEmailExists checks if an email is already registered
    78	func (s *Service) CheckEmailExists(email string) (bool, error) {
    79		user, err := s.repo.FindByEmail(email)
    80		if err != nil {
    81			return false, err
    82		}
    83		return user != nil, nil
    84	}

    86	// generateRandomUsername generates a random username in format "user_XXXXXX"
    87	func (s *Service) generateRandomUsername() (string, error) {
    88		maxAttempts := 10
    89		for i := 0; i < maxAttempts; i++ {
    90			// Generate random 6-digit number
    91			randomNum := rand.Intn(1000000)
    92			username := fmt.Sprintf("user_%06d", randomNum)
    93	
    94			// Check if username already exists
    95			existing, err := s.repo.FindByUsername(username)
    96			if err != nil {
    97				return "", err
    98			}
    99	
   100			if existing == nil {
   101				return username, nil
   102			}
   103		}
   104	
   105		// If all attempts failed, use timestamp + random
   106		timestamp := time.Now().Unix()
   107		randomSuffix := rand.Intn(10000)
   108		return fmt.Sprintf("user_%d_%04d", timestamp, randomSuffix), nil
   109	}

   111	// RegisterWithEmail registers a new user with email and password
   112	// Enhanced with transaction support for concurrency safety
   113	func (s *Service) RegisterWithEmail(email, password, code, ip string) (*User, string, error) {
   114		return s.RegisterWithEmailAndInvitation(email, password, code, "", ip)
   115	}
   116	
   117	// RegisterWithEmailAndInvitation registers a new user with email, password and optional invitation code
   118	func (s *Service) RegisterWithEmailAndInvitation(email, password, code, invitationCode, ip string) (*User, string, error) {
   119		// Verify the email code using Redis (only if code is provided)
   120		if code != "" {
   121			valid, err := cache.VerifyCode(context.Background(), email, code, "register")
   122			if err != nil {
   123				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to verify code: %w", err)
   124			}
   125			if !valid {
   126				return nil, "", errors.New("invalid or expired verification code")
   127			}
   128		}
   129	
   130		// First check: validate email availability (pre-verification)
   131		existing, err := s.repo.FindByEmail(email)
   132		if err != nil {
   133			return nil, "", err
   134		}
   135		if existing != nil {
   136			return nil, "", errors.New("email already registered")
   137		}
   138	
   139		// Hash password
   140		hashedPassword, err := utils.HashPassword(password)
   141		if err != nil {
   142			return nil, "", err
   143		}
   144	
   145		var user *User
   146		var token string
   147	
   148		// Use transaction for atomic registration
   149		err = s.repo.GetDB().Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
   150			txRepo := NewRepository(tx)
   151	
   152			// Second check: double-check email availability within transaction (concurrency protection)
   153			existing, err := txRepo.FindByEmail(email)
   154			if err != nil {
   155				return err
   156			}
   157			if existing != nil {
   158				return errors.New("email already registered")
   159			}
   160	
   161			// Generate random username
   162			username, err := s.generateRandomUsername()
   163			if err != nil {
   164				return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate username: %w", err)
   165			}
   166	
   167			// Create user
   168			user = &User{
   169				Email:         &email,
   170				Username:      &username,
   171				PasswordHash:  &hashedPassword,
   172				Status:        1,
   173				EmailVerified: true,
   174			}
   175	
   176			if err := txRepo.Create(user); err != nil {
   177				return err
   178			}
   179	
   180			// Update last login time and IP (registration counts as first login)
   181			_ = txRepo.UpdateLastLoginWithIP(user.ID, ip)
   182	
   183			// Create auth provider record
   184			authProvider := &UserAuthProvider{
   185				UserID:         user.ID,
   186				Provider:       "email",
   187				ProviderUserID: email,
   188			}
   189			if err := txRepo.CreateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
   190				return err
   191			}
   192	
   193			return nil
   194		})
   195	
   196		if err != nil {
   197			return nil, "", err
   198		}
   199	
   200		// Generate JWT token
   201		tokenUsername := email
   202		if user.Username != nil {
   203			tokenUsername = *user.Username
   204		}
   205		token, err = utils.GenerateToken(user.ID, tokenUsername, "user")
   206		if err != nil {
   207			return nil, "", err
   208		}
   209	
   210		// Record new user registration in statistics (async, non-blocking)
   211		go func() {
   212			today := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")
   213			_ = s.repo.IncrementNewUsers(today)
   214		}()
   215	
   216		// Handle invitation code if provided
   217		if invitationCode != "" && s.couponService != nil {
   218			// Process invitation in background to not block registration
   219			go func() {
   220				_ = s.couponService.RegisterWithInvitation(invitationCode, uint64(user.ID))
   221			}()
   222		}
   223	
   224		// Distribute register coupons to new user (auto_register type)
   225		if s.couponService != nil {
   226			go func() {
   227				_ = s.couponService.DistributeRegisterCoupons(uint64(user.ID))
   228			}()
   229		}
   230	
   231		return user, token, nil
   232	}

   234	// LoginWithEmail logs in a user with email and password
   235	func (s *Service) LoginWithEmail(email, password, ip string) (*User, string, error) {
   236		user, err := s.repo.FindByEmail(email)
   237		if err != nil {
   238			return nil, "", err
   239		}
   240	
   241		if user == nil {
   242			return nil, "", errors.New("invalid email or password")
   243		}
   244	
   245		if user.Status != 1 {
   246			return nil, "", errors.New("account is inactive or suspended")
   247		}
   248	
   249		if user.PasswordHash == nil {
   250			return nil, "", errors.New("email login not available for this account")
   251		}
   252	
   253		if !utils.CheckPassword(password, *user.PasswordHash) {
   254			return nil, "", errors.New("invalid email or password")
   255		}
   256	
   257		// Update last login time and IP
   258		_ = s.repo.UpdateLastLoginWithIP(user.ID, ip)
   259	
   260		// Generate JWT token
   261		username := email
   262		if user.Username != nil {
   263			username = *user.Username
   264		}
   265		token, err := utils.GenerateToken(user.ID, username, "user")
   266		if err != nil {
   267			return nil, "", err
   268		}
   269	
   270		return user, token, nil
   271	}

   273	// ResetPassword resets user password with email verification code
   274	func (s *Service) ResetPassword(email, code, newPassword string) error {
   275		// Verify the code
   276		valid, err := cache.VerifyCode(context.Background(), email, code, "reset_password")
   277		if err != nil {
   278			return fmt.Errorf("failed to verify code: %w", err)
   279		}
   280		if !valid {
   281			return errors.New("invalid or expired verification code")
   282		}
   283	
   284		// Find user by email
   285		user, err := s.repo.FindByEmail(email)
   286		if err != nil {
   287			return err
   288		}
   289		if user == nil {
   290			return errors.New("email not found")
   291		}
   292	
   293		// Hash new password
   294		hashedPassword, err := utils.HashPassword(newPassword)
   295		if err != nil {
   296			return fmt.Errorf("failed to hash password: %w", err)
   297		}
   298	
   299		// Update password
   300		return s.repo.UpdatePassword(user.ID, hashedPassword)
   301	}

   343	// SendVerificationCode sends a verification code to an email
   344	func (s *Service) SendVerificationCode(email, purpose string) error {
   345		// Check rate limit: prevent sending too frequently (must wait 1 minute)
   346		ttl, err := cache.GetVerificationCodeTTL(context.Background(), email, purpose)
   347		if err == nil && ttl > 9*time.Minute {
   348			// Code exists and was sent less than 1 minute ago
   349			remainingSeconds := int((ttl - 9*time.Minute).Seconds())
   350			return fmt.Errorf("操作过于频繁，请 %d 秒后再试", remainingSeconds)
   351		}
   352	
   353		// Generate 6-digit code
   354		code := fmt.Sprintf("%06d", rand.Intn(1000000))
   355	
   356		// Save verification code to Redis (auto-expires in 10 minutes)
   357		if err := cache.SaveVerificationCode(context.Background(), email, code, purpose); err != nil {
   358			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save verification code: %w", err)
   359		}
   360	
   361		// Get email configuration from database
   362		if s.configService != nil {
   363			emailConfig, err := s.configService.GetActiveEmailConfig()
   364			if err == nil && emailConfig != nil {
   365				// Determine purpose text
   366				purposeText := "验证码"
   367				if purpose == "register" {
   368					purposeText = "注册验证码"
   369				} else if purpose == "reset_password" {
   370					purposeText = "重置密码验证码"
   371				} else if purpose == "login" {
   372					purposeText = "登录验证码"
   373				}
   374	
   375				// Generate 3-letter reference code to avoid email deduplication
   376				// Format: "Scholay 注册验证码 [Ref: ABC]" - professional and unambiguous
   377				refCode := fmt.Sprintf("%c%c%c",
   378					'A'+rand.Intn(26),
   379					'A'+rand.Intn(26),
   380					'A'+rand.Intn(26))
   381				subject := fmt.Sprintf("Scholay %s [Ref: %s]", purposeText, refCode)
   382	
   383				// Add timestamp to body to avoid content deduplication
   384				currentTime := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
   385				body := fmt.Sprintf(`
   386				<html>
   387				<body style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; padding: 20px;">
   388					<h2 style="color: #2563eb;">Scholay %s</h2>
   389					<p>您的验证码是：</p>
   390					<div style="background: #f1f5f9; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 20px 0;">
   391						<h1 style="color: #1e293b; letter-spacing: 8px; text-align: center; margin: 0;">%s</h1>
   392					</div>
   393					<p style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.875rem;">
   394						验证码将在 <strong>10 分钟</strong> 后失效，请尽快使用。
   395					</p>
   396					<p style="color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.75rem;">
   397						发送时间: %s
   398					</p>
   399					<hr style="border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; margin: 20px 0;">
   400					<p style="color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.75rem;">
   401						这是一封自动发送的邮件，请勿直接回复。如果您没有请求此验证码，请忽略此邮件。
   402					</p>
   403				</body>
   404				</html>
   405				`, purposeText, code, currentTime)
   406	
   407				config := utils.EmailConfig{
   408					SMTPHost:     emailConfig.SMTPHost,
   409					SMTPPort:     emailConfig.SMTPPort,
   410					SMTPUser:     emailConfig.SMTPUser,
   411					SMTPPassword: emailConfig.SMTPPassword,
   412					FromEmail:    emailConfig.FromEmail,
   413					FromName:     emailConfig.FromName,
   414				}
   415	
   416				if err := utils.SendEmailWithTLS(config, []string{email}, subject, body); err != nil {
   417					// Log error but don't fail - still show code in console as fallback
   418					fmt.Printf("⚠ Failed to send email: %v\n", err)
   419					fmt.Printf("✓ Verification code for %s (%s): %s (expires in 10 min)\n", email, purpose, code)
   420					return nil
   421				}
   422	
   423				fmt.Printf("✓ Verification code sent to %s (%s) via email (expires in 10 min)\n", email, purpose)
   424				return nil
   425			}
   426		}
   427	
   428		// Fallback: If no email config, just log it
   429		fmt.Printf("✓ Verification code for %s (%s): %s (expires in 10 min)\n", email, purpose, code)
   430	
   431		return nil
   432	}

   463	// GetUserStatistics returns user statistics
   464	func (s *Service) GetUserStatistics() (map[string]interface{}, error) {
   465		onlineUsers, err := s.repo.GetOnlineUserCount()
   466		if err != nil {
   467			return nil, err
   468		}
   469	
   470		// 获取今日注册用户数
   471		now := time.Now()
   472		today := now.Format("2006-01-02")
   473		var todayRegistrations int64
   474		s.repo.db.Table("users").
   475			Where("DATE(created_at) = ?", today).
   476			Count(&todayRegistrations)
   477	
   478		// 获取本周注册用户数 (从周一开始)
   479		weekStart := now.AddDate(0, 0, -int(now.Weekday())+1) // 本周一
   480		if now.Weekday() == time.Sunday {
   481			weekStart = now.AddDate(0, 0, -6) // 如果今天是周日，往前推6天到周一
   482		}
   483		weekStartStr := weekStart.Format("2006-01-02")
   484		var weekRegistrations int64
   485		s.repo.db.Table("users").
   486			Where("DATE(created_at) >= ?", weekStartStr).
   487			Count(&weekRegistrations)
   488	
   489		// 获取本月注册用户数
   490		monthStart := time.Date(now.Year(), now.Month(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, now.Location())
   491		monthStartStr := monthStart.Format("2006-01-02")
   492		var monthRegistrations int64
   493		s.repo.db.Table("users").
   494			Where("DATE(created_at) >= ?", monthStartStr).
   495			Count(&monthRegistrations)
   496	
   497		// 获取今年注册用户数
   498		yearStart := time.Date(now.Year(), 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, now.Location())
   499		yearStartStr := yearStart.Format("2006-01-02")
   500		var yearRegistrations int64
   501		s.repo.db.Table("users").
   502			Where("DATE(created_at) >= ?", yearStartStr).
   503			Count(&yearRegistrations)
   504	
   505		stats := map[string]interface{}{
   506			"online_users":        onlineUsers,
   507			"today_registrations": todayRegistrations,
   508			"week_registrations":  weekRegistrations,
   509			"month_registrations": monthRegistrations,
   510			"year_registrations":  yearRegistrations,
   511		}
   512	
   513		return stats, nil
   514	}
   515

   520	}

   633	// GetUserDetail returns detailed user information for admin
   634	func (s *Service) GetUserDetail(userID uint) (*UserDetail, error) {
   635		// Get user basic info
   636		user, err := s.repo.FindByID(userID)
   637		if err != nil {
   638			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find user: %w", err)
   639		}
   640		if user == nil {
   641			return nil, fmt.Errorf("user not found")
   642		}
   643	
   644		detail := &UserDetail{
   645			ID:            user.ID,
   646			Username:      user.Username,
   647			Email:         user.Email,
   648			Phone:         user.Phone,
   649			EmailVerified: user.EmailVerified,
   650			PhoneVerified: user.PhoneVerified,
   651			Status:        user.Status,
   652			CreatedAt:     user.CreatedAt,
   653			LastLoginAt:   user.LastLoginAt,
   654			AuthProviders: []string{},
   655		}
   656	
   657		// Get auth providers
   658		authProviders, err := s.repo.GetUserAuthProviders([]uint{userID})
   659		if err == nil && len(authProviders[userID]) > 0 {
   660			for _, provider := range authProviders[userID] {
   661				detail.AuthProviders = append(detail.AuthProviders, provider.Provider)
   662			}
   663		}
   664	
   665		// Get subscription info using the same logic as GetUserSubscription
   666		var subscription struct {
   667			PlanCode  string     `gorm:"column:plan_code"`
   668			Status    string     `gorm:"column:status"`
   669			StartDate time.Time  `gorm:"column:start_date"`
   670			EndDate   *time.Time `gorm:"column:end_date"`
   671			AutoRenew bool       `gorm:"column:auto_renew"`
   672		}
   673		
   674		err = s.repo.GetDB().Table("user_subscriptions").
   675			Where("user_id = ? AND status = ?", userID, "active").
   676			Order("created_at DESC").
   677			First(&subscription).Error
   678	
   679		if err == nil {
   680			// Get plan details
   681			var plan struct {
   682				PlanName string `gorm:"column:plan_name"`
   683				Features string `gorm:"column:features"`
   684			}
   685			s.repo.GetDB().Table("subscription_plans").
   686				Select("plan_name, features").
   687				Where("plan_code = ? AND is_active = ?", subscription.PlanCode, true).
   688				First(&plan)
   689	
   690			remainingDays := 0
   691			endDate := time.Time{}
   692			
   693			if subscription.EndDate != nil {
   694				endDate = *subscription.EndDate
   695				remainingDays = int(time.Until(endDate).Hours() / 24)
   696				if remainingDays < 0 {
   697					remainingDays = 0
   698				}
   699			}
   700	
   701			// 计算 billing_cycle (根据订阅时长推断)
   702			billingCycle := "monthly" // 默认月付
   703			if subscription.EndDate != nil {
   704				duration := subscription.EndDate.Sub(subscription.StartDate)
   705				// 如果订阅期大于40天，认为是年付
   706				if duration.Hours() > 40*24 {
   707					billingCycle = "yearly"
   708				}
   709			}
   710	
   711			detail.CurrentSubscription = &SubscriptionInfo{
   712				PlanName:      plan.PlanName,
   713				PlanCode:      subscription.PlanCode,
   714				BillingCycle:  billingCycle,
   715				Status:        subscription.Status,
   716				StartDate:     subscription.StartDate,
   717				EndDate:       endDate,
   718				AutoRenew:     subscription.AutoRenew,
   719				RemainingDays: remainingDays,
   720			}
   721	
   722			// Get today's quota usage
   723			today := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")
   724			var todayQuota struct {
   725				TotalUsed int `gorm:"column:total_used"`
   726			}
   727			s.repo.GetDB().Table("usage_quotas").
   728				Select("COALESCE(normal_search_count + advanced_search_low_count + advanced_search_mid_count + advanced_search_high_count + ai_chat_normal_count + ai_chat_mid_count + ai_chat_high_count, 0) as total_used").
   729				Where("user_id = ? AND quota_date = ?", userID, today).
   730				Scan(&todayQuota)
   731	
   732			// Parse features to get quota limits
   733			var features struct {
   734				NormalSearch struct {
   735					Limit int `json:"limit"`
   736				} `json:"normal_search"`
   737				AdvancedSearchLow struct {
   738					Limit int `json:"limit"`
   739				} `json:"advanced_search_low"`
   740				AdvancedSearchMid struct {
   741					Limit int `json:"limit"`
   742				} `json:"advanced_search_mid"`
   743				AdvancedSearchHigh struct {
   744					Limit int `json:"limit"`
   745				} `json:"advanced_search_high"`
   746				AIChatNormal struct {
   747					Limit int `json:"limit"`
   748				} `json:"ai_chat_normal"`
   749				AIChatMid struct {
   750					Limit int `json:"limit"`
   751				} `json:"ai_chat_mid"`
   752				AIChatHigh struct {
   753					Limit int `json:"limit"`
   754				} `json:"ai_chat_high"`
   755			}
   756			
   757			totalQuota := 0
   758			if plan.Features != "" {
   759				json.Unmarshal([]byte(plan.Features), &features)
   760				// 计算总配额（取最大的作为代表，或者求和）
   761				limits := []int{
   762					features.NormalSearch.Limit,
   763					features.AdvancedSearchLow.Limit,
   764					features.AdvancedSearchMid.Limit,
   765					features.AdvancedSearchHigh.Limit,
   766					features.AIChatNormal.Limit,
   767					features.AIChatMid.Limit,
   768					features.AIChatHigh.Limit,
   769				}
   770				for _, limit := range limits {
   771					if limit > totalQuota && limit != -1 {
   772						totalQuota = limit
   773					}
   774				}
   775			}
   776	
   777			detail.CurrentSubscription.TotalQuota = totalQuota
   778			detail.CurrentSubscription.UsedQuota = todayQuota.TotalUsed
   779		}
   780	
   781		// Get order statistics
   782		var orderStats struct {
   783			TotalOrders int        `gorm:"column:total_orders"`
   784			TotalAmount float64    `gorm:"column:total_amount"`
   785			TotalSaved  float64    `gorm:"column:total_saved"`
   786			LastOrderAt *time.Time `gorm:"column:last_order_at"`
   787		}
   788		s.repo.GetDB().Table("orders").
   789			Select("COUNT(*) as total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) as total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) as total_saved, MAX(payment_time) as last_order_at").
   790			Where("user_id = ? AND status = ?", userID, "paid").
   791			Scan(&orderStats)
   792	
   793		detail.OrderStats = OrderStats{
   794			TotalOrders: orderStats.TotalOrders,
   795			TotalAmount: orderStats.TotalAmount,
   796			TotalSaved:  orderStats.TotalSaved,
   797			LastOrderAt: orderStats.LastOrderAt,
   798		}
   799	
   800		// Get invitation statistics
   801		var invitationData struct {
   802			Code           string `gorm:"column:code"`
   803			TotalInvited   int    `gorm:"column:total_invited"`
   804			SuccessInvited int    `gorm:"column:success_invited"`
   805		}
   806		err = s.repo.GetDB().Table("user_invitations").
   807			Where("inviter_id = ?", userID).
   808			First(&invitationData).Error
   809	
   810		if err == nil {
   811			detail.InvitationStats = InvitationStats{
   812				InvitationCode: invitationData.Code,
   813				TotalInvited:   invitationData.TotalInvited,
   814				SuccessInvited: invitationData.SuccessInvited,
   815				RewardsEarned:  invitationData.SuccessInvited, // Assuming 1 reward per successful invite
   816			}
   817		}
   818	
   819		// Get coupon statistics
   820		var couponStats struct {
   821			Total     int `gorm:"column:total"`
   822			Used      int `gorm:"column:used"`
   823			Available int `gorm:"column:available"`
   824			Expired   int `gorm:"column:expired"`
   825		}
   826		now := time.Now()
   827		s.repo.GetDB().Table("user_coupons").
   828			Select("COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'used' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as used, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'unused' AND valid_until >= ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as available, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'expired' OR (status = 'unused' AND valid_until < ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as expired", now, now).
   829			Where("user_id = ?", userID).
   830			Scan(&couponStats)
   831	
   832		detail.CouponStats = CouponStats{
   833			TotalCoupons:     couponStats.Total,
   834			UsedCoupons:      couponStats.Used,
   835			AvailableCoupons: couponStats.Available,
   836			ExpiredCoupons:   couponStats.Expired,
   837		}
   838	
   839		// NEW: Get inviter information (who invited this user)
   840		// 使用 invitation_relationships 表
   841		var inviterData struct {
   842			InviterID    uint       `gorm:"column:inviter_id"`
   843			Username     *string    `gorm:"column:username"`
   844			Email        *string    `gorm:"column:email"`
   845			RegisteredAt *time.Time `gorm:"column:registered_at"`
   846		}
   847		err = s.repo.GetDB().Table("invitation_relationships").
   848			Select("invitation_relationships.inviter_id, users.username, users.email, invitation_relationships.registered_at").
   849			Joins("LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = invitation_relationships.inviter_id").
   850			Where("invitation_relationships.invitee_id = ?", userID).
   851			First(&inviterData).Error
   852		
   853		if err == nil && inviterData.InviterID > 0 {
   854			invitedAt := user.CreatedAt
   855			if inviterData.RegisteredAt != nil {
   856				invitedAt = *inviterData.RegisteredAt
   857			}
   858			detail.InvitedBy = &InviterInfo{
   859				UserID:    inviterData.InviterID,
   860				Username:  inviterData.Username,
   861				Email:     inviterData.Email,
   862				InvitedAt: invitedAt,
   863			}
   864		}
   865	
   866		// NEW: Get list of users invited by this user
   867		// 使用 invitation_relationships 表
   868		type invitedUserRaw struct {
   869			UserID       uint       `gorm:"column:user_id"`
   870			Username     *string    `gorm:"column:username"`
   871			Email        *string    `gorm:"column:email"`
   872			RegisteredAt *time.Time `gorm:"column:registered_at"`
   873			Status       string     `gorm:"column:status"`
   874			HasOrdered   bool       `gorm:"column:has_ordered"`
   875		}
   876		var invitedUsersData []invitedUserRaw
   877		err = s.repo.GetDB().Table("invitation_relationships").
   878			Select("users.id as user_id, users.username, users.email, invitation_relationships.registered_at, "+
   879				"invitation_relationships.status, "+
   880				"EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE orders.user_id = users.id AND orders.status = 'paid') as has_ordered").
   881			Joins("LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = invitation_relationships.invitee_id").
   882			Where("invitation_relationships.inviter_id = ?", userID).
   883			Order("invitation_relationships.created_at DESC").
   884			Find(&invitedUsersData).Error
   885	
   886		if err == nil && len(invitedUsersData) > 0 {
   887			detail.InvitedUsers = make([]InvitedUser, len(invitedUsersData))
   888			for i, invitee := range invitedUsersData {
   889				invitedAt := user.CreatedAt
   890				if invitee.RegisteredAt != nil {
   891					invitedAt = *invitee.RegisteredAt
   892				}
   893				detail.InvitedUsers[i] = InvitedUser{
   894					UserID:       invitee.UserID,
   895					Username:     invitee.Username,
   896					Email:        invitee.Email,
   897					InvitedAt:    invitedAt,
   898					IsRegistered: invitee.Status != "pending", // pending 表示还未注册
   899					HasOrdered:   invitee.HasOrdered,
   900				}
   901			}
   902		}
   903	
   904		// NEW: Get AI conversation statistics
   905		var aiConvStats struct {
   906			TotalConv   int        `gorm:"column:total_conv"`
   907			TotalRounds int        `gorm:"column:total_rounds"`
   908			LastConvAt  *time.Time `gorm:"column:last_conv_at"`
   909		}
   910		s.repo.GetDB().Table("conversations").
   911			Select("COUNT(DISTINCT id) as total_conv, "+
   912				"COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id = conversations.id)), 0) as total_rounds, "+
   913				"MAX(updated_at) as last_conv_at").
   914			Where("user_id = ? AND conversation_type = ?", userID, "chat").
   915			Scan(&aiConvStats)
   916	
   917		// Get time-based statistics for AI conversations
   918		todayStart := time.Now().Truncate(24 * time.Hour)
   919		weekStart := todayStart.AddDate(0, 0, -int(todayStart.Weekday()))
   920		monthStart := time.Date(todayStart.Year(), todayStart.Month(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, todayStart.Location())
   921	
   922		var todayRounds, weekRounds, monthRounds int64
   923		s.repo.GetDB().Table("conversation_messages").
   924			Joins("JOIN conversations ON conversations.id = conversation_messages.conversation_id").
   925			Where("conversations.user_id = ? AND conversations.conversation_type = ? AND conversation_messages.created_at >= ?", userID, "chat", todayStart).
   926			Count(&todayRounds)
   927	
   928		s.repo.GetDB().Table("conversation_messages").
   929			Joins("JOIN conversations ON conversations.id = conversation_messages.conversation_id").
   930			Where("conversations.user_id = ? AND conversations.conversation_type = ? AND conversation_messages.created_at >= ?", userID, "chat", weekStart).
   931			Count(&weekRounds)
   932	
   933		s.repo.GetDB().Table("conversation_messages").
   934			Joins("JOIN conversations ON conversations.id = conversation_messages.conversation_id").
   935			Where("conversations.user_id = ? AND conversations.conversation_type = ? AND conversation_messages.created_at >= ?", userID, "chat", monthStart).
   936			Count(&monthRounds)
   937	
   938		avgRounds := 0.0
   939		if aiConvStats.TotalConv > 0 {
   940			avgRounds = float64(aiConvStats.TotalRounds) / float64(aiConvStats.TotalConv)
   941		}
   942	
   943		detail.AIConversationStats = ConversationStats{
   944			TotalConversations: aiConvStats.TotalConv,
   945			TotalRounds:        aiConvStats.TotalRounds,
   946			TodayRounds:        int(todayRounds),
   947			WeekRounds:         int(weekRounds),
   948			MonthRounds:        int(monthRounds),
   949			AvgRoundsPerConv:   avgRounds,
   950			LastConvAt:         aiConvStats.LastConvAt,
   951		}
   952	
   953		// NEW: Get Analysis conversation statistics (使用 'search' 作为智能分析类型)
   954		var analysisConvStats struct {
   955			TotalConv   int        `gorm:"column:total_conv"`
   956			TotalRounds int        `gorm:"column:total_rounds"`
   957			LastConvAt  *time.Time `gorm:"column:last_conv_at"`
   958		}
   959		s.repo.GetDB().Table("conversations").
   960			Select("COUNT(DISTINCT id) as total_conv, "+
   961				"COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id = conversations.id)), 0) as total_rounds, "+
   962				"MAX(updated_at) as last_conv_at").
   963			Where("user_id = ? AND conversation_type = ?", userID, "search").
   964			Scan(&analysisConvStats)
   965	
   966		// Get time-based statistics for Analysis conversations
   967		var todayRoundsAnalysis, weekRoundsAnalysis, monthRoundsAnalysis int64
   968		s.repo.GetDB().Table("conversation_messages").
   969			Joins("JOIN conversations ON conversations.id = conversation_messages.conversation_id").
   970			Where("conversations.user_id = ? AND conversations.conversation_type = ? AND conversation_messages.created_at >= ?", userID, "search", todayStart).
   971			Count(&todayRoundsAnalysis)
   972	
   973		s.repo.GetDB().Table("conversation_messages").
   974			Joins("JOIN conversations ON conversations.id = conversation_messages.conversation_id").
   975			Where("conversations.user_id = ? AND conversations.conversation_type = ? AND conversation_messages.created_at >= ?", userID, "search", weekStart).
   976			Count(&weekRoundsAnalysis)
   977	
   978		s.repo.GetDB().Table("conversation_messages").
   979			Joins("JOIN conversations ON conversations.id = conversation_messages.conversation_id").
   980			Where("conversations.user_id = ? AND conversations.conversation_type = ? AND conversation_messages.created_at >= ?", userID, "search", monthStart).
   981			Count(&monthRoundsAnalysis)
   982	
   983		avgAnalysisRounds := 0.0
   984		if analysisConvStats.TotalConv > 0 {
   985			avgAnalysisRounds = float64(analysisConvStats.TotalRounds) / float64(analysisConvStats.TotalConv)
   986		}
   987	
   988		detail.AnalysisConversationStats = ConversationStats{
   989			TotalConversations: analysisConvStats.TotalConv,
   990			TotalRounds:        analysisConvStats.TotalRounds,
   991			TodayRounds:        int(todayRoundsAnalysis),
   992			WeekRounds:         int(weekRoundsAnalysis),
   993			MonthRounds:        int(monthRoundsAnalysis),
   994			AvgRoundsPerConv:   avgAnalysisRounds,
   995			LastConvAt:         analysisConvStats.LastConvAt,
   996		}
   997	
   998		return detail, nil
   999	}

  1029	// ChangePassword changes user password with current password verification
  1030	func (s *Service) ChangePassword(userID uint, currentPassword, newPassword string) error {
  1031		// Get user by ID
  1032		user, err := s.repo.FindByID(userID)
  1033		if err != nil {
  1034			return fmt.Errorf("failed to find user: %w", err)
  1035		}
  1036		if user == nil {
  1037			return errors.New("user not found")
  1038		}
  1039	
  1040		// Check if user has a password set
  1041		if user.PasswordHash == nil || *user.PasswordHash == "" {
  1042			return errors.New("no password set for this account")
  1043		}
  1044	
  1045		// Verify current password
  1046		if !utils.CheckPassword(currentPassword, *user.PasswordHash) {
  1047			return errors.New("current password is incorrect")
  1048		}
  1049	
  1050		// Hash new password
  1051		hashedPassword, err := utils.HashPassword(newPassword)
  1052		if err != nil {
  1053			return fmt.Errorf("failed to hash password: %w", err)
  1054		}
  1055	
  1056		// Update password
  1057		return s.repo.UpdatePassword(userID, hashedPassword)
  1058	}

  1060	// GetUserStatisticsChart returns user registration statistics for charts (legacy, kept for compatibility)
  1061	func (s *Service) GetUserStatisticsChart(days int) ([]map[string]interface{}, error) {
  1062		startDate := time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -days+1)
  1063		startDate = time.Date(startDate.Year(), startDate.Month(), startDate.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, startDate.Location())
  1064		endDate := time.Now()
  1065		return s.GetUserStatisticsChartWithGranularity(startDate, endDate, "day")
  1066	}

  1068	// GetUserStatisticsChartWithGranularity returns user registration statistics with custom time range and granularity
  1069	// granularity: hour, day, week, month
  1070	func (s *Service) GetUserStatisticsChartWithGranularity(startTime, endTime time.Time, granularity string) ([]map[string]interface{}, error) {
  1071		result := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0)
  1072		loc := startTime.Location()
  1073	
  1074		switch granularity {
  1075		case "hour":
  1076			// 按小时统计
  1077			currentTime := time.Date(startTime.Year(), startTime.Month(), startTime.Day(), startTime.Hour(), 0, 0, 0, loc)
  1078			for currentTime.Before(endTime) || currentTime.Equal(endTime) {
  1079				nextTime := currentTime.Add(time.Hour)
  1080				
  1081				var count int64
  1082				err := s.repo.GetDB().Model(&User{}).
  1083					Where("created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?", currentTime, nextTime).
  1084					Count(&count).Error
  1085				if err != nil {
  1086					count = 0
  1087				}
  1088	
  1089				result = append(result, map[string]interface{}{
  1090					"time":      currentTime.Format("2006-01-02 15:04"),
  1091					"label":     currentTime.Format("01-02 15:00"),
  1092					"new_users": count,
  1093				})
  1094				currentTime = nextTime
  1095			}
  1096	
  1097		case "day":
  1098			// 按天统计
  1099			currentDate := time.Date(startTime.Year(), startTime.Month(), startTime.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, loc)
  1100			endDate := time.Date(endTime.Year(), endTime.Month(), endTime.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, loc)
  1101			for currentDate.Before(endDate) || currentDate.Equal(endDate) {
  1102				nextDate := currentDate.AddDate(0, 0, 1)
  1103				
  1104				var count int64
  1105				err := s.repo.GetDB().Model(&User{}).
  1106					Where("created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?", currentDate, nextDate).
  1107					Count(&count).Error
  1108				if err != nil {
  1109					count = 0
  1110				}
  1111	
  1112				result = append(result, map[string]interface{}{
  1113					"time":      currentDate.Format("2006-01-02"),
  1114					"label":     currentDate.Format("01-02"),
  1115					"new_users": count,
  1116				})
  1117				currentDate = nextDate
  1118			}
  1119	
  1120		case "week":
  1121			// 按周统计（从周一开始）
  1122			currentDate := startTime
  1123			// 调整到周一
  1124			weekday := int(currentDate.Weekday())
  1125			if weekday == 0 {
  1126				weekday = 7
  1127			}
  1128			currentDate = currentDate.AddDate(0, 0, -(weekday - 1))
  1129			currentDate = time.Date(currentDate.Year(), currentDate.Month(), currentDate.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, loc)
  1130	
  1131			for currentDate.Before(endTime) {
  1132				nextWeek := currentDate.AddDate(0, 0, 7)
  1133				weekEnd := nextWeek
  1134				if weekEnd.After(endTime) {
  1135					weekEnd = endTime.AddDate(0, 0, 1)
  1136				}
  1137	
  1138				var count int64
  1139				err := s.repo.GetDB().Model(&User{}).
  1140					Where("created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?", currentDate, weekEnd).
  1141					Count(&count).Error
  1142				if err != nil {
  1143					count = 0
  1144				}
  1145	
  1146				result = append(result, map[string]interface{}{
  1147					"time":      currentDate.Format("2006-01-02"),
  1148					"label":     currentDate.Format("01-02") + "周",
  1149					"new_users": count,
  1150				})
  1151				currentDate = nextWeek
  1152			}
  1153	
  1154		case "month":
  1155			// 按月统计
  1156			currentDate := time.Date(startTime.Year(), startTime.Month(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, loc)
  1157			endMonth := time.Date(endTime.Year(), endTime.Month(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, loc)
  1158	
  1159			for currentDate.Before(endMonth) || currentDate.Equal(endMonth) {
  1160				nextMonth := currentDate.AddDate(0, 1, 0)
  1161				monthEnd := nextMonth
  1162				if monthEnd.After(endTime) {
  1163					monthEnd = endTime.AddDate(0, 0, 1)
  1164				}
  1165	
  1166				var count int64
  1167				err := s.repo.GetDB().Model(&User{}).
  1168					Where("created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?", currentDate, monthEnd).
  1169					Count(&count).Error
  1170				if err != nil {
  1171					count = 0
  1172				}
  1173	
  1174				result = append(result, map[string]interface{}{
  1175					"time":      currentDate.Format("2006-01"),
  1176					"label":     currentDate.Format("2006年01月"),
  1177					"new_users": count,
  1178				})
  1179				currentDate = nextMonth
  1180			}
  1181	
  1182		default:
  1183			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid granularity: %s", granularity)
  1184		}
  1185	
  1186		return result, nil
  1187	}

  1189	// GetOnlineUserChartData returns online user count snapshots for charts (legacy, kept for compatibility)
  1190	func (s *Service) GetOnlineUserChartData(hours int) ([]map[string]interface{}, error) {
  1191		endTime := time.Now()
  1192		startTime := endTime.Add(-time.Duration(hours) * time.Hour)
  1193		return s.GetOnlineUserChartDataWithGranularity(startTime, endTime, "5min")

  1195	
  1196	// GetOnlineUserChartDataWithGranularity returns online user count snapshots with custom time range and granularity
  1197	// granularity: 5min, hour
  1198	func (s *Service) GetOnlineUserChartDataWithGranularity(startTime, endTime time.Time, granularity string) ([]map[string]interface{}, error) {
  1199		// Round start time based on granularity
  1200		loc := startTime.Location()
  1201		
  1202		var interval time.Duration
  1203		var timeFormat, labelFormat string
  1204		
  1205		switch granularity {
  1206		case "5min":
  1207			startTime = startTime.Truncate(5 * time.Minute)
  1208			interval = 5 * time.Minute
  1209			timeFormat = "2006-01-02 15:04"
  1210			labelFormat = "15:04"
  1211		case "hour":
  1212			startTime = time.Date(startTime.Year(), startTime.Month(), startTime.Day(), startTime.Hour(), 0, 0, 0, loc)
  1213			interval = time.Hour
  1214			timeFormat = "2006-01-02 15:00"
  1215			labelFormat = "01-02 15:00"
  1216		default:
  1217			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid granularity: %s", granularity)
  1218		}
  1219	
  1220		// Get snapshots from database
  1221		snapshots, err := s.repo.GetOnlineUserSnapshots(startTime, endTime)
  1222		if err != nil {
  1223			return nil, err
  1224		}
  1225	
  1226		// Create a map for aggregating snapshots by interval
  1227		snapshotsMap := make(map[string][]int)
  1228		for _, snapshot := range snapshots {
  1229			var key string
  1230			switch granularity {
  1231			case "5min":
  1232				roundedTime := snapshot.Timestamp.Truncate(5 * time.Minute)
  1233				key = roundedTime.Format(timeFormat)
  1234			case "hour":
  1235				roundedTime := time.Date(snapshot.Timestamp.Year(), snapshot.Timestamp.Month(), snapshot.Timestamp.Day(), 
  1236					snapshot.Timestamp.Hour(), 0, 0, 0, loc)
  1237				key = roundedTime.Format(timeFormat)
  1238			}
  1239			snapshotsMap[key] = append(snapshotsMap[key], snapshot.OnlineCount)
  1240		}
  1241	
  1242		// Generate result with all time points filled
  1243		result := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0)
  1244		currentTime := startTime
  1245	
  1246		for currentTime.Before(endTime) || currentTime.Equal(endTime) {
  1247			timeStr := currentTime.Format(timeFormat)
  1248			labelStr := currentTime.Format(labelFormat)
  1249	
  1250			// Get average online count for this interval
  1251			onlineCount := 0
  1252			if counts, exists := snapshotsMap[timeStr]; exists && len(counts) > 0 {
  1253				sum := 0
  1254				for _, c := range counts {
  1255					sum += c
  1256				}
  1257				onlineCount = sum / len(counts)
  1258			}
  1259	
  1260			result = append(result, map[string]interface{}{
  1261				"time":         timeStr,
  1262				"label":        labelStr,
  1263				"online_count": onlineCount,
  1264			})
  1265	
  1266			currentTime = currentTime.Add(interval)
  1267		}
  1268	
  1269		return result, nil
  1270	}

  1272	// RecordOnlineUserSnapshot records current online user count (called periodically)
  1273	func (s *Service) RecordOnlineUserSnapshot() error {
  1274		onlineCount, err := s.repo.GetOnlineUserCount()
  1275		if err != nil {
  1276			return err
  1277		}
  1278	
  1279		// Record snapshot
  1280		now := time.Now()
  1281		if err := s.repo.CreateOnlineUserSnapshot(now, int(onlineCount)); err != nil {
  1282			return err
  1283		}
  1284	
  1285		// Also update peak for today
  1286		today := now.Format("2006-01-02")
  1287		_ = s.repo.UpdatePeakOnlineUsers(today, int(onlineCount))
  1288	
  1289		return nil
  1290	}

  1301	// SendPhoneVerificationCode sends SMS verification code
  1302	func (s *Service) SendPhoneVerificationCode(phone, purpose string) error {
  1303		// Check rate limit: prevent sending too frequently (must wait 1 minute)
  1304		ttl, err := cache.GetVerificationCodeTTL(context.Background(), phone, purpose)
  1305		if err == nil && ttl > 9*time.Minute {
  1306			// Code exists and was sent less than 1 minute ago
  1307			remainingSeconds := int((ttl - 9*time.Minute).Seconds())
  1308			return fmt.Errorf("操作过于频繁，请 %d 秒后再试", remainingSeconds)
  1309		}
  1310	
  1311		// Generate 6-digit code
  1312		code := fmt.Sprintf("%06d", rand.Intn(1000000))
  1313	
  1314		// Save verification code to Redis (auto-expires in 10 minutes)
  1315		if err := cache.SaveVerificationCode(context.Background(), phone, code, purpose); err != nil {
  1316			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save verification code: %w", err)
  1317		}
  1318	
  1319		// Get SMS configuration from database
  1320		if s.configService != nil {
  1321			smsConfig, err := s.configService.GetActiveSMSConfig()
  1322			if err == nil && smsConfig != nil {
  1323				// Extract template variables from template content
  1324				variables := utils.ExtractTemplateVariables(smsConfig.TemplateContent)
  1325	
  1326				// Build parameters based on detected variables
  1327				params := make(map[string]string)
  1328				for _, varName := range variables {
  1329					switch varName {
  1330					case "code":
  1331						params["code"] = code
  1332					case "min", "minute", "minutes":
  1333						params[varName] = "5" // Default to 5 minutes (matching Redis expiry)
  1334					case "product":
  1335						params["product"] = "Scholay"
  1336					default:
  1337						// For unknown variables, use a placeholder
  1338						params[varName] = "测试值"
  1339					}
  1340				}
  1341	
  1342				config := utils.SMSConfig{
  1343					AccessKeyID:     smsConfig.AccessKeyID,
  1344					AccessSecret:    smsConfig.AccessSecret,
  1345					SignName:        smsConfig.SignName,
  1346					TemplateCode:    smsConfig.TemplateCode,
  1347					TemplateContent: smsConfig.TemplateContent,
  1348					Endpoint:        smsConfig.Endpoint,
  1349				}
  1350	
  1351				if err := utils.SendSMSVerifyCodePNS(config, phone, params); err != nil {
  1352					// Log error but don't fail - still show code in console as fallback
  1353					fmt.Printf("⚠ Failed to send SMS: %v\n", err)
  1354					fmt.Printf("✓ Verification code for %s (%s): %s (expires in 10 min)\n", phone, purpose, code)
  1355					return nil
  1356				}
  1357	
  1358				fmt.Printf("✓ Verification code sent to %s (%s) via SMS (expires in 10 min)\n", phone, purpose)
  1359				return nil
  1360			}
  1361		}
  1362	
  1363		// Fallback: If no SMS config, just log it
  1364		fmt.Printf("✓ Verification code for %s (%s): %s (expires in 10 min)\n", phone, purpose, code)
  1365	
  1366		return nil
  1367	}
