  1369	// RegisterWithPhone registers a new user with phone and password
  1370	// Enhanced with transaction support for concurrency safety
  1371	func (s *Service) RegisterWithPhone(phone, password, code, invitationCode, ip string) (*User, string, error) {
  1372		// Verify the phone code using Redis
  1373		valid, err := cache.VerifyCode(context.Background(), phone, code, "register")
  1374		if err != nil {
  1375			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to verify code: %w", err)
  1376		}
  1377		if !valid {
  1378			return nil, "", errors.New("invalid or expired verification code")
  1379		}
  1380	
  1381		// First check: validate phone availability (pre-verification)
  1382		existing, err := s.repo.FindByPhone(phone)
  1383		if err != nil {
  1384			return nil, "", err
  1385		}
  1386		if existing != nil {
  1387			return nil, "", errors.New("phone number already registered")
  1388		}
  1389	
  1390		// Hash password
  1391		hashedPassword, err := utils.HashPassword(password)
  1392		if err != nil {
  1393			return nil, "", err
  1394		}
  1395	
  1396		var user *User
  1397		var token string
  1398	
  1399		// Use transaction for atomic registration
  1400		err = s.repo.GetDB().Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
  1401			txRepo := NewRepository(tx)
  1402	
  1403			// Second check: double-check phone availability within transaction (concurrency protection)
  1404			existing, err := txRepo.FindByPhone(phone)
  1405			if err != nil {
  1406				return err
  1407			}
  1408			if existing != nil {
  1409				return errors.New("phone number already registered")
  1410			}
  1411	
  1412			// Generate random username
  1413			username, err := s.generateRandomUsername()
  1414			if err != nil {
  1415				return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate username: %w", err)
  1416			}
  1417	
  1418			// Create user
  1419			user = &User{
  1420				Phone:         &phone,
  1421				Username:      &username,
  1422				PasswordHash:  &hashedPassword,
  1423				Status:        1,
  1424				PhoneVerified: true,
  1425			}
  1426	
  1427			if err := txRepo.Create(user); err != nil {
  1428				return err
  1429			}
  1430	
  1431			// Update last login time and IP (registration counts as first login)
  1432			_ = txRepo.UpdateLastLoginWithIP(user.ID, ip)
  1433	
  1434			// Create auth provider entry
  1435			authProvider := &UserAuthProvider{
  1436				UserID:         user.ID,
  1437				Provider:       "phone",
  1438				ProviderUserID: phone,
  1439			}
  1440			if err := txRepo.CreateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
  1441				return err
  1442			}
  1443	
  1444			return nil
  1445		})
  1446	
  1447		if err != nil {
  1448			return nil, "", err
  1449		}
  1450	
  1451		// Generate JWT token
  1452		tokenUsername := phone
  1453		if user.Username != nil {
  1454			tokenUsername = *user.Username
  1455		}
  1456		token, err = utils.GenerateToken(user.ID, tokenUsername, "user")
  1457		if err != nil {
  1458			return nil, "", err
  1459		}
  1460	
  1461		// Handle invitation code if provided (same logic as email registration)
  1462		if invitationCode != "" && s.couponService != nil {
  1463			// Process invitation in background to not block registration
  1464			go func() {
  1465				_ = s.couponService.RegisterWithInvitation(invitationCode, uint64(user.ID))
  1466			}()
  1467		}
  1468	
  1469		// Distribute register coupons to new user (auto_register type)
  1470		if s.couponService != nil {
  1471			go func() {
  1472				_ = s.couponService.DistributeRegisterCoupons(uint64(user.ID))
  1473			}()
  1474		}
  1475	
  1476		return user, token, nil
  1477	}
  1478	
  1479	// LoginWithPhone handles login with phone and password
  1480	func (s *Service) LoginWithPhone(phone, password, ip string) (*User, string, error) {
  1481		// Find user by phone
  1482		user, err := s.repo.FindByPhone(phone)
  1483		if err != nil {
  1484			return nil, "", err
  1485		}
  1486	
  1487		if user == nil {
  1488			return nil, "", errors.New("phone number not registered")
  1489		}
  1490	
  1491		// Check if user is active
  1492		if user.Status != 1 {
  1493			return nil, "", errors.New("account is suspended")
  1494		}
  1495	
  1496		// Verify password
  1497		if user.PasswordHash == nil {
  1498			return nil, "", errors.New("please set a password first")
  1499		}
  1500	
  1501		if !utils.CheckPassword(password, *user.PasswordHash) {
  1502			return nil, "", errors.New("invalid password")
  1503		}
  1504	
  1505		// Update last login time and IP
  1506		_ = s.repo.UpdateLastLoginWithIP(user.ID, ip)
  1507	
  1508		// Generate JWT token
  1509		token, err := utils.GenerateToken(user.ID, "", "user")
  1510		if err != nil {
  1511			return nil, "", err
  1512		}
  1513	
  1514		return user, token, nil
  1515	}

  1517	// ResetPasswordPhone resets user password with phone verification code
  1518	func (s *Service) ResetPasswordPhone(phone, code, newPassword string) error {
  1519		// Verify the code
  1520		valid, err := cache.VerifyCode(context.Background(), phone, code, "reset_password")
  1521		if err != nil {
  1522			return fmt.Errorf("failed to verify code: %w", err)
  1523		}
  1524		if !valid {
  1525			return errors.New("invalid or expired verification code")
  1526		}
  1527	
  1528		// Find user by phone
  1529		user, err := s.repo.FindByPhone(phone)
  1530		if err != nil {
  1531			return err
  1532		}
  1533		if user == nil {
  1534			return errors.New("phone number not registered")
  1535		}
  1536	
  1537		// Hash new password

  1539		if err != nil {
  1540			return fmt.Errorf("failed to hash password: %w", err)
  1541		}
  1542	
  1543		// Update password

  1545	}

  1547	// LoginWithPhoneCode logs in a user with phone and verification code
  1548	func (s *Service) LoginWithPhoneCode(phone, code, ip string) (*User, string, error) {
  1549		// Verify the code
  1550		valid, err := cache.VerifyCode(context.Background(), phone, code, "login")
  1551		if err != nil {
  1552			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to verify code: %w", err)
  1553		}
  1554		if !valid {
  1555			return nil, "", errors.New("invalid or expired verification code")
  1556		}
  1557	
  1558		// Find user by phone
  1559		user, err := s.repo.FindByPhone(phone)
  1560		if err != nil {
  1561			return nil, "", err
  1562		}
  1563		if user == nil {
  1564			return nil, "", errors.New("phone number not registered")
  1565		}
  1566	
  1567		// Check if user is active
  1568		if user.Status != 1 {
  1569			return nil, "", errors.New("account is suspended")
  1570		}
  1571	
  1572		// Update last login time and IP
  1573		_ = s.repo.UpdateLastLoginWithIP(user.ID, ip)
  1574	
  1575		// Generate JWT token
  1576		token, err := utils.GenerateToken(user.ID, "", "user")
  1577		if err != nil {
  1578			return nil, "", err
  1579		}
  1580	
  1581		return user, token, nil
  1582	}

  1584	// BindPhone binds a phone number to an existing user account
  1585	// Enhanced with transaction support and double-check for concurrency safety
  1586	func (s *Service) BindPhone(userID uint, phone, code string) error {
  1587		// Verify the phone code using Redis
  1588		valid, err := cache.VerifyCode(context.Background(), phone, code, "bind")
  1589		if err != nil {
  1590			return fmt.Errorf("failed to verify code: %w", err)
  1591		}
  1592		if !valid {
  1593			return errors.New("invalid or expired verification code")
  1594		}
  1595	
  1596		// First check: validate phone availability (pre-verification)
  1597		existing, err := s.repo.FindByPhone(phone)
  1598		if err != nil {
  1599			return err
  1600		}
  1601		if existing != nil && existing.ID != userID {
  1602			return errors.New("phone number already bound to another account")
  1603		}
  1604	
  1605		// Use transaction for atomic binding operation
  1606		return s.repo.GetDB().Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
  1607			// Create a temporary repository with transaction DB
  1608			txRepo := NewRepository(tx)
  1609	
  1610			// Second check: double-check phone availability within transaction (concurrency protection)
  1611			existing, err := txRepo.FindByPhone(phone)
  1612			if err != nil {
  1613				return err
  1614			}
  1615			if existing != nil && existing.ID != userID {
  1616				return errors.New("phone number already bound to another account")
  1617			}
  1618	
  1619			// Get current user
  1620			user, err := txRepo.FindByID(userID)
  1621			if err != nil {
  1622				return err
  1623			}
  1624			if user == nil {
  1625				return errors.New("user not found")
  1626			}
  1627	
  1628			// Update user phone
  1629			user.Phone = &phone
  1630			user.PhoneVerified = true
  1631			if err := txRepo.Update(user); err != nil {
  1632				return err
  1633			}
  1634	
  1635			// Create or update auth provider entry
  1636			authProvider, err := txRepo.FindAuthProviderByUserAndProvider(userID, "phone")
  1637			if err != nil {
  1638				return err
  1639			}
  1640	
  1641			if authProvider == nil {
  1642				// Create new auth provider
  1643				authProvider = &UserAuthProvider{
  1644					UserID:         userID,
  1645					Provider:       "phone",
  1646					ProviderUserID: phone,
  1647				}
  1648				if err := txRepo.CreateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
  1649					return err
  1650				}
  1651			} else {
  1652				// Update existing auth provider
  1653				authProvider.ProviderUserID = phone
  1654				if err := txRepo.UpdateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
  1655					return err
  1656				}
  1657			}
  1658	
  1659			return nil
  1660		})
  1661	}

  1742	// UnbindPhone unbinds phone from user account
  1743	func (s *Service) UnbindPhone(userID uint, code string) error {
  1744		// First get user to verify code (without lock)
  1745		user, err := s.repo.FindByID(userID)
  1746		if err != nil {
  1747			return err
  1748		}
  1749		if user == nil {
  1750			return errors.New("user not found")
  1751		}
  1752	
  1753		// Check if phone is bound
  1754		if user.Phone == nil || *user.Phone == "" {
  1755			return errors.New("phone is not bound")
  1756		}
  1757	
  1758		// Verify the code before starting transaction
  1759		valid, err := cache.VerifyCode(context.Background(), *user.Phone, code, "unbind")
  1760		if err != nil {
  1761			return fmt.Errorf("failed to verify code: %w", err)
  1762		}
  1763		if !valid {
  1764			return errors.New("invalid or expired verification code")
  1765		}
  1766	
  1767		// Start transaction with pessimistic locking
  1768		tx := s.repo.GetDB().Begin()
  1769		defer func() {
  1770			if r := recover(); r != nil {
  1771				tx.Rollback()
  1772			}
  1773		}()
  1774	
  1775		// Lock the user row using FOR UPDATE
  1776		var lockedUser User
  1777		if err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).
  1778			Where("id = ?", userID).First(&lockedUser).Error; err != nil {
  1779			tx.Rollback()
  1780			return fmt.Errorf("failed to lock user record: %w", err)
  1781		}
  1782	
  1783		// Re-check if phone is still bound (might have been changed by another transaction)
  1784		if lockedUser.Phone == nil || *lockedUser.Phone == "" {
  1785			tx.Rollback()
  1786			return errors.New("phone is not bound")
  1787		}
  1788	
  1789		// Check if user has at least one other login method (within transaction)
  1790		hasEmail := lockedUser.Email != nil && *lockedUser.Email != ""
  1791	
  1792		var wechatCount int64
  1793		if err := tx.Model(&UserAuthProvider{}).
  1794			Where("user_id = ? AND provider = ?", userID, "wechat").
  1795			Count(&wechatCount).Error; err != nil {
  1796			tx.Rollback()
  1797			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check WeChat binding: %w", err)
  1798		}
  1799		hasWeChat := wechatCount > 0
  1800	
  1801		if !hasEmail && !hasWeChat {
  1802			tx.Rollback()
  1803			return errors.New("cannot unbind phone: at least one login method must remain")
  1804		}
  1805	
  1806		// Remove phone
  1807		lockedUser.Phone = nil
  1808		lockedUser.PhoneVerified = false
  1809	
  1810		if err := tx.Save(&lockedUser).Error; err != nil {
  1811			tx.Rollback()
  1812			return fmt.Errorf("failed to unbind phone: %w", err)
  1813		}
  1814	
  1815		// Remove auth provider
  1816		if err := tx.Where("user_id = ? AND provider = ?", userID, "phone").
  1817			Delete(&UserAuthProvider{}).Error; err != nil {
  1818			tx.Rollback()
  1819			return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete phone auth provider: %w", err)
  1820		}
  1821	
  1822		// Commit transaction
  1823		if err := tx.Commit().Error; err != nil {
  1824			return fmt.Errorf("failed to commit transaction: %w", err)
  1825		}
  1826	
  1827		return nil
  1828	}

  1918	// UnbindWeChat unbinds WeChat from user account

  1920		// Start transaction with pessimistic locking
  1921		tx := s.repo.GetDB().Begin()
  1922		defer func() {
  1923			if r := recover(); r != nil {
  1924				tx.Rollback()
  1925			}
  1926		}()
  1927	
  1928		// Lock the user row using FOR UPDATE

  1930		if err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).

  1968			return fmt.Errorf("failed to commit transaction: %w", err)
  1969		}
  1970	
  1971		return nil
  1972	}

  1974	// UnbindGitHub unbinds GitHub from user account
  1975	func (s *Service) UnbindGitHub(userID uint) error {
  1976		// Start transaction with pessimistic locking
  1977		tx := s.repo.GetDB().Begin()
  1978		defer func() {
  1979			if r := recover(); r != nil {
  1980				tx.Rollback()
  1981			}
  1982		}()
  1983	
  1984		// Lock the user row using FOR UPDATE

  2035		}
  2036	
  2037		return nil
  2038	}

  2040	// LoginOrRegisterWithWeChat handles WeChat login or registration
  2041	func (s *Service) LoginOrRegisterWithWeChat(openID, unionID, nickname, avatarURL, ip, invitationCode string) (*User, string, bool, error) {
  2042		var authProvider *UserAuthProvider
  2043		var err error
  2044		
  2045		// Priority 1: Try to find by unionID if available (for users who have it)
  2046		if unionID != "" {
  2047			authProvider, err = s.repo.FindAuthProviderByUnionID("wechat", unionID)
  2048			if err != nil {
  2049				return nil, "", false, err
  2050			}
  2051		}
  2052		
  2053		// Priority 2: If not found by unionID, try by openID (for backward compatibility)
  2054		if authProvider == nil {
  2055			authProvider, err = s.repo.FindAuthProviderByProviderAndProviderUserID("wechat", openID)
  2056			if err != nil {
  2057				return nil, "", false, err
  2058			}
  2059		}
  2060	
  2061		isNewUser := false
  2062	
  2063		if authProvider != nil {
  2064			// Existing user - login
  2065			user, err := s.repo.FindByID(authProvider.UserID)
  2066			if err != nil {
  2067				return nil, "", false, err
  2068			}
  2069	
  2070			if user == nil {
  2071				return nil, "", false, errors.New("user not found")
  2072			}
  2073	
  2074			// Check if user is active
  2075			if user.Status != 1 {
  2076				return nil, "", false, errors.New("account is suspended")
  2077			}
  2078	
  2079			// Update last login time and IP
  2080			_ = s.repo.UpdateLastLoginWithIP(user.ID, ip)
  2081			
  2082			// Update unionID if it's not set (migration for old records)
  2083			if authProvider.ProviderUnionID == nil && unionID != "" {
  2084				authProvider.ProviderUnionID = &unionID
  2085				_ = s.repo.UpdateAuthProvider(authProvider)
  2086			}
  2087	
  2088			// Generate JWT token
  2089			token, err := utils.GenerateToken(user.ID, "", "user")
  2090			if err != nil {
  2091				return nil, "", false, err
  2092			}
  2093	
  2094			return user, token, isNewUser, nil
  2095		}
  2096	
  2097		// New user - register
  2098		isNewUser = true
  2099	
  2100		// Create user with WeChat info
  2101		user := &User{
  2102			Username:  &nickname,
  2103			AvatarURL: &avatarURL,
  2104			Status:    1,
  2105		}
  2106	
  2107		if err := s.repo.Create(user); err != nil {
  2108			return nil, "", false, err
  2109		}
  2110	
  2111		// Update last login time and IP (registration counts as first login)
  2112		_ = s.repo.UpdateLastLoginWithIP(user.ID, ip)
  2113	
  2114		// 处理邀请码 - 如果是新用户且有邀请码
  2115		if invitationCode != "" {
  2116			if err := s.ProcessInvitationForOAuth(user.ID, invitationCode, ip); err != nil {
  2117				// 邀请码处理失败不影响注册，只记录日志
  2118				fmt.Printf("Failed to process invitation code for WeChat user %d: %v\n", user.ID, err)
  2119			}
  2120		}
  2121	
  2122		// 发放注册自动折扣券给新用户
  2123		if s.couponService != nil {
  2124			go func() {
  2125				_ = s.couponService.DistributeRegisterCoupons(uint64(user.ID))
  2126			}()
  2127		}
  2128	
  2129		// Create auth provider entry
  2130		// Save nickname and avatar in provider_data
  2131		providerDataJSON := fmt.Sprintf(`{"nickname":"%s","avatar_url":"%s"}`, nickname, avatarURL)
  2132		
  2133		var unionIDPtr *string
  2134		if unionID != "" {
  2135			unionIDPtr = &unionID
  2136		}
  2137		
  2138		authProvider = &UserAuthProvider{
  2139			UserID:          user.ID,
  2140			Provider:        "wechat",
  2141			ProviderUserID:  openID, // openID 作为主要标识
  2142			ProviderUnionID: unionIDPtr, // UnionID 作为跨应用标识
  2143			ProviderData:    &providerDataJSON,
  2144		}
  2145	
  2146		if err := s.repo.CreateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
  2147			return nil, "", false, err
  2148		}
  2149	
  2150		// Generate JWT token
  2151		token, err := utils.GenerateToken(user.ID, "", "user")
  2152		if err != nil {
  2153			return nil, "", false, err
  2154		}
  2155	
  2156		return user, token, isNewUser, nil
  2157	}
  2158	
  2159	// ProcessInvitationForOAuth processes invitation code for OAuth (WeChat/GitHub) registration
  2160	// This is called after a new user is created via OAuth login
  2161	func (s *Service) ProcessInvitationForOAuth(userID uint, invitationCode, ip string) error {
  2162		if invitationCode == "" || s.couponService == nil {
  2163			return nil
  2164		}
  2165	
  2166		// Process invitation (same logic as email/phone registration)
  2167		return s.couponService.RegisterWithInvitation(invitationCode, uint64(userID))
  2168	}

  2170	// BindWeChat binds a WeChat account to an existing user
  2171	func (s *Service) BindWeChat(userID uint, openID, unionID, nickname, avatarURL string) error {
  2172		// Check if WeChat is already bound to another user (check both openID and unionID)
  2173		existing, err := s.repo.FindAuthProviderByProviderAndProviderUserID("wechat", openID)
  2174		if err != nil {
  2175			return err
  2176		}
  2177	
  2178		if existing != nil && existing.UserID != userID {
  2179			return errors.New("该微信账号已被其他账号绑定")
  2180		}
  2181		
  2182		// Also check by unionID if available
  2183		if unionID != "" {
  2184			existingByUnionID, err := s.repo.FindAuthProviderByUnionID("wechat", unionID)
  2185			if err != nil {
  2186				return err
  2187			}
  2188			if existingByUnionID != nil && existingByUnionID.UserID != userID {
  2189				return errors.New("该微信账号已被其他账号绑定")
  2190			}
  2191		}
  2192	
  2193		// Get current user
  2194		user, err := s.repo.FindByID(userID)
  2195		if err != nil {
  2196			return err
  2197		}
  2198	
  2199		if user == nil {
  2200			return errors.New("user not found")
  2201		}
  2202	
  2203		// Update username and avatar if not set
  2204		if user.Username == nil || *user.Username == "" {
  2205			user.Username = &nickname
  2206		}
  2207		if user.AvatarURL == nil || *user.AvatarURL == "" {
  2208			user.AvatarURL = &avatarURL
  2209		}
  2210	
  2211		if err := s.repo.Update(user); err != nil {
  2212			return err
  2213		}
  2214	
  2215		// Create or update auth provider entry
  2216		authProvider, err := s.repo.FindAuthProviderByUserAndProvider(userID, "wechat")
  2217		if err != nil {
  2218			return err
  2219		}
  2220	
  2221		// Prepare provider data
  2222		providerDataJSON := fmt.Sprintf(`{"nickname":"%s","avatar_url":"%s"}`, nickname, avatarURL)
  2223		
  2224		var unionIDPtr *string
  2225		if unionID != "" {
  2226			unionIDPtr = &unionID
  2227		}
  2228		
  2229		if authProvider == nil {
  2230			// Create new auth provider
  2231			authProvider = &UserAuthProvider{
  2232				UserID:          userID,
  2233				Provider:        "wechat",
  2234				ProviderUserID:  openID,
  2235				ProviderUnionID: unionIDPtr,
  2236				ProviderData:    &providerDataJSON,
  2237			}
  2238			if err := s.repo.CreateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
  2239				return err
  2240			}
  2241		} else {
  2242			// Update existing auth provider
  2243			authProvider.ProviderUserID = openID
  2244			authProvider.ProviderUnionID = unionIDPtr
  2245			authProvider.ProviderData = &providerDataJSON
  2246			if err := s.repo.UpdateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
  2247				return err
  2248			}
  2249		}
  2250	
  2251		return nil
  2252	}

  2254	// BindEmailWithPassword binds email to WeChat-registered user with new password
  2255	func (s *Service) BindEmailWithPassword(userID uint, email, password, code string) error {
  2256		// Verify the email code using Redis
  2257		valid, err := cache.VerifyCode(context.Background(), email, code, "bind")
  2258		if err != nil {
  2259			return fmt.Errorf("failed to verify code: %w", err)
  2260		}
  2261		if !valid {
  2262			return errors.New("invalid or expired verification code")
  2263		}
  2264	
  2265		// Check if email is already used by another user
  2266		existing, err := s.repo.FindByEmail(email)
  2267		if err != nil {
  2268			return err
  2269		}
  2270	
  2271		if existing != nil && existing.ID != userID {
  2272			return errors.New("email already bound to another account")
  2273		}
  2274	
  2275		// Get current user
  2276		user, err := s.repo.FindByID(userID)
  2277		if err != nil {
  2278			return err
  2279		}
  2280	
  2281		if user == nil {
  2282			return errors.New("user not found")
  2283		}
  2284	
  2285		// Hash password
  2286		hashedPassword, err := utils.HashPassword(password)
  2287		if err != nil {
  2288			return err
  2289		}
  2290	
  2291		// Update user email and password
  2292		user.Email = &email
  2293		user.EmailVerified = true
  2294		user.PasswordHash = &hashedPassword
  2295	
  2296		if err := s.repo.Update(user); err != nil {
  2297			return err
  2298		}
  2299	
  2300		// Create or update auth provider entry
  2301		authProvider, err := s.repo.FindAuthProviderByUserAndProvider(userID, "email")
  2302		if err != nil {
  2303			return err
  2304		}
  2305	
  2306		if authProvider == nil {
  2307			// Create new auth provider
  2308			authProvider = &UserAuthProvider{
  2309				UserID:         userID,
  2310				Provider:       "email",
  2311				ProviderUserID: email,
  2312			}
  2313			if err := s.repo.CreateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
  2314				return err
  2315			}
  2316		} else {
  2317			// Update existing auth provider
  2318			authProvider.ProviderUserID = email
  2319			if err := s.repo.UpdateAuthProvider(authProvider); err != nil {
  2320				return err
  2321			}
  2322		}
  2323	
  2324		return nil
  2325	}

  2421	// CheckEmailAvailability checks if an email is available for binding
  2422	// Returns true if email can be used (either doesn't exist or belongs to current user)
  2423	func (s *Service) CheckEmailAvailability(email string, currentUserID uint) (bool, error) {
  2424		existing, err := s.repo.FindByEmail(email)
  2425		if err != nil {
  2426			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to check email: %w", err)
  2427		}
  2428	
  2429		// Email is available if it doesn't exist
  2430		if existing == nil {
  2431			return true, nil
  2432		}
  2433	
  2434		// Email exists but belongs to current user (rebind case)
  2435		if existing.ID == currentUserID {
  2436			return true, nil
  2437		}
  2438	
  2439		// Email already in use by another user
  2440		return false, nil
  2441	}
  2442

    85		// If show_secret=true, return the real secret (client should verify admin first)

    99	// CreateConfig creates a new WeChat configuration (Admin only)
   100	// POST /api/v1/admin/wechat/config
   101	func (h *Handler) CreateConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   102		var req CreateConfigRequest
   103		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   104			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   105			return
   106		}
   107	
   108		// Set default scope if not provided
   109		if req.Scope == "" {
   110			req.Scope = "snsapi_login"
   111		}
   112	
   113		config := &model.WeChatConfig{
   114			AppID:       req.AppID,
   115			AppSecret:   req.AppSecret,
   116			RedirectURI: req.RedirectURI,
   117			Scope:       req.Scope,
   118			IsActive:    req.IsActive,
   119		}
   120	
   121		if err := h.service.CreateConfig(config); err != nil {
   122			utils.Error(c, 5001, "Failed to create configuration: "+err.Error())
   123			return
   124		}
   125	
   126		// Mask sensitive information before returning
   127		config.AppSecret = "********"
   128

   130	}

   141	// UpdateConfig updates a WeChat configuration (Admin only)
   142	// PUT /api/v1/admin/wechat/config/:id
   143	func (h *Handler) UpdateConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   144		idStr := c.Param("id")
   145		id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 32)
   146		if err != nil {
   147			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid configuration ID")
   148			return
   149		}
   150	
   151		var req UpdateConfigRequest
   152		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
   153			utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
   154			return
   155		}
   156	
   157		// Get existing config (assuming we need to fetch first, or construct one)
   158		// For simplicity, construct a config object with the ID and update fields
   159		config := &model.WeChatConfig{
   160			ID: uint(id),
   161		}
   162	
   163		// Update fields only if provided
   164		if req.AppID != "" {
   165			config.AppID = req.AppID
   166		}
   167		if req.AppSecret != "" && req.AppSecret != "********" {
   168			config.AppSecret = req.AppSecret
   169		}
   170		if req.RedirectURI != "" {
   171			config.RedirectURI = req.RedirectURI
   172		}
   173		if req.Scope != "" {
   174			config.Scope = req.Scope
   175		}
   176		if req.IsActive != nil {
   177			config.IsActive = *req.IsActive
   178		}
   179	
   180		if err := h.service.UpdateConfig(config); err != nil {
   181			utils.Error(c, 5002, "Failed to update configuration: "+err.Error())
   182			return
   183		}
   184	
   185		// Mask sensitive information before returning
   186		config.AppSecret = "********"
   187	
   188		utils.Success(c, config)
   189	}

    26	// GetActiveConfig retrieves the active WeChat configuration
    27	func (r *Repository) GetActiveConfig() (*model.WeChatConfig, error) {
    28		var config model.WeChatConfig
    29		err := r.db.Where("is_active = ?", true).First(&config).Error
    30		if err != nil {
    31			return nil, err
    32		}
    33		return &config, nil
    34	}
    35	
    36	// GetConfigByID retrieves a WeChat configuration by ID
    37	func (r *Repository) GetConfigByID(id uint) (*model.WeChatConfig, error) {
    38		var config model.WeChatConfig
    39		err := r.db.Where("id = ?", id).First(&config).Error
    40		if err != nil {
    41			return nil, err
    42		}
    43		return &config, nil
    44	}
    45	
    46	// ListConfigs retrieves all WeChat configurations
    47	func (r *Repository) ListConfigs() ([]model.WeChatConfig, error) {
    48		var configs []model.WeChatConfig
    49		err := r.db.Order("created_at DESC").Find(&configs).Error
    50		return configs, err
    51	}
    52	
    53	// CreateConfig creates a new WeChat configuration
    54	func (r *Repository) CreateConfig(config *model.WeChatConfig) error {
    55		return r.db.Create(config).Error
    56	}
    57	
    58	// UpdateConfig updates a WeChat configuration
    59	func (r *Repository) UpdateConfig(config *model.WeChatConfig) error {
    60		// Use Updates instead of Save to avoid updating created_at
    61		// and to allow selective field updates
    62		updates := map[string]interface{}{
    63			"app_id":       config.AppID,
    64			"redirect_uri": config.RedirectURI,
    65			"scope":        config.Scope,
    66			"is_active":    config.IsActive,
    67		}
    68	
    69		// Only update app_secret if it's not empty
    70		if config.AppSecret != "" {
    71			updates["app_secret"] = config.AppSecret
    72		}
    73	
    74		return r.db.Model(&model.WeChatConfig{}).Where("id = ?", config.ID).Updates(updates).Error
    75	}
    76	
    77	// DeleteConfig deletes a WeChat configuration
    78	func (r *Repository) DeleteConfig(id uint) error {
    79		return r.db.Delete(&model.WeChatConfig{}, id).Error
    80	}
    81	
    82	// DeactivateAllConfigs deactivates all WeChat configurations
    83	func (r *Repository) DeactivateAllConfigs() error {
    84		return r.db.Model(&model.WeChatConfig{}).Where("is_active = ?", true).Update("is_active", false).Error
    85	}
    86	
    87	// SetActiveConfig sets a specific configuration as active (and deactivates others)
    88	func (r *Repository) SetActiveConfig(id uint) error {
    89		return r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
    90			// Deactivate all configs
    91			if err := tx.Model(&model.WeChatConfig{}).Where("is_active = ?", true).Update("is_active", false).Error; err != nil {
    92				return err
    93			}
    94			// Activate the specified config
    95			return tx.Model(&model.WeChatConfig{}).Where("id = ?", id).Update("is_active", true).Error
    96		})
    97	}

    66	// GenerateLoginURL generates the WeChat QR code login URL
    67	func (s *Service) GenerateLoginURL(state string) (string, error) {
    68		config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
    69		if err != nil {
    70			return "", fmt.Errorf("no active WeChat configuration: %w", err)
    71		}
    72	
    73		// For web-based QR code login
    74		params := url.Values{}
    75		params.Set("appid", config.AppID)
    76		params.Set("redirect_uri", config.RedirectURI)
    77		params.Set("response_type", "code")
    78		params.Set("scope", config.Scope)
    79		params.Set("state", state)
    80	
    81		loginURL := "https://open.weixin.qq.com/connect/qrconnect?" + params.Encode() + "#wechat_redirect"
    82		return loginURL, nil
    83	}

    85	// GetAccessToken exchanges authorization code for access token
    86	func (s *Service) GetAccessToken(code string) (*WeChatAccessTokenResponse, error) {
    87		config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
    88		if err != nil {
    89			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no active WeChat configuration: %w", err)
    90		}
    91	
    92		// Build request URL
    93		params := url.Values{}
    94		params.Set("appid", config.AppID)
    95		params.Set("secret", config.AppSecret)
    96		params.Set("code", code)
    97		params.Set("grant_type", "authorization_code")
    98	
    99		tokenURL := "https://api.weixin.qq.com/sns/oauth2/access_token?" + params.Encode()
   100	
   101		// Make HTTP request
   102		resp, err := http.Get(tokenURL)
   103		if err != nil {
   104			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get access token: %w", err)
   105		}
   106		defer resp.Body.Close()
   107	
   108		body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   109		if err != nil {
   110			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response: %w", err)
   111		}
   112	
   113		var tokenResp WeChatAccessTokenResponse
   114		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &tokenResp); err != nil {
   115			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse response: %w", err)
   116		}
   117	
   118		if tokenResp.ErrCode != 0 {
   119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("WeChat API error: %s (code: %d)", tokenResp.ErrMsg, tokenResp.ErrCode)
   120		}
   121	
   122		return &tokenResp, nil
   123	}
   124	
   125	// GetUserInfo retrieves user information using access token
   126	func (s *Service) GetUserInfo(accessToken, openID string) (*WeChatUserInfo, error) {
   127		params := url.Values{}

   135		if err != nil {
   136			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get user info: %w", err)
   137		}
   138		defer resp.Body.Close()

   157	// RefreshAccessToken refreshes the access token
   158	func (s *Service) RefreshAccessToken(refreshToken string) (*WeChatAccessTokenResponse, error) {
   159		config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
   160		if err != nil {
   161			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no active WeChat configuration: %w", err)
   162		}

   164		params := url.Values{}

   166		params.Set("grant_type", "refresh_token")
   167		params.Set("refresh_token", refreshToken)
   168	
   169		tokenURL := "https://api.weixin.qq.com/sns/oauth2/refresh_token?" + params.Encode()
   170	
   171		resp, err := http.Get(tokenURL)
   172		if err != nil {
   173			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to refresh token: %w", err)
   174		}
   175		defer resp.Body.Close()
   176	
   177		body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   178		if err != nil {
   179			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response: %w", err)
   180		}
   181	
   182		var tokenResp WeChatAccessTokenResponse
   183		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &tokenResp); err != nil {
   184			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse response: %w", err)
   185		}
   186	
   187		if tokenResp.ErrCode != 0 {
   188			return nil, fmt.Errorf("WeChat API error: %s (code: %d)", tokenResp.ErrMsg, tokenResp.ErrCode)
   189		}
   190	
   191		return &tokenResp, nil
   192	}

   194	// VerifySignature verifies WeChat callback signature
   195	func (s *Service) VerifySignature(signature, timestamp, nonce string) (bool, error) {
   196		config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
   197		if err != nil {
   198			return false, fmt.Errorf("no active WeChat configuration: %w", err)
   199		}
   200	
   201		// WeChat uses token for signature verification (different from OAuth flow)
   202		// This is typically used for message callbacks, not OAuth
   203		token := config.AppSecret // Using AppSecret as token for simplicity
   204	
   205		// Sort parameters
   206		params := []string{token, timestamp, nonce}
   207		sort.Strings(params)
   208	
   209		// Concatenate and hash
   210		str := strings.Join(params, "")
   211		hash := sha1.New()
   212		hash.Write([]byte(str))
   213		calculatedSignature := hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
   214	
   215		return calculatedSignature == signature, nil
   216	}

   228	// CreateConfig creates a new WeChat configuration
   229	func (s *Service) CreateConfig(config *model.WeChatConfig) error {
   230		// Validate required fields
   231		if config.AppID == "" || config.AppSecret == "" || config.RedirectURI == "" {
   232			return errors.New("app_id, app_secret, and redirect_uri are required")
   233		}
   234	
   235		// If this is set as active, deactivate others
   236		if config.IsActive {
   237			if err := s.repo.DeactivateAllConfigs(); err != nil {
   238				return fmt.Errorf("failed to deactivate existing configs: %w", err)
   239			}
   240		}
   241	
   242		return s.repo.CreateConfig(config)
   243	}

   250				return fmt.Errorf("failed to set active config: %w", err)

    10	import (

    22	// Handler handles HTTP requests for WeChat Official Account
    23	type Handler struct {
    24		service *Service
    25	}
    26	
    27	// NewHandler creates a new handler
    28	func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
    29		return &Handler{service: service}
    30	}
    31	
    32	// HandleVerification handles WeChat server verification (GET request)
    33	func (h *Handler) HandleVerification(c *gin.Context) {
    34		signature := c.Query("signature")
    35		timestamp := c.Query("timestamp")
    36		nonce := c.Query("nonce")
    37		echostr := c.Query("echostr")
    38	
    39		// Get config to retrieve token
    40		config, err := h.service.GetConfig()
    41		if err != nil {
    42			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to get config: %v\n", err)
    43			c.String(http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get config")
    44			return
    45		}
    46	
    47		// Verify signature
    48		if h.service.VerifySignature(signature, timestamp, nonce, config.Token) {
    49			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Verification successful\n")
    50			c.String(http.StatusOK, echostr)
    51		} else {
    52			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Verification failed\n")
    53			c.String(http.StatusUnauthorized, "Verification failed")
    54		}
    55	}
    56	
    57	// HandleMessage handles WeChat messages (POST request)
    58	func (h *Handler) HandleMessage(c *gin.Context) {
    59		// Read request body
    60		body, err := io.ReadAll(c.Request.Body)
    61		if err != nil {
    62			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to read body: %v\n", err)
    63			c.String(http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to read body")
    64			return
    65		}
    66	
    67		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Received message: %s\n", string(body))
    68	
    69		// Parse XML to determine message type
    70		var baseMsg struct {
    71			MsgType string `xml:"MsgType"`
    72		}
    73		if err := xml.Unmarshal(body, &baseMsg); err != nil {
    74			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to parse XML: %v\n", err)
    75			c.String(http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to parse XML")
    76			return
    77		}
    78	
    79		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Message type: %s\n", baseMsg.MsgType)
    80	
    81		var reply string
    82		var toUser, fromUser string
    83	
    84		switch baseMsg.MsgType {
    85		case "text":
    86			// Handle text message
    87			var msg WeChatTextMessage
    88			if err := xml.Unmarshal(body, &msg); err != nil {
    89				fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to parse text message: %v\n", err)
    90				c.String(http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to parse text message")
    91				return
    92			}
    93	
    94			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Text message - From: %s, Content: %s\n", msg.FromUserName, msg.Content)
    95	
    96			toUser = msg.FromUserName
    97			fromUser = msg.ToUserName
    98	
    99			// Get AI reply (text only)
   100			reply, err = h.service.GetAIReply(msg.Content, "")
   101			if err != nil {
   102				fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to get AI reply: %v\n", err)
   103				reply = "抱歉，我暂时无法处理您的消息，请稍后再试。"
   104			}
   105	
   106		case "image":
   107			// Handle image message
   108			var msg WeChatImageMessage
   109			if err := xml.Unmarshal(body, &msg); err != nil {
   110				fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to parse image message: %v\n", err)
   111				c.String(http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to parse image message")
   112				return
   113			}
   114	
   115			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Image message - From: %s, PicUrl: %s, MediaId: %s\n",
   116				msg.FromUserName, msg.PicUrl, msg.MediaId)
   117	
   118			toUser = msg.FromUserName
   119			fromUser = msg.ToUserName
   120	
   121			// Download image from WeChat
   122			base64Image, err := h.service.DownloadImage(msg.MediaId)
   123			if err != nil {
   124				fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to download image: %v\n", err)
   125				reply = "抱歉，我无法处理这张图片，请稍后再试。"
   126			} else {
   127				// Get AI reply with image
   128				userMessage := "请分析这张图片并回答相关问题。"
   129				reply, err = h.service.GetAIReplyWithImage(userMessage, base64Image, "")
   130				if err != nil {
   131					fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to get AI reply with image: %v\n", err)
   132					reply = "抱歉，我暂时无法处理您的图片，请稍后再试。"
   133				}
   134			}
   135	
   136		default:
   137			// Ignore other message types
   138			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Ignoring message type: %s\n", baseMsg.MsgType)
   139			c.String(http.StatusOK, "success")
   140			return
   141		}
   142	
   143		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] AI reply: %s\n", reply)
   144	
   145		// Build response
   146		response := WeChatTextResponse{
   147			ToUserName:   toUser,
   148			FromUserName: fromUser,
   149			CreateTime:   time.Now().Unix(),
   150			MsgType:      "text",
   151			Content:      reply,
   152		}
   153	
   154		// Convert to XML
   155		xmlData, err := xml.Marshal(response)
   156		if err != nil {
   157			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to marshal XML: %v\n", err)
   158			c.String(http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create response")
   159			return
   160		}
   161	
   162		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Sending response: %s\n", string(xmlData))
   163	
   164		// Return XML response
   165		c.Header("Content-Type", "application/xml")
   166		c.String(http.StatusOK, string(xmlData))
   167	}
   168	
   169	// GetConfig handles GET /api/v1/admin/wechat-official/config
   170	func (h *Handler) GetConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   171		config, err := h.service.GetConfig()
   172		if err != nil {
   173			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get config")
   174			return
   175		}
   176	
   177		// Check if request wants to show sensitive data
   178		showSensitive := c.Query("show_sensitive") == "true"
   179	
   180		if showSensitive {
   181			// Return real values without masking
   182			utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", config)
   183		} else {
   184			// Mask sensitive fields for display
   185			maskedConfig := config.MaskSensitiveData()
   186			utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", maskedConfig)
   187		}
   188	}
   189	
   190	// UpdateConfig handles PUT /api/v1/admin/wechat-official/config
   191	func (h *Handler) UpdateConfig(c *gin.Context) {
   192		var config WeChatOfficialConfig
   193		if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&config); err != nil {
   194			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request")
   195			return
   196		}
   197	
   198		if err := h.service.UpdateConfig(&config); err != nil {
   199			utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to update config")
   200			return
   201		}
   202	
   203		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Config updated successfully", gin.H{"message": "Config updated successfully"})
   204	}

    24		AIModelLevel    string    `json:"ai_model_level" gorm:"column:ai_model_level;type:varchar(20);not null;default:'low'"` // low, medium, high
    25		SystemPrompt    string    `json:"system_prompt" gorm:"column:system_prompt;type:text"`
    26		CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at" gorm:"column:created_at;autoCreateTime"`
    27		UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at" gorm:"column:updated_at;autoUpdateTime"`

    30	// TableName specifies the table name
    31	func (WeChatOfficialConfig) TableName() string {
    32		return "wechat_official_config"
    33	}
    34	
    35	// WeChatTextMessage represents a text message from WeChat
    36	type WeChatTextMessage struct {
    37		ToUserName   string `xml:"ToUserName"`
    38		FromUserName string `xml:"FromUserName"`

    74	// MaskSensitiveData masks sensitive fields in the config for display
    75	func (c *WeChatOfficialConfig) MaskSensitiveData() *WeChatOfficialConfig {
    76		masked := *c
    77		masked.AppSecret = maskString(c.AppSecret)
    78		masked.Token = maskString(c.Token)
    79		masked.EncodingAESKey = maskString(c.EncodingAESKey)
    80		return &masked
    81	}
    82	
    83	// maskString masks a string by showing first 4 and last 4 characters
    84	func maskString(s string) string {
    85		if s == "" {
    86			return ""
    87		}
    88	
    89		length := len(s)
    90		if length <= 8 {
    91			// For short strings, show only asterisks
    92			return "****"
    93		}
    94	
    95		// Show first 4 and last 4 characters, mask the middle
    96		return s[:4] + "****" + s[length-4:]
    97	}

    14	// Repository handles database operations for WeChat Official Account
    15	type Repository struct {
    16		db *gorm.DB
    17	}
    18	
    19	// NewRepository creates a new repository
    20	func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
    21		return &Repository{db: db}
    22	}
    23	
    24	// GetConfig gets the WeChat Official Account configuration
    25	func (r *Repository) GetConfig() (*WeChatOfficialConfig, error) {
    26		var config WeChatOfficialConfig
    27		err := r.db.First(&config).Error
    28		if err != nil {
    29			return nil, err
    30		}
    31		return &config, nil
    32	}
    33	
    34	// UpdateConfig updates the WeChat Official Account configuration
    35	func (r *Repository) UpdateConfig(config *WeChatOfficialConfig) error {
    36		// Check if config exists
    37		var existingConfig WeChatOfficialConfig
    38		err := r.db.First(&existingConfig).Error
    39	
    40		if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
    41			// Create new config
    42			return r.db.Create(config).Error
    43		} else if err != nil {
    44			return err
    45		}
    46	
    47		// Update existing config - use Updates to avoid overwriting timestamps
    48		return r.db.Model(&existingConfig).Updates(map[string]interface{}{
    49			"app_id":             config.AppID,
    50			"app_secret":         config.AppSecret,
    51			"token":              config.Token,
    52			"encoding_aes_key":   config.EncodingAESKey,
    53			"encryption_mode":    config.EncryptionMode,
    54			"auto_reply_enabled": config.AutoReplyEnabled,
    55			"ai_model_level":     config.AIModelLevel,
    56			"system_prompt":      config.SystemPrompt,
    57		}).Error
    58	}

    31		repo               *Repository
    32		aiService          *ai.Service

    56	// VerifySignature verifies the WeChat signature for server validation
    57	func (s *Service) VerifySignature(signature, timestamp, nonce, token string) bool {
    58		// Sort the parameters
    59		params := []string{token, timestamp, nonce}
    60		sort.Strings(params)
    61	
    62		// Join and hash
    63		str := strings.Join(params, "")
    64		hash := sha1.New()
    65		hash.Write([]byte(str))
    66		hashStr := hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
    67	
    68		return hashStr == signature
    69	}
    70	
    71	// GetAccessToken gets WeChat access token (cached)
    72	func (s *Service) GetAccessToken() (string, error) {
    73		s.accessTokenMutex.RLock()
    74		if s.accessToken != "" && time.Now().Before(s.accessTokenExpires) {
    75			token := s.accessToken
    76			s.accessTokenMutex.RUnlock()
    77			return token, nil
    78		}
    79		s.accessTokenMutex.RUnlock()
    80	
    81		// Need to fetch new token
    82		s.accessTokenMutex.Lock()
    83		defer s.accessTokenMutex.Unlock()
    84	
    85		// Double check after acquiring write lock
    86		if s.accessToken != "" && time.Now().Before(s.accessTokenExpires) {
    87			return s.accessToken, nil
    88		}
    89	
    90		// Get config
    91		config, err := s.GetConfig()
    92		if err != nil {
    93			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get config: %w", err)
    94		}
    95	
    96		// Fetch access token from WeChat API
    97		url := fmt.Sprintf("https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/token?grant_type=client_credential&appid=%s&secret=%s",
    98			config.AppID, config.AppSecret)
    99	
   100		resp, err := http.Get(url)
   101		if err != nil {
   102			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to fetch access token: %w", err)
   103		}
   104		defer resp.Body.Close()
   105	
   106		var tokenResp WeChatAccessTokenResponse
   107		if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&tokenResp); err != nil {
   108			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to decode access token response: %w", err)
   109		}
   110	
   111		if tokenResp.ErrCode != 0 {
   112			return "", fmt.Errorf("WeChat API error %d: %s", tokenResp.ErrCode, tokenResp.ErrMsg)
   113		}
   114	
   115		// Cache token (expire 5 minutes earlier than actual expiration)
   116		s.accessToken = tokenResp.AccessToken
   117		s.accessTokenExpires = time.Now().Add(time.Duration(tokenResp.ExpiresIn-300) * time.Second)
   118	
   119		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Access token refreshed, expires at: %s\n", s.accessTokenExpires)
   120	
   121		return s.accessToken, nil
   122	}
   123	
   124	// DownloadImage downloads image from WeChat server and returns base64 encoded data
   125	func (s *Service) DownloadImage(mediaID string) (string, error) {
   126		// Get access token
   127		accessToken, err := s.GetAccessToken()
   128		if err != nil {
   129			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get access token: %w", err)
   130		}
   131	
   132		// Download image from WeChat
   133		url := fmt.Sprintf("https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/media/get?access_token=%s&media_id=%s",
   134			accessToken, mediaID)
   135	
   136		resp, err := http.Get(url)
   137		if err != nil {
   138			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to download image: %w", err)
   139		}
   140		defer resp.Body.Close()
   141	
   142		// Read image data
   143		imageData, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   144		if err != nil {
   145			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read image data: %w", err)
   146		}
   147	
   148		// Check if response is error (JSON)
   149		if resp.Header.Get("Content-Type") == "application/json" || resp.Header.Get("Content-Type") == "text/plain" {
   150			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to download image, response: %s", string(imageData))
   151		}
   152	
   153		// Encode to base64
   154		base64Image := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(imageData)
   155	
   156		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Downloaded image, size: %d bytes, base64 length: %d\n", len(imageData), len(base64Image))
   157	
   158		return base64Image, nil
   159	}

   161	// GetAIReply gets AI reply for user message (text only)
   162	func (s *Service) GetAIReply(userMessage string, aiModelLevel string) (string, error) {
   163		return s.GetAIReplyWithImage(userMessage, "", aiModelLevel)
   164	}
   165	
   166	// GetAIReplyWithImage gets AI reply for user message with optional image
   167	func (s *Service) GetAIReplyWithImage(userMessage string, base64Image string, aiModelLevel string) (string, error) {
   168		// Get config to check if auto-reply is enabled
   169		config, err := s.GetConfig()
   170		if err != nil {
   171			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get config: %w", err)
   172		}
   173	
   174		if !config.AutoReplyEnabled {
   175			return "", fmt.Errorf("auto-reply is disabled")
   176		}
   177	
   178		// Use configured AI model level or default to low
   179		modelLevel := aiModelLevel
   180		if modelLevel == "" {
   181			modelLevel = config.AIModelLevel
   182		}
   183	
   184		// Convert string to thirdparty.ModelLevel
   185		var level thirdparty.ModelLevel
   186		switch modelLevel {
   187		case "low":
   188			level = thirdparty.ModelLevelLow
   189		case "medium", "mid":
   190			level = thirdparty.ModelLevelMid
   191		case "high":
   192			level = thirdparty.ModelLevelHigh
   193		default:
   194			level = thirdparty.ModelLevelLow
   195		}
   196	
   197		// Prepare system prompt
   198		systemPrompt := config.SystemPrompt
   199		if systemPrompt == "" {
   200			// Default system prompt if not configured
   201			systemPrompt = "你是一个友好的助手，请简洁准确地回答用户的问题。回复不要超过200字。"
   202		}
   203	
   204		// Prepare messages for AI
   205		messages := []ai.ChatMessage{
   206			{
   207				Role:    "system",
   208				Content: systemPrompt,
   209			},
   210		}
   211	
   212		// Build user message content
   213		var userContent ai.MessageContent
   214		if base64Image != "" {
   215			// Multimodal message with image
   216			contentParts := []interface{}{
   217				ai.TextContent{
   218					Type: "text",
   219					Text: userMessage,
   220				},
   221			}
   222	
   223			// Add image if provided
   224			imageContent := ai.ImageURLContent{
   225				Type: "image_url",
   226			}
   227			imageContent.ImageURL.URL = "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64Image
   228			imageContent.ImageURL.Detail = "auto"
   229			contentParts = append(contentParts, imageContent)
   230	
   231			userContent = contentParts
   232		} else {
   233			// Text-only message
   234			userContent = userMessage
   235		}
   236	
   237		messages = append(messages, ai.ChatMessage{
   238			Role:    "user",
   239			Content: userContent,
   240		})
   241	
   242		// Call AI service (non-streaming)
   243		response, err := s.aiService.ChatCompletionWithTools(messages, nil, "", level)
   244		if err != nil {
   245			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get AI response: %w", err)
   246		}
   247	
   248		// Extract reply from response
   249		if len(response.Choices) == 0 {
   250			return "", fmt.Errorf("no response from AI")
   251		}
   252	
   253		// Response content is always string in non-streaming mode
   254		reply := response.Choices[0].Message.Content
   255		return reply, nil
   256	}

    31	const Pricing = lazy(() => import('./pages/Pricing'));
    32	const Settings = lazy(() => import('./pages/Settings'));
    33	const WeChatCallback = lazy(() => import('./pages/WeChatCallback'));
    34	const GithubCallback = lazy(() => import('./pages/GithubCallback'));
    35	const OrderConfirmation = lazy(() => import('./pages/OrderConfirmation'));
    36	const FeedbackPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/FeedbackPage'));
    37	const AboutPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/AboutPage'));

    40	function App() {
    41	  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);
    42	
    43	  useEffect(() => {
    44	    // Listen for auth:required event from API interceptor
    45	    const handleAuthRequired = () => {
    46	      setShowAuthModal(true);
    47	    };
    48	
    49	    window.addEventListener('auth:required', handleAuthRequired);
    50	    return () => {
    51	      window.removeEventListener('auth:required', handleAuthRequired);
    52	    };
    53	  }, []);
    54	
    55	  return (
    56	    <HelmetProvider>
    57	      <ThemeProvider>
    58	      <ToastProvider>
    59	        <AuthProvider>
    60	          <SubscriptionProvider>
    61	            <SidebarProvider>
    62	              <Router>
    63	                <Suspense fallback={null}>
    64	                  <Routes>
    65	                    {/* 使用 MainLayout 包裹需要侧边栏的路由 */}
    66	                    <Route element={<MainLayout />}>
    67	                      {/* 公开路由 - 无需登录即可访问 */}
    68	                      <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
    69	                      <Route path="/search-results" element={<SearchResultsPage />} />
    70	                      
    71	                      {/* 智能分析页面 - 允许未登录访问 */}
    72	                      <Route path="/advanced-search" element={<AdvancedSearchPage />} />
    73	                      {/* 文献助手页面 - 允许未登录访问 */}
    74	                      <Route path="/assistant" element={<AssistantPage />} />
    75	                      {/* AI对话页面 - 允许未登录访问 */}
    76	                      <Route path="/chat" element={<ChatPage />} />
    77	                      {/* AI审稿人页面 - 允许未登录访问 */}
    78	                      <Route path="/peer-review" element={<PeerReviewPage />} />
    79	                    </Route>
    80	
    81	                    {/* 不需要侧边栏的路由 */}
    82	                    <Route path="/search" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
    83	                    <Route path="/pricing" element={<Pricing />} />
    84	                    <Route path="/settings" element={
    85	                      <ProtectedRoute>
    86	                        <Settings />
    87	                      </ProtectedRoute>
    88	                    } />
    89	                    <Route path="/paper/:paperId" element={<PaperDetailPage />} />
    90	                    <Route path="/order-confirmation" element={
    91	                      <ProtectedRoute>
    92	                        <OrderConfirmation />
    93	                      </ProtectedRoute>
    94	                    } />
    95	                    
    96	                    {/* WeChat callback - PUBLIC route (must be accessible without login for OAuth flow) */}
    97	                    <Route path="/wechat/callback" element={<WeChatCallback />} />
    98	
    99	                    {/* GitHub callback - PUBLIC route (must be accessible without login for OAuth flow) */}
   100	                    <Route path="/github/callback" element={<GithubCallback />} />
   101	
   102	                    {/* 反馈和关于我们页面 - 公开访问 */}
   103	                    <Route path="/feedback" element={<FeedbackPage />} />
   104	                    <Route path="/about" element={<AboutPage />} />
   105	
   106	                    {/* 404 redirect to home */}
   107	                    <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
   108	                  </Routes>
   109	
   110	                  {/* Global auth modal for session expiry - 条件渲染避免不必要的组件加载 */}
   111	                  {showAuthModal && (
   112	                    <AuthModal
   113	                      isOpen={showAuthModal}
   114	                      onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
   115	                      onLoginSuccess={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
   116	                    />
   117	                  )}
   118	                </Suspense>
   119	              </Router>
   120	            </SidebarProvider>
   121	          </SubscriptionProvider>
   122	        </AuthProvider>
   123	      </ToastProvider>
   124	    </ThemeProvider>
   125	    </HelmetProvider>
   126	  );
   127	}
   128	
   129	export default App;

    91	      if (showUserMenu &&
    92	          userMenuRef.current &&
    93	          !userMenuRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
    94	        setShowUserMenu(false);
    95	      }

    97	      // 关闭历史项菜单
    98	      if (openHistoryMenuId !== null &&

   102	        setOpenHistoryMenuId(null);
   103	      }
   104	    };
   105	
   106	    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
   107	    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
   108	  }, [showUserMenu, openHistoryMenuId]);
   109	
   110	  // 获取用户头像首字母
   111	  const getUserInitial = () => {
   112	    if (!user) return '?';
   113	    // 优先使用用户名，如果没有则使用邮箱
   114	    const displayName = user.username || user.email;
   115	    if (!displayName) return '?';
   116	    return displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
   117	  };
   118	
   119	  // 获取用户显示标识（邮箱 > 手机号 > 微信昵称 > GitHub用户名）
   120	  const getUserIdentifier = () => {
   121	    if (!user) return '未登录';
   122	    
   123	    // 优先级1: 邮箱
   124	    if (user.email) {
   125	      return user.email;
   126	    }
   127	    
   128	    // 优先级2: 手机号
   129	    if (user.phone) {
   130	      return user.phone;
   131	    }
   132	    
   133	    // 优先级3: 微信昵称
   134	    if (user.wechat_name) {
   135	      return `微信: ${user.wechat_name}`;
   136	    }
   137	    
   138	    // 优先级4: GitHub用户名
   139	    if (user.github_login) {
   140	      return `GitHub: ${user.github_login}`;
   141	    }
   142	    
   143	    // 兜底：用户名
   144	    if (user.username) {
   145	      return user.username;
   146	    }
   147	    
   148	    return '用户';
   149	  };

   221	  const handleMouseLeave = () => {

   223	    hoverTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {

   239	  // 格式化时间
   240	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
   241	    const date = new Date(dateString);
   242	    const now = new Date();
   243	    const diffMs = now - date;
   244	    const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
   245	    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
   246	    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);
   247	
   248	    if (diffMins < 1) return '刚刚';
   249	    if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}分钟前`;
   250	    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}小时前`;
   251	    if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}天前`;
   252	    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');

   271	    setOpenHistoryMenuId(null);
   272	
   273	    switch (action) {

   275	        // 进入重命名模式

   308	    setEditingValue('');

   315	    setEditingValue('');
   316	    setOriginalValue('');
   317	  };

   325	    setDeleteTargetId(null);

   347	  const handleHistoryItemClick = (itemId) => {

   455	            ref={(el) => (navItemRefs.current['assistant'] = el)}

   467	            </svg>
   468	            <span>文献助手</span>

   470	        </div>
   471	      </div>
   472	
   473	      {/* 侧边栏内容区域 - 历史记录部分 */}
   474	      {(!collapsed || isMobile) && (

   534	                        </div>
   535

   538	                            ref={(el) => (historyMenuButtonRefs.current[item.id] = el)}

   541	                            title="更多操作"

   544	                              <path d="M15.498 8.50159C16.3254 8.50159 16.9959 9.17228 16.9961 9.99963C16.9961 10.8271 16.3256 11.4987 15.498 11.4987C14.6705 11.4987 14 10.8271 14 9.99963C14.0002 9.17228 14.6706 8.50159 15.498 8.50159Z"></path>
   545	                              <path d="M4.49805 8.50159C5.32544 8.50159 5.99689 9.17228 5.99707 9.99963C5.99707 10.8271 5.32555 11.4987 4.49805 11.4987C3.67069 11.4985 3 10.827 3 9.99963C3.00018 9.17239 3.6708 8.50176 4.49805 8.50159Z"></path>

   786	              <path d="M17 3a2.828 2.828 0 1 1 4 4L7.5 20.5 2 22l1.5-5.5L17 3z"/>
   787	            </svg>
   788	            <span>重命名</span>
   789	          </button>
   790	
   791	          <div className="history-menu-divider"></div>
   792	
   793	          <button
   794	            className="history-menu-item delete-item"
   795	            onClick={() => handleHistoryMenuAction('delete', openHistoryMenuId)}
   796	          >
   797	            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
   798	              <polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/>
   799	              <path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>
   800	            </svg>
   801	            <span>删除</span>
   802	          </button>
   803	        </div>,
   804	        document.body
   805	      )}
   806	
   807	      {/* 自定义删除确认弹窗 */}
   808	      {showDeleteConfirm && ReactDOM.createPortal(
   809	        <div className="delete-confirm-overlay" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>
   810	          <div className="delete-confirm-dialog" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
   811	            <div className="delete-confirm-icon">
   812	              <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   813	                <path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/>
   814	                <line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/>
   815	                <line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/>
   816	              </svg>
   817	            </div>
   818	            <h3 className="delete-confirm-title">
   819	              {historyType === 'conversation' ? '删除对话' : '删除搜索记录'}
   820	            </h3>

   825	            </p>
   826	            <div className="delete-confirm-actions">
   827	              <button className="btn-cancel" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>
   828	                取消
   829	              </button>
   830	              <button className="btn-confirm-delete" onClick={handleConfirmDelete}>
   831	                删除
   832	              </button>
   833	            </div>
   834	          </div>
   835	        </div>,
   836	        document.body
   837	      )}
   838	    </div>
   839	    </>
   840	  );
   841	};
   842	
   843	export default AppSidebar;

    18	
    19	const AuthModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, onLoginSuccess }) => {
    20	  const { login } = useAuth();
    21	  const { showError, showSuccess } = useToast();
    22	  const [mode, setMode] = useState('welcome'); // 'welcome', 'login', 'register', 'phone-welcome', 'phone-login', 'phone-register', 'forgot-password-email', 'forgot-password-phone'
    23	  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
    24	  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
    25	  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
    26	  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
    27	  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
    28	  const [turnstileToken, setTurnstileToken] = useState('');
    29	  const [agreedToPolicy, setAgreedToPolicy] = useState(false);
    30	  const [useCodeLogin, setUseCodeLogin] = useState(false); // Toggle between password and code login
    31	
    32	  // Refs for captcha components
    33	  const emailCaptchaRef = useRef(null);
    34	  const phoneCaptchaRef = useRef(null);
    35	
    36	  // 每次打开弹窗时重置条款同意状态
    37	  useEffect(() => {
    38	    if (isOpen) {
    39	      setAgreedToPolicy(false);
    40	    }
    41	  }, [isOpen]);
    42	  const [showPolicy, setShowPolicy] = useState(false);
    43	  const [policyType, setPolicyType] = useState('privacy'); // 'privacy' or 'terms'
    44	  const [privacyContent, setPrivacyContent] = useState('');
    45	  const [termsContent, setTermsContent] = useState('');
    46	  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(0);
    47	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    48	  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState('');
    49	  const [requireEmailVerification, setRequireEmailVerification] = useState(true);
    50	  const [enableTurnstile, setEnableTurnstile] = useState(false);
    51	  const [enableGithubOAuth, setEnableGithubOAuth] = useState(false);
    52	  const [invitationCode, setInvitationCode] = useState('');
    53	  const [inviterInfo, setInviterInfo] = useState(null);
    54	  const [isComposing, setIsComposing] = useState(false); // 跟踪输入法状态
    55	
    56	  // 读取URL中的邀请码参数
    57	  useEffect(() => {
    58	    if (isOpen) {
    59	      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    60	      const inviteParam = urlParams.get('invite');
    61	      if (inviteParam) {
    62	        setInvitationCode(inviteParam);
    63	        // 可以在这里调用API验证邀请码并获取邀请人信息
    64	        // 暂时不验证,直接使用
    65	      }
    66	    }
    67	  }, [isOpen]);
    68	
    69	  // 获取隐私协议、用户协议和系统配置
    70	  useEffect(() => {
    71	    if (isOpen) {
    72	      // 获取隐私协议
    73	      fetch('/api/v1/config/privacy-policy')
    74	        .then(res => res.json())
    75	        .then(data => {
    76	          if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {
    77	            setPrivacyContent(data.data.content);
    78	          }
    79	        })
    80	        .catch(() => {
    81	          setPrivacyContent('隐私协议加载失败');
    82	        });
    83	
    84	      // 获取用户协议
    85	      fetch('/api/v1/config/terms-of-service')
    86	        .then(res => res.json())
    87	        .then(data => {
    88	          if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {
    89	            setTermsContent(data.data.content);
    90	          }
    91	        })
    92	        .catch(() => {
    93	          setTermsContent('用户协议加载失败');
    94	        });
    95	
    96	      // 获取系统配置
    97	      fetch('/api/v1/config/system')
    98	        .then(res => res.json())
    99	        .then(data => {
   100	          if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {
   101	            setRequireEmailVerification(data.data.require_email_verification ?? true);
   102	            const turnstileEnabled = data.data.enable_turnstile ?? false;
   103	            setEnableTurnstile(turnstileEnabled);
   104	            // GitHub login is available if client_id is configured
   105	            setEnableGithubOAuth(!!(data.data.github_client_id && data.data.github_client_id.trim() !== ''));
   106	            // If Turnstile is disabled, set a placeholder token to allow form submission
   107	            if (!turnstileEnabled) {
   108	              setTurnstileToken('disabled');
   109	            }
   110	          }
   111	        })
   112	        .catch(() => {
   113	          setRequireEmailVerification(true);
   114	          setEnableTurnstile(false);
   115	          setEnableGithubOAuth(false);
   116	          // On error, assume Turnstile is disabled and set placeholder token
   117	          setTurnstileToken('disabled');
   118	        });
   119	    }
   120	  }, [isOpen]);
   121	
   122	  // 倒计时
   123	  useEffect(() => {
   124	    if (countdown > 0) {
   125	      const timer = setTimeout(() => setCountdown(countdown - 1), 1000);
   126	      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
   127	    }
   128	  }, [countdown]);
   129	
   130	  // 验证确认密码
   131	  const validateConfirmPassword = () => {
   132	    if (confirmPassword && password !== confirmPassword) {
   133	      setPasswordError('两次输入的密码不一致');
   134	    } else {
   135	      setPasswordError('');
   136	    }
   137	  };
   138	
   139	  // 重置状态
   140	  const resetState = () => {
   141	    setMode('welcome');
   142	    setEmail('');
   143	    setPhone('');
   144	    setPassword('');
   145	    setConfirmPassword('');
   146	    setCode('');
   147	    setTurnstileToken('');
   148	    setAgreedToPolicy(false);
   149	    setPasswordError('');
   150	    setInvitationCode('');
   151	    setInviterInfo(null);
   152	    setUseCodeLogin(false);
   153	  };
   154	
   155	  // 清空输入框内容（切换登录方式时使用）
   156	  const clearInputs = () => {
   157	    setPassword('');
   158	    setConfirmPassword('');
   159	    setCode('');
   160	    setPasswordError('');
   161	    setCountdown(0);
   162	    if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
   163	      emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
   164	    }
   165	    if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
   166	      phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
   167	    }
   168	  };
   169	
   170	  // 关闭弹窗
   171	  const handleClose = () => {
   172	    resetState();
   173	    onClose();
   174	  };
   175	
   176	  // 检查邮箱并进入下一步
   177	  const handleEmailContinue = async () => {
   178	    if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
   179	      showError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
   180	      return;
   181	    }
   182	
   183	    setLoading(true);
   184	    
   185	
   186	    try {
   187	      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/check-email', {
   188	        method: 'POST',
   189	        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   190	        body: JSON.stringify({ email }),
   191	      });
   192	
   193	      const data = await response.json();
   194	
   195	      if (data.code === 0) {
   196	        // 根据邮箱是否存在决定是登录还是注册
   197	        setMode(data.data.exists ? 'login' : 'register');
   198	      } else {
   199	        showError(data.message || '检查邮箱失败');
   200	      }
   201	    } catch (err) {
   202	      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
   203	    } finally {
   204	      setLoading(false);
   205	    }
   206	  };
   207	
   208	  // 发送验证码
   209	  const handleSendCode = async (purpose = 'register') => {
   210	    if (countdown > 0) return;
   211	
   212	    setLoading(true);
   213	
   214	
   215	    try {
   216	      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/send-code', {
   217	        method: 'POST',
   218	        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   219	        body: JSON.stringify({ email, purpose }),
   220	      });
   221	
   222	      const data = await response.json();
   223	
   224	      if (data.code === 0) {
   225	        setCountdown(60);
   226	        showSuccess('验证码已发送');
   227	      } else {
   228	        showError(data.message || '发送验证码失败');
   229	      }
   230	    } catch (err) {
   231	      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
   232	    } finally {
   233	      setLoading(false);
   234	    }
   235	  };
   236	
   237	  // 登录
   238	  const handleLogin = async () => {
   239	    if (!password) {
   240	      showError('请输入密码');
   241	      return;
   242	    }
   243	
   244	    // Only check Turnstile token if Turnstile is enabled
   245	    if (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) {
   246	      showError('请完成人机验证');
   247	      return;
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    if (!agreedToPolicy) {
   251	      showError('请阅读并同意使用条款和隐私政策');
   252	      return;
   253	    }
   254	
   255	    setLoading(true);
   256	
   257	
   258	    try {
   259	      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/login', {
   260	        method: 'POST',
   261	        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   262	        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, turnstile_token: turnstileToken }),
   263	      });
   264	
   265	      const data = await response.json();
   266	
   267	      if (data.code === 0) {
   268	        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
   269	        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
   270	        handleClose();
   271	      } else {
   272	        showError(data.message || '登录失败');
   273	        // Reset captcha state to allow re-verification
   274	        setTurnstileToken('');
   275	        if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
   276	          emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
   277	        }
   278	      }
   279	    } catch (err) {
   280	      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
   281	      // Reset captcha state to allow re-verification
   282	      setTurnstileToken('');
   283	      if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
   284	        emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
   285	      }
   286	    } finally {
   287	      setLoading(false);
   288	    }
   289	  };
   290	
   291	  // 注册
   292	  const handleRegister = async () => {
   293	    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
   294	      showError('密码长度至少8位');
   295	      return;
   296	    }
   297	
   298	    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
   299	      showError('两次输入的密码不一致');
   300	      return;
   301	    }
   302	
   303	    if (requireEmailVerification && !code) {
   304	      showError('请输入验证码');
   305	      return;
   306	    }
   307	
   308	    // Only check Turnstile token if Turnstile is enabled
   309	    if (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) {
   310	      showError('请完成人机验证');
   311	      return;
   312	    }
   313	
   314	    if (!agreedToPolicy) {
   315	      showError('请阅读并同意使用条款和隐私政策');
   316	      return;
   317	    }
   318	
   319	    setLoading(true);
   320	
   321	
   322	    try {
   323	      const requestBody = {
   324	        email,
   325	        password,
   326	        code,
   327	        turnstile_token: turnstileToken
   328	      };
   329	
   330	      // 如果有邀请码，添加到请求中
   331	      if (invitationCode) {
   332	        requestBody.invitation_code = invitationCode;
   333	      }
   334	
   335	      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/register', {
   336	        method: 'POST',
   337	        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   338	        body: JSON.stringify(requestBody),
   339	      });
   340	
   341	      const data = await response.json();
   342	
   343	      if (data.code === 0) {
   344	        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
   345	        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
   346	        handleClose();
   347	      } else {
   348	        showError(data.message || '注册失败');
   349	        // Reset verification state but keep password and countdown
   350	        setCode('');
   351	        setTurnstileToken('');
   352	        // Reset turnstile captcha to allow re-verification
   353	        if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
   354	          emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
   355	        }
   356	      }
   357	    } catch (err) {
   358	      showError('网络错误,请稍后重试');
   359	      // Reset verification state but keep password and countdown
   360	      setCode('');
   361	      setTurnstileToken('');
   362	      // Reset turnstile captcha to allow re-verification
   363	      if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
   364	        emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
   365	      }
   366	    } finally {
   367	      setLoading(false);
   368	    }
   369	  };

   400	    }

   421

   425	    } catch (err) {
   426	      showError('网络错误,请稍后重试');

   428	      setLoading(false);
   429	    }
   430	  };

   735	      if (data.code === 0) {
   736	        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
   737	        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
   738	        handleClose();
   739	      } else {
   740	        showError(data.message || '登录失败');
   741	        setCode('');
   742	        setTurnstileToken('');
   743	        if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
   744	          phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
   745	        }
   746	      }
   747	    } catch (err) {
   748	      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
   749	      setCode('');
   750	      setTurnstileToken('');
   751	      if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
   752	        phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
   753	      }
   754	    } finally {
   755	      setLoading(false);
   756	    }
   757	  };
   758	
   759	  // 微信登录
   760	  const handleWeChatLogin = async () => {
   761	    try {
   762	      // CRITICAL: Clean up any bind-related data from previous operations
   763	      // This prevents state mismatch when different users attempt login
   764	      // after a previous bind operation left data in localStorage
   765	      localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_state');
   766	      localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_mode');
   767	
   768	      // Get WeChat login URL from backend (backend will generate state)
   769	      const response = await userAPI.getWeChatLoginURL();
   770	
   771	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   772	        const loginURL = response.data.data.login_url;
   773	        const state = response.data.data.state;
   774	
   775	        // Save state for verification after callback
   776	        localStorage.setItem('wechat_oauth_state', state);
   777	
   778	        // Save current URL for redirect after login (whitelist check will be done in callback)
   779	        const currentPath = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
   780	        if (currentPath !== '/') {
   781	          localStorage.setItem('wechat_return_url', currentPath);
   782	        }
   783	
   784	        // 保存邀请码（如果有）- 用于OAuth回调后处理新用户注册
   785	        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
   786	        const inviteParam = urlParams.get('invite');
   787	        if (inviteParam) {
   788	          localStorage.setItem('oauth_invitation_code', inviteParam);
   789	        } else {
   790	          localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code');
   791	        }
   792	
   793	        // Redirect to WeChat OAuth page
   794	        window.location.href = loginURL;
   795	      } else {
   796	        showError(response.data.message || '获取微信登录链接失败');
   797	      }
   798	    } catch (err) {
   799	      console.error('WeChat login error:', err);
   800	      showError('微信登录失败,请稍后重试');
   801	    }
   802	  };
   803	
   804	  // GitHub 登录
   805	  const handleGithubLogin = async () => {
   806	    try {
   807	      // Get GitHub login URL from backend
   808	      const response = await userAPI.getGithubLoginURL();
   809	
   810	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   811	        const loginURL = response.data.data.url;
   812	        const state = response.data.data.state;
   813	
   814	        // Save state for verification after callback
   815	        localStorage.setItem('github_oauth_state', state);

   817	        // Save current URL for redirect after login
   818	        const currentPath = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
   819	        if (currentPath !== '/') {
   820	          localStorage.setItem('github_return_url', currentPath);
   821	        }
   822	
   823	        // 保存邀请码（如果有）- 用于OAuth回调后处理新用户注册
   824	        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
   825	        const inviteParam = urlParams.get('invite');
   826	        if (inviteParam) {
   827	          localStorage.setItem('oauth_invitation_code', inviteParam);
   828	        } else {
   829	          localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code');
   830	        }
   831	
   832	        // Redirect to GitHub OAuth page
   833	        window.location.href = loginURL;
   834	      } else {
   835	        showError(response.data.message || '获取 GitHub 登录链接失败');
   836	      }
   837	    } catch (err) {
   838	      console.error('GitHub login error:', err);

   840	    }

   849	          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   850	            <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
   851	            <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
   852	          </svg>
   853	        </button>
   854	        <div className="auth-modal-body">
   855	        {/* 欢迎页面 */}
   856	        {mode === 'welcome' && (

   861	            </div>
   862	
   863	            <div className="auth-form">
