   867	                    <path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 0 1-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 0 1 4.11 2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.72 12.84 12.84 0 0 0 .7 2.81 2 2 0 0 1-.45 2.11L8.09 9.91a16 16 0 0 0 6 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 0 1 2.11-.45 12.84 12.84 0 0 0 2.81.7A2 2 0 0 1 22 16.92z"/>
   868	                  </svg>

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState } from 'react';
    11	import './CiteModal.css';
    12	
    13	const STORAGE_KEY = 'scholar_default_citation_format';
    14	
    15	const CiteModal = ({ paper, onClose }) => {
    16	  // 从 localStorage 读取默认格式
    17	  const [citationFormat, setCitationFormat] = useState(() => {
    18	    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    19	    return saved || 'bibtex';
    20	  });
    21	  const [defaultFormat, setDefaultFormat] = useState(() => {
    22	    return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || 'bibtex';
    23	  });
    24	  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
    25	
    26	  if (!paper) return null;
    27	
    28	  // 切换格式
    29	  const handleFormatChange = (format) => {
    30	    setCitationFormat(format);
    31	  };
    32	
    33	  // 设置为默认格式
    34	  const setAsDefault = (format) => {
    35	    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, format);
    36	    setDefaultFormat(format); // 立即更新状态
    37	  };
    38	
    39	  // 生成引用格式
    40	  const generateCitation = (format) => {
    41	    const authors = paper.authors || [];
    42	    const title = paper.title || 'Untitled';
    43	    const year = paper.year || 'n.d.';
    44	    const venue = paper.venue || '';
    45	    const doi = paper.externalIds?.DOI || '';
    46	    const corpusId = paper.paperId || '';
    47	
    48	    // 获取期刊信息
    49	    const journal = paper.journal || {};
    50	    const volume = journal.volume || '';
    51	    const pages = journal.pages || '';
    52	
    53	    switch (format) {
    54	      case 'bibtex':
    55	        const firstAuthor = authors[0]?.name || 'Unknown';
    56	        const lastName = firstAuthor.split(' ').pop();
    57	
    58	        const stopWords = ['of', 'the', 'in', 'for', 'and', 'a', 'an', 'to', 'on'];
    59	        const titleWords = title.split(' ').filter(w =>
    60	          w.length > 2 && !stopWords.includes(w.toLowerCase())
    61	        );
    62	
    63	        const firstTitleWord = titleWords[0]?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '') || 'Paper';
    64	        const secondTitleWord = titleWords[1]?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '') || '';
    65	        const secondWordInitials = secondTitleWord.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    66	
    67	        const bibtexKey = `${lastName}${year}${firstTitleWord}${secondWordInitials}`;
    68	
    69	        let bibtex = `@article{${bibtexKey},\n  title={${title}},\n  author={${authors.map(a => a.name).join(' and ')}}`;
    70	        if (venue) bibtex += `,\n  journal={${venue}}`;
    71	        if (year) bibtex += `,\n  year={${year}}`;
    72	        if (volume) bibtex += `,\n  volume={${volume}}`;
    73	        if (pages) bibtex += `,\n  pages={${pages}}`;
    74	        bibtex += `,\n  url={https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:${corpusId}}\n}`;
    75	        return bibtex;
    76	
    77	      case 'mla':
    78	        // MLA: 第一作者 姓, 名，超过3人用 et al.
    79	        // MLA格式：期刊名斜体
    80	        let mlaAuthorStr = '';
    81	        if (authors.length > 0) {
    82	          const firstAuthorParts = authors[0].name.split(' ');
    83	          const firstAuthorFormatted = firstAuthorParts.length > 1
    84	            ? `${firstAuthorParts[firstAuthorParts.length - 1]}, ${firstAuthorParts.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}`
    85	            : authors[0].name;
    86	          
    87	          if (authors.length === 1) {
    88	            mlaAuthorStr = firstAuthorFormatted;
    89	          } else if (authors.length === 2) {
    90	            mlaAuthorStr = `${firstAuthorFormatted}, and ${authors[1].name}`;
    91	          } else {
    92	            // 3人及以上使用 et al.
    93	            mlaAuthorStr = `${firstAuthorFormatted} et al.`;
    94	          }
    95	        } else {
    96	          mlaAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
    97	        }
    98	
    99	        let mla = `${mlaAuthorStr}. "${title}."`;
   100	        if (venue) mla += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
   101	        if (volume) mla += ` ${volume}`;
   102	        if (year && pages) mla += ` (${year}): ${pages}`;
   103	        else if (year) mla += ` (${year})`;
   104	        else if (pages) mla += `: ${pages}`;
   105	        mla += '.';
   106	        return mla;
   107	
   108	      case 'apa':
   109	        // APA: 姓, 名首字母., 最后一个作者用 & 连接
   110	        // APA格式：期刊名和卷号斜体
   111	        let apaAuthorStr = '';
   112	        if (authors.length > 0) {
   113	          const apaFormatted = authors.map(a => {
   114	            const nameParts = a.name.split(' ');
   115	            if (nameParts.length > 1) {
   116	              const initials = nameParts.slice(0, -1).map(n => n[0] + '.').join(' ');
   117	              return `${nameParts[nameParts.length - 1]}, ${initials}`;
   118	            }
   119	            return a.name;
   120	          });
   121	          
   122	          if (apaFormatted.length === 1) {
   123	            apaAuthorStr = apaFormatted[0];
   124	          } else if (apaFormatted.length === 2) {
   125	            apaAuthorStr = `${apaFormatted[0]}, & ${apaFormatted[1]}`;
   126	          } else {
   127	            apaAuthorStr = `${apaFormatted.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}, & ${apaFormatted[apaFormatted.length - 1]}`;
   128	          }
   129	        } else {
   130	          apaAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
   131	        }
   132	
   133	        let apa = `${apaAuthorStr} (${year}). ${title}.`;
   134	        if (venue && volume) apa += ` <i>${venue}, ${volume}</i>`;
   135	        else if (venue) apa += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
   136	        else if (volume) apa += ` <i>${volume}</i>`;
   137	        if (pages) apa += `, ${pages}`;
   138	        apa += '.';
   139	        return apa;
   140	
   141	      case 'chicago':
   142	        // Chicago: 所有作者都是 姓, 名 格式，最后用 and 连接
   143	        // Chicago格式：期刊名斜体
   144	        let chicagoAuthorStr = '';
   145	        if (authors.length > 0) {
   146	          const chicagoFormatted = authors.map(a => {
   147	            const nameParts = a.name.split(' ');
   148	            if (nameParts.length > 1) {
   149	              // 所有作者都是：姓, 名
   150	              return `${nameParts[nameParts.length - 1]}, ${nameParts.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}`;
   151	            }
   152	            return a.name;
   153	          });
   154	          if (chicagoFormatted.length === 1) {
   155	            chicagoAuthorStr = chicagoFormatted[0];
   156	          } else if (chicagoFormatted.length === 2) {
   157	            chicagoAuthorStr = `${chicagoFormatted[0]}, and ${chicagoFormatted[1]}`;
   158	          } else {
   159	            chicagoAuthorStr = `${chicagoFormatted.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}, and ${chicagoFormatted[chicagoFormatted.length - 1]}`;
   160	          }
   161	        } else {
   162	          chicagoAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
   163	        }
   164	
   165	        let chicago = `${chicagoAuthorStr}. "${title}."`;
   166	        if (venue) chicago += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
   167	        if (volume) chicago += ` ${volume}`;
   168	        if (year && pages) chicago += ` (${year}): ${pages}`;
   169	        else if (year) chicago += ` (${year})`;
   170	        else if (pages) chicago += `: ${pages}`;
   171	        chicago += '.';
   172	        return chicago;
   173	
   174	      default:
   175	        return '';
   176	    }
   177	  };
   178	
   179	  // 获取纯文本引用（去除HTML标签，用于复制）
   180	  const getPlainCitation = (format) => {
   181	    const citation = generateCitation(format);
   182	    return citation.replace(/<\/?i>/g, '');
   183	  };
   184	
   185	  const copyCitation = () => {
   186	    const citation = getPlainCitation(citationFormat);
   187	    navigator.clipboard.writeText(citation);
   188	    setCopied(true);
   189	    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
   190	  };
   191	
   192	  return (
   193	    <div className="cite-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
   194	      <div className="cite-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
   195	        <div className="cite-modal-header">
   196	          <h2>引用格式</h2>
   197	          <button className="cite-close-btn" onClick={onClose}>
   198	            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   199	              <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
   200	              <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
   201	            </svg>
   202	          </button>
   203	        </div>
   204	
   205	        <div className="cite-format-tabs">
   206	          {['bibtex', 'mla', 'apa', 'chicago'].map((format) => {
   207	            const isActive = citationFormat === format;
   208	            const isDefault = defaultFormat === format;
   209	            const labels = { bibtex: 'BibTeX', mla: 'MLA', apa: 'APA', chicago: 'Chicago' };
   210	            
   211	            return (
   212	              <button
   213	                key={format}
   214	                className={`${isActive ? 'active' : ''} ${isDefault ? 'is-default' : ''}`}
   215	                onClick={() => handleFormatChange(format)}
   216	                onDoubleClick={() => setAsDefault(format)}
   217	              >
   218	                {labels[format]}
   219	                <span className={`default-indicator ${isDefault ? 'visible' : ''}`}>
   220	                  <svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
   221	                    <path d="M12 2l3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01L12 2z"/>
   222	                  </svg>
   223	                </span>
   224	              </button>
   225	            );
   226	          })}
   227	          <span className="format-hint">双击设为默认</span>
   228	        </div>
   229	
   230	        <div className="cite-content">
   231	          <div className="cite-content-wrapper">
   232	            <pre 
   233	              className={citationFormat === 'bibtex' ? 'bibtex' : ''}
   234	              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: generateCitation(citationFormat) }}
   235	            />
   236	            <button className={`cite-inline-copy ${copied ? 'copied' : ''}`} onClick={copyCitation}>
   237	              {copied ? (
   238	                <>
   239	                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   240	                    <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline>
   241	                  </svg>
   242	                </>
   243	              ) : (
   244	                <>
   245	                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   246	                    <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
   247	                    <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path>
   248	                  </svg>
   249	                </>
   250	              )}
   251	            </button>
   252	          </div>
   253	        </div>
   254	      </div>
   255	    </div>
   256	  );
   257	};
   258	
   259	export default CiteModal;
   260

     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0

    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    12	import { conversationAPI } from '../services/api';
    13	import './ConversationSidebar.css';
    14	
    15	const ConversationSidebar = ({ currentConversationId, onSelectConversation, onNewConversation, collapsed, onToggleSidebar, onLogout }) => {
    16	  const { user } = useAuth();
    17	  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState([]);
    18	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    19	
    20	  useEffect(() => {
    21	    loadConversations();
    22	  }, []);
    23	
    24	  // Refresh when currentConversationId changes
    25	  useEffect(() => {
    26	    if (currentConversationId) {
    27	      loadConversations();
    28	    }
    29	  }, [currentConversationId]);
    30	
    31	  const loadConversations = async () => {
    32	    setLoading(true);
    33	    try {
    34	      const response = await conversationAPI.getConversations(1, 50);
    35	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    36	        setConversations(response.data.data.conversations || []);
    37	      }
    38	    } catch (error) {
    39	      console.error('Failed to load conversations:', error);
    40	    } finally {
    41	      setLoading(false);
    42	    }
    43	  };
    44	
    45	  const handleDelete = async (e, conversationId) => {
    46	    e.stopPropagation();
    47	    if (!window.confirm('确定删除这个对话吗？')) return;
    48	
    49	    try {
    50	      await conversationAPI.deleteConversation(conversationId);
    51	      setConversations(conversations.filter(c => c.id !== conversationId));
    52	      if (currentConversationId === conversationId) {
    53	        onNewConversation();
    54	      }
    55	    } catch (error) {
    56	      console.error('Failed to delete conversation:', error);
    57	      alert('删除失败');
    58	    }
    59	  };
    60	
    61	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    62	    const date = new Date(dateString);
    63	    const now = new Date();
    64	    const diffMs = now - date;
    65	    const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
    66	    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
    67	    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);
    68	
    69	    if (diffMins < 1) return '刚刚';
    70	    if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}分钟前`;
    71	    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}小时前`;
    72	    if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}天前`;
    73	    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
    74	  };
    75	
    76	  return (
    77	    <div className={`conversation-sidebar ${collapsed ? 'collapsed' : ''}`}>
    78	      <div className="sidebar-top">
    79	        {collapsed ? (
    80	          <button className="icon-btn logo-btn" onClick={onToggleSidebar} title="展开侧边栏">
    81	            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none">
    82	              <defs>
    83	                <linearGradient id="logo-gradient-sidebar" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
    84	                  <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#667eea" />
    85	                  <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#764ba2" />
    86	                </linearGradient>
    87	              </defs>
    88	              <path d="M24 10L34 20H29V34H19V20H14L24 10Z" fill="url(#logo-gradient-sidebar)"/>
    89	              <rect x="14" y="36" width="20" height="2" rx="1" fill="url(#logo-gradient-sidebar)"/>
    90	            </svg>
    91	          </button>
    92	        ) : (
    93	          <div className="sidebar-header">
    94	            <button className="logo logo-clickable" onClick={onToggleSidebar} title="收起侧边栏">
    95	              <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none">
    96	                <defs>
    97	                  <linearGradient id="logo-gradient-full" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
    98	                    <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#667eea" />
    99	                    <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#764ba2" />
   100	                  </linearGradient>
   101	                </defs>
   102	                <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="24" fill="url(#logo-gradient-full)" opacity="0.2"/>
   103	                <path d="M24 10L34 20H29V34H19V20H14L24 10Z" fill="url(#logo-gradient-full)"/>
   104	                <rect x="14" y="36" width="20" height="2" rx="1" fill="url(#logo-gradient-full)"/>
   105	              </svg>
   106	              <span className="logo-text">Scholar</span>
   107	            </button>
   108	          </div>
   109	        )}
   110	
   111	        <button
   112	          className={`btn-new-chat ${collapsed ? 'icon-only' : ''}`}
   113	          onClick={onNewConversation}
   114	          title="新建对话"
   115	        >
   116	          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   117	            <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/>
   118	          </svg>
   119	          {!collapsed && <span>新建对话</span>}
   120	        </button>
   121	      </div>
   122	
   123	      {!collapsed && (
   124	        <>
   125	          <div className="conversation-list">
   126	            {loading ? (
   127	              <div className="loading">加载中...</div>
   128	            ) : conversations.length === 0 ? (
   129	              <div className="empty-state">
   130	                <p>暂无对话</p>
   131	                <p className="hint">点击右上角 + 开始新对话</p>
   132	              </div>
   133	            ) : (
   134	              conversations.map((conversation) => (
   135	                <div
   136	                  key={conversation.id}
   137	                  className={`conversation-item ${currentConversationId === conversation.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
   138	                  onClick={() => onSelectConversation(conversation.id)}
   139	                >
   140	                  <div className="conversation-content">
   141	                    <div className="conversation-title">{conversation.title}</div>
   142	                    <div className="conversation-time">{formatDate(conversation.updated_at)}</div>
   143	                  </div>
   144	                  <button
   145	                    className="btn-delete"
   146	                    onClick={(e) => handleDelete(e, conversation.id)}
   147	                    title="删除对话"
   148	                  >
   149	                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   150	                      <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M9 2a1 1 0 00-.894.553L7.382 4H4a1 1 0 000 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2V6a1 1 0 100-2h-3.382l-.724-1.447A1 1 0 0011 2H9zM7 8a1 1 0 012 0v6a1 1 0 11-2 0V8zm5-1a1 1 0 00-1 1v6a1 1 0 102 0V8a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
   151	                    </svg>
   152	                  </button>
   153	                </div>
   154	              ))
   155	            )}
   156	          </div>
   157	
   158	          <div className="sidebar-footer">
   159	            <div className="user-info">
   160	              <div className="user-avatar-small">
   161	                {user?.avatar_url ? (
   162	                  <img src={user.avatar_url} alt="User" />
   163	                ) : (
   164	                  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   165	                    <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 9a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6zm-7 9a7 7 0 1114 0H3z" clipRule="evenodd" />
   166	                  </svg>
   167	                )}
   168	              </div>
   169	              <div className="user-details">
   170	                <div className="user-email-small">{user?.email || 'User'}</div>
   171	              </div>
   172	              <button className="btn-logout-small" onClick={onLogout} title="退出登录">
   173	                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   174	                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 3a1 1 0 00-1 1v12a1 1 0 102 0V4a1 1 0 00-1-1zm10.293 9.293a1 1 0 001.414 1.414l3-3a1 1 0 000-1.414l-3-3a1 1 0 10-1.414 1.414L14.586 9H7a1 1 0 100 2h7.586l-1.293 1.293z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
   175	                </svg>
   176	              </button>
   177	            </div>
   178	          </div>
   179	        </>
   180	      )}
   181	
   182	      {collapsed && (
   183	        <div className="sidebar-footer-collapsed">
   184	          <button className="icon-btn user-icon-btn" title={user?.email || 'User'}>
   185	            <div className="user-avatar-small">
   186	              {user?.avatar_url ? (
   187	                <img src={user.avatar_url} alt="User" />
   188	              ) : (
   189	                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   190	                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 9a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6zm-7 9a7 7 0 1114 0H3z" clipRule="evenodd" />
   191	                </svg>
   192	              )}
   193	            </div>
   194	          </button>
   195	        </div>
   196	      )}
   197	    </div>
   198	  );
   199	};

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.

     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React from 'react';
    11	import YearHistogram from './YearHistogram';
    12	import './FilterSidebar.css';
    13	
    14	const FilterSidebar = ({ filters, onFiltersChange, resultsTotal }) => {
    15	
    16	  const publicationTypes = [
    17	    { value: 'JournalArticle', label: 'Journal Article' },
    18	    { value: 'Conference', label: 'Conference' },
    19	    { value: 'Book', label: 'Book' },
    20	    { value: 'BookSection', label: 'Book Section' },
    21	    { value: 'Dataset', label: 'Dataset' },
    22	  ];
    23	
    24	  const fieldsOfStudy = [
    25	    'Computer Science',
    26	    'Medicine',
    27	    'Biology',
    28	    'Chemistry',
    29	    'Physics',
    30	    'Mathematics',
    31	    'Engineering',
    32	    'Materials Science',
    33	    'Economics',
    34	    'Psychology',
    35	  ];
    36	
    37	  const handleYearChange = (yearFrom, yearTo) => {
    38	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, yearFrom: String(yearFrom), yearTo: String(yearTo) });
    39	  };
    40	
    41	  const handlePublicationTypeToggle = (type) => {
    42	    const current = filters.publicationTypes || [];
    43	    const updated = current.includes(type)
    44	      ? current.filter(t => t !== type)
    45	      : [...current, type];
    46	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, publicationTypes: updated });
    47	  };
    48	
    49	  const handleFieldOfStudyToggle = (field) => {
    50	    const current = filters.fieldsOfStudy || [];
    51	    const updated = current.includes(field)
    52	      ? current.filter(f => f !== field)
    53	      : [...current, field];
    54	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, fieldsOfStudy: updated });
    55	  };
    56	
    57	  const handleOpenAccessToggle = () => {
    58	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, openAccessPdf: filters.openAccessPdf ? '' : 'true' });
    59	  };
    60	
    61	  const handleVenueChange = (e) => {
    62	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, venue: e.target.value });
    63	  };
    64	
    65	  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    66	    onFiltersChange({
    67	      yearFrom: '',
    68	      yearTo: '',
    69	      publicationTypes: [],
    70	      fieldsOfStudy: [],
    71	      openAccessPdf: '',
    72	      venue: '',
    73	    });
    74	  };
    75	
    76	  const hasActiveFilters = () => {
    77	    return filters.yearFrom || filters.yearTo ||
    78	           (filters.publicationTypes && filters.publicationTypes.length > 0) ||
    79	           (filters.fieldsOfStudy && filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) ||
    80	           filters.openAccessPdf || filters.venue;
    81	  };
    82	
    83	  return (
    84	    <div className="filter-sidebar">
    85	      <div className="filter-sidebar-header">
    86	        <h2>筛选条件</h2>
    87	        {hasActiveFilters() && (
    88	          <button className="clear-all-btn" onClick={handleClearFilters}>
    89	            清除
    90	          </button>
    91	        )}
    92	      </div>
    93	
    94	      <div className="filter-sidebar-content">
    95	        {/* Year Range with Histogram */}
    96	        <div className="filter-section">
    97	          <div className="filter-section-title-wrapper">
    98	            <h3 className="filter-section-title">发表年份</h3>
    99	            {(filters.yearFrom || filters.yearTo) && (
   100	              <span className="year-range-display">
   101	                {filters.yearFrom || '1920'} - {filters.yearTo || '2026'}
   102	              </span>
   103	            )}
   104	          </div>
   105	          <YearHistogram
   106	            yearFrom={filters.yearFrom ? parseInt(filters.yearFrom) : undefined}
   107	            yearTo={filters.yearTo ? parseInt(filters.yearTo) : undefined}
   108	            onChange={handleYearChange}
   109	          />
   110	        </div>
   111	
   112	        {/* Open Access */}
   113	        <div className="filter-section">
   114	          <label className="filter-option open-access">
   115	            <input
   116	              type="checkbox"
   117	              checked={filters.openAccessPdf === 'true'}
   118	              onChange={handleOpenAccessToggle}
   119	            />
   120	            <span>仅开放获取</span>
   121	          </label>
   122	        </div>
   123	
   124	        {/* Fields of Study */}
   125	        <div className="filter-section">
   126	          <h3 className="filter-section-title">研究领域</h3>
   127	          <div className="filter-options scrollable">
   128	            {fieldsOfStudy.map(field => (
   129	              <label key={field} className="filter-option">
   130	                <input
   131	                  type="checkbox"
   132	                  checked={(filters.fieldsOfStudy || []).includes(field)}
   133	                  onChange={() => handleFieldOfStudyToggle(field)}
   134	                />
   135	                <span>{field}</span>
   136	              </label>
   137	            ))}
   138	          </div>
   139	        </div>
   140	      </div>
   141	    </div>
   142	  );
   143	};
   144	
   145	export default FilterSidebar;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

文件: frontend-user/src/components/MainLayout.js

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
    11	import { Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    13	import { useSidebar } from '../contexts/SidebarContext';
    14	import AppSidebar from './AppSidebar';
    15	
    16	// 懒加载 AuthModal
    17	const AuthModal = lazy(() => import('./AuthModal'));
    18	
    19	/**
    20	 * MainLayout - 主布局组件
    21	 * 包含持久化的侧边栏，内容区域通过 Outlet 渲染子路由
    22	 * 这样在路由切换时侧边栏不会重新挂载，避免闪烁
    23	 * 
    24	 * 各个页面通过 useSidebar hook 来控制侧边栏的行为
    25	 */
    26	const MainLayout = () => {
    27	  const { user, isAuthenticated, logout } = useAuth();
    28	  const { sidebarConfig, isMobile } = useSidebar();
    29	  const location = useLocation();
    30	  
    31	  // 侧边栏折叠状态 - 从 localStorage 持久化
    32	  // 未登录用户默认收起侧边栏
    33	  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(() => {
    34	    const saved = localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed');
    35	    // 如果有保存的值，使用保存的值
    36	    if (saved !== null) {
    37	    return saved === 'true';
    38	    }
    39	    // 默认收起（未登录用户）
    40	    return true;
    41	  });
    42	  
    43	  // 当用户登录状态变化时，如果没有保存过偏好，则根据登录状态设置默认值
    44	  useEffect(() => {
    45	    const saved = localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed');
    46	    // 只有在没有保存过偏好时才自动设置
    47	    if (saved === null) {
    48	      // 未登录用户默认收起，已登录用户默认展开
    49	      setSidebarCollapsed(!isAuthenticated);
    50	    }
    51	  }, [isAuthenticated]);
    52	  
    53	  // 登录弹窗状态
    54	  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);
    55	
    56	  // 保存侧边栏状态到 localStorage
    57	  const handleToggleSidebar = () => {
    58	    setSidebarCollapsed(prev => {
    59	      const newState = !prev;
    60	      localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', newState);
    61	      return newState;
    62	    });
    63	  };
    64	
    65	  const handleLogout = () => {
    66	    logout();
    67	  };
    68	  
    69	  const handleShowLogin = () => {
    70	    setShowAuthModal(true);
    71	  };
    72	  
    73	  const handleLoginSuccess = () => {
    74	    setShowAuthModal(false);
    75	  };
    76	
    77	  // 判断是否应该渲染侧边栏组件
    78	  // 登录状态或特定页面时渲染侧边栏
    79	  const shouldRenderSidebar = isAuthenticated || 
    80	    location.pathname === '/search-results' || 
    81	    location.pathname === '/advanced-search' || 
    82	    location.pathname === '/chat' ||
    83	    location.pathname === '/peer-review';
    84	
    85	  return (
    86	    <>
    87	      {/* 持久化的侧边栏 */}
    88	      {shouldRenderSidebar && (
    89	        <AppSidebar
    90	          user={user}
    91	          onLogout={handleLogout}
    92	          collapsed={sidebarCollapsed}
    93	          onToggleCollapse={handleToggleSidebar}
    94	          showHistory={sidebarConfig.showHistory}
    95	          historyType={sidebarConfig.historyType}
    96	          historyItems={sidebarConfig.historyItems}
    97	          currentItemId={sidebarConfig.currentItemId}
    98	          onSelectItem={sidebarConfig.onSelectItem}
    99	          onDeleteItem={sidebarConfig.onDeleteItem}
   100	          onRenameItem={sidebarConfig.onRenameItem}
   101	          onNewItem={sidebarConfig.onNewItem}
   102	          historyLoading={sidebarConfig.historyLoading}
   103	          isAuthenticated={isAuthenticated}
   104	          onShowLogin={handleShowLogin}
   105	        />
   106	      )}
   107	      
   108	      {/* 子路由内容 - 通过 context 传递 sidebarCollapsed 状态 */}
   109	      <Outlet context={{ sidebarCollapsed: shouldRenderSidebar ? sidebarCollapsed : false, isAuthenticated }} />
   110	      
   111	      {/* 登录弹窗 */}
   112	      {showAuthModal && (
   113	        <Suspense fallback={<div>Loading...</div>}>
   114	          <AuthModal 
   115	            isOpen={showAuthModal}
   116	            onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
   117	            onLoginSuccess={handleLoginSuccess}
   118	          />
   119	        </Suspense>
   120	      )}
   121	    </>
   122	  );
   123	};
   124	
   125	export default MainLayout;
   126	
   127	

---------------------------- 文件结束 ----------------------------

文件: frontend-user/src/components/MarkdownRenderer.js

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { lazy, Suspense, memo } from 'react';
    11	
    12	// Lazy load the heavy markdown library
    13	const ReactMarkdown = lazy(() => import('react-markdown'));
    14	
    15	// Dynamic imports for plugins (they will be bundled with ReactMarkdown)
    16	const loadPlugins = async () => {
    17	  const [remarkGfm, rehypeHighlight] = await Promise.all([
    18	    import('remark-gfm'),
    19	    import('rehype-highlight')
    20	  ]);
    21	  return {
    22	    remarkPlugins: [remarkGfm.default],
    23	    rehypePlugins: [rehypeHighlight.default]
    24	  };
    25	};
    26	
    27	// Loading fallback for markdown content
    28	const MarkdownLoading = () => (
    29	  <div style={{ padding: '8px 0' }}>
    30	    <div style={{
    31	      height: '1em',
    32	      background: '#e0e0e0',
    33	      borderRadius: '4px',
    34	      marginBottom: '8px',
    35	      animation: 'pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite'
    36	    }} />
    37	    <div style={{
    38	      height: '1em',
    39	      background: '#e0e0e0',
    40	      borderRadius: '4px',
    41	      width: '80%'
    42	    }} />
    43	  </div>
    44	);
    45	
    46	// Memoized markdown renderer component
    47	const MarkdownRenderer = memo(({ content, components }) => {
    48	  const [plugins, setPlugins] = React.useState(null);
    49	
    50	  React.useEffect(() => {
    51	    loadPlugins().then(setPlugins);
    52	  }, []);
    53	
    54	  if (!plugins) {
    55	    return <MarkdownLoading />;
    56	  }
    57	
    58	  return (
    59	    <Suspense fallback={<MarkdownLoading />}>
    60	      <ReactMarkdown
    61	        remarkPlugins={plugins.remarkPlugins}
    62	        rehypePlugins={plugins.rehypePlugins}
    63	        components={components}
    64	      >
    65	        {content}
    66	      </ReactMarkdown>
    67	    </Suspense>
    68	  );
    69	});
    70	
    71	MarkdownRenderer.displayName = 'MarkdownRenderer';
    72	
    73	export default MarkdownRenderer;

     9	
    10	import React from 'react';
    11	import './MessageModal.css';
    12	
    13	/**
    14	 * 通用消息弹窗组件
    15	 * @param {boolean} isOpen - 是否显示
    16	 * @param {function} onClose - 关闭回调
    17	 * @param {string} type - 类型: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'confirm'
    18	 * @param {string} title - 标题
    19	 * @param {string} message - 消息内容
    20	 * @param {function} onConfirm - 确认回调（仅 confirm 类型）
    21	 * @param {string} confirmText - 确认按钮文字
    22	 * @param {string} cancelText - 取消按钮文字
    23	 */
    24	const MessageModal = ({ 
    25	  isOpen, 
    26	  onClose, 
    27	  type = 'info', 
    28	  title, 
    29	  message, 
    30	  onConfirm,
    31	  confirmText = '确定',
    32	  cancelText = '取消'
    33	}) => {
    34	  if (!isOpen) return null;
    35	
    36	  const handleConfirm = () => {
    37	    if (onConfirm) {
    38	      onConfirm();
    39	    }
    40	    onClose();
    41	  };
    42	
    43	  const getIcon = () => {
    44	    switch (type) {
    45	      case 'success':
    46	        return (
    47	          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    48	            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
    49	            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
    50	          </svg>
    51	        );
    52	      case 'warning':
    53	        return (
    54	          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    55	            <path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/>
    56	            <line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/>
    57	            <line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/>
    58	          </svg>
    59	        );
    60	      case 'error':
    61	        return (
    62	          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    63	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
    64	            <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/>
    65	            <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/>
    66	          </svg>
    67	        );
    68	      case 'confirm':
    69	        return (
    70	          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    71	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
    72	            <path d="M9.09 9a3 3 0 0 1 5.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3"/>
    73	            <line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/>
    74	          </svg>
    75	        );
    76	      default: // info
    77	        return (
    78	          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    79	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
    80	            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12"/>
    81	            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8"/>
    82	          </svg>
    83	        );
    84	    }
    85	  };
    86	
    87	  return (
    88	    <div className="msg-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
    89	      <div className={`msg-modal-container msg-modal-${type}`} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
    90	        <button className="msg-modal-close" onClick={onClose}>
    91	          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    92	            <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
    93	            <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
    94	          </svg>
    95	        </button>
    96	        
    97	        <div className="msg-modal-content">
    98	          <div className={`msg-modal-icon msg-modal-icon-${type}`}>
    99	            {getIcon()}
   100	          </div>
   101	
   102	          {title && <h2 className="msg-modal-title">{title}</h2>}
   103	          {message && <p className="msg-modal-message">{message}</p>}
   104	
   105	          <div className="msg-modal-actions">
   106	            {type === 'confirm' ? (
   107	              <>
   108	                <button className="msg-modal-btn msg-modal-btn-secondary" onClick={onClose}>
   109	                  {cancelText}
   110	                </button>
   111	                <button className="msg-modal-btn msg-modal-btn-primary" onClick={handleConfirm}>
   112	                  {confirmText}
   113	                </button>
   114	              </>
   115	            ) : (
   116	              <button className="msg-modal-btn msg-modal-btn-primary" onClick={onClose}>
   117	                {confirmText}
   118	              </button>
   119	            )}
   120	          </div>
   121	        </div>
   122	      </div>
   123	    </div>
   124	  );
   125	};
   126	
   127	export default MessageModal;
   128

文件: frontend-user/src/components/ModelSelector.js

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
    11	import { subscriptionAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import './ModelSelector.css';
    13	
    14	/**
    15	 * 模型选择器组件
    16	 * @param {string} value - 当前选中的模型级别 ('low', 'mid', 'high')
    17	 * @param {function} onChange - 模型变更回调
    18	 * @param {boolean} disabled - 是否禁用
    19	 * @param {object} userSubscription - 用户订阅信息
    20	 * @param {string} mode - 使用场景 ('advanced-search' 或 'ai-chat')，默认 'advanced-search'
    21	 * @param {boolean} compact - 是否使用紧凑模式
    22	 * @param {boolean} showOnly - 是否只显示，不可交互
    23	 * @param {string} dropdownAlign - 下拉菜单对齐方式 ('left' 或 'right')，默认 'left'
    24	 */
    25	const ModelSelector = ({ value = 'low', onChange, disabled = false, userSubscription: userSubscriptionProp, mode = 'advanced-search', compact = false, showOnly = false, isAuthenticated = true, dropdownAlign = 'left' }) => {
    26	  const [showDropdown, setShowDropdown] = useState(false);
    27	  const [quota, setQuota] = useState(null);
    28	  const [usage, setUsage] = useState(null);
    29	  const [userSubscription, setUserSubscription] = useState(userSubscriptionProp);
    30	  const containerRef = useRef(null);
    31	
    32	  // 获取订阅信息
    33	  useEffect(() => {
    34	    const fetchSubscription = async () => {
    35	      // 未登录时不获取
    36	      if (!isAuthenticated) {
    37	        return;
    38	      }
    39	
    40	      // 如果已经通过 prop 传入了订阅信息，优先使用
    41	      if (userSubscriptionProp) {
    42	        setUserSubscription(userSubscriptionProp);
    43	        console.log('[ModelSelector] Using subscription from props:', userSubscriptionProp);
    44	        return;
    45	      }
    46	
    47	      // 否则自己获取订阅信息
    48	      try {
    49	        const response = await subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription();
    50	        if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    51	          setUserSubscription(response.data.data);
    52	          console.log('[ModelSelector] Fetched subscription:', response.data.data);
    53	        }
    54	      } catch (error) {
    55	        console.error('[ModelSelector] Failed to fetch subscription:', error);
    56	      }
    57	    };
    58	
    59	    fetchSubscription();
    60	  }, [isAuthenticated, userSubscriptionProp]);
    61	
    62	  // SVG图标组件
    63	  const LowIcon = () => (
    64	    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    65	      <polygon points="13 2 3 14 12 14 11 22 21 10 12 10 13 2"/>
    66	    </svg>
    67	  );
    68	
    69	  const MidIcon = () => (
    70	    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    71	      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
    72	      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6"/>
    73	      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/>
    74	    </svg>
    75	  );
    76	
    77	  const HighIcon = () => (
    78	    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    79	      <path d="M12 2l3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01L12 2z"/>
    80	    </svg>
    81	  );
    82	
    83	  // 模型配置
    84	  const models = [
    85	    {
    86	      value: 'low',
    87	      label: '普通模型',
    88	      description: '快速响应，适合基础搜索',
    89	      icon: <LowIcon />,
    90	      featureTypes: ['advanced_search_low', 'ai_chat_normal']
    91	    },
    92	    {
    93	      value: 'mid',
    94	      label: '进阶模型',
    95	      description: '平衡性能，适合大多数场景',
    96	      icon: <MidIcon />,
    97	      featureTypes: ['advanced_search_mid', 'ai_chat_mid']
    98	    },
    99	    {
   100	      value: 'high',
   101	      label: '高级模型',
   102	      description: '最高质量，深度分析',
   103	      icon: <HighIcon />,
   104	      featureTypes: ['advanced_search_high', 'ai_chat_high']
   105	    }
   106	  ];
   107	
   108	  // 获取配额和使用情况
   109	  useEffect(() => {
   110	    const fetchQuotaAndUsage = async () => {
   111	      // 未登录时不获取配额
   112	      if (!isAuthenticated) {
   113	        return;
   114	      }
   115	      
   116	      try {
   117	        const response = await subscriptionAPI.getUsage();
   118	
   119	        if (response.data.code === 0) {
   120	          const data = response.data.data;
   121	          // 后端返回的数据包含 usage 和 limits
   122	          // 将 limits 映射为 quota 格式
   123	          const quotaData = {
   124	            advancedSearchLowQuota: data.limits?.advanced_search_low?.limit ?? -1,
   125	            advancedSearchMidQuota: data.limits?.advanced_search_mid?.limit ?? -1,
   126	            advancedSearchHighQuota: data.limits?.advanced_search_high?.limit ?? -1,
   127	            aiChatNormalQuota: data.limits?.ai_chat_normal?.limit ?? -1,
   128	            aiChatMidQuota: data.limits?.ai_chat_mid?.limit ?? -1,
   129	            aiChatHighQuota: data.limits?.ai_chat_high?.limit ?? -1,
   130	          };
   131	
   132	          // 将 usage 映射为前端格式
   133	          const usageData = {
   134	            advancedSearchLowCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_low ?? 0,
   135	            advancedSearchMidCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_mid ?? 0,
   136	            advancedSearchHighCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_high ?? 0,
   137	            aiChatNormalCount: data.usage?.ai_chat_normal ?? 0,
   138	            aiChatMidCount: data.usage?.ai_chat_mid ?? 0,
   139	            aiChatHighCount: data.usage?.ai_chat_high ?? 0,
   140	          };
   141	
   142	          setQuota(quotaData);
   143	          setUsage(usageData);
   144	        }
   145	      } catch (error) {
   146	        console.error('Failed to fetch quota/usage:', error);
   147	      }
   148	    };
   149	
   150	    // 只在组件挂载时获取一次配额信息
   151	    fetchQuotaAndUsage();
   152	    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
   153	  }, [isAuthenticated]);
   154	
   155	  // 点击外部关闭下拉菜单
   156	  useEffect(() => {
   157	    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
   158	      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
   159	        setShowDropdown(false);
   160	      }
   161	    };
   162	
   163	    if (showDropdown) {
   164	      // 使用 capture 阶段捕获事件，确保优先处理
   165	      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside, true);
   166	      document.addEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside, true);
   167	    }
   168	
   169	    return () => {
   170	      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside, true);
   171	      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside, true);
   172	    };
   173	  }, [showDropdown]);
   174	
   175	  // 获取当前选中的模型（默认第一个，即普通模型）
   176	  const selectedModel = models.find(m => m.value === value) || models[0];
   177	
   178	  // 检查模型是否可用
   179	  const isModelAvailable = (model) => {
   180	    // 未登录用户只能使用普通模型
   181	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   182	      return model.value === 'low';
   183	    }
   184	    
   185	    // 如果没有 quota 数据，还在加载中，默认只允许普通模型
   186	    if (!quota) {
   187	      return model.value === 'low';
   188	    }
   189	
   190	    // 根据 mode 和 model.value 确定对应的 feature type
   191	    const featurePrefix = mode === 'ai-chat' ? 'ai_chat_' : 'advanced_search_';
   192	    const feature = model.featureTypes.find(ft => ft.startsWith(featurePrefix));
   193	    
   194	    if (!feature) {
   195	      return false;
   196	    }
   197	
   198	    // 提取级别名称（low, mid, high 或 normal）
   199	    const levelName = feature.replace(featurePrefix, '');
   200	    
   201	    // 映射配额字段名
   202	    const quotaFieldMap = {
   203	      // Advanced Search
   204	      'low': 'advancedSearchLowQuota',
   205	      'mid': 'advancedSearchMidQuota',
   206	      'high': 'advancedSearchHighQuota',
   207	      // AI Chat
   208	      'normal': 'aiChatNormalQuota',
   209	    };
   210	
   211	    const usageFieldMap = {
   212	      // Advanced Search
   213	      'low': 'advancedSearchLowCount',
   214	      'mid': 'advancedSearchMidCount',
   215	      'high': 'advancedSearchHighCount',
   216	      // AI Chat
   217	      'normal': 'aiChatNormalCount',
   218	    };
   219	
   220	    // AI Chat 的 mid 和 high
   221	    if (mode === 'ai-chat') {
   222	      if (levelName === 'mid') {
   223	        quotaFieldMap['mid'] = 'aiChatMidQuota';
   224	        usageFieldMap['mid'] = 'aiChatMidCount';
   225	      } else if (levelName === 'high') {
   226	        quotaFieldMap['high'] = 'aiChatHighQuota';
   227	        usageFieldMap['high'] = 'aiChatHighCount';
   228	      }
   229	    }
   230	
   231	    const quotaField = quotaFieldMap[levelName];
   232	    const usageField = usageFieldMap[levelName];
   233	    
   234	    if (!quotaField || !usageField) {
   235	      return false;
   236	    }
   237	
   238	    const limitValue = quota[quotaField];
   239	    const usageValue = usage ? usage[usageField] || 0 : 0;
   240	
   241	    // limit === 0 表示没有权限
   242	    if (limitValue === 0) {
   243	      return false;
   244	    }
   245	
   246	    // limit === -1 表示无限制
   247	    if (limitValue === -1) {
   248	    return true;
   249	    }
   250	
   251	    // limit > 0 表示有配额限制，检查是否还有剩余
   252	    return usageValue < limitValue;
   253	  };
   254	
   255	  // 获取模型的剩余次数
   256	  const getRemainingCount = (model) => {
   257	    if (!quota || !usage) return null;
   258	
   259	    // 根据 mode 选择对应的 feature type
   260	    const featurePrefix = mode === 'ai-chat' ? 'ai_chat_' : 'advanced_search_';
   261	    const feature = model.featureTypes.find(ft => ft.startsWith(featurePrefix));
   262	
   263	    if (feature) {
   264	      // 提取级别名称（low, mid, high 或 normal）
   265	      const levelName = feature.replace(featurePrefix, '');
   266	
   267	      // 映射配额字段名
   268	      const quotaFieldMap = {
   269	        // Advanced Search
   270	        'low': 'advancedSearchLowQuota',
   271	        'mid': 'advancedSearchMidQuota',
   272	        'high': 'advancedSearchHighQuota',
   273	        // AI Chat
   274	        'normal': 'aiChatNormalQuota',
   275	      };
   276	
   277	      const usageFieldMap = {
   278	        // Advanced Search
   279	        'low': 'advancedSearchLowCount',
   280	        'mid': 'advancedSearchMidCount',
   281	        'high': 'advancedSearchHighCount',
   282	        // AI Chat
   283	        'normal': 'aiChatNormalCount',
   284	      };
   285	
   286	      // AI Chat 的 mid 和 high
   287	      if (mode === 'ai-chat') {
   288	        if (levelName === 'mid') {
   289	          quotaFieldMap['mid'] = 'aiChatMidQuota';
   290	          usageFieldMap['mid'] = 'aiChatMidCount';
   291	        } else if (levelName === 'high') {
   292	          quotaFieldMap['high'] = 'aiChatHighQuota';
   293	          usageFieldMap['high'] = 'aiChatHighCount';
   294	        }
   295	      }
   296	
   297	      const quotaField = quotaFieldMap[levelName];
   298	      const usageField = usageFieldMap[levelName];
   299	
   300	      const quotaValue = quota[quotaField];
   301	      const usageValue = usage[usageField] || 0;
   302	
   303	      // -1 表示无限制
   304	      if (quotaValue === -1) return '无限制';
   305	
   306	      const remaining = Math.max(0, quotaValue - usageValue);
   307	      return remaining;
   308	    }
   309	
   310	    return null;
   311	  };
   312	
   313	  const handleModelSelect = (model) => {
   314	    if (!isModelAvailable(model)) return;
   315	    onChange(model.value);
   316	    setShowDropdown(false);
   317	  };
   318	
   319	  return (
   320	    <div ref={containerRef} className={`model-selector ${compact ? 'compact' : ''} ${showOnly ? 'show-only' : ''}`}>
   321	        <button
   322	          type="button"
   323	          className={`model-selector-btn ${showDropdown ? 'open' : ''} ${compact ? 'compact' : ''} ${showOnly ? 'show-only' : ''}`}
   324	          onClick={() => !disabled && !showOnly && setShowDropdown(!showDropdown)}
   325	          disabled={disabled || showOnly}
   326	        >
   327	          <span className="model-icon">{selectedModel.icon}</span>
   328	          <span className="model-label">{selectedModel.label}</span>
   329	          {!compact && !showOnly && (
   330	          <svg
   331	            className={`dropdown-arrow ${showDropdown ? 'open' : ''}`}
   332	            width="12"
   333	            height="12"
   334	            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
   335	            fill="none"
   336	            stroke="currentColor"
   337	            strokeWidth="2"
   338	          >
   339	            <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/>
   340	          </svg>
   341	          )}
   342	        </button>
   343	
   344	        {showDropdown && (
   345	          <div className={`model-selector-dropdown ${dropdownAlign === 'right' ? 'align-right' : ''}`}>
   346	            <div className="dropdown-header">选择模型</div>
   347	            {models.map((model) => {
   348	              const available = isModelAvailable(model);
   349	              const remaining = getRemainingCount(model);
   350	              const isSelected = model.value === value;
   351	
   352	              return (
   353	                <button
   354	                  key={model.value}
   355	                  type="button"
   356	                  className={`model-option ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''} ${!available ? 'disabled' : ''}`}
   357	                  onClick={() => handleModelSelect(model)}
   358	                  disabled={!available}
   359	                >
   360	                  <div className="model-option-icon-wrapper">
   361	                    {model.icon}
   362	                  </div>
   363	                  <div className="model-option-header">
   364	                    <div className="model-option-top">
   365	                      <span className="model-option-label">{model.label}</span>
   366	                      {isSelected && (
   367	                        <svg className="check-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3">
   368	                          <path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/>
   369	                        </svg>
   370	                      )}
   371	                    </div>
   372	                    <div className="model-option-desc">{model.description}</div>
   373	                    {!available && (
   374	                      <div className="model-option-badge">
   375	                      {(() => {
   376	                        // 未登录
   377	                        if (!isAuthenticated) {
   378	                          return '需要登录';
   379	                        }
   380	                        
   381	                        // 已登录但没有配额数据
   382	                        if (!quota) {
   383	                          return '加载中...';
   384	                        }
   385	
   386	                        // 根据 feature type 检查具体原因
   387	                        const featurePrefix = mode === 'ai-chat' ? 'ai_chat_' : 'advanced_search_';
   388	                        const feature = model.featureTypes.find(ft => ft.startsWith(featurePrefix));
   389	                        
   390	                        if (feature) {
   391	                          const levelName = feature.replace(featurePrefix, '');
   392	                          const quotaFieldMap = {
   393	                            'low': 'advancedSearchLowQuota',
   394	                            'mid': 'advancedSearchMidQuota',
   395	                            'high': 'advancedSearchHighQuota',
   396	                            'normal': 'aiChatNormalQuota',
   397	                          };
   398	
   399	                          if (mode === 'ai-chat') {
   400	                            if (levelName === 'mid') quotaFieldMap['mid'] = 'aiChatMidQuota';
   401	                            if (levelName === 'high') quotaFieldMap['high'] = 'aiChatHighQuota';
   402	                          }
   403	
   404	                          const quotaField = quotaFieldMap[levelName];
   405	                          const limitValue = quota[quotaField];
   406	
   407	                          // limit === 0 表示没有权限
   408	                          if (limitValue === 0) {
   409	                            return '需要升级订阅';
   410	                          }
   411	
   412	                          // limit > 0 但已用完
   413	                          const usageFieldMap = {
   414	                            'low': 'advancedSearchLowCount',
   415	                            'mid': 'advancedSearchMidCount',
   416	                            'high': 'advancedSearchHighCount',
   417	                            'normal': 'aiChatNormalCount',
   418	                          };
   419	
   420	                          if (mode === 'ai-chat') {
   421	                            if (levelName === 'mid') usageFieldMap['mid'] = 'aiChatMidCount';
   422	                            if (levelName === 'high') usageFieldMap['high'] = 'aiChatHighCount';
   423	                          }
   424	
   425	                          const usageField = usageFieldMap[levelName];
   426	                          const usageValue = usage ? usage[usageField] || 0 : 0;
   427	
   428	                          if (limitValue > 0 && usageValue >= limitValue) {
   429	                            return '今日配额已用完';
   430	                          }
   431	                        }
   432	
   433	                        return '需要升级订阅';
   434	                      })()}
   435	                      </div>
   436	                    )}
   437	                    {available && isAuthenticated && remaining !== null && remaining !== '无限制' && (
   438	                      <div className="model-option-quota">
   439	                        剩余 {remaining} 次
   440	                      </div>
   441	                    )}
   442	                  </div>
   443	                </button>
   444	              );
   445	            })}
   446	          </div>
   447	        )}
   448	      </div>
   449	  );
   450	};
   451	
   452	export default ModelSelector;
   453

文件: frontend-user/src/components/PaperCitationMarkdown.js

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React from 'react';
    11	import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
    12	import logger from '../utils/logger';
    13	import './PaperCitationMarkdown.css';
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * 自定义 Markdown 组件，用于渲染带有论文引用的内容
    17	 * 识别 【引用n：引用内容】 或 【引用n:引用内容】 格式，并添加交互效果
    18	 * 同时支持中文冒号（：）和英文冒号（:）
    19	 */
    20	const PaperCitationMarkdown = ({ content, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick }) => {
    21	  // 预处理内容：将 【引用n：文本】 转换为特殊的临时标记
    22	  const processedContent = preprocessCitations(content);
    23	
    24	  // 自定义渲染器来处理文本节点
    25	  const components = {
    26	    // 处理段落中的文本
    27	    p: ({ node, children, ...props }) => {
    28	      const processedChildren = processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
    29	      return <p {...props}>{processedChildren}</p>;
    30	    },
    31	    // 处理列表项中的文本
    32	    li: ({ node, children, ...props }) => {
    33	      const processedChildren = processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
    34	      return <li {...props}>{processedChildren}</li>;
    35	    },
    36	    // 处理标题中的文本
    37	    h1: ({ node, children, ...props }) => {
    38	      const processedChildren = processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
    39	      return <h1 {...props}>{processedChildren}</h1>;
    40	    },
    41	    h2: ({ node, children, ...props }) => {
    42	      const processedChildren = processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
    43	      return <h2 {...props}>{processedChildren}</h2>;
    44	    },
    45	    h3: ({ node, children, ...props }) => {
    46	      const processedChildren = processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
    47	      return <h3 {...props}>{processedChildren}</h3>;
    48	    },
    49	    h4: ({ node, children, ...props }) => {
    50	      const processedChildren = processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
    51	      return <h4 {...props}>{processedChildren}</h4>;
    52	    },
    53	    // 处理强调文本
    54	    strong: ({ node, children, ...props }) => {
    55	      const processedChildren = processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
    56	      return <strong {...props}>{processedChildren}</strong>;
    57	    },
    58	    em: ({ node, children, ...props }) => {
    59	      const processedChildren = processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
    60	      return <em {...props}>{processedChildren}</em>;
    61	    },
    62	  };
    63	
    64	  return <ReactMarkdown components={components}>{processedContent}</ReactMarkdown>;
    65	};
    66	
    67	/**
    68	 * 预处理：将引用格式转换为临时标记
    69	 * 支持两种格式：
    70	 * 1. 【引用n：文本】 或 【引用n:文本】 -> {{CITE:n:text}}
    71	 * 2. 【引用n】 -> {{CITE:n}}
    72	 * 使用特殊标记避免被 Markdown 解析器处理
    73	 */
    74	function preprocessCitations(content) {
    75	  if (!content) return content;
    76	
    77	  // 先处理带内容的格式：【引用数字：内容】 或 【引用数字:内容】
    78	  const citeWithTextRegex = /【引用(\d+)[：:]([^】]+)】/g;
    79	  
    80	  // 再处理简单格式：【引用数字】（不带冒号和内容）
    81	  const citeSimpleRegex = /【引用(\d+)】/g;
    82	
    83	  const matchesWithText = content.match(citeWithTextRegex);
    84	  const matchesSimple = content.match(citeSimpleRegex);
    85	  
    86	  if ((matchesWithText && matchesWithText.length > 0) || (matchesSimple && matchesSimple.length > 0)) {
    87	    logger.log('🔗 找到引用标记:', 
    88	      (matchesWithText?.length || 0) + (matchesSimple?.length || 0), '个',
    89	      { withText: matchesWithText, simple: matchesSimple });
    90	  }
    91	
    92	  // 先替换带内容的格式
    93	  let result = content.replace(citeWithTextRegex, (match, paperNum, text) => {
    94	    logger.log('📝 转换引用(带内容):', match, '->', `{{CITE:${paperNum}:${text}}}`);
    95	    return `{{CITE:${paperNum}:${text}}}`;
    96	  });
    97	
    98	  // 再替换简单格式
    99	  result = result.replace(citeSimpleRegex, (match, paperNum) => {
   100	    logger.log('📝 转换引用(简单):', match, '->', `{{CITE:${paperNum}}}`);
   101	    return `{{CITE:${paperNum}}}`;
   102	  });
   103	
   104	  return result;
   105	}
   106	
   107	/**
   108	 * 处理文本内容，将临时标记转换为可交互的组件
   109	 */
   110	function processTextWithCitations(children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick) {
   111	  if (!children) return children;
   112	
   113	  return React.Children.map(children, (child) => {
   114	    // 如果是字符串，处理其中的引用
   115	    if (typeof child === 'string') {
   116	      return processSingleText(child, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick);
   117	    }
   118	
   119	    // 如果是 React 元素，递归处理其子元素
   120	    if (React.isValidElement(child) && child.props.children) {
   121	      return React.cloneElement(child, {
   122	        children: processTextWithCitations(child.props.children, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick),
   123	      });
   124	    }
   125	
   126	    return child;
   127	  });
   128	}
   129	
   130	/**
   131	 * 处理单个文本字符串，识别并替换引用标记
   132	 * 支持两种格式：
   133	 * 1. {{CITE:n:text}} - 带内容的引用，显示引用文本
   134	 * 2. {{CITE:n}} - 简单引用，显示为上标数字角标
   135	 */
   136	function processSingleText(text, onCitationHover, onCitationLeave, onCitationClick) {
   137	  // 正则表达式匹配两种格式：
   138	  // 1. {{CITE:数字:文本}} - 带内容
   139	  // 2. {{CITE:数字}} - 简单格式
   140	  const citationRegex = /\{\{CITE:(\d+)(?::([^}]+))?\}\}/g;
   141	  const parts = [];
   142	  let lastIndex = 0;
   143	  let match;
   144	
   145	  while ((match = citationRegex.exec(text)) !== null) {
   146	    // 添加引用前的文本
   147	    if (match.index > lastIndex) {
   148	      parts.push(text.substring(lastIndex, match.index));
   149	    }
   150	
   151	    // 提取论文编号和引用文本（可能为空）
   152	    const paperNumber = parseInt(match[1]);
   153	    const citationText = match[2]; // 可能为 undefined
   154	    const paperIndex = paperNumber - 1; // 转换为 0-based 索引
   155	
   156	    if (citationText) {
   157	      // 带内容的引用：显示引用文本，带下划线样式
   158	      parts.push(
   159	        <span
   160	          key={`citation-${match.index}`}
   161	          className="paper-citation-text"
   162	          onMouseEnter={() => onCitationHover && onCitationHover(paperIndex)}
   163	          onMouseLeave={() => onCitationLeave && onCitationLeave()}
   164	          onClick={() => onCitationClick && onCitationClick(paperIndex)}
   165	        >
   166	          {citationText}
   167	        </span>
   168	      );
   169	    } else {
   170	      // 简单引用：显示为上标数字角标
   171	      parts.push(
   172	        <sup
   173	          key={`citation-${match.index}`}
   174	          className="paper-citation-badge"
   175	          onMouseEnter={() => onCitationHover && onCitationHover(paperIndex)}
   176	          onMouseLeave={() => onCitationLeave && onCitationLeave()}
   177	          onClick={() => onCitationClick && onCitationClick(paperIndex)}
   178	        >
   179	          [{paperNumber}]
   180	        </sup>
   181	      );
   182	    }
   183	
   184	    lastIndex = match.index + match[0].length;
   185	  }
   186	
   187	  // 添加最后剩余的文本
   188	  if (lastIndex < text.length) {
   189	    parts.push(text.substring(lastIndex));
   190	  }
   191	
   192	  // 如果没有找到引用，返回原始文本
   193	  return parts.length > 0 ? parts : text;
   194	}
   195	
   196	export default PaperCitationMarkdown;

    15	  // 使用内部状态作为备选（如果父组件没有传递）
    16	  const [internalActiveTab, setInternalActiveTab] = useState(0);
    17	  const [hoveredPaper, setHoveredPaper] = useState(null); // 鼠标悬停的论文
    18	  const [popupPosition, setPopupPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 }); // 弹窗位置
    19	  const paperRefs = useRef({});
    20	  const paperListContentRef = useRef(null);
    21	  const paperListRef = useRef(null); // 论文列表容器的引用
    22	  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef(null); // 用于延迟隐藏弹窗的定时器
    23	  const showTimeoutRef = useRef(null); // 用于延迟显示弹窗的定时器
    24

    27	  const handleSetActiveTab = setActiveTab || setInternalActiveTab;

    56	      const currentPapers = usePaperSets ? (paperSets[currentActiveTab]?.papers || []) : papers;

    71

    73	        let idealTop = paperRect.top + paperRect.height / 2 - popupHeight / 2;
    74

   258	            <button

   262	            >

   264	              <span className="tab-count">({set.total || set.papers.length})</span>
   265	            </button>

   267	        </div>

   269	
   270	      <div className="paper-list-content" ref={paperListContentRef}>

   278	            onCardHover={(paper) => {
   279	              // 清除任何待执行的隐藏定时器
   280	              if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
   281	                clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
   282	                hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
   283	              }
   284

   286	              if (showTimeoutRef.current) {
   287	                clearTimeout(showTimeoutRef.current);
   288	                showTimeoutRef.current = null;
   289	              }
   290	              
   291	              // 如果是同一篇论文的弹窗已经显示，保持显示

   327	              <path d="M12 5V19M12 19L5 12M12 19L19 12" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>

   340	            if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
   341	              clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
   342	              hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
   343	            }
   344	          }}
   345	          onMouseLeave={() => {
   346	            // 延迟关闭

   349	            }, 200);
   350	          }}
   351	        />,
   352	        document.body
   353	      )}
   354	    </div>
   355	  );
   356	};
   357	
   358	const PaperCard = React.forwardRef(({ paper, index, isHighlighted = false, onCardClick, onCardHover, onCardLeave }, ref) => {
   359	  const {
   360	    title,
   361	    authors,
   362	    year,
   363	    abstract,
   364	    citationCount,
   365	    venue,
   366	    url,
   367	    publicationDate,
   368	    paperId,
   369	    externalIds,
   370	  } = paper;
   371	
   372	  // 确保 authors 始终是数组
   373	  const authorList = authors || [];
   374	
   375	  // 获取 DOI 链接
   376	  const getDOIUrl = () => {
   377	    if (externalIds && externalIds.DOI) {
   378	      return `https://doi.org/${externalIds.DOI}`;
   379	    }
   380	    return null;
   381	  };
   382	
   383	  const handleOpenPaper = (e) => {
   384	    e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止事件冒泡
   385	    // 优先使用 DOI 跳转到出版商页面
   386	    const doiUrl = getDOIUrl();
   387	    if (doiUrl) {
   388	      window.open(doiUrl, '_blank');
   389	    } else if (paperId) {
   390	      // 如果没有 DOI，跳转到论文详情页面
   391	      window.open(`/paper/${paperId}`, '_blank');
   392	    } else if (url) {
   393	      // 如果没有 paperId，fallback 到外部链接
   394	      window.open(url, '_blank');
   395	    }
   396	  };
   397	
   398	  // 处理特定区域的 hover
   399	  const handleHoverableAreaEnter = () => {
   400	    if (onCardHover) {
   401	      onCardHover(paper);
   402	    }
   403	  };
   404	
   405	  const handleHoverableAreaLeave = () => {
   406	    if (onCardLeave) {
   407	      onCardLeave();
   408	    }
   409	  };
   410	
   411	  // 期刊 Logo 处理
   412	  const [logoError, setLogoError] = React.useState(false);
   413	  
   414	  // 获取期刊 Logo URL
   415	  const getJournalLogoUrl = () => {
   416	    if (!venue) return null;
   417	    // 使用 Google 的 favicon 服务或其他服务来获取期刊网站的 logo
   418	    // 这里可以根据期刊名称尝试获取其官方网站的 favicon
   419	    // 对于一些知名期刊，可以使用特定的映射
   420	    const venueMap = {
   421	      'Nature': 'https://www.nature.com/static/images/favicons/nature/apple-touch-icon.png',
   422	      'Science': 'https://www.science.org/pb-assets/images/favicons/science/apple-touch-icon-1645011967513.png',
   423	      'Cell': 'https://www.cell.com/favicon.ico',
   424	      'PNAS': 'https://www.pnas.org/favicon.ico',
   425	      'arXiv': 'https://arxiv.org/static/browse/0.3.4/images/icons/favicon.ico',
   426	    };
   427	    
   428	    // 检查是否有预定义的映射
   429	    for (const [key, url] of Object.entries(venueMap)) {
   430	      if (venue.toLowerCase().includes(key.toLowerCase())) {
   431	        return url;
   432	      }
   433	    }
   434	    
   435	    return null;
   436	  };
   437	
   438	  const logoUrl = getJournalLogoUrl();
   439	
   440	  return (
   441	    <div
   442	      ref={ref}
   443	      className={`paper-card ${isHighlighted ? 'highlighted' : ''}`}
   444	      onClick={onCardClick}
   445	    >
   446	      <div className="paper-content">
   447	        {/* 第一行：序号 + 期刊信息 */}
   448	        <div className="paper-first-row">
   449	          <div className="paper-rank-inline">
   450	            <span className="rank-number">{index + 1}</span>
   451	          </div>
   452	          
   453	          {venue && (
   454	            <div className="paper-venue-info" onClick={handleOpenPaper}>
   455	              <div className="venue-logo">
   456	                {logoUrl && !logoError ? (
   457	                  <img 
   458	                    src={logoUrl} 
   459	                    alt={venue}
   460	                    onError={() => setLogoError(true)}
   461	                  />
   462	                ) : (
   463	                  // 默认学术图标
   464	                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
   465	                    <path d="M12 3L1 9l4 2.18v6L12 21l7-3.82v-6l2-1.09V17h2V9L12 3zm6.82 6L12 12.72 5.18 9 12 5.28 18.82 9zM17 15.99l-5 2.73-5-2.73v-3.72L12 15l5-2.73v3.72z"/>
   466	                  </svg>
   467	                )}
   468	              </div>
   469	              <span className="pl-venue-name">{venue}</span>
   470	            </div>
   471	          )}
   472	        </div>
   473	        
   474	        {/* 可 hover 区域：标题 + 作者 + 摘要作为一个整体 */}
   475	        <div 
   476	          className="paper-hoverable-area"
   477	          onMouseEnter={handleHoverableAreaEnter}
   478	          onMouseLeave={handleHoverableAreaLeave}
   479	        >
   480	          {/* 标题 */}
   481	          <div className="paper-header">
   482	            <h4 className="paper-list-title" onClick={handleOpenPaper} title={title}>
   483	              {title || '无标题'}
   484	            </h4>
   485	          </div>
   486	
   487	          {/* 作者 */}
   488	          {authorList.length > 0 && (
   489	            <div className="paper-authors">
   490	              {authorList.slice(0, 3).map((author, idx) => (
   491	                <span key={author.authorId || idx} className="author-name">
   492	                  {author.name}
   493	                  {idx < Math.min(authorList.length - 1, 2) && ', '}
   494	                </span>
   495	              ))}
   496	              {authorList.length > 3 && <span className="author-more"> 等 {authorList.length} 位作者</span>}
   497	            </div>
   498	          )}
   499	
   500	          {/* 摘要 */}
   501	          {abstract && (
   502	            <p className="paper-abstract">
   503	              {abstract}
   504	            </p>
   505	          )}
   506	        </div>
   507	
   508	        {/* Meta 信息 - 左对齐到序号位置 */}
   509	        <div className="paper-meta">
   510	          {citationCount !== undefined && (
   511	            <span className="meta-item citations">
   512	              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   513	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4 4a2 2 0 012-2h4.586A2 2 0 0112 2.586L15.414 6A2 2 0 0116 7.414V16a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V4zm2 6a1 1 0 011-1h6a1 1 0 110 2H7a1 1 0 01-1-1zm1 3a1 1 0 100 2h6a1 1 0 100-2H7z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
   514	              </svg>
   515	              {citationCount} 被引
   516	            </span>
   517	          )}
   518	          {publicationDate && (
   519	            <span className="meta-item date">
   520	              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   521	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M6 2a1 1 0 00-1 1v1H4a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2h-1V3a1 1 0 10-2 0v1H7V3a1 1 0 00-1-1zm0 5a1 1 0 000 2h8a1 1 0 100-2H6z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
   522	              </svg>
   523	              {new Date(publicationDate).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}
   524	            </span>
   525	          )}
   526	        </div>
   527	      </div>
   528	    </div>
   529	  );
   530	});
   531	
   532	// 论文详情弹窗组件
   533	const PaperDetailPopup = ({ paper, position, onMouseEnter, onMouseLeave }) => {
   534	  const {
   535	    title,
   536	    authors,
   537	    year,
   538	    abstract,
   539	    citationCount,
   540	    venue,
   541	    url,
   542	    publicationDate,
   543	    paperId,
   544	  } = paper;
   545	
   546	  const authorList = authors || [];
   547	
   548	  const handleOpenPaper = () => {
   549	    // 在新标签页中打开我们自己的论文详情页面
   550	    if (paperId) {
   551	      window.open(`/paper/${paperId}`, '_blank');
   552	    } else if (url) {
   553	      // 如果没有 paperId，fallback 到外部链接
   554	      window.open(url, '_blank');
   555	    }
   556	  };
   557	
   558	  // 格式化日期
   559	  const formatDate = (date) => {
   560	    if (!date) return '';
   561	    const d = new Date(date);
   562	    return `${d.getFullYear()}年${d.getMonth() + 1}月${d.getDate()}日`;
   563	  };
   564	
   565	  // 格式化作者列表
   566	  const formatAuthors = () => {
   567	    if (authorList.length === 0) return '';
   568	    if (authorList.length <= 3) {
   569	      return authorList.map(a => a.name).join(', ');
   570	    }
   571	    return `${authorList[0].name} 等${authorList.length}人`;
   572	  };
   573	
   574	  return (
   575	    <div
   576	      className="paper-detail-popup-wrapper"
   577	      style={{
   578	        position: 'fixed',
   579	        top: `${position.top}px`,
   580	        left: `${position.left}px`,
   581	      }}
   582	      onMouseEnter={onMouseEnter}
   583	      onMouseLeave={onMouseLeave}
   584	    >
   585	      <div className={`paper-detail-popup ${abstract ? 'with-abstract' : 'no-abstract'}`}>
   586	        {/* 顶部期刊信息 */}
   587	        {venue && (
   588	          <div className="popup-venue-header">
   589	            <svg className="venue-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
   590	              <path d="M19 3h-1V1h-2v2H8V1H6v2H5c-1.11 0-1.99.9-1.99 2L3 19c0 1.1.89 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V5c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm0 16H5V8h14v11zM7 10h5v5H7z"/>
   591	            </svg>
   592	            <span className="venue-text">{venue}</span>
   593	          </div>
   594	        )}
   595	
   596	        {/* 标题部分 */}
   597	        <div className="popup-title-section">
   598	          <h3 className="popup-main-title">{title || '无标题'}</h3>
   599	        </div>
   600	
   601	        {/* 日期和引用次数 */}
   602	        <div className="popup-meta-line">
   603	          {publicationDate && (
   604	            <span className="meta-date">{formatDate(publicationDate)}</span>
   605	          )}
   606	          {publicationDate && citationCount !== undefined && (
   607	            <span className="meta-divider">•</span>
   608	          )}
   609	          {citationCount !== undefined && (
   610	            <span className="meta-citations">被引 {citationCount} 次</span>
   611	          )}
   612	        </div>
   613	
   614	        {/* 作者 */}
   615	        {authorList.length > 0 && (
   616	          <div className="popup-authors-line">
   617	            <span className="authors-text">{formatAuthors()}</span>
   618	          </div>
   619	        )}
   620	
   621	        {/* 摘要区域 - 只在有摘要时显示 */}
   622	        {abstract && (
   623	          <>
   624	            <div className="popup-abstract-header">
   625	              <span className="abstract-label">Abstract</span>
   626	            </div>
   627	            <div className="popup-abstract-content">
   628	              <p className="abstract-text">{abstract}</p>
   629	            </div>
   630	          </>
   631	        )}
   632	
   633	        {/* 底部按钮 */}
   634	        <div className="popup-footer">
   635	          <button className="popup-abstract-btn" onClick={handleOpenPaper}>
   636	            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
   637	              <path d="M14 2H6c-1.1 0-1.99.9-1.99 2L4 20c0 1.1.89 2 1.99 2H18c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V8l-6-6zm2 16H8v-2h8v2zm0-4H8v-2h8v2zm-3-5V3.5L18.5 9H13z"/>
   638	            </svg>
   639	            <span>查看全文</span>
   640	          </button>
   641	        </div>
   642	      </div>
   643	    </div>
   644	  );
   645	};
   646	
   647	export default PaperList;

     1	/**
