     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
    11	import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
    12	import { publicScholarAPI, analysisDimensionAPI } from '../services/api';
    13	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    14	import './PaperTableView.css';
    15	
    16	// 懒加载 AuthModal
    17	const AuthModal = lazy(() => import('./AuthModal'));
    18	
    19	// 分析结果缓存
    20	const analysisCache = new Map();
    21	
    22	// 每次显示的论文数量
    23	const PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY = 10;
    24	// 每次从后端加载的论文数量（需要多加载一些，因为要过滤无摘要的）
    25	const PAPERS_PER_FETCH = 50;
    26	// 未登录用户最多显示的论文数量
    27	const GUEST_MAX_PAPERS = 5;
    28	
    29	// Loading期间的占位列（6个）
    30	const LOADING_COLUMNS = [
    31	  { key: 'paper', label: '论文', sticky: true },
    32	  { key: 'loading1', label: '加载中...' },
    33	  { key: 'loading2', label: '加载中...' },
    34	  { key: 'loading3', label: '加载中...' },
    35	  { key: 'loading4', label: '加载中...' },
    36	  { key: 'loading5', label: '加载中...' },
    37	  { key: 'loading6', label: '加载中...' },
    38	];
    39	
    40	const PaperTableView = ({ 
    41	  searchQuery, 
    42	  filters, 
    43	  onPaperClick, 
    44	  totalResults, 
    45	  selectedDimensionKey, 
    46	  onDimensionSelect, 
    47	  reloadTrigger,
    48	  // 新增：直接传入论文数据的模式
    49	  papers: providedPapers,
    50	  onLoadMore,
    51	  hasMore: providedHasMore,
    52	  loadingMore: providedLoadingMore,
    53	  // 是否隐藏加载更多按钮（用于相似论文未登录状态）
    54	  hideLoadMore = false,
    55	  // 标识是否是相似论文表格视图（用于登录后恢复状态）
    56	  isSimilarPapersTable = false,
    57	  // 使用推荐搜索词搜索的回调
    58	  onSearchWithQuery,
    59	}) => {
    60	  // 判断是否使用传入的论文数据模式
    61	  const useProvidedPapers = !!providedPapers;
    62	  // 获取用户认证状态
    63	  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
    64	  
    65	  // 登录弹窗状态
    66	  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);
    67	  
    68	  // 已加载的有摘要论文列表
    69	  const [papersWithAbstract, setPapersWithAbstract] = useState([]);
    70	  // 当前显示的数量
    71	  const [displayCount, setDisplayCount] = useState(PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
    72	  // 后端数据的偏移量
    73	  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0);
    74	  // 是否正在加载更多
    75	  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
    76	  // 是否还有更多数据可以从后端加载
    77	  const [hasMoreFromBackend, setHasMoreFromBackend] = useState(true);
    78	  // 初始加载状态
    79	  const [initialLoading, setInitialLoading] = useState(true);
    80	  // 重新加载提示
    81	  const [reloadNotice, setReloadNotice] = useState(null);
    82	  // 重新加载计数器（用于触发数据重新加载）
    83	  const [reloadCounter, setReloadCounter] = useState(0);
    84	  
    85	  const [analysisResults, setAnalysisResults] = useState({});
    86	  const [loadingPapers, setLoadingPapers] = useState({});
    87	  const [expandedCells, setExpandedCells] = useState({});
    88	  // 动态列定义（从API获取）
    89	  const [dynamicColumns, setDynamicColumns] = useState(null);
    90	  // 列加载状态
    91	  const [columnsLoading, setColumnsLoading] = useState(true);
    92	  // AI翻译后的搜索词（用于推荐搜索）
    93	  const [translatedQuery, setTranslatedQuery] = useState(null);
    94	  // 搜索策略: combined, original, translated
    95	  const [searchStrategy, setSearchStrategy] = useState('');
    96	  const tableRef = useRef(null);
    97	  const tableWrapperRef = useRef(null);
    98	  const columnRefs = useRef({}); // 列头引用，用于滚动定位
    99	  const observerRef = useRef(null);
   100	  const paperRefs = useRef({});
   101	
   102	  // 重新加载数据（清除缓存并重新获取）
   103	  const reloadData = useCallback(() => {
   104	    // 清除分析缓存
   105	    analysisCache.clear();
   106	    // 重置状态
   107	    setAnalysisResults({});
   108	    setDynamicColumns(null);
   109	    setColumnsLoading(true); // 重置列加载状态，触发重新加载维度
   110	    setPapersWithAbstract([]);
   111	    setDisplayCount(PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
   112	    setOffset(0);
   113	    setHasMoreFromBackend(true);
   114	    setInitialLoading(true);
   115	    setReloadNotice(null);
   116	    // 增加计数器以触发数据重新加载
   117	    setReloadCounter(prev => prev + 1);
   118	  }, []);
   119	
   120	  // 监听 reloadTrigger 变化，触发重新加载
   121	  useEffect(() => {
   122	    if (reloadTrigger && reloadTrigger.timestamp) {
   123	      // 显示提示
   124	      const actionText = reloadTrigger.action === 'add' ? '新增' : '修改';
   125	      setReloadNotice({
   126	        message: `维度"${reloadTrigger.dimensionName}"已${actionText}，正在重新加载数据...`,
   127	        type: 'info'
   128	      });
   129	      
   130	      // 延迟一下再重新加载，让用户看到提示
   131	      setTimeout(() => {
   132	        reloadData();
   133	      }, 500);
   134	    }
   135	  }, [reloadTrigger, reloadData]);
   136	
   137	  // 当用户登录状态变化时，清除缓存并重新加载
   138	  // 因为登录/登出会影响使用的维度配置
   139	  useEffect(() => {
   140	    // 清除缓存
   141	    analysisCache.clear();
   142	    // 重置分析结果和动态列
   143	    setAnalysisResults({});
   144	    setDynamicColumns(null);
   145	    setColumnsLoading(true);
   146	  }, [isAuthenticated]);
   147	
   148	  // 组件加载时从API获取分析维度列
   149	  // 依赖 reloadCounter 以便在维度修改后重新加载
   150	  useEffect(() => {
   151	    const loadDimensions = async () => {
   152	      setColumnsLoading(true);
   153	      try {
   154	        let response;
   155	        if (isAuthenticated) {
   156	          // 已登录用户：获取用户自定义维度或系统默认
   157	          response = await analysisDimensionAPI.getDimensions();
   158	        } else {
   159	          // 未登录用户：获取系统默认维度
   160	          response = await publicScholarAPI.getSystemDimensions();
   161	        }
   162	
   163	        if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   164	          const dims = response.data.data.dimensions || [];
   165	          if (dims.length > 0) {
   166	            const cols = [
   167	              { key: 'paper', label: '论文', sticky: true },
   168	              ...dims.map(dim => ({
   169	                key: dim.dimensionKey,
   170	                label: dim.name
   171	              }))
   172	            ];
   173	            setDynamicColumns(cols);
   174	          }
   175	        }
   176	      } catch (err) {
   177	        console.error('Failed to load dimensions:', err);
   178	      } finally {
   179	        setColumnsLoading(false);
   180	      }
   181	    };
   182	
   183	    loadDimensions();
   184	  }, [isAuthenticated, reloadCounter]);
   185	
   186	  // 当选中维度变化时，自动滚动到对应列
   187	  useEffect(() => {
   188	    if (selectedDimensionKey && columnRefs.current[selectedDimensionKey] && tableWrapperRef.current) {
   189	      const columnElement = columnRefs.current[selectedDimensionKey];
   190	      const wrapperElement = tableWrapperRef.current;
   191	      
   192	      // 计算需要滚动的位置
   193	      const columnRect = columnElement.getBoundingClientRect();
   194	      const wrapperRect = wrapperElement.getBoundingClientRect();
   195	      
   196	      // 第一列是固定的，宽度约340px
   197	      const stickyColumnWidth = 340;
   198	      
   199	      // 计算列相对于wrapper的位置
   200	      const columnLeft = columnElement.offsetLeft;
   201	      const scrollTarget = columnLeft - stickyColumnWidth - 20; // 留一点边距
   202	      
   203	      // 平滑滚动到目标位置
   204	      wrapperElement.scrollTo({
   205	        left: Math.max(0, scrollTarget),
   206	        behavior: 'smooth'
   207	      });
   208	    }
   209	  }, [selectedDimensionKey]);
   210	
   211	  // 点击列头处理
   212	  const handleColumnHeaderClick = (key) => {
   213	    if (key === 'paper') return; // 论文列不可选中
   214	    if (onDimensionSelect) {
   215	      // 如果已经选中，则取消选中；否则选中
   216	      onDimensionSelect(selectedDimensionKey === key ? null : key);
   217	    }
   218	  };
   219	
   220	  // 从后端加载论文数据
   221	  // 返回: { totalFetched: number, withAbstract: number, hasMore: boolean }
   222	  const fetchPapers = useCallback(async (query, currentFilters, currentOffset, append = false) => {
   223	    if (!query) {
   224	      console.log('[PaperTableView] No query provided, skipping fetch');
   225	      return { totalFetched: 0, withAbstract: 0, hasMore: false };
   226	    }
   227	    
   228	    console.log('[PaperTableView] Fetching papers:', { query, currentOffset, append });
   229	    
   230	    try {
   231	      const params = {
   232	        query: query,
   233	        offset: currentOffset,
   234	        limit: PAPERS_PER_FETCH,
   235	        enableTranslation: true, // 启用翻译以获取AI优化后的搜索词
   236	        fields: ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'url', 'venue', 'publicationDate', 'openAccessPdf', 'fieldsOfStudy', 'isOpenAccess', 'referenceCount', 'influentialCitationCount', 'tldr', 'journal', 'externalIds']
   237	      };
   238	
   239	      // 添加筛选条件
   240	      if (currentFilters) {
   241	        if (currentFilters.yearFrom || currentFilters.yearTo) {
   242	          params.yearFrom = currentFilters.yearFrom;
   243	          params.yearTo = currentFilters.yearTo;
   244	        }
   245	        if (currentFilters.publicationTypes && currentFilters.publicationTypes.length > 0) {
   246	          params.publicationTypes = currentFilters.publicationTypes;
   247	        }
   248	        if (currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy && currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) {
   249	          params.fieldsOfStudy = currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy;
   250	        }
   251	        if (currentFilters.openAccessPdf) {
   252	          params.openAccessPdf = currentFilters.openAccessPdf;
   253	        }
   254	        if (currentFilters.venue) {
   255	          params.venue = currentFilters.venue;
   256	        }
   257	        if (currentFilters.minCitationCount) {
   258	          params.minCitationCount = currentFilters.minCitationCount;
   259	        }
   260	      }
   261	
   262	      console.log('[PaperTableView] Request params:', params);
   263	      const response = await publicScholarAPI.searchPapers(params);
   264	      console.log('[PaperTableView] Response:', response.data);
   265	      
   266	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   267	        // 数据结构: response.data.data.data.data (Semantic Scholar返回的嵌套结构)
   268	        const searchData = response.data.data.data || response.data.data;
   269	        const newPapers = searchData.data || searchData.papers || [];
   270	        console.log('[PaperTableView] Got papers:', newPapers.length, 'from searchData:', searchData);
   271	        
   272	        // 保存AI翻译后的搜索词和搜索策略（用于推荐搜索）
   273	        // 数据可能在不同层级：response.data.data.translatedQuery 或 searchData.translatedQuery
   274	        const translated = response.data.data?.translatedQuery || searchData?.translatedQuery;
   275	        const strategy = response.data.data?.searchStrategy || searchData?.searchStrategy || '';
   276	        console.log('[PaperTableView] Looking for translatedQuery and searchStrategy:', {
   277	          'response.data.data': response.data.data,
   278	          'searchData': searchData,
   279	          'translatedQuery': translated,
   280	          'searchStrategy': strategy
   281	        });
   282	        if (translated && translated !== query) {
   283	          setTranslatedQuery(translated);
   284	          console.log('[PaperTableView] Set translated query:', translated);
   285	        }
   286	        if (strategy) {
   287	          setSearchStrategy(strategy);
   288	          console.log('[PaperTableView] Set search strategy:', strategy);
   289	        }
   290	        
   291	        // 过滤出有摘要的论文
   292	        const newPapersWithAbstract = newPapers.filter(p => p.abstract && p.abstract.trim().length > 0);
   293	        console.log('[PaperTableView] Papers with abstract:', newPapersWithAbstract.length);
   294	        
   295	        if (append) {
   296	          setPapersWithAbstract(prev => {
   297	            // 去重
   298	            const existingIds = new Set(prev.map(p => p.paperId));
   299	            const uniqueNew = newPapersWithAbstract.filter(p => !existingIds.has(p.paperId));
   300	            return [...prev, ...uniqueNew];
   301	          });
   302	        } else {
   303	          setPapersWithAbstract(newPapersWithAbstract);
   304	        }
   305	        
   306	        // 判断是否还有更多数据
   307	        const total = searchData.total || response.data.data.total || 0;
   308	        console.log('[PaperTableView] Total papers:', total);
   309	        const hasMore = currentOffset + PAPERS_PER_FETCH < total;
   310	        setHasMoreFromBackend(hasMore);
   311	        
   312	        return { totalFetched: newPapers.length, withAbstract: newPapersWithAbstract.length, hasMore };
   313	      }
   314	      return { totalFetched: 0, withAbstract: 0, hasMore: false };
   315	    } catch (error) {
   316	      console.error('[PaperTableView] Failed to fetch papers:', error);
   317	      return { totalFetched: 0, withAbstract: 0, hasMore: false };
   318	    }
   319	  }, []);
   320	
   321	  // 初始加载 - 当searchQuery、filters或reloadCounter变化时重新加载
   322	  // 自动继续加载直到有摘要的论文或没有更多数据
   323	  useEffect(() => {
   324	    // 如果使用传入的论文数据模式，不需要自己加载
   325	    if (useProvidedPapers) {
   326	      console.log('[PaperTableView] Using provided papers, count:', providedPapers?.length);
   327	      // 过滤出有摘要的论文
   328	      const papersWithAbs = (providedPapers || []).filter(p => p.abstract && p.abstract.trim().length > 0);
   329	      setPapersWithAbstract(papersWithAbs);
   330	      setInitialLoading(false);
   331	      setHasMoreFromBackend(providedHasMore !== undefined ? providedHasMore : false);
   332	      return;
   333	    }
   334	    
   335	    console.log('[PaperTableView] useEffect triggered, searchQuery:', searchQuery, 'reloadCounter:', reloadCounter);
   336	    
   337	    if (!searchQuery) {
   338	      console.log('[PaperTableView] No searchQuery, skipping');
   339	      setInitialLoading(false);
   340	      return;
   341	    }
   342	    
   343	    const loadInitial = async () => {
   344	      setInitialLoading(true);
   345	      setPapersWithAbstract([]);
   346	      setOffset(0);
   347	      setDisplayCount(PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
   348	      setHasMoreFromBackend(true);
   349	      
   350	      // 自动加载直到有摘要的论文或没有更多数据
   351	      let currentOffset = 0;
   352	      let totalWithAbstract = 0;
   353	      let hasMore = true;
   354	      const maxAttempts = 10; // 最多尝试10次，避免无限循环
   355	      let attempts = 0;
   356	      
   357	      while (totalWithAbstract === 0 && hasMore && attempts < maxAttempts) {
   358	        console.log(`[PaperTableView] Auto-loading attempt ${attempts + 1}, offset: ${currentOffset}`);
   359	        const result = await fetchPapers(searchQuery, filters, currentOffset, currentOffset > 0);
   360	        totalWithAbstract = result.withAbstract;
   361	        hasMore = result.hasMore;
   362	        
   363	        if (totalWithAbstract === 0 && hasMore) {
   364	          currentOffset += PAPERS_PER_FETCH;
   365	          setOffset(currentOffset);
   366	        }
   367	        attempts++;
   368	      }
   369	      
   370	      if (attempts > 1) {
   371	        console.log(`[PaperTableView] Auto-loaded ${attempts} pages to find papers with abstract`);
   372	      }
   373	      
   374	      setInitialLoading(false);
   375	    };
   376	    
   377	    loadInitial();
   378	  }, [searchQuery, filters, fetchPapers, reloadCounter, useProvidedPapers, providedPapers, providedHasMore]);
   379	
   380	  // 当前显示的论文
   381	  const displayedPapers = useProvidedPapers 
   382	    ? papersWithAbstract  // 传入数据模式：显示所有有摘要的论文
   383	    : papersWithAbstract.slice(0, displayCount);
   384	
   385	  // 是否可以显示更多（本地已有数据或后端还有数据）- 仅登录用户可用
   386	  const canLoadMore = useProvidedPapers 
   387	    ? (providedHasMore && onLoadMore)  // 传入数据模式：由外部控制
   388	    : (isAuthenticated && (displayCount < papersWithAbstract.length || hasMoreFromBackend));
   389	
   390	  // 当前是否正在加载
   391	  const isLoadingMore = useProvidedPapers ? providedLoadingMore : loadingMore;
   392	
   393	  // 剩余可加载数量提示
   394	  const remainingHint = useProvidedPapers 
   395	    ? (providedHasMore ? '加载更多...' : '')
   396	    : (displayCount < papersWithAbstract.length 
   397	        ? `还有 ${papersWithAbstract.length - displayCount} 篇已加载`
   398	        : hasMoreFromBackend ? '加载更多...' : '');
   399	
   400	  // 加载更多论文
   401	  // 自动继续加载直到有新的摘要论文或没有更多数据
   402	  const handleLoadMore = useCallback(async () => {
   403	    // 如果使用传入数据模式，调用外部的加载更多函数
   404	    if (useProvidedPapers) {
   405	      if (onLoadMore) {
   406	        onLoadMore();
   407	      }
   408	      return;
   409	    }
   410	    
   411	    if (loadingMore) return;
   412	    
   413	    // 如果本地已有足够数据，直接显示更多
   414	    if (displayCount + PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY <= papersWithAbstract.length) {
   415	      setDisplayCount(prev => prev + PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
   416	      return;
   417	    }
   418	    
   419	    // 需要从后端加载更多数据
   420	    if (hasMoreFromBackend) {
   421	      setLoadingMore(true);
   422	      
   423	      // 记录加载前的摘要论文数量
   424	      const previousCount = papersWithAbstract.length;
   425	      let currentOffset = offset;
   426	      let hasMore = true;
   427	      const maxAttempts = 10; // 最多尝试10次
   428	      let attempts = 0;
   429	      let newWithAbstract = 0;
   430	      
   431	      // 自动加载直到有新的摘要论文或没有更多数据
   432	      while (newWithAbstract === 0 && hasMore && attempts < maxAttempts) {
   433	        currentOffset += PAPERS_PER_FETCH;
   434	        console.log(`[PaperTableView] LoadMore attempt ${attempts + 1}, offset: ${currentOffset}`);
   435	        const result = await fetchPapers(searchQuery, filters, currentOffset, true);
   436	        newWithAbstract = result.withAbstract;
   437	        hasMore = result.hasMore;
   438	        attempts++;
   439	      }
   440	      
   441	      setOffset(currentOffset);
   442	      
   443	      if (attempts > 1) {
   444	        console.log(`[PaperTableView] LoadMore: loaded ${attempts} pages to find papers with abstract`);
   445	      }
   446	      
   447	      // 增加显示数量
   448	      if (newWithAbstract > 0 || displayCount < papersWithAbstract.length) {
   449	        setDisplayCount(prev => prev + PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
   450	      }
   451	      setLoadingMore(false);
   452	    } else {
   453	      // 没有更多后端数据，显示所有已加载的
   454	      setDisplayCount(papersWithAbstract.length);
   455	    }
   456	  }, [loadingMore, displayCount, papersWithAbstract.length, hasMoreFromBackend, offset, fetchPapers, searchQuery, filters, useProvidedPapers, onLoadMore]);
   457	
   458	  // 使用 ref 来跟踪正在请求的论文，避免闭包问题导致的重复请求
   459	  const pendingRequestsRef = useRef(new Set());
   460	
   461	  // 分析单篇论文
   462	  const analyzePaper = useCallback(async (paper) => {
   463	    // 检查是否有摘要
   464	    if (!paper.abstract) {
   465	      return;
   466	    }
   467	
   468	    // 使用 ref 检查是否正在请求，避免闭包问题
   469	    if (pendingRequestsRef.current.has(paper.paperId)) {
   470	      return;
   471	    }
   472	
   473	    // 检查缓存（注意：如果用户登录状态变化，缓存可能不适用）
   474	    if (analysisCache.has(paper.paperId)) {
   475	      setAnalysisResults(prev => {
   476	        // 再次检查，避免重复设置
   477	        if (prev[paper.paperId]) return prev;
   478	        return {
   479	          ...prev,
   480	          [paper.paperId]: analysisCache.get(paper.paperId)
   481	        };
   482	      });
   483	      return;
   484	    }
   485	
   486	    // 标记为正在请求
   487	    pendingRequestsRef.current.add(paper.paperId);
   488	    setLoadingPapers(prev => ({ ...prev, [paper.paperId]: true }));
   489	
   490	    try {
   491	      // 根据登录状态选择API：
   492	      // - 已登录：使用带认证的API，获取用户自定义维度的分析结果
   493	      // - 未登录：使用公共API，获取系统默认维度的分析结果
   494	      const response = isAuthenticated
   495	        ? await analysisDimensionAPI.analyzePaper(paper.paperId, paper.title, paper.abstract)
   496	        : await publicScholarAPI.analyzePaper(paper.paperId, paper.title, paper.abstract);
   497	      
   498	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   499	        const result = response.data.data;
   500	        // 存入缓存
   501	        analysisCache.set(paper.paperId, result);
   502	        setAnalysisResults(prev => ({
   503	          ...prev,
   504	          [paper.paperId]: result
   505	        }));
   506	      } else {
   507	        // 请求成功但返回错误码，也标记为已处理，避免无限重试
   508	        console.warn('Analysis API returned error code:', response.data.code, response.data.message);
   509	        setAnalysisResults(prev => ({
   510	          ...prev,
   511	          [paper.paperId]: { error: true, message: response.data.message || '分析失败' }
   512	        }));
   513	      }
   514	    } catch (error) {
   515	      console.error('Failed to analyze paper:', paper.paperId, error);
   516	      // 设置错误状态
   517	      setAnalysisResults(prev => ({
   518	        ...prev,
   519	        [paper.paperId]: { error: true }
   520	      }));
   521	    } finally {
   522	      // 清除正在请求标记
   523	      pendingRequestsRef.current.delete(paper.paperId);
   524	      setLoadingPapers(prev => ({ ...prev, [paper.paperId]: false }));
   525	    }
   526	  }, [isAuthenticated]); // 移除 loadingPapers 和 analysisResults 依赖，使用 ref 代替
   527	
   528	  // 使用 ref 存储最新的 analysisResults，避免 Observer 回调中的闭包问题
   529	  const analysisResultsRef = useRef(analysisResults);
   530	  useEffect(() => {
   531	    analysisResultsRef.current = analysisResults;
   532	  }, [analysisResults]);
   533	
   534	  // 使用 Intersection Observer 实现懒加载
   535	  useEffect(() => {
   536	    observerRef.current = new IntersectionObserver(
   537	      (entries) => {
   538	        entries.forEach(entry => {
   539	          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
   540	            const paperId = entry.target.dataset.paperId;
   541	            const paper = displayedPapers.find(p => p.paperId === paperId);
   542	            // 使用 ref 检查最新状态，避免闭包问题
   543	            const alreadyAnalyzed = analysisResultsRef.current[paperId];
   544	            const isPending = pendingRequestsRef.current.has(paperId);
   545	            
   546	            if (paper && paper.abstract && !alreadyAnalyzed && !isPending) {
   547	              analyzePaper(paper);
   548	            }
   549	          }
   550	        });
   551	      },
   552	      {
   553	        root: null,
   554	        rootMargin: '100px',
   555	        threshold: 0.1
   556	      }
   557	    );
   558	
   559	    // 观察所有论文行
   560	    Object.values(paperRefs.current).forEach(ref => {
   561	      if (ref) {
   562	        observerRef.current.observe(ref);
   563	      }
   564	    });
   565	
   566	    return () => {
   567	      if (observerRef.current) {
   568	        observerRef.current.disconnect();
   569	      }
   570	    };
   571	  }, [displayedPapers, analyzePaper]); // 移除 analysisResults 和 loadingPapers 依赖
   572	
   573	  // 切换单元格展开状态
   574	  const toggleCellExpand = (paperId, column) => {
   575	    const key = `${paperId}-${column}`;
   576	    setExpandedCells(prev => ({
   577	      ...prev,
   578	      [key]: !prev[key]
   579	    }));
   580	  };
   581	
   582	  // 渲染单元格内容
   583	  const renderCell = (paperId, column, content, isLoading) => {
   584	    const key = `${paperId}-${column}`;
   585	    const isExpanded = expandedCells[key];
   586	    
   587	    if (isLoading) {
   588	      return (
   589	        <div className="ptv-cell-loading">
   590	          <div className="ptv-loading-spinner"></div>
   591	        </div>
   592	      );
   593	    }
   594	
   595	    if (!content || content === '未提及' || content === '解析失败') {
   596	      return <span className="ptv-cell-empty">{content || '未提及'}</span>;
   597	    }
   598	
   599	    const shouldTruncate = content.length > 100;
   600	    const displayContent = shouldTruncate && !isExpanded 
   601	      ? content.substring(0, 100) + '...' 
   602	      : content;
   603	
   604	    return (
   605	      <div className="ptv-cell-content">
   606	        <span>{displayContent}</span>
   607	        {shouldTruncate && (
   608	          <button 
   609	            className="ptv-expand-btn"
   610	            onClick={(e) => {
   611	              e.stopPropagation();
   612	              toggleCellExpand(paperId, column);
   613	            }}
   614	          >
   615	            {isExpanded ? '收起' : '展开'}
   616	          </button>
   617	        )}
   618	      </div>
   619	    );
   620	  };
   621	
   622	  // 表格列定义 - 优先使用动态列，加载中时使用占位列
   623	  const columns = dynamicColumns || (columnsLoading ? LOADING_COLUMNS : LOADING_COLUMNS);
   624	
   625	  // 打开登录弹窗
   626	  const handleOpenAuthModal = () => {
   627	    setShowAuthModal(true);
   628	  };
   629	
   630	  // 登录成功回调
   631	  const handleLoginSuccess = () => {
   632	    setShowAuthModal(false);
   633	    // 设置标记，让页面刷新后自动切换到表格视图
   634	    localStorage.setItem('returnToTableView', 'true');
   635	    // 如果是相似论文表格视图，额外保存标记
   636	    if (isSimilarPapersTable) {
   637	      localStorage.setItem('returnToSimilarPapersTable', 'true');
   638	    }
   639	    // 刷新页面以重新加载数据
   640	    window.location.reload();
   641	  };
   642	  
   643	  // 获取分析数据中的某个维度值
   644	  const getAnalysisValue = (analysis, key) => {
   645	    if (!analysis) return null;
   646	    // 新的动态格式：从 data 字段获取
   647	    if (analysis.data && analysis.data[key] !== undefined) {
   648	      return analysis.data[key];
   649	    }
   650	    // 兼容旧的固定字段格式
   651	    if (analysis[key] !== undefined) {
   652	      return analysis[key];
   653	    }
   654	    return null;
   655	  };
   656	
   657	  // 初始加载中
   658	  if (initialLoading) {
   659	    return (
   660	      <div className="ptv-container">
   661	        <div className="ptv-loading-state">
   662	          <div className="ptv-loading-spinner-large"></div>
   663	          <p>正在加载论文数据...</p>
   664	        </div>
   665	      </div>
   666	    );
   667	  }
   668	
   669	  // 如果没有有摘要的论文
   670	  if (papersWithAbstract.length === 0) {
   671	    // 判断是否有可用的推荐搜索词
   672	    // 只有在搜索策略是 combined 时才显示推荐按钮
   673	    // 因为 original 策略已经在用原始词搜索，translated 策略已经在用翻译词搜索
   674	    const hasRecommendedQuery = translatedQuery && 
   675	                                 translatedQuery !== searchQuery && 
   676	                                 onSearchWithQuery && 
   677	                                 searchStrategy === 'combined';
   678	    
   679	    return (
   680	      <div className="ptv-container">
   681	        <div className="ptv-empty-state">
   682	          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
   683	            <path d="M9 12h6M12 9v6M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
   684	          </svg>
   685	          <p>当前搜索结果中没有包含摘要的论文</p>
   686	          <span className="ptv-empty-hint">表格视图需要论文摘要进行AI分析，已自动检索了多页数据但未找到带摘要的论文</span>
   687	          
   688	          <div className="ptv-empty-suggestions">
   689	            <p className="ptv-suggestion-title">建议尝试以下方式：</p>
   690	            <ul className="ptv-suggestion-list">
   691	              <li>使用更精准的英文学术关键词进行搜索</li>
   692	              <li>尝试缩小搜索范围或添加筛选条件</li>
   693	              <li>检查搜索词是否有拼写错误</li>
   694	            </ul>
   695	            
   696	            {/* 如果有AI翻译的搜索词且搜索策略是combined，显示推荐搜索按钮 */}
   697	            {hasRecommendedQuery && (
   698	              <div className="ptv-recommended-search">
   699	                <p className="ptv-recommended-label">推荐使用AI优化后的搜索词：</p>
   700	                <div className="ptv-recommended-query">
   701	                  <span className="ptv-query-text">{translatedQuery}</span>
   702	                  <button 
   703	                    className="ptv-use-query-btn"
   704	                    onClick={() => onSearchWithQuery(translatedQuery)}
   705	                  >
   706	                    使用此搜索词
   707	                  </button>
   708	                </div>
   709	              </div>
   710	            )}
   711	          </div>
   712	        </div>
   713	      </div>
   714	    );
   715	  }
   716	
   717	  return (
   718	    <div className="ptv-container">
   719	
   720	      {/* 重新加载提示 */}
   721	      {reloadNotice && (
   722	        <div className={`ptv-reload-notice ptv-reload-notice-${reloadNotice.type}`}>
   723	          <div className="ptv-reload-notice-icon">
   724	            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   725	              <path d="M23 4v6h-6M1 20v-6h6"/>
   726	              <path d="M3.51 9a9 9 0 0 1 14.85-3.36L23 10M1 14l4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 0 20.49 15"/>
   727	            </svg>
   728	          </div>
   729	          <span className="ptv-reload-notice-text">{reloadNotice.message}</span>
   730	        </div>
   731	      )}
   732	
   733	      <div className="ptv-table-wrapper" ref={tableWrapperRef}>
   734	        <table className="ptv-table" ref={tableRef}>
   735	          <thead>
   736	            <tr>
   737	              {columns.map(col => (
   738	                <th 
   739	                  key={col.key} 
   740	                  ref={el => { if (!col.sticky) columnRefs.current[col.key] = el; }}
   741	                  className={`${col.sticky ? 'ptv-sticky-col' : ''} ${!col.sticky ? 'ptv-clickable-header' : ''} ${selectedDimensionKey === col.key ? 'ptv-selected-header' : ''}`}
   742	                  onClick={() => handleColumnHeaderClick(col.key)}
   743	                >
   744	                  {col.label}
   745	                  {selectedDimensionKey === col.key && (
   746	                    <span className="ptv-selected-indicator"></span>
   747	                  )}
   748	                </th>
   749	              ))}
   750	            </tr>
   751	          </thead>
   752	          <tbody>
   753	            {displayedPapers.map((paper, index) => {
   754	              const analysis = analysisResults[paper.paperId];
   755	              const isLoading = loadingPapers[paper.paperId];
   756	              // 未登录用户第5行之后需要限制
   757	              const isRestricted = !isAuthenticated && index >= GUEST_MAX_PAPERS;
   758	
   759	              return (
   760	                <tr 
   761	                  key={paper.paperId || index}
   762	                  ref={el => paperRefs.current[paper.paperId] = el}
   763	                  data-paper-id={paper.paperId}
   764	                  className={isRestricted ? 'ptv-restricted-row' : ''}
   765	                >
   766	                  {/* 论文列 - 固定，使用类似列表的布局 */}
   767	                  <td className="ptv-sticky-col ptv-paper-cell">
   768	                    <div className="ptv-paper-info">
   769	                      {/* 标题 */}
   770	                      <h4 
   771	                        className="ptv-paper-title"
   772	                        onClick={() => onPaperClick && onPaperClick(paper)}
   773	                      >
   774	                        {paper.title || 'Untitled'}
   775	                      </h4>
   776	                      
   777	                      {/* 作者标签 */}
   778	                      {paper.authors && paper.authors.length > 0 && (
   779	                        <div className="ptv-authors-row">
   780	                          {paper.authors.slice(0, 3).map((author, idx) => (
   781	                            <span key={idx} className="ptv-author-tag">{author.name}</span>
   782	                          ))}
   783	                          {paper.authors.length > 3 && (
   784	                            <span className="ptv-author-tag ptv-author-more">+{paper.authors.length - 3}</span>
   785	                          )}
   786	                        </div>
   787	                      )}
   788	                      
   789	                      {/* 期刊/年份/引用 */}
   790	                      <div className="ptv-paper-meta">
   791	                        {paper.venue && (
   792	                          <span className="ptv-venue">{paper.venue}</span>
   793	                        )}
   794	                        {paper.year && (
   795	                          <span className="ptv-year">{paper.year}年</span>
   796	                        )}
   797	                        {paper.citationCount > 0 && (
   798	                          <span className="ptv-citations">{paper.citationCount} 被引</span>
   799	                        )}
   800	                      </div>
   801	                      
   802	                      {/* 摘要缩略 */}
   803	                      {paper.abstract && (
   804	                        <p className="ptv-abstract">
   805	                          {paper.abstract.length > 150 
   806	                            ? paper.abstract.substring(0, 150) + '...' 
   807	                            : paper.abstract}
   808	                        </p>
   809	                      )}
   810	                    </div>
   811	                  </td>
   812	
   813	                  {/* 动态渲染分析维度列 */}
   814	                  {isRestricted ? (
   815	                    // 未登录受限行：合并所有分析列，只显示一个登录提示
   816	                    <td 
   817	                      colSpan={columns.filter(col => !col.sticky).length} 
   818	                      className="ptv-restricted-cell ptv-restricted-merged"
   819	                      onClick={handleOpenAuthModal}
   820	                    >
   821	                      <div className="ptv-restricted-overlay">
   822	                        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   823	                          <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"/>
   824	                          <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"/>
   825	                        </svg>
   826	                        <span>登录查看分析结果</span>
   827	                      </div>
   828	                    </td>
   829	                  ) : (
   830	                    // 正常渲染每个分析列
   831	                    columns.filter(col => !col.sticky).map(col => (
   832	                      <td key={col.key}>
   833	                        {renderCell(paper.paperId, col.key, getAnalysisValue(analysis, col.key), isLoading)}
   834	                      </td>
   835	                    ))
   836	                  )}
   837	                </tr>
   838	              );
   839	            })}
   840	          </tbody>
   841	        </table>
   842	      </div>
   843	
   844	      {/* 未登录用户的登录引导 */}
   845	      {!isAuthenticated && displayedPapers.length > GUEST_MAX_PAPERS && (
   846	        <div className="ptv-guest-prompt">
   847	          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   848	            <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"/>
   849	            <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"/>
   850	          </svg>
   851	          <span>登录后查看全部分析结果</span>
   852	          <button className="ptv-guest-login-btn" onClick={handleOpenAuthModal}>
   853	            登录 / 注册
   854	          </button>
   855	        </div>
   856	      )}
   857	
   858	      {/* 登录弹窗 - 使用 Portal 渲染到 body，确保相对于整个浏览器窗口定位 */}
   859	      {showAuthModal && createPortal(
   860	        <Suspense fallback={null}>
   861	          <AuthModal
   862	            isOpen={showAuthModal}
   863	            onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
   864	            onLoginSuccess={handleLoginSuccess}
   865	          />
   866	        </Suspense>,
   867	        document.body
   868	      )}
   869	
   870	      {/* 加载更多按钮 - 仅登录用户可见（或传入数据模式下由外部控制），可通过 hideLoadMore 隐藏 */}
   871	      {canLoadMore && !hideLoadMore && (
   872	        <div className="ptv-load-more">
   873	          <button 
   874	            className="ptv-load-more-btn"
   875	            onClick={handleLoadMore}
   876	            disabled={isLoadingMore}
   877	          >
   878	            {isLoadingMore ? (
   879	              <>
   880	                <div className="ptv-loading-spinner"></div>
   881	                <span>加载中...</span>
   882	              </>
   883	            ) : (
   884	              <>
   885	                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   886	                  <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" />
   887	                </svg>
   888	                <span>加载更多论文</span>
   889	              </>
   890	            )}
   891	          </button>
   892	          {remainingHint && (
   893	            <span className="ptv-load-more-hint">{remainingHint}</span>
   894	          )}
   895	        </div>
   896	      )}
   897	    </div>
   898	  );
   899	};
   900	
   901	export default PaperTableView;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================

     9	
    10	import React from 'react';
    11	import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    13	
    14	/**
    15	 * ProtectedRoute - 保护需要登录才能访问的路由
    16	 *
    17	 * 如果用户未登录，自动重定向到首页
    18	 */
    19	const ProtectedRoute = ({ children }) => {
    20	  const { isAuthenticated, loading } = useAuth();
    21	  const location = useLocation();
    22	
    23	  // 等待认证状态加载完成
    24	  if (loading) {
    25	    return null; // 或者返回一个加载指示器
    26	  }
    27	
    28	  // 如果未登录，重定向到首页
    29	  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    30	    // 使用 replace 避免在浏览器历史中留下记录
    31	    return <Navigate to="/" replace state={{ from: location }} />;
    32	  }
    33	
    34	  // 已登录，渲染子组件
    35	  return children;
    36	};
    37	
    38	export default ProtectedRoute;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React from 'react';
    11	import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet-async';
    12	
    13	/**
    14	 * SEO Component - 用于管理页面的 meta 标签和结构化数据
    15	 *
    16	 * @param {string} title - 页面标题
    17	 * @param {string} description - 页面描述
    18	 * @param {string} keywords - 关键词（可选）
    19	 * @param {string} canonical - 规范链接
    20	 * @param {string} ogType - Open Graph类型（默认: website）
    21	 * @param {string} ogImage - 社交分享图片
    22	 * @param {Object} structuredData - 结构化数据（JSON-LD）
    23	 */
    24	const SEO = ({
    25	  title = 'Scholay - AI驱动的学术搜索平台',
    26	  description = 'Scholay是一个创新的学术搜索平台，提供AI驱动的文献检索、智能论文分析、引用图谱可视化等功能。',
    27	  keywords,
    28	  canonical,
    29	  ogType = 'website',
    30	  ogImage = '/og-image.png',
    31	  structuredData,
    32	  noindex = false,
    33	}) => {
    34	  const siteUrl = 'https://www.scholay.com';
    35	  const fullCanonical = canonical ? `${siteUrl}${canonical}` : siteUrl;
    36	  const fullOgImage = ogImage.startsWith('http') ? ogImage : `${siteUrl}${ogImage}`;
    37	
    38	  return (
    39	    <Helmet>
    40	      {/* Primary Meta Tags */}
    41	      <title>{title}</title>
    42	      <meta name="title" content={title} />
    43	      <meta name="description" content={description} />
    44	      {keywords && <meta name="keywords" content={keywords} />}
    45	      <link rel="canonical" href={fullCanonical} />
    46	
    47	      {/* Robots */}
    48	      {noindex ? (
    49	        <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow" />
    50	      ) : (
    51	        <meta name="robots" content="index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1" />
    52	      )}
    53	
    54	      {/* Open Graph / Facebook */}
    55	      <meta property="og:type" content={ogType} />
    56	      <meta property="og:url" content={fullCanonical} />
    57	      <meta property="og:title" content={title} />
    58	      <meta property="og:description" content={description} />
    59	      <meta property="og:image" content={fullOgImage} />
    60	      <meta property="og:site_name" content="Scholay" />
    61	
    62	      {/* Twitter Card */}
    63	      <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
    64	      <meta name="twitter:url" content={fullCanonical} />
    65	      <meta name="twitter:title" content={title} />
    66	      <meta name="twitter:description" content={description} />
    67	      <meta name="twitter:image" content={fullOgImage} />
    68	
    69	      {/* Structured Data */}
    70	      {structuredData && (
    71	        <script type="application/ld+json">
    72	          {JSON.stringify(structuredData)}
    73	        </script>
    74	      )}
    75	    </Helmet>
    76	  );
    77	};
    78	
    79	export default SEO;

    10	import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import YearHistogram from './YearHistogram';

    14	const SearchFilters = ({ filters, onFiltersChange, isExpanded, onToggle }) => {
    15	  const filtersPanelRef = useRef(null);
    16	  const overlayRef = useRef(null);
    17	
    18	  const handleOverlayClick = (e) => {
    19	    if (e.target === overlayRef.current) {
    20	      onToggle();
    21	    }
    22	  };
    23	
    24	  useEffect(() => {
    25	    const updateMaxHeight = () => {
    26	      if (filtersPanelRef.current && isExpanded) {
    27	        const rect = filtersPanelRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    28	        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
    29	        const availableHeight = viewportHeight - rect.top - 20; // 20px bottom padding
    30	        filtersPanelRef.current.style.maxHeight = `${Math.max(200, availableHeight)}px`;
    31	      }
    32	    };
    33	
    34	    if (isExpanded) {
    35	      // Update on mount and when expanded
    36	      setTimeout(updateMaxHeight, 0);
    37	
    38	      // Update on window resize
    39	      window.addEventListener('resize', updateMaxHeight);
    40	      return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', updateMaxHeight);
    41	    }
    42	  }, [isExpanded]);
    43	
    44	  const publicationTypes = [
    45	    { value: 'JournalArticle', label: 'Journal Article' },
    46	    { value: 'Conference', label: 'Conference' },
    47	    { value: 'Book', label: 'Book' },
    48	    { value: 'BookSection', label: 'Book Section' },
    49	    { value: 'Dataset', label: 'Dataset' },
    50	  ];
    51	
    52	  const fieldsOfStudy = [
    53	    { value: 'Computer Science', label: '计算机科学' },
    54	    { value: 'Medicine', label: '医学' },
    55	    { value: 'Biology', label: '生物学' },
    56	    { value: 'Chemistry', label: '化学' },
    57	    { value: 'Physics', label: '物理学' },
    58	    { value: 'Mathematics', label: '数学' },
    59	    { value: 'Engineering', label: '工程学' },
    60	    { value: 'Materials Science', label: '材料科学' },
    61	    { value: 'Economics', label: '经济学' },
    62	    { value: 'Psychology', label: '心理学' },
    63	    { value: 'Sociology', label: '社会学' },
    64	    { value: 'Political Science', label: '政治学' },
    65	    { value: 'Business', label: '商业' },
    66	    { value: 'Environmental Science', label: '环境科学' },
    67	    { value: 'Geography', label: '地理学' },
    68	    { value: 'History', label: '历史学' },
    69	    { value: 'Philosophy', label: '哲学' },
    70	    { value: 'Art', label: '艺术' },
    71	  ];
    72	
    73	  const handleYearChange = (yearFrom, yearTo) => {
    74	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, yearFrom: String(yearFrom), yearTo: String(yearTo) });
    75	  };
    76	
    77	  const handlePublicationTypeToggle = (type) => {
    78	    const current = filters.publicationTypes || [];
    79	    const updated = current.includes(type)
    80	      ? current.filter(t => t !== type)
    81	      : [...current, type];
    82	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, publicationTypes: updated });
    83	  };
    84	
    85	  const handleFieldOfStudyToggle = (field) => {
    86	    const current = filters.fieldsOfStudy || [];
    87	    const updated = current.includes(field)
    88	      ? current.filter(f => f !== field)
    89	      : [...current, field];
    90	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, fieldsOfStudy: updated });
    91	  };
    92	
    93	  const handleClearFieldsOfStudy = () => {
    94	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, fieldsOfStudy: [] });
    95	  };
    96	
    97	  const handleOpenAccessToggle = () => {
    98	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, openAccessPdf: filters.openAccessPdf ? '' : 'true' });
    99	  };
   100	
   101	  const handleVenueChange = (e) => {
   102	    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, venue: e.target.value });
   103	  };
   104	
   105	  const handleClearFilters = () => {
   106	    onFiltersChange({
   107	      yearFrom: '',
   108	      yearTo: '',
   109	      publicationTypes: [],
   110	      fieldsOfStudy: [],
   111	      openAccessPdf: '',
   112	      venue: '',
   113	    });
   114	  };
   115	
   116	  const hasActiveFilters = () => {
   117	    return filters.yearFrom || filters.yearTo ||
   118	           (filters.publicationTypes && filters.publicationTypes.length > 0) ||
   119	           (filters.fieldsOfStudy && filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) ||
   120	           filters.openAccessPdf || filters.venue;
   121	  };
   122	
   123	  return (
   124	    <div className={`filters-container ${isExpanded ? 'expanded' : ''}`}>
   125	      {/* 蒙层 */}

   137	          清除全部
   138	        </button>
   139	      </div>

   149	          />
   150	        </div>
   151	
   152	        {/* Open Access - Toggle Switch */}
   153	        <div className="filter-group">
   154	          <div className="open-access-switch-container">
   155	            <span className="switch-label">仅显示开放获取论文 (Open Access)</span>
   156	            <label className="toggle-switch">
   157	              <input
   158	                type="checkbox"
   159	                checked={filters.openAccessPdf === 'true'}
   160	                onChange={handleOpenAccessToggle}
   161	              />
   162	              <span className="toggle-slider"></span>
   163	            </label>
   164	          </div>
   165	        </div>
   166	
   167	        {/* Fields of Study */}
   168	        <div className="filter-group">
   169	          <div className="filter-label-row">
   170	            <label className="filter-label">研究领域</label>
   171	            {filters.fieldsOfStudy && filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0 && (
   172	              <button
   173	                type="button"
   174	                className="clear-section-btn"
   175	                onClick={handleClearFieldsOfStudy}
   176	              >
   177	                清除
   178	              </button>
   179	            )}
   180	          </div>
   181	          <div className="checkbox-list scrollable">
   182	            {fieldsOfStudy.map(field => {
   183	              const isChecked = (filters.fieldsOfStudy || []).includes(field.value);
   184	              return (
   185	                <label key={field.value} className="checkbox-item">
   186	                  <input
   187	                    type="checkbox"
   188	                    checked={isChecked}
   189	                    onChange={() => handleFieldOfStudyToggle(field.value)}
   190	                  />
   191	                  <span>{field.label}</span>
   192	                </label>
   193	              );
   194	            })}
   195	          </div>
   196	        </div>
   197	      </div>

   199	      {/* 底部应用按钮 */}
   200	      <div className="filters-footer">
   201	        <button
   202	          className="apply-filters-btn"
   203	          onClick={onToggle}
   204	        >
   205	          应用筛选
   206	        </button>
   207	        </div>
   208	      </div>
   209	    </div>
   210	  );

文件: frontend-user/src/components/SearchSuggestions.js

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	import { publicScholarAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import './SearchSuggestions.css';
    13	
    14	/**
    15	 * SearchSuggestions Component
    16	 * 显示搜索建议下拉框，包含论文标题匹配和作者搜索结果
    17	 * 
    18	 * Props:
    19	 * - query: 当前搜索查询
    20	 * - onSelectPaper: 选择论文建议时的回调 (paper) => void
    21	 * - onSelectAuthor: 选择作者建议时的回调 (author) => void
    22	 * - onClose: 关闭下拉框的回调
    23	 * - visible: 是否显示下拉框
    24	 * - inputRef: 输入框的ref，用于定位下拉框
    25	 */
    26	const SearchSuggestions = ({ 
    27	  query, 
    28	  onSelectPaper, 
    29	  onSelectAuthor, 
    30	  onClose, 
    31	  visible,
    32	  inputRef
    33	}) => {
    34	  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState({ papers: [], authors: [] });
    35	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    36	  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
    37	  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(-1);
    38	  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);
    39	  const debounceTimerRef = useRef(null);
    40	
    41	  // 计算总建议数量
    42	  const totalSuggestions = suggestions.papers.length + suggestions.authors.length;
    43	
    44	  // 获取搜索建议
    45	  const fetchSuggestions = useCallback(async (searchQuery) => {
    46	    if (!searchQuery || searchQuery.trim().length < 2) {
    47	      setSuggestions({ papers: [], authors: [] });
    48	      return;
    49	    }
    50	
    51	    setLoading(true);
    52	    setError(null);
    53	
    54	    try {
    55	      const response = await publicScholarAPI.getSearchSuggestions(searchQuery.trim(), 5, 5);
    56	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    57	        setSuggestions({
    58	          papers: response.data.data.papers || [],
    59	          authors: response.data.data.authors || []
    60	        });
    61	      } else {
    62	        setSuggestions({ papers: [], authors: [] });
    63	      }
    64	    } catch (err) {
    65	      console.error('Failed to fetch search suggestions:', err);
    66	      setError('获取搜索建议失败');
    67	      setSuggestions({ papers: [], authors: [] });
    68	    } finally {
    69	      setLoading(false);
    70	    }
    71	  }, []);
    72	
    73	  // 防抖处理查询变化
    74	  useEffect(() => {
    75	    if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
    76	      clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
    77	    }
    78	
    79	    if (!visible || !query || query.trim().length < 2) {
    80	      setSuggestions({ papers: [], authors: [] });
    81	      return;
    82	    }
    83	
    84	    debounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    85	      fetchSuggestions(query);
    86	    }, 300); // 300ms 防抖
    87	
    88	    return () => {
    89	      if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
    90	        clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
    91	      }
    92	    };
    93	  }, [query, visible, fetchSuggestions]);
    94	
    95	  // 重置选中索引当建议变化时
    96	  useEffect(() => {
    97	    setSelectedIndex(-1);
    98	  }, [suggestions]);
    99	
   100	  // 点击外部关闭
   101	  useEffect(() => {
   102	    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
   103	      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target) &&
   104	          inputRef?.current && !inputRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
   105	        onClose?.();
   106	      }
   107	    };
   108	
   109	    if (visible) {
   110	      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
   111	    }
   112	
   113	    return () => {
   114	      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
   115	    };
   116	  }, [visible, onClose, inputRef]);
   117	
   118	  // 键盘导航
   119	  const handleKeyDown = useCallback((event) => {
   120	    if (!visible || totalSuggestions === 0) return;
   121	
   122	    switch (event.key) {
   123	      case 'ArrowDown':
   124	        event.preventDefault();
   125	        setSelectedIndex(prev => 
   126	          prev < totalSuggestions - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0
   127	        );
   128	        break;
   129	      case 'ArrowUp':
   130	        event.preventDefault();
   131	        setSelectedIndex(prev => 
   132	          prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : totalSuggestions - 1
   133	        );
   134	        break;
   135	      case 'Enter':
   136	        event.preventDefault();
   137	        if (selectedIndex >= 0) {
   138	          const papersCount = suggestions.papers.length;
   139	          if (selectedIndex < papersCount) {
   140	            onSelectPaper?.(suggestions.papers[selectedIndex]);
   141	          } else {
   142	            onSelectAuthor?.(suggestions.authors[selectedIndex - papersCount]);
   143	          }
   144	        }
   145	        break;
   146	      case 'Escape':
   147	        onClose?.();
   148	        break;
   149	      default:
   150	        break;
   151	    }
   152	  }, [visible, totalSuggestions, selectedIndex, suggestions, onSelectPaper, onSelectAuthor, onClose]);
   153	
   154	  // 绑定键盘事件到输入框
   155	  useEffect(() => {
   156	    const input = inputRef?.current;
   157	    if (input && visible) {
   158	      input.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
   159	    }
   160	    return () => {
   161	      if (input) {
   162	        input.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
   163	      }
   164	    };
   165	  }, [inputRef, visible, handleKeyDown]);
   166	
   167	  // 处理论文选择
   168	  const handlePaperClick = (paper) => {
   169	    onSelectPaper?.(paper);
   170	    onClose?.();
   171	  };
   172	
   173	  // 处理作者选择
   174	  const handleAuthorClick = (author) => {
   175	    onSelectAuthor?.(author);
   176	    onClose?.();
   177	  };
   178	
   179	  // 计算弹窗最大高度，确保不超出视口底部
   180	  const [maxHeight, setMaxHeight] = useState(400);
   181	
   182	  useEffect(() => {
   183	    if (visible && dropdownRef.current) {
   184	      const updateMaxHeight = () => {
   185	        const dropdown = dropdownRef.current;
   186	        if (dropdown) {
   187	          const rect = dropdown.getBoundingClientRect();
   188	          const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
   189	          // 计算弹窗顶部到视口底部的距离，留出20px的边距
   190	          const availableHeight = viewportHeight - rect.top - 20;
   191	          // 限制在100-500px之间
   192	          setMaxHeight(Math.max(100, Math.min(500, availableHeight)));
   193	        }
   194	      };
   195	      
   196	      // 初始计算
   197	      setTimeout(updateMaxHeight, 0);
   198	      
   199	      // 监听窗口大小变化
   200	      window.addEventListener('resize', updateMaxHeight);
   201	      return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', updateMaxHeight);
   202	    }
   203	  }, [visible, totalSuggestions]);
   204	
   205	  // 不显示时返回null
   206	  if (!visible) return null;
   207	
   208	  // 查询太短时不显示
   209	  if (query?.trim().length < 2) return null;
   210	
   211	  // 加载中时不显示弹窗（等结果返回后再显示）
   212	  if (loading) return null;
   213	
   214	  // 没有任何结果时不显示弹窗
   215	  if (totalSuggestions === 0) return null;
   216	
   217	  return (
   218	    <div className="search-suggestions-dropdown" ref={dropdownRef} style={{ maxHeight: `${maxHeight}px` }}>
   219	      {error && (
   220	        <div className="suggestions-error">
   221	          {error}
   222	        </div>
   223	      )}
   224	
   225	      {/* 可滚动的内容区域 */}
   226	      <div className="suggestions-content">
   227	        {suggestions.papers.length > 0 && (
   228	        <div className="suggestions-section">
   229	          <div className="suggestions-section-header">
   230	            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   231	              <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
   232	              <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
   233	              <line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/>
   234	              <line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"/>
   235	              <polyline points="10 9 9 9 8 9"/>
   236	            </svg>
   237	            <span>论文匹配</span>
   238	          </div>
   239	          <div className="suggestions-list">
   240	            {suggestions.papers.map((paper, index) => (
   241	              <div
   242	                key={paper.id}
   243	                className={`suggestion-item paper-item ${selectedIndex === index ? 'selected' : ''}`}
   244	                onClick={() => handlePaperClick(paper)}
   245	                onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(index)}
   246	              >
   247	                <div className="suggestion-content">
   248	                  <div className="suggestion-title">{paper.title}</div>
   249	                  <div className="suggestion-meta">{paper.authorsYear}</div>
   250	                </div>
   251	              </div>
   252	            ))}
   253	          </div>
   254	        </div>
   255	      )}
   256	
   257	        {suggestions.authors.length > 0 && (
   258	        <div className="suggestions-section">
   259	          <div className="suggestions-section-header">
   260	            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   261	              <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
   262	              <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/>
   263	            </svg>
   264	            <span>作者</span>
   265	          </div>
   266	          <div className="suggestions-list">
   267	            {suggestions.authors.map((author, index) => {
   268	              const actualIndex = suggestions.papers.length + index;
   269	              return (
   270	                <div
   271	                  key={author.authorId}
   272	                  className={`suggestion-item author-item ${selectedIndex === actualIndex ? 'selected' : ''}`}
   273	                  onClick={() => handleAuthorClick(author)}
   274	                  onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(actualIndex)}
   275	                >
   276	                  <div className="suggestion-content">
   277	                    <div className="suggestion-title">{author.name}</div>
   278	                    {(author.affiliations?.length > 0 || author.paperCount > 0) && (
   279	                      <div className="suggestion-meta">
   280	                        {author.affiliations?.[0] && <span>{author.affiliations[0]}</span>}
   281	                        {author.paperCount > 0 && (
   282	                          <span className="author-stats">
   283	                            {author.paperCount} 篇论文
   284	                            {author.citationCount > 0 && ` · ${author.citationCount} 次引用`}
   285	                          </span>
   286	                        )}
   287	                      </div>
   288	                    )}
   289	                  </div>
   290	                </div>
   291	              );
   292	            })}
   293	          </div>
   294	        </div>
   295	      )}
   296	      </div>
   297	
   298	      {/* 固定在底部的提示 */}
   299	      {query?.trim().length >= 2 && (
   300	        <div className="suggestions-footer">
   301	          <span>按 Enter 搜索 "{query}"</span>
   302	        </div>
   303	      )}
   304	    </div>
   305	  );
   306	};
   307	
   308	export default SearchSuggestions;
   309

    38	    topics: 'Big Data, Healthcare'
    39	  },
    40	];

    42	const SimilarPapersGuide = ({ onClose, onTryIt, onDismiss, targetRef }) => {
    43	  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
    44	  const [showingRow, setShowingRow] = useState(-1);
    45	  const [arrowPosition, setArrowPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });
    46	  const [highlightRect, setHighlightRect] = useState(null);
    47	  const [modalPosition, setModalPosition] = useState({ top: 'auto', left: 'auto', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' });
    48	
    49	  useEffect(() => {
    50	    // 计算箭头位置和弹窗位置（弹窗在标签右侧，箭头从弹窗左侧水平指向标签）
    51	    const calculatePositions = () => {
    52	      if (targetRef?.current) {
    53	        const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    54	        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
    55	        const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
    56	        
    57	        // 标签中心点位置
    58	        const tabCenterY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
    59	        const tabRight = rect.right;
    60	        
    61	        // 箭头+线的总宽度
    62	        const arrowTotalWidth = 70; // 60px line + 10px arrow
    63	        const gapToArrow = 8;
    64	        
    65	        // 弹窗左边缘位置 = 标签右边 + 间距 + 箭头宽度
    66	        const modalLeftX = tabRight + gapToArrow + arrowTotalWidth;
    67	        
    68	        // 弹窗垂直位置 - 与标签中心对齐
    69	        let modalCenterY = tabCenterY;
    70	        
    71	        // 确保弹窗不超出顶部和底部
    72	        const modalHeight = 500;
    73	        const minY = modalHeight / 2 + 20;
    74	        const maxY = viewportHeight - modalHeight / 2 - 20;
    75	        modalCenterY = Math.max(minY, Math.min(maxY, modalCenterY));
    76	        
    77	        // 箭头位置 - 箭头尖端靠近标签右侧
    78	        setArrowPosition({
    79	          top: tabCenterY,
    80	          left: tabRight + gapToArrow, // 箭头尖端距离标签8px
    81	        });
    82	        
    83	        // 弹窗位置
    84	        setModalPosition({
    85	          top: `${modalCenterY}px`,
    86	          left: `${modalLeftX}px`,
    87	          transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
    88	        });
    89	      }
    90	    };
    91	    
    92	    calculatePositions();
    93	    
    94	    // 监听窗口大小变化
    95	    window.addEventListener('resize', calculatePositions);
    96	    
    97	    // 延迟显示动画
    98	    setTimeout(() => setVisible(true), 100);
    99	    
   100	    // 逐行显示动画
   101	    let row = 0;
   102	    const timer = setInterval(() => {
   103	      setShowingRow(row);
   104	      row++;
   105	      if (row >= mockPapers.length) {
   106	        clearInterval(timer);
   107	      }
   108	    }, 500);
   109	    
   110	    return () => {
   111	      clearInterval(timer);
   112	      window.removeEventListener('resize', calculatePositions);
   113	    };
   114	
   115	    return () => clearInterval(timer);
   116	  }, [targetRef]);
   117	
   118	  // 计算高亮区域
   119	  useEffect(() => {
   120	    if (targetRef?.current && visible) {
   121	      const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
   122	      setHighlightRect({
   123	        top: rect.top - 6,
   124	        left: rect.left - 6,
   125	        width: rect.width + 12,
   126	        height: rect.height + 12,
   127	      });
   128	    }
   129	  }, [targetRef, visible]);
   130	
   131	  // X 按钮 - 只关闭弹窗，下次还会显示
   132	  const handleDismiss = () => {
   133	    setVisible(false);
   134	    setTimeout(() => {
   135	      if (onDismiss) {
   136	        onDismiss();
   137	      } else {
   138	        onClose();
   139	      }
   140	    }, 200);
   141	  };
   142	
   143	  // "稍后再说" 按钮 - 关闭并记住，下次不再显示
   144	  const handleClose = () => {
   145	    setVisible(false);
   146	    setTimeout(onClose, 200);
   147	  };
   148	
   149	  // "立即体验" 按钮
   150	  const handleTryIt = () => {
   151	    setVisible(false);
   152	    setTimeout(() => {
   153	      onClose();
   154	      if (onTryIt) onTryIt();
   155	    }, 200);
   156	  };
   157	
   158	  return (
   159	    <div className={`spg-overlay ${visible ? 'spg-visible' : ''}`}>
   160	      {/* 遮罩层 - 点击蒙层关闭但下次还会显示 */}
   161	      <div 
   162	        className="spg-mask"
   163	        onClick={handleDismiss}
   164	        style={highlightRect ? {
   165	          clipPath: `polygon(
   166	            0% 0%, 
   167	            0% 100%, 
   168	            ${highlightRect.left}px 100%, 
   169	            ${highlightRect.left}px ${highlightRect.top}px, 
   170	            ${highlightRect.left + highlightRect.width}px ${highlightRect.top}px, 
   171	            ${highlightRect.left + highlightRect.width}px ${highlightRect.top + highlightRect.height}px, 
   172	            ${highlightRect.left}px ${highlightRect.top + highlightRect.height}px, 
   173	            ${highlightRect.left}px 100%, 
   174	            100% 100%, 
   175	            100% 0%
   176	          )`
   177	        } : {}}
   178	      />
   179	      
   180	      {/* 高亮边框 */}
   181	      {highlightRect && (
   182	        <div 
   183	          className={`spg-highlight ${visible ? 'spg-highlight-show' : ''}`}
   184	          style={{
   185	            top: highlightRect.top,
   186	            left: highlightRect.left,
   187	            width: highlightRect.width,
   188	            height: highlightRect.height,
   189	          }}
   190	        />
   191	      )}
   192	      
   193	      {/* 指向标签的箭头 - 水平方向，从右向左指 */}
   194	      {arrowPosition.left > 0 && (
   195	        <div 
   196	          className={`spg-pointer ${visible ? 'spg-pointer-show' : ''}`}
   197	          style={{ 
   198	            top: arrowPosition.top, 
   199	            left: arrowPosition.left,
   200	            transform: 'translateY(-50%)', // 垂直居中
   201	          }}
   202	        >
   203	          <div className="spg-pointer-arrow" />
   204	          <div className="spg-pointer-line" />
   205	        </div>
   206	      )}
   207	      
   208	      <div 
   209	        className="spg-modal" 
   210	        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
   211	        style={{
   212	          position: 'fixed',
   213	          top: modalPosition.top,
   214	          left: modalPosition.left,
   215	          transform: modalPosition.transform,
   216	        }}
   217	      >
   218	        {/* 关闭按钮 - 点击后下次还会显示 */}
   219	        <button className="spg-close-btn" onClick={handleDismiss}>
   220	          <X size={18} />
   221	        </button>
   222	
   223	        {/* 头部 */}
   224	        <div className="spg-header">
   225	          <div className="spg-badge">新功能</div>
   226	          <h3>发现相似论文</h3>

   259	
   260	        {/* 功能亮点 */}
   261	        <div className="spg-features">

   264	              <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>

   266	            </svg>

   272	              <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>

   275	          </div>
   276	          <div className="spg-feature">
   277	            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   278	              <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
   279	              <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
   280	            </svg>

   282	          </div>
   283	        </div>
   284	
   285	        {/* 操作按钮 */}
   286	        <div className="spg-actions">
   287	          <button className="spg-btn-skip" onClick={handleClose}>
   288	            稍后再说
   289	          </button>
   290	          <button className="spg-btn-try" onClick={handleTryIt}>
   291	            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   292	              <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"/>
   293	              <path d="M8.59 13.51l6.83 3.98M15.41 6.51l-6.82 3.98"/>
   294	            </svg>
   295	            立即体验
   296	          </button>
   297	        </div>
   298	      </div>
   299	    </div>
   300	  );
   301	};

   303	export default SimilarPapersGuide;

    10	import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, forwardRef, useImperativeHandle } from 'react';
    11	import './SliderCaptcha.css';
    12	
    13	const SliderCaptcha = forwardRef(({ onSuccess, onFail }, ref) => {
    14	  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
    15	  const [position, setPosition] = useState(0);
    16	  const [verified, setVerified] = useState(false);
    17	  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
    18	
    19	  const sliderRef = useRef(null);
    20	  const containerRef = useRef(null);
    21	  const startXRef = useRef(0);
    22	  const currentPositionRef = useRef(0);
    23	  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
    24	
    25	  const handleStart = useCallback((clientX) => {
    26	    if (verified || failed) return;
    27	    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    28	    setIsDragging(true);
    29	    startXRef.current = clientX - currentPositionRef.current;
    30	  }, [verified, failed]);
    31	
    32	  const handleMove = useCallback((clientX) => {
    33	    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    34	
    35	    const container = containerRef.current;
    36	    if (!container) return;
    37	
    38	    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    39	    let newPosition = clientX - startXRef.current;
    40	    newPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(newPosition, maxMove));
    41	
    42	    currentPositionRef.current = newPosition;
    43	    setPosition(newPosition);
    44	  }, []);
    45	
    46	  const handleEnd = useCallback(() => {
    47	    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    48	    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    49	    setIsDragging(false);
    50	
    51	    const container = containerRef.current;
    52	    if (!container) return;
    53	
    54	    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    55	    const currentPercent = (currentPositionRef.current / maxMove) * 100;
    56	
    57	    // 验证是否滑动到最右边 (95%以上)
    58	    if (currentPercent >= 95) {
    59	      setVerified(true);
    60	      // 自动吸附到最右边
    61	      setPosition(maxMove);
    62	      currentPositionRef.current = maxMove;
    63	      if (onSuccess) {
    64	        setTimeout(() => onSuccess(), 300);
    65	      }
    66	    } else {
    67	      setFailed(true);
    68	      if (onFail) {
    69	        onFail();
    70	      }
    71	      setTimeout(() => {
    72	        setPosition(0);
    73	        currentPositionRef.current = 0;
    74	        setFailed(false);
    75	      }, 1000);
    76	    }
    77	  }, [onSuccess, onFail]);
    78	
    79	  // 鼠标事件
    80	  const handleMouseDown = useCallback((e) => {
    81	    e.preventDefault();
    82	    handleStart(e.clientX);
    83	  }, [handleStart]);
    84	
    85	  // 触摸事件
    86	  const handleTouchStart = useCallback((e) => {
    87	    e.preventDefault();
    88	    if (e.touches.length > 0) {
    89	      handleStart(e.touches[0].clientX);
    90	    }
    91	  }, [handleStart]);
    92	
    93	  useEffect(() => {
    94	    const onMouseMove = (e) => handleMove(e.clientX);
    95	    const onTouchMove = (e) => {
    96	      if (e.touches.length > 0) {
    97	        handleMove(e.touches[0].clientX);
    98	      }
    99	    };
   100	    const onEnd = () => handleEnd();
   101	
   102	    if (isDragging) {
   103	      document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
   104	      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);
   105	      document.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: false });
   106	      document.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd);
   107	
   108	      return () => {
   109	        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
   110	        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);
   111	        document.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
   112	        document.removeEventListener('touchend', onEnd);
   113	      };
   114	    }
   115	  }, [isDragging, handleMove, handleEnd]);
   116	
   117	  const reset = useCallback(() => {
   118	    setPosition(0);
   119	    currentPositionRef.current = 0;
   120	    setVerified(false);
   121	    setFailed(false);
   122	    setIsDragging(false);
   123	    isDraggingRef.current = false;
   124	  }, []);
   125	
   126	  // Expose reset method to parent component via ref
   127	  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
   128	    reset
   129	  }), [reset]);
   130	
   131	  // 计算进度百分比用于显示
   132	  const getProgressPercent = () => {
   133	    const container = containerRef.current;
   134	    if (!container) return 0;
   135	    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
   136	    return Math.round((position / maxMove) * 100);
   137	  };
   138	
   139	  return (
   140	    <div className="slider-captcha-container">
   141	      {/* 滑块轨道 */}
   142	      <div
   143	        ref={containerRef}
   144	        className={`slider-captcha-track ${verified ? 'verified' : ''} ${failed ? 'failed' : ''}`}
   145	      >
   146	        <div className="slider-captcha-bg-text">
   147	          {verified ? '✓ 验证成功' : failed ? '✗ 请重试' : '向右滑动滑块完成验证'}
   148	        </div>
   149	
   150	        <div
   151	          className="slider-captcha-progress"
   152	          style={{ width: `${position}px` }}
   153	        />
   154	
   155	        <div
   156	          ref={sliderRef}
   157	          className={`slider-captcha-button ${isDragging ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
   158	          style={{ left: `${position}px` }}
   159	          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
   160	          onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
   161	        >
   162	          <div className="slider-icon">
   163	            {verified ? '✓' : failed ? '✗' : '››'}
   164	          </div>
   165	        </div>
   166	      </div>
   167	
   168	      <div className="captcha-hint">
   169	        {isDragging ? `已滑动 ${getProgressPercent()}%` : '按住滑块，向右拖动至最右端'}
   170	      </div>
   171	    </div>
   172	  );
   173	});
   174	
   175	export default SliderCaptcha;

---------------------------- 文件结束 ----------------------------
