    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
    11	import { publicScholarAPI, analysisDimensionAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    13	import { AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
    14	import './TableColumnPanel.css';
    15	
    16	// 懒加载 AuthModal
    17	const AuthModal = lazy(() => import('./AuthModal'));
    18	
    19	// 生成随机维度标识
    20	const generateDimensionKey = () => {
    21	  const chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
    22	  let result = 'custom_';
    23	  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    24	    result += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    25	  }
    26	  return result;
    27	};
    28	
    29	// 维度数量限制
    30	const MAX_DIMENSIONS = 15;
    31	
    32	const TableColumnPanel = ({ onDimensionsChange, selectedDimensionKey, onDimensionSelect, onDimensionsUpdated }) => {
    33	  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
    34	  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState([]);
    35	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    36	  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
    37	  const [expandedColumn, setExpandedColumn] = useState(null);
    38	  const [isCustom, setIsCustom] = useState(false);
    39	  // 维度数量限制相关
    40	  const [maxDimensions, setMaxDimensions] = useState(MAX_DIMENSIONS);
    41	  const [customCount, setCustomCount] = useState(0); // 用户新增的自定义维度数量
    42	  // 控制绿色提示的显示/隐藏，从 localStorage 读取初始值
    43	  const [showHint, setShowHint] = useState(() => {
    44	    const hidden = localStorage.getItem('hideTableColumnHint');
    45	    return hidden !== 'true';
    46	  });
    47	  
    48	  // 编辑相关状态
    49	  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
    50	  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false); // 是否正在添加新维度
    51	  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({ name: '', description: '' });
    52	  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    53	  
    54	  // 登录弹窗状态
    55	  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);
    56	
    57	  // 当外部选中维度变化时，同步更新展开状态
    58	  useEffect(() => {
    59	    if (selectedDimensionKey && selectedDimensionKey !== expandedColumn) {
    60	      setExpandedColumn(selectedDimensionKey);
    61	      setIsEditing(false);
    62	      setIsAdding(false);
    63	      // 初始化编辑表单
    64	      const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === selectedDimensionKey);
    65	      if (column) {
    66	        setEditForm({ name: column.name, description: column.description });
    67	      }
    68	    }
    69	  }, [selectedDimensionKey, dimensions]);
    70	
    71	  // 加载分析维度
    72	  const loadDimensions = useCallback(async () => {
    73	    setLoading(true);
    74	    setError(null);
    75	    try {
    76	      let response;
    77	      if (isAuthenticated) {
    78	        // 已登录用户：获取用户自定义维度或系统默认
    79	        response = await analysisDimensionAPI.getDimensions();
    80	      } else {
    81	        // 未登录用户：获取系统默认维度
    82	        response = await publicScholarAPI.getSystemDimensions();
    83	      }
    84	
    85	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    86	        const dims = response.data.data.dimensions || [];
    87	        setDimensions(dims);
    88	        setIsCustom(response.data.data.isCustom || false);
    89	        // 设置维度数量限制信息
    90	        if (response.data.data.maxDimensions) {
    91	          setMaxDimensions(response.data.data.maxDimensions);
    92	        }
    93	        if (typeof response.data.data.customCount === 'number') {
    94	          setCustomCount(response.data.data.customCount);
    95	        }
    96	        // 通知父组件维度已更新
    97	        if (onDimensionsChange) {
    98	          onDimensionsChange(dims);
    99	        }
   100	      }
   101	    } catch (err) {
   102	      console.error('Failed to load dimensions:', err);
   103	      setError('加载分析维度失败');
   104	    } finally {
   105	      setLoading(false);
   106	    }
   107	  }, [isAuthenticated, onDimensionsChange]);
   108	
   109	  useEffect(() => {
   110	    loadDimensions();
   111	  }, [loadDimensions]);
   112	
   113	  const handleColumnClick = (key) => {
   114	    setExpandedColumn(key);
   115	    setIsEditing(false);
   116	    // 初始化编辑表单
   117	    const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === key);
   118	    if (column) {
   119	      setEditForm({ name: column.name, description: column.description });
   120	    }
   121	    // 通知父组件选中了某个维度
   122	    if (onDimensionSelect) {
   123	      onDimensionSelect(key);
   124	    }
   125	  };
   126	
   127	  const handleBack = () => {
   128	    setExpandedColumn(null);
   129	    setIsEditing(false);
   130	    // 清除选中状态
   131	    if (onDimensionSelect) {
   132	      onDimensionSelect(null);
   133	    }
   134	  };
   135	
   136	  // 切换提示显示状态
   137	  const toggleHint = () => {
   138	    const newValue = !showHint;
   139	    setShowHint(newValue);
   140	    // 保存到 localStorage
   141	    if (newValue) {
   142	      localStorage.removeItem('hideTableColumnHint');
   143	    } else {
   144	      localStorage.setItem('hideTableColumnHint', 'true');
   145	    }
   146	  };
   147	
   148	  // 开始编辑
   149	  const handleStartEdit = () => {
   150	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   151	      alert('请先登录后再编辑维度');
   152	      return;
   153	    }
   154	    setIsEditing(true);
   155	  };
   156	
   157	  // 取消编辑
   158	  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
   159	    setIsEditing(false);
   160	    // 恢复原始值
   161	    const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === expandedColumn);
   162	    if (column) {
   163	      setEditForm({ name: column.name, description: column.description });
   164	    }
   165	  };
   166	
   167	  // 保存编辑
   168	  const handleSaveEdit = async () => {
   169	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   170	      alert('请先登录');
   171	      return;
   172	    }
   173	
   174	    const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === expandedColumn);
   175	    if (!column) return;
   176	
   177	    setSaving(true);
   178	    try {
   179	      let response;
   180	      
   181	      // 判断是用户自定义维度还是系统维度（userId > 0 为用户自定义，-1 为系统默认）
   182	      if (column.userId && column.userId > 0) {
   183	        // 用户自定义维度：直接更新
   184	        response = await analysisDimensionAPI.updateDimension(
   185	          column.id,
   186	          editForm.name,
   187	          editForm.description,
   188	          column.sortOrder
   189	        );
   190	      } else {
   191	        // 系统维度：创建一个同key的用户维度来覆盖
   192	        response = await analysisDimensionAPI.createDimension(
   193	          column.dimensionKey,  // 使用相同的key来覆盖
   194	          editForm.name,
   195	          editForm.description,
   196	          column.sortOrder
   197	        );
   198	      }
   199	
   200	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   201	        // 重新加载维度列表
   202	        await loadDimensions();
   203	        setIsEditing(false);
   204	        // 更新当前展开的维度
   205	        const updatedColumn = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === expandedColumn);
   206	        if (updatedColumn) {
   207	          setEditForm({ name: updatedColumn.name, description: updatedColumn.description });
   208	        }
   209	        // 通知父组件维度已更新，需要重新加载表格数据
   210	        if (onDimensionsUpdated) {
   211	          onDimensionsUpdated('edit', editForm.name);
   212	        }
   213	      } else {
   214	        alert('保存失败: ' + (response.data.message || '未知错误'));
   215	      }
   216	    } catch (err) {
   217	      console.error('Failed to save dimension:', err);
   218	      alert('保存失败: ' + (err.response?.data?.message || err.message));
   219	    } finally {
   220	      setSaving(false);
   221	    }
   222	  };
   223	
   224	  // 检查是否已达到维度数量上限
   225	  const isAtMaxDimensions = dimensions.length >= maxDimensions;
   226	
   227	  // 添加自定义维度 - 进入添加模式
   228	  const handleAddDimension = () => {
   229	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   230	      alert('请先登录后再添加自定义维度');
   231	      return;
   232	    }
   233	    // 检查维度数量限制
   234	    if (isAtMaxDimensions) {
   235	      alert(`已达到维度数量上限（${maxDimensions}个），请删除部分自定义维度后再添加`);
   236	      return;
   237	    }
   238	    setIsAdding(true);
   239	    setIsEditing(true);
   240	    setExpandedColumn('__new__'); // 特殊标记表示新建
   241	    setEditForm({ name: '', description: '' });
   242	  };
   243	
   244	  // 保存新维度
   245	  const handleSaveNewDimension = async () => {
   246	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   247	      alert('请先登录');
   248	      return;
   249	    }
   250

   252	      alert('请填写完整的维度信息');
   253	      return;
   254	    }
   255	
   256	    setSaving(true);
   257	    try {

   260	      
   261	      // 计算排序顺序（放在最后）
   262	      const maxSortOrder = dimensions.length > 0 
   263	        ? Math.max(...dimensions.map(d => d.sortOrder || 0)) 
   264	        : 0;
   265	
   266	      // 创建新维度
   267	      const response = await analysisDimensionAPI.createDimension(
   268	        dimensionKey,
   269	        editForm.name,
   270	        editForm.description,
   271	        maxSortOrder + 1
   272	      );
   273	
   274	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   275	        // 重新加载维度列表
   276	        await loadDimensions();
   277	        // 退出添加模式
   278	        setIsAdding(false);
   279	        setIsEditing(false);
   280	        setExpandedColumn(null);
   281	        // 通知父组件维度已更新，需要重新加载表格数据
   282	        if (onDimensionsUpdated) {
   283	          onDimensionsUpdated('add', editForm.name);
   284	        }
   285	      } else {
   286	        alert('创建失败: ' + (response.data.message || '未知错误'));
   287	      }
   288	    } catch (err) {
   289	      console.error('Failed to create dimension:', err);
   290	      alert('创建失败: ' + (err.response?.data?.message || err.message));
   291	    } finally {
   292	      setSaving(false);
   293	    }
   294	  };
   295	
   296	  // 取消添加
   297	  const handleCancelAdd = () => {
   298	    setIsAdding(false);
   299	    setIsEditing(false);
   300	    setExpandedColumn(null);
   301	    setEditForm({ name: '', description: '' });
   302	  };
   303	
   304	  // 打开登录弹窗
   305	  const handleOpenAuthModal = () => {
   306	    setShowAuthModal(true);
   307	  };
   308	
   309	  // 登录成功回调
   310	  const handleLoginSuccess = () => {
   311	    setShowAuthModal(false);
   312	    // 设置标记，让页面刷新后自动切换到表格视图
   313	    localStorage.setItem('returnToTableView', 'true');
   314	    // 刷新页面以重新加载数据
   315	    window.location.reload();
   316	  };
   317	
   318	  // 加载中状态
   319	  if (loading) {
   320	    return (
   321	      <div className="tcp-container">
   322	        <div className="tcp-loading">
   323	          <div className="tcp-loading-spinner"></div>
   324	          <span>加载中...</span>
   325	        </div>
   326	      </div>
   327	    );
   328	  }
   329	
   330	  // 错误状态
   331	  if (error) {
   332	    return (
   333	      <div className="tcp-container">
   334	        <div className="tcp-error">
   335	          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   336	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
   337	            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"/>
   338	            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/>
   339	          </svg>
   340	          <span>{error}</span>
   341	        </div>
   342	      </div>
   343	    );
   344	  }
   345	
   346	  // 新建维度视图
   347	  if (isAdding && expandedColumn === '__new__') {
   348	    return (
   349	      <div className="tcp-container">
   350	        <div className="tcp-detail-header">
   351	          <button className="tcp-back-btn" onClick={handleCancelAdd}>
   352	            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   353	              <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
   354	            </svg>
   355	            返回
   356	          </button>
   357	          <span className="tcp-detail-title">新建维度</span>
   358	        </div>
   359	        
   360	        <div className="tcp-detail-content">
   361	          <div className="tcp-detail-section">
   362	            <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">名称 <span className="tcp-required">*</span></h4>
   363	            <input
   364	              type="text"
   365	              className="tcp-input"
   366	              value={editForm.name}
   367	              onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, name: e.target.value })}
   368	              placeholder="例如：研究方法"
   369	              autoFocus
   370	            />
   371	          </div>
   372	          <div className="tcp-detail-section">
   373	            <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">分析指示 <span className="tcp-required">*</span></h4>
   374	            <textarea
   375	              className="tcp-textarea"
   376	              value={editForm.description}
   377	              onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, description: e.target.value })}
   378	              placeholder="描述AI应该如何分析这个维度，例如：提取论文中使用的研究方法，包括定量研究、定性研究、混合方法等"
   379	              rows={8}
   380	            />
   381	            <p className="tcp-input-hint">描述AI分析论文摘要时应该关注的内容和提取方式</p>
   382	          </div>
   383	          
   384	          {/* 操作按钮 */}
   385	          <div className="tcp-edit-actions">
   386	            <button 
   387	              className="tcp-btn tcp-btn-secondary" 
   388	              onClick={handleCancelAdd}
   389	              disabled={saving}
   390	            >
   391	              取消
   392	            </button>
   393	            <button 
   394	              className="tcp-btn tcp-btn-primary" 
   395	              onClick={handleSaveNewDimension}
   396	              disabled={saving || !editForm.name.trim() || !editForm.description.trim()}
   397	            >
   398	              {saving ? (
   399	                <>
   400	                  <div className="tcp-btn-spinner"></div>
   401	                  <span>创建中...</span>
   402	                </>
   403	              ) : (
   404	                <>
   405	                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   406	                    <line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/>
   407	                    <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/>
   408	                  </svg>
   409	                  <span>创建维度</span>
   410	                </>
   411	              )}
   412	            </button>
   413	          </div>
   414	        </div>
   415	      </div>
   416	    );
   417	  }
   418	
   419	  // 展开的列详情视图
   420	  if (expandedColumn && expandedColumn !== '__new__') {
   421	    const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === expandedColumn);
   422	    if (!column) {
   423	      setExpandedColumn(null);
   424	      return null;
   425	    }
   426	
   427	    return (
   428	      <div className="tcp-container">
   429	        <div className="tcp-detail-header">
   430	          <button className="tcp-back-btn" onClick={handleBack}>
   431	            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   432	              <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
   433	            </svg>
   434	            返回
   435	          </button>
   436	          <span className="tcp-detail-title">列详情</span>
   437	          {!isEditing && isAuthenticated && (
   438	            <button className="tcp-edit-btn" onClick={handleStartEdit} title="编辑">
   439	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   440	                <path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/>
   441	                <path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/>
   442	              </svg>
   443	            </button>
   444	          )}
   445	        </div>
   446	        
   447	        <div className="tcp-detail-content">
   448	          {isEditing ? (
   449	            // 编辑模式
   450	            <>
   451	              <div className="tcp-detail-section">
   452	                <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">名称 <span className="tcp-required">*</span></h4>
   453	                <input
   454	                  type="text"
   455	                  className="tcp-input"
   456	                  value={editForm.name}
   457	                  onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, name: e.target.value })}
   458	                  placeholder="输入维度名称"
   459	                />
   460	              </div>
   461	              <div className="tcp-detail-section">
   462	                <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">分析指示 <span className="tcp-required">*</span></h4>
   463	                <textarea
   464	                  className="tcp-textarea"
   465	                  value={editForm.description}
   466	                  onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, description: e.target.value })}
   467	                  placeholder="输入分析指示，描述AI应该如何分析这个维度"
   468	                  rows={8}
   469	                />
   470	                <p className="tcp-input-hint">描述AI分析论文摘要时应该关注的内容和提取方式</p>
   471	              </div>
   472	              
   473	              {/* 编辑操作按钮 */}
   474	              <div className="tcp-edit-actions">
   475	                <button 
   476	                  className="tcp-btn tcp-btn-secondary" 
   477	                  onClick={handleCancelEdit}
   478	                  disabled={saving}
   479	                >
   480	                  取消
   481	                </button>
   482	                <button 
   483	                  className="tcp-btn tcp-btn-primary" 
   484	                  onClick={handleSaveEdit}
   485	                  disabled={saving || !editForm.name.trim() || !editForm.description.trim()}
   486	                >
   487	                  {saving ? (
   488	                    <>
   489	                      <div className="tcp-btn-spinner"></div>
   490	                      <span>保存中...</span>
   491	                    </>
   492	                  ) : (
   493	                    <>
   494	                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   495	                        <path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/>
   496	                        <polyline points="17 21 17 13 7 13 7 21"/>
   497	                        <polyline points="7 3 7 8 15 8"/>
   498	                      </svg>
   499	                      <span>保存</span>
   500	                    </>
   501	                  )}
   502	                </button>
   503	              </div>
   504	            </>
   505	          ) : (
   506	            // 查看模式
   507	            <>
   508	              <div className="tcp-detail-section">
   509	                <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">名称</h4>
   510	                <p className="tcp-detail-value">{column.name}</p>
   511	              </div>
   512	              <div className="tcp-detail-section">
   513	                <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">分析指示</h4>
   514	                <p className="tcp-detail-value tcp-detail-description">{column.description}</p>
   515	              </div>
   516	              {column.userId && column.userId > 0 && (
   517	                <div className="tcp-detail-section">
   518	                  <span className="tcp-custom-badge-large">自定义维度</span>
   519	                </div>
   520	              )}
   521	            </>
   522	          )}
   523	        </div>
   524	      </div>
   525	    );
   526	  }
   527	
   528	  // 列列表视图
   529	  return (
   530	    <div className="tcp-container">
   531	      <div className="tcp-header">
   532	        <h3 className="tcp-title">列</h3>
   533	        <button 
   534	          className="tcp-info-btn"
   535	          title={showHint ? "隐藏提示" : "显示提示"}
   536	          onClick={toggleHint}
   537	        >
   538	          <AlertCircle size={18} />
   539	        </button>
   540	      </div>
   541	
   542	      {/* 添加提取列提示 - 可隐藏 */}
   543	      {showHint && (
   544	        <div className="tcp-add-hint">
   545	          <div className="tcp-add-icon">
   546	            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   547	              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
   548	              <path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/>
   549	            </svg>
   550	          </div>
   551	          <div className="tcp-add-text">
   552	            <h4>添加提取列</h4>
   553	            <p>使用建议的提取列或添加您自己的提取列。评估提取结果并根据需要完善列定义。</p>
   554	            <button className="tcp-hide-btn" onClick={toggleHint}>隐藏</button>
   555	          </div>
   556	        </div>
   557	      )}
   558	
   559	      {/* 列列表 */}
   560	      <div className="tcp-list">
   561	        {dimensions.map((column) => (
   562	          <div 
   563	            key={column.dimensionKey} 
   564	            className={`tcp-list-item ${column.userId && column.userId > 0 ? 'tcp-list-item-custom' : ''}`}
   565	            onClick={() => handleColumnClick(column.dimensionKey)}
   566	          >
   567	            <div className="tcp-item-icon">
   568	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   569	                <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/>
   570	                <line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/>
   571	                <line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/>
   572	              </svg>
   573	            </div>
   574	            <span className="tcp-item-name">{column.name}</span>
   575	            {column.userId && column.userId > 0 && (
   576	              <span className="tcp-item-custom-tag">自定义</span>
   577	            )}
   578	            <svg className="tcp-item-arrow" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   579	              <path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6"/>
   580	            </svg>
   581	          </div>
   582	        ))}
   583	      </div>
   584	
   585	      {/* 添加自定义维度按钮 / 登录引导 */}
   586	      <div className="tcp-add-dimension">
   587	        {isAuthenticated ? (
   588	          <>
   589	            {/* 维度数量提示 */}
   590	            <div className="tcp-dimension-count">
   591	              <span className={`tcp-count-text ${isAtMaxDimensions ? 'tcp-count-max' : ''}`}>
   592	                {dimensions.length} / {maxDimensions} 个维度
   593	                {customCount > 0 && <span className="tcp-count-custom">（{customCount}个自定义）</span>}
   594	              </span>
   595	            </div>
   596	            <button 
   597	              className={`tcp-add-dimension-btn ${isAtMaxDimensions ? 'tcp-add-dimension-btn-disabled' : ''}`}
   598	              onClick={handleAddDimension}
   599	              disabled={isAtMaxDimensions}
   600	              title={isAtMaxDimensions ? `已达到维度数量上限（${maxDimensions}个）` : '添加自定义维度'}
   601	            >
   602	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   603	                <line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/>
   604	                <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/>
   605	              </svg>
   606	              <span>{isAtMaxDimensions ? '已达上限' : '添加自定义维度'}</span>
   607	            </button>
   608	            {isAtMaxDimensions && (
   609	              <p className="tcp-max-hint">删除部分自定义维度后可继续添加</p>
   610	            )}
   611	          </>
   612	        ) : (
   613	          <div className="tcp-login-prompt">
   614	            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   615	              <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"/>
   616	              <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"/>
   617	            </svg>
   618	            <p>登录后可自定义维度</p>
   619	            <button className="tcp-login-btn" onClick={handleOpenAuthModal}>
   620	              登录
   621	            </button>
   622	          </div>
   623	        )}
   624	      </div>
   625	
   626	      {/* 登录弹窗 */}
   627	      {showAuthModal && (
   628	        <Suspense fallback={null}>
   629	          <AuthModal
   630	            isOpen={showAuthModal}
   631	            onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
   632	            onLoginSuccess={handleLoginSuccess}
   633	          />
   634	        </Suspense>
   635	      )}
   636	    </div>
   637	  );
   638	};
   639	
   640	export default TableColumnPanel;

    48	      useCases: '实时监控、智能制造',
    49	      keyFindings: '延迟降至毫秒级',
    50	    }
    51	  },

    53	
    54	const TableViewGuide = ({ onClose, onTryIt, onDismiss, targetRef }) => {
    55	  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
    56	  const [typingRow, setTypingRow] = useState(-1);
    57	  const [arrowPosition, setArrowPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });
    58	  const [modalPosition, setModalPosition] = useState({ top: 'auto', right: 'auto', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' });
    59	
    60	  useEffect(() => {
    61	    // 计算箭头位置和弹窗位置（弹窗在按钮左侧，箭头从弹窗指向按钮）
    62	    const calculatePositions = () => {
    63	    if (targetRef?.current) {
    64	      const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    65	        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
    66	        const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
    67	        
    68	        // 按钮中心点的垂直位置
    69	        const buttonCenterY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
    70	        // 按钮左边缘
    71	        const buttonLeft = rect.left;
    72	        
    73	        // 箭头+线的总宽度 (线60px + 箭头10px)
    74	        const arrowTotalWidth = 70;
    75	        // 弹窗和箭头之间的间距
    76	        const gapToArrow = 8;
    77	        
    78	        // 弹窗右边缘位置 = 按钮左边 - 箭头宽度 - 间距
    79	        const modalRightX = buttonLeft - arrowTotalWidth - gapToArrow;
    80	        
    81	        // 弹窗垂直位置 - 与按钮中心对齐，但确保不超出视口
    82	        const modalHeight = 480;
    83	        let modalCenterY = buttonCenterY;
    84	        const minY = modalHeight / 2 + 20;
    85	        const maxY = viewportHeight - modalHeight / 2 - 20;
    86	        modalCenterY = Math.max(minY, Math.min(maxY, modalCenterY));
    87	        
    88	        // 箭头位置 - 箭头尖端靠近按钮
    89	      setArrowPosition({
    90	          top: buttonCenterY,
    91	          left: buttonLeft - 8, // 箭头尖端距离按钮8px
    92	        });
    93	        
    94	        // 弹窗位置 - 使用 right 定位，弹窗右边缘到视口右边的距离
    95	        const modalRightFromViewport = viewportWidth - modalRightX;
    96	        setModalPosition({
    97	          top: `${modalCenterY}px`,
    98	          right: `${modalRightFromViewport}px`,
    99	          transform: 'translateY(-50%)', // 只垂直居中
   100	      });
   101	    }
   102	    };
   103	    
   104	    calculatePositions();
   105	    
   106	    // 监听窗口大小变化
   107	    window.addEventListener('resize', calculatePositions);
   108	    
   109	    // 延迟显示动画
   110	    setTimeout(() => setVisible(true), 100);
   111	    
   112	    // 逐行显示动画
   113	    let row = 0;
   114	    const timer = setInterval(() => {
   115	      setTypingRow(row);
   116	      row++;
   117	      if (row >= mockData.length) {
   118	        clearInterval(timer);
   119	      }
   120	    }, 600);
   121	
   122	    return () => {
   123	      clearInterval(timer);
   124	      window.removeEventListener('resize', calculatePositions);
   125	    };
   126	  }, [targetRef]);
   127	
   128	  // X 按钮 - 只关闭弹窗，下次还会显示
   129	  const handleDismiss = () => {
   130	    setVisible(false);
   131	    setTimeout(() => {
   132	      if (onDismiss) {
   133	        onDismiss();
   134	      } else {
   135	        onClose();
   136	      }
   137	    }, 200);
   138	  };
   139	
   140	  // "稍后再说" 按钮 - 关闭并记住，下次不再显示
   141	  const handleClose = () => {
   142	    setVisible(false);
   143	    setTimeout(onClose, 200);
   144	  };
   145	
   146	  // "立即体验" 按钮
   147	  const handleTryIt = () => {
   148	    setVisible(false);
   149	    setTimeout(() => {
   150	      onClose();
   151	      onTryIt();
   152	    }, 200);
   153	  };
   154	
   155	  // 计算高亮区域（表格按钮）
   156	  const [highlightRect, setHighlightRect] = useState(null);
   157	  
   158	  useEffect(() => {
   159	    if (targetRef?.current && visible) {
   160	      const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
   161	      setHighlightRect({
   162	        top: rect.top - 6,
   163	        left: rect.left - 6,
   164	        width: rect.width + 12,
   165	        height: rect.height + 12,
   166	      });
   167	    }
   168	  }, [targetRef, visible]);
   169	
   170	  return (
   171	    <div className={`tvg-overlay ${visible ? 'tvg-visible' : ''}`}>
   172	      {/* 遮罩层 - 使用 clip-path 留出高亮区域，点击蒙层关闭但下次还会显示 */}
   173	      <div 
   174	        className="tvg-mask"
   175	        onClick={handleDismiss}
   176	        style={highlightRect ? {
   177	          clipPath: `polygon(
   178	            0% 0%, 
   179	            0% 100%, 
   180	            ${highlightRect.left}px 100%, 
   181	            ${highlightRect.left}px ${highlightRect.top}px, 
   182	            ${highlightRect.left + highlightRect.width}px ${highlightRect.top}px, 
   183	            ${highlightRect.left + highlightRect.width}px ${highlightRect.top + highlightRect.height}px, 
   184	            ${highlightRect.left}px ${highlightRect.top + highlightRect.height}px, 
   185	            ${highlightRect.left}px 100%, 
   186	            100% 100%, 
   187	            100% 0%
   188	          )`
   189	        } : {}}
   190	      />
   191	      
   192	      {/* 高亮边框 */}
   193	      {highlightRect && (
   194	        <div 
   195	          className={`tvg-highlight ${visible ? 'tvg-highlight-show' : ''}`}
   196	          style={{
   197	            top: highlightRect.top,
   198	            left: highlightRect.left,
   199	            width: highlightRect.width,
   200	            height: highlightRect.height,
   201	          }}
   202	        />
   203	      )}
   204	      
   205	      {/* 指向表格按钮的箭头 - 水平方向，从左向右指 */}
   206	      {arrowPosition.left > 0 && (
   207	        <div 
   208	          className={`tvg-pointer ${visible ? 'tvg-pointer-show' : ''}`}
   209	          style={{ 
   210	            top: arrowPosition.top, 
   211	            left: arrowPosition.left,
   212	            transform: 'translate(-100%, -50%)', // 箭头尖端对齐到 left 位置
   213	          }}
   214	        >
   215	          <div className="tvg-pointer-line" />
   216	          <div className="tvg-pointer-arrow" />
   217	        </div>
   218	      )}
   219	      
   220	      <div 
   221	        className="tvg-modal" 
   222	        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
   223	        style={{
   224	          position: 'fixed',
   225	          top: modalPosition.top,
   226	          right: modalPosition.right,
   227	          left: 'auto',
   228	          transform: modalPosition.transform,
   229	        }}
   230	      >
   231	        {/* 关闭按钮 - 点击后下次还会显示 */}
   232	        <button className="tvg-close-btn" onClick={handleDismiss}>
   233	          <X size={18} />
   234	        </button>
   235	
   236	        {/* 头部 */}
   237	        <div className="tvg-header">
   238	          <div className="tvg-badge">新功能</div>
   239	          <h3>AI 智能表格分析</h3>
   240	          <p>自动提取论文关键信息，多维度对比研究成果</p>
   241	        </div>
   242	
   243	        {/* 模拟表格预览 */}
   244	        <div className="tvg-preview">
   245	          <div className="tvg-table-container">
   246	            <table className="tvg-table">
   247	              <thead>
   248	                <tr>
   249	                  <th className="tvg-th-paper">论文</th>
   250	                  <th>研究类型</th>
   251	                  <th>技术/平台</th>
   252	                  <th>使用场景</th>
   253	                  <th>关键发现</th>
   254	                </tr>
   255	              </thead>
   256	              <tbody>
   257	                {mockData.map((paper, index) => (
   258	                  <tr 
   259	                    key={index} 
   260	                    className={`tvg-row ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-row-show' : ''}`}
   261	                  >
   262	                    <td className="tvg-td-paper">
   263	                      <div className="tvg-paper-title">{paper.title}</div>
   264	                      <div className="tvg-paper-meta">
   265	                        {paper.authors} · {paper.year} · {paper.citations}引用
   266	                      </div>
   267	                    </td>
   268	                    <td>
   269	                      <span className={`tvg-cell ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-cell-show' : ''}`}>
   270	                        {paper.analysis.studyType}
   271	                      </span>
   272	                    </td>
   273	                    <td>
   274	                      <span className={`tvg-cell ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-cell-show' : ''}`}>
   275	                        {paper.analysis.technologies}
   276	                      </span>
   277	                    </td>
   278	                    <td>
   279	                      <span className={`tvg-cell ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-cell-show' : ''}`}>
   280	                        {paper.analysis.useCases}
   281	                      </span>
   282	                    </td>
   283	                    <td>
   284	                      <span className={`tvg-cell ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-cell-show' : ''}`}>
   285	                        {paper.analysis.keyFindings}
   286	                      </span>
   287	                    </td>
   288	                  </tr>
   289	                ))}
   290	              </tbody>
   291	            </table>

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import './Toast.css';
    12	
    13	/**
    14	 * Toast notification component
    15	 * @param {string} message - The message to display
    16	 * @param {string} type - Type of toast: 'success', 'error', 'warning', 'info'
    17	 * @param {number} duration - Duration in milliseconds (default: 3000)
    18	 * @param {function} onClose - Callback when toast closes
    19	 */
    20	const Toast = ({ message, type = 'info', duration = 3000, onClose }) => {
    21	  useEffect(() => {
    22	    if (duration > 0) {
    23	      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    24	        onClose();
    25	      }, duration);
    26	
    27	      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    28	    }
    29	  }, [duration, onClose]);
    30	
    31	  const getIcon = () => {
    32	    switch (type) {
    33	      case 'success':
    34	        return (
    35	          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    36	            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
    37	            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
    38	          </svg>
    39	        );
    40	      case 'error':
    41	        return (
    42	          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    43	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
    44	            <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"></line>
    45	            <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"></line>
    46	          </svg>
    47	        );
    48	      case 'warning':
    49	        return (
    50	          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    51	            <path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"></path>
    52	            <line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"></line>
    53	            <line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"></line>
    54	          </svg>
    55	        );
    56	      case 'info':
    57	      default:
    58	        return (
    59	          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    60	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
    61	            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12"></line>
    62	            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8"></line>
    63	          </svg>
    64	        );
    65	    }
    66	  };
    67	
    68	  return (
    69	    <div className={`toast toast-${type}`}>
    70	      <div className="toast-icon">{getIcon()}</div>
    71	      <div className="toast-message">{message}</div>
    72	      <button className="toast-close" onClick={onClose}>
    73	        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    74	          <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
    75	          <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
    76	        </svg>
    77	      </button>
    78	    </div>
    79	  );
    80	};
    81	
    82	export default Toast;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	import Toast from './Toast';
    12	import ErrorDialog from './ErrorDialog';
    13	import './Toast.css';
    14	
    15	const ToastContext = createContext();
    16	
    17	export const useToast = () => {
    18	  const context = useContext(ToastContext);
    19	  if (!context) {
    20	    throw new Error('useToast must be used within ToastProvider');
    21	  }
    22	  return context;
    23	};
    24	
    25	export const ToastProvider = ({ children }) => {
    26	  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
    27	  const [errorDialog, setErrorDialog] = useState(null);
    28	
    29	  const showToast = useCallback((message, type = 'info', duration = 3000) => {
    30	    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    31	    const toast = { id, message, type, duration };
    32	
    33	    setToasts((prevToasts) => [...prevToasts, toast]);
    34	
    35	    return id;
    36	  }, []);
    37	
    38	  const hideToast = useCallback((id) => {
    39	    setToasts((prevToasts) => prevToasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id));
    40	  }, []);
    41	
    42	  const showSuccess = useCallback((message, duration = 3000) => {
    43	    return showToast(message, 'success', duration);
    44	  }, [showToast]);
    45	
    46	  // showError now shows a modal dialog that requires user acknowledgment
    47	  const showError = useCallback((message, title = '错误') => {
    48	    setErrorDialog({ message, title });
    49	  }, []);
    50	
    51	  const hideError = useCallback(() => {
    52	    setErrorDialog(null);
    53	  }, []);
    54	
    55	  const showWarning = useCallback((message, duration = 3000) => {
    56	    return showToast(message, 'warning', duration);
    57	  }, [showToast]);
    58	
    59	  const showInfo = useCallback((message, duration = 3000) => {
    60	    return showToast(message, 'info', duration);
    61	  }, [showToast]);
    62	
    63	  return (
    64	    <ToastContext.Provider
    65	      value={{
    66	        showToast,
    67	        hideToast,
    68	        showSuccess,
    69	        showError,
    70	        showWarning,
    71	        showInfo,
    72	      }}
    73	    >
    74	      {children}
    75	      <div className="toast-container">
    76	        {toasts.map((toast) => (
    77	          <Toast
    78	            key={toast.id}
    79	            message={toast.message}
    80	            type={toast.type}
    81	            duration={toast.duration}
    82	            onClose={() => hideToast(toast.id)}
    83	          />
    84	        ))}
    85	      </div>
    86	      {errorDialog && (
    87	        <ErrorDialog
    88	          message={errorDialog.message}
    89	          title={errorDialog.title}
    90	          onClose={hideError}
    91	        />
    92	      )}
    93	    </ToastContext.Provider>
    94	  );
    95	};

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { forwardRef, useImperativeHandle, useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { Turnstile } from '@marsidev/react-turnstile';
    12	import './TurnstileCaptcha.css';
    13	
    14	/**
    15	 * TurnstileCaptcha - Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA component
    16	 *
    17	 * Props:
    18	 *  - onSuccess: Callback when verification succeeds (receives token)
    19	 *  - onFail: Callback when verification fails
    20	 *  - onExpire: Callback when token expires
    21	 *  - theme: 'light' or 'dark' (default: 'dark')
    22	 *
    23	 * Ref methods:
    24	 *  - reset(): Reset the captcha
    25	 */
    26	const TurnstileCaptcha = forwardRef(({ onSuccess, onFail, onExpire, theme = 'dark' }, ref) => {
    27	  const turnstileRef = useRef(null);
    28	  const [config, setConfig] = useState(null);
    29	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    30	
    31	  // Fetch system configuration on mount
    32	  useEffect(() => {
    33	    const fetchConfig = async () => {
    34	      try {
    35	        const response = await fetch('/api/v1/config/system');
    36	        const data = await response.json();
    37	        if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {
    38	          setConfig(data.data);
    39	        }
    40	      } catch (err) {
    41	        console.error('[Turnstile] Failed to load system config:', err);
    42	        // Use fallback config if fetch fails
    43	        setConfig({
    44	          enable_turnstile: false,
    45	          turnstile_site_key: '1x00000000000000000000AA'
    46	        });
    47	      } finally {
    48	        setLoading(false);
    49	      }
    50	    };
    51	    fetchConfig();
    52	  }, []);
    53	
    54	  // Expose reset method to parent
    55	  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    56	    reset: () => {
    57	      if (turnstileRef.current) {
    58	        turnstileRef.current.reset();
    59	      }
    60	    }
    61	  }));
    62	
    63	  // If Turnstile is disabled, call onSuccess immediately with empty token
    64	  useEffect(() => {
    65	    if (!loading && config && !config.enable_turnstile) {
    66	      console.log('[Turnstile] Turnstile is disabled, auto-succeeding');
    67	      if (onSuccess) onSuccess('');
    68	    }
    69	    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    70	  }, [loading, config]);
    71	
    72	  // Don't render anything while loading or if Turnstile is disabled
    73	  if (loading || !config || !config.enable_turnstile) {
    74	    return null;
    75	  }
    76	
    77	  // Get site key from config or use test key as fallback
    78	  const siteKey = config.turnstile_site_key || '1x00000000000000000000AA';
    79	
    80	  return (
    81	    <div className="turnstile-container">
    82	      <Turnstile
    83	        ref={turnstileRef}
    84	        siteKey={siteKey}
    85	        onSuccess={(token) => {
    86	          console.log('[Turnstile] Verification successful');
    87	          if (onSuccess) onSuccess(token);
    88	        }}
    89	        onError={() => {
    90	          console.error('[Turnstile] Verification error');
    91	          if (onFail) onFail();
    92	        }}
    93	        onExpire={() => {
    94	          console.log('[Turnstile] Token expired');
    95	          if (onExpire) onExpire();
    96	        }}
    97	        options={{
    98	          theme: theme,
    99	          size: 'normal',
   100	          action: 'login',
   101	          cData: 'scholar-auth'
   102	        }}
   103	      />
   104	    </div>
   105	  );
   106	});
   107	
   108	TurnstileCaptcha.displayName = 'TurnstileCaptcha';
   109	
   110	export default TurnstileCaptcha;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0

    10	import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
    12	import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
    13	import api from '../services/api';
    14	import Logo from './Logo';
    15	import { NormalSearchIcon, AdvancedSearchIcon } from './SearchIcons';
    16	import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeContext';
    17	import IOSThemeToggle from './IOSThemeToggle';
    18	import './UnifiedSidebar.css';
    19	
    20	const UnifiedSidebar = ({
    21	  user,
    22	  onLogout,
    23	  collapsed,
    24	  onToggleCollapse,
    25	  // 历史记录相关 props
    26	  showHistory = false, // 是否显示历史记录部分
    27	  historyType = 'conversation', // 'conversation' 或 'search'
    28	  historyItems = [], // 历史记录列表
    29	  currentItemId = null, // 当前选中的项目ID
    30	  onSelectItem = null, // 选择历史记录项的回调
    31	  onDeleteItem = null, // 删除历史记录项的回调
    32	  onNewItem = null, // 新建项目的回调
    33	  historyLoading = false // 历史记录加载状态
    34	}) => {
    35	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    36	  const location = useLocation();
    37	  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
    38	  const [showUserMenu, setShowUserMenu] = useState(false);
    39	  const [logoHovered, setLogoHovered] = useState(false);
    40	  const userMenuRef = useRef(null);
    41	  const avatarRef = useRef(null);
    42	  const [menuPosition, setMenuPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });
    43	  const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState(null);
    44	
    45	  // 获取订阅信息
    46	  useEffect(() => {
    47	    const fetchSubscription = async () => {
    48	      try {
    49	        const response = await api.get('/user/subscription/my');
    50	        if (response.data.code === 0) {
    51	          setSubscription(response.data.data);
    52	        }
    53	      } catch (error) {
    54	        console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', error);
    55	      }
    56	    };
    57	
    58	    if (user) {
    59	      fetchSubscription();
    60	    }
    61	  }, [user]);
    62	
    63	  // 点击外部关闭用户菜单
    64	  useEffect(() => {
    65	    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
    66	      if (showUserMenu &&
    67	          userMenuRef.current &&
    68	          !userMenuRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
    69	        setShowUserMenu(false);
    70	      }
    71	    };
    72	
    73	    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    74	    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    75	  }, [showUserMenu]);
    76	
    77	  // 获取用户头像首字母
    78	  const getUserInitial = () => {
    79	    if (!user || !user.email) return '?';
    80	    return user.email.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    81	  };
    82	
    83	  // 更新菜单位置 - 向上弹出
    84	  const updateMenuPosition = () => {
    85	    if (avatarRef.current) {
    86	      const rect = avatarRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    87	      setMenuPosition({
    88	        bottom: window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8,
    89	        left: collapsed ? rect.left : rect.left
    90	      });
    91	    }
    92	  };
    93	
    94	  // 当显示菜单时更新位置
    95	  useEffect(() => {
    96	    if (showUserMenu) {
    97	      updateMenuPosition();
    98	      window.addEventListener('resize', updateMenuPosition);
    99	      window.addEventListener('scroll', updateMenuPosition);
   100	      return () => {
   101	        window.removeEventListener('resize', updateMenuPosition);
   102	        window.removeEventListener('scroll', updateMenuPosition);
   103	      };
   104	    }
   105	  }, [showUserMenu, collapsed]);
   106	
   107	  // Logo点击处理
   108	  const handleLogoClick = () => {
   109	    if (collapsed) {
   110	      onToggleCollapse();
   111	    } else {
   112	      navigate('/');
   113	    }
   114	  };
   115	
   116	  // 格式化时间
   117	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
   118	    const date = new Date(dateString);
   119	    const now = new Date();
   120	    const diffMs = now - date;
   121	    const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
   122	    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
   123	    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);
   124	
   125	    if (diffMins < 1) return '刚刚';
   126	    if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}分钟前`;
   127	    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}小时前`;
   128	    if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}天前`;
   129	    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
   130	  };
   131	
   132	  // 处理删除
   133	  const handleDelete = (e, itemId) => {
   134	    e.stopPropagation();
   135	    if (!window.confirm(historyType === 'conversation' ? '确定删除这个对话吗？' : '确定删除这条搜索记录吗？')) return;
   136	
   137	    if (onDeleteItem) {
   138	      onDeleteItem(itemId);
   139	    }
   140	  };
   141	
   142	  // 判断当前页面
   143	  const isSearchPage = location.pathname === '/search-results';
   144	  const isAdvancedSearchPage = location.pathname === '/advanced-search';
   145	
   146	  return (
   147	    <div className={`unified-sidebar ${collapsed ? 'collapsed' : ''}`}>
   148	      {/* 顶部Logo区域 */}
   149	      <div className="unified-sidebar-header">
   150	        <div className="sidebar-header-top">
   151	          <div
   152	            className={`sidebar-logo ${collapsed ? 'collapsed-logo' : ''}`}
   153	            onClick={handleLogoClick}
   154	            onMouseEnter={() => collapsed && setLogoHovered(true)}
   155	            onMouseLeave={() => setLogoHovered(false)}
   156	            style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
   157	            title={collapsed ? '展开侧边栏' : '返回首页'}
   158	          >
   159	            {collapsed && logoHovered ? (
   160	              // 收起状态且hover时显示展开图标

   179	            </svg>
   180	          </button>
   181	        </div>
   182	      </div>
   183

   265	                            </svg>
   266	                          </button>
   267	                        )}
   268	                      </div>
   269	                    ))
   270	                  )}
   271	                </div>
   272	              </div>
   273	            </>
   274	          )}
   275	        </div>
   276	      )}
   277	
   278	      {/* 底部用户信息区域 */}
   279	      <div className="sidebar-user-section sidebar-footer">
   280	        <div
   281	          ref={avatarRef}

   283	          onClick={() => setShowUserMenu(!showUserMenu)}
   284	          title={collapsed ? user?.email : ''}
   285	        >
   286	          <div className="user-avatar">
   287	            {getUserInitial()}
   288	          </div>
   289	          {!collapsed && (
   290	            <div className="user-email-wrapper">
   291	              <span className="user-email">{user?.email || '未登录'}</span>
   292	            </div>
   293	          )}
   294	        </div>
   295	      </div>
   296

   298	      {showUserMenu && ReactDOM.createPortal(

   301	          className={`user-menu-popup ${collapsed ? 'collapsed-menu' : ''}`}
   302	          style={{
   303	            position: 'fixed',
   304	            bottom: `${menuPosition.bottom}px`,
   305	            left: `${menuPosition.left}px`,
   306	            zIndex: 10000
   307	          }}
   308	        >
   309	          <div className={`user-menu-header ${subscription && subscription.plan_code === 'pro' ? 'premium-pro' : ''} ${subscription && subscription.plan_code === 'max' ? 'premium-max' : ''}`}>
   310	            <div className="user-avatar-large">
   311	              {getUserInitial()}
   312	            </div>
   313	            <div className="user-info-text">
   314	              <div className="user-name">{user?.username || user?.email?.split('@')[0] || '用户'}</div>

   316	              {subscription && (

   318	                  <span className={`subscription-plan-badge ${subscription.plan_code}`}>
   319	                    {subscription.plan_name}
   320	                  </span>
   321	                </div>
   322	              )}
   323	            </div>
   324	          </div>
   325	
   326	          <div className="user-menu-divider"></div>
   327	
   328	          <div className="user-menu-options">
   329	            <button
   330	              className="user-menu-item"
   331	              onClick={() => {
   332	                setShowUserMenu(false);
   333	                navigate('/settings');
   334	              }}
   335	            >
   336	              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   337	                <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
   338	                <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/>
   339	              </svg>
   340	              <span>个人资料</span>
   341	            </button>
   342	
   343	            <button
   344	              className="user-menu-item"

   346	                setShowUserMenu(false);

   375	            <div className="user-menu-bottom-actions">

    69	  ];
    70	
    71	  const startYear = 1920;
    72	  const endYear = 2026;
    73	  const totalYears = endYear - startYear;
    74	
    75	  // Initialize with provided values or defaults
    76	  const [lowYear, setLowYear] = useState(yearFrom || startYear);
    77	  const [highYear, setHighYear] = useState(yearTo || endYear);
    78	  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(null); // 'low' or 'high'
    79	  const sliderRef = useRef(null);
    80	
    81	  // Update internal state when props change (e.g., when filters are cleared)
    82	  // But only if not currently dragging
    83	  useEffect(() => {
    84	    if (!dragging) {
    85	      setLowYear(yearFrom || startYear);
    86	      setHighYear(yearTo || endYear);
    87	    }
    88	  }, [yearFrom, yearTo, dragging, startYear, endYear]);
    89	
    90	  const maxValue = Math.max(...HISTOGRAM_DATA.map(d => d.docCount));
    91	
    92	  // Convert year to slider position (0-100%)
    93	  const yearToPercent = (year) => {
    94	    return ((year - startYear) / totalYears) * 100;
    95	  };
    96	
    97	  // Convert slider position to year
    98	  const percentToYear = (percent) => {
    99	    return Math.round(startYear + (percent / 100) * totalYears);
   100	  };
   101	
   102	  // Handle slider drag
   103	  const handleMouseDown = (handle) => (e) => {
   104	    e.preventDefault();
   105	    e.stopPropagation();
   106	    setDragging(handle);
   107	  };
   108	
   109	  useEffect(() => {
   110	    if (!dragging) return;
   111	
   112	    const handleMouseMove = (e) => {
   113	      if (!sliderRef.current) return;
   114	
   115	      const rect = sliderRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
   116	      const padding = 12; // Match the CSS padding
   117	      const effectiveWidth = rect.width - padding * 2;
   118	      const x = Math.max(padding, Math.min(e.clientX - rect.left, rect.width - padding));
   119	      const percent = ((x - padding) / effectiveWidth) * 100;
   120	      const year = percentToYear(percent);
   121	
   122	      if (dragging === 'low') {
   123	        const newLowYear = Math.min(year, highYear - 1);
   124	        setLowYear(newLowYear);
   125	        // Call onChange immediately during drag for real-time update
   126	        onChange(newLowYear, highYear);
   127	      } else if (dragging === 'high') {
   128	        const newHighYear = Math.max(year, lowYear + 1);
   129	        setHighYear(newHighYear);
   130	        // Call onChange immediately during drag for real-time update
   131	        onChange(lowYear, newHighYear);
   132	      }
   133	    };
   134	
   135	    const handleMouseUp = () => {
   136	      // Call onChange one final time when dragging ends (in case of any rounding)
   137	      onChange(lowYear, highYear);
   138	      setDragging(null);
   139	    };
   140	
   141	    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   142	    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
   143	
   144	    return () => {
   145	      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   146	      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
   147	    };
   148	  }, [dragging, lowYear, highYear, onChange, startYear, totalYears, yearToPercent, percentToYear]);
   149	
   150	  const lowPercent = yearToPercent(lowYear);
   151	  const highPercent = yearToPercent(highYear);
   152	
   153	  return (
   154	    <div className="year-histogram">
   155	      {/* 年份范围显示 */}
   156	      <div className="year-range-display">
   157	        <span className="year-value">{lowYear}</span>
   158	        <span className="year-separator-display">至</span>
   159	        <span className="year-value">{highYear}</span>
   160	      </div>
   161	
   162	      {/* Histogram visualization with integrated handles */}
   163	      <div className="histogram-container" ref={sliderRef}>
   164	        <svg className="histogram-svg" viewBox="0 0 100 50" preserveAspectRatio="none">
   165	          <defs>
   166	            <linearGradient id="barGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
   167	              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="rgb(16, 163, 127)" stopOpacity="0.3" />
   168	              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="rgb(16, 163, 127)" stopOpacity="0.15" />
   169	            </linearGradient>
   170	            <linearGradient id="barGradientSelected" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
   171	              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="rgb(16, 163, 127)" stopOpacity="0.9" />
   172	              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="rgb(16, 163, 127)" stopOpacity="0.6" />
   173	            </linearGradient>
   174	          </defs>
   175	
   176	          {HISTOGRAM_DATA.map((item, index) => {
   177	            // Parse year range
   178	            const [rangeStart, rangeEnd] = item.key.split('-').map(Number);
   179	            const midYear = (rangeStart + rangeEnd) / 2;
   180	
   181	            // Calculate position and size
   182	            const x = ((midYear - startYear) / totalYears) * 100;
   183	            const barWidth = ((rangeEnd - rangeStart) / totalYears) * 100 * 0.85; // 85% width for gaps
   184	            const height = (item.docCount / maxValue) * 50;
   185	            const y = 50 - height;
   186	
   187	            // Check if in selected range
   188	            const isInRange = rangeEnd >= lowYear && rangeStart <= highYear;
   189	
   190	            return (
   191	              <rect
   192	                key={item.key}
   193	                x={x - barWidth / 2}
   194	                y={y}
   195	                width={barWidth}
   196	                height={height}
   197	                fill={isInRange ? "url(#barGradientSelected)" : "url(#barGradient)"}
   198	                opacity={isInRange ? 1 : 0.25}
   199	                rx="0.5"
   200	              />
   201	            );
   202	          })}
   203	        </svg>
   204	
   205	        {/* Low handle */}
   206	        <div
   207	          className="slider-handle slider-handle-low"
   208	          style={{ left: `calc(${lowPercent}%)` }}
   209	          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown('low')}
   210	        />
   211	
   212	        {/* High handle */}
   213	        <div
   214	          className="slider-handle slider-handle-high"
   215	          style={{ left: `calc(${highPercent}%)` }}
   216	          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown('high')}
   217	        />
   218	      </div>
   219	
   220	    </div>
   221	  );
   222	};
   223	
   224	export default YearHistogram;

     1	/**

    10	import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';

    14	export const useSidebar = () => {
    15	  const context = useContext(SidebarContext);
    16	  if (!context) {
    17	    throw new Error('useSidebar must be used within SidebarProvider');
    18	  }
    19	  return context;

    22	export const SidebarProvider = ({ children }) => {
    23	  // 侧边栏配置状态
    24	  const [sidebarConfig, setSidebarConfig] = useState({
    25	    showHistory: false,
    26	    historyType: 'conversation',
    27	    historyItems: [],
    28	    currentItemId: null,
    29	    onSelectItem: null,
    30	    onDeleteItem: null,
    31	    onRenameItem: null,
    32	    onNewItem: null,
    33	    historyLoading: false,
    34	  });
    35	
    36	  // 移动端侧边栏状态
    37	  const [isMobileOpen, setIsMobileOpen] = useState(false);
    38	  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);
    39	
    40	  // 检测是否为移动端
    41	  useEffect(() => {
    42	    const checkMobile = () => {
    43	      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth <= 768);
    44	    };
    45	    
    46	    checkMobile();
    47	    window.addEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
    48	    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
    49	  }, []);
    50	
    51	  // 移动端打开侧边栏时禁止body滚动
    52	  useEffect(() => {
    53	    if (isMobileOpen && isMobile) {
    54	      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    55	    } else {
    56	      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    57	    }
    58	    return () => {
    59	      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    60	    };
    61	  }, [isMobileOpen, isMobile]);
    62	
    63	  // 更新侧边栏配置
    64	  const updateSidebarConfig = useCallback((config) => {
    65	    setSidebarConfig(prev => ({
    66	      ...prev,
    67	      ...config,
    68	    }));
    69	  }, []);
    70	
    71	  // 重置侧边栏配置（用于无历史记录的页面）
    72	  const resetSidebarConfig = useCallback(() => {
    73	    setSidebarConfig({
    74	      showHistory: false,
    75	      historyType: 'conversation',
    76	      historyItems: [],
    77	      currentItemId: null,
    78	      onSelectItem: null,
    79	      onDeleteItem: null,
    80	      onRenameItem: null,
    81	      onNewItem: null,
    82	      historyLoading: false,
    83	    });
    84	  }, []);
    85	
    86	  // 打开移动端侧边栏
    87	  const openMobileSidebar = useCallback(() => {
    88	    setIsMobileOpen(true);
    89	  }, []);
    90	
    91	  // 关闭移动端侧边栏
    92	  const closeMobileSidebar = useCallback(() => {
    93	    setIsMobileOpen(false);
    94	  }, []);
    95	
    96	  // 切换移动端侧边栏
    97	  const toggleMobileSidebar = useCallback(() => {
    98	    setIsMobileOpen(prev => !prev);
    99	  }, []);
   100	
   101	  return (
   102	    <SidebarContext.Provider
   103	      value={{
   104	        sidebarConfig,
   105	        updateSidebarConfig,
   106	        resetSidebarConfig,
   107	        isMobile,
   108	        isMobileOpen,
   109	        openMobileSidebar,
   110	        closeMobileSidebar,
   111	        toggleMobileSidebar,
   112	      }}
   113	    >
   114	      {children}
   115	    </SidebarContext.Provider>
   116	  );
   117	};

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
    11	import * as subscriptionAPI from '../services/subscriptionService';
    12	
    13	const SubscriptionContext = createContext();
    14	
    15	// 缓存有效期：5分钟
    16	const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    17	
    18	export const SubscriptionProvider = ({ children }) => {
    19	  const [subscriptionData, setSubscriptionData] = useState(null);
    20	  const [usageData, setUsageData] = useState(null);
    21	  const [quotaData, setQuotaData] = useState(null);
    22	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    23	  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
    24	
    25	  // 缓存时间戳
    26	  const lastFetchTime = useRef({
    27	    subscription: 0,
    28	    usage: 0,
    29	    quota: 0
    30	  });
    31	
    32	  // 防止并发请求
    33	  const fetchingRef = useRef({
    34	    subscription: false,
    35	    usage: false,
    36	    quota: false
    37	  });
    38	
    39	  /**
    40	   * 获取订阅信息
    41	   * @param {boolean} force - 是否强制刷新缓存
    42	   */
    43	  const fetchSubscription = useCallback(async (force = false) => {
    44	    const now = Date.now();
    45	    const cacheKey = 'subscription';
    46	
    47	    // 检查缓存
    48	    if (!force && subscriptionData && (now - lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] < CACHE_TTL)) {
    49	      return subscriptionData;
    50	    }
    51	
    52	    // 防止并发请求
    53	    if (fetchingRef.current[cacheKey]) {
    54	      return subscriptionData;
    55	    }
    56	
    57	    try {
    58	      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = true;
    59	      setLoading(true);
    60	      setError(null);
    61	
    62	      const response = await subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription();
    63	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    64	        const data = response.data.data;
    65	        setSubscriptionData(data);
    66	        lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] = now;
    67	        return data;
    68	      } else {
    69	        throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取订阅信息失败');
    70	      }
    71	    } catch (err) {
    72	      const errorMsg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || '获取订阅信息失败';
    73	      setError(errorMsg);
    74	      console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', err);
    75	      return null;
    76	    } finally {
    77	      setLoading(false);
    78	      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = false;
    79	    }
    80	  }, [subscriptionData]);
    81	
    82	  /**
    83	   * 获取使用情况
    84	   * @param {boolean} force - 是否强制刷新缓存
    85	   */
    86	  const fetchUsage = useCallback(async (force = false) => {
    87	    const now = Date.now();
    88	    const cacheKey = 'usage';
    89	
    90	    // 检查缓存
    91	    if (!force && usageData && (now - lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] < CACHE_TTL)) {
    92	      return usageData;
    93	    }
    94	
    95	    // 防止并发请求
    96	    if (fetchingRef.current[cacheKey]) {
    97	      return usageData;
    98	    }
    99	
   100	    try {
   101	      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = true;
   102	      setLoading(true);
   103	      setError(null);
   104	
   105	      const response = await subscriptionAPI.getUsage();
   106	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   107	        const data = response.data.data;
   108	        setUsageData(data);
   109	        lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] = now;
   110	        return data;
   111	      } else {
   112	        throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取使用情况失败');
   113	      }
   114	    } catch (err) {
   115	      const errorMsg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || '获取使用情况失败';
   116	      setError(errorMsg);
   117	      console.error('Failed to fetch usage:', err);
   118	      return null;
   119	    } finally {
   120	      setLoading(false);
   121	      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = false;
   122	    }
   123	  }, [usageData]);
   124	
   125	  /**
   126	   * 获取配额信息
   127	   * @param {boolean} force - 是否强制刷新缓存
   128	   */
   129	  const fetchQuota = useCallback(async (force = false) => {
   130	    const now = Date.now();
   131	    const cacheKey = 'quota';
   132	
   133	    // 检查缓存
   134	    if (!force && quotaData && (now - lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] < CACHE_TTL)) {
   135	      return quotaData;
   136	    }
   137	
   138	    // 防止并发请求
   139	    if (fetchingRef.current[cacheKey]) {
   140	      return quotaData;
   141	    }
   142	
   143	    try {
   144	      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = true;
   145	      setLoading(true);
   146	      setError(null);
   147	
   148	      const response = await subscriptionAPI.getQuota();
   149	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   150	        const data = response.data.data;
   151	        setQuotaData(data);
   152	        lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] = now;
   153	        return data;
   154	      } else {
   155	        throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取配额信息失败');
   156	      }
   157	    } catch (err) {
   158	      const errorMsg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || '获取配额信息失败';
   159	      setError(errorMsg);
   160	      console.error('Failed to fetch quota:', err);
   161	      return null;
   162	    } finally {
   163	      setLoading(false);
   164	      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = false;
   165	    }
   166	  }, [quotaData]);
   167	
   168	  /**
   169	   * 批量获取所有数据（并行）
   170	   * @param {boolean} force - 是否强制刷新缓存
   171	   */
   172	  const fetchAll = useCallback(async (force = false) => {
   173	    try {
   174	      setLoading(true);
   175	      setError(null);
   176	
   177	      const [subscription, usage, quota] = await Promise.all([
   178	        fetchSubscription(force),
   179	        fetchUsage(force),
   180	        fetchQuota(force)
   181	      ]);
   182	
   183	      return { subscription, usage, quota };
   184	    } catch (err) {
   185	      setError(err.message || '获取数据失败');
   186	      return null;
   187	    } finally {
   188	      setLoading(false);
   189	    }
   190	  }, [fetchSubscription, fetchUsage, fetchQuota]);
   191	
   192	  /**
   193	   * 清除缓存
   194	   */
   195	  const clearCache = useCallback(() => {
   196	    setSubscriptionData(null);
   197	    setUsageData(null);
   198	    setQuotaData(null);
   199	    lastFetchTime.current = {
   200	      subscription: 0,
   201	      usage: 0,
   202	      quota: 0
   203	    };
   204	  }, []);
   205	
   206	  /**
   207	   * 更新使用量（扣减配额后调用）
   208	   * @param {object} updates - 要更新的使用量字段
   209	   */
   210	  const incrementUsage = useCallback((updates) => {
   211	    setUsageData(prev => {
   212	      if (!prev) return prev;
   213	      return {
   214	        ...prev,
   215	        ...updates
   216	      };
   217	    });
   218	  }, []);
   219	
   220	  const value = {
   221	    // 数据
   222	    subscriptionData,
   223	    usageData,
   224	    quotaData,
   225	    loading,
   226	    error,
   227	
   228	    // 方法
   229	    fetchSubscription,
   230	    fetchUsage,
   231	    fetchQuota,
   232	    fetchAll,
   233	    clearCache,
   234	    incrementUsage,
   235	
   236	    // 辅助方法
   237	    isSubscriptionValid: subscriptionData?.status === 'active',
   238	    hasQuotaRemaining: (quotaType) => {
   239	      if (!usageData || !subscriptionData) return false;
   240	      const used = usageData[quotaType] || 0;
   241	      const quota = subscriptionData[`${quotaType}_quota`];
   242	      return quota === -1 || used < quota; // -1 表示无限制
   243	    }
   244	  };
   245	
   246	  return (
   247	    <SubscriptionContext.Provider value={value}>
   248	      {children}
   249	    </SubscriptionContext.Provider>
   250	  );
   251	};
   252	
   253	/**
   254	 * 使用订阅上下文的 Hook
   255	 */
   256	export const useSubscription = () => {
   257	  const context = useContext(SubscriptionContext);
   258	  if (!context) {
   259	    throw new Error('useSubscription must be used within a SubscriptionProvider');
   260	  }
   261	  return context;
   262	};
   263	
   264	export default SubscriptionContext;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	
    12	const ThemeContext = createContext();
    13	
    14	// localStorage 键名
    15	const THEME_KEY = 'theme';
    16	const USER_PREFERENCE_KEY = 'theme_user_preference'; // 用户是否手动设置过主题
    17	
    18	// 根据当前时间获取推荐主题
    19	// 日间模式: 6:00 - 18:00
    20	// 夜间模式: 18:00 - 6:00
    21	const getThemeByTime = () => {
    22	  const hour = new Date().getHours();
    23	  return (hour >= 6 && hour < 18) ? 'light' : 'dark';
    24	};
    25	
    26	export const useTheme = () => {
    27	  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
    28	  if (!context) {
    29	    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
    30	  }
    31	  return context;
    32	};
    33	
    34	export const ThemeProvider = ({ children }) => {
    35	  // 初始化主题
    36	  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
    37	    const userPreference = localStorage.getItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY);
    38	    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    39	    
    40	    // 如果用户手动设置过主题，使用用户的偏好
    41	    if (userPreference === 'true' && savedTheme) {
    42	      return savedTheme;
    43	    }
    44	    
    45	    // 否则根据当前时间自动设置
    46	    return getThemeByTime();
    47	  });
    48	
    49	  // 切换主题（用户手动切换）
    50	  const toggleTheme = () => {
    51	    setTheme(prevTheme => {
    52	      const newTheme = prevTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    53	      localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, newTheme);
    54	      localStorage.setItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY, 'true'); // 标记用户已手动设置
    55	      return newTheme;
    56	    });
    57	  };
    58	
    59	  // 设置特定主题（用户手动设置）
    60	  const setSpecificTheme = (themeName) => {
    61	    setTheme(themeName);
    62	    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, themeName);
    63	    localStorage.setItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY, 'true'); // 标记用户已手动设置
    64	  };
    65	
    66	  // 重置为自动模式（根据时间自动切换）
    67	  const resetToAutoTheme = () => {
    68	    localStorage.removeItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY);
    69	    const autoTheme = getThemeByTime();
    70	    setTheme(autoTheme);
    71	    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, autoTheme);
    72	  };
    73	
    74	  // 检查是否为用户手动设置的主题
    75	  const isUserPreference = () => {
    76	    return localStorage.getItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY) === 'true';
    77	  };
    78	
    79	  // 当主题改变时，更新document的class
    80	  useEffect(() => {
    81	    const root = document.documentElement;
    82	    root.className = theme;
    83	    
    84	    // 也可以设置data-theme属性，方便CSS选择器使用
    85	    root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    86	    
    87	    // 更新meta标签的theme-color（影响浏览器地址栏颜色）
    88	    const metaThemeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    89	    if (metaThemeColor) {
    90	      metaThemeColor.content = theme === 'dark' ? '#212121' : '#ffffff';
    91	    } else {
    92	      const meta = document.createElement('meta');
    93	      meta.name = 'theme-color';
    94	      meta.content = theme === 'dark' ? '#212121' : '#ffffff';
    95	      document.head.appendChild(meta);
    96	    }
    97	  }, [theme]);
    98	
    99	  // 定时检查是否需要根据时间自动切换主题（仅在非用户手动设置时）
   100	  useEffect(() => {
   101	    // 如果用户手动设置过，不自动切换
   102	    if (isUserPreference()) {
   103	      return;
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    // 每分钟检查一次是否需要切换主题
   107	    const checkAndUpdateTheme = () => {
   108	      if (!isUserPreference()) {
   109	        const timeBasedTheme = getThemeByTime();
   110	        if (timeBasedTheme !== theme) {
   111	          setTheme(timeBasedTheme);
   112	          localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, timeBasedTheme);
   113	        }
   114	      }
   115	    };
   116	
   117	    const intervalId = setInterval(checkAndUpdateTheme, 60000); // 每分钟检查
   118	
   119	    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
   120	  }, [theme]);
   121	
   122	  const value = {
   123	    theme,
   124	    toggleTheme,
   125	    setTheme: setSpecificTheme,
   126	    resetToAutoTheme,
   127	    isUserPreference: isUserPreference(),
   128	    isDark: theme === 'dark',
   129	    isLight: theme === 'light'
   130	  };
   131	
   132	  return (
   133	    <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>
   134	      {children}
   135	    </ThemeContext.Provider>
   136	  );
   137	};

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	
    12	/**
    13	 * 优化的打字机效果Hook
    14	 * 使用单个定时器和requestAnimationFrame优化性能
    15	 */
    16	export const useTypewriter = (phrases, options = {}) => {
    17	  const {
    18	    typingSpeed = 100,
    19	    deletingSpeed = 50,
    20	    pauseAfterComplete = 2000,
    21	    pauseAfterDelete = 500,
    22	    enabled = true,
    23	  } = options;
    24	
    25	  const [displayedText, setDisplayedText] = useState('');
    26	  const [currentPhraseIndex, setCurrentPhraseIndex] = useState(0);
    27	  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
    28	  const [showCursor, setShowCursor] = useState(true);
    29	
    30	  const timeoutRef = useRef(null);
    31	  const cursorIntervalRef = useRef(null);
    32	
    33	  // 清理所有定时器
    34	  const cleanup = useCallback(() => {
    35	    if (timeoutRef.current) {
    36	      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    37	      timeoutRef.current = null;
    38	    }
    39	    if (cursorIntervalRef.current) {
    40	      clearInterval(cursorIntervalRef.current);
    41	      cursorIntervalRef.current = null;
    42	    }
    43	  }, []);
    44	
    45	  useEffect(() => {
    46	    if (!enabled || !phrases || phrases.length === 0) {
    47	      return;
    48	    }
    49	
    50	    const currentPhrase = phrases[currentPhraseIndex];
    51	
    52	    // 光标闪烁 - 使用单一interval
    53	    if (!cursorIntervalRef.current) {
    54	      cursorIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
    55	        setShowCursor(prev => !prev);
    56	      }, 530);
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    // 打字机逻辑
    60	    if (!isDeleting && displayedText === currentPhrase) {
    61	      // 完成打字,暂停后开始删除
    62	      timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    63	        setIsDeleting(true);
    64	      }, pauseAfterComplete);
    65	      return;
    66	    }
    67	
    68	    if (isDeleting && displayedText === '') {
    69	      // 删除完成,切换到下一个短语
    70	      setIsDeleting(false);
    71	      setCurrentPhraseIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % phrases.length);
    72	      timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    73	        // 小延迟后开始下一个短语
    74	      }, pauseAfterDelete);
    75	      return;
    76	    }
    77	
    78	    // 打字或删除字符
    79	    const speed = isDeleting ? deletingSpeed : typingSpeed + Math.random() * 20;
    80	    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    81	      setDisplayedText(prev => {
    82	        if (isDeleting) {
    83	          return currentPhrase.substring(0, prev.length - 1);
    84	        } else {
    85	          return currentPhrase.substring(0, prev.length + 1);
    86	        }
    87	      });
    88	    }, speed);
    89	
    90	    return cleanup;
    91	  }, [displayedText, isDeleting, currentPhraseIndex, phrases, enabled, typingSpeed, deletingSpeed, pauseAfterComplete, pauseAfterDelete, cleanup]);
    92	
    93	  // 组件卸载时清理
    94	  useEffect(() => {
    95	    return cleanup;
    96	  }, [cleanup]);
    97	
    98	  return { displayedText, showCursor };
    99	};

    24	// 懒加载 AuthModal
    25	const AuthModal = lazy(() => import('../components/AuthModal'));
