    27	// 辅助函数：根据parent_message_id组织消息，确保问答对正确匹配
    28	// 对于有parent_message_id的新消息，使用严格的父子关系
    29	// 对于没有parent_message_id的旧消息，回退到时间顺序
    30	const organizeMessagesByParentId = (messages) => {
    31	  if (!messages || messages.length === 0) return [];
    32	  
    33	  // 检查是否有消息包含parent_message_id
    34	  const hasParentIds = messages.some(m => m.parent_message_id);
    35	  
    36	  // 如果没有parent_message_id，使用原始顺序（向后兼容旧数据）
    37	  if (!hasParentIds) {
    38	    return messages;
    39	  }
    40	  
    41	  // 构建消息映射
    42	  const messageMap = {};
    43	  messages.forEach(msg => {
    44	    messageMap[msg.message_id] = msg;
    45	  });
    46	  
    47	  // 找到所有根消息（用户消息且没有parent_message_id的）
    48	  const rootMessages = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user' && !m.parent_message_id);
    49	  
    50	  // 构建有序的消息列表
    51	  const organized = [];
    52	  const processedIds = new Set();
    53	  
    54	  // 对每个根消息，递归添加其子消息
    55	  const addMessageAndChildren = (msg) => {
    56	    if (processedIds.has(msg.id)) return;
    57	    
    58	    organized.push(msg);
    59	    processedIds.add(msg.id);
    60	    
    61	    // 查找以当前消息为parent的子消息
    62	    const children = messages.filter(m => 
    63	      m.parent_message_id === msg.message_id && !processedIds.has(m.id)
    64	    );
    65	    
    66	    // 按时间排序子消息
    67	    children.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
    68	    
    69	    children.forEach(child => {
    70	      addMessageAndChildren(child);
    71	    });
    72	  };
    73	  
    74	  // 按时间排序根消息
    75	  rootMessages.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
    76	  
    77	  // 处理所有根消息
    78	  rootMessages.forEach(rootMsg => {
    79	    addMessageAndChildren(rootMsg);
    80	  });
    81	  
    82	  // 添加任何未被处理的消息（孤儿消息，可能是数据不一致）
    83	  messages.forEach(msg => {
    84	    if (!processedIds.has(msg.id)) {
    85	      organized.push(msg);
    86	    }
    87	  });
    88	  
    89	  return organized;
    90	};

   184	        const response = await subscriptionAPI.getUsage();
   185	
   186	        if (response.data.code === 0) {
   187	          const data = response.data.data;
   188	          // 后端返回的数据包含 usage 和 limits
   189	          // 将 limits 映射为 quota 格式
   190	          const quotaData = {
   191	            advancedSearchLowQuota: data.limits?.advanced_search_low?.limit ?? -1,
   192	            advancedSearchMidQuota: data.limits?.advanced_search_mid?.limit ?? -1,
   193	            advancedSearchHighQuota: data.limits?.advanced_search_high?.limit ?? -1,
   194	          };
   195	
   196	          // 将 usage 映射为前端格式
   197	          const usageData = {
   198	            advancedSearchLowCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_low ?? 0,
   199	            advancedSearchMidCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_mid ?? 0,
   200	            advancedSearchHighCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_high ?? 0,
   201	          };
   202	
   203	          setQuota(quotaData);
   204	          setUsage(usageData);
   205	        }
   206	      } catch (error) {
   207	        console.error('Failed to fetch quota/usage:', error);
   208	      }
   209	    };
   210	
   211	    if (isAuthenticated && user) {
   212	      fetchQuotaAndUsage();
   213	    }
   214	  }, [isAuthenticated, user]);
   215	
   216	  // 搜索示例轮播效果
   217	  useEffect(() => {
   218	    const interval = setInterval(() => {
   219	      setCurrentExampleIndex((prevIndex) => (prevIndex + 1) % searchExamples.length);
   220	    }, 3000); // 每3秒切换一次
   221	
   222	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
   223	  }, [searchExamples.length]);
   224	
   225	  const loadConversations = async () => {
   226	    setConversationsLoading(true);
   227	    try {
   228	      const response = await conversationAPI.getConversations(1, 50, 'search');
   229	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   230	        setConversations(response.data.data.conversations || []);
   231	      }
   232	    } catch (error) {
   233	      console.error('Failed to load search conversations:', error);
   234	    } finally {
   235	      setConversationsLoading(false);
   236	    }
   237	  };
   238	
   239	  // 获取当前模型的剩余次数
   240	  const getRemainingCount = () => {
   241	    if (!quota || !usage) return null;
   242	
   243	    // 映射配额和使用情况字段
   244	    const quotaFieldMap = {
   245	      'low': 'advancedSearchLowQuota',
   246	      'mid': 'advancedSearchMidQuota',
   247	      'high': 'advancedSearchHighQuota'
   248	    };
   249	
   250	    const usageFieldMap = {
   251	      'low': 'advancedSearchLowCount',
   252	      'mid': 'advancedSearchMidCount',
   253	      'high': 'advancedSearchHighCount'
   254	    };
   255	
   256	    const quotaField = quotaFieldMap[modelLevel];
   257	    const usageField = usageFieldMap[modelLevel];
   258	
   259	    const quotaValue = quota[quotaField];
   260	    const usageValue = usage[usageField] || 0;
   261	
   262	    // -1 表示无限制
   263	    if (quotaValue === -1) return null; // 无限制时不显示提示
   264	
   265	    const remaining = Math.max(0, quotaValue - usageValue);
   266	    return remaining;
   267	  };
   268	
   269	  // 从URL参数读取对话ID或初始查询（仅执行一次）
   270	  useEffect(() => {
   271	    const urlConversationId = searchParams.get('conversation');
   272	    const query = searchParams.get('query');
   273	    const urlModelLevel = searchParams.get('modelLevel');
   274	
   275	    // 如果URL中有模型级别参数，设置模型级别
   276	    if (urlModelLevel && ['low', 'mid', 'high'].includes(urlModelLevel)) {
   277	      setModelLevel(urlModelLevel);
   278	    }
   279	
   280	    if (urlConversationId && isAuthenticated && !currentConversationId && conversations.length > 0) {
   281	      // 恢复对话 - 确保对话列表已加载
   282	      const conversation = conversations.find(c => c.id === parseInt(urlConversationId));
   283	      if (conversation) {
   284	        handleSelectConversation(urlConversationId);
   285	      }
   286	    } else if (query && isAuthenticated && messages.length === 0 && !urlConversationId) {
   287	      // 立即清除URL参数
   288	      setSearchParams({});
   289	      // 执行搜索
   290	      setSearchQuery(query);
   291	      setTimeout(() => {
   292	        handleInitialSearch(query);
   293	      }, 100);
   294	    }
   295	    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
   296	  }, [searchParams, isAuthenticated, conversations]);
   297	
   298	  // 当对话ID变化时，更新URL参数
   299	  useEffect(() => {
   300	    if (currentConversationId) {
   301	      const currentUrl = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
   302	      const urlConvId = currentUrl.get('conversation');
   303	      if (urlConvId !== String(currentConversationId)) {
   304	        setSearchParams({ conversation: String(currentConversationId) });
   305	      }
   306	    } else {
   307	      const currentUrl = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
   308	      if (currentUrl.get('conversation')) {
   309	        setSearchParams({});
   310	      }
   311	    }
   312	    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
   313	  }, [currentConversationId]);
   314	
   315	  // 获取延伸问题（通过独立 API）
   316	  const fetchFollowUpQuestions = async (conversationId, messageId, message, showLoading = true) => {
   317	    try {
   318	      logger.log(`Fetching follow-up questions for message ${messageId}`);
   319	      // 只有在需要显示 loading 时才设置状态（通常只有最新消息才显示）
   320	      if (showLoading) {
   321	        setIsLoadingSuggestedQuestions(true);
   322	      }
   323	      const response = await conversationAPI.getFollowUpQuestions(conversationId, messageId);
   324	
   325	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data.questions) {
   326	        const questionsText = response.data.data.questions;
   327	        const questions = extractSuggestedQuestions(questionsText);
   328	
   329	        if (questions.length > 0) {
   330	          // 更新消息的延伸问题
   331	          setMessages(prev => prev.map(msg =>
   332	            msg.id === messageId
   333	              ? { ...msg, suggestedQuestions: questions }
   334	              : msg
   335	          ));
   336	
   337	          logger.log(`Loaded ${questions.length} follow-up questions`);
   338	
   339	          // 延伸问题加载后，确保滚动到底部显示出来
   340	          setTimeout(() => {
   341	            if (autoScroll) {
   342	              // 滚动到底部，确保延伸问题完全可见
   343	              scrollToBottom(0);
   344	            }
   345	          }, 150);
   346	        }
   347	      }
   348	    } catch (error) {
   349	      // 延伸问题加载失败不影响主流程，只记录日志
   350	      console.error('Failed to load follow-up questions:', error);
   351	      logger.log('Failed to load follow-up questions, but search completed successfully');
   352	    } finally {
   353	      if (showLoading) {
   354	        setIsLoadingSuggestedQuestions(false);
   355	      }
   356	    }
   357	  };
   358	
   359	  // 解析 AI 回复中的推荐问题
   360	  const extractSuggestedQuestions = (content) => {
   361	    const regex = /\[FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS\]/;
   362	    const match = content.match(regex);
   363	
   364	    if (match && match[1]) {
   365	      // 提取问题列表
   366	      const questionsText = match[1].trim();
   367	      const questions = questionsText
   368	        .split('\n')
   369	        .map(line => line.trim())
   370	        .filter(line => line.match(/^\d+\.\s+/)) // 匹配 "1. " 格式
   371	        .map(line => line.replace(/^\d+\.\s+/, '')); // 移除序号
   372	
   373	      return questions;
   374	    }
   375	
   376	    return [];
   377	  };
   378	
   379	  // 处理延伸问题点击 - 直接触发新搜索
   380	  const handleFollowUpQuestionClick = async (question) => {
   381	    // 检查是否已登录
   382	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   383	      alert('请先登录');
   384	      return;
   385	    }
   386	
   387	    // 检查是否正在加载
   388	    if (loading || isStreaming) {
   389	      return;
   390	    }
   391	
   392	    // 立即滚动到底部并启用自动滚动
   393	    setAutoScroll(true);
   394	    setTimeout(() => scrollToBottom(), 100);
   395	
   396	    // 使用现有的 handleInitialSearch 函数触发新搜索
   397	    // 这会自动处理配额检查、创建消息、启动流式搜索等所有逻辑
   398	    await handleInitialSearch(question);
   399	  };
   400	
   401	  // 渲染推荐问题组件
   402	  const renderSuggestedQuestions = (questions) => {
   403	    if (!questions || questions.length === 0) return null;
   404	
   405	    return (
   406	      <div className="suggested-questions-inline">
   407	        <div className="suggested-questions-header">
   408	          <span className="suggested-questions-title">你可以继续提问</span>
   409	        </div>
   410	        <div className="suggested-questions-list">
   411	          {questions.map((question, index) => (
   412	            <button
   413	              key={index}
   414	              className="suggested-question-btn"
   415	              onClick={() => handleFollowUpQuestionClick(question)}
   416	              disabled={loading}
   417	            >
   418	              <span className="question-text">{question}</span>
   419	            </button>
   420	          ))}
   421	        </div>
   422	      </div>
   423	    );
   424	  };
   425	
   426	  const scrollToBottom = (extraHeight = 0) => {
   427	    // 如果用户正在手动滚动或已禁用自动滚动，不执行自动滚动
   428	    if (userScrolling || !autoScroll) return;
   429	    
   430	    const container = chatMessagesRef.current;
   431	    if (container) {
   432	      lastScrollTime.current = Date.now(); // 记录程序滚动时间
   433	      const targetScroll = container.scrollHeight + extraHeight;
   434	      container.scrollTo({
   435	        top: targetScroll,
   436	        behavior: 'smooth'
   437	      });
   438	    }
   439	  };
   440	
   441	  const scrollToTop = () => {
   442	    if (chatMessagesRef.current) {
   443	      chatMessagesRef.current.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
   444	    }
   445	  };
   446	
   447	  // 检查是否滚动到底部
   448	  const isAtBottom = () => {
   449	    if (!chatMessagesRef.current) return true;
   450	    const { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight } = chatMessagesRef.current;
   451	    // 允许 50px 的误差范围
   452	    return scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight < 50;
   453	  };
   454	
   455	  // 处理滚动事件
   456	  const handleScroll = () => {
   457	    if (!chatMessagesRef.current) return;
   458	
   459	    const now = Date.now();
   460	    const timeSinceLastScroll = now - lastScrollTime.current;
   461	    
   462	    // 如果距离上次程序滚动时间很短，说明是程序触发的滚动
   463	    // 使用 200ms 阈值，给 smooth 滚动动画留足时间
   464	    if (timeSinceLastScroll < 200) {
   465	      return;
   466	    }
   467	
   468	    // 用户手动滚动，恢复自动切换 tab
   469	    setUserScrolling(true);
   470	    setManualTabSwitch(false); // 用户滚动时，取消手动切换标志，恢复自动切换
   471	    
   472	    const atBottom = isAtBottom();
   473	
   474	    // 如果用户滚动到底部，重新启用自动滚动
   475	    if (atBottom) {
   476	      setAutoScroll(true);
   477	      userScrolledRef.current = false;
   478	      setUserScrolling(false);
   479	    } else if (isStreaming || messages.length > 0) {
   480	      // 如果用户在流式传输或有消息时向上滚动，禁用自动滚动
   481	      setAutoScroll(false);
   482	      userScrolledRef.current = true;
   483	    }
   484	    
   485	    // 更新当前可见的问题索引
   486	    updateVisibleQuestionIndex();
   487	  };
   488	  
   489	  // 根据滚动位置更新当前问题索引
   490	  const updateVisibleQuestionIndex = () => {
   491	    // 如果正在滚动到指定问题，不更新索引
   492	    if (isScrollingToQuestion) return;
   493	    
   494	    // 如果正在流式传输，不更新索引（避免流式渲染时索引跳动）
   495	    if (isStreaming) return;
   496	    
   497	    const container = chatMessagesRef.current;
   498	    if (!container) return;
   499	    
   500	    const scrollTop = container.scrollTop;
   501	    const containerTop = container.getBoundingClientRect().top;
   502	    
   503	    // 找到所有用户消息
   504	    const userMessages = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user');
   505	    
   506	    // 找到当前可见的问题
   507	    for (let i = userMessages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   508	      const fullIndex = messages.indexOf(userMessages[i]);
   509	      const messageElement = document.getElementById(`message-${fullIndex}`);
   510	      
   511	      if (messageElement) {
   512	        const messageRect = messageElement.getBoundingClientRect();
   513	        const messageTop = messageRect.top - containerTop;
   514	        
   515	        // 如果消息在视口中或在视口上方，则认为是当前问题
   516	        if (messageTop <= 100) { // 100px的阈值
   517	          setCurrentQuestionIndex(i);
   518	          break;
   519	        }
   520	      }
   521	    }
   522	  };
   523	
   524	  // 监听滚动事件
   525	  useEffect(() => {
   526	    const chatMessages = chatMessagesRef.current;
   527	    if (chatMessages) {
   528	      // 监听滚轮事件，立即检测用户滚动意图
   529	      const handleWheel = (e) => {
   530	        // 用户使用滚轮，立即禁用自动滚动
   531	        if (isStreaming) {
   532	          setAutoScroll(false);
   533	          setUserScrolling(true);
   534	          userScrolledRef.current = true;
   535	        }
   536	      };
   537	      
   538	      chatMessages.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
   539	      chatMessages.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: true });
   540	      
   541	      return () => {
   542	        chatMessages.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
   543	        chatMessages.removeEventListener('wheel', handleWheel);
   544	      };
   545	    }
   546	  }, [isStreaming, messages.length, isScrollingToQuestion]); // 添加 isScrollingToQuestion 依赖
   547	
   548	  // 自动滚动逻辑
   549	  useEffect(() => {
   550	    // 如果正在加载历史对话，滚动到顶部
   551	    if (isLoadingHistoryRef.current && messages.length > 0) {
   552	      setTimeout(() => {
   553	        scrollToTop();
   554	        isLoadingHistoryRef.current = false;
   555	      }, 100); // 给DOM渲染留一点时间
   556	      return;
   557	    }
   558	
   559	    // 只在以下情况自动滚动到底部：
   560	    // 1. autoScroll 为 true
   561	    // 2. 消息数量增加或正在流式传输
   562	    // 3. 不是加载历史对话
   563	    if (autoScroll && (messages.length > prevMessagesLengthRef.current || isStreaming) && !isLoadingHistoryRef.current) {
   564	      scrollToBottom();
   565	    }
   566	    prevMessagesLengthRef.current = messages.length;
   567	  }, [messages, isStreaming, autoScroll]);
   568	
   569	  // 当流式内容更新时也自动滚动（如果启用了自动滚动）
   570	  useEffect(() => {
   571	    if (autoScroll && isStreaming && streamingContent && !userScrolling) {
   572	      // 立即滚动，不需要延迟
   573	      scrollToBottom();
   574	    }
   575	  }, [streamingContent]); // 只依赖streamingContent，避免过多触发
   576	  
   577	  // 当消息列表变化时，仅在特定情况下更新索引
   578	  useEffect(() => {
   579	    // 如果正在加载历史对话，不自动更新
   580	    if (isLoadingHistoryRef.current) return;
   581	    
   582	    // 如果消息列表为空，重置索引
   583	    if (messages.length === 0) {
   584	      setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
   585	    }
   586	    // 注意：新增消息时的索引更新已经在 handleInitialSearch 中处理
   587	  }, [messages.length]);
   588	
   589	  // 自动切换论文tab - 根据当前可见的消息
   590	  useEffect(() => {
   591	    if (!chatMessagesRef.current || paperSets.length <= 1) return;
   592	
   593	    const handleTabSwitch = () => {
   594	      // 如果是手动切换的 tab，不执行自动切换
   595	      if (manualTabSwitch) return;
   596	      
   597	      const container = chatMessagesRef.current;
   598	      if (!container) return;
   599	
   600	      const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
   601	      const containerMiddle = containerRect.top + containerRect.height / 2;
   602	
   603	      // 找出所有 assistant 消息
   604	      const assistantMessages = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.message-assistant'));
   605	
   606	      // 找到最接近视口中心的 assistant 消息
   607	      let closestMessageIndex = -1;
   608	      let closestDistance = Infinity;
   609	
   610	      assistantMessages.forEach((msgElement, idx) => {
   611	        const msgRect = msgElement.getBoundingClientRect();
   612	        const msgMiddle = msgRect.top + msgRect.height / 2;
   613	        const distance = Math.abs(msgMiddle - containerMiddle);
   614	
   615	        // 检查消息是否在视口内
   616	        const isVisible = msgRect.bottom > containerRect.top && msgRect.top < containerRect.bottom;
   617	
   618	        if (isVisible && distance < closestDistance) {
   619	          closestDistance = distance;
   620	          closestMessageIndex = idx;
   621	        }
   622	      });
   623	
   624	      // 如果找到了可见的 assistant 消息
   625	      if (closestMessageIndex >= 0 && closestMessageIndex < paperSets.length) {
   626	        // paperSets 是倒序的（最新在索引0），assistantMessages 是正序的（最老在索引0）
   627	        // 需要反转索引：第一条消息（索引0）对应最后一个 paperSet（索引 length-1）
   628	        const tabIndex = paperSets.length - 1 - closestMessageIndex;
   629	        if (activeTab !== tabIndex) {
   630	          setActiveTab(tabIndex);
   631	        }
   632	      }
   633	    };
   634	
   635	    // 添加滚动监听
   636	    const container = chatMessagesRef.current;
   637	    container.addEventListener('scroll', handleTabSwitch);
   638	
   639	    // 初始调用一次
   640	    handleTabSwitch();
   641	
   642	    return () => {
   643	      if (container) {
   644	        container.removeEventListener('scroll', handleTabSwitch);
   645	      }
   646	    };
   647	  }, [paperSets, activeTab, setActiveTab, manualTabSwitch]);
   648	
   649	  // Clean up event source on unmount
   650	  useEffect(() => {
   651	    return () => {
   652	      if (eventSourceRef.current) {
   653	        eventSourceRef.current.close();
   654	      }
   655	    };
   656	  }, []);
   657	
   658	  // 更新侧边栏配置 - 只在登录状态下更新
   659	  useEffect(() => {
   660	    if (isAuthenticated) {
   661	      updateSidebarConfig({
   662	        showHistory: true,
   663	        historyType: 'conversation',
   664	        historyItems: conversations,
   665	        currentItemId: currentConversationId,
   666	        onSelectItem: handleSelectConversation,
   667	        onDeleteItem: handleDeleteConversation,
   668	        onRenameItem: handleRenameConversation,
   669	        onNewItem: handleNewConversation,
   670	        historyLoading: conversationsLoading,
   671	      });
   672	    }
   673	  }, [conversations, currentConversationId, conversationsLoading, updateSidebarConfig, isAuthenticated]);
   674	
   675	  const handleNewConversation = () => {
   676	    if (eventSourceRef.current) {
   677	      eventSourceRef.current.close();
   678	    }
   679	    setCurrentConversationId(null);
   680	    setMessages([]);
   681	    setPapers([]);
   682	    setPapersTotal(0);
   683	    setPaperSets([]); // 清空论文集合
   684	    setSearchQuery('');
   685	    setStreamingContent('');
   686	    setIsStreaming(false);
   687	    setHasAdvancedSearch(false); // 重置智能分析标志
   688	  };
   689	
   690	  const handleDeleteConversation = async (conversationId) => {
   691	    try {
   692	      await conversationAPI.deleteConversation(conversationId);
   693	      setConversations(conversations.filter(c => c.id !== conversationId));
   694	      if (currentConversationId === conversationId) {
   695	        handleNewConversation();
   696	      }
   697	    } catch (error) {
   698	      console.error('Failed to delete conversation:', error);
   699	      alert('删除失败');
   700	    }
   701	  };
   702	
   703	  const handleRenameConversation = async (conversationId, newTitle) => {
   704	    logger.log('handleRenameConversation called:', { conversationId, newTitle });
   705	    try {
   706	      const response = await api.put(`/user/conversations/${conversationId}/title`, { title: newTitle });
   707	      logger.log('Rename API response:', response.data);
   708	      setConversations(prevConversations =>
   709	        prevConversations.map(conv =>
   710	          conv.id === conversationId ? { ...conv, title: newTitle } : conv
   711	        )
   712	      );
   713	      logger.log('Local conversations updated');
   714	    } catch (error) {
   715	      console.error('Failed to rename conversation:', error);
   716	      console.error('Error details:', error.response?.data);
   717	    }
   718	  };
   719	
   720	  const handleSelectConversation = async (conversationId) => {
   721	    setLoading(true);
   722	    setSearchQuery(''); // 清空搜索输入框
   723	    setStreamingContent(''); // 切换对话时清空流式内容
   724	    setPaperSets([]); // 清空论文集合
   725	    setHasAdvancedSearch(false); // 重置智能分析标志
   726	    isLoadingHistoryRef.current = true; // 标记正在加载历史对话
   727	    setCurrentQuestionIndex(0); // 加载历史对话时，默认显示第一个问题
   728	    setAutoScroll(false); // 加载历史对话时禁用自动滚动
   729	
   730	    try {
   731	      const response = await conversationAPI.getConversation(conversationId);
   732	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   733	        const conv = response.data.data;
   734	        setCurrentConversationId(conv.id);
   735	        
   736	        // 重新组织消息顺序，使用parent_message_id建立问答对
   737	        const organizedMessages = organizeMessagesByParentId(conv.messages || []);
   738	        setMessages(organizedMessages);
   739	
   740	        // 查找所有有论文结果的消息，构建 paperSets
   741	        const messagesWithPapers = organizedMessages.filter(
   742	          m => m.role === 'user' && m.search_results && m.search_results.length > 0
   743	        );
   744	
   745	        if (messagesWithPapers.length > 0) {
   746	          // 按时间顺序（最新的在前），不需要 reverse，因为 messages 本身就是按时间顺序的
   747	          const sets = messagesWithPapers.map((msg, index) => ({
   748	            title: index === messagesWithPapers.length - 1 ? '最新搜索' : `搜索 ${index + 1}`,
   749	            papers: msg.search_results,
   750	            total: msg.search_results_total || msg.search_results.length,
   751	            query: msg.search_query
   752	          }));
   753	          // 倒序，让最新的在数组第一个位置
   754	          setPaperSets(sets.reverse());
   755	          setPapers(sets[0].papers);
   756	          setPapersTotal(sets[0].total);
   757	
   758	          // 检查是否有 assistant 消息，判断是否进行过智能分析
   759	          const hasAssistantMessages = organizedMessages.some(m => m.role === 'assistant');
   760	          setHasAdvancedSearch(hasAssistantMessages);
   761	
   762	          // 对于历史对话中的 assistant 消息，只加载已有的推荐问题，不再异步获取
   763	          const assistantMessages = organizedMessages.filter(m => m.role === 'assistant');
   764	          assistantMessages.forEach((assistantMsg) => {
   765	            // 如果已有 follow_up_questions 字段，直接解析
   766	            if (assistantMsg.follow_up_questions) {
   767	              const questions = extractSuggestedQuestions(assistantMsg.follow_up_questions);
   768	              if (questions.length > 0) {
   769	                setMessages(prev => prev.map(msg =>
   770	                  msg.id === assistantMsg.id
   771	                    ? { ...msg, suggestedQuestions: questions }
   772	                    : msg
   773	                ));
   774	              }
   775	            }
   776	            // 历史对话中没有推荐问题的消息，不再尝试加载
   777	          });
   778	        } else {
   779	          setPapers([]);
   780	          setPapersTotal(0);
   781	        }
   782	      }
   783	    } catch (error) {
   784	      console.error('Failed to load conversation:', error);
   785	      alert('加载对话失败');
   786	    } finally {
   787	      setLoading(false);
   788	    }
   789	  };
   790	
   791	  const handleInitialSearch = async (query) => {
   792	    if (!query.trim()) return;
   793	
   794	    // 检查是否登录，未登录则弹出登录弹窗
   795	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   796	      setShowAuthModal(true);
   797	      return;
   798	    }
   799	
   800	    const userMessage = query.trim();
   801	    const isFirstMessage = messages.length === 0;
   802	
   803	    setSearchQuery('');
   804	
   805	    // Reset textarea height
   806	    if (textareaRef.current) {
   807	      textareaRef.current.style.height = 'auto';
   808	    }
   809	
   810	    // Immediately show user message with loading state
   811	    const tempUserMessage = {
   812	      id: 'temp-' + Date.now(),
   813	      role: 'user',
   814	      content: userMessage,
   815	      search_query: userMessage,
   816	      search_results: null,
   817	      created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   818	    };
   819	
   820	    // 先计算新的索引（当前用户消息数量）
   821	    const currentUserMessageCount = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').length;
   822	    
   823	    setMessages(prev => [...prev, tempUserMessage]);
   824	    setLoading(true);
   825	    setShowAIThinking(true); // 显示 AI 思考状态
   826	
   827	    // 清空之前的流式内容状态，避免重复显示
   828	    setStreamingContent('');
   829	    streamingContentRef.current = '';
   830	    setIsStreaming(false);
   831	    
   832	    // 立即更新当前问题索引到最新的问题（索引从0开始，所以当前数量就是新问题的索引）
   833	    setCurrentQuestionIndex(currentUserMessageCount);
   834	
   835	    // 继续提问时，简单地滚动到底部
   836	    if (!isFirstMessage) {
   837	      // 延迟执行，确保DOM已更新
   838	      setTimeout(() => {
   839	        scrollToBottom();
   840	      }, 100);
   841	    }
   842	
   843	    // 每次搜索都清空旧的论文列表，确保显示 skeleton loading
   844	    setPapers([]);
   845	    setPapersTotal(0);
   846	
   847	    try {
   848	      // 🔥 先检查配额，避免保存无效的消息
   849	      const featureType = modelLevel === 'low' ? 'advanced_search_low' : 
   850	                         modelLevel === 'mid' ? 'advanced_search_mid' : 
   851	                         'advanced_search_high';
   852	      
   853	      try {
   854	        const quotaCheck = await subscriptionAPI.checkQuota(featureType);
   855	        if (quotaCheck.data.code === 0 && !quotaCheck.data.data.has_quota) {
   856	          // 配额不足，直接返回
   857	          setMessages(prev => prev.filter(msg => msg.id !== tempUserMessage.id));
   858	          setLoading(false);
   859	          setShowAIThinking(false);
   860	          setShowQuotaModal(true);
   861	          return;
   862	        }
   863	      } catch (quotaError) {
   864	        console.error('Failed to check quota:', quotaError);
   865	        // 如果检查失败，继续尝试（让后端再次检查）
   866	      }
   867	
   868	      let conversationId = currentConversationId;
   869	
   870	      if (!conversationId) {
   871	        const createResponse = await conversationAPI.createConversation(
   872	          userMessage.length > 50 ? userMessage.substring(0, 50) + '...' : userMessage,
   873	          'search'
   874	        );
   875	        if (createResponse.data.code === 0 && createResponse.data.data) {
   876	          conversationId = createResponse.data.data.id;
   877	          setCurrentConversationId(conversationId);
   878	          // 刷新对话列表，确保新对话显示在侧边栏
   879	          loadConversations();
   880	        } else {
   881	          throw new Error('Failed to create conversation');
   882	        }
   883	      }
   884	
   885	      // 所有搜索都使用 advanced-search API，而不是 continue API
   886	      // 这样确保每次搜索都计入 advanced_search_* 配额
   887	      const response = await conversationAPI.addMessage(
   888	        conversationId,
   889	        userMessage,
   890	        userMessage,
   891	        false // Advanced mode doesn't use direct search
   892	      );
   893	
   894	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   895	        const newMessage = response.data.data;
   896	        // Replace temp message with real message
   897	        setMessages(prev => prev.map(msg =>
   898	          msg.id === tempUserMessage.id ? newMessage : msg
   899	        ));
   900	
   901	        // Always use advanced search for all searches
   902	        startAdvancedSearch(conversationId, newMessage.id, userMessage);
   903	      } else {
   904	        throw new Error(response.data.message || 'Failed to send message');
   905	      }
   906	    } catch (error) {
   907	      console.error('Search failed:', error);
   908	      // Remove temp message on error
   909	      setMessages(prev => prev.filter(msg => msg.id !== tempUserMessage.id));
   910	      alert('搜索失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   911	      // Only stop loading on error, let streaming handlers manage loading state
   912	      setLoading(false);
   913	      setShowAIThinking(false);
   914	    }
   915	  };
   916	
   917	  const handleSearch = async (e) => {
   918	    e.preventDefault();
   919	    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
   920	
   921	    // 立即滚动到底部并启用自动滚动
   922	    setAutoScroll(true);
   923	    setTimeout(() => scrollToBottom(), 100);
   924	
   925	    await handleInitialSearch(searchQuery);
   926	  };
   927	
   928	  const startAdvancedSearch = async (convId, messageId, query) => {
   929	    if (eventSourceRef.current) {
   930	      eventSourceRef.current.close();
   931	    }
   932	
   933	    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
   934	    if (!token) {
   935	      console.error('No auth token found');
   936	      return;
   937	    }
   938	
   939	    // 先检查配额
   940	    const featureType = modelLevel === 'low' ? 'advanced_search_low' : 
   941	                       modelLevel === 'mid' ? 'advanced_search_mid' : 
   942	                       'advanced_search_high';
   943	    
   944	    try {
   945	      const quotaCheck = await subscriptionAPI.checkQuota(featureType);
   946	      if (quotaCheck.data.code === 0 && !quotaCheck.data.data.has_quota) {
   947	        // 配额不足
   948	        setLoading(false);
   949	        setShowAIThinking(false);
   950	        
   951	        // 删除刚添加的用户消息
   952	        setMessages(prev => prev.filter(msg => msg.id !== messageId));
   953	        
   954	        // 显示配额不足的提示
   955	        setShowQuotaModal(true);
   956	        return;
   957	      }
   958	    } catch (error) {
   959	      console.error('Failed to check quota:', error);
   960	      // 如果检查失败，继续尝试请求（让后端再次检查）
   961	    }
   962	
   963	    setIsStreaming(true);
   964	    setStreamingContent('');
   965	    streamingContentRef.current = '';
   966	    setShowAIThinking(true);
   967	    
   968	    // 开始流式传输时，确保自动滚动到底部
   969	    if (autoScroll) {
   970	      setTimeout(() => scrollToBottom(), 100);
   971	    }
   972	
   973	    // 添加新的论文集合占位符
   974	    setPaperSets(prevSets => [
   975	      {
   976	        title: '最新搜索',
   977	        papers: [],
   978	        total: 0,
   979	        query: query,
   980	        isLoading: true // 标记正在加载
   981	      },
   982	      ...prevSets
   983	    ]);
   984	
   985	    const url = `/api/v1/user/conversations/${convId}/messages/${messageId}/advanced-search`;
   986	    const eventSource = new EventSource(`${url}?token=${token}&model_level=${modelLevel}`);
   987	    eventSourceRef.current = eventSource;
   988	
   989	    eventSource.onopen = () => {
   990	      logger.log('Advanced search stream started');
   991	    };
   992	
   993	    let isFirstMessage = true;
   994	
   995	    eventSource.onmessage = (event) => {
   996	      // 检查是否是错误消息（第一条消息）
   997	      if (isFirstMessage) {
   998	        isFirstMessage = false;
   999	        try {
  1000	          const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
  1001	          if (data.code === 403 || data.message?.includes('配额不足')) {
  1002	            // 配额不足错误
  1003	            eventSource.close();
  1004	            setIsStreaming(false);
  1005	            setShowAIThinking(false);
  1006	            setLoading(false);
  1007	            
  1008	            // 删除刚添加的用户消息
  1009	            setMessages(prev => prev.filter(msg => msg.id !== messageId));
  1010	            
  1011	            // 移除添加的论文集合占位符
  1012	            setPaperSets(prevSets => prevSets.slice(1));
  1013	            
  1014	            // 显示配额不足的提示
  1015	            alert('配额不足，请升级订阅');
  1016	            return;
  1017	          }
  1018	        } catch (e) {
  1019	          // 如果不是JSON格式，继续正常处理
  1020	        }
  1021	      }
  1022	      
  1023	      if (event.data.startsWith('[DONE]')) {
  1024	        logger.log('Advanced search completed');
  1025	        eventSource.close();
  1026	
  1027	        // 先清空流式内容和停止状态，避免重复显示
  1028	        const finalContent = streamingContentRef.current;
  1029	
  1030	        setStreamingContent('');
  1031	        streamingContentRef.current = '';
  1032	        setIsStreaming(false);
  1033	
  1034	        // 将流式内容添加到消息列表（不包含延伸问题，延伸问题将通过独立API获取）
  1035	        if (finalContent) {
  1036	          setMessages(prev => {
  1037	            const lastMessage = prev[prev.length - 1];
  1038	            // 如果最后一条消息不是 assistant 或内容为空，添加新的 assistant 消息
  1039	            if (!lastMessage || lastMessage.role !== 'assistant' || !lastMessage.content) {
  1040	              const newMessage = {
  1041	                id: messageId, // 使用实际的 messageId
  1042	                role: 'assistant',
  1043	                content: finalContent,
  1044	                suggestedQuestions: [], // 初始化为空，稍后通过 API 加载
  1045	                created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  1046	              };
  1047	
  1048	              // 流式输出结束后，滚动并预留延伸问题的空间
  1049	              setTimeout(() => {
  1050	                if (autoScroll) {
  1051	                  // 滚动到底部，并额外预留150px空间给延伸问题
  1052	                  scrollToBottom(300);
  1053	                }
  1054	              }, 200);
  1055	
  1056	              // 异步加载延伸问题
  1057	              fetchFollowUpQuestions(convId, messageId, newMessage);
  1058	
  1059	              return [...prev, newMessage];
  1060	            }
  1061	            return prev;
  1062	          });
  1063	        }
  1064	
  1065	        // 最后关闭其他loading状态
  1066	        setLoading(false);
  1067	        setShowAIThinking(false);
  1068	        return;
  1069	      }
  1070	
  1071	      if (event.data.startsWith('[ERROR]')) {
  1072	        const errorMsg = event.data.substring(7).trim(); // Remove '[ERROR]' prefix
  1073	        console.error('Advanced search error:', errorMsg);
  1074	        eventSource.close();
  1075	
  1076	        // Clear all loading states
  1077	        setIsStreaming(false);
  1078	        setLoading(false);
  1079	        setShowAIThinking(false);
  1080	
  1081	        // Remove loading placeholder from paper sets
  1082	        setPaperSets(prevSets => prevSets.filter(set => !set.isLoading));
  1083	
  1084	        // Display error message to user
  1085	        setStreamingContent('');
  1086	        streamingContentRef.current = '';
  1087	
  1088	        // Add error message as assistant message (backend already provides friendly message)
  1089	        setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
  1090	          id: 'error-' + Date.now(),
  1091	          role: 'assistant',
  1092	          content: errorMsg,
  1093	          created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  1094	        }]);
  1095	
  1096	        return;
  1097	      }
  1098	
  1099	      if (event.data.startsWith('[PAPERS]')) {
  1100	        // Handle papers data
  1101	        try {
  1102	          const papersData = JSON.parse(event.data.substring(8));
  1103	          const newPapers = papersData.papers || [];
  1104	          const newTotal = papersData.total || 0;
  1105	
  1106	          setPapers(newPapers);
  1107	          setPapersTotal(newTotal);
  1108	
  1109	          // 更新第一个占位符（索引0）为真实的论文数据
  1110	          setPaperSets(prevSets => {
  1111	            const newSets = [...prevSets];
  1112	            if (newSets.length > 0 && newSets[0].isLoading) {
  1113	              // 更新第一个占位符
  1114	              newSets[0] = {
  1115	                title: '最新搜索',
  1116	                papers: newPapers,
  1117	                total: newTotal,
  1118	                query: query,
  1119	                isLoading: false
  1120	              };
  1121	            } else {
  1122	              // 如果没有占位符，添加新的
  1123	              newSets.unshift({
  1124	                title: '最新搜索',
  1125	                papers: newPapers,
  1126	                total: newTotal,
  1127	                query: query,
  1128	                isLoading: false
  1129	              });
  1130	            }
  1131	            return newSets;
  1132	          });
  1133	
  1134	          setHasAdvancedSearch(true); // 标记已进行智能分析
  1135	          // 收到论文数据后立即停止 loading，让 PaperList 显示论文
  1136	          setLoading(false);
  1137	        } catch (err) {
  1138	          console.error('Failed to parse papers data:', err);
  1139	        }
  1140	        return;
  1141	      }
  1142	
  1143	      if (event.data.startsWith('[FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS]')) {
  1144	        // Handle follow-up questions (non-streaming, all at once)
  1145	        try {
  1146	          const followUpQuestions = event.data.substring(21); // Remove '[FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS]' prefix
  1147	          console.log('Received follow-up questions:', followUpQuestions);
  1148	
  1149	          // Extract questions from the content
  1150	          const questions = extractSuggestedQuestions(followUpQuestions);
  1151	          if (questions.length > 0) {
  1152	            setSuggestedQuestions(questions);
  1153	          }
  1154	        } catch (err) {
  1155	          console.error('Failed to parse follow-up questions:', err);
  1156	        }
  1157	        return;
  1158	      }
  1159	
  1160	      try {
  1161	        const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
  1162	        if (data.choices && data.choices[0] && data.choices[0].delta) {
  1163	          const delta = data.choices[0].delta;
  1164	          if (delta.content) {
  1165	            // 收到第一个内容片段时，关闭 AI 思考动画
  1166	            if (streamingContentRef.current === '') {
  1167	              setShowAIThinking(false);
  1168	            }
  1169	            // loading 已经在收到论文数据时关闭了，不需要再次设置
  1170	            streamingContentRef.current += delta.content;
  1171	            setStreamingContent(prev => prev + delta.content);
  1172	            
  1173	          }
  1174	        }
  1175	      } catch (err) {
  1176	        console.error('Failed to parse SSE data:', err);
  1177	      }
  1178	    };
  1179	
  1180	    eventSource.onerror = (err) => {
  1181	      console.error('SSE error:', err);
  1182	      eventSource.close();
  1183	      setIsStreaming(false);
  1184	      setShowAIThinking(false);
  1185	      setLoading(false);
  1186	      
  1187	      // 如果是连接失败（可能是403），删除用户消息和论文集合占位符
  1188	      setMessages(prev => prev.filter(msg => msg.id !== messageId));
  1189	      setPaperSets(prevSets => prevSets.slice(1));
  1190	      
  1191	      // 显示配额不足弹窗
  1192	      setShowQuotaModal(true);
  1193	    };
  1194	  };
  1195	
  1196	  // 继续对话 - 用于智能分析后的追问
  1197	  const startContinueConversation = async (conversationId, query) => {
  1198	    if (eventSourceRef.current) {
  1199	      eventSourceRef.current.close();
  1200	    }
  1201	
  1202	    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
  1203	    if (!token) {
  1204	      console.error('No auth token found');
  1205	      return;
  1206	    }
  1207	
  1208	    setIsStreaming(true);
  1209	    setStreamingContent('');
  1210	    streamingContentRef.current = '';
  1211	    setLoading(true);
  1212	    setShowAIThinking(true); // 显示 AI 思考状态
  1213	
  1214	    // 清空当前论文列表，显示 loading skeleton
  1215	    setPapers([]);
  1216	    setPapersTotal(0);
  1217	
  1218	    // 添加新的论文集合占位符，用于新的搜索
  1219	    setPaperSets(prevSets => [
  1220	      {
  1221	        title: '追问搜索',
  1222	        papers: [],
  1223	        total: 0,
  1224	        query: query,
  1225	        isLoading: true // 标记正在加载
  1226	      },
  1227	      ...prevSets
  1228	    ]);
  1229	
  1230	    try {
  1231	      // 调用继续对话 API
  1232	      const response = await fetch(
  1233	        `/api/v1/user/conversations/${conversationId}/continue`,
  1234	        {
  1235	          method: 'POST',
  1236	          headers: {
  1237	            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  1238	            'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`
  1239	          },
  1240	          body: JSON.stringify({
  1241	            query,
  1242	            model_level: modelLevel  // 传递模型级别
  1243	          })
  1244	        }
  1245	      );
  1246	
  1247	      if (!response.ok) {
  1248	        throw new Error('Failed to continue conversation');
  1249	      }
  1250	
  1251	      // 创建 EventSource 来接收流式响应
  1252	      const reader = response.body.getReader();
  1253	      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  1254	
  1255	      const readStream = async () => {
  1256	        while (true) {
  1257	          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  1258	          if (done) break;
  1259	
  1260	          const chunk = decoder.decode(value);
  1261	          const lines = chunk.split('\n');
  1262	
  1263	          for (const line of lines) {
  1264	            if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
  1265	              const data = line.substring(6);
  1266	
  1267	              if (data.startsWith('[DONE]')) {
  1268	                // 先清空流式内容和停止状态，避免重复显示
  1269	                const finalContent = streamingContentRef.current;
  1270	
  1271	                setStreamingContent('');
  1272	                streamingContentRef.current = '';
  1273	                setIsStreaming(false);
  1274	
  1275	                // 将流式内容添加到消息列表（不包含延伸问题）
  1276	                if (finalContent) {
  1277	                  setMessages(prev => {
  1278	                    const lastMessage = prev[prev.length - 1];
  1279	                    if (!lastMessage || lastMessage.role !== 'assistant' || !lastMessage.content) {
  1280	                      return [...prev, {
  1281	                        id: 'assistant-' + Date.now(),
  1282	                        role: 'assistant',
  1283	                        content: finalContent,
  1284	                        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  1285	                      }];
  1286	                    }
  1287	                    return prev;
  1288	                  });
  1289	                }
  1290	
  1291	                setLoading(false);
  1292	                return;
  1293	              }
  1294	
  1295	              if (data.startsWith('[ERROR]')) {
  1296	                const errorMsg = data.substring(8).trim(); // Remove '[ERROR] ' prefix
  1297	                console.error('Continue conversation error:', errorMsg);
  1298	                setIsStreaming(false);
  1299	                setLoading(false);
  1300	                setShowAIThinking(false);
  1301	                
  1302	                // Remove loading placeholder from paper sets
  1303	                setPaperSets(prevSets => prevSets.filter(set => !set.isLoading));
  1304	                
  1305	                // Add error message as assistant message (backend already provides friendly message)
  1306	                setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
  1307	                  id: 'error-' + Date.now(),
  1308	                  role: 'assistant',
  1309	                  content: errorMsg,
  1310	                  created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  1311	                }]);
  1312	                
  1313	                return;
  1314	              }
  1315	
  1316	              if (data.startsWith('[PAPERS]')) {
  1317	                try {
  1318	                  const papersData = JSON.parse(data.substring(8));
  1319	                  const newPapers = papersData.papers || [];
  1320	                  const newTotal = papersData.total || 0;
  1321	
  1322	                  setPapers(newPapers);
  1323	                  setPapersTotal(newTotal);
  1324	                  setLoading(false);
  1325	
  1326	                  // 更新第一个占位符（索引0）为真实的论文数据
  1327	                  setPaperSets(prevSets => {
  1328	                    const newSets = [...prevSets];
  1329	                    if (newSets.length > 0 && newSets[0].isLoading) {
  1330	                      // 更新第一个占位符
  1331	                      newSets[0] = {
  1332	                        title: '追问搜索',
  1333	                        papers: newPapers,
  1334	                        total: newTotal,
  1335	                        query: query,
  1336	                        isLoading: false
  1337	                      };
  1338	                    } else {
  1339	                      // 如果没有占位符，添加新的
  1340	                      newSets.unshift({
  1341	                        title: '追问搜索',
  1342	                        papers: newPapers,
  1343	                        total: newTotal,
  1344	                        query: query,
  1345	                        isLoading: false
  1346	                      });
  1347	                    }
  1348	                    return newSets;
  1349	                  });
  1350	                } catch (err) {
  1351	                  console.error('Failed to parse papers data:', err);
  1352	                }
  1353	                continue;
  1354	              }
  1355	
  1356	              if (data.startsWith('[FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS]')) {
  1357	                // Handle follow-up questions (non-streaming, all at once)
  1358	                try {
  1359	                  const followUpQuestions = data.substring(21); // Remove '[FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS]' prefix
  1360	                  console.log('Received follow-up questions for continue conversation:', followUpQuestions);
  1361	
  1362	                  // Extract questions from the content
  1363	                  const questions = extractSuggestedQuestions(followUpQuestions);
  1364	                  if (questions.length > 0) {
  1365	                    setSuggestedQuestions(questions);
  1366	                  }
  1367	                } catch (err) {
  1368	                  console.error('Failed to parse follow-up questions:', err);
  1369	                }
  1370	                continue;
  1371	              }
  1372	
  1373	              // 解析流式内容
  1374	              try {
  1375	                const jsonData = JSON.parse(data);
  1376	                if (jsonData.choices && jsonData.choices[0] && jsonData.choices[0].delta) {
  1377	                  const delta = jsonData.choices[0].delta;
  1378	                  if (delta.content) {
  1379	                    // 收到第一个内容片段时，关闭 AI 思考动画
  1380	                    if (streamingContentRef.current === '') {
  1381	                      setShowAIThinking(false);
  1382	                    }
  1383	                    streamingContentRef.current += delta.content;
  1384	                    setStreamingContent(prev => prev + delta.content);
  1385	                  }
  1386	                }
  1387	              } catch (err) {
  1388	                // 可能不是 JSON，忽略
  1389	              }
  1390	            }
  1391	          }
  1392	        }
  1393	      };
  1394	
  1395	      readStream();
  1396	    } catch (error) {
  1397	      console.error('Continue conversation failed:', error);
  1398	      setIsStreaming(false);
  1399	      setLoading(false);
  1400	      setShowAIThinking(false); // 关闭 AI 思考状态
  1401	      alert('继续对话失败: ' + error.message);
  1402	    }

  1404

    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
    11	import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
    12	import { useNavigate, useOutletContext } from 'react-router-dom';
