    22	
    23	// 懒加载 AuthModal
    24	const AuthModal = lazy(() => import('../components/AuthModal'));
    25	
    26	// Code Block Component with Copy Button (Memoized for performance)
    27	const CodeBlock = React.memo(({ inline, className, children, ...props }) => {
    28	  const [isCopied, setIsCopied] = useState(false);
    29	  const codeRef = useRef(null);
    30	  const match = /language-(\w+)/.exec(className || '');
    31	  const lang = match ? match[1] : '';
    32	
    33	  const copyCode = React.useCallback(() => {
    34	    const code = codeRef.current?.textContent;
    35	    if (code) {
    36	      navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.trim());
    37	      setIsCopied(true);
    38	      setTimeout(() => setIsCopied(false), 3000);
    39	    }
    40	  }, []);
    41	
    42	  if (inline) {
    43	    return <code className="inline-code" {...props}>{children}</code>;
    44	  }
    45	
    46	  return (
    47	    <div className="code-block-wrapper">
    48	      <div className="code-block-header">
    49	        <span className="code-lang">{lang || 'text'}</span>
    50	        <button onClick={copyCode} className="code-copy-btn">
    51	          {isCopied ? (
    52	            <>
    53	              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    54	                <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/>
    55	              </svg>
    56	              Copied
    57	            </>
    58	          ) : (
    59	            <>
    60	              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    61	                <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"/>
    62	                <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"/>
    63	              </svg>
    64	              Copy code
    65	            </>
    66	          )}
    67	        </button>
    68	      </div>
    69	      <div className="code-block-content">
    70	        <code ref={codeRef} className={className} {...props}>
    71	          {children}
    72	        </code>
    73	      </div>
    74	    </div>
    75	  );
    76	});
    77	
    78	function ChatPage() {
    79	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    80	  const { isAuthenticated, user } = useAuth();
    81	  const { updateSidebarConfig, isMobile, openMobileSidebar } = useSidebar();
    82	  const outletContext = useOutletContext();
    83	  const sidebarCollapsed = outletContext?.sidebarCollapsed ?? true;
    84	
    85	  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState([]);
    86	  const [currentConversation, setCurrentConversation] = useState(null);
    87	  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
    88	  const [inputMessage, setInputMessage] = useState('');
    89	  const [isStreaming, setIsStreaming] = useState(false);
    90	  const [streamingContent, setStreamingContent] = useState('');
    91	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    92	  const [isWaitingForResponse, setIsWaitingForResponse] = useState(false); // Loading dots before streaming starts
    93	  const [modelLevel, setModelLevel] = useState('low'); // 'low', 'mid', 'high' - AI chat model level
    94	  const [showModelDropdown, setShowModelDropdown] = useState(false); // Model selector dropdown state
    95	  const [quota, setQuota] = useState(null); // AI Chat quota limits
    96	  const [usage, setUsage] = useState(null); // AI Chat usage counts
    97	  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false); // 登录弹窗
    98	  const [hoveredMessage, setHoveredMessage] = useState(null);
    99	  const [editingMessage, setEditingMessage] = useState(null);
   100	  const [editContent, setEditContent] = useState('');
   101	  const [siblingInfo, setSiblingInfo] = useState({}); // Map of message_id -> {siblings, currentIndex, total}
   102	  const [isComposing, setIsComposing] = useState(false); // 跟踪输入法状态
   103	  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
   104	  const abortControllerRef = useRef(null);
   105	  const textareaRef = useRef(null);
   106	  const loadingStartTimeRef = useRef(null); // Track when loading started for minimum display time
   107	  const hoverTimeoutRef = useRef(null); // 用于延迟显示hover按钮
   108	
   109	  // Memoize dropdown arrow style to prevent unnecessary re-renders
   110	  const dropdownArrowStyle = useMemo(() => ({
   111	    transform: showModelDropdown ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)',
   112	    transition: 'transform 0.2s ease'
   113	  }), [showModelDropdown]);
   114	
   115	  // Fetch AI Chat quota and usage
   116	  useEffect(() => {
   117	    const fetchQuotaAndUsage = async () => {
   118	      // 只在登录状态下获取配额
   119	      if (!isAuthenticated) return;
   120	      
   121	      try {
   122	        const response = await subscriptionAPI.getUsage();
   123	        if (response.data.code === 0) {
   124	          const data = response.data.data;
   125	          // Map backend data to frontend format for AI Chat quotas
   126	          const quotaData = {
   127	            aiChatNormalQuota: data.limits?.ai_chat_normal?.limit ?? -1,
   128	            aiChatMidQuota: data.limits?.ai_chat_mid?.limit ?? -1,
   129	            aiChatHighQuota: data.limits?.ai_chat_high?.limit ?? -1,
   130	          };
   131	          const usageData = {
   132	            aiChatNormalCount: data.usage?.ai_chat_normal ?? 0,
   133	            aiChatMidCount: data.usage?.ai_chat_mid ?? 0,
   134	            aiChatHighCount: data.usage?.ai_chat_high ?? 0,
   135	          };
   136	          setQuota(quotaData);
   137	          setUsage(usageData);
   138	        }
   139	      } catch (error) {
   140	        console.error('Failed to fetch AI Chat quota/usage:', error);
   141	      }
   142	    };
   143	
   144	    if (isAuthenticated) {
   145	      fetchQuotaAndUsage();
   146	    }
   147	  }, [isAuthenticated]);
   148	
   149	  useEffect(() => {
   150	    // 只在登录状态下加载对话历史
   151	    if (isAuthenticated) {
   152	      loadConversations();
   153	    }
   154	    
   155	    // 清理hover定时器
   156	    return () => {
   157	      if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) {
   158	        clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
   159	      }
   160	    };
   161	  }, [isAuthenticated]);
   162	
   163	  // Save sidebar state to localStorage
   164	  useEffect(() => {
   165	    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebarCollapsed.toString());
   166	  }, [sidebarCollapsed]);
   167	
   168	  // Auto-scroll during streaming and message updates
   169	  useEffect(() => {
   170	    scrollToBottom();
   171	  }, [messages, streamingContent, isStreaming, isWaitingForResponse]);
   172	
   173	  useEffect(() => {
   174	    if (textareaRef.current) {
   175	      textareaRef.current.style.height = 'auto';
   176	      const scrollHeight = textareaRef.current.scrollHeight;
   177	      const maxHeight = window.innerWidth >= 768 ? window.innerHeight * 0.55 : window.innerHeight * 0.45;
   178	      textareaRef.current.style.height = Math.min(scrollHeight, maxHeight) + 'px';
   179	    }
   180	  }, [inputMessage]);
   181	
   182	  const scrollToBottom = () => {
   183	    if (messagesEndRef.current) {
   184	      // Get the scrollable container (.messages-scrollable)
   185	      // messagesEndRef -> .messages-inner -> .messages-scrollable
   186	      const scrollContainer = messagesEndRef.current.parentElement?.parentElement;
   187	      if (scrollContainer) {
   188	        // Scroll to the absolute bottom of the container
   189	        // This ensures the content is fully visible above the fixed input
   190	        scrollContainer.scrollTo({
   191	          top: scrollContainer.scrollHeight,
   192	          behavior: 'smooth'
   193	        });
   194	      }
   195	    }
   196	  };
   197	
   198	  // Get remaining count for a model level
   199	  const getRemainingCount = (level) => {
   200	    if (!quota || !usage) return null;
   201	
   202	    const quotaMap = {
   203	      'low': { quota: quota.aiChatNormalQuota, usage: usage.aiChatNormalCount },
   204	      'mid': { quota: quota.aiChatMidQuota, usage: usage.aiChatMidCount },
   205	      'high': { quota: quota.aiChatHighQuota, usage: usage.aiChatHighCount }
   206	    };
   207	
   208	    const { quota: quotaValue, usage: usageValue } = quotaMap[level] || {};
   209	    if (quotaValue === undefined) return null;
   210	
   211	    // -1 means unlimited
   212	    if (quotaValue === -1) return '无限制';
   213	
   214	    const remaining = Math.max(0, quotaValue - usageValue);
   215	    return remaining;
   216	  };
   217	
   218	  // Check if model is available based on user subscription
   219	  const isModelAvailable = (level) => {
   220	    if (!user?.subscription) return true;
   221	
   222	    const planCode = user.subscription.plan_code;
   223	
   224	    // FREE users can only use 'low' (normal)
   225	    if (planCode === 'FREE' && level !== 'low') {
   226	      return false;
   227	    }
   228	
   229	    // PRO users can use 'low' and 'mid'
   230	    if (planCode === 'PRO' && level === 'high') {
   231	      return false;
   232	    }
   233	
   234	    // MAX users can use all models
   235	    return true;
   236	  };
   237	
   238	  const loadConversations = async () => {
   239	    try {
   240	      const response = await api.get('/user/conversations', {
   241	        params: { page: 1, page_size: 50, conversation_type: 'chat' }
   242	      });
   243	      // Backend returns {code: 0, message, data}, not {success: true}
   244	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   245	        const convs = response.data.data.conversations || [];
   246	        setConversations(convs);
   247	      }
   248	    } catch (error) {
   249	      console.error('Failed to load chat conversations:', error);
   250	    }
   251	  };
   252	
   253	  const loadConversation = async (conversationId) => {
   254	    try {
   255	      setLoading(true);
   256	      const response = await api.get(`/user/conversations/${conversationId}/history`);
   257	
   258	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   259	        const data = response.data.data || {};
   260	        const conversation = data.conversation || {};
   261	        const loadedMessages = data.messages || [];
   262	
   263	        setCurrentConversation({ id: conversationId });
   264	
   265	        // Set model level from conversation metadata
   266	        if (conversation.model_level) {
   267	          setModelLevel(conversation.model_level);
   268	        }
   269	
   270	        setMessages(loadedMessages);
   271	
   272	        // Load sibling info for all assistant messages
   273	        loadedMessages.forEach(msg => {
   274	          if (msg.role === 'assistant') {
   275	            loadSiblings(msg.message_id);
   276	          }
   277	        });
   278	      } else {
   279	        console.error('Failed to load conversation: invalid response code', response.data);
   280	      }
   281	    } catch (error) {
   282	      console.error('Failed to load conversation:', error);
   283	    } finally {
   284	      setLoading(false);
   285	    }
   286	  };
   287	
   288	  const createNewConversation = async (content) => {
   289	    // 检查是否登录，未登录则弹出登录弹窗
   290	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   291	      setShowAuthModal(true);
   292	      return;
   293	    }
   294	    
   295	    try {
   296	      setIsStreaming(true);
   297	      setStreamingContent('');
   298	      setIsWaitingForResponse(true); // Show loading dots
   299	      loadingStartTimeRef.current = Date.now(); // Track when loading started
   300	
   301	      // Immediately add user message to UI (LibreChat style)
   302	      const tempUserMessage = {
   303	        message_id: `temp-user-${Date.now()}`,
   304	        role: 'user',
   305	        content: content,
   306	        parent_message_id: null,
   307	        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   308	      };
   309	      setMessages([tempUserMessage]);
   310	
   311	      abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();
   312	
   313	      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/conversations/chat/new', {
   314	        method: 'POST',
   315	        headers: {
   316	          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   317	          'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('user_token')}`
   318	        },
   319	        body: JSON.stringify({
   320	          content,
   321	          model_level: modelLevel  // Pass selected model level
   322	        }),
   323	        signal: abortControllerRef.current.signal
   324	      });
   325	
   326	      await handleStreamResponse(response);
   327	      // Reload conversations to update sidebar history
   328	      await loadConversations();
   329	    } catch (error) {
   330	      if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
   331	        console.error('Failed to create conversation:', error);
   332	      }
   333	    } finally {
   334	      setIsStreaming(false);
   335	      setStreamingContent('');
   336	      setIsWaitingForResponse(false); // Hide loading dots
   337	      // 自动聚焦到输入框，方便用户继续对话
   338	      setTimeout(() => {
   339	        if (textareaRef.current) {
   340	          textareaRef.current.focus();
   341	        }
   342	      }, 100);
   343	    }
   344	  };
   345	
   346	  const sendMessage = async (content) => {
   347	    if (!content.trim()) return;
   348	
   349	    // 检查是否登录，未登录则弹出登录弹窗
   350	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
   351	      setShowAuthModal(true);
   352	      return;
   353	    }
   354	
   355	    if (!currentConversation) {
   356	      await createNewConversation(content);
   357	      return;
   358	    }
   359	
   360	    try {
   361	      setIsStreaming(true);
   362	      setStreamingContent('');
   363	      setIsWaitingForResponse(true); // Show loading dots
   364	      loadingStartTimeRef.current = Date.now(); // Track when loading started
   365	
   366	      // Find the latest message ID to use as parent
   367	      const latestMessage = messages.length > 0 ? messages[messages.length - 1] : null;
   368	      const parentMessageId = latestMessage?.message_id || null;
   369	
   370	      const userMessage = {
   371	        message_id: `temp-${Date.now()}`,
   372	        role: 'user',
   373	        content: content,
   374	        parent_message_id: parentMessageId,  // Track parent for message chain
   375	        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   376	      };
   377	      setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMessage]);
   378	
   379	      // Scroll user message to top of viewport after a short delay
   380	      setTimeout(() => {
   381	        const messagesContainer = messagesEndRef.current?.parentElement;
   382	        if (messagesContainer) {
   383	          const userMessageElements = messagesContainer.querySelectorAll('[data-role="user"]');
   384	          const lastUserMessage = userMessageElements[userMessageElements.length - 1];
   385	          if (lastUserMessage) {
   386	            lastUserMessage.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
   387	          }
   388	        }
   389	      }, 100);
   390	
   391	      abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();
   392	
   393	      // Send parent_message_id and model_level to backend for context building
   394	      const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/user/conversations/${currentConversation.id}/chat/stream`, {
   395	        method: 'POST',
   396	        headers: {
   397	          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   398	          'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('user_token')}`
   399	        },
   400	        body: JSON.stringify({
   401	          content,
   402	          parent_message_id: parentMessageId,  // Critical: enables context chain
   403	          model_level: modelLevel  // Pass selected model level
   404	        }),
   405	        signal: abortControllerRef.current.signal
   406	      });
   407	
   408	      await handleStreamResponse(response);
   409	    } catch (error) {
   410	      if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
   411	        console.error('Failed to send message:', error);
   412	      }
   413	    } finally {
   414	      setIsStreaming(false);
   415	      setStreamingContent('');
   416	      setIsWaitingForResponse(false); // Hide loading dots
   417	      // 自动聚焦到输入框，方便用户继续对话
   418	      setTimeout(() => {
   419	        if (textareaRef.current) {
   420	          textareaRef.current.focus();
   421	        }
   422	      }, 100);
   423	    }
   424	  };
   425	
   426	  // Note: We no longer use a minimum display time for loading dots
   427	  // because we want to hide them immediately when streaming content arrives
   428	  // This prevents double indicators (loading dots + streaming cursor)
   429	
   430	  const handleStreamResponse = async (response) => {
   431	    const reader = response.body.getReader();
   432	    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
   433	    let assistantMessageId = null;
   434	    let parentMessageId = null;
   435	    let fullContent = '';
   436	    let userMessageId = null;
   437	    let messageEndReceived = false;
   438	
   439	    // Smooth streaming optimization: batch updates using requestAnimationFrame
   440	    let pendingContent = '';
   441	    let animationFrameId = null;
   442	
   443	    const updateStreamingContent = () => {
   444	      if (pendingContent !== fullContent) {
   445	        setStreamingContent(fullContent);
   446	        pendingContent = fullContent;
   447	      }
   448	      animationFrameId = null;
   449	    };
   450	
   451	    const scheduleUpdate = () => {
   452	      if (!animationFrameId) {
   453	        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(updateStreamingContent);
   454	      }
   455	    };
   456	
   457	    try {
   458	      while (true) {
   459	        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
   460	        if (done) {
   461	          // Final update to ensure all content is displayed
   462	          if (animationFrameId) {
   463	            cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
   464	          }
   465	          updateStreamingContent();
   466	          break;
   467	        }
   468	
   469	        const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
   470	        const lines = chunk.split('\n');
   471	
   472	        for (const line of lines) {
   473	          if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
   474	            try {
   475	              const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
   476	
   477	              if (data.type === 'conversation_created') {
   478	                const newConvId = data.metadata.conversation_id;
   479	                const newConvTitle = data.metadata.title;
   480	
   481	                setCurrentConversation({
   482	                  id: newConvId,
   483	                  title: newConvTitle
   484	                });
   485	
   486	              } else if (data.type === 'user_message_created') {
   487	                // Update temp user message with real message_id from backend
   488	                userMessageId = data.message_id;
   489	                parentMessageId = userMessageId;
   490	
   491	                setMessages(prev => prev.map(msg =>
   492	                  msg.message_id.startsWith('temp-user-') || msg.message_id.startsWith('temp-')
   493	                    ? { ...msg, message_id: userMessageId }
   494	                    : msg
   495	                ));
   496	
   497	              } else if (data.type === 'message_start') {
   498	                assistantMessageId = data.message_id;
   499	                // Get parent_message_id from metadata (sent by backend)
   500	                parentMessageId = data.metadata?.parent_message_id || parentMessageId;
   501	                // Don't hide loading yet - wait for first content_delta
   502	              } else if (data.type === 'content_delta') {
   503	                const isFirstContent = fullContent === '';
   504	                fullContent += data.content;
   505	
   506	                if (isFirstContent) {
   507	                  // For the first content, use flushSync to ensure atomic state updates
   508	                  // This prevents both loading indicators from showing at the same time
   509	                  flushSync(() => {
   510	                    setIsWaitingForResponse(false);
   511	                    setStreamingContent(fullContent);
   512	                  });
   513	                  pendingContent = fullContent;
   514	                  loadingStartTimeRef.current = null;
   515	                } else {
   516	                  // For subsequent content, use batched updates for smooth streaming
   517	                  scheduleUpdate();
   518	                }
   519	              } else if (data.type === 'message_end') {
   520	                const assistantMessage = {
   521	                  message_id: assistantMessageId,
   522	                  role: 'assistant',
   523	                  content: fullContent,
   524	                  parent_message_id: parentMessageId,  // Track parent for context chain
   525	                  created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   526	                  token_count: data.metadata?.token_count,
   527	                  finish_reason: data.metadata?.finish_reason
   528	                };
   529	
   530	                setMessages(prev => [...prev, assistantMessage]);
   531	
   532	                // Load sibling info for the new assistant message
   533	                if (assistantMessageId) {
   534	                  loadSiblings(assistantMessageId);
   535	                }
   536	                fullContent = '';
   537	                parentMessageId = null;  // Reset for next message
   538	                messageEndReceived = true;
   539	              } else if (data.type === 'error') {
   540	                console.error('Stream error:', data.error);
   541	              }
   542	            } catch (e) {
   543	              // Skip invalid JSON lines
   544	            }
   545	          }
   546	        }
   547	      }
   548	    } catch (error) {
   549	      if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
   550	        console.error('Stream error:', error);
   551	        throw error;
   552	      }
   553	    } finally {
   554	      // If stream ended but we never received message_end, add whatever content we have
   555	      if (fullContent && !messageEndReceived && assistantMessageId) {
   556	        const assistantMessage = {
   557	          message_id: assistantMessageId,
   558	          role: 'assistant',
   559	          content: fullContent,
   560	          parent_message_id: parentMessageId,
   561	          created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   562	        };
   563	        setMessages(prev => [...prev, assistantMessage]);
   564	        if (assistantMessageId) {
   565	          loadSiblings(assistantMessageId);
   566	        }
   567	      }
   568	
   569	      // Refocus the input textarea after streaming completes
   570	      // This allows the user to immediately type their next question
   571	      if (textareaRef.current) {
   572	        textareaRef.current.focus();
   573	      }
   574	    }
   575	
   576	    // Wait a tick to ensure state updates are processed
   577	    if (messageEndReceived) {
   578	      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
   579	    }
   580	  };
   581	
   582	  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
   583	    e.preventDefault();
   584	    if (inputMessage.trim() && !isStreaming) {
   585	      sendMessage(inputMessage);
   586	      setInputMessage('');
   587	      if (textareaRef.current) {
   588	        textareaRef.current.style.height = '44px';
   589	      }
   590	    }
   591	  };
   592	
   593	  const stopStreaming = () => {
   594	    if (abortControllerRef.current) {
   595	      abortControllerRef.current.abort();
   596	    }
   597	    setIsStreaming(false);
   598	    setStreamingContent('');
   599	  };
   600	
   601	  const copyToClipboard = (content) => {
   602	    navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
   603	  };
   604	
   605	  const regenerateMessage = async (messageId) => {
   606	    try {
   607	      setIsStreaming(true);
   608	      setStreamingContent('');
   609	      setIsWaitingForResponse(true); // Show loading dots
   610	      loadingStartTimeRef.current = Date.now(); // Track when loading started
   611	
   612	      // Remove the old assistant message and any messages after it
   613	      const messageIndex = messages.findIndex(m => m.message_id === messageId);
   614	      if (messageIndex >= 0) {
   615	        setMessages(prev => prev.slice(0, messageIndex));
   616	      }
   617	
   618	      abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();
   619	
   620	      const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/user/conversations/messages/${messageId}/regenerate`, {
   621	        method: 'POST',
   622	        headers: {
   623	          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   624	          'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('user_token')}`
   625	        },
   626	        signal: abortControllerRef.current.signal
   627	      });
   628	
   629	      await handleStreamResponse(response);
   630	    } catch (error) {
   631	      if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
   632	        console.error('Failed to regenerate message:', error);
   633	      }
   634	    } finally {
   635	      setIsStreaming(false);
   636	      setStreamingContent('');
   637	      setIsWaitingForResponse(false); // Hide loading dots
   638	    }
   639	  };
   640	
   641	  const startEditMessage = (message) => {
   642	    setEditingMessage(message.message_id);
   643	    setEditContent(message.content);
   644	  };
   645	
   646	  const cancelEdit = () => {
   647	    setEditingMessage(null);
   648	    setEditContent('');
   649	  };
   650	
   651	  const saveEdit = async (messageId) => {
   652	    if (!editContent.trim()) return;
   653	
   654	    try {
   655	      setIsStreaming(true);
   656	      setStreamingContent('');
   657	      setIsWaitingForResponse(true); // Show loading dots
   658	      loadingStartTimeRef.current = Date.now(); // Track when loading started
   659	      setEditingMessage(null);
   660	
   661	      // Find the message being edited and get the parent context
   662	      const messageIndex = messages.findIndex(m => m.message_id === messageId);
   663	      const editedMessage = messages[messageIndex];
   664	      const parentMessageId = messageIndex > 0 ? messages[messageIndex - 1].message_id : null;
   665	
   666	      // Remove the edited message and everything after it
   667	      if (messageIndex >= 0) {
   668	        setMessages(prev => prev.slice(0, messageIndex));
   669	      }
   670	
   671	      // Add the edited user message to UI immediately
   672	      const updatedUserMessage = {
   673	        message_id: messageId,
   674	        role: 'user',
   675	        content: editContent,
   676	        parent_message_id: parentMessageId,
   677	        created_at: editedMessage?.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
   678	      };
   679	      setMessages(prev => [...prev, updatedUserMessage]);
   680	
   681	      abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();
   682	
   683	      const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/user/conversations/messages/${messageId}/edit`, {
   684	        method: 'POST',
   685	        headers: {
   686	          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   687	          'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('user_token')}`
   688	        },
   689	        body: JSON.stringify({ content: editContent }),
   690	        signal: abortControllerRef.current.signal
   691	      });
   692	
   693	      await handleStreamResponse(response);
   694	    } catch (error) {
   695	      if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
   696	        console.error('Failed to edit message:', error);
   697	      }
   698	    } finally {
   699	      setIsStreaming(false);
   700	      setStreamingContent('');
   701	      setIsWaitingForResponse(false); // Hide loading dots
   702	      setEditContent('');
   703	    }
   704	  };
   705	
   706	  const loadSiblings = async (messageId) => {
   707	    try {
   708	      const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/user/conversations/messages/${messageId}/siblings`, {
   709	        headers: {
   710	          'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('user_token')}`
   711	        }
   712	      });
   713	
   714	      if (response.ok) {
   715	        const result = await response.json();
   716	        setSiblingInfo(prev => ({
   717	          ...prev,
   718	          [messageId]: {
   719	            siblings: result.data.siblings,
   720	            currentIndex: result.data.current_index,
   721	            total: result.data.total
   722	          }
   723	        }));
   724	      }
   725	    } catch (error) {
   726	      console.error('Failed to load siblings:', error);
   727	    }
   728	  };
   729	
   730	  const navigateToSibling = async (messageId, direction) => {
   731	    const info = siblingInfo[messageId];
   732	    if (!info || info.total <= 1) return;
   733	
   734	    let newIndex = info.currentIndex + direction;
   735	    if (newIndex < 0) newIndex = info.total - 1;
   736	    if (newIndex >= info.total) newIndex = 0;
   737	
   738	    const targetMessage = info.siblings[newIndex];
   739	    if (!targetMessage) return;
   740	
   741	    try {
   742	      // Load complete branch chain for the target sibling
   743	      const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/user/conversations/messages/${targetMessage.message_id}/branch`, {
   744	        headers: {
   745	          'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('user_token')}`
   746	        }
   747	      });
   748	
   749	      if (!response.ok) {
   750	        console.error('Failed to load branch chain');
   751	        return;
   752	      }
   753	
   754	      const result = await response.json();
   755	      const branchChain = result.data;
   756	
   757	      if (!branchChain || branchChain.length === 0) {
   758	        console.error('Empty branch chain returned');
   759	        return;
   760	      }
   761	
   762	      // Find the index of current message in the messages array
   763	      const messageIndex = messages.findIndex(m => m.message_id === messageId);
   764	      if (messageIndex < 0) return;
   765	
   766	      // Replace from the branch point onwards with the complete branch chain
   767	      const newMessages = messages.slice(0, messageIndex);
   768	      newMessages.push(...branchChain.slice(messageIndex));
   769	
   770	      setMessages(newMessages);
   771	
   772	      // Load sibling info for all messages in the new branch
   773	      for (const msg of branchChain.slice(messageIndex)) {
   774	        await loadSiblings(msg.message_id);
   775	      }
   776	    } catch (error) {
   777	      console.error('Failed to load branch chain:', error);
   778	    }
   779	  };
   780	
   781	  const deleteConversation = async (conversationId) => {
   782	    try {
   783	      await api.delete(`/user/conversations/${conversationId}`);
   784	      await loadConversations();
   785	      if (currentConversation?.id === conversationId) {
   786	        setCurrentConversation(null);
   787	        setMessages([]);
   788	      }
   789	    } catch (error) {
   790	      console.error('Failed to delete conversation:', error);
   791	    }
   792	  };

   803	    } catch (error) {
   804	      console.error('Failed to rename conversation:', error);
   805	    }
   806	  };
   807

   824	
   825	  const handleNewConversation = () => {
   826	    setCurrentConversation(null);
   827	    setMessages([]);
   828	  };
   829	
   830	  const getGreeting = () => {
   831	    const hour = new Date().getHours();
   832	    if (hour < 5) return '夜深了';
   833	    if (hour < 12) return '早上好';

   838	  return (
   839	    <div className="chat-page-wrapper chat-page">

   841	      <div className={`main-container ${sidebarCollapsed ? 'sidebar-collapsed' : 'sidebar-expanded'}`}>

   864	                <div className="navbar-left-group">

   869	                        <path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 0 1-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 0 1-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 0 1 7.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/>

  1300	                  )}
  1301	
  1302	                  {/* Streaming content - shown when content arrives */}
  1303	                  {streamingContent && (

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
    11	import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import { Upload, File, Image, Trash2, Loader2, CheckCircle, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
    13	import api, { publicApi } from '../services/api';
    14	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    15	import './styles/FeedbackPage.css';
    16	
    17	// 文件限制常量
    18	const MAX_FILES = 2;
    19	const MAX_IMAGES = 10;
    20	const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB
    21	
    22	const FeedbackPage = () => {
    23	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    24	  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
    25	  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
    26	  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
    27	  const [files, setFiles] = useState([]); // 文件附件
    28	  const [images, setImages] = useState([]); // 图片附件
    29	  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
    30	  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
    31	  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
    32	  const [error, setError] = useState('');
    33	  const [uploadKey, setUploadKey] = useState(''); // 上传批次key
    34	  
    35	  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
    36	  const imageInputRef = useRef(null);
    37	
    38	  // 验证文件大小
    39	  const validateFileSize = (file) => {
    40	    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
    41	      setError(`文件 "${file.name}" 超过10MB限制`);
    42	      return false;
    43	    }
    44	    return true;
    45	  };
    46	
    47	  // 处理文件上传
    48	  const handleFileChange = async (e, type) => {
    49	    const selectedFiles = Array.from(e.target.files);
    50	    if (!selectedFiles.length) return;
    51	
    52	    const currentList = type === 'file' ? files : images;
    53	    const maxCount = type === 'file' ? MAX_FILES : MAX_IMAGES;
    54	    const remaining = maxCount - currentList.length;
    55	
    56	    if (remaining <= 0) {
    57	      setError(`最多只能上传${maxCount}个${type === 'file' ? '文件' : '图片'}`);
    58	      return;
    59	    }
    60	
    61	    const filesToUpload = selectedFiles.slice(0, remaining);
    62	    
    63	    // 验证文件大小
    64	    for (const file of filesToUpload) {
    65	      if (!validateFileSize(file)) return;
    66	    }
    67	
    68	    setUploading(true);
    69	    setError('');
    70	
    71	    try {
    72	      const formData = new FormData();
    73	      filesToUpload.forEach(file => {
    74	        formData.append('files', file);
    75	      });
    76	      // 如果已有uploadKey，则使用同一个key
    77	      if (uploadKey) {
    78	        formData.append('uploadKey', uploadKey);
    79	      }
    80	
    81	      const response = await publicApi.post('/feedback/upload', formData, {
    82	        headers: {
    83	          'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',
    84	        },
    85	      });
    86	
    87	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    88	        // 保存uploadKey用于后续上传和提交
    89	        if (response.data.data.uploadKey) {
    90	          setUploadKey(response.data.data.uploadKey);
    91	        }
    92	
    93	        // 后端返回 attachments 数组，包含 name, url, size, type
    94	        const uploadedFiles = (response.data.data.attachments || response.data.data.files || []).map((f) => ({
    95	          name: f.name,
    96	          url: f.url,
    97	          size: f.size,
    98	          type: f.type, // 'image' 或 'file'
    99	        }));
   100	
   101	        if (type === 'file') {
   102	          setFiles(prev => [...prev, ...uploadedFiles]);
   103	        } else {
   104	          setImages(prev => [...prev, ...uploadedFiles]);
   105	        }
   106	      } else {
   107	        setError(response.data.message || '上传失败');
   108	      }
   109	    } catch (err) {
   110	      console.error('Upload error:', err);
   111	      setError(err.response?.data?.message || '上传失败，请重试');
   112	    } finally {
   113	      setUploading(false);
   114	      // 清空 input
   115	      e.target.value = '';
   116	    }
   117	  };
   118	
   119	  // 删除文件
   120	  const removeFile = (index, type) => {
   121	    if (type === 'file') {
   122	      setFiles(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
   123	    } else {
   124	      setImages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
   125	    }
   126	  };
   127	
   128	  // 提交反馈
   129	  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
   130	    e.preventDefault();
   131	    
   132	    // 验证
   133	    if (!email.trim()) {
   134	      setError('请输入邮箱地址');
   135	      return;
   136	    }
   137	    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
   138	      setError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
   139	      return;
   140	    }
   141	    if (!content.trim() || content.trim().length < 10) {
   142	      setError('反馈内容至少需要10个字符');
   143	      return;
   144	    }
   145	
   146	    setSubmitting(true);
   147	    setError('');
   148	
   149	    try {
   150	      const feedbackData = {
   151	        email: email.trim(),
   152	        content: content.trim(),
   153	        attachmentsKey: uploadKey, // 使用上传时返回的key关联附件
   154	      };
   155	
   156	      // 如果用户已登录，使用带认证的API，以便后端关联用户信息
   157	      const response = isAuthenticated 
   158	        ? await api.post('/user/feedback', feedbackData)
   159	        : await publicApi.post('/feedback', feedbackData);
   160	
   161	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   162	        setSubmitted(true);
   163	      } else {
   164	        setError(response.data.message || '提交失败');
   165	      }
   166	    } catch (err) {
   167	      console.error('Submit error:', err);
   168	      setError(err.response?.data?.message || '提交失败，请重试');
   169	    } finally {
   170	      setSubmitting(false);
   171	    }
   172	  };
   173	
   174	  return (
   175	    <div className="feedback-page">
   176	      <div className="feedback-container">
   177	        <div className="feedback-header">
   178	          <button className="back-btn" onClick={() => navigate(-1)}>
   179	            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
   180	            <span>返回</span>
   181	          </button>
   182	          <h1>意见反馈</h1>
   183	          <p>您的反馈对我们非常重要，我们会认真对待每一条意见</p>
   184	        </div>
   185	
   186	        {submitted ? (
   187	          <div className="feedback-success">
   188	            <CheckCircle size={64} className="success-icon" />
   189	            <h2>感谢您的反馈！</h2>
   190	            <p>我们已收到您的意见，会尽快处理并通过邮件回复您。</p>
   191	            <button className="btn-primary" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
   192	              返回首页
   193	            </button>
   194	          </div>
   195	        ) : (
   196	          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="feedback-form">
   197	            <div className="form-field">
   198	              <label htmlFor="feedback-email">
   199	                邮箱地址 <span className="required">*</span>
   200	              </label>
   201	              <input
   202	                id="feedback-email"
   203	                type="email"
   204	                placeholder="请输入您的邮箱，我们会通过邮件回复您"
   205	                value={email}
   206	                onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
   207	                disabled={submitting}
   208	              />
   209	            </div>
   210	
   211	            <div className="form-field">
   212	              <label htmlFor="feedback-content">
   213	                反馈内容 <span className="required">*</span>
   214	              </label>
   215	              <textarea
   216	                id="feedback-content"
   217	                placeholder="请详细描述您的问题或建议（至少10个字符）"
   218	                value={content}
   219	                onChange={e => setContent(e.target.value)}
   220	                rows={8}
   221	                maxLength={5000}
   222	                disabled={submitting}
   223	              />
   224	              <div className="char-count">{content.length}/5000</div>
   225	            </div>
   226	
   227	            {/* 文件上传区域 */}
   228	            <div className="form-field">
   229	              <label>附件（可选）</label>
   230	              <div className="upload-section">
   231	                {/* 文件上传 */}
   232	                <div className="upload-group">
   233	                  <div className="upload-header">
   234	                    <File size={18} />
   235	                    <span>文件（最多{MAX_FILES}个，每个不超过10MB）</span>
   236	                  </div>
   237	                  <div className="upload-list">
   238	                    {files.map((file, idx) => (

   240	                        <File size={16} />
   241	                        <span className="upload-item-name">{file.name}</span>
   242	                        <button 
   243	                          type="button" 
   244	                          className="upload-remove-btn"
   245	                          onClick={() => removeFile(idx, 'file')}
   246	                          disabled={submitting}
   247	                        >
   248	                          <Trash2 size={16} />

   251	                    ))}
   252	                    {files.length < MAX_FILES && (
   253	                      <button
   254	                        type="button"
   255	                        className="upload-add-btn"
   256	                        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
   257	                        disabled={uploading || submitting}
   258	                      >
   259	                        {uploading ? <Loader2 size={16} className="spin" /> : <Upload size={16} />}
   260	                        <span>上传文件</span>
   261	                      </button>
   262	                    )}
   263	                  </div>
   264	                  <input
   265	                    ref={fileInputRef}
   266	                    type="file"
   267	                    multiple
   268	                    accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.txt,.zip,.rar"
   269	                    onChange={e => handleFileChange(e, 'file')}
   270	                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
   271	                  />
   272	                </div>
   273

   275	                <div className="upload-group">
   276	                  <div className="upload-header">
   277	                    <Image size={18} />
   278	                    <span>图片（最多{MAX_IMAGES}张，每张不超过10MB）</span>
   279	                  </div>
   280	                  <div className="upload-images">
   281	                    {images.map((img, idx) => (
   282	                      <div key={idx} className="upload-image-item">

   284	                        <button

   287	                          onClick={() => removeFile(idx, 'image')}

   289	                        >

   294	                    {images.length < MAX_IMAGES && (

   298	                        onClick={() => imageInputRef.current?.click()}
   299	                        disabled={uploading || submitting}
   300	                      >
   301	                        {uploading ? <Loader2 size={24} className="spin" /> : <Upload size={24} />}
   302	                      </button>
   303	                    )}
   304	                  </div>
   305	                  <input
   306	                    ref={imageInputRef}
   307	                    type="file"
   308	                    multiple
   309	                    accept="image/*"
   310	                    onChange={e => handleFileChange(e, 'image')}
   311	                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
   312	                  />
   313	                </div>
   314	              </div>
   315	            </div>
   316	
   317	            {error && <div className="form-error">{error}</div>}
   318	
   319	            {isAuthenticated && (
   320	              <div className="form-note">

文件: frontend-user/src/pages/GithubCallback.js

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import { useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    13	import { userAPI } from '../services/api';
    14	import logger from '../utils/logger';
    15	
    16	// Whitelist of allowed return URLs
    17	const RETURN_URL_WHITELIST = [
    18	  '/pricing',
    19	  '/search-results',
    20	  '/advanced-search',
    21	  '/chat',
    22	  '/settings',
    23	  '/dashboard',
    24	  '/order-confirmation',
    25	];
    26	
    27	/**
    28	 * Check if a return URL is in the whitelist
    29	 */
    30	const isWhitelistedReturnURL = (url) => {
    31	  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
    32	
    33	  let pathname;
    34	  try {
    35	    if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) {
    36	      pathname = new URL(url).pathname;
    37	    } else {
    38	      pathname = url.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
    39	    }
    40	  } catch (e) {
    41	    return false;
    42	  }
    43	
    44	  return RETURN_URL_WHITELIST.includes(pathname);
    45	};
    46	
    47	// CRITICAL: Clear old tokens IMMEDIATELY before component renders
    48	// This prevents AuthContext from starting heartbeat with expired tokens
    49	// Must be outside the component to run before React lifecycle
    50	// NOTE: We only clear auth tokens, NOT OAuth state which is needed for verification
    51	const bindMode = localStorage.getItem('github_bind_mode');
    52	if (bindMode !== 'bind') {
    53	  // Only clear tokens in login mode, not binding mode
    54	  // DO NOT clear github_bind_state/github_oauth_state here - it's needed for verification
    55	  localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
    56	  localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
    57	}
    58	
    59	const GithubCallback = () => {
    60	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    61	  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
    62	  const { login } = useAuth();
    63	
    64	  useEffect(() => {
    65	    const handleCallback = async () => {
    66	      const code = searchParams.get('code');
    67	      const state = searchParams.get('state');
    68	
    69	      if (!code || !state) {
    70	        console.error('Invalid GitHub callback parameters');
    71	        navigate('/');
    72	        return;
    73	      }
    74	
    75	      // Check if this is a binding operation
    76	      const bindMode = localStorage.getItem('github_bind_mode');
    77	      const stateKey = bindMode === 'bind' ? 'github_bind_state' : 'github_oauth_state';
    78	      const savedState = localStorage.getItem(stateKey);
    79	
    80	      // Debug logging
    81	      logger.log('GitHub callback - bindMode:', bindMode);
    82	      logger.log('GitHub callback - State key:', stateKey);
    83	      logger.log('GitHub callback - URL state:', state);
    84	      logger.log('GitHub callback - Saved state:', savedState);
    85	
    86	      if (state !== savedState) {
    87	        console.error('State mismatch!');
    88	        console.error('  Expected (from localStorage):', savedState);
    89	        console.error('  Received (from URL):', state);
    90	        console.error('  Storage key used:', stateKey);
    91	
    92	        // Redirect with error state
    93	        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
    94	          const params = new URLSearchParams({
    95	            tab: 'account',
    96	            github_bind_status: 'error',
    97	            message: '安全验证失败，请重试'
    98	          });
    99	          navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
   100	        } else {
   101	          navigate('/');
   102	        }
   103	        return;
   104	      }
   105	
   106	      try {
   107	        let response;
   108	
   109	        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
   110	          // Binding mode
   111	          response = await userAPI.bindGitHubAccount(code, state);
   112	
   113	          if (response.data.code === 0) {
   114	            // Clean up
   115	            localStorage.removeItem('github_bind_state');
   116	            localStorage.removeItem('github_bind_mode');
   117	            localStorage.removeItem('github_return_url');
   118	
   119	            // Redirect to settings with success state
   120	            const params = new URLSearchParams({
   121	              tab: 'account',
   122	              github_bind_status: 'success',
   123	              message: 'GitHub 账号绑定成功！'
   124	            });
   125	            navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
   126	          } else {
   127	            throw new Error(response.data.message || 'GitHub 绑定失败');
   128	          }
   129	        } else {
   130	          // Login mode
   131	          // 获取保存的邀请码（如果有）
   132	          const invitationCode = localStorage.getItem('oauth_invitation_code');
   133	          response = await userAPI.githubCallback(code, state, invitationCode);
   134	
   135	          if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   136	            const { token, user } = response.data.data;
   137	
   138	            // Save token and user data
   139	            localStorage.setItem('user_token', token);
   140	            localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(user));
   141	
   142	            // Check for return URL
   143	            const returnURL = localStorage.getItem('github_return_url');
   144	            let redirectPath = '/';
   145	
   146	            if (returnURL && isWhitelistedReturnURL(returnURL)) {
   147	              redirectPath = returnURL;
   148	              logger.log('GitHub login success - redirecting to:', redirectPath);
   149	            } else if (returnURL) {
   150	              logger.warn('GitHub login - return URL not whitelisted:', returnURL);
   151	            }
   152	
   153	            // Clean up
   154	            localStorage.removeItem('github_oauth_state');
   155	            localStorage.removeItem('github_return_url');
   156	            localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code'); // 清理邀请码
   157	
   158	            // Update auth context
   159	            login(token, user);
   160	
   161	            // Redirect
   162	            navigate(redirectPath);
   163	          } else {
   164	            throw new Error(response.data.message || 'GitHub 登录失败');
   165	          }
   166	        }
   167	      } catch (error) {
   168	        console.error('GitHub callback error:', error);
   169	        const errorMessage = error.response?.data?.message || error.message || (bindMode === 'bind' ? 'GitHub 绑定失败' : 'GitHub 登录失败');
   170	
   171	        // Clean up on error
   172	        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
   173	          localStorage.removeItem('github_bind_state');
   174	          localStorage.removeItem('github_bind_mode');
   175	          localStorage.removeItem('github_return_url');
   176	
   177	          // Redirect to settings with error state
   178	          const params = new URLSearchParams({
   179	            tab: 'account',
   180	            github_bind_status: 'error',
   181	            message: errorMessage
   182	          });
   183	          navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
   184	        } else {
   185	          localStorage.removeItem('github_oauth_state');
   186	          localStorage.removeItem('github_return_url');
   187	          localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code'); // 清理邀请码
   188	          navigate('/');
   189	        }
   190	      }
   191	    };
   192	
   193	    handleCallback();
   194	  }, [searchParams, navigate, login]);
   195	
   196	  return null;
   197	};
   198	
   199	export default GithubCallback;

   125	  }, [searchMode]); // 当searchMode变化时重新开始轮播
   126	
   127	  // 当切换搜索模式时，重置示例索引
   128	  useEffect(() => {
   129	    setCurrentExampleIndex(0);
   130	  }, [searchMode]);
   131	
   132	  useEffect(() => {
   133	    const phrases = [
   134	      '探索学术世界,从这里开始',
   135	      '发现前沿研究,开启智慧之旅',
   136	      '用AI连接知识,让学术触手可及',
   137	      '搜索论文,理解文献,推动创新'
   138	    ];
   139	
   140	    const currentPhrase = phrases[currentPhraseIndex];
   141	    const pauseAfterComplete = 30000; // 30s 展示间隔
   142	    const pauseAfterDelete = 500;
   143	
   144	    if (!isDeleting && displayedText === currentPhrase) {
   145	      // Finished typing, pause then start deleting
   146	      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   147	        setIsDeleting(true);
   148	      }, pauseAfterComplete);
   149	      return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
   150	    }
   151	
   152	    if (isDeleting && displayedText === '') {
   153	      // Finished deleting, move to next phrase
   154	      setIsDeleting(false);
   155	      setCurrentPhraseIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % phrases.length);
   156	      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   157	      }, pauseAfterDelete);
   158	      return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
   159	    }
   160	
   161	    const phraseLength = currentPhrase.length || 1;
   162	    const rawProgress = displayedText.length / phraseLength;
   163	    const directionalProgress = isDeleting ? 1 - rawProgress : rawProgress;
   164	    const clampedProgress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, directionalProgress));
   165	    const wave = Math.sin(Math.PI * clampedProgress);
   166	    const config = isDeleting
   167	      ? { base: 60, variance: 18, min: 28 }
   168	      : { base: 115, variance: 35, min: 60 };
   169	    const targetDelay = Math.max(
   170	      config.min,
   171	      config.base - wave * config.variance
   172	    );
   173	    const smoothDelay = lastTypingDelayRef.current * 0.4 + targetDelay * 0.6;
   174	    lastTypingDelayRef.current = smoothDelay;
   175	
   176	    // Type or delete character
   177	    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   178	      setDisplayedText(prev => {
   179	        if (isDeleting) {
   180	          return currentPhrase.substring(0, prev.length - 1);
   181	        } else {
   182	          return currentPhrase.substring(0, prev.length + 1);
   183	        }
   184	      });
   185	    }, smoothDelay);
   186	
   187	    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
   188	  }, [displayedText, isDeleting, currentPhraseIndex]);
   189	
   190	  const handleLoginSuccess = () => {
   191	    setShowAuthModal(false);
   192	  };
   193	
   194	  // 处理选择论文建议
   195	  const handleSelectPaper = (paper) => {
   196	    // 使用论文标题作为搜索查询
   197	    const title = paper.title || '';
   198	    const paperId = paper.id || '';
   199	    setSearchQuery(title);
   200	    setShowSuggestions(false);
   201	    // 跳转到搜索结果页面，并带上 paperId 以显示论文详情
   202	    const params = new URLSearchParams();
   203	    if (title) params.set('query', title);
   204	    if (paperId) params.set('paperId', paperId);
   205	    navigate(`/search-results?${params.toString()}`);
   206	  };
   207	
   208	  // 处理选择作者建议
   209	  const handleSelectAuthor = (author) => {
   210	    // 使用作者名字作为搜索查询
   211	    const name = author.name || '';
   212	    const authorId = author.authorId || '';
   213	    setSearchQuery(name);
   214	    setShowSuggestions(false);
   215	    // 跳转到搜索结果页面，并带上 authorId 以显示作者详情
   216	    const params = new URLSearchParams();
   217	    if (name) params.set('query', name);
   218	    if (authorId) params.set('authorId', authorId);
   219	    navigate(`/search-results?${params.toString()}`);
   220	  };
   221	
   222	  const handleSearch = async (e) => {
   223	    e.preventDefault();
   224	    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
   225	
   226	    const userMessage = searchQuery.trim();
   227	
   228	    // 学术检索模式：允许未登录用户使用
   229	    if (searchMode === 'normal') {
   230	      const params = new URLSearchParams({ query: userMessage });
   231	
   232	      // 添加筛选条件到URL参数
   233	      if (filters.yearFrom) params.set('yearFrom', filters.yearFrom);
   234	      if (filters.yearTo) params.set('yearTo', filters.yearTo);
   235	      if (filters.publicationTypes.length > 0) params.set('publicationTypes', filters.publicationTypes.join(','));
   236	      if (filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) params.set('fieldsOfStudy', filters.fieldsOfStudy.join(','));
   237	      if (filters.openAccessPdf) params.set('openAccessPdf', filters.openAccessPdf);
   238	      if (filters.venue) params.set('venue', filters.venue);
   239	
   240	      navigate(`/search-results?${params.toString()}`);
   241	      return;
   242	    }
   243	
   244	    // 智能分析模式：需要登录才能使用
   245	    if (searchMode === 'advanced') {
   246	      // Check if user is authenticated
   247	      if (!isAuthenticated) {
   248	        setShowAuthModal(true);
   249	        return;
   250	      }
   251	
   252	      const params = new URLSearchParams({
   253	        query: userMessage,
   254	        modelLevel: modelLevel  // 传递模型级别
   255	      });
   256	      navigate(`/advanced-search?${params.toString()}`);
   257	      return;
   258	    }
   259	  };
   260	
   261	  // FAQ数据用于结构化数据
   262	  const faqData = [
   263	    {
   264	      question: '什么是Scholay学术搜索平台？',
   265	      answer: 'Scholay是一个AI驱动的学术搜索平台，提供智能文献检索、论文分析、引用图谱可视化等功能，帮助研究人员快速找到高质量学术资源。'
   266	    },
   267	    {
   268	      question: 'Scholay支持哪些搜索模式？',
   269	      answer: 'Scholay支持学术检索和智能分析两种模式。学术检索可以快速检索论文标题、作者和关键词；智能分析使用AI智能理解并解析您的研究需求，提供更精准的结果。'
   270	    },
   271	    {
   272	      question: 'Scholay的数据来源是什么？',
   273	      answer: 'Scholay基于Semantic Scholay学术图谱API，提供来自计算机科学、生物医学等多个领域的数百万篇学术论文数据。'
   274	    }
   275	  ];
   276	
   277	  // Main search interface
   278	  return (
   279	    <div className="home-search">
   280	      <SEO
   281	        title="Scholay - AI驱动的学术搜索平台 | 智能文献检索与分析"
   282	        description="Scholay是创新的学术搜索平台，提供AI驱动的文献检索、智能论文分析、引用图谱可视化等功能。支持学术检索和智能分析两种模式，帮助研究人员快速找到高质量学术资源，提升科研效率。"
   283	        keywords="学术搜索,论文检索,文献查找,AI论文分析,学术资源,科研工具,Semantic Scholar,论文引用,学术数据库,研究助手,智能搜索"
   284	        canonical="/"
   285	        structuredData={generateFAQSchema(faqData)}
   286	      />
   287	      
   288	      <div className={`main-container ${isAuthenticated ? (sidebarCollapsed ? 'sidebar-collapsed-narrow' : 'has-sidebar') : 'sidebar-collapsed'}`}>
   289	        <nav className="top-navbar">
   290	          <div className="navbar-left">
   291	            {/* 移动端菜单按钮 - 登录状态下显示 */}
   292	            {isMobile && isAuthenticated && (
   293	              <button 
   294	                className="mobile-menu-btn"
   295	                onClick={openMobileSidebar}
   296	                aria-label="打开菜单"
   297	              >
   298	                <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
   299	                  <line x1="4" y1="8" x2="20" y2="8" />
   300	                  <line x1="4" y1="16" x2="14" y2="16" />
   301	                </svg>
   302	              </button>
   303	            )}
   304	            <div className="logo">
   305	              <span className="logo-text">Scholay</span>
   306	            </div>
   307	          </div>
   308	
   309	          <div className="navbar-right">
   310	            {!isAuthenticated && (
   311	              <div className="auth-buttons">
   312	                {/* 桌面端显示的按钮 */}
   313	                <button
   314	                  onClick={() => navigate('/pricing')}
   315	                  className="btn-auth btn-pricing desktop-only"
   316	                >
   317	                  价格方案
   318	                </button>
   319	                <div className="desktop-only">
   320	                <ThemeToggle />
   321	                </div>
   322	                <button
   323	                  onClick={() => setShowAuthModal(true)}
   324	                  className="btn-auth btn-login desktop-only"
   325	                >
   326	                  登录
   327	                </button>
   328	                <button
   329	                  onClick={() => setShowAuthModal(true)}
   330	                  className="btn-auth btn-register desktop-only"
   331	                >
   332	                  免费注册
   333	                </button>
   334	
   335	                {/* 移动端显示的按钮 */}
   336	                <button
   337	                  onClick={() => setShowHelpModal(true)}
   338	                  className="btn-mobile-help mobile-only"
   339	                  aria-label="帮助与设置"
   340	                >
   341	                  <HelpCircle size={20} strokeWidth={2} />
   342	                </button>
   343	                <button
   344	                  onClick={() => setShowAuthModal(true)}
   345	                  className="btn-auth btn-login-mobile mobile-only"
   346	                >
   347	                  登录
   348	                </button>
   349	              </div>
   350	            )}
   351	          </div>
   352	        </nav>
   353	
   354	        <div className="search-content">
   355	          <div className="chat-container">
   356	            <div className="welcome-screen">
   357	              <h1 className="welcome-title">
   358	                {displayedText}
   359	              </h1>
   360	            </div>
   361	
   362	            {/* 底部链接 */}
   363	            <div className="home-footer-links">
   364	              <button 
   365	                className="footer-link-btn"
   366	                onClick={() => navigate('/feedback')}
   367	              >
   368	                反馈
   369	              </button>
   370	              <span className="footer-link-divider">|</span>
   371	              <button 
   372	                className="footer-link-btn"
   373	                onClick={() => navigate('/about')}
   374	              >
   375	                关于我们
   376	              </button>
   377	            </div>
   378	
   379	            <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="home-composer-wrapper" ref={composerRef}>
   380	              {/* 输入区域 */}
   381	              <div className="home-composer-input-area">
   382	                    <textarea
   383	                      ref={textareaRef}
   384	                      className="home-chat-input"
   385	                      placeholder={searchExamples[searchMode][currentExampleIndex]}
   386	                      value={searchQuery}
   387	                      maxLength={1000}
   388	                      onChange={(e) => {
   389	                        setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
   390	                        // Auto-resize textarea
   391	                        e.target.style.height = 'auto';
   392	                        e.target.style.height = Math.min(e.target.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
   393	                        // 学术检索模式下显示搜索建议
   394	                        if (searchMode === 'normal' && e.target.value.trim().length >= 2) {
   395	                          setShowSuggestions(true);
   396	                        } else {
   397	                          setShowSuggestions(false);
   398	                        }
   399	                      }}
   400	                      onFocus={() => {
   401	                        // 学术检索模式下，如果有输入内容则显示搜索建议
   402	                        if (searchMode === 'normal' && searchQuery.trim().length >= 2) {
   403	                          setShowSuggestions(true);
   404	                        }
   405	                      }}
   406	                      onBlur={() => {
   407	                        // 延迟关闭，以便点击建议项时不会立即关闭
   408	                        setTimeout(() => setShowSuggestions(false), 200);
   409	                      }}
   410	                      onCompositionStart={() => setIsComposing(true)}
   411	                      onCompositionEnd={() => setIsComposing(false)}
   412	                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
   413	                        // Submit on Enter, new line on Shift+Enter
   414	                        // 但要避免在输入法输入过程中触发提交
   415	                        if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !isComposing) {
   416	                          e.preventDefault();
   417	                          setShowSuggestions(false);
   418	                          if (searchQuery.trim()) {
   419	                            handleSearch(e);
   420	                          }
   421	                        }
   422	                        // Escape 关闭搜索建议
   423	                        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
   424	                          setShowSuggestions(false);
   425	                        }
   426	                      }}
   427	                      rows={1}
   428	                    />
   429	                    <button type="submit" className="btn-send" disabled={!searchQuery.trim()}>
   430	                      <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   431	                        <path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/>
   432	                      </svg>
   433	                    </button>
   434	                  </div>
   435	
   436	              {/* 搜索建议下拉框 - 仅在学术检索模式下显示 */}
   437	              {searchMode === 'normal' && (
   438	                <SearchSuggestions
   439	                  query={searchQuery}
   440	                  onSelectPaper={handleSelectPaper}
   441	                  onSelectAuthor={handleSelectAuthor}
   442	                  onClose={() => setShowSuggestions(false)}
   443	                  visible={showSuggestions}
   444	                  inputRef={textareaRef}
   445	                />
   446	              )}
   447	
   448	                  {/* 底部操作栏 */}
   449	                  <div className="home-composer-footer">
   450	                    <div className="home-composer-footer-left">
   451	                      {/* 搜索模式切换 - 分段控制器设计 */}
   452	                      <div className="home-search-mode-segmented">
   453	                        <button
   454	                          type="button"
   455	                          className={`mode-segment ${searchMode === 'normal' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   456	                          onClick={() => setSearchMode('normal')}
   457	                        >
   458	                          <span className="mode-segment-icon">
   459	                            <NormalSearchIcon size={16} />
   460	                          </span>
   461	                          <span className="mode-segment-label">学术检索</span>
   462	                        </button>
   463	                        <button
   464	                          type="button"
   465	                          className={`mode-segment ${searchMode === 'advanced' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   466	                          onClick={() => setSearchMode('advanced')}
   467	                        >
   468	                          <span className="mode-segment-icon">
   469	                            <AdvancedSearchIcon size={16} />
   470	                          </span>
   471	                          <span className="mode-segment-label">智能分析</span>
   472	                        </button>
   473	                      </div>
   474	
   475	                      {/* 分隔线 */}
   476	                      <div className="footer-divider"></div>
   477	
   478	                      {/* 筛选按钮 - 仅在学术检索模式显示 */}
   479	                      {searchMode === 'normal' && (() => {
   480	                        const hasFilters = filters.yearFrom ||
   481	                                         filters.yearTo ||
   482	                                         filters.publicationTypes.length > 0 ||
   483	                                         filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0 ||
   484	                                         filters.openAccessPdf ||
   485	                                         filters.venue;
   486	
   487	                        const handleClearClick = (e) => {
   488	                          e.stopPropagation();
   489	                          setFilters({
   490	                            yearFrom: '',
   491	                            yearTo: '',
   492	                            publicationTypes: [],
   493	                            fieldsOfStudy: [],
   494	                            openAccessPdf: '',
   495	                            venue: '',
   496	                          });
   497	                        };
   498	
   499	                        return (
   500	                          <button
   501	                            type="button"
   502	                            className={`footer-btn filter-btn ${showFilters ? 'panel-open' : ''} ${hasFilters ? 'has-filters' : ''}`}
   503	                            onClick={() => setShowFilters(!showFilters)}
   504	                            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.classList.add('is-hovering')}
   505	                            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.classList.remove('is-hovering')}
   506	                            title={hasFilters ? "点击打开筛选" : "筛选条件"}
   507	                          >
   508	                            <div className="filter-icon-wrapper" onClick={(e) => {
   509	                              if (hasFilters && e.currentTarget.parentElement.classList.contains('is-hovering')) {
   510	                                e.stopPropagation();
   511	                                handleClearClick(e);
   512	                              }
   513	                            }}>
   514	                              <svg className="filter-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   515	                                <path d="M2.5 3.75C2.5 3.19772 2.94772 2.75 3.5 2.75H16.5C17.0523 2.75 17.5 3.19772 17.5 3.75V5.25C17.5 5.51522 17.3946 5.76957 17.2071 5.95711L11.75 11.4142V16.25C11.75 16.6297 11.5085 16.9705 11.1522 17.1094L8.65217 18.1094C8.15522 18.3078 7.58333 17.9469 7.58333 17.4167V11.4142L2.79289 5.95711C2.60536 5.76957 2.5 5.51522 2.5 5.25V3.75Z"/>
   516	                              </svg>
   517	                              <svg className="clear-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   518	                                <path d="M13.5355 5.46447C13.9261 5.85499 13.9261 6.48816 13.5355 6.87868L11.4142 9L13.5355 11.1213C13.9261 11.5118 13.9261 12.145 13.5355 12.5355C13.145 12.9261 12.5118 12.9261 12.1213 12.5355L10 10.4142L7.87868 12.5355C7.48816 12.9261 6.85499 12.9261 6.46447 12.5355C6.07394 12.145 6.07394 11.5118 6.46447 11.1213L8.58579 9L6.46447 6.87868C6.07394 6.48816 6.07394 5.85499 6.46447 5.46447C6.85499 5.07394 7.48816 5.07394 7.87868 5.46447L10 7.58579L12.1213 5.46447C12.5118 5.07394 13.145 5.07394 13.5355 5.46447Z"/>
   519	                              </svg>
   520	                            </div>
   521	                            <span>筛选</span>
   522	                          </button>
   523	                        );
   524	                      })()}
   525	
   526	                      {/* 模型选择器 - 仅在智能分析模式显示 */}
   527	                      {searchMode === 'advanced' && (
   528	                        <div className="model-selector-wrapper">
   529	                          <ModelSelector
   530	                            value={modelLevel}
   531	                            onChange={setModelLevel}
   532	                            userSubscription={user?.subscription}
   533	                            isAuthenticated={isAuthenticated}
   534	                          />
   535	                        </div>
   536	                      )}
   537	                    </div>
   538	                  </div>
   539	            </form>
   540	
   541	            {/* 学术检索模式下的筛选条件 */}
   542	            {searchMode === 'normal' && (
   543	              <SearchFilters
   544	                filters={filters}
   545	                onFiltersChange={setFilters}
   546	                isExpanded={showFilters}
   547	                onToggle={() => setShowFilters(!showFilters)}
   548	              />
   549	            )}
   550	          </div>
   551	        </div>
   552	      </div>
   553	
   554	      {/* 条件渲染 AuthModal - 只在需要时加载 */}
   555	      {showAuthModal && (
   556	        <Suspense fallback={null}>
   557	          <AuthModal
   558	            isOpen={showAuthModal}
   559	            onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
   560	            onLoginSuccess={handleLoginSuccess}
   561	          />
   562	        </Suspense>
   563	      )}
   564	
   565	      {/* 移动端帮助弹窗 */}
   566	      <MobileHelpModal
   567	        isOpen={showHelpModal}
   568	        onClose={() => setShowHelpModal(false)}
   569	      />
   570	
   571	    </div>
   572	  );
   573	};
   574	
   575	export default Home;
