    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import api from '../services/api';
    13	import './MyCoupons.css';
    14	
    15	const MyCoupons = () => {
    16	  const [coupons, setCoupons] = useState([]);
    17	  const [invitation, setInvitation] = useState(null);
    18	  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState(null);
    19	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    20	  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('available');
    21	  const [showClaimModal, setShowClaimModal] = useState(false);
    22	  const [claimCode, setClaimCode] = useState('');
    23	  const [invitationCopied, setInvitationCopied] = useState(false);
    24	  const [isComposing, setIsComposing] = useState(false); // 跟踪输入法状态
    25	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    26	
    27	  useEffect(() => {
    28	    fetchData();
    29	  }, [activeTab]);
    30	
    31	  const fetchData = async () => {
    32	    setLoading(true);
    33	    try {
    34	      // 获取用户的折扣券
    35	      const statusFilter = activeTab === 'available' ? 'unused' : activeTab === 'used' ? 'used' : 'expired';
    36	      const couponsRes = await api.get(`/user/coupons?status=${statusFilter}`);
    37	      setCoupons(couponsRes.data.data.coupons || []);
    38	
    39	      // 获取邀请信息
    40	      try {
    41	        const inviteRes = await api.get('/user/invitation/my');
    42	        setInvitation(inviteRes.data.data);
    43	      } catch (error) {
    44	        // 用户可能还没有生成邀请码
    45	      }
    46	
    47	      // 获取邀请统计
    48	      try {
    49	        const statsRes = await api.get('/user/invitation/statistics');
    50	        setStatistics(statsRes.data.data);
    51	      } catch (error) {
    52	        // 可能没有统计数据
    53	      }
    54	    } catch (error) {
    55	      console.error('Failed to fetch data:', error);
    56	    } finally {
    57	      setLoading(false);
    58	    }
    59	  };
    60	
    61	  const generateInvitation = async () => {
    62	    try {
    63	      const response = await api.post('/user/invitation/generate');
    64	      setInvitation(response.data.data);
    65	      alert('邀请码生成成功！');
    66	    } catch (error) {
    67	      console.error('Failed to generate invitation:', error);
    68	      alert('生成邀请码失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    69	    }
    70	  };
    71	
    72	  const claimCoupon = async () => {
    73	    if (!claimCode.trim()) {
    74	      alert('请输入折扣券代码');
    75	      return;
    76	    }
    77	
    78	    try {
    79	      const response = await api.post('/user/coupons/claim', {
    80	        code: claimCode
    81	      });
    82	      alert('领取成功！');
    83	      setShowClaimModal(false);
    84	      setClaimCode('');
    85	      fetchData();
    86	    } catch (error) {
    87	      alert('领取失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    88	    }
    89	  };
    90	
    91	  const copyInvitationCode = () => {
    92	    if (invitation) {
    93	      navigator.clipboard.writeText(invitation.invitation_code);
    94	      setInvitationCopied(true);
    95	      setTimeout(() => setInvitationCopied(false), 2000);
    96	    }
    97	  };
    98	
    99	  const copyInvitationUrl = () => {
   100	    if (invitation) {
   101	      const url = `${window.location.origin}/register?invite=${invitation.invitation_code}`;
   102	      navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
   103	      alert('邀请链接已复制到剪贴板');
   104	    }
   105	  };
   106	
   107	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
   108	    if (!dateString) return '-';
   109	    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
   110	  };
   111	
   112	  const getDiscountDisplay = (type, value) => {
   113	    switch (type) {
   114	      case 'percentage':
   115	        return `${value}% OFF`;
   116	      case 'fixed':
   117	      case 'price_off':
   118	        return `¥${value}`;
   119	      default:
   120	        return value;
   121	    }
   122	  };
   123	
   124	  const getCouponStatusClass = (status) => {
   125	    switch (status) {
   126	      case 'unused':
   127	        return 'status-available';
   128	      case 'used':
   129	        return 'status-used';
   130	      case 'expired':
   131	        return 'status-expired';
   132	      default:
   133	        return '';
   134	    }
   135	  };
   136	
   137	  if (loading) {
   138	    return (
   139	      <div className="coupons-container">
   140	        <div className="loading">加载中...</div>
   141	      </div>
   142	    );
   143	  }
   144	
   145	  return (
   146	    <div className="coupons-container">
   147	      <div className="page-header">
   148	        <h1>我的折扣券</h1>
   149	        <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowClaimModal(true)}>
   150	          领取折扣券
   151	        </button>
   152	      </div>
   153	
   154	      {/* 邀请卡片 */}
   155	      <div className="invitation-card">
   156	        <div className="invitation-header">
   157	          <h2>邀请好友，赚取奖励</h2>
   158	          {!invitation && (
   159	            <button className="btn btn-success" onClick={generateInvitation}>
   160	              生成邀请码
   161	            </button>
   162	          )}
   163	        </div>
   164	
   165	        {invitation && (
   166	          <div className="invitation-content">
   167	            <div className="invitation-code-section">
   168	              <div className="code-display">
   169	                <span className="label">我的邀请码：</span>
   170	                <span className="code">{invitation.invitation_code}</span>
   171	                <button
   172	                  className="btn-copy"
   173	                  onClick={copyInvitationCode}
   174	                >
   175	                  {invitationCopied ? '已复制' : '复制'}
   176	                </button>
   177	              </div>
   178	              <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={copyInvitationUrl}>
   179	                复制邀请链接
   180	              </button>
   181	            </div>
   182	
   183	            {statistics && (
   184	              <div className="invitation-stats">
   185	                <div className="stat-item">
   186	                  <div className="stat-value">{statistics.invitation?.total_invites || 0}</div>
   187	                  <div className="stat-label">总邀请数</div>
   188	                </div>
   189	                <div className="stat-item">
   190	                  <div className="stat-value">{statistics.invitation?.successful_invites || 0}</div>
   191	                  <div className="stat-label">成功注册</div>
   192	                </div>
   193	                <div className="stat-item">
   194	                  <div className="stat-value">{statistics.invitation?.paid_invites || 0}</div>
   195	                  <div className="stat-label">付费用户</div>
   196	                </div>
   197	              </div>
   198	            )}
   199	          </div>
   200	        )}
   201	      </div>
   202	
   203	      {/* 折扣券标签页 */}
   204	      <div className="tabs">
   205	        <button
   206	          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'available' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   207	          onClick={() => setActiveTab('available')}
   208	        >
   209	          可用 ({coupons.filter(c => c.status === 'unused').length})
   210	        </button>
   211	        <button
   212	          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'used' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   213	          onClick={() => setActiveTab('used')}
   214	        >
   215	          已使用
   216	        </button>
   217	        <button
   218	          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'expired' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   219	          onClick={() => setActiveTab('expired')}
   220	        >
   221	          已过期
   222	        </button>
   223	      </div>
   224	
   225	      {/* 折扣券列表 */}
   226	      <div className="coupons-grid">
   227	        {coupons.length === 0 ? (
   228	          <div className="empty-state">
   229	            <p>暂无{activeTab === 'available' ? '可用' : activeTab === 'used' ? '已使用' : '已过期'}的折扣券</p>
   230	          </div>
   231	        ) : (
   232	          coupons.map(coupon => (
   233	            <div key={coupon.id} className={`coupon-card ${getCouponStatusClass(coupon.status)}`}>
   234	              <div className="coupon-header">
   235	                <div className="discount">
   236	                  {getDiscountDisplay(coupon.discount_type, coupon.discount_value)}
   237	                </div>
   238	                <div className="coupon-code">{coupon.coupon_code}</div>
   239	              </div>
   240	              <div className="coupon-body">
   241	                <div className="coupon-name">{coupon.template?.name || '优惠券'}</div>
   242	                <div className="coupon-desc">{coupon.template?.description || ''}</div>
   243	                <div className="coupon-conditions">
   244	                  {coupon.min_purchase_amount > 0 && (
   245	                    <span>满¥{coupon.min_purchase_amount}可用</span>
   246	                  )}
   247	                </div>
   248	                <div className="coupon-validity">
   249	                  有效期：{formatDate(coupon.valid_from)} - {formatDate(coupon.valid_until)}
   250	                </div>
   251	              </div>
   252	              {coupon.status === 'unused' && (
   253	                <div className="coupon-footer">
   254	                  <button
   255	                    className="btn btn-use"
   256	                    onClick={() => navigate('/subscription-plans')}
   257	                  >
   258	                    立即使用
   259	                  </button>
   260	                </div>
   261	              )}
   262	              {coupon.status === 'used' && coupon.used_at && (
   263	                <div className="coupon-footer">
   264	                  <span className="used-info">已于 {formatDate(coupon.used_at)} 使用</span>
   265	                </div>
   266	              )}
   267	            </div>
   268	          ))
   269	        )}
   270	      </div>
   271	
   272	      {/* 领取折扣券弹窗 */}
   273	      {showClaimModal && (
   274	        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowClaimModal(false)}>
   275	          <div className="modal-content" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
   276	            <div className="modal-header">
   277	              <h3>领取折扣券</h3>
   278	              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowClaimModal(false)}>×</button>
   279	            </div>
   280	            <div className="modal-body">
   281	              <div className="form-group">
   282	                <label>折扣券代码</label>
   283	                <input
   284	                  type="text"
   285	                  value={claimCode}
   286	                  onChange={e => setClaimCode(e.target.value)}
   287	                  placeholder="请输入折扣券代码"
   288	                  onCompositionStart={() => setIsComposing(true)}
   289	                  onCompositionEnd={() => setIsComposing(false)}
   290	                  onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && !isComposing && claimCoupon()}
   291	                />
   292	              </div>
   293	            </div>
   294	            <div className="modal-footer">
   295	              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowClaimModal(false)}>
   296	                取消
   297	              </button>
   298	              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={claimCoupon}>
   299	                领取
   300	              </button>
   301	            </div>
   302	          </div>
   303	        </div>
   304	      )}
   305	    </div>
   306	  );
   307	};
   308	
   309	export default MyCoupons;

     1	/**

     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import api, { orderAPI, paymentAPI } from '../services/api';
    13	import { useToast } from '../components/ToastContainer';
    14	import './OrderConfirmation.css';
    15	
    16	const OrderConfirmation = () => {
    17	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    18	  const location = useLocation();
    19	  const { showError } = useToast();
    20	
    21	  const [order, setOrder] = useState(null);
    22	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    23	  const [paymentLoading, setPaymentLoading] = useState(false);
    24	  const [selectedPaymentMethod, setSelectedPaymentMethod] = useState('alipay');
    25	  const [isDevMode, setIsDevMode] = useState(false);
    26	  const [isPolling, setIsPolling] = useState(false);
    27	  const [pollingCount, setPollingCount] = useState(0);
    28	
    29	  // 折扣券相关状态
    30	  const [availableCoupons, setAvailableCoupons] = useState([]);
    31	  const [selectedCoupon, setSelectedCoupon] = useState(null);
    32	  const [showCouponModal, setShowCouponModal] = useState(false);
    33	  const [discountPreview, setDiscountPreview] = useState(null);
    34	
    35	  // 微信支付相关状态
    36	  const [showWeChatQRModal, setShowWeChatQRModal] = useState(false);
    37	  const [wechatQRCodeURL, setWechatQRCodeURL] = useState('');
    38	  const [wechatPaymentPolling, setWechatPaymentPolling] = useState(false);
    39	
    40	  useEffect(() => {
    41	    // Check if in development mode (localhost or dev environment)
    42	    const isDev = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1';
    43	    setIsDevMode(isDev);
    44	
    45	    // Check if we have plan details (new flow - order not created yet)
    46	    const { planCode, billingCycle } = location.state || {};
    47	
    48	    if (planCode && billingCycle) {
    49	      // New flow: order not created yet, fetch plan details and show preview
    50	      fetchPlanDetails(planCode, billingCycle);
    51	      return;
    52	    }
    53	
    54	    // Old flow: order already created (for backward compatibility or payment callback)
    55	    const orderNo = location.state?.orderNo || new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('orderNo');
    56	    if (orderNo) {
    57	      fetchOrderDetails(orderNo);
    58	      fetchAvailableCoupons(orderNo);
    59	      return;
    60	    }
    61	
    62	    // No valid state
    63	    showError('订单信息不存在,请重新下单');
    64	    navigate('/pricing');
    65	  }, [location.state, location.search]);
    66	
    67	  // 获取可用折扣券
    68	  const fetchAvailableCoupons = async (orderNo) => {
    69	    try {
    70	      // 先获取订单详情以获取订单金额
    71	      const orderResponse = await orderAPI.getOrderDetail(orderNo);
    72	      if (orderResponse.data.code === 0 && orderResponse.data.data) {
    73	        const orderAmount = orderResponse.data.data.amount;
    74	
    75	        // 获取可用的折扣券
    76	        const couponsResponse = await api.get(`/user/coupons/available?amount=${orderAmount}`);
    77	        if (couponsResponse.data.code === 0) {
    78	          setAvailableCoupons(couponsResponse.data.data || []);
    79	        }
    80	      }
    81	    } catch (error) {
    82	      console.error('Failed to fetch available coupons:', error);
    83	    }
    84	  };
    85	
    86	  // Polling effect - check order status periodically after payment redirect
    87	  useEffect(() => {
    88	    if (!order || order.status !== 'pending') {
    89	      return;
    90	    }
    91	
    92	    // Start polling if we came from payment (URL has orderNo parameter)
    93	    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    94	    const orderNoFromURL = searchParams.get('orderNo');
    95	
    96	    if (orderNoFromURL && !isPolling) {
    97	      setIsPolling(true);
    98	      console.log('[Payment Polling] Starting payment status polling...');
    99	    }
   100	
   101	    if (!isPolling) {
   102	      return;
   103	    }
   104	
   105	    // Maximum polling duration: 60 seconds (30 attempts × 2 seconds)
   106	    if (pollingCount >= 30) {
   107	      console.log('[Payment Polling] Polling timeout, stopping');
   108	      setIsPolling(false);
   109	      return;
   110	    }
   111	
   112	    // Poll every 2 seconds
   113	    const pollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   114	      console.log(`[Payment Polling] Checking order status (attempt ${pollingCount + 1}/30)...`);
   115	      fetchOrderDetails(order.order_no, true);
   116	      setPollingCount(prev => prev + 1);
   117	    }, 2000);
   118	
   119	    return () => clearTimeout(pollTimer);
   120	  }, [order, isPolling, pollingCount, location.search]);
   121	
   122	  // Fetch plan details and create a preview order object (order not created on backend yet)
   123	  const fetchPlanDetails = async (planCode, billingCycle) => {
   124	    try {
   125	      const response = await api.get(`/user/subscription/plans/${planCode}`);
   126	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   127	        const plan = response.data.data;
   128	        const amount = billingCycle === 'monthly' ? plan.current_price_monthly : plan.current_price_yearly;
   129	
   130	        // Create a preview order object (not saved to backend yet)
   131	        const previewOrder = {
   132	          plan_code: plan.plan_code,
   133	          plan_name: plan.plan_name,
   134	          billing_cycle: billingCycle,
   135	          amount: amount,
   136	          final_amount: amount, // Will be updated when coupon is selected
   137	          discount_amount: 0,
   138	          coupon_id: null,
   139	          status: 'preview', // Special status to indicate this is a preview
   140	          order_no: null, // Will be generated on payment
   141	          created_at: new Date().toISOString(), // Add current time for preview
   142	        };
   143	
   144	        setOrder(previewOrder);
   145	
   146	        // Fetch available coupons
   147	        const couponsResponse = await api.get(`/user/coupons/available?amount=${amount}`);
   148	        if (couponsResponse.data.code === 0 && couponsResponse.data.data) {
   149	          setAvailableCoupons(couponsResponse.data.data || []);
   150	        }
   151	      }
   152	      setLoading(false);
   153	    } catch (error) {
   154	      showError('获取套餐信息失败,请重试');
   155	      console.error('Failed to fetch plan details:', error);
   156	      setLoading(false);
   157	      navigate('/pricing');
   158	    }
   159	  };
   160	
   161	  const fetchOrderDetails = async (orderNo, isPollingRequest = false) => {
   162	    try {
   163	      const response = await orderAPI.getOrderDetail(orderNo);
   164	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   165	        const newOrder = response.data.data;
   166	        const previousStatus = order?.status;
   167	        setOrder(newOrder);
   168	
   169	        console.log(`[Order Status] Current: ${newOrder.status}, Previous: ${previousStatus}, IsPolling: ${isPollingRequest}`);
   170	
   171	        // If polling and order status changed to paid, stop polling and show success
   172	        if (isPollingRequest && newOrder.status === 'paid') {
   173	          console.log('[Payment Polling] Payment confirmed! Status changed to paid');
   174	          setIsPolling(false);
   175	          setPollingCount(0);
   176	
   177	          // Show a brief success message before redirecting
   178	          console.log('[Payment Polling] Redirecting to subscription page in 2 seconds...');
   179	          setTimeout(() => {
   180	            console.log('[Payment Polling] Executing redirect now');
   181	            navigate('/settings?tab=subscription');
   182	          }, 2000);
   183	        }
   184	
   185	        // Also handle case where user refreshes a paid order page - auto redirect
   186	        if (!isPollingRequest && newOrder.status === 'paid' && !previousStatus) {
   187	          console.log('[Order] Detected paid order on initial load, redirecting in 3 seconds...');
   188	          setTimeout(() => {
   189	            console.log('[Order] Executing redirect for paid order');
   190	            navigate('/settings?tab=subscription');
   191	          }, 3000);
   192	        }
   193	      } else {
   194	        if (!isPollingRequest) {
   195	          showError('获取订单详情失败：' + (response.data.message || '未知错误'));
   196	          navigate('/settings');
   197	        }
   198	      }
   199	    } catch (error) {
   200	      if (!isPollingRequest) {
   201	        showError('获取订单详情失败,请重试');
   202	        console.error('Failed to fetch order details:', error);
   203	        navigate('/settings');
   204	      } else {
   205	        console.error('[Payment Polling] Failed to fetch order status:', error);
   206	      }
   207	    } finally {
   208	      if (!isPollingRequest) {
   209	        setLoading(false);
   210	      }
   211	    }
   212	  };
   213	
   214	  // 选择折扣券
   215	  const handleSelectCoupon = async (coupon) => {
   216	    if (!coupon || !order) return;
   217	
   218	    try {
   219	      // 计算折扣预览
   220	      const response = await api.get(`/user/coupons/calculate-discount?coupon_id=${coupon.id}&amount=${order.amount}`);
   221	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   222	        setSelectedCoupon(coupon);
   223	        setDiscountPreview(response.data.data);
   224	        setShowCouponModal(false);
   225	
   226	        // If order is in preview mode, update the preview order with discount information
   227	        if (order.status === 'preview') {
   228	          const discountData = response.data.data;
   229	          setOrder({
   230	            ...order,
   231	            coupon_id: coupon.id,
   232	            discount_amount: discountData.discount_amount,
   233	            final_amount: discountData.final_amount,
   234	          });
   235	        }
   236	      }
   237	    } catch (error) {
   238	      showError('计算折扣失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   239	    }
   240	  };
   241	
   242	  // 取消选择折扣券
   243	  const handleRemoveCoupon = () => {
   244	    setSelectedCoupon(null);
   245	    setDiscountPreview(null);
   246	
   247	    // If order is in preview mode, reset the discount information
   248	    if (order && order.status === 'preview') {
   249	      setOrder({
   250	        ...order,
   251	        coupon_id: null,
   252	        discount_amount: 0,
   253	        final_amount: order.amount,
   254	      });
   255	    }
   256	  };
   257	
   258	  // 获取最终支付金额
   259	  const getFinalAmount = () => {
   260	    if (discountPreview) {
   261	      return discountPreview.final_amount;
   262	    }
   263	    return order.amount;
   264	  };
   265	
   266	  const handlePayment = async () => {
   267	    if (!order) return;
   268	
   269	    setPaymentLoading(true);
   270	
   271	    // If order is in preview status, create the order first
   272	    let actualOrder = order;
   273	    if (order.status === 'preview') {
   274	      try {
   275	        console.log('[Order Creation] Creating order with coupon:', selectedCoupon?.id);
   276	        const createOrderResponse = await orderAPI.createOrder(
   277	          order.plan_code,
   278	          order.billing_cycle,
   279	          selectedCoupon?.id // Pass coupon_id if selected
   280	        );
   281	
   282	        if (createOrderResponse.data.code !== 0 || !createOrderResponse.data.data) {
   283	          showError('创建订单失败：' + (createOrderResponse.data.message || '未知错误'));
   284	          setPaymentLoading(false);
   285	          return;
   286	        }
   287	
   288	        actualOrder = createOrderResponse.data.data;
   289	        setOrder(actualOrder);
   290	        console.log('[Order Creation] Order created successfully:', actualOrder.order_no);
   291	      } catch (error) {
   292	        showError('创建订单失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   293	        setPaymentLoading(false);
   294	        return;
   295	      }
   296	    }
   297	
   298	    try {
   299	      // Use the final_amount from the order (backend has already calculated discount)
   300	      const finalAmount = actualOrder.final_amount;
   301	
   302	      if (selectedPaymentMethod === 'simulate') {
   303	        // Simulate payment for development
   304	        const response = await api.post('/user/payment/simulate', {
   305	          order_no: actualOrder.order_no,
   306	          amount: finalAmount
   307	        });
   308	
   309	        if (response.data.code === 0) {
   310	          // Payment simulated successfully, start polling
   311	          setIsPolling(true);
   312	          console.log('[Simulate Payment] Payment simulated, starting polling...');
   313	        } else {
   314	          showError('模拟支付失败：' + (response.data.message || '未知错误'));
   315	          setPaymentLoading(false);
   316	        }
   317	      } else if (selectedPaymentMethod === 'alipay') {
   318	        // Create Alipay payment
   319	        // Return to order confirmation page with order number so user can see payment result
   320	        const returnURL = `${window.location.origin}/order-confirmation?orderNo=${actualOrder.order_no}`;
   321	        const subject = `Scholar ${actualOrder.plan_name} ${actualOrder.billing_cycle === 'monthly' ? '月付' : '年付'}订阅`;
   322	        const description = `订单号: ${actualOrder.order_no}`;
   323	
   324	        const paymentResponse = await paymentAPI.createAlipayPayment(
   325	          actualOrder.order_no,
   326	          subject,
   327	          finalAmount, // Use discounted amount if coupon applied
   328	          returnURL,
   329	          description
   330	        );
   331	
   332	        if (paymentResponse.data.code === 0 && paymentResponse.data.data) {
   333	          // Redirect to Alipay payment page
   334	          window.location.href = paymentResponse.data.data.payment_url;
   335	        } else {
   336	          showError('创建支付失败：' + (paymentResponse.data.message || '未知错误'));
   337	          setPaymentLoading(false);
   338	        }
   339	      } else if (selectedPaymentMethod === 'wechat') {
   340	        // Create WeChat Pay payment
   341	        const paymentResponse = await paymentAPI.createWeChatPayment(
   342	          actualOrder.order_no,
   343	          finalAmount // Use discounted amount if coupon applied
   344	        );
   345	
   346	        if (paymentResponse.data.code === 0 && paymentResponse.data.data) {
   347	          // Show QR code modal for user to scan
   348	          setWechatQRCodeURL(paymentResponse.data.data.code_url);
   349	          setShowWeChatQRModal(true);
   350	          setPaymentLoading(false);
   351	          // Start polling for payment status
   352	          startWeChatPaymentPolling(actualOrder.order_no);
   353	        } else {
   354	          showError('创建微信支付失败：' + (paymentResponse.data.message || '未知错误'));
   355	          setPaymentLoading(false);
   356	        }
   357	      }
   358	    } catch (error) {
   359	      showError('支付失败,请稍后重试');
   360	      console.error('Payment failed:', error);
   361	      setPaymentLoading(false);
   362	    }
   363	  };
   364	
   365	  // WeChat Pay polling function
   366	  const startWeChatPaymentPolling = (orderNo) => {
   367	    setWechatPaymentPolling(true);
   368	    let attempts = 0;
   369	    const maxAttempts = 60; // 60 attempts × 3 seconds = 3 minutes
   370	
   371	    const pollingInterval = setInterval(async () => {
   372	      attempts++;
   373	      console.log(`[WeChat Pay Polling] Checking payment status (attempt ${attempts}/${maxAttempts})...`);
   374	
   375	      try {
   376	        const response = await orderAPI.getOrderDetail(orderNo);
   377	        if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   378	          const orderData = response.data.data;
   379	
   380	          if (orderData.status === 'paid') {
   381	            console.log('[WeChat Pay Polling] Payment successful!');
   382	            clearInterval(pollingInterval);
   383	            setWechatPaymentPolling(false);
   384	            setShowWeChatQRModal(false);
   385	            setOrder(orderData);
   386	            // Will trigger the success UI update through order state change
   387	          } else if (orderData.status === 'cancelled' || orderData.status === 'failed') {
   388	            console.log(`[WeChat Pay Polling] Payment ${orderData.status}`);
   389	            clearInterval(pollingInterval);
   390	            setWechatPaymentPolling(false);
   391	            setShowWeChatQRModal(false);
   392	            showError('支付已取消或失败');
   393	          }
   394	        }
   395	      } catch (error) {
   396	        console.error('[WeChat Pay Polling] Error checking payment status:', error);
   397	      }
   398	
   399	      // Stop polling after max attempts
   400	      if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
   401	        console.log('[WeChat Pay Polling] Polling timeout, stopping');
   402	        clearInterval(pollingInterval);
   403	        setWechatPaymentPolling(false);
   404	        showError('支付超时,请检查支付状态或重试');
   405	      }
   406	    }, 3000); // Poll every 3 seconds
   407	  };
   408	
   409	  const handleCancel = () => {
   410	    navigate('/settings');
   411	  };
   412	
   413	  if (loading) {
   414	    return (
   415	      <div className="order-confirmation-container">
   416	        <div className="loading">加载订单信息...</div>
   417	      </div>

   472	          <h1>{order.status === 'paid' ? '支付成功' : order.status === 'cancelled' ? '订单已取消' : '订单确认'}</h1>
   473	          {order.status !== 'preview' && (
   474	            <span className={`status-badge ${order.status}`}>
   475	              {order.status === 'pending' ? '待支付' :
   476	               order.status === 'paid' ? '已支付' :

   499

   501	        <div className="order-content">

   541	              <div className="amount-row">

   547	              <div className="coupon-selection">
   548	                {selectedCoupon ? (

   553	                    </div>

   555	                  </div>

   566	                      </>
   567	                    ) : (

   569	                    )}

   572	              </div>

   575	              <div className="amount-row total">
   576	                <span className="amount-label">实付金额</span>
   577	                <span className="amount-value amount-final">¥{getFinalAmount().toFixed(2)}</span>
   578	              </div>
   579	            </div>
   580	
   581	            {/* Payment Method */}
   582	            <div className="payment-method-section">
   583	              <h3>支付方式</h3>
   584	              <div className="payment-methods">
   585	                <div
   586	                  className={`payment-method-item ${selectedPaymentMethod === 'alipay' ? 'selected' : ''}`}
   587	                  onClick={() => setSelectedPaymentMethod('alipay')}
   588	                >
   589	                  <div className="payment-icon">
   590	                    <img
   591	                      src="/支付宝logo.png"
   592	                      alt="支付宝"
   593	                      style={{width: '32px', height: '32px', borderRadius: '6px'}}
   594	                    />
   595	                  </div>
   596	                  <div className="payment-method-info">
   597	                    <div className="payment-name">支付宝</div>
   598	                  </div>
   599	                  {selectedPaymentMethod === 'alipay' && (
   600	                    <div className="payment-check">✓</div>
   601	                  )}
   602	                </div>
   603	
   604	                {/* 暂时注释掉手动支付 */}
   605	                {/* {isDevMode && (
