     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
    11	import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import api, { publicScholarAPI } from '../services/api';
    13	import SEO from '../components/SEO';
    14	import FloatingGuide from '../components/FloatingGuide';
    15	import { generateScholarlyArticleSchema, generateBreadcrumbSchema, truncateText } from '../utils/seoHelpers';
    16	import './PaperDetailPage.css';
    17	
    18	const PaperDetailPage = () => {
    19	  const { paperId } = useParams();
    20	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    21	  const [paper, setPaper] = useState(null);
    22	  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
    23	  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
    24	  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    25	  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('citations'); // 'citations' or 'references'
    26	  const [showCiteModal, setShowCiteModal] = useState(false);
    27	  const [citationFormat, setCitationFormat] = useState('bibtex'); // 'bibtex', 'mla', 'apa', 'chicago'
    28	  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
    29	  const [copiedDoi, setCopiedDoi] = useState(false);
    30	  const [copiedCorpusId, setCopiedCorpusId] = useState(false);
    31	  
    32	  // 搜索结果相关状态
    33	  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState([]);
    34	  const [searchTotal, setSearchTotal] = useState(0); // 搜索结果总数
    35	  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
    36	  const [searchError, setSearchError] = useState(null);
    37	  const [hasSearched, setHasSearched] = useState(false);
    38	
    39	  // 相似论文弹窗状态
    40	  const [showSimilarPopup, setShowSimilarPopup] = useState(false);
    41	  const [similarPapers, setSimilarPapers] = useState([]);
    42	  const [similarPapersLoading, setSimilarPapersLoading] = useState(false);
    43	  const [similarPapersLoaded, setSimilarPapersLoaded] = useState(false);
    44	  const isHoveringTitleRef = useRef(false); // 使用 ref 来跟踪 hover 状态，避免闭包问题
    45	
    46	  // 构建 Semantic Scholar 的 URL
    47	  const semanticScholarUrl = `https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/${paperId}`;
    48	
    49	  useEffect(() => {
    50	    // 从公开API获取论文详情(无需认证)
    51	    const fetchPaperDetails = async () => {
    52	      try {
    53	        setIsLoading(true);
    54	        const response = await api.get(`/public/papers/${paperId}`, {
    55	          params: {
    56	            fields: 'paperId,title,abstract,authors,year,citationCount,referenceCount,venue,publicationDate,publicationTypes,fieldsOfStudy,s2FieldsOfStudy,externalIds,url,openAccessPdf,influentialCitationCount,isOpenAccess,tldr,journal,citations.paperId,citations.externalIds,citations.url,citations.title,citations.abstract,citations.venue,citations.publicationVenue,citations.year,citations.referenceCount,citations.citationCount,citations.influentialCitationCount,citations.openAccessPdf,citations.s2FieldsOfStudy,citations.publicationTypes,citations.publicationDate,citations.journal,citations.citationStyles,citations.authors,references.paperId,references.externalIds,references.url,references.title,references.abstract,references.venue,references.publicationVenue,references.year,references.referenceCount,references.citationCount,references.influentialCitationCount,references.openAccessPdf,references.s2FieldsOfStudy,references.publicationTypes,references.publicationDate,references.journal,references.citationStyles,references.authors'
    57	          }
    58	        });
    59	        // API返回格式: { code: 0, message: "success", data: {...} }
    60	        setPaper(response.data.data);
    61	        setError(null);
    62	      } catch (err) {
    63	        console.error('Failed to fetch paper details:', err);
    64	        setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to load paper details');
    65	      } finally {
    66	        setIsLoading(false);
    67	      }
    68	    };
    69	
    70	    if (paperId) {
    71	      fetchPaperDetails();
    72	    }
    73	  }, [paperId]);
    74	
    75	  // 预加载相似论文数据（单独的 useEffect，在 paperId 变化时触发）
    76	  useEffect(() => {
    77	    const prefetchSimilarPapers = async () => {
    78	      console.log('[Prefetch] Starting to prefetch similar papers for paperId:', paperId);
    79	      setSimilarPapersLoading(true);
    80	      setSimilarPapersLoaded(false);
    81	      setSimilarPapers([]);
    82	      
    83	      try {
    84	        // 获取推荐论文列表
    85	        const recResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getRecommendations(paperId, 5);
    86	        const recommendedPapers = recResponse.data?.data?.recommendedPapers || recResponse.data?.recommendedPapers || [];
    87	        
    88	        if (recommendedPapers.length === 0) {
    89	          console.log('[Prefetch] No recommended papers found');
    90	          setSimilarPapers([]);
    91	          setSimilarPapersLoaded(true);
    92	          setSimilarPapersLoading(false);
    93	          return;
    94	        }
    95	        
    96	        // 提取论文ID列表 - 只取第一个
    97	        const paperIds = recommendedPapers.map(p => p.paperId).filter(id => id).slice(0, 1);
    98	        
    99	        // 通过batch接口获取详细信息
   100	        const batchResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getPaperBatch(
   101	          paperIds,
   102	          ['paperId', 'title', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'venue']
   103	        );
   104	        
   105	        const papers = batchResponse.data?.data || batchResponse.data || [];
   106	        console.log('[Prefetch] Similar papers loaded:', papers.length);
   107	        setSimilarPapers(papers);
   108	        setSimilarPapersLoaded(true);
   109	      } catch (err) {
   110	        console.error('[Prefetch] Failed to prefetch similar papers:', err);
   111	        setSimilarPapers([]);
   112	        setSimilarPapersLoaded(true);
   113	      } finally {
   114	        setSimilarPapersLoading(false);
   115	      }
   116	    };
   117	
   118	    if (paperId) {
   119	      prefetchSimilarPapers();
   120	    }
   121	  }, [paperId]);
   122	
   123	  const handleLogoClick = () => {
   124	    navigate('/');
   125	  };
   126	
   127	  const handleSearch = async (e) => {
   128	    e.preventDefault();
   129	    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
   130	    
   131	    setIsSearching(true);
   132	    setSearchError(null);
   133	    setHasSearched(true);
   134	    
   135	    try {
   136	      const response = await publicScholarAPI.searchPapers({
   137	        query: searchQuery.trim(),
   138	        limit: 10, // 最多获取10篇
   139	        fields: ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'venue', 'citationCount', 'openAccessPdf', 's2FieldsOfStudy', 'tldr']
   140	      });
   141	      
   142	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   143	        const results = response.data.data.data?.data || [];
   144	        const total = response.data.data.data?.total || results.length;
   145	        setSearchResults(results);
   146	        setSearchTotal(total);
   147	      } else {
   148	        setSearchResults([]);
   149	        setSearchTotal(0);
   150	      }
   151	    } catch (err) {
   152	      console.error('Search failed:', err);
   153	      setSearchError('搜索失败，请稍后重试');
   154	      setSearchResults([]);
   155	      setSearchTotal(0);
   156	    } finally {
   157	      setIsSearching(false);
   158	    }
   159	  };
   160	  
   161	  // 清除搜索结果
   162	  const clearSearchResults = () => {
   163	    setSearchResults([]);
   164	    setHasSearched(false);
   165	    setSearchQuery('');
   166	  };
   167	  
   168	  // 跳转到学术检索页面进行完整搜索
   169	  const goToHomeSearch = () => {
   170	    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
   171	      navigate(`/search-results?query=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery.trim())}`);
   172	    } else {
   173	      navigate('/search-results');
   174	    }
   175	  };
   176	
   177	  const handleSignIn = () => {
   178	    navigate('/');
   179	  };
   180	
   181	  const handleSignUp = () => {
   182	    navigate('/');
   183	  };
   184	
   185	  // 处理标题hover
   186	  const handleTitleMouseEnter = () => {
   187	    console.log('[Hover] Mouse enter title, similarPapersLoaded:', similarPapersLoaded, 'similarPapersLoading:', similarPapersLoading, 'similarPapers:', similarPapers.length);
   188	    isHoveringTitleRef.current = true;
   189	    // 立即显示弹窗（数据通常已预加载完成，如果还在加载则显示loading状态）
   190	    setShowSimilarPopup(true);
   191	  };
   192	
   193	  const handleTitleMouseLeave = () => {
   194	    console.log('[Hover] Mouse leave title');
   195	    isHoveringTitleRef.current = false;
   196	    setShowSimilarPopup(false);
   197	  };
   198	
   199	  // 点击推荐论文 - 跳转到搜索结果页
   200	  const handleSimilarPaperClick = (similarPaperId) => {
   201	    navigate(`/search-results?query=&paperId=${similarPaperId}`);
   202	  };
   203	
   204	  // 查看更多相似论文
   205	  const handleViewMoreSimilar = () => {
   206	    navigate(`/search-results?query=&paperId=${paperId}`);
   207	  };
   208	
   209	  // 点击作者 - 跳转到作者页面
   210	  const handleAuthorClick = (authorId, e) => {
   211	    e.preventDefault();
   212	    e.stopPropagation();
   213	    if (authorId) {
   214	      navigate(`/search-results?query=&authorId=${authorId}`);
   215	    }
   216	  };
   217	
   218	  // 生成引用格式
   219	  const generateCitation = (format) => {
   220	    if (!paper) return '';
   221	
   222	    const authors = paper.authors || [];
   223	    const title = paper.title || 'Untitled';
   224	    const year = paper.year || 'n.d.';
   225	    const venue = paper.venue || '';
   226	    const corpusId = paper.paperId || '';
   227	
   228	    // 获取期刊信息
   229	    const journal = paper.journal || {};
   230	    const volume = journal.volume || '';
   231	    const pages = journal.pages || '';
   232	
   233	    switch (format) {
   234	      case 'bibtex':
   235	        const firstAuthor = authors[0]?.name || 'Unknown';
   236	        const lastName = firstAuthor.split(' ').pop();
   237	
   238	        const stopWords = ['of', 'the', 'in', 'for', 'and', 'a', 'an', 'to', 'on'];
   239	        const titleWords = title.split(' ').filter(w =>
   240	          w.length > 2 && !stopWords.includes(w.toLowerCase())
   241	        );
   242	
   243	        const firstTitleWord = titleWords[0]?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '') || 'Paper';
   244	        const secondTitleWord = titleWords[1]?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '') || '';
   245	        const secondWordInitials = secondTitleWord.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
   246	
   247	        const bibtexKey = `${lastName}${year}${firstTitleWord}${secondWordInitials}`;
   248	
   249	        let bibtex = `@article{${bibtexKey},\n  title={${title}},\n  author={${authors.map(a => a.name).join(' and ')}}`;
   250	        if (venue) bibtex += `,\n  journal={${venue}}`;
   251	        if (year) bibtex += `,\n  year={${year}}`;
   252	        if (volume) bibtex += `,\n  volume={${volume}}`;
   253	        if (pages) bibtex += `,\n  pages={${pages}}`;
   254	        bibtex += `,\n  url={https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:${corpusId}}\n}`;
   255	        return bibtex;
   256	
   257	      case 'mla':
   258	        // MLA: 第一作者 姓, 名，超过3人用 et al.
   259	        // MLA格式：期刊名斜体
   260	        let mlaAuthorStr = '';
   261	        if (authors.length > 0) {
   262	          const firstAuthorParts = authors[0].name.split(' ');
   263	          const firstAuthorFormatted = firstAuthorParts.length > 1
   264	            ? `${firstAuthorParts[firstAuthorParts.length - 1]}, ${firstAuthorParts.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}`
   265	            : authors[0].name;
   266	          
   267	          if (authors.length === 1) {
   268	            mlaAuthorStr = firstAuthorFormatted;
   269	          } else if (authors.length === 2) {
   270	            mlaAuthorStr = `${firstAuthorFormatted}, and ${authors[1].name}`;
   271	          } else {
   272	            // 3人及以上使用 et al.
   273	            mlaAuthorStr = `${firstAuthorFormatted} et al.`;
   274	          }
   275	        } else {
   276	          mlaAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
   277	        }
   278	
   279	        let mla = `${mlaAuthorStr}. "${title}."`;
   280	        if (venue) mla += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
   281	        if (volume) mla += ` ${volume}`;
   282	        if (year && pages) mla += ` (${year}): ${pages}`;
   283	        else if (year) mla += ` (${year})`;
   284	        else if (pages) mla += `: ${pages}`;
   285	        mla += '.';
   286	        return mla;
   287	
   288	      case 'apa':
   289	        // APA: 姓, 名首字母., 最后一个作者用 & 连接
   290	        // APA格式：期刊名和卷号斜体
   291	        let apaAuthorStr = '';
   292	        if (authors.length > 0) {
   293	          const apaFormatted = authors.map(a => {
   294	            const nameParts = a.name.split(' ');
   295	            if (nameParts.length > 1) {
   296	              const initials = nameParts.slice(0, -1).map(n => n[0] + '.').join(' ');
   297	              return `${nameParts[nameParts.length - 1]}, ${initials}`;
   298	            }
   299	            return a.name;
   300	          });
   301	          
   302	          if (apaFormatted.length === 1) {
   303	            apaAuthorStr = apaFormatted[0];
   304	          } else if (apaFormatted.length === 2) {
   305	            apaAuthorStr = `${apaFormatted[0]}, & ${apaFormatted[1]}`;
   306	          } else {
   307	            apaAuthorStr = `${apaFormatted.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}, & ${apaFormatted[apaFormatted.length - 1]}`;
   308	          }
   309	        } else {
   310	          apaAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
   311	        }
   312	
   313	        let apa = `${apaAuthorStr} (${year}). ${title}.`;
   314	        if (venue && volume) apa += ` <i>${venue}, ${volume}</i>`;
   315	        else if (venue) apa += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
   316	        else if (volume) apa += ` <i>${volume}</i>`;
   317	        if (pages) apa += `, ${pages}`;
   318	        apa += '.';
   319	        return apa;
   320	
   321	      case 'chicago':
   322	        // Chicago: 所有作者都是 姓, 名 格式，最后用 and 连接
   323	        // Chicago格式：期刊名斜体
   324	        let chicagoAuthorStr = '';
   325	        if (authors.length > 0) {
   326	          const chicagoFormatted = authors.map(a => {
   327	            const nameParts = a.name.split(' ');
   328	            if (nameParts.length > 1) {
   329	              // 所有作者都是：姓, 名
   330	              return `${nameParts[nameParts.length - 1]}, ${nameParts.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}`;
   331	            }
   332	            return a.name;
   333	          });
   334	          if (chicagoFormatted.length === 1) {
   335	            chicagoAuthorStr = chicagoFormatted[0];
   336	          } else if (chicagoFormatted.length === 2) {
   337	            chicagoAuthorStr = `${chicagoFormatted[0]}, and ${chicagoFormatted[1]}`;
   338	          } else {
   339	            chicagoAuthorStr = `${chicagoFormatted.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}, and ${chicagoFormatted[chicagoFormatted.length - 1]}`;
   340	          }
   341	        } else {
   342	          chicagoAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
   343	        }
   344	
   345	        let chicago = `${chicagoAuthorStr}. "${title}."`;
   346	        if (venue) chicago += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
   347	        if (volume) chicago += ` ${volume}`;
   348	        if (year && pages) chicago += ` (${year}): ${pages}`;
   349	        else if (year) chicago += ` (${year})`;
   350	        else if (pages) chicago += `: ${pages}`;
   351	        chicago += '.';
   352	        return chicago;
   353	
   354	      default:
   355	        return '';
   356	    }
   357	  };
   358	
   359	  const copyCitation = () => {
   360	    const citation = generateCitation(citationFormat);
   361	    // 去除 HTML 标签后复制
   362	    const plainCitation = citation.replace(/<\/?i>/g, '');
   363	    navigator.clipboard.writeText(plainCitation);
   364	    setCopied(true);
   365	    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000); // 2秒后恢复
   366	  };
   367	
   368	  // 复制 DOI
   369	  const copyDoi = (e) => {
   370	    e.stopPropagation();
   371	    if (paper?.externalIds?.DOI) {
   372	      navigator.clipboard.writeText(paper.externalIds.DOI);
   373	      setCopiedDoi(true);
   374	      setTimeout(() => setCopiedDoi(false), 2000);
   375	    }
   376	  };
   377	
   378	  // 复制 Corpus ID
   379	  const copyCorpusId = (e) => {
   380	    e.stopPropagation();
   381	    if (paper?.externalIds?.CorpusId) {
   382	      navigator.clipboard.writeText(paper.externalIds.CorpusId.toString());
   383	      setCopiedCorpusId(true);
   384	      setTimeout(() => setCopiedCorpusId(false), 2000);
   385	    }
   386	  };
   387	
   388	  if (isLoading) {
   389	    return (
   390	      <div className="pd-page">
   391	        <div className="pd-loading">
   392	          <div className="pd-loading-spinner"></div>
   393	          <p>Loading paper details...</p>
   394	        </div>
   395	      </div>
   396	    );
   397	  }
   398	
   399	  if (error || !paper) {
   400	    return (
   401	      <div className="pd-page">
   402	        <div className="pd-error">
   403	          <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
   404	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
   405	            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12" />
   406	            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16" />
   407	          </svg>
   408	          <h2>Failed to load</h2>
   409	          <p>{error || 'Paper not found'}</p>
   410	          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', marginTop: '1.5rem' }}>
   411	            <button onClick={handleLogoClick} className="pd-error-btn">
   412	              Back to Home
   413	            </button>
   414	            <button onClick={() => window.open(semanticScholarUrl, '_blank')} className="pd-error-btn secondary">
   415	              View on Semantic Scholar
   416	            </button>
   417	          </div>
   418	        </div>
   419	      </div>
   420	    );
   421	  }
   422	
   423	  // 生成SEO数据
   424	  const pageTitle = paper?.title
   425	    ? `${paper.title} - Scholay`
   426	    : 'Paper Details - Scholay';
   427	
   428	  const pageDescription = paper?.abstract
   429	    ? truncateText(paper.abstract, 160)
   430	    : `View details for this ${paper?.year || ''} academic paper by ${paper?.authors?.slice(0, 3).map(a => a.name).join(', ')} et al.`;
   431	
   432	  const breadcrumbData = [
   433	    { name: 'Home', url: '/' },
   434	    { name: 'Paper Details', url: `/paper/${paperId}` }
   435	  ];
   436	
   437	  return (
   438	    <div className="pd-page">
   439	      {/* 悬浮引导卡片 */}
   440	      <FloatingGuide />
   441	      
   442	      <SEO
   443	        title={pageTitle}
   444	        description={pageDescription}
   445	        keywords={`${paper?.title},${paper?.authors?.slice(0, 5).map(a => a.name).join(',')},${paper?.fieldsOfStudy?.join(',')}`}
   446	        canonical={`/paper/${paperId}`}
   447	        ogType="article"
   448	        structuredData={paper ? generateScholarlyArticleSchema(paper) : generateBreadcrumbSchema(breadcrumbData)}
   449	      />
   450	
   451	      {/* 顶部导航栏 - 带搜索框和登录/注册按钮 */}
   452	      <div className="pd-top-header">
   453	        {/* Logo */}
   454	        <div className="pd-header-left">
   455	          <div className="pd-header-logo" onClick={handleLogoClick}>
   456	            <img src="/logo.png" alt="Scholay" className="pd-logo-image" />
   457	            <span className="pd-logo-text">Scholay</span>
   458	          </div>
   459	          <div 
   460	            className="pd-new-feature-tag"
   461	            onClick={(e) => {
   462	              e.stopPropagation();
   463	              if (window.openFloatingGuide) {
   464	                window.openFloatingGuide();
   465	              }
   466	            }}
   467	          >
   468	            <span className="pd-new-badge">NEW</span>
   469	            <span className="pd-feature-text">AI Analysis</span>
   470	            <svg className="pd-feature-arrow" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   471	              <path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6"/>
   472	            </svg>
   473	          </div>
   474	        </div>
   475	
   476	        {/* 搜索框 - 居中 */}
   477	        <form className="pd-header-search-form" onSubmit={handleSearch}>
   478	          <div className="pd-search-input-wrapper">
   479	            <svg className="pd-search-icon" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   480	              <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
   481	              <path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"/>
   482	            </svg>
   483	            <input
   484	              type="text"
   485	              className="pd-search-input"
   486	              placeholder="Search papers..."
   487	              value={searchQuery}
   488	              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
   489	            />
   490	          </div>
   491	          <button type="submit" className="pd-search-submit-btn">
   492	            Search
   493	          </button>
   494	        </form>
   495	
   496	        {/* 右侧按钮 */}
   497	        <div className="pd-header-actions">
   498	          <button className="pd-header-btn pd-signin-btn" onClick={handleSignIn}>
   499	            Sign In
   500	          </button>
   501	          <button className="pd-header-btn pd-signup-btn" onClick={handleSignUp}>
   502	            Sign Up
   503	          </button>
   504	        </div>
   505	      </div>
   506	
   507	      {/* 主内容区域 */}
   508	      {hasSearched ? (
   509	        /* 搜索结果展示区域 - 替换原有内容 */
   510	        <div className="pd-search-results-section">
   511	          <div className="pd-search-results-container">
   512	            <div className="pd-search-results-header">
   513	              <h3 className="pd-search-results-title">
   514	                搜索结果: "{searchQuery}"
   515	                {searchTotal > 0 && <span className="pd-results-count">({searchTotal}篇)</span>}
   516	              </h3>
   517	              <button className="pd-back-to-paper-btn" onClick={clearSearchResults}>
   518	                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   519	                  <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
   520	                </svg>
   521	                返回论文详情
   522	              </button>
   523	            </div>
   524	            
   525	            {isSearching ? (
   526	              <div className="pd-search-loading">
   527	                <div className="pd-loading-spinner small"></div>
   528	                <span>正在搜索...</span>
   529	              </div>
   530	            ) : searchError ? (
   531	              <div className="pd-search-error-msg">{searchError}</div>
   532	            ) : searchResults.length === 0 ? (
   533	              <div className="pd-no-results">未找到相关论文</div>
   534	            ) : (
   535	              <div className="pd-search-results-list">
   536	                {/* 只展示前3篇结果 */}
   537	                {searchResults.slice(0, 3).map((result, index) => (
   538	                  <div 
   539	                    key={result.paperId || index} 
   540	                    className="pd-search-result-item"
   541	                  >
   542	                    <h4 className="pd-result-title">
   543	                      <a href={`/paper/${result.paperId}`} className="pd-result-link">
   544	                        {result.title || 'Untitled'}
   545	                      </a>
   546	                    </h4>
   547	                    
   548	                    <div className="pd-result-meta">
   549	                      {result.authors && result.authors.length > 0 && (
   550	                        <>
   551	                          {result.authors.slice(0, 3).map((author, i) => (
   552	                            <React.Fragment key={i}>
   553	                              <span className="pd-result-author">{author.name}</span>
   554	                              {i < Math.min(result.authors.length - 1, 2) && <span>, </span>}
   555	                            </React.Fragment>
   556	                          ))}
   557	                          {result.authors.length > 3 && <span> et al.</span>}
   558	                          {(result.venue || result.year) && <span className="pd-meta-dot"> · </span>}
   559	                        </>
   560	                      )}
   561	                      {result.venue && <span className="pd-result-venue">{result.venue}</span>}
   562	                      {result.venue && result.year && <span> </span>}
   563	                      {result.year && <span className="pd-result-year">{result.year}</span>}
   564	                      {result.citationCount > 0 && (
   565	                        <>
   566	                          <span className="pd-meta-dot"> · </span>
   567	                          <span className="pd-result-citations">{result.citationCount} citations</span>
   568	                        </>
   569	                      )}
   570	                    </div>
   571	                    
   572	                    {result.tldr?.text && (
   573	                      <p className="pd-result-tldr">{result.tldr.text}</p>
   574	                    )}
   575	                  </div>
   576	                ))}
   577	                
   578	                {/* 蒙版遮罩区域 - 当总结果超过3篇时显示 */}
   579	                {searchTotal > 3 && (
   580	                  <div className="pd-search-results-overlay-wrapper">
   581	                    {/* 模糊预览的后续结果 */}
   582	                    <div className="pd-blurred-results">
   583	                      {searchResults.slice(3, 6).map((result, index) => (
   584	                        <div key={result.paperId || index} className="pd-search-result-item blurred">
   585	                          <h4 className="pd-result-title">
   586	                            <span className="pd-result-link">{result.title || 'Untitled'}</span>
   587	                          </h4>
   588	                          <div className="pd-result-meta">
   589	                            {result.authors && result.authors.slice(0, 2).map((author, i) => (
   590	                              <React.Fragment key={i}>
   591	                                <span className="pd-result-author">{author.name}</span>
   592	                                {i < Math.min(result.authors.length - 1, 1) && <span>, </span>}
   593	                              </React.Fragment>
   594	                            ))}
   595	                            {result.year && <span> · {result.year}</span>}
   596	                          </div>
   597	                        </div>
   598	                      ))}
   599	                    </div>
   600	                    
   601	                    {/* 提示卡片 - 在蒙层顶部 */}
   602	                    <div className="pd-overlay-content">
   603	                      <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   604	                        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
   605	                        <path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"/>
   606	                      </svg>
   607	                      <p>更多搜索结果请前往首页查看</p>
   608	                      <button className="pd-go-home-btn" onClick={goToHomeSearch}>
   609	                        <span>前往首页搜索</span>
   610	                        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   611	                          <path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/>
   612	                        </svg>
   613	                      </button>
   614	                    </div>
   615	                  </div>
   616	                )}
   617	                
   618	                {/* 结果不足3篇但总数更多时的提示 */}
   619	                {searchResults.length <= 3 && searchTotal > searchResults.length && (
   620	                  <div className="pd-more-results-hint">
   621	                    <p>还有 {searchTotal - searchResults.length} 篇相关论文</p>
   622	                    <button className="pd-go-home-btn" onClick={goToHomeSearch}>
   623	                      <span>前往首页查看全部</span>
   624	                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   625	                        <path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/>
   626	                      </svg>
   627	                    </button>
   628	                  </div>
   629	                )}
   630	              </div>
   631	            )}
   632	          </div>
   633	        </div>
   634	      ) : (
   635	      <div className="pd-content-container">
   636	        {/* 左侧主要内容 */}
   637	        <div className="pd-main-column">
   638	          {/* 论文标题和元数据 */}
   639	          <div className="pd-header-section">
   640	            {/* DOI 和 Corpus ID (顶部显示) */}
   641	            <div className="pd-top-meta-info">
   642	              {paper.externalIds?.DOI && (
   643	                <span className="pd-top-meta-item pd-copyable">
   644	                  <span className="pd-meta-text">DOI: {paper.externalIds.DOI}</span>
   645	                  <button 
   646	                    className={`pd-copy-icon-btn ${copiedDoi ? 'copied' : ''}`}
   647	                    onClick={copyDoi}
   648	                    title={copiedDoi ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy DOI'}
   649	                  >
   650	                    {copiedDoi ? (
   651	                      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   652	                        <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline>
   653	                      </svg>
   654	                    ) : (
   655	                      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   656	                        <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
   657	                        <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path>
   658	                      </svg>
   659	                    )}
   660	                  </button>
   661	                </span>
   662	              )}
   663	              {paper.externalIds?.CorpusId && (
   664	                <>
   665	                  {paper.externalIds?.DOI && <span className="pd-meta-dot">•</span>}
   666	                  <span className="pd-top-meta-item pd-copyable">
   667	                    <span className="pd-meta-text">Corpus ID: {paper.externalIds.CorpusId}</span>
   668	                    <button 
   669	                      className={`pd-copy-icon-btn ${copiedCorpusId ? 'copied' : ''}`}
   670	                      onClick={copyCorpusId}
   671	                      title={copiedCorpusId ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy Corpus ID'}
   672	                    >
   673	                      {copiedCorpusId ? (
   674	                        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   675	                          <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline>
   676	                        </svg>
   677	                      ) : (
   678	                        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   679	                          <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
   680	                          <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path>
   681	                        </svg>
   682	                      )}
   683	                    </button>
   684	                  </span>
   685	                </>
   686	              )}
   687	            </div>
   688	
   689	            {/* 标题 - 带相似论文hover弹窗 */}
   690	            <div 
   691	              className="pd-title-wrapper"
   692	              onMouseEnter={handleTitleMouseEnter}
   693	              onMouseLeave={handleTitleMouseLeave}
   694	            >
   695	            <h1 className="pd-paper-title">{paper.title}</h1>
   696	              
   697	              {/* 相似论文弹窗 - hover后立即显示，内部处理loading状态 */}
   698	              {showSimilarPopup && (
   699	                <div className="pd-similar-popup">
   700	                  <div className="pd-similar-popup-header">
   701	                    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   702	                      <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"/>
   703	                      <path d="M8.59 13.51l6.83 3.98M15.41 6.51l-6.82 3.98"/>
   704	                    </svg>
   705	                    <span>Similar Paper</span>
   706	                  </div>
   707	                  <div className="pd-similar-popup-content">
   708	                    {/* Loading 状态 */}
   709	                    {similarPapersLoading && (
   710	                      <div className="pd-similar-loading">
   711	                        <div className="pd-similar-loading-spinner"></div>
   712	                        <span>Loading similar papers...</span>
   713	                      </div>
   714	                    )}
   715	                    {/* 无数据状态 */}
   716	                    {!similarPapersLoading && similarPapersLoaded && similarPapers.length === 0 && (
   717	                      <div className="pd-similar-empty">
   718	                        <span>No similar papers found</span>
   719	                      </div>
   720	                    )}
   721	                    {/* 有数据时显示第一个推荐论文 */}
   722	                    {!similarPapersLoading && similarPapers.length > 0 && (
   723	                      <>
   724	                        <div 
   725	                          className="pd-similar-item-single"
   726	                          onClick={() => handleSimilarPaperClick(similarPapers[0].paperId)}
   727	                        >
   728	                          <span className="pd-similar-title">{similarPapers[0].title}</span>
   729	                          <span className="pd-similar-meta">
   730	                            {similarPapers[0].authors?.[0]?.name && (
   731	                              <span>{similarPapers[0].authors[0].name}{similarPapers[0].authors.length > 1 ? ' et al.' : ''}</span>
   732	                            )}
   733	                            {similarPapers[0].year && <span> · {similarPapers[0].year}</span>}
   734	                            {similarPapers[0].citationCount !== undefined && <span> · {similarPapers[0].citationCount} citations</span>}
   735	                          </span>
   736	                        </div>
   737	                        {/* 查看更多按钮 */}
   738	                        <button 
   739	                          className="pd-similar-view-more"
   740	                          onClick={handleViewMoreSimilar}
   741	                        >
   742	                          <span>View more similar papers</span>
   743	                          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   744	                            <path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/>
   745	                          </svg>
   746	                        </button>
   747	                      </>
   748	                    )}
   749	                  </div>
   750	                </div>
   751	              )}
   752	            </div>
   753	
   754	            {/* 作者和出版信息 */}
   755	            <div className="pd-publication-meta">
   756	              {/* 作者列表 */}
   757	              {paper.authors && paper.authors.length > 0 && (
   758	                <>
   759	                  {paper.authors.map((author, index) => (
   760	                    <React.Fragment key={index}>
   761	                      {author.authorId ? (
   762	                        <span 
   763	                          className="pd-author-name pd-author-clickable"
   764	                          onClick={(e) => handleAuthorClick(author.authorId, e)}
   765	                          title={`查看 ${author.name} 的论文`}
   766	                        >
   767	                          {author.name}
   768	                        </span>
   769	                      ) : (
   770	                        <span className="pd-author-name">{author.name}</span>
   771	                      )}
   772	                      {index < paper.authors.length - 1 && <span className="pd-author-separator">, </span>}
   773	                    </React.Fragment>
   774	                  ))}
   775	                  {(paper.venue || paper.year || (paper.fieldsOfStudy && paper.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0)) && (
   776	                    <span className="pd-meta-dot"> · </span>
   777	                  )}
   778	                </>
   779	              )}
   780	
   781	              {/* Published in 信息 */}
   782	              {(paper.venue || paper.year) && (
   783	                <>
   784	                  <span className="pd-meta-text">Published in </span>
   785	                  {paper.venue && <span className="pd-meta-venue">{paper.venue}</span>}
   786	                  {paper.venue && paper.year && <span> </span>}
   787	                  {paper.year && <span className="pd-meta-year">{paper.year}</span>}
   788	                  {paper.fieldsOfStudy && paper.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0 && (
   789	                    <span className="pd-meta-dot"> · </span>
   790	                  )}
   791	                </>
   792	              )}
   793	
   794	              {/* 研究领域 */}
   795	              {paper.fieldsOfStudy && paper.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0 && (
   796	                <span className="pd-meta-fields">{paper.fieldsOfStudy.join(', ')}</span>
   797	              )}
   798	            </div>
   799	          </div>
   800	
   801	          {/* TL;DR */}
   802	          {paper.tldr && (
   803	            <div className="pd-tldr-section">
   804	              <div className="pd-tldr-header">
   805	                <span className="pd-tldr-badge">TLDR</span>
   806	              </div>
   807	              <p className="pd-tldr-text">{paper.tldr.text}</p>
   808	            </div>
   809	          )}
   810	
   811	          {/* Abstract */}
   812	          {paper.abstract && (
   813	            <div className="pd-content-section">
   814	              <h2 className="pd-section-heading">Abstract</h2>
   815	              <p className="pd-abstract-text">{paper.abstract}</p>
   816	            </div>
   817	          )}
   818	
   819	          {/* 操作按钮 - Cite、DOI链接和PDF */}
   820	          <div className="pd-action-buttons">
   821	            <button
   822	              onClick={() => setShowCiteModal(true)}
   823	              className="pd-action-btn"
   824	            >
   825	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   826	                <path d="M3 21h18M3 10h18M3 7l9-4 9 4M4 10v11M20 10v11M8 21V10M16 21V10"/>
   827	              </svg>
   828	              Cite
   829	            </button>
   830	            <button
   831	              onClick={handleViewMoreSimilar}
   832	              className="pd-action-btn pd-similar-btn"
   833	            >
   834	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   835	                <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"/>
   836	                <path d="M8.59 13.51l6.83 3.98M15.41 6.51l-6.82 3.98"/>
   837	              </svg>
   838	              Similar Papers
   839	            </button>
   840	            {paper.externalIds?.DOI && (
   841	              <a
   842	                href={`https://doi.org/${paper.externalIds.DOI}`}
   843	                target="_blank"
   844	                rel="noopener noreferrer"
   845	                className="pd-action-btn"
   846	              >
   847	                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   848	                  <path d="M18 13v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V8a2 2 0 012-2h6M15 3h6v6M10 14L21 3"/>
   849	                </svg>
   850	                View Publisher
   851	              </a>
   852	            )}
   853	            {paper.openAccessPdf?.url && (
   854	              <a
   855	                href={paper.openAccessPdf.url}
   856	                target="_blank"
   857	                rel="noopener noreferrer"
   858	                className="pd-action-btn pd-pdf-btn"
   859	              >
   860	                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   861	                  <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z"/>
   862	                  <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
   863	                </svg>
   864	                View PDF
   865	              </a>
   866	            )}
   867	          </div>
   868	
   869	          {/* Citations & References Tab */}
   870	          <div className="pd-content-section pd-citations-references-section">
   871	            {/* Tab 头部 */}
   872	            <div className="pd-tab-header">
   873	              <button
   874	                className={`pd-tab-btn ${activeTab === 'citations' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   875	                onClick={() => setActiveTab('citations')}
   876	              >
   877	                Citations
   878	                <span className="pd-tab-count">{paper.citationCount || 0}</span>
   879	              </button>
   880	              <button
   881	                className={`pd-tab-btn ${activeTab === 'references' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   882	                onClick={() => setActiveTab('references')}
   883	              >
   884	                References
   885	                <span className="pd-tab-count">{paper.referenceCount || 0}</span>
   886	              </button>
   887	            </div>
   888	
   889	            {/* Tab 内容 */}
   890	            <div className="pd-tab-content">
   891	              {activeTab === 'citations' && (
   892	                <div className="pd-citations-list">
   893	                  {paper.citations && paper.citations.length > 0 ? (
   894	                    paper.citations.map((citation, index) => (
   895	                      <div key={citation.paperId || index} className="pd-citation-item">
   896	                        <h3 className="pd-citation-title">
   897	                          <a href={`/paper/${citation.paperId}`} className="pd-citation-link">
   898	                            {citation.title || 'Untitled'}
   899	                          </a>
   900	                        </h3>
   901	
   902	                        <div className="pd-citation-meta">
   903	                          {/* 作者 */}
   904	                          {citation.authors && citation.authors.length > 0 && (
   905	                            <>
   906	                              {citation.authors.slice(0, 5).map((author, i) => (
   907	                                <React.Fragment key={i}>
   908	                                  <span className="pd-citation-author">{author.name}</span>
   909	                                  {i < Math.min(citation.authors.length - 1, 4) && <span className="pd-author-separator">, </span>}
   910	                                </React.Fragment>
   911	                              ))}
   912	                              {citation.authors.length > 5 && <span className="pd-citation-author"> et al.</span>}
   913	                              <span className="pd-meta-dot"> · </span>
   914	                            </>
   915	                          )}
   916	
   917	                          {/* 出版信息 */}
   918	                          {citation.venue && (
   919	                            <>
   920	                              <span className="pd-citation-venue">{citation.venue}</span>
   921	                              {citation.year && <span> </span>}
   922	                            </>
   923	                          )}
   924	                          {citation.year && (
   925	                            <>
   926	                              <span className="pd-citation-year">{citation.year}</span>
   927	                              <span className="pd-meta-dot"> · </span>
   928	                            </>
   929	                          )}
   930	
   931	                          {/* 研究领域 */}
   932	                          {citation.s2FieldsOfStudy && citation.s2FieldsOfStudy.length > 0 && (
   933	                            <span className="pd-citation-fields">
   934	                              {citation.s2FieldsOfStudy.map(f => f.category).join(', ')}
   935	                            </span>
   936	                          )}
   937	                        </div>
   938	
   939	                        {/* TLDR */}
   940	                        {citation.tldr && (
   941	                          <div className="pd-citation-tldr">
   942	                            <span className="pd-tldr-label">TLDR</span>
   943	                            <span className="pd-tldr-text-inline">{citation.tldr.text}</span>
   944	                          </div>
   945	                        )}
   946	
   947	                        {/* Abstract摘要 */}
   948	                        {citation.abstract && (
   949	                          <p className="pd-citation-abstract">{citation.abstract}</p>
   950	                        )}
   951	
   952	                        {/* 底部操作 */}
   953	                        {citation.openAccessPdf?.url && (
   954	                          <div className="pd-citation-actions">
   955	                            <a href={citation.openAccessPdf.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="pd-citation-action-btn">
   956	                              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   957	                                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z"/>
   958	                                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
   959	                              </svg>
   960	                              PDF
   961	                            </a>
   962	                          </div>
   963	                        )}
   964	                      </div>
   965	                    ))
   966	                  ) : (
   967	                    <p className="pd-placeholder-text">No citations found.</p>
   968	                  )}
   969	                </div>
   970	              )}
   971	
   972	              {activeTab === 'references' && (
   973	                <div className="pd-references-list">
   974	                  {paper.references && paper.references.length > 0 ? (
   975	                    paper.references.map((reference, index) => (
   976	                      <div key={reference.paperId || index} className="pd-citation-item">
   977	                        <h3 className="pd-citation-title">
   978	                          <a href={`/paper/${reference.paperId}`} className="pd-citation-link">
   979	                            {reference.title || 'Untitled'}
   980	                          </a>
   981	                        </h3>
   982	
   983	                        <div className="pd-citation-meta">
   984	                          {/* 作者 */}
   985	                          {reference.authors && reference.authors.length > 0 && (
   986	                            <>
   987	                              {reference.authors.slice(0, 5).map((author, i) => (
   988	                                <React.Fragment key={i}>
   989	                                  <span className="pd-citation-author">{author.name}</span>
   990	                                  {i < Math.min(reference.authors.length - 1, 4) && <span className="pd-author-separator">, </span>}
   991	                                </React.Fragment>
   992	                              ))}
   993	                              {reference.authors.length > 5 && <span className="pd-citation-author"> et al.</span>}
   994	                              <span className="pd-meta-dot"> · </span>
   995	                            </>
   996	                          )}
   997	
   998	                          {/* 出版信息 */}
   999	                          {reference.venue && (
  1000	                            <>
  1001	                              <span className="pd-citation-venue">{reference.venue}</span>
  1002	                              {reference.year && <span> </span>}
  1003	                            </>
  1004	                          )}
  1005	                          {reference.year && (
  1006	                            <>
  1007	                              <span className="pd-citation-year">{reference.year}</span>
  1008	                              <span className="pd-meta-dot"> · </span>
  1009	                            </>
  1010	                          )}
  1011	
  1012	                          {/* 研究领域 */}
  1013	                          {reference.s2FieldsOfStudy && reference.s2FieldsOfStudy.length > 0 && (
  1014	                            <span className="pd-citation-fields">
  1015	                              {reference.s2FieldsOfStudy.map(f => f.category).join(', ')}
  1016	                            </span>
  1017	                          )}
  1018	                        </div>
  1019	
  1020	                        {/* TLDR */}
  1021	                        {reference.tldr && (
  1022	                          <div className="pd-citation-tldr">
  1023	                            <span className="pd-tldr-label">TLDR</span>
  1024	                            <span className="pd-tldr-text-inline">{reference.tldr.text}</span>
  1025	                          </div>
  1026	                        )}
  1027	
  1028	                        {/* Abstract摘要 */}
  1029	                        {reference.abstract && (
  1030	                          <p className="pd-citation-abstract">{reference.abstract}</p>
  1031	                        )}
  1032	
  1033	                        {/* 底部操作 */}
  1034	                        {reference.openAccessPdf?.url && (
  1035	                          <div className="pd-citation-actions">
  1036	                            <a href={reference.openAccessPdf.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="pd-citation-action-btn">
  1037	                              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1038	                                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z"/>
  1039	                                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
  1040	                              </svg>
  1041	                              PDF
  1042	                            </a>
  1043	                          </div>
  1044	                        )}
  1045	                      </div>
  1046	                    ))
  1047	                  ) : (
  1048	                    <p className="pd-placeholder-text">No references found.</p>
  1049	                  )}
  1050	                </div>
  1051	              )}
  1052	            </div>
  1053	          </div>
  1054	        </div>
  1055	
  1056	        {/* 右侧边栏 */}
  1057	        <div className="pd-sidebar-column">
  1058	          {/* 快捷统计和导航 */}
  1059	          <div className="pd-sidebar-card">
  1060	            {/* Citations 统计 - 可点击跳转 */}
  1061	            <div
  1062	              className="pd-stat-row clickable"
  1063	              onClick={() => {
  1064	                setActiveTab('citations');
  1065	                document.querySelector('.pd-tab-header')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  1066	              }}
  1067	            >
  1068	              <div className="pd-stat-label">Citations</div>
  1069	              <div className="pd-stat-value">{paper.citationCount?.toLocaleString() || 0}</div>
  1070	            </div>
  1071	
  1072	            {/* References 统计 - 可点击跳转 */}
  1073	            <div
  1074	              className="pd-stat-row clickable"
  1075	              onClick={() => {
  1076	                setActiveTab('references');
  1077	                document.querySelector('.pd-tab-header')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  1078	              }}
  1079	            >
  1080	              <div className="pd-stat-label">References</div>
  1081	              <div className="pd-stat-value">{paper.referenceCount?.toLocaleString() || 0}</div>
  1082	            </div>
  1083	          </div>
  1084	
  1085	          {/* 快捷操作按钮 */}
  1086	          <div className="pd-sidebar-card">
  1087	            <button
  1088	              onClick={() => setShowCiteModal(true)}
  1089	              className="pd-sidebar-action-btn"
  1090	            >
  1091	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1092	                <path d="M3 21h18M3 10h18M3 7l9-4 9 4M4 10v11M20 10v11M8 21V10M16 21V10"/>
  1093	              </svg>
  1094	              Cite
  1095	            </button>
  1096	            {paper.externalIds?.DOI && (
  1097	              <a
  1098	                href={`https://doi.org/${paper.externalIds.DOI}`}
  1099	                target="_blank"
  1100	                rel="noopener noreferrer"
  1101	                className="pd-sidebar-action-btn"
  1102	              >
  1103	                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1104	                  <path d="M18 13v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V8a2 2 0 012-2h6M15 3h6v6M10 14L21 3"/>
  1105	                </svg>
  1106	                View Publisher
  1107	              </a>
  1108	            )}
  1109	            {paper.openAccessPdf?.url && (
  1110	              <a
  1111	                href={paper.openAccessPdf.url}
  1112	                target="_blank"
  1113	                rel="noopener noreferrer"
  1114	                className="pd-sidebar-action-btn pd-pdf-btn"
  1115	              >
  1116	                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1117	                  <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z"/>
  1118	                  <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
  1119	                </svg>
  1120	                View PDF
  1121	              </a>
  1122	            )}
  1123	            <button
  1124	              onClick={handleViewMoreSimilar}
  1125	              className="pd-sidebar-action-btn pd-similar-btn"
  1126	            >
  1127	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1128	                <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"/>
  1129	                <path d="M8.59 13.51l6.83 3.98M15.41 6.51l-6.82 3.98"/>
  1130	              </svg>
  1131	              Similar Papers
  1132	            </button>
  1133	          </div>
  1134	        </div>
  1135	      </div>
  1136	      )}
  1137	
  1138	      {/* Citation Modal */}
  1139	      {showCiteModal && (
  1140	        <div className="pd-cite-modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowCiteModal(false)}>
  1141	          <div className="pd-cite-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
  1142	            <div className="pd-cite-modal-header">
  1143	              <h2>Cite Paper</h2>
  1144	              <button className="pd-close-btn" onClick={() => setShowCiteModal(false)}>
  1145	                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1146	                  <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
  1147	                  <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
  1148	                </svg>
  1149	              </button>
  1150	            </div>
  1151	
  1152	            <div className="pd-cite-format-tabs">
  1153	              <button
  1154	                className={citationFormat === 'bibtex' ? 'active' : ''}
  1155	                onClick={() => setCitationFormat('bibtex')}
  1156	              >
  1157	                BibTeX
  1158	              </button>
  1159	              <button
  1160	                className={citationFormat === 'mla' ? 'active' : ''}
  1161	                onClick={() => setCitationFormat('mla')}
  1162	              >
  1163	                MLA
  1164	              </button>
  1165	              <button
  1166	                className={citationFormat === 'apa' ? 'active' : ''}
  1167	                onClick={() => setCitationFormat('apa')}
  1168	              >
  1169	                APA
  1170	              </button>
  1171	              <button
  1172	                className={citationFormat === 'chicago' ? 'active' : ''}
  1173	                onClick={() => setCitationFormat('chicago')}
  1174	              >
  1175	                Chicago
  1176	              </button>
  1177	            </div>
  1178	
  1179	            <div className="pd-cite-content">
  1180	              <pre 
  1181	                className={citationFormat === 'bibtex' ? 'bibtex' : ''}
  1182	                dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: generateCitation(citationFormat) }}
  1183	              />
  1184	            </div>
  1185	
  1186	            <div className="pd-cite-modal-footer">
  1187	              <button className={`pd-copy-btn ${copied ? 'copied' : ''}`} onClick={copyCitation}>
  1188	                {copied ? (
  1189	                  <>
  1190	                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1191	                      <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline>
  1192	                    </svg>
  1193	                    Copied!
  1194	                  </>
  1195	                ) : (
  1196	                  <>
  1197	                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1198	                      <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
  1199	                      <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 01-2-2V4a2 2 0 012-2h9a2 2 0 012 2v1"></path>
  1200	                    </svg>
  1201	                    Copy
  1202	                  </>
  1203	                )}
  1204	              </button>
  1205	            </div>
  1206	          </div>
  1207	        </div>
  1208	      )}
  1209	    </div>
  1210	  );
  1211	};
  1212	
  1213	export default PaperDetailPage;
