    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
    11	import { useOutletContext, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import { peerReviewAPI } from '../services/api';
    13	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    14	import { useSidebar } from '../contexts/SidebarContext';
    15	import ModelSelector from '../components/ModelSelector';
    16	import MarkdownRenderer from '../components/MarkdownRenderer';
    17	import MessageModal from '../components/MessageModal';
    18	import './styles/PeerReviewPage.css';
    19	import './styles/ReviewReport.css';
    20	
    21	// 任务状态映射
    22	const STATUS_MAP = {
    23	  draft: { label: '草稿', color: 'gray' },
    24	  pending: { label: '等待处理', color: 'orange' },
    25	  processing: { label: '处理中', color: 'blue' },
    26	  completed: { label: '已完成', color: 'green' },
    27	  failed: { label: '失败', color: 'red' },
    28	};
    29	
    30	// 视图模式
    31	const VIEW_MODE = {
    32	  HOME: 'home',       // 主页（创建+列表）
    33	  DETAIL: 'detail',   // 任务详情
    34	};
    35	
    36	// 截取字符串（按字符数，不截断中文）
    37	const truncateString = (str, maxLen) => {
    38	  if (!str) return '';
    39	  if (str.length <= maxLen) return str;
    40	  return str.slice(0, maxLen) + '...';
    41	};
    42	
    43	export default function PeerReviewPage() {
    44	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    45	  const { sidebarCollapsed, openMobileSidebar, isMobile } = useOutletContext() || {};
    46	  const { user, openLoginModal } = useAuth();
    47	  const { resetSidebarConfig } = useSidebar();
    48	
    49	  // 进入页面时清空侧边栏历史记录
    50	  useEffect(() => {
    51	    resetSidebarConfig();
    52	  }, [resetSidebarConfig]);
    53	
    54	  // 视图状态
    55	  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState(VIEW_MODE.HOME);
    56	  const [selectedTaskId, setSelectedTaskId] = useState(null);
    57	
    58	  // 任务列表状态
    59	  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
    60	  const [totalTasks, setTotalTasks] = useState(0);
    61	  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
    62	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    63	
    64	  // 草稿状态（从后端加载）
    65	  const [draftId, setDraftId] = useState(null);
    66	  const [inputType, setInputType] = useState('text');
    67	  const [manuscriptText, setManuscriptText] = useState('');
    68	  const [targetVenue, setTargetVenue] = useState('');
    69	  const [modelLevel, setModelLevel] = useState('low'); // 默认普通模式
    70	  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState('');
    71	  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
    72	  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
    73	  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
    74	  const [draftLoading, setDraftLoading] = useState(false);
    75	
    76	  // 任务详情状态
    77	  const [taskDetail, setTaskDetail] = useState(null);
    78	  const [detailLoading, setDetailLoading] = useState(false);
    79	
    80	  // 弹窗状态
    81	  const [modal, setModal] = useState({ isOpen: false, type: 'info', title: '', message: '', onConfirm: null });
    82	
    83	  // 轮询和防抖相关
    84	  const pollingRef = useRef(null);
    85	  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
    86	  const saveDraftTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
    87	
    88	  // 显示弹窗
    89	  const showMessage = (type, title, message) => {
    90	    setModal({ isOpen: true, type, title, message, onConfirm: null });
    91	  };
    92	
    93	  // 显示确认弹窗
    94	  const showConfirm = (title, message, onConfirm) => {
    95	    setModal({ isOpen: true, type: 'confirm', title, message, onConfirm });
    96	  };
    97	
    98	  // 关闭弹窗
    99	  const closeModal = () => {
   100	    setModal({ ...modal, isOpen: false });
   101	  };
   102	
   103	  // 从后端加载草稿
   104	  const loadDraft = async () => {
   105	    if (!user) return;
   106	    
   107	    setDraftLoading(true);
   108	    try {
   109	      const response = await peerReviewAPI.getDraft();
   110	      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
   111	        const draft = response.data.data;
   112	        setDraftId(draft.id);
   113	        setInputType(draft.input_type || 'text');
   114	        setManuscriptText(draft.manuscript_text || '');
   115	        setTargetVenue(draft.target_venue || '');
   116	        setModelLevel(draft.model_level || 'low');
   117	        setFileName(draft.file_name || '');
   118	      }
   119	    } catch (error) {
   120	      console.error('加载草稿失败:', error);
   121	    } finally {
   122	      setDraftLoading(false);
   123	    }
   124	  };
   125	
   126	  // 保存草稿到后端（防抖）
   127	  const saveDraftToServer = async (data) => {
   128	    if (!user) return;
   129	    
   130	    try {
   131	      await peerReviewAPI.saveDraft(data);
   132	    } catch (error) {
   133	      console.error('保存草稿失败:', error);
   134	    }
   135	  };
   136	
   137	  // 防抖保存草稿
   138	  const debouncedSaveDraft = (data) => {
   139	    if (saveDraftTimeoutRef.current) {
   140	      clearTimeout(saveDraftTimeoutRef.current);
   141	    }
   142	    saveDraftTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   143	      saveDraftToServer(data);
   144	    }, 1000); // 1秒防抖
   145	  };
   146	
   147	  // 当草稿内容变化时自动保存
   148	  useEffect(() => {
   149	    if (!user || draftLoading) return;
   150	    
   151	    debouncedSaveDraft({
   152	      input_type: inputType,
   153	      manuscript_text: manuscriptText,
   154	      target_venue: targetVenue,
   155	      model_level: modelLevel,
   156	      file_name: fileName,
   157	    });
   158	  }, [inputType, manuscriptText, targetVenue, modelLevel, fileName, user, draftLoading]);
   159	
   160	  // 初始加载：获取草稿和任务列表
   161	  useEffect(() => {
   162	    if (!user) return;
   163	    loadDraft();
   164	    loadTasks();
   165	  }, [user]);
   166	
   167	  // 分页变化时重新加载任务列表
   168	  useEffect(() => {
   169	    if (!user) return;
   170	    loadTasks();
   171	  }, [currentPage]);
   172	
   173	  // 清理轮询
   174	  useEffect(() => {
   175	    return () => {
   176	      if (pollingRef.current) {
   177	        clearInterval(pollingRef.current);
   178	      }
   179	    };
   180	  }, []);
   181	
   182	  // 加载任务列表
   183	  const loadTasks = async () => {
   184	    if (!user) return;
   185	    
   186	    setLoading(true);
   187	    try {
   188	      const response = await peerReviewAPI.getTaskList(currentPage, 10);
   189	      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
   190	        setTasks(response.data.data.tasks || []);
   191	        setTotalTasks(response.data.data.total || 0);
   192	      }
   193	    } catch (error) {
   194	      console.error('加载任务列表失败:', error);
   195	    } finally {
   196	      setLoading(false);
   197	    }
   198	  };
   199	
   200	  // 验证文件
   201	  const validateFile = (file) => {
   202	    if (!file) return null;
   203	
   204	    // 检查文件类型
   205	    const allowedTypes = ['.txt', '.doc', '.docx', '.rtf', '.odt', '.pdf'];
   206	    const ext = '.' + file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
   207	    if (!allowedTypes.includes(ext)) {
   208	      showMessage('warning', '文件类型不支持', '请上传 txt、doc、docx、rtf、odt 或 pdf 文件');
   209	      return null;
   210	    }
   211	
   212	    // 检查文件大小
   213	    if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
   214	      showMessage('warning', '文件过大', '文件大小不能超过 10MB');
   215	      return null;
   216	    }
   217	
   218	    return file;
   219	  };
   220	
   221	  // 上传文件（解析并保存到草稿）
   222	  const uploadFile = async (file) => {
   223	    if (!user) {
   224	      showMessage('warning', '请先登录', '上传文件需要登录');
   225	      openLoginModal();
   226	      return;
   227	    }
   228	
   229	    setUploading(true);
   230	    try {
   231	      const response = await peerReviewAPI.uploadFile(file);
   232	      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
   233	        const data = response.data.data;
   234	        // 文件上传后，后端会自动保存到草稿，更新本地状态
   235	        setInputType('file');
   236	        setManuscriptText(data.extracted_text || '');
   237	        setFileName(data.file_name || file.name);
   238	        if (data.draft_id) {
   239	          setDraftId(data.draft_id);
   240	        }
   241	        // 上传成功不弹窗，直接显示在输入框中
   242	      } else {
   243	        showMessage('error', '上传失败', response.data?.message || '文件上传失败');
   244	      }
   245	    } catch (error) {
   246	      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);
   247	      showMessage('error', '上传失败', error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
   248	    } finally {
   249	      setUploading(false);
   250	    }
   251	  };
   252	
   253	  // 文件选择处理
   254	  const handleFileSelect = async (e) => {
   255	    const file = validateFile(e.target.files[0]);
   256	    if (file) {
   257	      await uploadFile(file);
   258	    }
   259	    // 清空 input 以便重新选择同一文件
   260	    if (fileInputRef.current) {
   261	      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
   262	    }
   263	  };
   264	
   265	  // 拖拽上传处理
   266	  const handleDragEnter = (e) => {
   267	    e.preventDefault();
   268	    e.stopPropagation();
   269	    setIsDragging(true);
   270	  };
   271	
   272	  const handleDragOver = (e) => {
   273	    e.preventDefault();
   274	    e.stopPropagation();
   275	    setIsDragging(true);
   276	  };
   277	
   278	  const handleDragLeave = (e) => {
   279	    e.preventDefault();
   280	    e.stopPropagation();
   281	    // 只有当离开上传区域时才取消拖拽状态
   282	    if (e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
   283	    setIsDragging(false);
   284	  };
   285	
   286	  const handleDrop = async (e) => {
   287	    e.preventDefault();
   288	    e.stopPropagation();
   289	    setIsDragging(false);
   290	    
   291	    const file = validateFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
   292	    if (file) {
   293	      await uploadFile(file);
   294	    }
   295	  };
   296	
   297	  // 提交草稿开始审稿
   298	  const handleSubmitDraft = async () => {
   299	    if (!user) {
   300	      openLoginModal();
   301	      return;
   302	    }
   303	
   304	    // 验证输入
   305	    if (!manuscriptText.trim()) {
   306	      showMessage('warning', '请输入内容', '请输入或上传稿件内容后再开始审稿');
   307	      return;
   308	    }
   309	
   310	    if (manuscriptText.trim().length < 100) {
   311	      showMessage('warning', '内容太短', '稿件内容至少需要100个字符');
   312	      return;
   313	    }
   314	
   315	    setSubmitting(true);
   316	    try {
   317	      const response = await peerReviewAPI.submitDraft(targetVenue, modelLevel);
   318	      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
   319	        const taskId = response.data.data.task_id;
   320	        
   321	        // 清空本地草稿状态
   322	        clearDraft();
   323	        
   324	        // 跳转到详情页
   325	        setSelectedTaskId(taskId);
   326	        setViewMode(VIEW_MODE.DETAIL);
   327	        
   328	        // 刷新列表
   329	        loadTasks();
   330	        
   331	        // 提交成功不弹窗，直接跳转到详情页
   332	      } else {
   333	        showMessage('error', '提交失败', response.data?.message || '提交审稿失败');
   334	      }
   335	    } catch (error) {
   336	      console.error('提交审稿失败:', error);
   337	      showMessage('error', '提交失败', error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
   338	    } finally {
   339	      setSubmitting(false);
   340	    }
   341	  };
   342	
   343	  // 清空草稿（本地状态）
   344	  const clearDraft = () => {
   345	    setManuscriptText('');
   346	    setTargetVenue('');
   347	    setFileName('');
   348	    setInputType('text');
   349	    // 同时保存空草稿到后端
   350	    saveDraftToServer({
   351	      input_type: 'text',
   352	      manuscript_text: '',
   353	      target_venue: '',
   354	      model_level: modelLevel,
   355	      file_name: '',
   356	    });
   357	  };
   358	
   359	  // 查看任务详情
   360	  const viewTaskDetail = async (taskId) => {
   361	    setSelectedTaskId(taskId);
   362	    setViewMode(VIEW_MODE.DETAIL);
   363	    await loadTaskDetail(taskId);
   364	  };
   365	
   366	  // 加载任务详情
   367	  const loadTaskDetail = async (taskId) => {
   368	    setDetailLoading(true);
   369	    try {
   370	      const response = await peerReviewAPI.getTaskDetail(taskId);
   371	      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
   372	        setTaskDetail(response.data.data);
   373	        
   374	        // 如果任务还在处理中，启动轮询
   375	        if (response.data.data.status === 'pending' || response.data.data.status === 'processing') {
   376	          startPolling(taskId);
   377	        } else {
   378	          stopPolling();
   379	        }
   380	      }
   381	    } catch (error) {
   382	      console.error('加载任务详情失败:', error);
   383	    } finally {
   384	      setDetailLoading(false);
   385	    }
   386	  };
   387	
   388	  // 启动轮询
   389	  const startPolling = (taskId) => {
   390	    stopPolling();
   391	    pollingRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
   392	      try {
   393	        const response = await peerReviewAPI.getTaskProgress(taskId);
   394	        if (response.data?.code === 0) {
   395	          const progress = response.data.data;
   396	          setTaskDetail(prev => ({
   397	            ...prev,
   398	            status: progress.status,
   399	            progress: progress.progress,
   400	            progress_stage: progress.progress_stage,
   401	          }));
   402	
   403	          // 如果完成或失败，停止轮询并重新加载详情
   404	          if (progress.status === 'completed' || progress.status === 'failed') {
   405	            stopPolling();
   406	            loadTaskDetail(taskId);
   407	          }
   408	        }
   409	      } catch (error) {
   410	        console.error('轮询失败:', error);
   411	      }
   412	    }, 2000);
   413	  };
   414	
   415	  // 停止轮询
   416	  const stopPolling = () => {
   417	    if (pollingRef.current) {
   418	      clearInterval(pollingRef.current);
   419	      pollingRef.current = null;
   420	    }
   421	  };
   422	
   423	  // 删除任务
   424	  const handleDeleteTask = async (taskId) => {
   425	    showConfirm('确认删除', '确定要删除这个审稿任务吗？删除后无法恢复。', async () => {
   426	      try {
   427	        const response = await peerReviewAPI.deleteTask(taskId);
   428	        if (response.data?.code === 0) {
   429	          loadTasks();
   430	          if (selectedTaskId === taskId) {
   431	            setViewMode(VIEW_MODE.HOME);
   432	            setSelectedTaskId(null);
   433	          }
   434	        }
   435	      } catch (error) {
   436	        console.error('删除任务失败:', error);
   437	        showMessage('error', '删除失败', error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
   438	      }
   439	    });
   440	  };
   441	
   442	  // 返回主页
   443	  const backToHome = () => {
   444	    stopPolling();
   445	    setViewMode(VIEW_MODE.HOME);
   446	    setSelectedTaskId(null);
   447	    setTaskDetail(null);
   448	    loadTasks();
   449	  };
   450	
   451	  // 启动草稿任务（保留用于详情页中的草稿任务）
   452	  const handleStartTask = async (taskId, targetVenue, modelLevel) => {
   453	    try {
   454	      const response = await peerReviewAPI.startTask(taskId, targetVenue, modelLevel);
   455	      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
   456	        // 重新加载任务详情
   457	        await loadTaskDetail(taskId);
   458	        loadTasks();
   459	      } else {
   460	        showMessage('error', '启动失败', response.data?.message || '启动任务失败');
   461	      }
   462	    } catch (error) {
   463	      console.error('启动任务失败:', error);
   464	      showMessage('error', '启动失败', error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
   465	    }
   466	  };
   467	
   468	  // 未登录提示
   469	  if (!user) {
   470	    return (
   471	      <div className={`prv-page-wrapper ${sidebarCollapsed ? 'prv-sidebar-collapsed' : 'prv-sidebar-expanded'}`}>
   472	        <div className="prv-main-container">
   473	          <div className="prv-content">
   474	            <div className="prv-login-prompt">
   475	              <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
   476	                <path d="M12 22C17.5228 22 22 17.5228 22 12C22 6.47715 17.5228 2 12 2C6.47715 2 2 6.47715 2 12C2 17.5228 6.47715 22 12 22Z"/>
   477	                <path d="M12 8V12M12 16H12.01"/>
   478	              </svg>
   479	              <h2>请先登录</h2>
   480	              <p>AI 审稿人功能需要登录后才能使用</p>
   481	              <button className="prv-login-btn" onClick={openLoginModal}>
   482	                立即登录
   483	              </button>
   484	            </div>
   485	          </div>
   486	        </div>
   487	      </div>
   488	    );
   489	  }
   490	
   491	  return (
   492	    <div className={`prv-page-wrapper ${sidebarCollapsed ? 'prv-sidebar-collapsed' : 'prv-sidebar-expanded'}`}>
   493	      <div className="prv-main-container">
   494	        <div className="prv-content">
   495	          <div className="prv-layout">
   496	            {/* 顶部导航 */}
   497	            <nav className="prv-navbar">
   498	              {isMobile && (
   499	                <button className="prv-mobile-menu-btn" onClick={openMobileSidebar}>
   500	                  <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   501	                    <line x1="4" y1="8" x2="20" y2="8" />
   502	                    <line x1="4" y1="16" x2="14" y2="16" />
   503	                  </svg>
   504	                </button>
   505	              )}
   506	              
   507	              <div className="prv-navbar-left">
   508	                {/* 面包屑导航 */}
   509	                <div className="prv-breadcrumb">
   510	                  <button className="prv-breadcrumb-link" onClick={() => navigate('/assistant')}>
   511	                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   512	                      <path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 0 1-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 0 1-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 0 1 7.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/>
   513	                    </svg>
   514	                    文献助手
   515	                  </button>
   516	                  <span className="prv-breadcrumb-separator">/</span>
   517	                  <span className="prv-breadcrumb-current">AI 审稿</span>
   518	                </div>
   519	                
   520	                {viewMode === VIEW_MODE.DETAIL && (
   521	                  <button className="prv-back-btn" onClick={backToHome}>
   522	                    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   523	                      <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
   524	                    </svg>
   525	                    返回列表
   526	                  </button>
   527	                )}
   528	              </div>
   529	            </nav>
   530	
   531	            {/* 主内容区 - 仅用于首页 */}
   532	            {viewMode === VIEW_MODE.HOME && (
   533	              <div className="prv-main">
   534	                {/* 上半部分：创建任务区域 */}
   535	                <CreateSection
   536	                  inputType={inputType}
   537	                  setInputType={setInputType}
   538	                  manuscriptText={manuscriptText}
   539	                  setManuscriptText={setManuscriptText}
   540	                  targetVenue={targetVenue}
   541	                  setTargetVenue={setTargetVenue}
   542	                  fileName={fileName}
   543	                  uploading={uploading}
   544	                  submitting={submitting}
   545	                  isDragging={isDragging}
   546	                  draftLoading={draftLoading}
   547	                  modelLevel={modelLevel}
   548	                  setModelLevel={setModelLevel}
   549	                  fileInputRef={fileInputRef}
   550	                  onFileSelect={handleFileSelect}
   551	                  onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
   552	                  onDragOver={handleDragOver}
   553	                  onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
   554	                  onDrop={handleDrop}
   555	                  onRemoveFile={() => { 
   556	                    setFileName(''); 
   557	                    setManuscriptText(''); 
   558	                    setInputType('text');
   559	                    // 同步清空后端草稿中的文件信息
   560	                    saveDraftToServer({
   561	                      input_type: 'text',
   562	                      manuscript_text: '',
   563	                      target_venue: targetVenue,
   564	                      model_level: modelLevel,
   565	                      file_name: '',
   566	                    });
   567	                  }}
   568	                  onSubmit={handleSubmitDraft}
   569	                  onClearDraft={clearDraft}
   570	                />
   571	
   572	                {/* 下半部分：历史任务列表 */}
   573	                <HistorySection
   574	                  tasks={tasks}
   575	                  loading={loading}
   576	                  totalTasks={totalTasks}
   577	                  currentPage={currentPage}
   578	                  onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
   579	                  onViewDetail={viewTaskDetail}
   580	                  onDelete={handleDeleteTask}
   581	                />
   582	              </div>
   583	            )}
   584	
   585	            {/* 详情视图 - 独立布局，不在 prv-main 内 */}
   586	            {viewMode === VIEW_MODE.DETAIL && (
   587	              <TaskDetailView
   588	                task={taskDetail}
   589	                loading={detailLoading}
   590	                onBack={backToHome}
   591	                onDelete={() => handleDeleteTask(selectedTaskId)}
   592	                onStartTask={handleStartTask}
   593	              />
   594	            )}
   595	          </div>
   596	        </div>
   597	      </div>
   598	
   599	      {/* 消息弹窗 */}
   600	      <MessageModal
   601	        isOpen={modal.isOpen}
   602	        onClose={closeModal}
   603	        type={modal.type}
   604	        title={modal.title}
   605	        message={modal.message}
   606	        onConfirm={modal.onConfirm}
   607	      />
   608	    </div>
   609	  );
   610	}
   611	
   612	// ========== 子组件 ==========
   613	
   614	// 创建任务区域（上半部分）
   615	function CreateSection({
   616	  inputType, setInputType,
   617	  manuscriptText, setManuscriptText,
   618	  targetVenue, setTargetVenue,
   619	  fileName,
   620	  uploading, submitting, isDragging, draftLoading,
   621	  modelLevel, setModelLevel,
   622	  fileInputRef,
   623	  onFileSelect, onDragEnter, onDragOver, onDragLeave, onDrop,
   624	  onRemoveFile, onSubmit, onClearDraft
   625	}) {
   626	  const hasContent = manuscriptText.trim().length > 0;
   627	
   628	  return (
   629	    <div className="prv-create-section">
   630	      <div className="prv-section-header">
   631	        <div className="prv-section-intro">
   632	          <h2 className="prv-section-title">
   633	            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
   634	              <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
   635	              <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
   636	              <path d="M12 18l-2.4-1.2L7 18v-4l2.6 1.3L12 14l2.4 1.3L17 14v4l-2.6-1.2L12 18z"/>
   637	            </svg>
   638	            AI 审稿
   639	          </h2>
   640	          <p className="prv-section-desc">上传论文，获取专业审稿意见</p>
   641	        </div>
   642	        <div className="prv-header-right">
   643	          {hasContent && (
   644	            <button className="prv-clear-btn" onClick={onClearDraft}>
   645	              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   646	                <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
   647	                <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
   648	              </svg>
   649	              清空
   650	            </button>
   651	          )}
   652	        </div>
   653	      </div>
   654	
   655	
   656	      {/* 输入区域 - 毛玻璃效果，支持粘贴文本和拖拽上传 */}
   657	      <div 
   658	        className={`prv-composer-wrapper ${isDragging ? 'prv-dragging' : ''}`}
   659	        onDragEnter={onDragEnter}
   660	        onDragOver={onDragOver}
   661	        onDragLeave={onDragLeave}
   662	        onDrop={onDrop}
   663	      >
   664	        {/* 拖拽上传遮罩 */}
   665	        {isDragging && (
   666	          <div className="prv-drag-overlay">
   667	            <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
   668	              <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
   669	              <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
   670	              <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
   671	            </svg>
   672	            <p>松开鼠标上传文件</p>
   673	          </div>
   674	        )}
   675	
   676	        {/* 上传中遮罩 */}
   677	        {uploading && (
   678	          <div className="prv-upload-overlay">
   679	            <div className="prv-spinner"></div>
   680	            <p>正在解析文件...</p>
   681	          </div>
   682	        )}
   683	
   684	        <div className="prv-input-area">
   685	          {draftLoading ? (
   686	            <div className="prv-draft-loading">
   687	              <div className="prv-spinner-small"></div>
   688	              <span>加载草稿中...</span>
   689	            </div>
   690	          ) : (
   691	            <>
   692	              {/* 已上传文件信息条 */}
   693	              {fileName && (
   694	                <div className="prv-file-bar">
   695	                  <div className="prv-file-bar-info">
   696	                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   697	                      <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
   698	                      <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
   699	                    </svg>
   700	                    <span className="prv-file-bar-name">{fileName}</span>
   701	                  </div>
   702	                  <button className="prv-file-bar-remove" onClick={onRemoveFile}>
   703	                    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   704	                      <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
   705	                      <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
   706	                    </svg>
   707	                  </button>
   708	                </div>
   709	              )}
   710	              
   711	              {/* 文本输入区域 */}
   712	              <div className="prv-textarea-wrapper">
   713	                <textarea
   714	                  className={`prv-textarea ${fileName ? 'prv-textarea-readonly' : ''}`}
   715	                  placeholder=""
   716	                  value={manuscriptText}
   717	                  onChange={(e) => !fileName && setManuscriptText(e.target.value)}
   718	                  readOnly={!!fileName}
   719	                  maxLength={50000}
   720	                />
   721	                
   722	                {/* 空状态引导提示 */}
   723	                {!manuscriptText && !fileName && (
   724	                  <div className="prv-empty-guide">
   725	                    <div className="prv-guide-methods">
   726	                      {/* 文字输入方式 */}
   727	                      <div className="prv-guide-method">
   728	                        <div className="prv-method-icon prv-method-text">
   729	                          <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
   730	                            <path d="M17 3a2.828 2.828 0 1 1 4 4L7.5 20.5 2 22l1.5-5.5L17 3z"/>
   731	                          </svg>
   732	                        </div>
   733	                        <p className="prv-method-title">直接输入</p>
   734	                        <p className="prv-method-desc">粘贴或输入论文内容</p>
   735	                      </div>
   736	                      
   737	                      <div className="prv-guide-divider">
   738	                        <span>或</span>
   739	                      </div>
   740	                      
   741	                      {/* 文件上传方式 */}
   742	                      <div className="prv-guide-method">
   743	                        <div className="prv-method-icon prv-method-file">
   744	                          <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
   745	                            <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
   746	                            <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
   747	                            <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
   748	                          </svg>
   749	                        </div>
   750	                        <p className="prv-method-title">上传文件</p>
   751	                        <p className="prv-method-desc">拖拽文件到此处</p>
   752	                      </div>
   753	                    </div>
   754	                    
   755	                    <div className="prv-guide-formats">
   756	                      <span>支持格式：</span>
   757	                      <span className="prv-format-tag">TXT</span>
   758	                      <span className="prv-format-tag">DOC</span>
   759	                      <span className="prv-format-tag">DOCX</span>
   760	                      <span className="prv-format-tag">PDF</span>
   761	                      <span className="prv-format-tag">RTF</span>
   762	                      <span className="prv-format-tag">ODT</span>
   763	                    </div>
   764	                  </div>
   765	                )}
   766	              </div>
   767	              
   768	              {/* 隐藏的文件输入 */}
   769	              <input
   770	                ref={fileInputRef}
   771	                type="file"
   772	                accept=".txt,.doc,.docx,.rtf,.odt,.pdf"
   773	                onChange={onFileSelect}
   774	                style={{ display: 'none' }}
   775	              />
   776	            </>
   777	          )}
   778	        </div>
   779	
   780	        {/* Composer Footer */}
   781	        <div className="prv-composer-footer">
   782	          {/* 左侧：模型选择和上传 */}
   783	          <div className="prv-composer-footer-left">
   784	            <ModelSelector 
   785	              value={modelLevel} 
   786	              onChange={setModelLevel}
   787	              compact={true}
   788	            />
   789	            
   790	            <button 
   791	              className="prv-footer-btn"
   792	              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
   793	              disabled={uploading}
   794	              title="上传文件"
   795	            >
   796	              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   797	                <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
   798	                <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
   799	                <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
   800	              </svg>
   801	            </button>
   802	          </div>
   803	
   804	          {/* 中间：目标期刊 - 可展开的输入 */}
   805	          <div className="prv-venue-section">
   806	            <div className="prv-venue-toggle">
   807	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   808	                <path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 17H20"/>
   809	                <path d="M6.5 2H20v20H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 19.5v-15A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 2z"/>
   810	              </svg>
   811	              <input
   812	                type="text"
   813	                className="prv-venue-input"
   814	                placeholder="投稿期刊（可选，让审稿更有针对性）"
   815	                value={targetVenue}
   816	                onChange={(e) => setTargetVenue(e.target.value)}
   817	              />
   818	            </div>
   819	          </div>
   820	          
   821	          {/* 右侧：字符计数 + 提交按钮 */}
   822	          <div className="prv-composer-footer-right">
   823	            <div className="prv-char-count">
   824	              <span className={manuscriptText.length > 45000 ? 'prv-char-warning' : ''}>
   825	                {manuscriptText.length.toLocaleString()}
   826	              </span>
   827	              <span className="prv-char-separator">/</span>
   828	              <span className="prv-char-max">50,000</span>
   829	            </div>
   830	            
   831	            <button 
   832	              className="prv-submit-btn" 
   833	              onClick={onSubmit}
   834	              disabled={submitting || !hasContent || draftLoading}
   835	            >
   836	              {submitting ? (
   837	                <>
   838	                  <div className="prvr-btn-spinner"></div>
   839	                  审稿中...
   840	                </>
   841	              ) : (
   842	                <>
   843	                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   844	                    <line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13"/>
   845	                    <polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2"/>
   846	                  </svg>
   847	                  开始审稿
   848	                </>
   849	              )}
   850	            </button>
   851	          </div>
   852	        </div>
   853	      </div>
   854	    </div>
   855	  );
   856	}
   857	
   858	// 历史任务区域（下半部分）
   859	function HistorySection({ tasks, loading, totalTasks, currentPage, onPageChange, onViewDetail, onDelete }) {
   860	  const pageSize = 10;
   861	  const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalTasks / pageSize);
   862	
   863	  return (
   864	    <div className="prv-history-section">
   865	      <div className="prv-section-header">
   866	        <h2 className="prv-section-title">
   867	          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   868	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
   869	            <polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/>
   870	          </svg>
   871	          历史任务
   872	          {totalTasks > 0 && <span className="prv-task-count">({totalTasks})</span>}
   873	        </h2>
   874	      </div>
   875	
   876	      {loading ? (
   877	        <div className="prv-loading-inline">
   878	          <div className="prv-spinner-small"></div>
   879	          <span>加载中...</span>
   880	        </div>
   881	      ) : tasks.length === 0 ? (
   882	        <div className="prv-empty-history">
   883	          <p>暂无审稿记录，开始您的第一次审稿吧</p>
   884	        </div>
   885	      ) : (
   886	        <>
   887	          <div className="prv-task-list-compact">
   888	            {tasks.map(task => (
   889	              <div key={task.id} className="prv-task-item" onClick={() => onViewDetail(task.id)}>
   890	                <div className="prv-task-item-main">
   891	                  <span className={`prv-task-status-dot prv-dot-${task.status}`}></span>
   892	                  <div className="prv-task-item-info">
   893	                    <h4 className="prv-task-item-title">{task.title || '未命名稿件'}</h4>
   894	                    <span className="prv-task-item-time">
   895	                      {new Date(task.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}
   896	                      {task.target_venue && ` · ${task.target_venue}`}
   897	                    </span>
   898	                  </div>
   899	                </div>
   900	                <div className="prv-task-item-right">
   901	                  <span className={`prv-task-status-badge prv-status-${task.status}`}>
   902	                    {STATUS_MAP[task.status]?.label || task.status}
   903	                  </span>
   904	                  {(task.status === 'draft' || task.status === 'failed') && (
   905	                    <button 
   906	                      className="prv-task-item-delete" 
   907	                      onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(task.id); }}
   908	                    >
   909	                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   910	                        <polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/>
   911	                        <path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>
   912	                      </svg>
   913	                    </button>
   914	                  )}
   915	                </div>
   916	              </div>
   917	            ))}
   918	          </div>
   919	
   920	          {totalPages > 1 && (
   921	            <div className="prv-pagination-compact">
   922	              <button 
   923	                className="prv-page-btn-small" 
   924	                disabled={currentPage <= 1}
   925	                onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage - 1)}
   926	              >
   927	                ‹ 上一页
   928	              </button>
   929	              <span className="prv-page-info-small">{currentPage} / {totalPages}</span>
   930	              <button 
   931	                className="prv-page-btn-small" 
   932	                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
   933	                onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage + 1)}
   934	              >
   935	                下一页 ›
   936	              </button>
   937	            </div>
   938	          )}
   939	        </>
   940	      )}
   941	    </div>
   942	  );
   943	}

  1118	        <div className="prv-form-actions">

  1120	            取消
  1121	          </button>

  1123	            className="prvr-btn prvr-btn-primary"

  1141	          </button>
  1142	        </div>
  1143	      </div>
  1144	    </div>
  1145	  );

  1148	// 任务详情视图 - 左右分栏布局
  1149	function TaskDetailView({ task, loading, onBack, onDelete, onStartTask }) {
  1150	  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState('report'); // 当前激活的模块
  1151	
  1152	  if (loading || !task) {
  1153	    return (
  1154	      <div className="prvr-page">
  1155	        <div className="prvr-loading">
  1156	          <div className="prvr-loading-content">
  1157	            <div className="prvr-spinner"></div>
  1158	            <h3>正在加载审稿报告...</h3>
  1159	            <p>请稍候</p>
  1160	          </div>
  1161	        </div>
  1162	      </div>
  1163	    );
  1164	  }
  1165	
  1166	  const isProcessing = task.status === 'pending' || task.status === 'processing';
  1167	  const isCompleted = task.status === 'completed';
  1168	  const isFailed = task.status === 'failed';
  1169	
  1170	  // 解析稿件内容获取预览
  1171	  const getManuscriptPreview = () => {
  1172	    if (!task.manuscript_text) return '暂无内容';
  1173	    return task.manuscript_text.length > 300 
  1174	      ? task.manuscript_text.substring(0, 300) + '...' 
  1175	      : task.manuscript_text;
  1176	  };
  1177	
  1178	  // 格式化日期
  1179	  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
  1180	    if (!dateStr) return '-';
  1181	    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleString('zh-CN', {
  1182	      year: 'numeric',
  1183	      month: '2-digit',
  1184	      day: '2-digit',
  1185	      hour: '2-digit',
  1186	      minute: '2-digit'
  1187	    });
  1188	  };
  1189	
  1190	  // 获取模型名称
  1191	  const getModelName = (level) => {
  1192	    const models = { low: '普通模式', mid: '进阶模式', high: '高级模式' };
  1193	    return models[level] || level;
  1194	  };
  1195	
  1196	  return (
  1197	    <div className="prvr-page">
  1198	      {/* 左侧边栏 - 稿件信息 */}
  1199	      <aside className="prvr-sidebar">
  1200	        {/* 状态卡片 */}
  1201	        <div className="prvr-card">
  1202	          <div className="prvr-card-title">
  1203	            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1204	              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
  1205	              <path d="M12 6v6l4 2"/>
  1206	            </svg>
  1207	            任务状态
  1208	          </div>
  1209	          <div className={`prvr-status prvr-status-${task.status}`}>
  1210	            {isProcessing && (
  1211	              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="prvr-spin">
  1212	                <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 11-6.219-8.56"/>
  1213	              </svg>
  1214	            )}
  1215	            {isCompleted && (
  1216	              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1217	                <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/>
  1218	              </svg>
  1219	            )}
  1220	            {isFailed && (
  1221	              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1222	                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/><line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/>
  1223	              </svg>
  1224	            )}
  1225	            {STATUS_MAP[task.status]?.label || task.status}
  1226	          </div>
  1227	        </div>
  1228	
  1229	        {/* 稿件信息卡片 */}
  1230	        <div className="prvr-card">
  1231	          <div className="prvr-card-title">
  1232	            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1233	              <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
  1234	              <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
  1235	            </svg>
  1236	            稿件信息
  1237	          </div>
  1238	          <div className="prvr-info-item">
  1239	            <span className="prvr-info-label">标题</span>
  1240	            <span className="prvr-info-value">{task.title || '未命名稿件'}</span>
  1241	          </div>
  1242	          {task.target_venue && (
  1243	            <div className="prvr-info-item">
  1244	              <span className="prvr-info-label">目标期刊</span>
  1245	              <span className="prvr-info-value">{task.target_venue}</span>
  1246	            </div>
  1247	          )}
  1248	          <div className="prvr-info-item">
  1249	            <span className="prvr-info-label">AI 模型</span>
  1250	            <span className="prvr-info-value">{getModelName(task.model_level)}</span>
  1251	          </div>
  1252	          <div className="prvr-info-item">
  1253	            <span className="prvr-info-label">创建时间</span>
  1254	            <span className="prvr-info-value">{formatDate(task.created_at)}</span>
  1255	          </div>
  1256	          {task.completed_at && (
  1257	            <div className="prvr-info-item">
  1258	              <span className="prvr-info-label">完成时间</span>
  1259	              <span className="prvr-info-value">{formatDate(task.completed_at)}</span>
  1260	            </div>
  1261	          )}
  1262	        </div>
  1263	
  1264	        {/* 稿件预览卡片 */}
  1265	        <div className="prvr-card">
  1266	          <div className="prvr-card-title">
  1267	            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1268	              <path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/>
  1269	              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
  1270	            </svg>
  1271	            稿件预览
  1272	          </div>
  1273	          <div className="prvr-preview">
  1274	            {getManuscriptPreview()}
  1275	          </div>
  1276	        </div>
  1277	      </aside>
  1278	
  1279	      {/* 右侧主内容 - 审稿报告 */}
  1280	      <main className="prvr-main">
  1281	        {/* 报告头部 */}
  1282	        <div className="prvr-header">
  1283	          <div className="prvr-title">
  1284	            <div className="prvr-title-icon">
  1285	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
  1286	                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
  1287	                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
  1288	                <path d="M12 18l-2.4-1.2L7 18v-4l2.6 1.3L12 14l2.4 1.3L17 14v4l-2.6-1.2L12 18z"/>
  1289	              </svg>
  1290	            </div>
  1291	            <h2>审稿报告</h2>
  1292	          </div>
  1293	        </div>
  1294	
  1295	        {/* 处理中状态 */}
  1296	        {isProcessing && (
  1297	          <div className="prvr-processing-status">
  1298	            <div className="prvr-processing-animation">
  1299	              <div className="prvr-processing-ring"></div>
  1300	              <div className="prvr-processing-icon">

    62	  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
    63	    return '--';

    65	  const numeric = Number(value);
    66	  if (Number.isNaN(numeric)) {
    67	    return value;

   243	        label: '学术检索',
   244	        value: featureSet.normal_search?.description || '无限制'
   245	      },
   246	      {
   247	        key: 'advanced',
   248	        label: '智能分析',
   249	        value: formatMultiLevelFeature(
   250	          featureSet.advanced_search_low?.description,
   251	          featureSet.advanced_search_mid?.description,
   252	          featureSet.advanced_search_high?.description
   253	        )
   254	      },
   255	      {
   256	        key: 'chat',
   257	        label: 'AI 聊天',
   258	        value: formatMultiLevelFeature(
   259	          featureSet.ai_chat_normal?.description,
   260	          featureSet.ai_chat_mid?.description,
   261	          featureSet.ai_chat_high?.description
   262	        )
   263	      },
   264	      {
   265	        key: 'history',
   266	        label: '历史记录',
   267	        value: featureSet.ai_history_data?.enabled ? '云端同步与多端共享' : '最近会话'
   268	      },
   269	      {
   270	        key: 'data',
   271	        label: '数据洞察',
   272	        value: featureSet.advanced_search_data?.enabled ? '智能分析数据导出' : '基础使用统计'
   273	      }
   274	    ];
   275	
   276	    if (plan.plan_code === 'max') {
   277	      features.push({
   278	        key: 'early-access',
   279	        label: '提前尝鲜新功能',
   280	        value: '优先体验最新能力'
   281	      });
   282	    }
   283	
   284	    return features;
   285	  };
   286	
   287	  // Get total price for display purposes only (actual payment uses backend-calculated order.amount)
   288	  const getTotalPrice = (plan) => {
   289	    if (billingCycle === 'monthly') {
   290	      return plan.current_price_monthly || plan.price_monthly;
   291	    }
   292	    return plan.current_price_yearly || plan.price_yearly;
   293	  };
   294	
   295	  // Calculate yearly discount badge text based on backend configuration
   296	  const getYearlyDiscountText = () => {
   297	    // Find any plan with yearly pricing to determine discount display
   298	    const paidPlan = plans.find(p => p.price_yearly > 0);
   299	    if (!paidPlan) return null;
   300	
   301	    // Method 1: Percentage discount (if enabled and percentage is set)
   302	    if (paidPlan.yearly_discount_enabled && paidPlan.yearly_discount_percent > 0) {
   303	      return `优惠 ${paidPlan.yearly_discount_percent}%`;
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    // Method 2: Price optimization (calculate savings if prices differ)
   307	    if (paidPlan.price_yearly > paidPlan.current_price_yearly) {
   308	      const savings = paidPlan.price_yearly - paidPlan.current_price_yearly;
   309	      return `省 ¥${savings.toFixed(0)}`;
   310	    }
   311	
   312	    // Fallback: Calculate equivalent months saved (original behavior)
   313	    const monthlyEquivalent = paidPlan.price_monthly * 12;
   314	    if (monthlyEquivalent > paidPlan.current_price_yearly) {
   315	      const monthsSaved = Math.round((monthlyEquivalent - paidPlan.current_price_yearly) / paidPlan.price_monthly);
   316	      if (monthsSaved > 0) {
   317	        return `省 ${monthsSaved} 个月`;
   318	      }
   319	    }
   320	
   321	    return null;
   322	  };
   323	
   324	  // Simplify multi-level feature display
   325	  // If all unlimited -> "无限制请求"
   326	  // If some have limits -> "较少次数限制"
   327	  // If all disabled -> "-"
   328	  const formatMultiLevelFeature = (low, mid, high) => {
   329	    const features = [low, mid, high].filter(f => f && f !== '-');
   330	
   331	    // All disabled
   332	    if (features.length === 0) {
   333	      return '-';
   334	    }
   335	
   336	    // Check if all are unlimited
   337	    const allUnlimited = features.every(f =>
   338	      f.includes('无限制') || f.includes('unlimited') || f === '不限'
   339	    );
   340	
   341	    if (allUnlimited) {
   342	      return '无限制请求';
   343	    }
   344	
   345	    // Some have limits
   346	    return '较少次数限制';
   347	  };
   348	
   349	  // Generate dynamic comparison data from plans
   350	  const getComparisonData = () => {
   351	    if (plans.length === 0) return { sections: [] };
   352	
   353	    // Find plans by code for easy access
   354	    const plansByCode = {};
   355	    plans.forEach(plan => {
   356	      plansByCode[plan.plan_code] = plan;
   357	    });
   358	
   359	    const freePlan = plansByCode['free'];
   360	    const proPlan = plansByCode['pro'];
   361	    const maxPlan = plansByCode['max'];
   362	
   363	    if (!freePlan || !proPlan || !maxPlan) {
   364	      return { sections: [] };
   365	    }
   366	
   367	    return {
   368	      sections: [
   369	        {
   370	          title: '核心功能',
   371	          features: [
   372	            {
   373	              name: '学术检索',
   374	              free: freePlan.features?.normal_search?.description || '无限制',
   375	              pro: proPlan.features?.normal_search?.description || '无限制',
   376	              max: maxPlan.features?.normal_search?.description || '无限制'
   377	            },
   378	            { name: '聊天历史记录', free: true, pro: true, max: true },
   379	            { name: '访问网页、移动端应用', free: true, pro: true, max: true },
   380	          ]
   381	        },
   382	        {
   383	          title: 'AI 模型',
   384	          features: [
   385	            {
   386	              name: '智能分析 - 低级模型',
   387	              free: freePlan.features?.advanced_search_low?.description || '-',
   388	              pro: proPlan.features?.advanced_search_low?.description || '-',
   389	              max: maxPlan.features?.advanced_search_low?.description || '-'
   390	            },
   391	            {
   392	              name: '智能分析 - 中级模型',
   393	              free: freePlan.features?.advanced_search_mid?.description || '-',
   394	              pro: proPlan.features?.advanced_search_mid?.description || '-',
   395	              max: maxPlan.features?.advanced_search_mid?.description || '-'
   396	            },
   397	            {
   398	              name: '智能分析 - 高级模型',
   399	              free: freePlan.features?.advanced_search_high?.description || '-',
   400	              pro: proPlan.features?.advanced_search_high?.description || '-',
   401	              max: maxPlan.features?.advanced_search_high?.description || '-'
   402	            },
   403	            {
   404	              name: 'AI 聊天 - 普通模型',
   405	              free: freePlan.features?.ai_chat_normal?.description || '-',
   406	              pro: proPlan.features?.ai_chat_normal?.description || '-',
   407	              max: maxPlan.features?.ai_chat_normal?.description || '-'
   408	            },
   409	            {
   410	              name: 'AI 聊天 - 中级模型',
   411	              free: freePlan.features?.ai_chat_mid?.description || '-',
   412	              pro: proPlan.features?.ai_chat_mid?.description || '-',
   413	              max: maxPlan.features?.ai_chat_mid?.description || '-'
   414	            },
   415	            {
   416	              name: 'AI 聊天 - 高级模型',
   417	              free: freePlan.features?.ai_chat_high?.description || '-',
   418	              pro: proPlan.features?.ai_chat_high?.description || '-',
   419	              max: maxPlan.features?.ai_chat_high?.description || '-'
   420	            },
   421	          ]
   422	        },
   423	        {
   424	          title: '数据与分析',
   425	          features: [
   426	            {
   427	              name: '智能分析数据',
   428	              free: freePlan.features?.advanced_search_data?.enabled,
   429	              pro: proPlan.features?.advanced_search_data?.enabled,
   430	              max: maxPlan.features?.advanced_search_data?.enabled
   431	            },
   432	            {
   433	              name: 'AI 对话历史数据',
   434	              free: freePlan.features?.ai_history_data?.enabled,
   435	              pro: proPlan.features?.ai_history_data?.enabled,
   436	              max: maxPlan.features?.ai_history_data?.enabled
   437	            },
   438	          ]
   439	        }
   440	      ]
   441	    };
   442	  };
   443	
   444	  const yearlyDiscountText = getYearlyDiscountText();
   445	  const comparisonData = getComparisonData();
   446	  const orderedPlans = PLAN_DISPLAY_ORDER
   447	    .map(code => plans.find(plan => plan.plan_code === code))
   448	    .filter(Boolean);
   449	  const remainingPlans = plans.filter(plan => !PLAN_DISPLAY_ORDER.includes(plan.plan_code));
   450	  const finalPlans = [...orderedPlans, ...remainingPlans];
   451	  const showcasePlan = finalPlans.find(plan => plan.plan_code === 'pro') || finalPlans[0];
   452	
   453	  if (loading) {
   454	    return (
   455	      <div className="pricing-page">
   456	        <div className="loading">加载中...</div>
   457	      </div>
   458	    );
   459	  }
   460	
   461	  return (
   462	    <div className="pricing-page">
   463	      <div className="pricing-nav">
   464	        <div className="nav-logo" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
   465	          <img src="/logo.png" alt="Scholay" />
   466	          <span>Scholay</span>
   467	        </div>
   468	        <div className="nav-actions">
   469	          <button type="button" className="nav-link" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
   470	            返回首页
   471	          </button>
   472	          <button type="button" className="nav-cta" onClick={scrollToPlans}>
   473	            查看套餐
   474	          </button>
   475	        </div>
   476	      </div>
   477	
   478	      <main className="pricing-main">
   479	        <section className="pricing-hero">
   480	          <div className="hero-grid">
   481	            <div className="hero-content">
   482	              <span className="hero-pill">针对学术研究优化</span>
   483	              <h1>升级到更懂你的 AI 学术助手</h1>
   484	              <p className="hero-subtitle">
   485	                多模型协作、深度引用链追踪与团队共享，帮助你更快完成文献筛选、综述撰写与灵感验证。
   486	              </p>
   487	
   488	              <div className="hero-actions">
   489	                <div className="billing-toggle">
   490	                  <button
   491	                    className={billingCycle === 'monthly' ? 'active' : ''}
   492	                    onClick={() => setBillingCycle('monthly')}
   493	                  >
   494	                    按月付费
   495	                  </button>
   496	                  <button
   497	                    className={billingCycle === 'yearly' ? 'active' : ''}
   498	                    onClick={() => setBillingCycle('yearly')}
   499	                  >
   500	                    按年付费 {yearlyDiscountText && <span className="save-badge">{yearlyDiscountText}</span>}
   501	                  </button>
   502	                </div>
   503	                <span className="billing-hint">
   504	                  {billingCycle === 'yearly'
   505	                    ? `按年支付${yearlyDiscountText ? ` · ${yearlyDiscountText}` : ' · 低至 8.5 折'}`
   506	                    : '按月结算 · 随时升级或取消'}
   507	                </span>
   508	              </div>
   509	
   510	              <div className="hero-meta">
   511	                {HERO_STATS.map(stat => (
   512	                  <div key={stat.label} className="hero-meta-item">
   513	                    <span className="hero-meta-value">{stat.value}</span>
   514	                    <span className="hero-meta-label">{stat.label}</span>
   515	                  </div>
   516	                ))}
   517	              </div>
   518	            </div>
   519	
   520	            <div className="hero-showcase">
   521	              <div className="hero-card">
   522	                <div className="hero-card-header">
   523	                  <span>即时体验</span>
   524	                  <p>智能提炼要点、生成引用，并保持多终端同步。</p>
   525	                </div>
   526	                <div className="hero-card-body">
   527	                  <h3>{showcasePlan ? `${showcasePlan.plan_name} 套餐` : '升级套餐'}</h3>
   528	                  {showcasePlan && (

   530	                      <span className="currency">¥</span>
   531	                      <span className="amount">

   533	                          billingCycle === 'monthly'
   534	                            ? getPricePerMonth(showcasePlan)
   535	                            : getTotalPrice(showcasePlan)
   536	                        )}
   537	                      </span>
   538	                      <span className="period">{billingCycle === 'monthly' ? '/月' : '/年'}</span>
   539	                    </div>
   540	                  )}
   541	                  <ul>
   542	                    {HERO_CARD_BULLETS.map(bullet => (
   543	                      <li key={bullet}>{bullet}</li>
   544	                    ))}
   545	                  </ul>
   546	                </div>
   547	                <div className="hero-card-footer">
   548	                  <span>覆盖 PRO / MAX 的全部高级模型</span>
   549	                  <button type="button" onClick={scrollToPlans}>查看方案</button>
   550	                </div>
   551	              </div>
   552	            </div>
   553	          </div>
   554	        </section>
   555	
   556	        <section id="plans-section" className="plan-grid-section">
   557	          <div className="section-heading">
   558	            <div>
   559	              <h2>根据研究节奏选择方案</h2>
   560	            </div>
   561	            <p className="section-description">
   562	              从基础体验到高频研究，灵活切换；将支持团队扩展以及 API 联动。
   563	            </p>
   564	          </div>
   565	          <div className="plan-grid">
   566	            {finalPlans.length === 0 ? (

   568	            ) : (
   569	              finalPlans.map(plan => {
   570	                const buttonInfo = getPlanButtonInfo(plan.plan_code);
   571	                const planBadge = getPlanBadge(plan.plan_code);
   572	                const isCurrent = isCurrentPlan(plan.plan_code);
   573	                const isFreePlan = plan.price_monthly === 0 && plan.price_yearly === 0;
   574	                const displayPrice = billingCycle === 'monthly'
   575	                  ? plan.current_price_monthly ?? plan.price_monthly ?? 0
   576	                  : getTotalPrice(plan) ?? 0;
   577	                const originalPrice = billingCycle === 'monthly'
   578	                  ? plan.price_monthly ?? plan.current_price_monthly ?? 0
   579	                  : getOriginalTotalPrice(plan);
   580	                const showOriginalPrice = hasDiscount(plan) && Number(originalPrice) > Number(displayPrice);
   581	                const savingsValue = showOriginalPrice ? Number(originalPrice) - Number(displayPrice) : 0;
   582	
   583	                let buttonClass = 'btn-upgrade';
   584	                if (buttonInfo.disabled) {
   585	                  buttonClass = buttonInfo.action === 'none' && plan.plan_code === 'free' ? 'btn-free' : 'btn-current';
   586	                } else if (buttonInfo.action === 'renew') {
   587	                  buttonClass = 'btn-renew';
   588	                }
   589	
   590	                return (
   591	                  <article
   592	                    key={plan.plan_code}
   593	                    className={`plan-card plan-${plan.plan_code} ${isCurrent ? 'is-current' : ''}`}

   599	                      </div>
   600	                      <p className="plan-description">{getPlanDescription(plan.plan_code)}</p>
   601	                      {isCurrent && <span className="current-chip">当前订阅</span>}
   602	                    </div>
   603	
   604	                    <div className="plan-price-block">
   605	                      {showOriginalPrice && (
   606	                        <div className="original-price">
   607	                          <span className="currency">¥</span>
   608	                          <span className="amount">{formatPrice(originalPrice)}</span>
   609	                          <span className="period">{billingCycle === 'monthly' ? '/月' : '/年'}</span>
   610	                        </div>
   611	                      )}
   612	                      <div className="price-amount">
   613	                        <span className="currency">¥</span>
   614	                        <span className="amount">{formatPrice(displayPrice)}</span>
   615	                        <span className="period">{billingCycle === 'monthly' ? '/月' : '/年'}</span>
   616	                      </div>
   617	                      {!isFreePlan && (
   618	                        <p className="plan-total">
   619	                          {billingCycle === 'yearly'
   620	                            ? `折合 ¥${formatPrice(getPricePerMonth(plan))}/月`
   621	                            : '按月结算 · 随时升级'}
   622	                          {savingsValue > 0 && (
   623	                            <span className="plan-savings">节省 ¥{formatPrice(savingsValue)}</span>
   624	                          )}
   625	                        </p>
   626	                      )}
   627	                    </div>
   628	
   629	                    <ul className="plan-feature-list">
   630	                      {getPlanFeatureList(plan).map(feature => (
   631	                        <li key={feature.key}>
   632	                          <span className="feature-name">{feature.label}</span>
   633	                          <span className="feature-desc">{feature.value}</span>
   634	                        </li>
   635	                      ))}
   636	                    </ul>
   637	
   638	                    <div className="plan-cta">
   639	                      <button
   640	                        className={buttonClass}
   641	                        onClick={() => handlePlanAction(plan.plan_code, buttonInfo.action)}
   642	                        disabled={buttonInfo.disabled}
   643	                      >
   644	                        {buttonInfo.text}
   645	                      </button>
   646	                    </div>
   647	                  </article>
   648	                );
   649	              })
   650	            )}
   651	          </div>
   652	        </section>
   653	
   654	        {comparisonData.sections.length > 0 && (
   655	          <section className="plan-comparison">
   656	            <div className="comparison-heading">
   657	              <h2>细致比较每项能力</h2>
   658	              <p>了解不同套餐在模型、配额与协作能力上的差异，帮助你快速决策。</p>
   659	            </div>
   660	            <div className="comparison-plan-cards">
   661	              {finalPlans.map(plan => (
   662	                <div key={plan.plan_code} className="comparison-plan-card">
   663	                  <p className="plan-tier-label">{plan.plan_name}</p>
   664	                  <p className="plan-tier-price">
   665	                    {plan.plan_code === 'free'
   666	                      ? '免费使用'
   667	                      : `¥${formatPrice(plan.current_price_monthly ?? plan.price_monthly ?? 0)}/月`}
   668	                  </p>
   669	                  <button
   670	                    className={`plan-tier-btn ${plan.plan_code === 'free' ? 'btn-free' : 'btn-upgrade'}`}
   671	                    onClick={() => handlePlanAction(plan.plan_code, plan.plan_code === 'free' ? 'none' : 'subscribe')}
   672	                  >
   673	                    {plan.plan_code === 'free' ? '免费使用' : '立即订阅'}
   674	                  </button>
   675	                </div>
   676	              ))}
   677	            </div>
   678	            <div className="comparison-table">
   679	              <div className="table-header">
   680	                <div className="table-header-cell">功能</div>
   681	                {['free', 'pro', 'max'].map(code => {
   682	                  const plan = plans.find(p => p.plan_code === code);
   683	                  return (
   684	                    <div key={code} className="table-header-cell">
   685	                      {plan ? plan.plan_name : code.toUpperCase()}
   686	                    </div>
   687	                  );
   688	                })}
   689	              </div>
   690	
   691	              {comparisonData.sections.map((section, sectionIndex) => (
   692	                <div key={sectionIndex} className="table-section">
   693	                  <div className="section-title">{section.title}</div>
   694	                  {section.features.map((feature, featureIndex) => (
   695	                    <div key={featureIndex} className="table-row">
   696	                      <div className="table-cell">{feature.name}</div>
   697	                      <div className="table-cell">
   698	                        {typeof feature.free === 'boolean' ? (
   699	                          feature.free ? <span className="check-icon">✓</span> : <span className="cross-icon">—</span>
   700	                        ) : (
   701	                          <span className="feature-text">{feature.free}</span>
   702	                        )}
   703	                      </div>
   704	                      <div className="table-cell">
   705	                        {typeof feature.pro === 'boolean' ? (
   706	                          feature.pro ? <span className="check-icon">✓</span> : <span className="cross-icon">—</span>
   707	                        ) : (
   708	                          <span className="feature-text">{feature.pro}</span>
   709	                        )}
   710	                      </div>
   711	                      <div className="table-cell">
   712	                        {typeof feature.max === 'boolean' ? (
   713	                          feature.max ? <span className="check-icon">✓</span> : <span className="cross-icon">—</span>
   714	                        ) : (
   715	                          <span className="feature-text">{feature.max}</span>
   716	                        )}
   717	                      </div>
   718	                    </div>
   719	                  ))}
   720	                </div>
   721	              ))}
   722	            </div>
   723	          </section>
   724	        )}
   725	
   726	        <section className="pricing-faq">
   727	          <div className="section-heading">
   728	            <p className="section-eyebrow">常见问题</p>
   729	            <h2>关于订阅的更多解答</h2>
   730	            <p className="section-description">
   731	              如果还有疑问，随时联系支持团队，我们会第一时间响应。
   732	            </p>
   733	          </div>
   734	          <div className="faq-grid">
   735	            {FAQ_ITEMS.map(item => (
   736	              <div key={item.question} className="faq-item">
   737	                <h3>{item.question}</h3>
   738	                <p>{item.answer}</p>
   739	              </div>
   740	            ))}
   741	          </div>
   742	        </section>
   743	      </main>
   744	
   745	      <AuthModal
   746	        isOpen={showAuthModal}
   747	        onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
   748	        onLoginSuccess={handleAuthSuccess}
   749	      />
   750	    </div>
   751	  );
   752	};
