   363	  // 执行搜索
   364	  const performSearch = async (query, currentFilters, page = 1, saveToHistory = true, enableTranslation = true) => {
   365	    if (!query.trim()) return;
   366	
   367	    // 搜索时自动切换回列表视图（除非是从登录返回的）
   368	    if (returnedFromLogin.current) {
   369	      // 从登录返回时，保持表格视图，只在第一次搜索时跳过重置
   370	      returnedFromLogin.current = false;
   371	    } else {
   372	      setViewMode('list');
   373	    }
   374	
   375	    setLoading(true);
   376	    // 重置右侧预览面板
   377	    setSelectedPaper(null);
   378	    setPreviewWidth(getDefaultPreviewWidth());
   379	    try {
   380	      // 检查是否可以复用缓存的翻译结果
   381	      // 条件：查询词相同 && 不是第一次搜索 && 不是禁用翻译的搜索
   382	      const canReuseTranslation = 
   383	        cachedTranslation.query === query && 
   384	        cachedTranslation.translated && 
   385	        enableTranslation &&
   386	        (page > 1 || saveToHistory === false); // 分页或筛选时复用
   387	      
   388	      const params = {
   389	        query: query,
   390	        offset: (page - 1) * papersPerPage,
   391	        limit: papersPerPage,
   392	        // 如果可以复用缓存，禁用后端翻译；否则根据参数决定
   393	        enableTranslation: canReuseTranslation ? false : enableTranslation,
   394	        fields: ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'url', 'venue', 'publicationDate', 'openAccessPdf', 'fieldsOfStudy', 'isOpenAccess', 'referenceCount', 'influentialCitationCount', 'tldr', 'journal', 'externalIds']
   395	      };
   396	      
   397	      if (canReuseTranslation) {
   398	        console.log('[Search] Reusing cached translation:', cachedTranslation);
   399	      }
   400	
   401	      // 添加筛选条件
   402	      if (currentFilters.yearFrom || currentFilters.yearTo) {
   403	        params.yearFrom = currentFilters.yearFrom;
   404	        params.yearTo = currentFilters.yearTo;
   405	      }
   406	
   407	      if (currentFilters.publicationTypes && currentFilters.publicationTypes.length > 0) {
   408	        params.publicationTypes = currentFilters.publicationTypes;
   409	      }
   410	
   411	      if (currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy && currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) {
   412	        params.fieldsOfStudy = currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy;
   413	      }
   414	
   415	      if (currentFilters.openAccessPdf) {
   416	        params.openAccessPdf = currentFilters.openAccessPdf;
   417	      }
   418	
   419	      if (currentFilters.venue) {
   420	        params.venue = [currentFilters.venue];
   421	      }
   422	
   423	      // 使用公共API，支持未登录用户访问
   424	      const response = await publicScholarAPI.searchPapers(params);
   425	
   426	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   427	        const responseData = response.data.data;
   428	        const searchResults = responseData.data?.data || [];
   429	        const resultsTotal = responseData.data?.total || 0;
   430	        
   431	        setPapers(searchResults);
   432	        setTotal(resultsTotal);
   433	        
   434	        // 如果是复用缓存的情况，使用缓存的查询信息
   435	        let finalQueryInfo;
   436	        if (canReuseTranslation) {
   437	          finalQueryInfo = {
   438	            originalQuery: query,
   439	            translatedQuery: cachedTranslation.translated,
   440	            actualQuery: cachedTranslation.actual,
   441	            translationEnabled: true,
   442	            searchStrategy: cachedTranslation.searchStrategy || 'combined'
   443	          };
   444	        } else {
   445	          finalQueryInfo = {
   446	            originalQuery: responseData.originalQuery || query,
   447	            translatedQuery: responseData.translatedQuery || '',
   448	            actualQuery: responseData.actualQuery || query,
   449	            translationEnabled: responseData.translationEnabled || false,
   450	            searchStrategy: responseData.searchStrategy || ''
   451	          };
   452	          
   453	          // 如果是新的翻译结果，更新缓存
   454	          if (responseData.translationEnabled && responseData.translatedQuery) {
   455	            setCachedTranslation({
   456	              query: query,
   457	              translated: responseData.translatedQuery,
   458	              actual: responseData.actualQuery,
   459	              searchStrategy: responseData.searchStrategy || 'combined'
   460	            });
   461	            console.log('[Search] Cached new translation:', {
   462	              query,
   463	              translated: responseData.translatedQuery,
   464	              actual: responseData.actualQuery,
   465	              searchStrategy: responseData.searchStrategy
   466	            });
   467	          }
   468	        }
   469	        
   470	        // 保存查询信息用于展示
   471	        setQueryInfo(finalQueryInfo);
   472	
   473	        // 只有在saveToHistory为true且用户已登录时才添加到搜索历史
   474	        if (saveToHistory && isAuthenticated && user?.id) {
   475	          const historyItem = addSearchHistory(query, currentFilters, resultsTotal, user.id);
   476	          loadSearchHistory();
   477	          // 自动选中刚添加的历史记录
   478	          if (historyItem && historyItem.id) {
   479	            setSelectedHistoryId(historyItem.id);
   480	          }
   481	        }
   482	      }
   483	    } catch (error) {
   484	      console.error('搜索失败:', error);
   485	      alert('搜索失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   486	    } finally {
   487	      setLoading(false);
   488	    }
   489	  };
   490	
   491	  // 加载搜索历史 (当用户切换时重新加载)
   492	  useEffect(() => {
   493	    // 首次加载时尝试迁移旧的搜索历史
   494	    if (user?.id) {
   495	      migrateOldSearchHistory(user.id);
   496	    }
   497	    loadSearchHistory();
   498	  }, [user?.id]);
   499	
   500	  const loadSearchHistory = () => {
   501	    const history = getFormattedSearchHistory(user?.id);
   502	    setSearchHistory(history);
   503	  };
   504	
   505	  // 搜索示例轮播效果
   506	  useEffect(() => {
   507	    const interval = setInterval(() => {
   508	      setCurrentExampleIndex((prevIndex) => (prevIndex + 1) % searchExamples.length);
   509	    }, 3000); // 每3秒切换一次
   510	
   511	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
   512	  }, [searchExamples.length]);
   513	
   514	  const handleSelectSearchHistory = (itemId) => {
   515	    const history = searchHistory.find(h => h.id === itemId);
   516	    if (history) {
   517	      setSelectedHistoryId(itemId); // 设置选中的历史记录ID
   518	      // 搜索框始终显示真正的搜索词（query），而不是重命名后的displayName
   519	      // 这样用户可以看到实际搜索的内容，也方便继续修改
   520	      setSearchQuery(history.query);
   521	      setFilters(history.filters || {
   522	        yearFrom: '',
   523	        yearTo: '',
   524	        publicationTypes: [],
   525	        fieldsOfStudy: [],
   526	        openAccessPdf: '',
   527	        venue: '',
   528	      });
   529	      setCurrentPage(1);
   530	      updateURL(history.query, history.filters, 1);
   531	      performSearch(history.query, history.filters, 1, false); // 从历史记录搜索,不保存到历史记录
   532	    }
   533	  };
   534	
   535	  const handleDeleteSearchHistory = (itemId) => {
   536	    deleteSearchHistory(itemId, user?.id);
   537	    loadSearchHistory();
   538	  };
   539	
   540	  const handleRenameSearchHistory = (itemId, newTitle) => {
   541	    renameSearchHistory(itemId, newTitle, user?.id);
   542	    loadSearchHistory();
   543	  };
   544	
   545	  // 更新侧边栏配置 - 只在用户登录时
   546	  useEffect(() => {
   547	    if (isAuthenticated) {
   548	      updateSidebarConfig({
   549	        showHistory: true,
   550	        historyType: 'search',
   551	        historyItems: searchHistory,
   552	        currentItemId: selectedHistoryId,
   553	        onSelectItem: handleSelectSearchHistory,
   554	        onDeleteItem: handleDeleteSearchHistory,
   555	        onRenameItem: handleRenameSearchHistory,
   556	        onNewItem: null,
   557	        historyLoading: false,
   558	      });
   559	    }
   560	  }, [searchHistory, selectedHistoryId, updateSidebarConfig, isAuthenticated]);
   561	
   562	  // 不再需要认证检查 - 允许未登录用户访问
   563	
   564	  // 加载论文详情的函数
   565	  const loadPaperDetail = useCallback(async (paperId) => {
   566	    if (!paperId) return;
   567	    
   568	    console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Loading paper detail:', paperId);
   569	    setViewMode('paper');
   570	    setDetailPaperId(paperId);
   571	    setDetailLoading(true);
   572	    setDetailError(null);
   573	    setDetailPaper(null);
   574	    setDetailAbstractExpanded(false); // 重置摘要展开状态
   575	    
   576	    try {
   577	      // 使用公共 API，支持未登录用户访问
   578	      const response = await publicScholarAPI.getPaper(paperId);
   579	      console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Paper detail loaded:', response.data);
   580	      // API 返回格式是 {code: 0, message: 'success', data: {...}}，需要取 data.data
   581	      setDetailPaper(response.data.data);
   582	      setDetailLoading(false);
   583	    } catch (error) {
   584	      console.error('[SearchResultsPage] Failed to load paper details:', error);
   585	      setDetailError('加载论文详情失败');
   586	      setDetailLoading(false);
   587	    }
   588	  }, []);
   589	
   590	  // 加载作者详情的函数
   591	  const loadAuthorDetail = useCallback(async (authorId, page = 1) => {
   592	    if (!authorId) return;
   593	    
   594	    console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Loading author detail:', authorId, 'page:', page);
   595	    setViewMode('author');
   596	    setDetailAuthorId(authorId);
   597	    setAuthorLoading(true);
   598	    setAuthorError(null);
   599	    if (page === 1) {
   600	      setDetailAuthor(null);
   601	      setAuthorPapers([]);
   602	    }
   603	    setAuthorPapersPage(page);
   604	    
   605	    const perPage = 20;
   606	    const offset = (page - 1) * perPage;
   607	    
   608	    try {
   609	      // Step 1: 并行加载作者详情和作者论文ID列表
   610	      const [authorResponse, papersIdsResponse] = await Promise.all([
   611	        page === 1 ? publicScholarAPI.getAuthor(authorId) : Promise.resolve(null),
   612	        publicScholarAPI.getAuthorPapers(authorId, offset, perPage, 'paperId') // 只获取 paperId
   613	      ]);
   614	      
   615	      if (page === 1 && authorResponse) {
   616	        console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Author detail loaded:', authorResponse.data);
   617	        if (authorResponse.data.code === 0 && authorResponse.data.data) {
   618	          setDetailAuthor(authorResponse.data.data);
   619	          // 计算总页数
   620	          const totalPapers = authorResponse.data.data.paperCount || 0;
   621	          const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalPapers / perPage);
   622	          console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Total papers:', totalPapers, 'Total pages:', totalPages);
   623	          setAuthorPapersTotal(totalPapers);
   624	          setAuthorPapersTotalPages(totalPages);
   625	        } else {
   626	          throw new Error('Failed to load author details');
   627	        }
   628	      }
   629	      
   630	      // Step 2: 用论文ID批量获取完整论文详情
   631	      if (papersIdsResponse.data.code === 0 && papersIdsResponse.data.data) {
   632	        const paperIds = (papersIdsResponse.data.data.data || []).map(p => p.paperId).filter(id => id);
   633	        console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Paper IDs:', paperIds);
   634	        
   635	        if (paperIds.length > 0) {
   636	          const batchResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getPaperBatch(
   637	            paperIds,
   638	            ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'url', 'venue', 'publicationDate', 'openAccessPdf', 'fieldsOfStudy', 'isOpenAccess', 'referenceCount', 'influentialCitationCount', 'tldr', 'journal', 'externalIds']
   639	          );
   640	          
   641	          console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Batch response:', batchResponse.data);
   642	          if (batchResponse.data.code === 0 && batchResponse.data.data) {
   643	            const papersData = batchResponse.data.data || [];
   644	            console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Papers data length:', papersData.length);
   645	            console.log('[SearchResultsPage] First paper:', papersData[0]);
   646	            setAuthorPapers(papersData);
   647	          } else {
   648	            console.log('[SearchResultsPage] Batch response failed:', batchResponse.data);
   649	          }
   650	        } else {
   651	          setAuthorPapers([]);
   652	        }
   653	      }
   654	      
   655	      setAuthorLoading(false);
   656	    } catch (error) {
   657	      console.error('[SearchResultsPage] Failed to load author details:', error);
   658	      setAuthorError('加载作者详情失败');
   659	      setAuthorLoading(false);
   660	    }
   661	  }, []);
   662	
   663	  // 作者论文分页切换
   664	  const handleAuthorPapersPageChange = useCallback((newPage) => {
   665	    if (newPage < 1 || newPage > authorPapersTotalPages || newPage === authorPapersPage) return;
   666	    loadAuthorDetail(detailAuthorId, newPage);
   667	  }, [detailAuthorId, authorPapersTotalPages, authorPapersPage, loadAuthorDetail]);
   668	
   669	  // 作者论文表格视图 - 加载更多（累积加载，与相似论文逻辑一致）
   670	  const loadMoreAuthorPapersForTable = useCallback(async () => {
   671	    if (!detailAuthorId || authorPapersLoading) return;
   672	    
   673	    // 计算下一页
   674	    const currentLoadedPages = Math.ceil(allAuthorPapers.length / 20);
   675	    const nextPage = currentLoadedPages + 1;
   676	    const totalPages = authorPapersTotalPages;
   677	    
   678	    if (nextPage > totalPages) return;
   679	    
   680	    setAuthorPapersLoading(true);
   681	    const offset = (nextPage - 1) * 20;
   682	    
   683	    try {
   684	      // Step 1: 获取论文ID
   685	      const papersIdsResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getAuthorPapers(detailAuthorId, offset, 20, 'paperId');
   686	      
   687	      if (papersIdsResponse.data.code === 0 && papersIdsResponse.data.data) {
   688	        const paperIds = (papersIdsResponse.data.data.data || []).map(p => p.paperId).filter(id => id);
   689	        
   690	        if (paperIds.length > 0) {
   691	          // Step 2: 批量获取论文详情
   692	          const batchResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getPaperBatch(
   693	            paperIds,
   694	            ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'url', 'venue', 'publicationDate', 'openAccessPdf', 'fieldsOfStudy', 'isOpenAccess', 'referenceCount', 'influentialCitationCount', 'tldr', 'journal', 'externalIds']
   695	          );
   696	          
   697	          if (batchResponse.data.code === 0 && batchResponse.data.data) {
   698	            const newPapers = batchResponse.data.data || [];
   699	            // 累积添加到所有论文列表
   700	            setAllAuthorPapers(prev => [...prev, ...newPapers]);
   701	          }
   702	        }
   703	      }
   704	    } catch (error) {
   705	      console.error('[SearchResultsPage] Failed to load more author papers for table:', error);
   706	    } finally {
   707	      setAuthorPapersLoading(false);
   708	    }
   709	  }, [detailAuthorId, authorPapersLoading, allAuthorPapers.length, authorPapersTotalPages]);
   710	
   711	  // 当切换到表格视图时，从第一页开始加载数据
   712	  const initAuthorTableFromFirstPage = useCallback(async () => {
   713	    if (!detailAuthorId || authorPapersLoading) return;
   714	    
   715	    setAuthorPapersLoading(true);
   716	    
   717	    try {
   718	      // 从第一页开始加载
   719	      const papersIdsResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getAuthorPapers(detailAuthorId, 0, 20, 'paperId');
   720	      
   721	      if (papersIdsResponse.data.code === 0 && papersIdsResponse.data.data) {
   722	        const paperIds = (papersIdsResponse.data.data.data || []).map(p => p.paperId).filter(id => id);
   723	        
   724	        if (paperIds.length > 0) {
   725	          const batchResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getPaperBatch(
   726	            paperIds,
   727	            ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'url', 'venue', 'publicationDate', 'openAccessPdf', 'fieldsOfStudy', 'isOpenAccess', 'referenceCount', 'influentialCitationCount', 'tldr', 'journal', 'externalIds']
   728	          );
   729	          
   730	          if (batchResponse.data.code === 0 && batchResponse.data.data) {
   731	            const papers = batchResponse.data.data || [];
   732	            setAllAuthorPapers(papers);
   733	          }
   734	        }
   735	      }
   736	    } catch (error) {
   737	      console.error('[SearchResultsPage] Failed to init author table from first page:', error);
   738	    } finally {
   739	      setAuthorPapersLoading(false);
   740	    }
   741	  }, [detailAuthorId, authorPapersLoading]);
   742	
   743	  useEffect(() => {
   744	    if (viewMode === 'author' && authorPapersViewMode === 'table' && detailAuthorId && allAuthorPapers.length === 0 && !authorPapersLoading) {
   745	      // 从第一页开始加载表格数据
   746	      initAuthorTableFromFirstPage();
   747	    }
   748	  }, [viewMode, authorPapersViewMode, detailAuthorId, allAuthorPapers.length, authorPapersLoading, initAuthorTableFromFirstPage]);
   749	
   750	  // 监听 URL 中的 paperId 或 authorId 参数变化
   751	  useEffect(() => {
   752	    const paperId = searchParams.get('paperId');
   753	    const authorId = searchParams.get('authorId');
   754	    const query = searchParams.get('query');
   755	    
   756	    console.log('[SearchResultsPage] URL params changed - paperId:', paperId, 'authorId:', authorId, 'query:', query);
   757	    
   758	    if (authorId) {
   759	      // URL 中有 authorId，加载作者详情
   760	      loadAuthorDetail(authorId);
   761	      // 如果有 query 参数，也设置搜索框的值
   762	      if (query) {
   763	        setSearchQuery(query);
   764	      }
   765	    } else if (paperId) {
   766	      // URL 中有 paperId，加载论文详情
   767	      loadPaperDetail(paperId);
   768	      // 如果有 query 参数，也设置搜索框的值
   769	      if (query) {
   770	        setSearchQuery(query);
   771	      }
   772	      // 注意：相似论文引导的显示逻辑移到单独的 useEffect 中，等待论文详情加载完成后再显示
   773	    }
   774	  }, [searchParams]); // 监听 URL 参数变化
   775	
   776	  // 相似论文新手引导 - 等待论文详情加载完成后显示
   777	  useEffect(() => {
   778	    // 只有当论文详情加载完成且有选中的论文时才考虑显示引导
   779	    if (detailLoading || !selectedPaper) return;
   780	    
   781	    // 检查是否需要显示相似论文引导弹窗（每个用户只显示一次）
   782	    const hasSeenSimilarGuide = localStorage.getItem('similarPapersGuideShown');
   783	    if (hasSeenSimilarGuide) return;
   784	    
   785	    // 检查用户是否已经点击过相似论文标签
   786	    if (hasClickedSimilarTabRef.current) return;
   787	    
   788	    // 延迟显示，等待 DOM 渲染完成
   789	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   790	      // 再次检查用户是否点击过
   791	      if (hasClickedSimilarTabRef.current) return;
   792	      
   793	      // 检查相似论文标签按钮是否在可见范围内
   794	      if (similarPapersTabRef.current) {
   795	        const rect = similarPapersTabRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
   796	        const isVisible = (
   797	          rect.top >= 0 &&
   798	          rect.left >= 0 &&
   799	          rect.bottom <= (window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight) &&
   800	          rect.right <= (window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth)
   801	        );
   802	        
   803	        if (!isVisible) {
   804	          // 如果不在可见范围内，先滚动到可见位置
   805	          similarPapersTabRef.current.scrollIntoView({ 
   806	            behavior: 'smooth', 
   807	            block: 'center',
   808	            inline: 'nearest'
   809	          });
   810	          // 等待滚动完成后再显示引导
   811	          setTimeout(() => {
   812	            // 再次检查用户是否点击过
   813	            if (!hasClickedSimilarTabRef.current) {
   814	              setShowSimilarPapersGuide(true);
   815	            }
   816	          }, 500);
   817	        } else {
   818	          // 已经在可见范围内，直接显示引导
   819	          setShowSimilarPapersGuide(true);
   820	        }
   821	      } else {
   822	        // 如果 ref 还没准备好，直接显示引导
   823	        setShowSimilarPapersGuide(true);
   824	      }
   825	    }, 800); // 等待 DOM 渲染
   826	    
   827	    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
   828	  }, [detailLoading, selectedPaper]); // 监听论文详情加载状态和选中的论文
   829	
   830	  // 标记是否已经点击过表格按钮
   831	  const hasClickedTableBtnRef = useRef(false);
   832	
   833	  // 初始化时从URL参数加载搜索结果（不包含 paperId 或 authorId 的情况）
   834	  useEffect(() => {
   835	    const query = searchParams.get('query');
   836	    const paperId = searchParams.get('paperId');
   837	    const authorId = searchParams.get('authorId');
   838	    
   839	    // 如果有 paperId 或 authorId，由上面的 useEffect 处理
   840	    if (paperId || authorId) return;
   841	    
   842	    if (query) {
   843	      setSearchQuery(query);
   844	      performSearch(query, filters, currentPage);
   845	    }
   846	  }, []); // 只在组件挂载时执行一次
   847	    
   848	  // 监听搜索结果加载完成，显示表格视图引导
   849	  useEffect(() => {
   850	    // 只有当不在加载中、有结果、且用户没点击过表格按钮时才显示引导
   851	    if (!loading && papers.length > 0 && !hasClickedTableBtnRef.current) {
   852	    const hasSeenTableGuide = localStorage.getItem('hasSeenTableViewGuide');
   853	      if (!hasSeenTableGuide) {
   854	        // 延迟一点显示，让用户先看到结果
   855	        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   856	          if (!hasClickedTableBtnRef.current) {
   857	        setShowTableGuide(true);
   858	          }
   859	        }, 500);
   860	        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
   861	    }
   862	    }
   863	  }, [loading, papers.length]); // 当 loading 状态或 papers 变化时检查
   864	
   865	  // 监听相似论文加载完成，显示表格视图引导
   866	  useEffect(() => {
   867	    // 只有当：
   868	    // 1. 论文详情加载完成（detailLoading = false）
   869	    // 2. 切换到相似论文 tab
   870	    // 3. 相似论文不在加载中
   871	    // 4. 有相似论文结果
   872	    // 5. 用户没点击过表格按钮
   873	    // 才显示引导
   874	    if (!detailLoading && detailActiveTab === 'similar' && !similarPapersLoading && similarPapersData.papers.length > 0 && !hasClickedSimilarTableBtnRef.current) {
   875	      const hasSeenTableGuide = localStorage.getItem('hasSeenTableViewGuide');
   876	      if (!hasSeenTableGuide) {
   877	        // 延迟一点显示，让用户先看到结果
   878	        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   879	          if (!hasClickedSimilarTableBtnRef.current) {
   880	            setShowSimilarTableGuide(true);
   881	          }
   882	        }, 800);
   883	        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
   884	      }
   885	    }
   886	  }, [detailLoading, detailActiveTab, similarPapersLoading, similarPapersData.papers.length]);
   887	
   888	  // 监听作者页面数据加载完成，显示表格视图引导
   889	  useEffect(() => {
   890	    // 只有当：
   891	    // 1. 是作者视图模式
   892	    // 2. 作者详情加载完成（authorLoading = false）
   893	    // 3. 作者数据存在（有 detailAuthor）
   894	    // 4. 作者论文加载完成（authorPapersLoading = false）
   895	    // 5. 有作者论文结果
   896	    // 6. 用户没点击过作者表格按钮
   897	    // 才显示引导
   898	    if (viewMode === 'author' && !authorLoading && detailAuthor && !authorPapersLoading && authorPapers.length > 0 && !hasClickedAuthorTableBtnRef.current) {
   899	      const hasSeenTableGuide = localStorage.getItem('hasSeenTableViewGuide');

   910	  }, [viewMode, authorLoading, detailAuthor, authorPapersLoading, authorPapers.length]);

   924	  // 监听论文列表滚动，控制搜索框收缩
   925	  useEffect(() => {
   926	    let scrollHandler = null;
   927	    let retryCount = 0;
   928	    const maxRetries = 10;
   929	    
   930	    const setupScrollListener = () => {
   931	      const container = papersContainerRef.current;
   932	      
   933	      if (!container) {
   934	        // 如果容器还不存在，重试
   935	        if (retryCount < maxRetries) {
   936	          retryCount++;
   937	          setTimeout(setupScrollListener, 200);
   938	        }
   939	        return;
   940	      }
   941	
   942	      const scrollThreshold = 50; // 滚动多少像素后触发收缩
   943	
   944	      scrollHandler = () => {
   945	        const scrollTop = container.scrollTop;
   946	        
   947	        // 向下滚动超过阈值时收缩
   948	        if (scrollTop > scrollThreshold) {
   949	          setIsSearchBarCollapsed(true);
   950	        }
   951	        // 滚动回顶部时展开
   952	        else if (scrollTop <= 10) {
   953	          setIsSearchBarCollapsed(false);
   954	        }
   955	      };
   956	
   957	      // 初始化时检查滚动位置
   958	      scrollHandler();
   959	
   960	      // 添加滚动监听器
   961	      container.addEventListener('scroll', scrollHandler, { passive: true });
   962	    };
   963	
   964	    // 开始设置监听器
   965	    setupScrollListener();
   966	
   967	    // 清理函数
   968	    return () => {
   969	      if (scrollHandler && papersContainerRef.current) {
   970	        papersContainerRef.current.removeEventListener('scroll', scrollHandler);
   971	      }
   972	    };
   973	  }, [location.pathname, papers.length]); // 依赖于路径变化和论文数据变化
   974	
   975	  // 论文详情模式下：点击外部或滚动时收起搜索框，展开时自动聚焦

  1014	    }
  1015

  1017	      document.removeEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
  1018	      if (container) {

  1164	  // 加载引用文献（分页）- 使用 batch API 获取详细信息
  1165	  const loadCitations = useCallback(async (page = 1) => {
  1166	    if (!detailPaper || citationsLoading) return;
  1167	    
  1168	    // 翻页时关闭右侧预览
  1169	    setSelectedPaper(null);
  1170	    
  1171	    // 获取原始引用列表中的 paper IDs
  1172	    const allCitations = detailPaper.citations || [];
  1173	    if (allCitations.length === 0) return;
  1174	    
  1175	    const totalPages = Math.ceil(allCitations.length / REFS_PER_PAGE);
  1176	    const startIndex = (page - 1) * REFS_PER_PAGE;
  1177	    const endIndex = startIndex + REFS_PER_PAGE;
  1178	    
  1179	    // 获取当前页的 paper IDs
  1180	    const pageIds = allCitations
  1181	      .slice(startIndex, endIndex)
  1182	      .map(c => c.paperId)

  1186

  1189	      const response = await publicScholarAPI.getPaperBatch(
  1190	        pageIds,
  1191	        ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'url', 'venue', 'publicationDate', 'openAccessPdf', 'fieldsOfStudy', 'isOpenAccess', 'referenceCount', 'influentialCitationCount', 'tldr', 'journal', 'externalIds']
  1192	      );
  1193

  1195	      
  1196	      setCitationsData({
  1197	        papers: newPapers,
  1198	        currentPage: page,
  1199	        total: allCitations.length,
  1200	        totalPages: totalPages
  1201	      });
  1202	    } catch (error) {
  1203	      console.error('Failed to load citations:', error);
  1204	    } finally {
  1205	      setCitationsLoading(false);
  1206	    }
  1207	  }, [detailPaper, citationsLoading, REFS_PER_PAGE]);

  1209	  // 加载参考文献（分页）- 使用 batch API 获取详细信息

  1223

  1225	    const pageIds = allReferences

  1254	  // 加载相似论文（分页）- 先获取推荐论文ID列表，再通过batch接口获取详细信息
  1255	  // append 参数用于表格视图的累积加载模式
  1256	  const loadSimilarPapers = useCallback(async (page = 1, append = false) => {
  1257	    if (!detailPaper || similarPapersLoading) return;
  1258	    
  1259	    // 翻页时关闭右侧预览
  1260	    setSelectedPaper(null);

  1263	    try {
  1264	      // 如果还没有加载过所有相似论文ID，先获取推荐列表
  1265	      let allPaperIds = allSimilarPapers;
  1266	      if (allPaperIds.length === 0) {
  1267	        // 只获取论文ID（推荐接口默认只返回paperId和title）
  1268	        const recResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getRecommendations(
  1269	          detailPaper.paperId,
  1270	          100 // 最多获取100篇推荐论文
  1271	        );
  1272	        
  1273	        const recommendedPapers = recResponse.data?.data?.recommendedPapers || recResponse.data?.recommendedPapers || [];
  1274	        // 提取论文ID列表
  1275	        allPaperIds = recommendedPapers.map(p => p.paperId).filter(id => id);
  1276	        setAllSimilarPapers(allPaperIds);
  1277	      }
  1278	      
  1279	      if (allPaperIds.length === 0) {
  1280	        setSimilarPapersData({
  1281	          papers: [],
  1282	          currentPage: 1,
  1283	          total: 0,
  1284	          totalPages: 0
  1285	        });
  1286	        return;
  1287	      }
  1288	      
  1289	      // 分页获取当前页的论文ID
  1290	      const totalPages = Math.ceil(allPaperIds.length / REFS_PER_PAGE);
  1291	      const startIndex = (page - 1) * REFS_PER_PAGE;
  1292	      const endIndex = startIndex + REFS_PER_PAGE;
  1293	      const pageIds = allPaperIds.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
  1294	      
  1295	      // 通过batch接口获取详细信息
  1296	      const batchResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getPaperBatch(
  1297	        pageIds,
  1298	        ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'url', 'venue', 'publicationDate', 'openAccessPdf', 'fieldsOfStudy', 'isOpenAccess', 'referenceCount', 'influentialCitationCount', 'tldr', 'journal', 'externalIds']
  1299	      );
  1300	      
  1301	      const pagePapers = batchResponse.data?.data || batchResponse.data || [];
  1302	      
  1303	      setSimilarPapersData(prev => {
  1304	        // 如果是累积模式（表格视图的加载更多），追加到现有数据
  1305	        if (append && prev.papers.length > 0) {
  1306	          // 去重

  1308	          const newPapers = pagePapers.filter(p => !existingIds.has(p.paperId));
  1309	          return {
  1310	            papers: [...prev.papers, ...newPapers],
  1311	            currentPage: page,
  1312	            total: allPaperIds.length,
  1313	            totalPages: totalPages
  1314	          };
  1315	        }
  1316	        // 否则替换数据（列表视图的分页）
  1317	        return {
  1318	          papers: pagePapers,
  1319	          currentPage: page,
  1320	          total: allPaperIds.length,
  1321	          totalPages: totalPages
  1322	        };
  1323	      });
  1324	    } catch (error) {
  1325	      console.error('Failed to load similar papers:', error);
  1326	      setSimilarPapersData({
  1327	        papers: [],
  1328	        currentPage: 1,
  1329	        total: 0,
  1330	        totalPages: 0
  1331	      });
  1332	    } finally {
  1333	      setSimilarPapersLoading(false);
  1334	    }
  1335	  }, [detailPaper, similarPapersLoading, allSimilarPapers, REFS_PER_PAGE]);

  1351	  // 更新URL参数

  1360	    if (currentFilters.openAccessPdf) params.set('openAccessPdf', currentFilters.openAccessPdf);
  1361	    if (currentFilters.venue) params.set('venue', currentFilters.venue);
  1362	    if (page > 1) params.set('page', page);
  1363	
  1364	    setSearchParams(params);
  1365	  };

  1415	
  1416	  // 检查是否有筛选条件
  1417	  const hasActiveFilters = () => {
  1418	    return filters.yearFrom ||
  1419	           filters.yearTo ||
  1420	           filters.publicationTypes.length > 0 ||

  1423	           filters.venue;

  1451	      tags.push({ key: 'venue', label: filters.venue, type: 'venue' });
  1452	    }

  1454	    return tags;

  1471	      newFilters.publicationTypes = newFilters.publicationTypes.filter(t => t !== typeName);
  1472	    } else if (tagType === 'venue') {
  1473	      newFilters.venue = '';
  1474	    }
  1475	    
  1476	    setFilters(newFilters);
  1477	    
  1478	    // 如果已经执行过搜索，自动重新搜索
  1479	    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
  1480	    setCurrentPage(1);
  1481	    updateURL(searchQuery, newFilters, 1);
  1482	    performSearch(searchQuery, newFilters, 1);
  1483	    }
  1484	  };

  1543	      if (event.touches.length !== 1) {
  1544	        return;
  1545	      }

  1548	    };

  1555	      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', finishResize);
  1556	      document.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, touchMoveOptions);
  1557	      document.removeEventListener('touchend', finishResize);
  1558	      document.body.style.cursor = '';
  1559	      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
  1560	    };
  1561	
  1562	    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  1563	    document.addEventListener('mouseup', finishResize);
  1564	    document.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, touchMoveOptions);
  1565	    document.addEventListener('touchend', finishResize);
  1566	    document.body.style.cursor = 'col-resize';
  1567	    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
  1568	  };

  1570	  const handlePreviewResizeMouseDown = (event) => {

  3710	      {/* 相似论文引导弹窗 */}
  3711	      {showSimilarPapersGuide && (
  3712	        <SimilarPapersGuide
  3713	          targetRef={similarPapersTabRef}
  3714	          onDismiss={() => {
  3715	            // X 按钮 - 只关闭，下次还会显示
  3716	            setShowSimilarPapersGuide(false);
  3717	          }}
  3718	          onClose={() => {
  3719	            // "稍后再说" - 关闭并记住
  3720	            setShowSimilarPapersGuide(false);
  3721	            localStorage.setItem('similarPapersGuideShown', 'true');
  3722	          }}
  3723	          onTryIt={() => {
  3724	            // "立即体验" - 关闭并记住，切换到相似论文 Tab
  3725	            setShowSimilarPapersGuide(false);
  3726	            localStorage.setItem('similarPapersGuideShown', 'true');
  3727	            setDetailActiveTab('similar');
  3728	            setDetailHeaderCollapsed(true);
  3729	          }}
  3730	        />
  3731	      )}
  3732	
  3733	      {/* 相似论文表格视图引导弹窗 */}
  3734	      {showSimilarTableGuide && (
  3735	        <TableViewGuide
  3736	          targetRef={similarTableBtnRef}
  3737	          onDismiss={() => {
  3738	            // X 按钮 - 只关闭，下次还会显示
  3739	            setShowSimilarTableGuide(false);
  3740	          }}
  3741	          onClose={() => {
  3742	            // "稍后再说" - 关闭并记住
  3743	            setShowSimilarTableGuide(false);
  3744	            localStorage.setItem('hasSeenTableViewGuide', 'true');
  3745	          }}
  3746	          onTryIt={() => {
  3747	            // "立即体验" - 关闭并记住，切换到表格视图
  3748	            setShowSimilarTableGuide(false);
  3749	            localStorage.setItem('hasSeenTableViewGuide', 'true');
  3750	            hasClickedSimilarTableBtnRef.current = true;
  3751	            setSimilarPapersViewMode('table');
  3752	          }}
  3753	        />
  3754	      )}
  3755	
  3756	      {/* 作者页面表格视图引导弹窗 */}
  3757	      {showAuthorTableGuide && (
  3758	        <TableViewGuide
  3759	          targetRef={authorTableBtnRef}
  3760	          onDismiss={() => {
  3761	            // X 按钮 - 只关闭，下次还会显示
  3762	            setShowAuthorTableGuide(false);
  3763	          }}
  3764	          onClose={() => {
  3765	            // "稍后再说" - 关闭并记住
  3766	            setShowAuthorTableGuide(false);
  3767	            localStorage.setItem('hasSeenTableViewGuide', 'true');
  3768	          }}
  3769	          onTryIt={() => {
  3770	            // "立即体验" - 关闭并记住，切换到表格视图
  3771	            setShowAuthorTableGuide(false);
  3772	            localStorage.setItem('hasSeenTableViewGuide', 'true');
  3773	            hasClickedAuthorTableBtnRef.current = true;
  3774	            setAuthorPapersViewMode('table');
  3775	            // 切换到表格视图时，关闭预览窗口
  3776	            setSelectedPaper(null);
  3777	            // 重置表格数据，从第一页开始加载
  3778	            setAllAuthorPapers([]);
  3779	          }}
  3780	        />
  3781	      )}
  3782	    </div>
  3783	  );
  3784	};
  3785	
  3786	export default SearchResultsPage;

   281	  const maskEmail = (email) => {

   511	
   512	      // Mark as binding mode
   513	      localStorage.setItem('wechat_bind_mode', 'bind');

   515	      // Get WeChat login URL from backend (backend will generate state)
   516	      const response = await api.get('/user/wechat/login-url');
   517	
   518	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   519	        const loginURL = response.data.data.login_url;
   520	        const state = response.data.data.state;
   521	
   522	        // Save backend-generated state for verification after callback
   523	        localStorage.setItem('wechat_bind_state', state);
   524	
   525	        // Redirect to WeChat OAuth page
   526	        window.location.href = loginURL;
   527	      } else {
   528	        showError('获取微信登录链接失败');
   529	      }
   530	    } catch (err) {
   531	      console.error('WeChat binding error:', err);
   532	      showError('微信绑定失败,请稍后重试');
   533	    }
   534	  };
   535	
   536	  // Handle GitHub binding
   537	  const handleBindGitHub = async () => {
   538	    try {
   539	      // Save current page URL for return after binding
   540	      const currentPath = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
   541	      localStorage.setItem('github_return_url', currentPath);
   542	
   543	      // Get GitHub login URL
   544	      const response = await api.get('/user/github/login-url');
   545	
   546	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   547	        const { url, state } = response.data.data;
   548	
   549	        // Store state and bind mode in localStorage for verification
   550	        localStorage.setItem('github_bind_state', state);
   551	        localStorage.setItem('github_bind_mode', 'bind');
   552	
   553	        // Redirect to GitHub OAuth
   554	        window.location.href = url;
   555	      } else {
   556	        showError('获取 GitHub 登录链接失败');
   557	      }
   558	    } catch (err) {
   559	      console.error('GitHub binding error:', err);
   560	      showError('GitHub 绑定失败,请稍后重试');
   561	    }
   562	  };
   563	
   564	  // Count available login methods
   565	  const getLoginMethodCount = () => {
   566	    let count = 0;
   567	    if (user?.email) count++;
   568	    if (user?.phone) count++;
   569	    if (user?.wechat_openid) count++;
   570	    if (user?.github_id) count++;
   571	    return count;
   572	  };
   573	
   574	  // Modal handlers
   575	  const handleOpenModal = (type, currentValue) => {
   576	    const titles = {
   577	      'bind-email': '绑定邮箱',
   578	      'bind-phone': '绑定手机号',
   579	      'rebind-email': '换绑邮箱',
   580	      'rebind-phone': '换绑手机号',
   581	      'unbind-email': '解绑邮箱',
   582	      'unbind-phone': '解绑手机号',
   583	      'unbind-wechat': '解绑微信',
   584	      'unbind-github': '解绑 GitHub',
   585	      'change-password': '修改密码'
   586	    };
   587	
   588	    setAccountModal({
   589	      show: true,
   590	      type,
   591	      title: titles[type] || '',
   592	      currentValue,
   593	      step: 1 // Always start at step 1
   594	    });
   595	
   596	    // Reset form
   597	    setModalForm({
   598	      email: '',
   599	      phone: '',
   600	      code: '',
   601	      password: '',
   602	      newPassword: '',
   603	      confirmPassword: ''
   604	    });
   605	    setModalCodeCountdown(0);
   606	  };
   607	
   608	  const handleCloseModal = () => {
   609	    setAccountModal({
   610	      show: false,
   611	      type: '',
   612	      title: '',
   613	      currentValue: '',
   614	      step: 1
   615	    });
   616	    setModalForm({
   617	      email: '',
   618	      phone: '',
   619	      code: '',
   620	      password: '',
   621	      newPassword: '',
   622	      confirmPassword: ''
   623	    });
   624	    setModalCodeCountdown(0);
   625	  };
   626	
   627	  // Check availability and proceed to step 2 (for bind/rebind operations)
   628	  const handleCheckAvailability = async () => {
   629	    const type = accountModal.type;
   630	    setLoading(true);
   631	
   632	    try {
   633	      let response;
   634	
   635	      if (type.includes('email')) {
   636	        // Validate email format
   637	        if (!modalForm.email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(modalForm.email)) {
   638	          showError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
   639	          setLoading(false);
   640	          return;
   641	        }
   642	
   643	        // Check email availability
   644	        response = await api.post('/user/check-email-availability', {
   645	          email: modalForm.email
   646	        });
   647	      } else if (type.includes('phone')) {
   648	        // Validate phone format
   649	        if (!modalForm.phone || !/^1[3-9]\d{9}$/.test(modalForm.phone)) {
   650	          showError('请输入有效的手机号码');
   651	          setLoading(false);
   652	          return;
   653	        }
   654	
   655	        // Check phone availability
   656	        response = await api.post('/user/check-phone-availability', {
   657	          phone: modalForm.phone
   658	        });
   659	      }
   660	
   661	      if (response && response.data.code === 0) {
   662	        if (response.data.data.available) {
   663	          // Available - proceed to step 2
   664	          setAccountModal(prev => ({ ...prev, step: 2 }));
   665	          showSuccess('验证通过,请继续输入验证码');
   666	        } else {
   667	          // Not available
   668	          if (type.includes('email')) {
   669	            showError('该邮箱已被其他账号绑定');
   670	          } else {
   671	            showError('该手机号已被其他账号绑定');
   672	          }
   673	        }
   674	      } else {
   675	        showError('检查失败：' + (response?.data?.message || '未知错误'));
   676	      }
   677	    } catch (error) {
   678	      showError('检查失败,请稍后重试');
   679	      console.error('Failed to check availability:', error);
   680	    } finally {
   681	      setLoading(false);
   682	    }
   683	  };
   684	
   685	  // Send modal verification code
   686	  const handleSendModalCode = async () => {
   687	    if (modalCodeCountdown > 0) return;
   688	
   689	    const type = accountModal.type;
   690	    let endpoint = '';
   691	    let payload = {};
   692	    let purpose = '';
   693	
   694	    // Determine endpoint and purpose based on modal type
   695	    if (type.includes('email')) {
   696	      if (!modalForm.email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(modalForm.email)) {
   697	        showError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
   698	        return;
   699	      }
   700	      endpoint = '/user/send-code';
   701	      payload = { email: modalForm.email, purpose: type.includes('bind') ? 'bind' : 'unbind' };
   702	    } else if (type.includes('phone')) {
   703	      if (!modalForm.phone || !/^1[3-9]\d{9}$/.test(modalForm.phone)) {
   704	        showError('请输入有效的手机号码');
   705	        return;
   706	      }
   707	      endpoint = '/user/send-phone-code';
   708	      payload = { phone: modalForm.phone, purpose: type.includes('bind') ? 'bind' : 'unbind' };
   709	    }
   710	
   711	    setLoading(true);
   712	
   713	    try {
   714	      const response = await api.post(endpoint, payload);
   715	
   716	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   717	        setModalCodeCountdown(60);
   718	        showSuccess('验证码已发送');
   719	      } else {
   720	        showError('发送验证码失败：' + response.data.message);
   721	      }
   722	    } catch (error) {
   723	      showError('发送验证码失败,请稍后重试');
   724	      console.error('Failed to send code:', error);
   725	    } finally {
   726	      setLoading(false);
   727	    }
   728	  };
   729	
   730	  // Handle modal submit
   731	  const handleModalSubmit = async () => {
   732	    const type = accountModal.type;
   733	    setLoading(true);
   734	
   735	    try {
   736	      let response;
   737	
   738	      switch (type) {
   739	        case 'bind-email':
   740	          if (!modalForm.email || !modalForm.code) {
   741	            showError('请填写完整信息');
   742	            setLoading(false);
   743	            return;
   744	          }
   745	          response = await api.post('/user/bind-email', {
   746	            email: modalForm.email,
   747	            code: modalForm.code
   748	          });
   749	          break;
   750	
   751	        case 'bind-phone':
   752	          if (!modalForm.phone || !modalForm.code) {
   753	            showError('请填写完整信息');
   754	            setLoading(false);
   755	            return;
   756	          }
   757	          response = await api.post('/user/bind-phone', {
   758	            phone: modalForm.phone,
   759	            code: modalForm.code
   760	          });
   761	          break;
   762	
   763	        case 'rebind-email':
   764	          if (!modalForm.email || !modalForm.code) {
   765	            showError('请填写完整信息');
   766	            setLoading(false);
   767	            return;
   768	          }
   769	          // Direct replacement - bind new email (will replace the old one)
   770	          response = await api.post('/user/bind-email', {
   771	            email: modalForm.email,
   772	            code: modalForm.code
   773	          });
   774	          break;
   775	
   776	        case 'rebind-phone':
   777	          if (!modalForm.phone || !modalForm.code) {
   778	            showError('请填写完整信息');
   779	            setLoading(false);
   780	            return;
   781	          }
   782	          // Direct replacement - bind new phone (will replace the old one)
   783	          response = await api.post('/user/bind-phone', {
   784	            phone: modalForm.phone,
   785	            code: modalForm.code
   786	          });
   787	          break;
   788	
   789	        case 'unbind-email':
   790	          if (!modalForm.code) {
   791	            showError('请输入验证码');
   792	            setLoading(false);
   793	            return;
   794	          }
   795	          response = await api.post('/user/unbind-email', { code: modalForm.code });
   796	          break;
   797	
   798	        case 'unbind-phone':
   799	          if (!modalForm.code) {
   800	            showError('请输入验证码');
   801	            setLoading(false);
   802	            return;
   803	          }
   804	          response = await api.post('/user/unbind-phone', { code: modalForm.code });
   805	          break;
   806	
   807	        case 'unbind-wechat':
   808	          response = await api.post('/user/unbind-wechat');
   809	          break;
   810	
   811	        case 'unbind-github':
   812	          response = await api.post('/user/unbind-github');
   813	          break;
   814	
   815	        case 'change-password':
   816	          if (!modalForm.password || !modalForm.newPassword || !modalForm.confirmPassword) {
   817	            showError('请填写完整信息');
   818	            setLoading(false);
   819	            return;
   820	          }
   821	          if (modalForm.newPassword !== modalForm.confirmPassword) {
   822	            showError('两次输入的密码不一致');
   823	            setLoading(false);
   824	            return;
   825	          }
   826	          if (modalForm.newPassword.length < 8) {
   827	            showError('新密码长度至少为8个字符');
   828	            setLoading(false);
   829	            return;
   830	          }
   831	          response = await api.post('/user/change-password', {
   832	            current_password: modalForm.password,
   833	            new_password: modalForm.newPassword
   834	          });
   835	          break;
   836	
   837	        default:
   838	          setLoading(false);
   839	          return;
   840	      }
   841	
   842	      if (response && response.data.code === 0) {
   843	        showSuccess('操作成功');
   844	        handleCloseModal();
   845	        // Refresh user profile
   846	        fetchUserProfile();
   847	      } else {
   848	        showError('操作失败：' + (response?.data?.message || '未知错误'));
   849	      }
   850	    } catch (error) {
   851	      showError('操作失败,请稍后重试');
   852	      console.error('Modal submit error:', error);
   853	    } finally {
   854	      setLoading(false);
   855	    }
   856	  };
   857	
   858	  // Render modal content based on type
   859	  const renderModalContent = () => {
   860	    const type = accountModal.type;
   861	    const step = accountModal.step;
   862	
   863	    if (type === 'bind-email' || type === 'rebind-email') {
   864	      if (step === 1) {
   865	        // Step 1: Enter email and check availability
   866	        return (
   867	          <>
   868	            {type === 'rebind-email' && (
   869	              <div className="modal-info">
   870	                <p>当前邮箱: <strong>{accountModal.currentValue}</strong></p>
   871	                <p>请输入新邮箱地址</p>
   872	              </div>
   873	            )}
   874	            <div className="modal-form-group">
   875	              <label>新邮箱地址</label>
   876	              <input
   877	                type="email"
   878	                value={modalForm.email}
   879	                onChange={(e) => setModalForm({ ...modalForm, email: e.target.value })}
   880	                placeholder="输入邮箱地址"
   881	              />
   882	            </div>
   883	            <button className="btn-modal-submit" onClick={handleCheckAvailability} disabled={loading}>
   884	              {loading ? '检查中...' : '继续'}
   885	            </button>
   886	          </>
   887	        );
   888	      } else {
   889	        // Step 2: Enter verification code
   890	        return (
   891	          <>
   892	            <div className="modal-info">
   893	              <p>邮箱: <strong>{modalForm.email}</strong></p>
   894	              <button
   895	                className="btn-link"
   896	                onClick={() => setAccountModal(prev => ({ ...prev, step: 1 }))}
   897	              >
   898	                返回修改
   899	              </button>
   900	            </div>
   901	            <div className="modal-form-group">
   902	              <label>验证码</label>
   903	              <div className="modal-code-input">
   904	                <input
   905	                  type="text"
   906	                  value={modalForm.code}
   907	                  onChange={(e) => setModalForm({ ...modalForm, code: e.target.value })}
   908	                  placeholder="输入验证码"
   909	                  maxLength={6}
   910	                />
   911	                <button
   912	                  className="btn-send-code"
   913	                  onClick={handleSendModalCode}
   914	                  disabled={modalCodeCountdown > 0 || loading}
   915	                >
   916	                  {modalCodeCountdown > 0 ? `${modalCodeCountdown}秒` : '发送验证码'}
   917	                </button>
   918	              </div>
   919	            </div>
   920	            <button className="btn-modal-submit" onClick={handleModalSubmit} disabled={loading}>
   921	              {loading ? '处理中...' : '确认'}
   922	            </button>
   923	          </>
   924	        );
   925	      }
   926	    }
   927	
   928	    if (type === 'bind-phone' || type === 'rebind-phone') {
   929	      if (step === 1) {
   930	        // Step 1: Enter phone and check availability
   931	        return (
   932	          <>
   933	            {type === 'rebind-phone' && (
   934	              <div className="modal-info">
   935	                <p>当前手机号: <strong>{accountModal.currentValue}</strong></p>
   936	                <p>请输入新手机号</p>
   937	              </div>
   938	            )}
   939	            <div className="modal-form-group">
   940	              <label>新手机号</label>
   941	              <input
   942	                type="tel"
   943	                value={modalForm.phone}
   944	                onChange={(e) => setModalForm({ ...modalForm, phone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '') })}
   945	                placeholder="输入11位手机号码"
   946	                maxLength={11}
   947	              />
   948	            </div>
   949	            <button className="btn-modal-submit" onClick={handleCheckAvailability} disabled={loading}>
   950	              {loading ? '检查中...' : '继续'}
   951	            </button>
   952	          </>
   953	        );
   954	      } else {
   955	        // Step 2: Enter verification code
   956	        return (
   957	          <>
   958	            <div className="modal-info">
   959	              <p>手机号: <strong>{modalForm.phone}</strong></p>
   960	              <button
   961	                className="btn-link"
   962	                onClick={() => setAccountModal(prev => ({ ...prev, step: 1 }))}
   963	              >
   964	                返回修改
   965	              </button>
   966	            </div>
   967	            <div className="modal-form-group">
   968	              <label>验证码</label>
   969	              <div className="modal-code-input">
   970	                <input
   971	                  type="text"
   972	                  value={modalForm.code}
   973	                  onChange={(e) => setModalForm({ ...modalForm, code: e.target.value })}
   974	                  placeholder="输入验证码"
   975	                  maxLength={6}
   976	                />
   977	                <button
   978	                  className="btn-send-code"
   979	                  onClick={handleSendModalCode}
   980	                  disabled={modalCodeCountdown > 0 || loading}
   981	                >
   982	                  {modalCodeCountdown > 0 ? `${modalCodeCountdown}秒` : '发送验证码'}
   983	                </button>
   984	              </div>
   985	            </div>
   986	            <button className="btn-modal-submit" onClick={handleModalSubmit} disabled={loading}>
   987	              {loading ? '处理中...' : '确认'}
   988	            </button>
   989	          </>
   990	        );
   991	      }
   992	    }
   993	
   994	    if (type === 'unbind-email') {
   995	      return (
   996	        <>
   997	          <div className="modal-info modal-warning">
   998	            <p>即将解绑邮箱: <strong>{accountModal.currentValue}</strong></p>
   999	            <p className="warning-text">注意：必须至少保留一种登录方式</p>
  1000	          </div>
  1001	          <div className="modal-form-group">
  1002	            <label>验证码（将发送到当前邮箱）</label>
  1003	            <div className="modal-code-input">
  1004	              <input
  1005	                type="text"
  1006	                value={modalForm.code}
  1007	                onChange={(e) => setModalForm({ ...modalForm, code: e.target.value })}
  1008	                placeholder="输入验证码"
  1009	                maxLength={6}
  1010	              />
  1011	              <button
  1012	                className="btn-send-code"
  1013	                onClick={async () => {
  1014	                  if (modalCodeCountdown > 0) return;
  1015	                  setLoading(true);
  1016	                  try {
  1017	                    const response = await api.post('/user/send-code', {
  1018	                      email: user.email,
  1019	                      purpose: 'unbind'
  1020	                    });
  1021	                    if (response.data.code === 0) {
  1022	                      setModalCodeCountdown(60);
  1023	                      showSuccess('验证码已发送');
  1024	                    } else {
  1025	                      showError(response.data.message);
  1026	                    }
  1027	                  } catch (err) {
  1028	                    showError('发送失败');
  1029	                  } finally {
  1030	                    setLoading(false);
  1031	                  }
  1032	                }}
  1033	                disabled={modalCodeCountdown > 0 || loading}
  1034	              >
  1035	                {modalCodeCountdown > 0 ? `${modalCodeCountdown}秒` : '发送验证码'}
  1036	              </button>
  1037	            </div>
  1038	          </div>
  1039	          <button className="btn-modal-submit btn-modal-danger" onClick={handleModalSubmit} disabled={loading}>
  1040	            {loading ? '处理中...' : '确认解绑'}
  1041	          </button>
  1042	        </>
  1043	      );
  1044	    }
  1045	
  1046	    if (type === 'unbind-phone') {
  1047	      return (
  1048	        <>
  1049	          <div className="modal-info modal-warning">
  1050	            <p>即将解绑手机号: <strong>{accountModal.currentValue}</strong></p>
  1051	            <p className="warning-text">注意：必须至少保留一种登录方式</p>
  1052	          </div>
  1053	          <div className="modal-form-group">
  1054	            <label>验证码（将发送到当前手机）</label>
  1055	            <div className="modal-code-input">
  1056	              <input
  1057	                type="text"
  1058	                value={modalForm.code}
  1059	                onChange={(e) => setModalForm({ ...modalForm, code: e.target.value })}
  1060	                placeholder="输入验证码"
  1061	                maxLength={6}
  1062	              />
  1063	              <button
  1064	                className="btn-send-code"
  1065	                onClick={async () => {
  1066	                  if (modalCodeCountdown > 0) return;
  1067	                  setLoading(true);
  1068	                  try {
  1069	                    const response = await api.post('/user/send-phone-code', {
  1070	                      phone: user.phone,
  1071	                      purpose: 'unbind'
  1072	                    });
  1073	                    if (response.data.code === 0) {
  1074	                      setModalCodeCountdown(60);
  1075	                      showSuccess('验证码已发送');
  1076	                    } else {
  1077	                      showError(response.data.message);
  1078	                    }
  1079	                  } catch (err) {
  1080	                    showError('发送失败');
  1081	                  } finally {
  1082	                    setLoading(false);
  1083	                  }
  1084	                }}
  1085	                disabled={modalCodeCountdown > 0 || loading}
  1086	              >
  1087	                {modalCodeCountdown > 0 ? `${modalCodeCountdown}秒` : '发送验证码'}
  1088	              </button>
  1089	            </div>
  1090	          </div>
  1091	          <button className="btn-modal-submit btn-modal-danger" onClick={handleModalSubmit} disabled={loading}>
  1092	            {loading ? '处理中...' : '确认解绑'}
  1093	          </button>
  1094	        </>
  1095	      );
  1096	    }
  1097	
  1098	    if (type === 'unbind-wechat') {
  1099	      return (
  1100	        <>
  1101	          <div className="modal-info modal-warning">
  1102	            <p>即将解绑微信账号</p>
  1103	            <p className="warning-text">注意：必须至少保留一种登录方式</p>
  1104	          </div>
  1105	          <button className="btn-modal-submit btn-modal-danger" onClick={handleModalSubmit} disabled={loading}>
  1106	            {loading ? '处理中...' : '确认解绑'}
  1107	          </button>
  1108	        </>
  1109	      );
  1110	    }
  1111	
  1112	    if (type === 'unbind-github') {

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0

     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    13	import api, { orderAPI, paymentAPI } from '../services/api';
    14	import AppSidebar from '../components/AppSidebar';
    15	import './SubscriptionManagement.css';
    16	
    17	const SubscriptionManagement = () => {
    18	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    19	  const { isAuthenticated, user, logout } = useAuth();
    20	  const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState(null);
    21	  const [usage, setUsage] = useState(null);
    22	  const [plans, setPlans] = useState([]);
    23	  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
    24	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    25	  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
    26	  const [billingCycle, setBillingCycle] = useState('monthly');
    27	  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(() => {
    28	    const saved = localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed');
    29	    return saved !== null ? JSON.parse(saved) : true;
    30	  });
    31	  const [message, setMessage] = useState({ type: '', text: '' });
    32	
    33	  useEffect(() => {
    34	    if (!isAuthenticated) {
    35	      navigate('/');
    36	      return;
    37	    }
    38	    fetchAllData();
    39	  }, [isAuthenticated, navigate]);
    40	
    41	  useEffect(() => {
    42	    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', JSON.stringify(sidebarCollapsed));
    43	  }, [sidebarCollapsed]);
    44	
    45	  useEffect(() => {
    46	    if (message.text) {
    47	      const timer = setTimeout(() => setMessage({ type: '', text: '' }), 5000);
    48	      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    49	    }
    50	  }, [message]);
    51	
    52	  const fetchAllData = async () => {
    53	    try {
    54	      setLoading(true);
    55	      const [subRes, usageRes, plansRes, ordersRes] = await Promise.all([
    56	        api.get('/user/subscription/my'),
    57	        api.get('/user/subscription/usage'),
    58	        api.get('/user/subscription/plans'),
    59	        api.get('/user/orders/my')
    60	      ]);
    61	
    62	      if (subRes.data.code === 0) {
    63	        setSubscription(subRes.data.data);
    64	      }
    65	      if (usageRes.data.code === 0) {
    66	        setUsage(usageRes.data);
    67	      }
    68	      if (plansRes.data.code === 0) {
    69	        setPlans(plansRes.data.data);
    70	      }
    71	      if (ordersRes.data.code === 0) {
    72	        setOrders(ordersRes.data.data.orders || []);
    73	      }
    74	    } catch (error) {
    75	      console.error('Failed to fetch data:', error);
    76	      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '加载数据失败，请刷新重试' });
    77	    } finally {
    78	      setLoading(false);
    79	    }
    80	  };
    81	
    82	  const handleLogout = () => {
    83	    logout();
    84	    navigate('/');
    85	  };
    86	
    87	  const handleToggleSidebar = () => {
    88	    setSidebarCollapsed(!sidebarCollapsed);
    89	  };
    90	
    91	  const handleViewPlans = () => {
    92	    // Navigate to pricing page
    93	    navigate('/pricing');
    94	  };
    95	
    96	  const getPricePerMonth = (plan) => {
    97	    if (billingCycle === 'monthly') {
    98	      return plan.price_monthly;
    99	    }
   100	    return (plan.price_yearly / 12).toFixed(2);
   101	  };
   102	
   103	  const getUsagePercentage = (used, limit) => {
   104	    if (limit === -1) return 0;
   105	    return Math.min((used / limit) * 100, 100);
   106	  };
   107	
   108	  const formatUsageText = (used, limitInfo) => {
   109	    if (limitInfo.limit === -1) {
   110	      return `今日已使用 ${used} 次`;
   111	    }
   112	    return `${used} / ${limitInfo.limit}`;
   113	  };
   114	
   115	  const formatOrderStatus = (status) => {
   116	    const statusMap = {
   117	      pending: { text: '待支付', class: 'pending' },
   118	      paid: { text: '已支付', class: 'paid' },
   119	      cancelled: { text: '已取消', class: 'cancelled' },
   120	      refunded: { text: '已退款', class: 'refunded' }
   121	    };
   122	    return statusMap[status] || { text: status, class: 'unknown' };
   123	  };
   124	
   125	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
   126	    const date = new Date(dateString);
   127	    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', {
   128	      year: 'numeric',
   129	      month: '2-digit',
   130	      day: '2-digit',
   131	      hour: '2-digit',
   132	      minute: '2-digit'
   133	    });
   134	  };
   135	
   136	  const handlePayOrder = async (order) => {
   137	    setActionLoading(true);
   138	    setMessage({ type: '', text: '' });
   139	
   140	    try {
   141	      // Get plan details for payment
   142	      const plan = plans.find(p => p.plan_code === order.plan_code);
   143	      if (!plan) {
   144	        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '无法找到订阅方案信息' });
   145	        setActionLoading(false);
   146	        return;
   147	      }
   148	
   149	      // Create Alipay payment
   150	      const returnURL = `${window.location.origin}/subscription`;
   151	      const subject = `Scholar ${order.plan_name} ${order.billing_cycle === 'monthly' ? '月付' : '年付'}订阅`;
   152	      const description = `订单号: ${order.order_no}`;
   153	
   154	      const paymentResponse = await paymentAPI.createAlipayPayment(
   155	        order.order_no,
   156	        subject,
   157	        order.amount,
   158	        returnURL,
   159	        description
   160	      );
   161	
   162	      if (paymentResponse.data.code === 0 && paymentResponse.data.data) {
   163	        // Redirect to Alipay payment page
   164	        window.location.href = paymentResponse.data.data.payment_url;
   165	      } else {
   166	        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '创建支付失败：' + (paymentResponse.data.message || '未知错误') });
   167	        setActionLoading(false);
   168	      }
   169	    } catch (error) {
   170	      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '创建支付失败，请稍后重试' });
   171	      console.error('Payment failed:', error);
   172	      setActionLoading(false);
   173	    }
   174	  };
   175	
   176	  const handleCancelOrder = async (orderNo) => {
   177	    if (!window.confirm('确认取消此订单吗？')) {
   178	      return;
   179	    }
   180	
   181	    setActionLoading(true);
   182	    setMessage({ type: '', text: '' });
   183	
   184	    try {
   185	      const response = await orderAPI.cancelOrder(orderNo);
   186	
   187	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   188	        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: '订单已取消' });
   189	        await fetchAllData();
   190	      } else {
   191	        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '取消订单失败：' + (response.data.message || '未知错误') });
   192	      }
   193	    } catch (error) {
   194	      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '取消订单失败，请稍后重试' });
   195	      console.error('Cancel order failed:', error);
   196	    } finally {
   197	      setActionLoading(false);
   198	    }
   199	  };
   200	
   201	  if (loading) {

   221	  }
   222	
   223	  return (

   227	          user={user}
   228	          onLogout={handleLogout}

   234

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================

     9	
    10	import { useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    13	import { userAPI } from '../services/api';
    14	import logger from '../utils/logger';
    15	
    16	// Whitelist of allowed return URLs (paths only, no query params validation)
    17	// Only these paths are allowed for redirect after WeChat login
    18	const RETURN_URL_WHITELIST = [
    19	  '/pricing',
    20	  '/search-results',
    21	  '/advanced-search',
    22	  '/chat',
    23	  '/settings',
    24	  '/dashboard',
    25	  '/order-confirmation',
    26	];
    27	
    28	/**
    29	 * Check if a return URL is in the whitelist
    30	 * @param {string} url - The URL to check (can be full path or just pathname)
    31	 * @returns {boolean} - True if the URL is whitelisted
    32	 */
    33	const isWhitelistedReturnURL = (url) => {
    34	  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
    35	
    36	  // Extract pathname from URL (remove query string and hash)
    37	  let pathname;
    38	  try {
    39	    // Handle both absolute URLs and relative paths
    40	    if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) {
    41	      pathname = new URL(url).pathname;
    42	    } else {
    43	      // Relative path - extract pathname before query/hash
    44	      pathname = url.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
    45	    }
    46	  } catch (e) {
    47	    return false;
    48	  }
    49	
    50	  // Check if pathname is in whitelist
    51	  return RETURN_URL_WHITELIST.includes(pathname);
    52	};
    53	
    54	// CRITICAL: Clear old tokens IMMEDIATELY before component renders
    55	// This prevents AuthContext from starting heartbeat with expired tokens
    56	// Must be outside the component to run before React lifecycle
    57	// NOTE: We only clear auth tokens, NOT OAuth state which is needed for verification
    58	const bindMode = localStorage.getItem('wechat_bind_mode');
    59	if (bindMode !== 'bind') {
    60	  // Only clear tokens in login mode, not binding mode
    61	  // DO NOT clear wechat_oauth_state here - it's needed for verification
    62	  localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
    63	  localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
    64	}
    65	
    66	const WeChatCallback = () => {
    67	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    68	  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
    69	  const { login } = useAuth();
    70	
    71	  useEffect(() => {
    72	    const handleCallback = async () => {
    73	      const code = searchParams.get('code');
    74	      const state = searchParams.get('state');
    75	
    76	      if (!code || !state) {
    77	        console.error('Invalid WeChat callback parameters');
    78	        navigate('/');
    79	        return;
    80	      }
    81	
    82	      // Check if this is a binding operation
    83	      const bindMode = localStorage.getItem('wechat_bind_mode');
    84	      const stateKey = bindMode === 'bind' ? 'wechat_bind_state' : 'wechat_oauth_state';
    85	      const savedState = localStorage.getItem(stateKey);
    86	
    87	      // Debug logging
    88	      logger.log('WeChat callback - bindMode:', bindMode);
    89	      logger.log('WeChat callback - State key:', stateKey);
    90	      logger.log('WeChat callback - URL state:', state);
    91	      logger.log('WeChat callback - Saved state:', savedState);
    92	      logger.log('WeChat callback - All localStorage keys:', Object.keys(localStorage));
    93	
    94	      if (state !== savedState) {
    95	        console.error('State mismatch!');
    96	        console.error('  Expected (from localStorage):', savedState);
    97	        console.error('  Received (from URL):', state);
    98	        console.error('  Storage key used:', stateKey);
    99	        console.error('  All localStorage:', JSON.stringify({
   100	          wechat_oauth_state: localStorage.getItem('wechat_oauth_state'),
   101	          wechat_bind_state: localStorage.getItem('wechat_bind_state'),
   102	          wechat_bind_mode: localStorage.getItem('wechat_bind_mode'),
   103	        }));
   104	
   105	        // Redirect with error state
   106	        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
   107	          const params = new URLSearchParams({
   108	            tab: 'account',
   109	            wechat_bind_status: 'error',
   110	            message: '安全验证失败，请重试'
   111	          });
   112	          navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
   113	        } else {
   114	          navigate('/');
   115	        }
   116	        return;
   117	      }
   118	
   119	      // Note: Old tokens were already cleared at module load time (lines 10-17)
   120	      // to prevent AuthContext from starting heartbeat with expired tokens
   121	
   122	      try {
   123	        let response;
   124	
   125	        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
   126	          // Binding mode
   127	          response = await userAPI.bindWeChatAccount(code, state);
   128	
   129	          if (response.data.code === 0) {
   130	            // Clean up
   131	            localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_state');
   132	            localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_mode');
   133	
   134	            // Redirect to settings with success state
   135	            const params = new URLSearchParams({
   136	              tab: 'account',
   137	              wechat_bind_status: 'success',
   138	              message: '微信账号绑定成功！'
   139	            });
   140	            navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
   141	          } else {
   142	            throw new Error(response.data.message || '微信绑定失败');
   143	          }
   144	        } else {
   145	          // Login mode
   146	          // 获取保存的邀请码（如果有）
   147	          const invitationCode = localStorage.getItem('oauth_invitation_code');
   148	          response = await userAPI.wechatCallback(code, state, invitationCode);
   149	
   150	          if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   151	            const { token, user } = response.data.data;
   152	
   153	            // Save token and user data
   154	            localStorage.setItem('user_token', token);
   155	            localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(user));
   156	
   157	            // Check for return URL and validate against whitelist
   158	            const returnURL = localStorage.getItem('wechat_return_url');
   159	            let redirectPath = '/'; // Default to home
   160	
   161	            if (returnURL && isWhitelistedReturnURL(returnURL)) {
   162	              // URL is whitelisted, use it for redirect
   163	              redirectPath = returnURL;
   164	              logger.log('WeChat login success - redirecting to whitelisted URL:', redirectPath);
   165	            } else if (returnURL) {
   166	              // URL provided but not whitelisted - log warning and use default
   167	              logger.warn('WeChat login - return URL not whitelisted:', returnURL);
   168	            }
   169	
   170	            // Clean up
   171	            localStorage.removeItem('wechat_oauth_state');
   172	            localStorage.removeItem('wechat_return_url');
   173	            localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code'); // 清理邀请码
   174	
   175	            // Update auth context (token first, then user data)
   176	            login(token, user);
   177	
   178	            // Redirect to target page
   179	            navigate(redirectPath);
   180	          } else {
   181	            throw new Error(response.data.message || '微信登录失败');
   182	          }
   183	        }
   184	      } catch (error) {
   185	        console.error('WeChat callback error:', error);
   186	        const errorMessage = error.response?.data?.message || error.message || (bindMode === 'bind' ? '微信绑定失败' : '微信登录失败');
   187	
   188	        // Clean up on error
   189	        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
   190	          localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_state');
   191	          localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_mode');
   192	
   193	          // Redirect to settings with error state
   194	          const params = new URLSearchParams({
   195	            tab: 'account',
   196	            wechat_bind_status: 'error',
   197	            message: errorMessage
   198	          });
   199	          navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
   200	        } else {
   201	          localStorage.removeItem('wechat_oauth_state');
   202	          localStorage.removeItem('wechat_return_url'); // Clean up return URL on error
   203	          localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code'); // 清理邀请码
   204	          navigate('/');
   205	        }
   206	      }
   207	    };
   208	
   209	    handleCallback();
   210	  }, [searchParams, navigate, login]);
   211	
   212	  // No UI - just processing in background
   213	  return null;
   214	};
   215	
   216	export default WeChatCallback;

    10	import axios from 'axios';
    11	
    12	// Use relative path so requests go through Nginx reverse proxy
    13	// In production, this will be '' (empty), making requests to /api/v1/*
    14	// In development, you can set REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 for direct backend access
    15	const API_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || '';
    16	
    17	const api = axios.create({
    18	  baseURL: `${API_URL}/api/v1`,
    19	  headers: {
    20	    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    21	  },
    22	});
    23	
    24	// Request interceptor to add auth token
    25	api.interceptors.request.use(
    26	  (config) => {
    27	    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
    28	    if (token) {
    29	      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    30	    }
    31	    return config;
    32	  },
    33	  (error) => {
    34	    return Promise.reject(error);
    35	  }
    36	);
    37	
    38	// Response interceptor to handle errors
    39	api.interceptors.response.use(
    40	  (response) => response,
    41	  (error) => {
    42	    // 处理 401 (未授权) 和 403 (禁止访问) 错误
    43	    if (error.response?.status === 401 || error.response?.status === 403) {
    44	      // Unauthorized/Forbidden - clear token and state
    45	      localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
    46	      localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
    47	
    48	      // Show notification to user
    49	      const message = error.response?.data?.message ||
    50	        (error.response?.status === 403 ? '访问被拒绝，请重新登录' : '登录已失效，请重新登录');
    51	
    52	      // Dispatch custom event with message
    53	      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:expired', {
    54	        detail: { message }
    55	      }));
    56	
    57	      // Redirect to home page immediately if not already there
    58	      if (window.location.pathname !== '/') {
    59	        window.location.href = '/';
    60	      }
    61	    }
    62	    return Promise.reject(error);
    63	  }
    64	);

   413	  getTaskList: (page = 1, pageSize = 10, status = '') =>
   414	    api.get('/user/peer-review/tasks', { params: { page, page_size: pageSize, status } }),
   415	
   416	  // 获取任务详情
   417	  getTaskDetail: (taskId) =>
   418	    api.get(`/user/peer-review/tasks/${taskId}`),
   419	
   420	  // 获取任务进度
   421	  getTaskProgress: (taskId) =>
   422	    api.get(`/user/peer-review/tasks/${taskId}/progress`),
   423	
   424	  // 监听任务进度（SSE）
   425	  watchTaskProgress: (taskId) => {
   426	    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
   427	    return new EventSource(`${API_URL}/api/v1/user/peer-review/tasks/${taskId}/watch?token=${token}`);
   428	  },
   429	
   430	  // 删除任务
   431	  deleteTask: (taskId) =>
   432	    api.delete(`/user/peer-review/tasks/${taskId}`),
   433	
   434	  // 启动草稿任务（保留兼容）
   435	  startTask: (taskId, targetVenue = '', modelLevel = 'mid') =>
   436	    api.post(`/user/peer-review/tasks/${taskId}/start`, { target_venue: targetVenue, model_level: modelLevel }),
   437	
   438	  // 上传文件（解析文件并保存到草稿）
   439	  uploadFile: (file) => {
   440	    const formData = new FormData();
   441	    formData.append('file', file);
   442	    return api.post('/user/peer-review/upload', formData, {
   443	      headers: { 'Content-Type': null },
   444	    });
   445	  },
   446	
   447	  // ========== 兼容旧接口 ==========
   448	  
   449	  // 执行审稿（流式输出，同步方式）
   450	  runPeerReview: (manuscriptText, targetVenue, modelLevel = 'mid') => {
   451	    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
   452	    return fetch(`${API_URL}/api/v1/user/peer-review/run`, {
   453	      method: 'POST',
   454	      headers: {
   455	        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   456	        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
   457	      },
   458	      body: JSON.stringify({
   459	        manuscript_text: manuscriptText,
   460	        target_venue: targetVenue,
   461	        model_level: modelLevel,
   462	      }),
   463	    });
   464	  },
   465	
   466	  // 获取审稿历史
   467	  getReviewHistory: () =>
   468	    api.get('/user/peer-review/history'),
   469	
   470	  // 获取审稿详情
   471	  getReviewDetail: (id) =>
   472	    api.get(`/user/peer-review/${id}`),
   473	};
   474	
   475	export default api;
