================================================================================
文件: frontend-user/src/utils/AuthContext.js
================================================================================

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	import { userAPI, subscriptionAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	
    13	const AuthContext = createContext(null);
    14	
    15	// 配置常量
    16	const HEARTBEAT_CONFIG = {
    17	  ACTIVE_INTERVAL: 30000,      // 活跃状态下的心跳间隔：30秒
    18	  IDLE_INTERVAL: 120000,       // 空闲状态下的心跳间隔：2分钟
    19	  IDLE_TIMEOUT: 60000,         // 空闲超时时间：1分钟无操作视为空闲
    20	  INACTIVE_TIMEOUT: 300000,    // 不活跃超时时间：5分钟无操作停止心跳
    21	};
    22	
    23	// 需要监听的用户活动事件
    24	const USER_ACTIVITY_EVENTS = [
    25	  'mousedown',
    26	  'mousemove', 
    27	  'keydown',
    28	  'scroll',
    29	  'touchstart',
    30	  'click',
    31	  'focus',
    32	];
    33	
    34	export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
    35	  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
    36	  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
    37	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    38	  
    39	  // 心跳相关的 refs
    40	  const heartbeatIntervalRef = useRef(null);
    41	  const lastActivityRef = useRef(Date.now());
    42	  const isIdleRef = useRef(false);
    43	  const activityCheckIntervalRef = useRef(null);
    44	  
    45	  // 使用 ref 存储函数引用，避免循环依赖
    46	  const startHeartbeatRef = useRef(null);
    47	
    48	  // Heartbeat function to keep session alive
    49	  const sendHeartbeat = useCallback(async () => {
    50	    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
    51	    if (!token) {
    52	      return false;
    53	    }
    54	
    55	    try {
    56	      await userAPI.heartbeat();
    57	      return true;
    58	    } catch (error) {
    59	      // If 401, axios interceptor will handle it (clear token, redirect, etc.)
    60	      // For other errors, just log
    61	      if (error.response?.status !== 401) {
    62	        console.error('Heartbeat error:', error);
    63	      }
    64	      return false;
    65	    }
    66	  }, []);
    67	
    68	  // 重新设置心跳间隔
    69	  const restartHeartbeatWithInterval = useCallback((interval) => {
    70	    if (heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
    71	      clearInterval(heartbeatIntervalRef.current);
    72	    }
    73	    heartbeatIntervalRef.current = setInterval(sendHeartbeat, interval);
    74	  }, [sendHeartbeat]);
    75	
    76	  // Stop heartbeat - 定义在前面以便其他函数使用
    77	  const stopHeartbeat = useCallback(() => {
    78	    if (heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
    79	      clearInterval(heartbeatIntervalRef.current);
    80	      heartbeatIntervalRef.current = null;
    81	    }
    82	    if (activityCheckIntervalRef.current) {
    83	      clearInterval(activityCheckIntervalRef.current);
    84	      activityCheckIntervalRef.current = null;
    85	    }
    86	  }, []);
    87	
    88	  // 检查用户活动状态
    89	  const checkActivityStatus = useCallback(() => {
    90	    const now = Date.now();
    91	    const timeSinceLastActivity = now - lastActivityRef.current;
    92	
    93	    // 如果超过不活跃时间，停止心跳
    94	    if (timeSinceLastActivity >= HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.INACTIVE_TIMEOUT) {
    95	      if (heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
    96	        stopHeartbeat();
    97	      }
    98	      return;
    99	    }
   100	
   101	    // 如果超过空闲时间但未超过不活跃时间，降低心跳频率
   102	    if (timeSinceLastActivity >= HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.IDLE_TIMEOUT && !isIdleRef.current) {
   103	      isIdleRef.current = true;
   104	      restartHeartbeatWithInterval(HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.IDLE_INTERVAL);
   105	    }
   106	  }, [stopHeartbeat, restartHeartbeatWithInterval]);
   107	
   108	  // 更新最后活动时间
   109	  const updateLastActivity = useCallback(() => {
   110	    lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
   111	    
   112	    // 如果之前是空闲状态，现在变为活跃
   113	    if (isIdleRef.current) {
   114	      isIdleRef.current = false;
   115	      // 立即发送一次心跳，然后重新设置活跃间隔
   116	      const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
   117	      if (token) {
   118	        sendHeartbeat();
   119	        restartHeartbeatWithInterval(HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.ACTIVE_INTERVAL);
   120	      }
   121	    }
   122	  }, [sendHeartbeat, restartHeartbeatWithInterval]);
   123	
   124	  // Handle page visibility change
   125	  const handleVisibilityChange = useCallback(() => {
   126	    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
   127	      // Page became visible, update activity
   128	      lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
   129	      const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
   130	      if (token && !heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
   131	        // Restart heartbeat if it was stopped - 使用 ref 引用
   132	        if (startHeartbeatRef.current) {
   133	          startHeartbeatRef.current();
   134	        }
   135	      }
   136	    }
   137	  }, []);
   138	
   139	  // Start heartbeat with activity detection
   140	  const startHeartbeat = useCallback(() => {
   141	    // Clear any existing intervals
   142	    if (heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
   143	      clearInterval(heartbeatIntervalRef.current);
   144	    }
   145	    if (activityCheckIntervalRef.current) {
   146	      clearInterval(activityCheckIntervalRef.current);
   147	    }
   148	
   149	    // Reset activity state
   150	    lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
   151	    isIdleRef.current = false;
   152	
   153	    // Send initial heartbeat
   154	    sendHeartbeat();
   155	
   156	    // Set up interval to send heartbeat (active interval initially)
   157	    heartbeatIntervalRef.current = setInterval(sendHeartbeat, HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.ACTIVE_INTERVAL);
   158	
   159	    // Set up activity status check (every 10 seconds)
   160	    activityCheckIntervalRef.current = setInterval(checkActivityStatus, 10000);
   161	
   162	    // Add activity event listeners
   163	    USER_ACTIVITY_EVENTS.forEach(event => {
   164	      window.addEventListener(event, updateLastActivity, { passive: true });
   165	    });
   166	
   167	    // Also listen for visibility change
   168	    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
   169	  }, [sendHeartbeat, checkActivityStatus, updateLastActivity, handleVisibilityChange]);
   170	
   171	  // 更新 ref
   172	  useEffect(() => {
   173	    startHeartbeatRef.current = startHeartbeat;
   174	  }, [startHeartbeat]);
   175	
   176	  // 完整的 stopHeartbeat（包含清理事件监听器）
   177	  const fullStopHeartbeat = useCallback(() => {
   178	    stopHeartbeat();
   179	    
   180	    // Remove activity event listeners
   181	    USER_ACTIVITY_EVENTS.forEach(event => {
   182	      window.removeEventListener(event, updateLastActivity);
   183	    });
   184	    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
   185	  }, [stopHeartbeat, updateLastActivity, handleVisibilityChange]);
   186	
   187	  useEffect(() => {
   188	    const initializeAuth = async () => {
   189	    // Check for existing token on mount
   190	    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
   191	    const userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');
   192	
   193	    if (token && userData && userData !== 'undefined') {
   194	      try {
   195	        setIsAuthenticated(true);
   196	        setUser(JSON.parse(userData));
   197	        startHeartbeat(); // Start heartbeat for existing session
   198	          
   199	          // 立即获取最新的用户信息和订阅信息
   200	          try {
   201	            const [profileResponse, subscriptionResponse] = await Promise.all([
   202	              userAPI.getProfile(),
   203	              subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription().catch(err => {
   204	                console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', err);
   205	                return null;
   206	              })
   207	            ]);
   208	
   209	            if (profileResponse.data.code === 0 && profileResponse.data.data) {
   210	              const freshUserData = profileResponse.data.data;
   211	              
   212	              // 如果成功获取订阅信息，将其添加到用户数据中
   213	              if (subscriptionResponse && subscriptionResponse.data.code === 0) {
   214	                freshUserData.subscription = subscriptionResponse.data.data;
   215	              }
   216	              
   217	              localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(freshUserData));
   218	              setUser(freshUserData);
   219	            }
   220	          } catch (error) {
   221	            console.error('Failed to refresh user data on init:', error);
   222	          }
   223	      } catch (error) {
   224	        // Clear invalid data
   225	        localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
   226	        localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
   227	      }
   228	    }
   229	    setLoading(false);
   230	    };
   231	
   232	    initializeAuth();
   233	
   234	    // Listen for auth expiration events
   235	    const handleAuthExpired = (event) => {
   236	      // Stop heartbeat and clear state
   237	      fullStopHeartbeat();
   238	      setIsAuthenticated(false);
   239	      setUser(null);
   240	
   241	      // 静默处理，不显示 alert 弹窗
   242	      // API 拦截器已经处理了重定向到首页
   243	      console.log('Auth expired:', event.detail?.message || '登录已失效');
   244	    };
   245	
   246	    window.addEventListener('auth:expired', handleAuthExpired);
   247	
   248	    // Cleanup on unmount
   249	    return () => {
   250	      fullStopHeartbeat();
   251	      window.removeEventListener('auth:expired', handleAuthExpired);
   252	    };
   253	    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
   254	  }, []);
   255	
   256	  const login = async (token, userData) => {
   257	    localStorage.setItem('user_token', token);
   258	    localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(userData));
   259	    setIsAuthenticated(true);
   260	    setUser(userData);
   261	    startHeartbeat(); // Start heartbeat when user logs in
   262	    
   263	    // 登录后立即获取订阅信息
   264	    try {
   265	      const subscriptionResponse = await subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription();
   266	      if (subscriptionResponse.data.code === 0) {
   267	        const updatedUserData = { ...userData, subscription: subscriptionResponse.data.data };
   268	        localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(updatedUserData));
   269	        setUser(updatedUserData);
   270	      }
   271	    } catch (error) {
   272	      console.error('Failed to fetch subscription after login:', error);
   273	    }
   274	  };
   275	
   276	  const logout = async () => {
   277	    // Stop heartbeat first
   278	    fullStopHeartbeat();
   279	
   280	    // Call backend logout API to delete session
   281	    try {
   282	      await userAPI.logout();
   283	    } catch (error) {
   284	      console.error('Logout API call failed:', error);
   285	    }
   286	
   287	    // Clear local storage and state
   288	    localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
   289	    localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
   290	    setIsAuthenticated(false);
   291	    setUser(null);
   292	  };
   293	
   294	  // Update user data in state and localStorage
   295	  const updateUser = (userData) => {
   296	    localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(userData));
   297	    setUser(userData);
   298	  };
   299	
   300	  // Refresh user data from backend
   301	  const refreshUser = async () => {
   302	    try {
   303	      // 同时获取用户信息和订阅信息
   304	      const [profileResponse, subscriptionResponse] = await Promise.all([
   305	        userAPI.getProfile(),
   306	        subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription().catch(err => {
   307	          console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', err);
   308	          return null;
   309	        })
   310	      ]);
   311	
   312	      if (profileResponse.data.code === 0 && profileResponse.data.data) {
   313	        const userData = profileResponse.data.data;
   314	        
   315	        // 如果成功获取订阅信息，将其添加到用户数据中
   316	        if (subscriptionResponse && subscriptionResponse.data.code === 0) {
   317	          userData.subscription = subscriptionResponse.data.data;
   318	        }
   319	        
   320	        updateUser(userData);
   321	        return userData;
   322	      }
   323	    } catch (error) {
   324	      console.error('Failed to refresh user data:', error);
   325	    }
   326	    return null;
   327	  };
   328	
   329	  const value = {
   330	    isAuthenticated,
   331	    user,
   332	    login,
   333	    logout,
   334	    updateUser,
   335	    refreshUser,
   336	    loading,
   337	  };
   338	
   339	  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
   340	};
   341	
   342	export const useAuth = () => {
   343	  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
   344	  if (!context) {
   345	    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
   346	  }
   347	  return context;
   348	};

文件: frontend-user/src/utils/performanceUtils.js

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import { useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	
    12	/**
    13	 * 防抖函数 - 延迟执行,多次调用只执行最后一次
    14	 * @param {Function} func - 要防抖的函数
    15	 * @param {number} delay - 延迟时间(毫秒)
    16	 * @returns {Function} 防抖后的函数
    17	 */
    18	export function debounce(func, delay = 300) {
    19	  let timeoutId;
    20	  return function debounced(...args) {
    21	    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    22	    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => func.apply(this, args), delay);
    23	  };
    24	}
    25	
    26	/**
    27	 * 节流函数 - 固定时间间隔执行,限制执行频率
    28	 * @param {Function} func - 要节流的函数
    29	 * @param {number} limit - 时间间隔(毫秒)
    30	 * @returns {Function} 节流后的函数
    31	 */
    32	export function throttle(func, limit = 300) {
    33	  let inThrottle;
    34	  let lastResult;
    35	
    36	  return function throttled(...args) {
    37	    if (!inThrottle) {
    38	      inThrottle = true;
    39	      lastResult = func.apply(this, args);
    40	
    41	      setTimeout(() => {
    42	        inThrottle = false;
    43	      }, limit);
    44	    }
    45	    return lastResult;
    46	  };
    47	}
    48	
    49	/**
    50	 * React Hook: 使用防抖
    51	 * @param {Function} callback - 回调函数
    52	 * @param {number} delay - 延迟时间(毫秒)
    53	 * @param {Array} deps - 依赖数组
    54	 * @returns {Function} 防抖后的回调
    55	 *
    56	 * @example
    57	 * const handleSearch = useDebounce((query) => {
    58	 *   // API call
    59	 * }, 500);
    60	 */
    61	export function useDebounce(callback, delay = 300, deps = []) {
    62	  const timeoutRef = useRef(null);
    63	
    64	  useEffect(() => {
    65	    return () => {
    66	      if (timeoutRef.current) {
    67	        clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    68	      }
    69	    };
    70	  }, []);
    71	
    72	  return useCallback((...args) => {
    73	    if (timeoutRef.current) {
    74	      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    75	    }
    76	
    77	    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    78	      callback(...args);
    79	    }, delay);
    80	  }, [callback, delay, ...deps]);
    81	}
    82	
    83	/**
    84	 * React Hook: 使用节流
    85	 * @param {Function} callback - 回调函数
    86	 * @param {number} limit - 时间间隔(毫秒)
    87	 * @param {Array} deps - 依赖数组
    88	 * @returns {Function} 节流后的回调
    89	 *
    90	 * @example
    91	 * const handleScroll = useThrottle(() => {
    92	 *   // Handle scroll
    93	 * }, 100);
    94	 */
    95	export function useThrottle(callback, limit = 300, deps = []) {
    96	  const inThrottleRef = useRef(false);
    97	
    98	  return useCallback((...args) => {
    99	    if (!inThrottleRef.current) {
   100	      callback(...args);
   101	      inThrottleRef.current = true;
   102	
   103	      setTimeout(() => {
   104	        inThrottleRef.current = false;
   105	      }, limit);
   106	    }
   107	  }, [callback, limit, ...deps]);
   108	}
   109	
   110	/**
   111	 * 请求去重 - 防止相同请求并发执行
   112	 * @param {Function} requestFn - 返回 Promise 的请求函数
   113	 * @returns {Function} 去重后的请求函数
   114	 *
   115	 * @example
   116	 * const fetchData = dedupe(async (id) => {
   117	 *   return await api.get(`/data/${id}`);
   118	 * });
   119	 */
   120	export function dedupe(requestFn) {
   121	  const pendingRequests = new Map();
   122	
   123	  return async function deduped(...args) {
   124	    const key = JSON.stringify(args);
   125	
   126	    // 如果相同请求正在进行,返回同一个 Promise
   127	    if (pendingRequests.has(key)) {
   128	      return pendingRequests.get(key);
   129	    }
   130	
   131	    // 创建新请求
   132	    const promise = requestFn(...args).finally(() => {
   133	      pendingRequests.delete(key);
   134	    });
   135	
   136	    pendingRequests.set(key, promise);
   137	    return promise;
   138	  };
   139	}
   140	
   141	/**
   142	 * React Hook: 使用请求去重
   143	 * @param {Function} requestFn - 异步请求函数
   144	 * @returns {Function} 去重后的请求函数
   145	 *
   146	 * @example
   147	 * const fetchPaper = useDedupe(async (paperId) => {
   148	 *   return await api.get(`/papers/${paperId}`);
   149	 * });
   150	 */
   151	export function useDedupe(requestFn) {
   152	  const pendingRef = useRef(new Map());
   153	
   154	  useEffect(() => {
   155	    return () => {
   156	      // 组件卸载时清理待处理请求
   157	      pendingRef.current.clear();
   158	    };
   159	  }, []);
   160	
   161	  return useCallback(async (...args) => {
   162	    const key = JSON.stringify(args);
   163	
   164	    if (pendingRef.current.has(key)) {
   165	      return pendingRef.current.get(key);
   166	    }
   167	
   168	    const promise = requestFn(...args).finally(() => {
   169	      pendingRef.current.delete(key);
   170	    });
   171	
   172	    pendingRef.current.set(key, promise);
   173	    return promise;
   174	  }, [requestFn]);
   175	}
   176	
   177	/**
   178	 * 简单的LRU缓存实现
   179	 */
   180	export class LRUCache {
   181	  constructor(capacity = 50) {
   182	    this.capacity = capacity;
   183	    this.cache = new Map();
   184	  }
   185	
   186	  get(key) {
   187	    if (!this.cache.has(key)) {
   188	      return null;
   189	    }
   190	
   191	    // LRU: 移到最后
   192	    const value = this.cache.get(key);
   193	    this.cache.delete(key);
   194	    this.cache.set(key, value);
   195	
   196	    return value;
   197	  }
   198	
   199	  set(key, value) {
   200	    // 删除旧的
   201	    if (this.cache.has(key)) {
   202	      this.cache.delete(key);
   203	    }
   204	
   205	    // 添加新的
   206	    this.cache.set(key, value);
   207	
   208	    // 超过容量,删除最旧的
   209	    if (this.cache.size > this.capacity) {
   210	      const oldestKey = this.cache.keys().next().value;
   211	      this.cache.delete(oldestKey);
   212	    }
   213	  }
   214	
   215	  has(key) {
   216	    return this.cache.has(key);
   217	  }
   218	
   219	  clear() {
   220	    this.cache.clear();
   221	  }
   222	
   223	  get size() {
   224	    return this.cache.size;
   225	  }
   226	}
   227	
   228	/**
   229	 * 带过期时间的缓存
   230	 */
   231	export class TTLCache {
   232	  constructor(ttl = 5 * 60 * 1000) { // 默认5分钟
   233	    this.ttl = ttl;
   234	    this.cache = new Map();
   235	  }
   236	
   237	  get(key) {
   238	    const item = this.cache.get(key);
   239	
   240	    if (!item) {
   241	      return null;
   242	    }
   243	
   244	    // 检查是否过期
   245	    if (Date.now() > item.expiry) {
   246	      this.cache.delete(key);
   247	      return null;
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    return item.value;
   251	  }
   252	
   253	  set(key, value, customTTL) {
   254	    const ttl = customTTL || this.ttl;
   255	    this.cache.set(key, {
   256	      value,
   257	      expiry: Date.now() + ttl
   258	    });
   259	  }
   260	
   261	  has(key) {
   262	    const item = this.cache.get(key);
   263	    if (!item) return false;
   264	
   265	    if (Date.now() > item.expiry) {
   266	      this.cache.delete(key);
   267	      return false;
   268	    }
   269	
   270	    return true;
   271	  }
   272	
   273	  delete(key) {
   274	    return this.cache.delete(key);
   275	  }
   276	
   277	  clear() {
   278	    this.cache.clear();
   279	  }
   280	
   281	  // 清理过期项
   282	  cleanup() {
   283	    const now = Date.now();
   284	    for (const [key, item] of this.cache.entries()) {
   285	      if (now > item.expiry) {
   286	        this.cache.delete(key);
   287	      }
   288	    }
   289	  }
   290	
   291	  get size() {
   292	    return this.cache.size;
   293	  }
   294	}
   295	
   296	/**
   297	 * React Hook: 使用带TTL的缓存
   298	 * @param {number} ttl - 缓存时间(毫秒)
   299	 * @returns {TTLCache} 缓存实例
   300	 */
   301	export function useTTLCache(ttl = 5 * 60 * 1000) {
   302	  const cacheRef = useRef(null);
   303	
   304	  if (!cacheRef.current) {
   305	    cacheRef.current = new TTLCache(ttl);
   306	  }
   307	
   308	  useEffect(() => {
   309	    const cache = cacheRef.current;
   310	
   311	    // 定期清理过期项(每分钟)
   312	    const interval = setInterval(() => {
   313	      cache.cleanup();
   314	    }, 60 * 1000);
   315	
   316	    return () => {
   317	      clearInterval(interval);
   318	      cache.clear();
   319	    };
   320	  }, []);
   321	
   322	  return cacheRef.current;
   323	}
   324	
   325	/**
   326	 * 批量请求合并 - 将多个请求合并为一次批量请求
   327	 * @param {Function} batchFn - 批量请求函数,接收ID数组,返回结果数组
   328	 * @param {Object} options - 配置选项
   329	 * @returns {Function} 合并后的请求函数
   330	 */
   331	export function batchRequests(batchFn, options = {}) {
   332	  const {
   333	    maxBatchSize = 50,    // 最大批量大小
   334	    maxWaitTime = 50,     // 最大等待时间(毫秒)
   335	  } = options;
   336	
   337	  let batch = [];
   338	  let timeoutId = null;
   339	
   340	  const executeBatch = async () => {
   341	    if (batch.length === 0) return;
   342	
   343	    const currentBatch = batch;
   344	    batch = [];
   345	
   346	    try {
   347	      const ids = currentBatch.map(item => item.id);
   348	      const results = await batchFn(ids);
   349	
   350	      // 分发结果
   351	      currentBatch.forEach((item, index) => {
   352	        item.resolve(results[index]);
   353	      });
   354	    } catch (error) {
   355	      currentBatch.forEach(item => {
   356	        item.reject(error);
   357	      });
   358	    }
   359	  };
   360	
   361	  return function batched(id) {
   362	    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   363	      batch.push({ id, resolve, reject });
   364	
   365	      if (batch.length >= maxBatchSize) {
   366	        // 达到批量大小,立即执行
   367	        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   368	        executeBatch();
   369	      } else if (!timeoutId) {
   370	        // 设置定时器,等待更多请求
   371	        timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   372	          timeoutId = null;
   373	          executeBatch();
   374	        }, maxWaitTime);
   375	      }
   376	    });
   377	  };
   378	}
   379	
   380	export default {
   381	  debounce,
   382	  throttle,
   383	  useDebounce,
   384	  useThrottle,
   385	  dedupe,
   386	  useDedupe,
   387	  LRUCache,
   388	  TTLCache,
   389	  useTTLCache,
   390	  batchRequests
   391	};

    10	// 搜索历史管理工具
    11	const SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY_PREFIX = 'scholar_search_history';
    12	const MAX_HISTORY_ITEMS = 50; // 最多保存50条历史记录
    13	
    14	/**
    15	 * 获取用户特定的localStorage键名
    16	 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
    17	 * @returns {string} localStorage键名
    18	 */
    19	const getUserHistoryKey = (userId) => {
    20	  return userId ? `${SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY_PREFIX}_${userId}` : `${SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY_PREFIX}_guest`;
    21	};
    22	
    23	// 搜索历史项目结构:
    24	// {
    25	//   id: number,
    26	//   query: string,           // 实际的搜索查询词（不可变，用于搜索）
    27	//   displayName: string,     // 显示名称（可重命名，用于界面显示）
    28	//   filters: object,         // 包含所有搜索过滤条件
    29	//   timestamp: number,
    30	//   resultsCount: number (optional)
    31	// }
    32	
    33	/**
    34	 * 获取指定用户的所有搜索历史
    35	 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
    36	 * @returns {Array} 搜索历史数组,按时间倒序排列
    37	 */
    38	export const getSearchHistory = (userId = null) => {
    39	  try {
    40	    const historyKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);
    41	    const historyJson = localStorage.getItem(historyKey);
    42	    if (!historyJson) return [];
    43	
    44	    const history = JSON.parse(historyJson);
    45	
    46	    // 迁移旧数据：为没有displayName的项目添加displayName字段
    47	    let needsSave = false;
    48	    history.forEach(item => {
    49	      if (!item.displayName) {
    50	        item.displayName = item.query;
    51	        needsSave = true;
    52	      }
    53	    });
    54	
    55	    // 如果有数据被迁移，保存回localStorage
    56	    if (needsSave) {
    57	      localStorage.setItem(historyKey, JSON.stringify(history));
    58	    }
    59	
    60	    // 按时间戳倒序排列(最新的在前)
    61	    return history.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
    62	  } catch (error) {
    63	    console.error('Failed to get search history:', error);
    64	    return [];
    65	  }
    66	};
    67	
    68	/**
    69	 * 添加搜索历史记录
    70	 * @param {string} query - 搜索关键词
    71	 * @param {object} filters - 搜索过滤条件
    72	 * @param {number} resultsCount - 搜索结果数量(可选)
    73	 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
    74	 * @returns {object} 新添加的历史记录项
    75	 */
    76	export const addSearchHistory = (query, filters = {}, resultsCount = null, userId = null) => {
    77	  if (!query || query.trim() === '') {
    78	    return null;
    79	  }
    80	
    81	  try {
    82	    const historyKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);
    83	    const history = getSearchHistory(userId);
    84	
    85	    // 检查是否已存在相同的搜索(query和主要filters相同)
    86	    const existingIndex = history.findIndex(item =>
    87	      item.query === query &&
    88	      JSON.stringify(item.filters) === JSON.stringify(filters)
    89	    );
    90	
    91	    let newItem;
    92	
    93	    if (existingIndex !== -1) {
    94	      // 如果已存在,更新时间戳并移到最前面
    95	      newItem = {
    96	        ...history[existingIndex],
    97	        timestamp: Date.now(),
    98	        resultsCount: resultsCount !== null ? resultsCount : history[existingIndex].resultsCount
    99	      };
   100	      history.splice(existingIndex, 1);
   101	    } else {
   102	      // 创建新项目
   103	      newItem = {
   104	        id: Date.now(),
   105	        query: query.trim(),
   106	        displayName: query.trim(), // 初始时显示名称和查询词相同
   107	        filters: filters || {},
   108	        timestamp: Date.now(),
   109	        resultsCount
   110	      };
   111	    }
   112	
   113	    // 添加到数组开头
   114	    history.unshift(newItem);
   115	
   116	    // 保持最大数量限制
   117	    if (history.length > MAX_HISTORY_ITEMS) {
   118	      history.splice(MAX_HISTORY_ITEMS);
   119	    }
   120	
   121	    // 保存到localStorage
   122	    localStorage.setItem(historyKey, JSON.stringify(history));
   123	
   124	    return newItem;
   125	  } catch (error) {
   126	    console.error('Failed to add search history:', error);
   127	    return null;
   128	  }
   129	};
   130	
   131	/**
   132	 * 重命名搜索历史记录 (只更新displayName字段，不改变实际的query)
   133	 * @param {number} id - 历史记录ID
   134	 * @param {string} newDisplayName - 新的显示名称
   135	 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
   136	 * @returns {boolean} 是否重命名成功
   137	 */
   138	export const renameSearchHistory = (id, newDisplayName, userId = null) => {
   139	  if (!newDisplayName || newDisplayName.trim() === '') {
   140	    return false;
   141	  }
   142	
   143	  try {
   144	    const historyKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);
   145	    const history = getSearchHistory(userId);
   146	    const itemIndex = history.findIndex(item => item.id === id);
   147	
   148	    if (itemIndex !== -1) {
   149	      // 只更新displayName，保持query不变
   150	      history[itemIndex].displayName = newDisplayName.trim();
   151	      localStorage.setItem(historyKey, JSON.stringify(history));
   152	      return true;
   153	    }
   154	
   155	    return false;
   156	  } catch (error) {
   157	    console.error('Failed to rename search history:', error);
   158	    return false;
   159	  }
   160	};

   162	/**
   163	 * 删除搜索历史记录
   164	 * @param {number} id - 历史记录ID
   165	 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
   166	 * @returns {boolean} 是否删除成功

   168	export const deleteSearchHistory = (id, userId = null) => {

   179	  }

   187	export const clearSearchHistory = (userId = null) => {

   198	/**
   199	 * 格式化历史记录用于显示
   200	 * @param {object} item - 历史记录项
   201	 * @returns {object} 格式化后的对象,包含title和updated_at
   202	 */
   203	export const formatHistoryItem = (item) => {
   204	  // 使用displayName作为基础标题，如果不存在则使用query（兼容旧数据）
   205	  let title = item.displayName || item.query;
   206	
   207	  // 添加过滤条件到标题(可选)
   208	  const filterParts = [];
   209	
   210	  if (item.filters?.year) {
   211	    filterParts.push(`年份: ${item.filters.year}`);
   212	  }
   213	
   214	  if (item.filters?.publicationTypes && item.filters.publicationTypes.length > 0) {
   215	    filterParts.push(`类型: ${item.filters.publicationTypes.length}项`);
   216	  }
   217	
   218	  if (item.filters?.fieldsOfStudy && item.filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) {
   219	    filterParts.push(`领域: ${item.filters.fieldsOfStudy.length}项`);
   220	  }
   221	
   222	  if (filterParts.length > 0) {
   223	    title = `${item.displayName || item.query} (${filterParts.join(', ')})`;
   224	  }
   225	
   226	  if (item.resultsCount !== null && item.resultsCount !== undefined) {
   227	    title = `${title} - ${item.resultsCount}条结果`;
   228	  }
   229	
   230	  return {
   231	    id: item.id,
   232	    title: title,
   233	    query: item.query,              // 实际查询词，用于搜索
   234	    displayName: item.displayName || item.query,  // 显示名称，用于界面展示
   235	    filters: item.filters,
   236	    updated_at: new Date(item.timestamp).toISOString(),
   237	    resultsCount: item.resultsCount
   238	  };
   239	};

   246	export const getFormattedSearchHistory = (userId = null) => {

   251	/**

   256	export const migrateOldSearchHistory = (userId) => {

   271	      console.log(`Migrated search history for user ${userId}`);
   272	    }
   273	  } catch (error) {
   274	    console.error('Failed to migrate search history:', error);
   275	  }

    14	/**
    15	 * 生成学术论文的结构化数据
    16	 */
    17	export const generateScholarlyArticleSchema = (paper) => {
    18	  if (!paper) return null;
    19	
    20	  return {
    21	    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    22	    '@type': 'ScholarlyArticle',
    23	    headline: paper.title,
    24	    abstract: paper.abstract,
    25	    author: paper.authors?.map(author => ({
    26	      '@type': 'Person',
    27	      name: author.name,
    28	      identifier: author.authorId ? `https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/${author.authorId}` : undefined,
    29	    })),
    30	    datePublished: paper.year ? `${paper.year}-01-01` : undefined,
    31	    publisher: paper.venue ? {
    32	      '@type': 'Organization',
    33	      name: paper.venue,
    34	    } : undefined,
    35	    citation: paper.citationCount ? {
    36	      '@type': 'CreativeWork',
    37	      identifier: `${paper.citationCount} citations`,
    38	    } : undefined,
    39	    url: paper.url || `https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/${paper.paperId}`,
    40	    identifier: {
    41	      '@type': 'PropertyValue',
    42	      propertyID: 'Semantic Scholar ID',
    43	      value: paper.paperId,
    44	    },
    45	    ...(paper.externalIds?.DOI && {
    46	      sameAs: `https://doi.org/${paper.externalIds.DOI}`,
    47	    }),
    48	  };
    49	};
    50	
    51	/**
    52	 * 生成面包屑导航的结构化数据
    53	 */
    54	export const generateBreadcrumbSchema = (items) => {
    55	  return {
    56	    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    57	    '@type': 'BreadcrumbList',
    58	    itemListElement: items.map((item, index) => ({
    59	      '@type': 'ListItem',
    60	      position: index + 1,
    61	      name: item.name,
    62	      item: item.url ? `https://www.scholay.com${item.url}` : undefined,
    63	    })),
    64	  };
    65	};
    66	
    67	/**
    68	 * 生成搜索结果页的结构化数据
    69	 */
    70	export const generateSearchResultsSchema = (query, results) => {
    71	  if (!results || results.length === 0) return null;
    72	
    73	  return {
    74	    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    75	    '@type': 'SearchResultsPage',
    76	    name: `"${query}"的搜索结果`,
    77	    about: {
    78	      '@type': 'Thing',
    79	      name: query,
    80	    },
    81	    mainEntity: {
    82	      '@type': 'ItemList',
    83	      numberOfItems: results.length,
    84	      itemListElement: results.slice(0, 10).map((paper, index) => ({
    85	        '@type': 'ListItem',
    86	        position: index + 1,
    87	        item: {
    88	          '@type': 'ScholarlyArticle',
    89	          headline: paper.title,
    90	          author: paper.authors?.slice(0, 3).map(author => ({
    91	            '@type': 'Person',
    92	            name: author.name,
    93	          })),
    94	          datePublished: paper.year ? `${paper.year}-01-01` : undefined,
    95	          url: `https://www.scholay.com/paper/${paper.paperId}`,
    96	        },
    97	      })),
    98	    },
    99	  };
   100	};
   101	
   102	/**
   103	 * 生成FAQ的结构化数据
   104	 */
   105	export const generateFAQSchema = (faqs) => {
   106	  return {
   107	    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
   108	    '@type': 'FAQPage',
   109	    mainEntity: faqs.map(faq => ({
   110	      '@type': 'Question',
   111	      name: faq.question,
   112	      acceptedAnswer: {
   113	        '@type': 'Answer',
   114	        text: faq.answer,
   115	      },
   116	    })),
   117	  };
   118	};
   119	
   120	/**
   121	 * 截断文本用于描述
   122	 */
   123	export const truncateText = (text, maxLength = 160) => {
   124	  if (!text) return '';
   125	  if (text.length <= maxLength) return text;
   126	  return text.substring(0, maxLength - 3) + '...';
   127	};
   128	
   129	/**
   130	 * 生成页面标题
   131	 */
   132	export const generatePageTitle = (pageTitle, includePrefix = true) => {
   133	  if (!includePrefix) return pageTitle;
   134	  return `${pageTitle} | Scholay - AI驱动的学术搜索平台`;
   135	};
   136	
   137	/**
   138	 * 清理和格式化关键词
   139	 */
   140	export const formatKeywords = (keywords) => {
   141	  if (Array.isArray(keywords)) {
   142	    return keywords.join(',');
   143	  }
   144	  return keywords;
   145	};

    10	import React, { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
    11	import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    12	import Toast from './components/Toast';
    13	import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './utils/AuthContext';
    14	
    15	// Lazy load all page components for better performance
    16	const Login = lazy(() => import('./pages/Login'));
    17	const DashboardLayout = lazy(() => import('./components/DashboardLayout'));
    18	const DashboardHome = lazy(() => import('./pages/DashboardHome'));
    19	const SystemSettings = lazy(() => import('./pages/SystemSettings'));
    20	const UserManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/UserManagement'));
    21	const ThirdPartyAccounts = lazy(() => import('./pages/ThirdPartyAccounts'));
    22	const PromptTemplates = lazy(() => import('./pages/PromptTemplates'));
    23	const SubscriptionPlans = lazy(() => import('./pages/SubscriptionPlans'));
    24	const OrderManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/OrderManagement'));
    25	const CouponManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/CouponManagement'));
    26	const CouponBatchManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/CouponBatchManagement'));
    27	const DistributedCoupons = lazy(() => import('./pages/DistributedCoupons'));
    28	const DefaultBusinessData = lazy(() => import('./pages/DefaultBusinessData'));
    29	const FeedbackManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/FeedbackManagement'));
    30	
    31	// Loading component for Suspense fallback
    32	const LoadingFallback = () => (
    33	  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', height: '100vh' }}>
    34	    <div>Loading...</div>
    35	  </div>
    36	);
    37	
    38	const PrivateRoute = ({ children }) => {
    39	  const { isAuthenticated, loading } = useAuth();
    40	
    41	  if (loading) {
    42	    return <LoadingFallback />;
    43	  }
    44	
    45	  return isAuthenticated ? children : <Navigate to="/login" />;
    46	};
    47	
    48	function App() {
    49	  return (
    50	    <AuthProvider>
    51	      <Router>
    52	        <Suspense fallback={<LoadingFallback />}>
    53	          <Routes>
    54	            <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
    55	            <Route
    56	              path="/dashboard"
    57	              element={
    58	                <PrivateRoute>
    59	                  <DashboardLayout />
    60	                </PrivateRoute>
    61	              }
    62	            >
    63	              <Route index element={<DashboardHome />} />
    64	              <Route path="users" element={<UserManagement />} />
    65	              <Route path="orders" element={<OrderManagement />} />
    66	              <Route path="coupons" element={<CouponManagement />} />
    67	              <Route path="coupon-batches" element={<CouponBatchManagement />} />
    68	              <Route path="distributed-coupons" element={<DistributedCoupons />} />
    69	              <Route path="third-party-accounts" element={<ThirdPartyAccounts />} />
    70	              <Route path="prompt-templates" element={<PromptTemplates />} />
    71	              <Route path="subscription-plans" element={<SubscriptionPlans />} />
    72	              <Route path="default-business-data" element={<DefaultBusinessData />} />
    73	              <Route path="feedbacks" element={<FeedbackManagement />} />
    74	              <Route path="settings" element={<SystemSettings />} />
    75	              {/* 保留旧路由以防万一，但重定向到设置页 */}
    76	              <Route path="alipay-config" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/settings?tab=alipay" replace />} />
    77	              <Route path="wechat-config" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/settings?tab=wechat" replace />} />
    78	            </Route>
    79	            <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" />} />
    80	          </Routes>
    81	        </Suspense>
    82	        <Toast />
    83	      </Router>
    84	    </AuthProvider>
    85	  );
    86	}
    87	
    88	export default App;

    13	import { showToast } from './Toast';
    14	import './DashboardLayout.css';
    15	
    16	const DashboardLayout = () => {
    17	  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
    18	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    19	  const location = useLocation();
    20	  const [showPasswordModal, setShowPasswordModal] = useState(false);
    21	  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
    22	  const [couponMenuOpen, setCouponMenuOpen] = useState(false);
    23	  const [passwordForm, setPasswordForm] = useState({
    24	    oldPassword: '',
    25	    newPassword: '',
    26	    confirmPassword: '',
    27	  });
    28	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    29	
    30	  const handlePasswordChange = (e) => {
    31	    setPasswordForm({
    32	      ...passwordForm,
    33	      [e.target.name]: e.target.value,
    34	    });
    35	  };
    36	
    37	  const handlePasswordSubmit = async (e) => {
    38	    e.preventDefault();
    39	
    40	    if (passwordForm.newPassword !== passwordForm.confirmPassword) {
    41	      showToast('新密码两次输入不一致', 'error');
    42	      return;
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    if (passwordForm.newPassword.length < 8) {
    46	      showToast('密码长度至少为8个字符', 'error');
    47	      return;
    48	    }
    49	
    50	    setLoading(true);
    51	
    52	    try {
    53	      const { adminAPI } = await import('../services/api');
    54	      const response = await adminAPI.updatePassword(
    55	        passwordForm.oldPassword,
    56	        passwordForm.newPassword
    57	      );
    58	
    59	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    60	        showToast('密码修改成功', 'success');
    61	        setPasswordForm({
    62	          oldPassword: '',
    63	          newPassword: '',
    64	          confirmPassword: '',
    65	        });
    66	        setTimeout(() => {
    67	          setShowPasswordModal(false);
    68	        }, 1000);
    69	      } else {
    70	        showToast(response.data.message || '密码修改失败', 'error');
    71	      }
    72	    } catch (err) {
    73	      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '操作失败', 'error');
    74	    } finally {
    75	      setLoading(false);
    76	    }

    81	    navigate('/login');

    93

   100	              <rect x="16" y="34" width="16" height="2" fill="white"/>

   103	          <h2>Scholar</h2>
   104	        </div>
   105	
   106	        <nav className="sidebar-nav">

   110	          >
   111	            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   112	              <path d="M3 4a1 1 0 011-1h12a1 1 0 011 1v2a1 1 0 01-1 1H4a1 1 0 01-1-1V4zM3 10a1 1 0 011-1h6a1 1 0 011 1v6a1 1 0 01-1 1H4a1 1 0 01-1-1v-6zM14 9a1 1 0 00-1 1v6a1 1 0 001 1h2a1 1 0 001-1v-6a1 1 0 00-1-1h-2z"/>

   272	              </svg>

     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0

    10	import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts';
    12	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    13	import './UserStatisticsChart.css';
    14	
    15	const OnlineUserChart = () => {
    16	  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
    17	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    18	  const [showFilter, setShowFilter] = useState(false);
    19	  
    20	  // 时间范围和粒度
    21	  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState(() => {
    22	    const date = new Date();
    23	    date.setHours(date.getHours() - 24);
    24	    return formatDateTimeLocal(date);
    25	  });
    26	  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState(() => {
    27	    const date = new Date();
    28	    return formatDateTimeLocal(date);
    29	  });
    30	  const [granularity, setGranularity] = useState('5min');
    31	
    32	  // 格式化日期为 datetime-local 输入格式
    33	  function formatDateTimeLocal(date) {
    34	    const year = date.getFullYear();
    35	    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    36	    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    37	    const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    38	    const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    39	    const seconds = String(date.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
    40	    return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds}`;
    41	  }
    42	
    43	  // 格式化日期为 API 格式
    44	  function formatDateTimeAPI(dateTimeLocal) {
    45	    return dateTimeLocal.replace('T', ' ');
    46	  }
    47	
    48	  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    49	    setLoading(true);
    50	    try {
    51	      const params = {
    52	        start_time: formatDateTimeAPI(startTime),
    53	        end_time: formatDateTimeAPI(endTime),
    54	        granularity: granularity
    55	      };
    56	      const response = await adminAPI.getOnlineUserChart(params);
    57	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    58	        setData(response.data.data.snapshots || []);
    59	      }
    60	    } catch (error) {
    61	      console.error('Failed to fetch online user data:', error);
    62	    } finally {
    63	      setLoading(false);
    64	    }
    65	  }, [startTime, endTime, granularity]);
    66	
    67	  useEffect(() => {
    68	    fetchData();
    69	    // Refresh every 5 minutes
    70	    const interval = setInterval(fetchData, 5 * 60 * 1000);
    71	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
    72	  }, [fetchData]);
    73	
    74	  const handleSearch = () => {
    75	    fetchData();
    76	    setShowFilter(false);
    77	  };
    78	
    79	  const handleCancel = () => {
    80	    setShowFilter(false);
    81	  };
    82	
    83	  // 快捷时间选择
    84	  const setQuickRange = (type) => {
    85	    const now = new Date();
    86	    let start = new Date();
    87	    let gran = '5min';
    88	
    89	    switch (type) {
    90	      case 'hour':
    91	        start.setHours(start.getHours() - 1);
    92	        gran = '5min';
    93	        break;
    94	      case 'today':
    95	        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    96	        gran = '5min';
    97	        break;
    98	      case 'day':
    99	        start.setHours(start.getHours() - 24);
   100	        gran = '5min';
   101	        break;
   102	      case 'week':
   103	        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7);
   104	        gran = 'hour';
   105	        break;
   106	      case 'month':
   107	        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 30);
   108	        gran = 'hour';
   109	        break;
   110	      default:
   111	        break;
   112	    }
   113	
   114	    setStartTime(formatDateTimeLocal(start));
   115	    setEndTime(formatDateTimeLocal(now));
   116	    setGranularity(gran);
   117	  };
   118	
   119	  const granularityOptions = [
   120	    { value: '5min', label: '5分钟' },
   121	    { value: 'hour', label: '小时' },
   122	  ];
   123	
   124	  const quickRangeOptions = [
   125	    { value: 'hour', label: '近1小时' },
   126	    { value: 'today', label: '今日' },
   127	    { value: 'day', label: '近24小时' },
   128	    { value: 'week', label: '近7天' },
   129	    { value: 'month', label: '近30天' },
   130	  ];
   131	
   132	  return (
   133	    <div className="chart-wrapper">
   134	      {/* 搜索条件按钮 */}
   135	      <div className="chart-toolbar">
   136	        <button 
   137	          className="filter-trigger-btn"
   138	          onClick={() => setShowFilter(true)}
   139	        >
   140	          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   141	            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
   142	            <path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/>
   143	          </svg>
   144	          搜索条件
   145	        </button>
   146	        <div className="current-range">
   147	          {startTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)} ~ {endTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}
   148	          <span className="granularity-tag">{granularityOptions.find(g => g.value === granularity)?.label}</span>
   149	        </div>
   150	      </div>
   151	
   152	      {/* 搜索条件弹窗 */}
   153	      {showFilter && (
   154	        <div className="filter-modal-overlay" onClick={handleCancel}>
   155	          <div className="filter-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
   156	            <div className="filter-modal-header">
   157	              <h4>搜索条件</h4>
   158	              <button className="filter-modal-close" onClick={handleCancel}>×</button>
   159	            </div>
   160	            <div className="filter-modal-body">
   161	              {/* 快捷选择 */}
   162	              <div className="filter-section">
   163	                <label>快捷选择</label>
   164	                <div className="quick-range-btns">
   165	                  {quickRangeOptions.map(opt => (
   166	                    <button
   167	                      key={opt.value}
   168	                      className="quick-range-btn"
   169	                      onClick={() => setQuickRange(opt.value)}
   170	                    >
   171	                      {opt.label}
   172	                    </button>
   173	                  ))}
   174	                </div>
   175	              </div>
   176	
   177	              <div className="filter-section">
   178	                <label>起始时间</label>
   179	                <input
   180	                  type="datetime-local"
   181	                  value={startTime}
   182	                  onChange={e => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
   183	                  className="filter-input"
   184	                  step="1"
   185	                />
   186	              </div>
   187	
   188	              <div className="filter-section">
   189	                <label>结束时间</label>
   190	                <input
   191	                  type="datetime-local"
   192	                  value={endTime}
   193	                  onChange={e => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
   194	                  className="filter-input"
   195	                  step="1"
   196	                />
   197	              </div>
   198	
   199	              <div className="filter-section">
   200	                <label>时间粒度</label>
   201	                <select
   202	                  value={granularity}
   203	                  onChange={e => setGranularity(e.target.value)}
   204	                  className="filter-select"
   205	                >
   206	                  {granularityOptions.map(opt => (
   207	                    <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
   208	                  ))}
   209	                </select>
   210	              </div>
   211	            </div>
   212	            <div className="filter-modal-footer">
   213	              <button className="filter-btn filter-btn-cancel" onClick={handleCancel}>取消</button>
   214	              <button className="filter-btn filter-btn-confirm" onClick={handleSearch}>确定</button>
   215	            </div>
   216	          </div>
   217	        </div>
   218	      )}
   219	
   220	      {/* 图表区域 */}
   221	      {loading ? (
   222	        <div className="chart-loading">
   223	          <div className="loading-spinner"></div>
   224	          <p>加载中...</p>
   225	        </div>
   226	      ) : !data || data.length === 0 ? (
   227	        <div className="chart-no-data">
   228	          <p>暂无数据</p>
   229	        </div>
   230	      ) : (
   231	        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
   232	          <LineChart data={data} margin={{ top: 10, right: 20, left: 0, bottom: 5 }}>
   233	            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e0e0e0" vertical={false} />
   234	            <XAxis
   235	              dataKey="label"
   236	              stroke="#999"
   237	              tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
   238	              tickLine={false}
   239	              axisLine={{ stroke: '#e0e0e0' }}
   240	              interval="preserveStartEnd"
   241	              angle={data.length > 20 ? -45 : 0}
   242	              textAnchor={data.length > 20 ? "end" : "middle"}
   243	              height={data.length > 20 ? 60 : 30}
   244	            />
   245	            <YAxis
   246	              stroke="#999"
   247	              tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
   248	              tickLine={false}
   249	              axisLine={false}
   250	              allowDecimals={false}
   251	              width={35}
   252	            />
   253	            <Tooltip
   254	              contentStyle={{
   255	                backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
   256	                border: '1px solid #374151',
   257	                borderRadius: '8px',
   258	                color: '#fff'
   259	              }}
   260	              labelStyle={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}
   261	              formatter={(value) => [value, '在线用户']}

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState } from 'react';
    11	import './SensitiveField.css';
    12	
    13	/**
    14	 * 敏感信息字段组件
    15	 * 默认显示遮罩，需要二次验证后才能查看
    16	 */
    17	const SensitiveField = ({ label, value, isVerified, onRequestVerify, type = 'text' }) => {
    18	  const [showValue, setShowValue] = useState(false);
    19	  const [copySuccess, setCopySuccess] = useState(false);
    20	
    21	  const handleViewClick = () => {
    22	    if (!isVerified) {
    23	      if (onRequestVerify) {
    24	        onRequestVerify();
    25	      }
    26	    } else {
    27	      setShowValue(!showValue);
    28	    }
    29	  };
    30	
    31	  const handleCopyClick = async () => {
    32	    if (!isVerified || !showValue || !value) return;
    33	
    34	    try {
    35	      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    36	      setCopySuccess(true);
    37	      setTimeout(() => setCopySuccess(false), 2000);
    38	    } catch (err) {
    39	      console.error('Failed to copy:', err);
    40	    }
    41	  };
    42	
    43	  const maskedValue = value ? '●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●' : '未设置';
    44	  const displayValue = (isVerified && showValue) ? value : maskedValue;
    45	
    46	  return (
    47	    <div className="sensitive-field">
    48	      {label && <label>{label}</label>}
    49	      <div className="sensitive-field-input-group">
    50	        <input
    51	          type={showValue ? 'text' : 'password'}
    52	          value={displayValue}
    53	          readOnly
    54	          className="sensitive-field-input"
    55	        />
    56	        {isVerified && showValue && (
    57	          <button
    58	            type="button"
    59	            onClick={handleCopyClick}
    60	            className="sensitive-field-btn sensitive-field-copy-btn"
    61	            title={copySuccess ? '已复制' : '复制'}
    62	          >
    63	            {copySuccess ? (
    64	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    65	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M16.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414l-8 8a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 011.414-1.414L8 12.586l7.293-7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    66	              </svg>
    67	            ) : (
    68	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    69	                <path d="M8 3a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 110 2H9a1 1 0 01-1-1z"/>
    70	                <path d="M6 3a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2 3 3 0 01-3 3H9a3 3 0 01-3-3z"/>
    71	              </svg>
    72	            )}
    73	          </button>
    74	        )}
    75	        <button
    76	          type="button"
    77	          onClick={handleViewClick}
    78	          className="sensitive-field-btn"
    79	          title={isVerified ? (showValue ? '隐藏' : '显示') : '需要验证'}
    80	        >
    81	          {isVerified ? (
    82	            showValue ? (
    83	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    84	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3.707 2.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l14 14a1 1 0 001.414-1.414l-1.473-1.473A10.014 10.014 0 0019.542 10C18.268 5.943 14.478 3 10 3a9.958 9.958 0 00-4.512 1.074l-1.78-1.781zm4.261 4.26l1.514 1.515a2.003 2.003 0 012.45 2.45l1.514 1.514a4 4 0 00-5.478-5.478z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    85	                <path d="M12.454 16.697L9.75 13.992a4 4 0 01-3.742-3.741L2.335 6.578A9.98 9.98 0 00.458 10c1.274 4.057 5.065 7 9.542 7 .847 0 1.669-.105 2.454-.303z"/>
    86	              </svg>
    87	            ) : (
    88	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    89	                <path d="M10 12a2 2 0 100-4 2 2 0 000 4z"/>
    90	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M.458 10C1.732 5.943 5.522 3 10 3s8.268 2.943 9.542 7c-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7S1.732 14.057.458 10zM14 10a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    91	              </svg>
    92	            )
    93	          ) : (
    94	            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    95	              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M5 9V7a5 5 0 0110 0v2a2 2 0 012 2v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5a2 2 0 012-2zm8-2v2H7V7a3 3 0 016 0z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    96	            </svg>
    97	          )}
    98	        </button>
    99	      </div>
   100	      {!isVerified && (
   101	        <p className="sensitive-field-hint">
   102	          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   103	            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
   104	          </svg>
   105	          查看此敏感信息需要验证管理员密码
   106	        </p>
   107	      )}
   108	    </div>
   109	  );
   110	};

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	import './SliderCaptcha.css';
    12	
    13	const SliderCaptcha = ({ onSuccess, onFail }) => {
    14	  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
    15	  const [position, setPosition] = useState(0);
    16	  const [verified, setVerified] = useState(false);
    17	  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
    18	
    19	  const sliderRef = useRef(null);
    20	  const containerRef = useRef(null);
    21	  const startXRef = useRef(0);
    22	  const currentPositionRef = useRef(0);
    23	  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
    24	
    25	  const handleStart = useCallback((clientX) => {
    26	    if (verified || failed) return;
    27	    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    28	    setIsDragging(true);
    29	    startXRef.current = clientX - currentPositionRef.current;
    30	  }, [verified, failed]);
    31	
    32	  const handleMove = useCallback((clientX) => {
    33	    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    34	
    35	    const container = containerRef.current;
    36	    if (!container) return;
    37	
    38	    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    39	    let newPosition = clientX - startXRef.current;
    40	    newPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(newPosition, maxMove));
    41	
    42	    currentPositionRef.current = newPosition;
    43	    setPosition(newPosition);
    44	  }, []);
    45	
    46	  const handleEnd = useCallback(() => {
    47	    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    48	    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    49	    setIsDragging(false);
    50	
    51	    const container = containerRef.current;
    52	    if (!container) return;
    53	
    54	    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    55	    const currentPercent = (currentPositionRef.current / maxMove) * 100;
    56	
    57	    // 验证是否滑动到最右边 (95%以上)
    58	    if (currentPercent >= 95) {
    59	      setVerified(true);
    60	      // 自动吸附到最右边
    61	      setPosition(maxMove);
    62	      currentPositionRef.current = maxMove;
    63	      if (onSuccess) {
    64	        setTimeout(() => onSuccess(), 300);
    65	      }
    66	    } else {
    67	      setFailed(true);
    68	      if (onFail) {
    69	        onFail();
    70	      }
    71	      setTimeout(() => {
    72	        setPosition(0);
    73	        currentPositionRef.current = 0;
    74	        setFailed(false);
    75	      }, 1000);
    76	    }
    77	  }, [onSuccess, onFail]);
    78	
    79	  // 鼠标事件
    80	  const handleMouseDown = useCallback((e) => {
    81	    e.preventDefault();
    82	    handleStart(e.clientX);
    83	  }, [handleStart]);
    84	
    85	  // 触摸事件
    86	  const handleTouchStart = useCallback((e) => {
    87	    e.preventDefault();
    88	    if (e.touches.length > 0) {
    89	      handleStart(e.touches[0].clientX);
    90	    }
    91	  }, [handleStart]);
    92	
    93	  useEffect(() => {
    94	    const onMouseMove = (e) => handleMove(e.clientX);
    95	    const onTouchMove = (e) => {
    96	      if (e.touches.length > 0) {
    97	        handleMove(e.touches[0].clientX);
    98	      }
    99	    };
   100	    const onEnd = () => handleEnd();
   101	
   102	    if (isDragging) {
   103	      document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
   104	      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);
   105	      document.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: false });
   106	      document.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd);
   107	
   108	      return () => {
   109	        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
   110	        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);
   111	        document.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
   112	        document.removeEventListener('touchend', onEnd);
   113	      };
   114	    }
   115	  }, [isDragging, handleMove, handleEnd]);
   116	
   117	  const reset = useCallback(() => {
   118	    setPosition(0);
   119	    currentPositionRef.current = 0;
   120	    setVerified(false);
   121	    setFailed(false);
   122	  }, []);
   123	
   124	  useEffect(() => {
   125	    if (sliderRef.current) {
   126	      sliderRef.current.reset = reset;
   127	    }
   128	  }, [reset]);
   129	
   130	  // 计算进度百分比用于显示
   131	  const getProgressPercent = () => {
   132	    const container = containerRef.current;
   133	    if (!container) return 0;
   134	    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
   135	    return Math.round((position / maxMove) * 100);
   136	  };
   137	
   138	  return (
   139	    <div className="slider-captcha-container">
   140	      {/* 滑块轨道 */}
   141	      <div
   142	        ref={containerRef}
   143	        className={`slider-captcha-track ${verified ? 'verified' : ''} ${failed ? 'failed' : ''}`}
   144	      >
   145	        <div className="slider-captcha-bg-text">
   146	          {verified ? '✓ 验证成功' : failed ? '✗ 请重试' : '向右滑动滑块完成验证'}
   147	        </div>
   148	
   149	        <div
   150	          className="slider-captcha-progress"
   151	          style={{ width: `${position}px` }}
   152	        />
   153	
   154	        <div
   155	          ref={sliderRef}
   156	          className={`slider-captcha-button ${isDragging ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
   157	          style={{ left: `${position}px` }}
   158	          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
   159	          onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
   160	        >
   161	          <div className="slider-icon">
   162	            {verified ? '✓' : failed ? '✗' : '››'}
   163	          </div>
   164	        </div>
   165	      </div>
   166	
   167	      <div className="captcha-hint">
   168	        {isDragging ? `已滑动 ${getProgressPercent()}%` : '按住滑块，向右拖动至最右端'}
   169	      </div>
   170	    </div>
   171	  );
   172	};
   173	
   174	export default SliderCaptcha;

---------------------------- 文件结束 ----------------------------

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	import './Toast.css';
    12	
    13	let toastId = 0;
    14	let toastCallbacks = [];
    15	
    16	export const showToast = (message, type = 'success', duration = 3000) => {
    17	  const id = toastId++;
    18	  const toast = { id, message, type, duration };
    19	  toastCallbacks.forEach(callback => callback(toast));
    20	};
    21	
    22	const Toast = () => {
    23	  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
    24	
    25	  const addToast = useCallback((toast) => {
    26	    setToasts(prev => [...prev, toast]);
    27	
    28	    // Auto remove after duration
    29	    setTimeout(() => {
    30	      removeToast(toast.id);
    31	    }, toast.duration);
    32	  }, []);
    33	
    34	  const removeToast = (id) => {
    35	    setToasts(prev => prev.filter(toast => toast.id !== id));
    36	  };
    37	
    38	  useEffect(() => {
    39	    toastCallbacks.push(addToast);
    40	    return () => {
    41	      toastCallbacks = toastCallbacks.filter(cb => cb !== addToast);
    42	    };
    43	  }, [addToast]);
    44	
    45	  return (
    46	    <div className="toast-container">
    47	      {toasts.map(toast => (
    48	        <div
    49	          key={toast.id}
    50	          className={`toast toast-${toast.type} toast-slide-in`}
    51	          onClick={() => removeToast(toast.id)}
    52	        >
    53	          <div className="toast-icon">
    54	            {toast.type === 'success' && (
    55	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    56	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    57	              </svg>
    58	            )}
    59	            {toast.type === 'error' && (
    60	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    61	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zM8.707 7.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414L8.586 10l-1.293 1.293a1 1 0 101.414 1.414L10 11.414l1.293 1.293a1 1 0 001.414-1.414L11.414 10l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L10 8.586 8.707 7.293z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    62	              </svg>
    63	            )}
    64	            {toast.type === 'warning' && (
    65	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    66	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M8.257 3.099c.765-1.36 2.722-1.36 3.486 0l5.58 9.92c.75 1.334-.213 2.98-1.742 2.98H4.42c-1.53 0-2.493-1.646-1.743-2.98l5.58-9.92zM11 13a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-8a1 1 0 00-1 1v3a1 1 0 002 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    67	              </svg>
    68	            )}
    69	            {toast.type === 'info' && (
    70	              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    71	                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    72	              </svg>
    73	            )}
    74	          </div>
    75	          <div className="toast-message">{toast.message}</div>
    76	          <button
    77	            className="toast-close"
    78	            onClick={(e) => {
    79	              e.stopPropagation();
    80	              removeToast(toast.id);
    81	            }}
    82	          >
    83	            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    84	              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    85	            </svg>
    86	          </button>
    87	        </div>
    88	      ))}
    89	    </div>
    90	  );
    91	};
    92	
    93	export default Toast;
