   263	                      <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   264	                        <path d="M10 2a1 1 0 011 1v1.323l3.954 1.582 1.599-.8a1 1 0 01.894 1.79l-1.233.616 1.738 5.42a1 1 0 01-.285 1.05L11.949 18H6.051L.333 13.98a1 1 0 01-.285-1.049l1.738-5.42-1.233-.617a1 1 0 11.894-1.788l1.599.799L7 4.323V3a1 1 0 011-1h2zm0 2.274L7 5.607v3.893a1 1 0 01-1 1H4.268l-1.2 3.748L7.586 17h4.828l4.519-2.752-1.2-3.748H14a1 1 0 01-1-1V5.607L10 4.274z"/>
   265	                      </svg>
   266	                    </div>
   267	                    <div className="stat-content-small">
   268	                      <div className="stat-label-small">累计节省</div>
   269	                      <div className="stat-value-small">{formatCurrency(detail.order_stats.total_saved)}</div>
   270	                    </div>
   271	                  </div>
   272	                  {detail.order_stats.last_order_at && (
   273	                    <div className="stat-card-small full-width">
   274	                      <div className="stat-label-small">最后订单时间</div>
   275	                      <div className="stat-value-small text-muted">{formatDate(detail.order_stats.last_order_at)}</div>
   276	                    </div>
   277	                  )}
   278	                </div>
   279	              </div>
   280	
   281	              {/* Invitation Statistics */}
   282	              {detail.invitation_stats && detail.invitation_stats.invitation_code && (
   283	                <div className="detail-section">
   284	                  <h3 className="section-title">邀请统计</h3>
   285	                  <div className="invitation-card">
   286	                    <div className="invitation-code">
   287	                      <label>邀请码：</label>
   288	                      <span className="code">{detail.invitation_stats.invitation_code}</span>
   289	                    </div>
   290	                    <div className="invitation-stats">
   291	                      <div className="stat-item">
   292	                        <div className="stat-number">{detail.invitation_stats.total_invited}</div>
   293	                        <div className="stat-label">总邀请数</div>
   294	                      </div>
   295	                      <div className="stat-item">
   296	                        <div className="stat-number success">{detail.invitation_stats.success_invited}</div>
   297	                        <div className="stat-label">成功邀请</div>
   298	                      </div>
   299	                      <div className="stat-item">
   300	                        <div className="stat-number reward">{detail.invitation_stats.rewards_earned}</div>
   301	                        <div className="stat-label">获得奖励</div>
   302	                      </div>
   303	                    </div>
   304	                  </div>
   305	                </div>
   306	              )}
   307	
   308	              {/* Coupon Statistics */}
   309	              <div className="detail-section">
   310	                <h3 className="section-title">折扣券统计</h3>
   311	                <div className="coupon-stats">
   312	                  <div className="coupon-stat-item">
   313	                    <span className="coupon-label">总领取：</span>
   314	                    <span className="coupon-value">{detail.coupon_stats.total_coupons}</span>
   315	                  </div>
   316	                  <div className="coupon-stat-item">
   317	                    <span className="coupon-label">已使用：</span>
   318	                    <span className="coupon-value used">{detail.coupon_stats.used_coupons}</span>
   319	                  </div>
   320	                  <div className="coupon-stat-item">
   321	                    <span className="coupon-label">可用：</span>
   322	                    <span className="coupon-value available">{detail.coupon_stats.available_coupons}</span>
   323	                  </div>
   324	                  <div className="coupon-stat-item">
   325	                    <span className="coupon-label">已过期：</span>
   326	                    <span className="coupon-value expired">{detail.coupon_stats.expired_coupons}</span>
   327	                  </div>
   328	                </div>
   329	              </div>
   330	
   331	              {/* Invitation Relationships */}
   332	              <div className="detail-section">
   333	                <h3 className="section-title">邀请关系</h3>
   334	                
   335	                {/* Invited By */}
   336	                {detail.invited_by ? (
   337	                  <div className="relationship-card">
   338	                    <div className="relationship-header">
   339	                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   340	                        <path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path>
   341	                        <circle cx="8.5" cy="7" r="4"></circle>
   342	                        <polyline points="17 11 19 13 23 9"></polyline>
   343	                      </svg>
   344	                      <span>邀请人</span>
   345	                    </div>
   346	                    <div className="inviter-info">
   347	                      <div className="inviter-details">
   348	                        <div className="inviter-name">
   349	                          {detail.invited_by.username || detail.invited_by.email || `用户 ${detail.invited_by.user_id}`}
   350	                        </div>
   351	                        <div className="inviter-meta">
   352	                          <span>ID: {detail.invited_by.user_id}</span>
   353	                          {detail.invited_by.email && <span>{detail.invited_by.email}</span>}
   354	                          <span>邀请时间: {formatDate(detail.invited_by.invited_at)}</span>
   355	                        </div>
   356	                      </div>
   357	                    </div>
   358	                  </div>
   359	                ) : (
   360	                  <div className="relationship-empty">
   361	                    <span>该用户无邀请人（直接注册）</span>
   362	                  </div>
   363	                )}
   364	
   365	                {/* Invited Users */}
   366	                {detail.invited_users && detail.invited_users.length > 0 && (
   367	                  <div className="relationship-card">
   368	                    <div className="relationship-header">
   369	                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   370	                        <path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path>
   371	                        <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"></circle>
   372	                        <path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"></path>
   373	                        <path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"></path>
   374	                      </svg>
   375	                      <span>已邀请用户 ({detail.invited_users.length})</span>
   376	                    </div>
   377	                    <div className="invited-users-list">
   378	                      {detail.invited_users.map((user) => (
   379	                        <div key={user.user_id} className="invited-user-item">
   380	                          <div className="invited-user-main">
   381	                            <div className="invited-user-name">
   382	                              {user.username || user.email || `用户 ${user.user_id}`}
   383	                            </div>
   384	                            <div className="invited-user-badges">
   385	                              {user.is_registered && (
   386	                                <span className="user-badge registered">已注册</span>
   387	                              )}
   388	                              {user.has_ordered && (
   389	                                <span className="user-badge ordered">已下单</span>
   390	                              )}
   391	                            </div>
   392	                          </div>
   393	                          <div className="invited-user-meta">
   394	                            <span>ID: {user.user_id}</span>
   395	                            {user.email && <span>{user.email}</span>}
   396	                            <span>{formatDate(user.invited_at)}</span>
   397	                          </div>
   398	                        </div>
   399	                      ))}
   400	                    </div>
   401	                  </div>
   402	                )}
   403	              </div>
   404	
   405	              {/* AI Conversation Statistics */}
   406	              <div className="detail-section">
   407	                <h3 className="section-title">AI对话统计</h3>
   408	                <div className="conversation-stats-card">
   409	                  <div className="conv-stats-overview">
   410	                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
   411	                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.total_conversations}</div>
   412	                      <div className="conv-stat-label">总对话数</div>
   413	                    </div>
   414	                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
   415	                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.total_rounds}</div>
   416	                      <div className="conv-stat-label">总轮次</div>
   417	                    </div>
   418	                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
   419	                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.avg_rounds_per_conv.toFixed(1)}</div>
   420	                      <div className="conv-stat-label">平均轮次/对话</div>
   421	                    </div>
   422	                  </div>
   423	                  <div className="conv-stats-timeline">
   424	                    <div className="timeline-item">
   425	                      <span className="timeline-label">今日</span>
   426	                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.today_rounds} 轮</span>
   427	                    </div>
   428	                    <div className="timeline-item">
   429	                      <span className="timeline-label">本周</span>
   430	                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.week_rounds} 轮</span>
   431	                    </div>
   432	                    <div className="timeline-item">
   433	                      <span className="timeline-label">本月</span>
   434	                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.month_rounds} 轮</span>
   435	                    </div>
   436	                  </div>
   437	                  {detail.ai_conversation_stats.last_conv_at && (
   438	                    <div className="conv-last-activity">
   439	                      最后对话: {formatDate(detail.ai_conversation_stats.last_conv_at)}
   440	                    </div>
   441	                  )}
   442	                </div>
   443	              </div>
   444	
   445	              {/* Analysis Conversation Statistics */}
   446	              <div className="detail-section">
   447	                <h3 className="section-title">智能分析统计</h3>
   448	                <div className="conversation-stats-card analysis">
   449	                  <div className="conv-stats-overview">
   450	                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
   451	                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.total_conversations}</div>
   452	                      <div className="conv-stat-label">总分析数</div>
   453	                    </div>
   454	                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
   455	                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.total_rounds}</div>
   456	                      <div className="conv-stat-label">总轮次</div>
   457	                    </div>
   458	                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
   459	                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.avg_rounds_per_conv.toFixed(1)}</div>
   460	                      <div className="conv-stat-label">平均轮次/分析</div>
   461	                    </div>
   462	                  </div>
   463	                  <div className="conv-stats-timeline">
   464	                    <div className="timeline-item">
   465	                      <span className="timeline-label">今日</span>
   466	                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.today_rounds} 轮</span>
   467	                    </div>
   468	                    <div className="timeline-item">
   469	                      <span className="timeline-label">本周</span>
   470	                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.week_rounds} 轮</span>
   471	                    </div>
   472	                    <div className="timeline-item">
   473	                      <span className="timeline-label">本月</span>
   474	                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.month_rounds} 轮</span>
   475	                    </div>
   476	                  </div>
   477	                  {detail.analysis_conversation_stats.last_conv_at && (
   478	                    <div className="conv-last-activity">
   479	                      最后分析: {formatDate(detail.analysis_conversation_stats.last_conv_at)}
   480	                    </div>
   481	                  )}
   482	                </div>
   483	              </div>
   484	            </>
   485	          ) : (
   486	            <div className="drawer-error">
   487	              <p>加载失败，请重试</p>
   488	            </div>
   489	          )}
   490	        </div>
   491	      </div>
   492	    </div>
   493	  );
   494	};
   495	
   496	export default UserDetailDrawer;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
    11	import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts';
    12	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    13	import './UserStatisticsChart.css';
    14	
    15	const UserStatisticsChart = () => {
    16	  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
    17	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    18	  const [showFilter, setShowFilter] = useState(false);
    19	  
    20	  // 时间范围和粒度
    21	  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState(() => {
    22	    const date = new Date();
    23	    date.setDate(date.getDate() - 29);
    24	    date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    25	    return formatDateTimeLocal(date);
    26	  });
    27	  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState(() => {
    28	    const date = new Date();
    29	    date.setHours(23, 59, 59, 0);
    30	    return formatDateTimeLocal(date);
    31	  });
    32	  const [granularity, setGranularity] = useState('day');
    33	
    34	  // 格式化日期为 datetime-local 输入格式
    35	  function formatDateTimeLocal(date) {
    36	    const year = date.getFullYear();
    37	    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    38	    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    39	    const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    40	    const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    41	    const seconds = String(date.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
    42	    return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds}`;
    43	  }
    44	
    45	  // 格式化日期为 API 格式
    46	  function formatDateTimeAPI(dateTimeLocal) {
    47	    return dateTimeLocal.replace('T', ' ');
    48	  }
    49	
    50	  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    51	    setLoading(true);
    52	    try {
    53	      const params = {
    54	        start_time: formatDateTimeAPI(startTime),
    55	        end_time: formatDateTimeAPI(endTime),
    56	        granularity: granularity
    57	      };
    58	      const response = await adminAPI.getUserStatisticsChart(params);
    59	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    60	        setData(response.data.data.statistics || []);
    61	      }
    62	    } catch (error) {
    63	      console.error('Failed to fetch user statistics:', error);
    64	    } finally {
    65	      setLoading(false);
    66	    }
    67	  }, [startTime, endTime, granularity]);
    68	
    69	  useEffect(() => {
    70	    fetchData();
    71	  }, [fetchData]);
    72	
    73	  const handleSearch = () => {
    74	    fetchData();
    75	    setShowFilter(false);
    76	  };
    77	
    78	  const handleCancel = () => {
    79	    setShowFilter(false);
    80	  };
    81	
    82	  // 快捷时间选择
    83	  const setQuickRange = (type) => {
    84	    const now = new Date();
    85	    let start = new Date();
    86	    let gran = 'day';
    87	
    88	    switch (type) {
    89	      case 'today':
    90	        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    91	        gran = 'hour';
    92	        break;
    93	      case 'yesterday':
    94	        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 1);
    95	        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    96	        now.setDate(now.getDate() - 1);
    97	        now.setHours(23, 59, 59, 0);
    98	        gran = 'hour';
    99	        break;
   100	      case 'week':
   101	        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 6);
   102	        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
   103	        gran = 'day';
   104	        break;
   105	      case 'month':
   106	        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 29);
   107	        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
   108	        gran = 'day';
   109	        break;
   110	      case 'quarter':
   111	        start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - 3);
   112	        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
   113	        gran = 'week';
   114	        break;
   115	      case 'year':
   116	        start.setFullYear(start.getFullYear() - 1);
   117	        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
   118	        gran = 'month';
   119	        break;
   120	      default:
   121	        break;
   122	    }
   123	
   124	    setStartTime(formatDateTimeLocal(start));
   125	    setEndTime(formatDateTimeLocal(now));
   126	    setGranularity(gran);
   127	  };
   128	
   129	  const granularityOptions = [
   130	    { value: 'hour', label: '小时' },
   131	    { value: 'day', label: '天' },
   132	    { value: 'week', label: '周' },
   133	    { value: 'month', label: '月' }
   134	  ];
   135	
   136	  const quickRangeOptions = [
   137	    { value: 'today', label: '今日' },
   138	    { value: 'yesterday', label: '昨日' },
   139	    { value: 'week', label: '近7天' },
   140	    { value: 'month', label: '近30天' },
   141	    { value: 'quarter', label: '近3月' },
   142	    { value: 'year', label: '近1年' }
   143	  ];
   144	
   145	  return (
   146	    <div className="chart-wrapper">
   147	      {/* 搜索条件按钮 */}
   148	      <div className="chart-toolbar">
   149	        <button 
   150	          className="filter-trigger-btn"
   151	          onClick={() => setShowFilter(true)}
   152	        >
   153	          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   154	            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
   155	            <path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/>
   156	          </svg>
   157	          搜索条件
   158	        </button>
   159	        <div className="current-range">
   160	          {startTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)} ~ {endTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}
   161	          <span className="granularity-tag">{granularityOptions.find(g => g.value === granularity)?.label}</span>
   162	        </div>
   163	      </div>
   164	
   165	      {/* 搜索条件弹窗 */}
   166	      {showFilter && (
   167	        <div className="filter-modal-overlay" onClick={handleCancel}>
   168	          <div className="filter-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
   169	            <div className="filter-modal-header">
   170	              <h4>搜索条件</h4>
   171	              <button className="filter-modal-close" onClick={handleCancel}>×</button>
   172	            </div>
   173	            <div className="filter-modal-body">
   174	              {/* 快捷选择 */}
   175	              <div className="filter-section">
   176	                <label>快捷选择</label>
   177	                <div className="quick-range-btns">
   178	                  {quickRangeOptions.map(opt => (
   179	                    <button
   180	                      key={opt.value}
   181	                      className="quick-range-btn"
   182	                      onClick={() => setQuickRange(opt.value)}
   183	                    >
   184	                      {opt.label}
   185	                    </button>
   186	                  ))}
   187	                </div>
   188	              </div>
   189	
   190	              <div className="filter-section">
   191	                <label>起始时间</label>
   192	                <input
   193	                  type="datetime-local"
   194	                  value={startTime}
   195	                  onChange={e => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
   196	                  className="filter-input"
   197	                  step="1"
   198	                />
   199	              </div>
   200	
   201	              <div className="filter-section">
   202	                <label>结束时间</label>
   203	                <input
   204	                  type="datetime-local"
   205	                  value={endTime}
   206	                  onChange={e => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
   207	                  className="filter-input"
   208	                  step="1"
   209	                />
   210	              </div>
   211	
   212	              <div className="filter-section">
   213	                <label>时间粒度</label>
   214	                <select
   215	                  value={granularity}
   216	                  onChange={e => setGranularity(e.target.value)}
   217	                  className="filter-select"
   218	                >
   219	                  {granularityOptions.map(opt => (
   220	                    <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
   221	                  ))}
   222	                </select>
   223	              </div>
   224	            </div>
   225	            <div className="filter-modal-footer">
   226	              <button className="filter-btn filter-btn-cancel" onClick={handleCancel}>取消</button>
   227	              <button className="filter-btn filter-btn-confirm" onClick={handleSearch}>确定</button>
   228	            </div>
   229	          </div>
   230	        </div>
   231	      )}
   232	
   233	      {/* 图表区域 */}
   234	      {loading ? (
   235	        <div className="chart-loading">
   236	          <div className="loading-spinner"></div>
   237	          <p>加载中...</p>
   238	        </div>
   239	      ) : !data || data.length === 0 ? (
   240	        <div className="chart-no-data">
   241	          <p>暂无数据</p>
   242	        </div>
   243	      ) : (
   244	        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
   245	          <LineChart data={data} margin={{ top: 10, right: 20, left: 0, bottom: 5 }}>
   246	            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e0e0e0" vertical={false} />
   247	            <XAxis
   248	              dataKey="label"
   249	              stroke="#999"
   250	              tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
   251	              tickLine={false}
   252	              axisLine={{ stroke: '#e0e0e0' }}
   253	              interval="preserveStartEnd"
   254	              angle={data.length > 15 ? -45 : 0}
   255	              textAnchor={data.length > 15 ? "end" : "middle"}
   256	              height={data.length > 15 ? 60 : 30}
   257	            />
   258	            <YAxis
   259	              stroke="#999"
   260	              tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
   261	              tickLine={false}
   262	              axisLine={false}
   263	              allowDecimals={false}
   264	              width={35}
   265	            />
   266	            <Tooltip
   267	              contentStyle={{
   268	                backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
   269	                border: '1px solid #374151',
   270	                borderRadius: '8px',
   271	                color: '#fff'
   272	              }}
   273	              labelStyle={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}
   274	              formatter={(value) => [value, '新注册用户']}
   275	              labelFormatter={(label, payload) => {
   276	                if (payload && payload[0]) {
   277	                  return payload[0].payload.time || label;
   278	                }
   279	                return label;
   280	              }}
   281	            />
   282	            <Legend
   283	              wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: '13px', paddingTop: '10px' }}
   284	              iconType="line"
   285	            />
   286	            <Line
   287	              type="monotone"
   288	              dataKey="new_users"
   289	              stroke="#667eea"
   290	              strokeWidth={2}
   291	              name="新注册用户"
   292	              dot={false}
   293	              activeDot={{ r: 4, strokeWidth: 0 }}
   294	            />
   295	          </LineChart>
   296	        </ResponsiveContainer>
   297	      )}
   298	    </div>
   299	  );
   300	};
   301	
   302	export default UserStatisticsChart;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState } from 'react';
    11	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import { showToast } from './Toast';
    13	import './VerifyPasswordModal.css';
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * 二次验证密码模态框
    17	 * 用于查看敏感信息前验证管理员身份
    18	 */
    19	const VerifyPasswordModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, onVerified }) => {
    20	  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
    21	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    22	
    23	  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    24	    e.preventDefault();
    25	
    26	    if (!password.trim()) {
    27	      showToast('请输入密码', 'error');
    28	      return;
    29	    }
    30	
    31	    setLoading(true);
    32	
    33	    try {
    34	      // 验证密码（使用修改密码接口，传入相同的旧密码和新密码作为验证）
    35	      const response = await adminAPI.verifyPassword(password);
    36	
    37	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    38	        showToast('验证成功', 'success');
    39	        setPassword('');
    40	        onVerified();
    41	        onClose();
    42	      } else {
    43	        showToast(response.data.message || '密码错误', 'error');
    44	      }
    45	    } catch (err) {
    46	      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '验证失败', 'error');
    47	    } finally {
    48	      setLoading(false);
    49	    }
    50	  };
    51	
    52	  const handleClose = () => {
    53	    setPassword('');
    54	    onClose();
    55	  };
    56	
    57	  if (!isOpen) return null;
    58	
    59	  return (
    60	    <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={handleClose}>
    61	      <div className="verify-password-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
    62	        <div className="modal-header">
    63	          <div className="modal-icon-warning">
    64	            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
    65	              <path d="M12 1v6m0 6v6m0 0h.01M12 21a9 9 0 110-18 9 9 0 010 18z"/>
    66	              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
    67	              <path d="M12 8v4m0 4h.01"/>
    68	            </svg>
    69	          </div>
    70	          <h3>安全验证</h3>
    71	          <p>查看敏感信息需要验证您的管理员密码</p>
    72	          <button onClick={handleClose} className="modal-close">
    73	            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    74	              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
    75	            </svg>
    76	          </button>
    77	        </div>
    78	
    79	        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="modal-body">
    80	          <div className="form-group">
    81	            <label htmlFor="verify-password">管理员密码</label>
    82	            <input
    83	              type="password"
    84	              id="verify-password"
    85	              className="input"
    86	              value={password}
    87	              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
    88	              placeholder="请输入管理员密码"
    89	              autoFocus
    90	              required
    91	            />
    92	          </div>
    93	
    94	          <div className="modal-actions">
    95	            <button
    96	              type="button"
    97	              onClick={handleClose}
    98	              className="btn btn-secondary"
    99	              disabled={loading}
   100	            >
   101	              取消
   102	            </button>
   103	            <button
   104	              type="submit"
   105	              className="btn btn-primary"
   106	              disabled={loading}
   107	            >
   108	              {loading ? (
   109	                <>
   110	                  <span className="spinner"></span>
   111	                  <span style={{ marginLeft: '0.5rem' }}>验证中...</span>
   112	                </>
   113	              ) : (
   114	                '验证并查看'
   115	              )}
   116	            </button>
   117	          </div>
   118	        </form>
   119	      </div>
   120	    </div>
   121	  );
   122	};
   123	
   124	export default VerifyPasswordModal;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import api from '../services/api';
    12	import './CouponsBase.css';
    13	
    14	const CouponBatchManagement = () => {
    15	  const [batches, setBatches] = useState([]);
    16	  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
    17	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    18	  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
    19	  const [showDetailsModal, setShowDetailsModal] = useState(false);
    20	  const [selectedBatch, setSelectedBatch] = useState(null);
    21	  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    22	    batch_code: '',
    23	    template_id: '',
    24	    name: '',
    25	    description: '',
    26	    target_type: 'all',
    27	    target_users: '',
    28	    total_quantity: 100
    29	  });
    30	
    31	  useEffect(() => {
    32	    fetchBatches();
    33	    fetchTemplates();
    34	  }, []);
    35	
    36	  const fetchBatches = async () => {
    37	    setLoading(true);
    38	    try {
    39	      const response = await api.get('/admin/coupon-batches');
    40	      setBatches(response.data.data.batches || []);
    41	    } catch (error) {
    42	      console.error('Failed to fetch batches:', error);
    43	    } finally {
    44	      setLoading(false);
    45	    }
    46	  };
    47	
    48	  const fetchTemplates = async () => {
    49	    try {
    50	      const response = await api.get('/admin/coupon-templates?page_size=100');
    51	      setTemplates(response.data.data.templates || []);
    52	    } catch (error) {
    53	      console.error('Failed to fetch templates:', error);
    54	    }
    55	  };
    56	
    57	  const handleCreateBatch = async () => {
    58	    try {
    59	      // Parse target users if it's a specific_users type
    60	      const payload = { ...formData };
    61	      if (formData.target_type === 'specific_users' && formData.target_users) {
    62	        payload.target_users = formData.target_users
    63	          .split(',')
    64	          .map(id => parseInt(id.trim()))
    65	          .filter(id => !isNaN(id));
    66	      } else {
    67	        delete payload.target_users;
    68	      }
    69	
    70	      // Convert template_id to number
    71	      payload.template_id = parseInt(payload.template_id);
    72	      payload.total_quantity = parseInt(payload.total_quantity);
    73	
    74	      await api.post('/admin/coupon-batches', payload);
    75	      setShowCreateModal(false);
    76	      resetForm();
    77	      fetchBatches();
    78	      alert('批次创建成功！');
    79	    } catch (error) {
    80	      console.error('Failed to create batch:', error);
    81	      alert('创建失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    82	    }
    83	  };
    84	
    85	  const handleExecuteBatch = async (batchId) => {
    86	    if (!window.confirm('确定要执行此批次发放吗？此操作不可撤销！')) return;
    87	
    88	    try {
    89	      await api.post(`/admin/coupon-batches/${batchId}/execute`);
    90	      fetchBatches();
    91	      alert('批次执行成功！');
    92	    } catch (error) {
    93	      console.error('Failed to execute batch:', error);
    94	      alert('执行失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    95	    }
    96	  };
    97	
    98	  const handleCancelBatch = async (batchId) => {
    99	    if (!window.confirm('确定要取消此批次吗？')) return;
   100	
   101	    try {
   102	      await api.post(`/admin/coupon-batches/${batchId}/cancel`);
   103	      fetchBatches();
   104	      alert('批次已取消');
   105	    } catch (error) {
   106	      console.error('Failed to cancel batch:', error);
   107	      alert('取消失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   108	    }
   109	  };
   110	
   111	  const viewBatchDetails = async (batchId) => {
   112	    try {
   113	      const response = await api.get(`/admin/coupon-batches/${batchId}`);
   114	      setSelectedBatch(response.data.data);
   115	      setShowDetailsModal(true);
   116	    } catch (error) {
   117	      console.error('Failed to fetch batch details:', error);
   118	    }
   119	  };
   120	
   121	  const resetForm = () => {
   122	    setFormData({
   123	      batch_code: '',
   124	      template_id: '',
   125	      name: '',
   126	      description: '',
   127	      target_type: 'all',
   128	      target_users: '',
   129	      total_quantity: 100
   130	    });
   131	  };
   132	
   133	  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
   134	    switch (status) {
   135	      case 'draft':
   136	        return 'badge-secondary';
   137	      case 'processing':
   138	        return 'badge-warning';
   139	      case 'completed':
   140	        return 'badge-success';
   141	      case 'cancelled':
   142	        return 'badge-danger';
   143	      default:
   144	        return 'badge-secondary';
   145	    }
   146	  };
   147	
   148	  const getTargetTypeDisplay = (type) => {
   149	    switch (type) {
   150	      case 'all':
   151	        return '全部用户';
   152	      case 'new_users':
   153	        return '新用户';
   154	      case 'paid_users':
   155	        return '付费用户';
   156	      case 'specific_users':
   157	        return '指定用户';
   158	      case 'user_group':
   159	        return '用户组';
   160	      default:
   161	        return type;
   162	    }
   163	  };
   164	
   165	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
   166	    if (!dateString) return '-';
   167	    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
   168	  };
   169	
   170	  if (loading) {
   171	    return <div className="loading">加载中...</div>;
   172	  }
   173	
   174	  return (
   175	    <div className="batch-management">
   176	      <div className="page-header">
   177	        <h2>批量发放管理</h2>
   178	        <button
   179	          className="btn btn-primary"
   180	          onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
   181	        >
   182	          创建批次
   183	        </button>
   184	      </div>
   185	
   186	      <div className="batches-table">
   187	        <table>
   188	          <thead>
   189	            <tr>
   190	              <th>批次编号</th>
   191	              <th>批次名称</th>
   192	              <th>折扣券模板</th>
   193	              <th>目标类型</th>
   194	              <th>计划发放</th>
   195	              <th>已发放</th>
   196	              <th>状态</th>
   197	              <th>创建时间</th>
   198	              <th>操作</th>
   199	            </tr>
   200	          </thead>
   201	          <tbody>
   202	            {batches.map(batch => (
   203	              <tr key={batch.id}>
   204	                <td className="code">{batch.batch_code}</td>
   205	                <td>
   206	                  <div className="batch-name">{batch.name}</div>
   207	                  {batch.description && (
   208	                    <div className="batch-desc">{batch.description}</div>
   209	                  )}
   210	                </td>
   211	                <td>{batch.template?.name || '-'}</td>
   212	                <td>{getTargetTypeDisplay(batch.target_type)}</td>
   213	                <td>{batch.total_quantity}</td>
   214	                <td>{batch.distributed_quantity || 0}</td>
   215	                <td>
   216	                  <span className={`badge ${getStatusBadgeClass(batch.status)}`}>
   217	                    {batch.status}
   218	                  </span>
   219	                </td>
   220	                <td>{formatDate(batch.created_at)}</td>
   221	                <td className="actions">
   222	                  <button
   223	                    className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary"
   224	                    onClick={() => viewBatchDetails(batch.id)}
   225	                  >
   226	                    详情
   227	                  </button>
   228	                  {batch.status === 'draft' && (
   229	                    <>
   230	                      <button
   231	                        className="btn btn-sm btn-success"
   232	                        onClick={() => handleExecuteBatch(batch.id)}
   233	                      >
   234	                        执行
   235	                      </button>
   236	                      <button
   237	                        className="btn btn-sm btn-danger"
   238	                        onClick={() => handleCancelBatch(batch.id)}

   246	            ))}
   247	          </tbody>
   248	        </table>
   249	      </div>

   251	      {/* Create Modal */}

   258	            </div>

   260	              <div className="form-group">
   261	                <label>批次编号 *</label>
   262	                <input
   263	                  type="text"
   264	                  value={formData.batch_code}
   265	                  onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, batch_code: e.target.value})}
   266	                  placeholder="如: BATCH20250101"
   267	                />
   268	              </div>

    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import api from '../services/api';
    12	import './CouponsBase.css';
    13	
    14	// 数字输入组件
    15	const NumberInput = ({ value, onChange, min = 0, max, step = 1, unit, placeholder }) => {
    16	  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = React.useState(value?.toString() || '');
    17	  const [isFocused, setIsFocused] = React.useState(false);
    18	
    19	  // 同步外部 value 变化
    20	  React.useEffect(() => {
    21	    if (!isFocused) {
    22	      setInputValue(value?.toString() || '');
    23	    }
    24	  }, [value, isFocused]);
    25	
    26	  const handleDecrease = () => {
    27	    const currentValue = parseFloat(inputValue) || 0;
    28	    const newValue = Math.max(min, currentValue - step);
    29	    setInputValue(newValue.toString());
    30	    onChange(newValue);
    31	  };
    32	
    33	  const handleIncrease = () => {
    34	    const currentValue = parseFloat(inputValue) || 0;
    35	    let newValue = currentValue + step;
    36	    if (max !== undefined) {
    37	      newValue = Math.min(max, newValue);
    38	    }
    39	    setInputValue(newValue.toString());
    40	    onChange(newValue);
    41	  };
    42	
    43	  const handleInputChange = (e) => {
    44	    const val = e.target.value;
    45	    // 允许空值和正在输入的状态
    46	    setInputValue(val);
    47	  };
    48	
    49	  const handleFocus = (e) => {
    50	    setIsFocused(true);
    51	    // 如果当前值是0，选中全部以便覆盖输入
    52	    if (value === 0 || inputValue === '0') {
    53	      e.target.select();
    54	    }
    55	  };
    56	
    57	  const handleBlur = () => {
    58	    setIsFocused(false);
    59	    // 失焦时验证并提交值
    60	    let finalValue = parseFloat(inputValue);
    61	    if (isNaN(finalValue) || inputValue === '') {
    62	      finalValue = min;
    63	    }
    64	    if (max !== undefined) {
    65	      finalValue = Math.min(max, finalValue);
    66	    }
    67	    finalValue = Math.max(min, finalValue);
    68	    setInputValue(finalValue.toString());
    69	    onChange(finalValue);
    70	  };
    71	
    72	  const displayValue = isFocused ? inputValue : (value?.toString() || '');
    73	
    74	  return (
    75	    <div className="number-input-wrapper">
    76	      <button 
    77	        type="button"
    78	        className="number-btn decrease" 
    79	        onClick={handleDecrease}
    80	        disabled={value <= min}
    81	      >
    82	        −
    83	      </button>
    84	      <input
    85	        type="text"
    86	        inputMode="decimal"
    87	        value={displayValue}
    88	        onChange={handleInputChange}
    89	        onFocus={handleFocus}
    90	        onBlur={handleBlur}
    91	        placeholder={placeholder || '输入数值'}
    92	      />
    93	      {unit && <span className="number-input-unit">{unit}</span>}
    94	      <button 
    95	        type="button"
    96	        className="number-btn increase" 
    97	        onClick={handleIncrease}
    98	        disabled={max !== undefined && value >= max}
    99	      >
   100	        +
   101	      </button>
   102	    </div>
   103	  );
   104	};
   105	
   106	const CouponManagement = () => {
   107	  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
   108	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   109	  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
   110	  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);
   111	  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState(null);
   112	  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
   113	    code: '',
   114	    name: '',
   115	    description: '',
   116	    type: 'percentage',
   117	    discount_value: 0,
   118	    min_purchase_amount: 0,
   119	    distribution_type: 'manual',
   120	    valid_days: 30,
   121	    max_usage_per_user: 1,
   122	    first_purchase_only: false,
   123	    is_invite_coupon: false
   124	  });
   125	
   126	  // 折扣类型配置
   127	  const discountTypes = [
   128	    {
   129	      value: 'percentage',
   130	      label: '百分比折扣',
   131	      icon: '%',
   132	      description: '按订单金额的百分比减免',
   133	      valueLabel: '折扣比例',
   134	      valueUnit: '%',
   135	      valuePlaceholder: '例如：10 表示打9折',
   136	      valueHelp: '输入1-100的数字，如10表示减免10%（即打9折）',
   137	      exampleCalc: (value, amount) => `订单 ¥${amount} × ${value}% = 优惠 ¥${(amount * value / 100).toFixed(2)}，实付 ¥${(amount - amount * value / 100).toFixed(2)}`
   138	    },
   139	    {
   140	      value: 'fixed',
   141	      label: '固定价格',
   142	      icon: '¥',
   143	      description: '用户只需支付固定金额，无论原价多少',
   144	      valueLabel: '固定支付金额',
   145	      valueUnit: '元',
   146	      valuePlaceholder: '例如：99 表示只需支付99元',
   147	      valueHelp: '用户使用此券后只需支付此固定金额',
   148	      exampleCalc: (value, amount) => value >= amount 
   149	        ? `订单 ¥${amount}，固定价 ¥${value} ≥ 原价，无优惠`
   150	        : `订单 ¥${amount}，使用后只需支付 ¥${value}，优惠 ¥${(amount - value).toFixed(2)}`
   151	    },
   152	    {
   153	      value: 'price_off',
   154	      label: '立减金额',
   155	      icon: '-¥',
   156	      description: '直接减免固定金额',
   157	      valueLabel: '减免金额',
   158	      valueUnit: '元',
   159	      valuePlaceholder: '例如：20 表示立减20元',
   160	      valueHelp: '订单金额直接减去此数值',
   161	      exampleCalc: (value, amount) => `订单 ¥${amount} - ¥${value} = 实付 ¥${Math.max(0, amount - value).toFixed(2)}`
   162	    }
   163	  ];
   164	
   165	  // 发放方式配置
   166	  const distributionTypes = [
   167	    {
   168	      value: 'manual',
   169	      label: '手动发放',
   170	      icon: 'M',
   171	      description: '管理员手动选择用户发放'
   172	    },
   173	    {
   174	      value: 'auto_register',
   175	      label: '注册自动发放',
   176	      icon: 'R',
   177	      description: '新用户注册时自动获得'
   178	    },
   179	    {
   180	      value: 'auto_invite',
   181	      label: '邀请自动发放',
   182	      icon: 'I',
   183	      description: '成功邀请新用户后自动获得'
   184	    }
   185	  ];
   186	
   187	  // 获取当前折扣类型配置
   188	  const getCurrentDiscountType = () => {
   189	    return discountTypes.find(t => t.value === formData.type) || discountTypes[0];
   190	  };
   191	
   192	  useEffect(() => {
   193	    fetchTemplates();
   194	  }, []);
   195	
   196	  const fetchTemplates = async () => {
   197	    setLoading(true);
   198	    try {
   199	      const response = await api.get('/admin/coupon-templates');
   200	      setTemplates(response.data.data.templates || []);
   201	    } catch (error) {
   202	      console.error('Failed to fetch templates:', error);
   203	    } finally {
   204	      setLoading(false);
   205	    }
   206	  };
   207	
   208	  const handleCreateTemplate = async () => {
   209	    try {
   210	      await api.post('/admin/coupon-templates', formData);
   211	      setShowCreateModal(false);
   212	      resetForm();
   213	      fetchTemplates();
   214	    } catch (error) {
   215	      console.error('Failed to create template:', error);
   216	      alert('创建失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   217	    }
   218	  };
   219	
   220	  const handleUpdateTemplate = async () => {
   221	    try {
   222	      await api.put(`/admin/coupon-templates/${selectedTemplate.id}`, formData);
   223	      setShowEditModal(false);
   224	      resetForm();
   225	      fetchTemplates();
   226	    } catch (error) {
   227	      console.error('Failed to update template:', error);
   228	      alert('更新失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   229	    }
   230	  };
   231	
   232	  const [deleteModalVisible, setDeleteModalVisible] = useState(false);
   233	  const [deleteTargetId, setDeleteTargetId] = useState(null);
   234	  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState('');
   235	  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
   236	  
   237	  // 点击删除按钮，显示确认弹窗
   238	  const handleDeleteClick = (id) => {
   239	    setDeleteTargetId(id);
   240	    setDeleteError('');
   241	    setDeleteModalVisible(true);
   242	  };
   243	
   244	  // 确认删除
   245	  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
   246	    if (deleting || !deleteTargetId) return;
   247	    
   248	    setDeleting(true);
   249	    setDeleteError('');
   250	    
   251	    try {
   252	      await api.delete(`/admin/coupon-templates/${deleteTargetId}`);
   253	      setDeleteModalVisible(false);
   254	      setDeleteTargetId(null);
   255	      fetchTemplates();
   256	    } catch (error) {
   257	      console.error('Failed to delete template:', error);
   258	      const errorMsg = error.response?.data?.message || error.message;
   259	      setDeleteError(errorMsg);
   260	    } finally {
   261	      setDeleting(false);
   262	    }
   263	  };
   264	
   265	  // 取消删除
   266	  const handleCancelDelete = () => {
   267	    setDeleteModalVisible(false);
   268	    setDeleteTargetId(null);
   269	    setDeleteError('');
   270	  };
   271	
   272	  const handleActivateTemplate = async (id) => {
   273	    try {
   274	      await api.post(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}/activate`);
   275	      fetchTemplates();
   276	    } catch (error) {
   277	      console.error('Failed to activate template:', error);
   278	    }
   279	  };
   280	
   281	  const handlePauseTemplate = async (id) => {
   282	    try {
   283	      await api.post(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}/pause`);
   284	      fetchTemplates();
   285	    } catch (error) {
   286	      console.error('Failed to pause template:', error);
   287	    }
   288	  };
   289	
   290	  const resetForm = () => {
   291	    setFormData({
   292	      code: '',
   293	      name: '',
   294	      description: '',
   295	      type: 'percentage',
   296	      discount_value: 0,
   297	      min_purchase_amount: 0,
   298	      distribution_type: 'manual',
   299	      valid_days: 30,
   300	      max_usage_per_user: 1,
   301	      first_purchase_only: false,
   302	      is_invite_coupon: false
   303	    });
   304	    setSelectedTemplate(null);
   305	  };
   306	
   307	  const openEditModal = (template) => {
   308	    setSelectedTemplate(template);
   309	    setFormData({
   310	      name: template.name,
   311	      description: template.description,
   312	      min_purchase_amount: template.min_purchase_amount,
   313	      valid_days: template.valid_days,
   314	      max_usage_per_user: template.max_usage_per_user,
   315	      first_purchase_only: template.first_purchase_only,
   316	      status: template.status
   317	    });
   318	    setShowEditModal(true);
   319	  };
   320	
   321	  const getDiscountDisplay = (type, value) => {
   322	    switch (type) {
   323	      case 'percentage':
   324	        return `${value}%`;
   325	      case 'fixed':
   326	      case 'price_off':
   327	        return `¥${value}`;
   328	      default:
   329	        return value;
   330	    }
   331	  };
   332	
   333	  const getTypeDisplay = (type) => {
   334	    switch (type) {
   335	      case 'percentage':
   336	        return '百分比折扣';
   337	      case 'fixed':
   338	        return '固定价格';
   339	      case 'price_off':
   340	        return '立减金额';
   341	      default:
   342	        return type;
   343	    }
   344	  };
   345	
   346	  const getDistributionDisplay = (type) => {
   347	    switch (type) {
   348	      case 'manual':
   349	        return '手动发放';
   350	      case 'auto_register':
   351	        return '注册自动';
   352	      case 'auto_invite':
   353	        return '邀请自动';
   354	      case 'batch':
   355	        return '批量发放';
   356	      case 'targeted':
   357	        return '定向发放';
   358	      default:
   359	        return type;
   360	    }
   361	  };
   362	
   363	  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
   364	    switch (status) {
   365	      case 'active':
   366	        return 'badge-success';
   367	      case 'paused':
   368	        return 'badge-warning';
   369	      case 'expired':
   370	        return 'badge-danger';
   371	      default:
   372	        return 'badge-secondary';
   373	    }
   374	  };
   375	
   376	  if (loading) {
   377	    return <div className="loading">加载中...</div>;
   378	  }
   379	
   380	  return (
   381	    <div className="coupon-management">
   382	      <div className="page-header">
   383	        <h2>折扣券管理</h2>
   384	        <button
   385	          className="btn btn-primary"
   386	          onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
   387	        >
   388	          创建折扣券
   389	        </button>
   390	      </div>
   391	
   392	      <div className="templates-table">
   393	        <table>
   394	          <thead>
   395	            <tr>
   396	              <th>编码</th>
   397	              <th>名称</th>
   398	              <th>类型</th>
   399	              <th>折扣</th>
   400	              <th>最低消费</th>
   401	              <th>发放方式</th>
   402	              <th>有效天数</th>
   403	              <th>状态</th>
   404	              <th>操作</th>
   405	            </tr>
   406	          </thead>
   407	          <tbody>
   408	            {templates.map(template => (
   409	              <tr key={template.id}>
   410	                <td className="code">{template.code}</td>
   411	                <td>
   412	                  <div className="template-name">{template.name}</div>
   413	                  <div className="template-desc">{template.description}</div>
   414	                </td>
   415	                <td>{getTypeDisplay(template.type)}</td>
   416	                <td className="discount">
   417	                  {getDiscountDisplay(template.type, template.discount_value)}
   418	                </td>
   419	                <td>¥{template.min_purchase_amount}</td>
   420	                <td>{getDistributionDisplay(template.distribution_type)}</td>
   421	                <td>{template.valid_days}天</td>
   422	                <td>
   423	                  <span className={`badge ${getStatusBadgeClass(template.status)}`}>
   424	                    {template.status}
   425	                  </span>
   426	                </td>
   427	                <td className="actions">
   428	                  <button
   429	                    className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary"
   430	                    onClick={() => openEditModal(template)}
   431	                  >
   432	                    编辑
   433	                  </button>
   434	                  {template.status === 'active' ? (
   435	                    <button
   436	                      className="btn btn-sm btn-warning"
   437	                      onClick={() => handlePauseTemplate(template.id)}
   438	                    >
   439	                      暂停
   440	                    </button>
   441	                  ) : (
   442	                    <button
   443	                      className="btn btn-sm btn-success"
   444	                      onClick={() => handleActivateTemplate(template.id)}
   445	                    >
   446	                      激活
   447	                    </button>
   448	                  )}
   449	                  <button
   450	                    className="btn btn-sm btn-danger"
   451	                    onClick={(e) => {
   452	                      e.stopPropagation();
   453	                      handleDeleteClick(template.id);
   454	                    }}
   455	                  >
   456	                    删除
   457	                  </button>
   458	                </td>
   459	              </tr>
   460	            ))}
   461	          </tbody>
   462	        </table>
   463	      </div>
   464	
   465	      {/* Create Modal */}
   466	      {showCreateModal && (
   467	        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}>
   468	          <div className="modal-content modal-large" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
   469	            <div className="modal-header">
   470	              <h3>创建折扣券</h3>
   471	              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}>×</button>
   472	            </div>
   473	            <div className="modal-body">
   474	              {/* 基本信息 */}
   475	              <div className="form-section">
   476	                <div className="form-section-title">基本信息</div>
   477	                <div className="form-group">
   478	                  <label>折扣券名称 *</label>
   479	                  <input
   480	                    type="text"
   481	                    value={formData.name}
   482	                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, name: e.target.value})}
   483	                    placeholder="例如：新用户专享8折券"
   484	                  />
   485	                  <div className="form-hint">折扣券编码将根据发放方式自动生成</div>
   486	                </div>
   487	                <div className="form-group">
   488	                  <label>描述</label>
   489	                  <textarea
   490	                    value={formData.description}
   491	                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, description: e.target.value})}
   492	                    placeholder="简要描述折扣券的用途和优惠内容"
   493	                  />
   494	                </div>
   495	              </div>
   496	
   497	              {/* 折扣类型 */}
   498	              <div className="form-section">
   499	                <div className="form-section-title">折扣类型 *</div>
   500	                <div className="radio-card-group">
   501	                  {discountTypes.map(type => (
   502	                    <div 
   503	                      key={type.value}
   504	                      className={`radio-card ${formData.type === type.value ? 'active' : ''}`}
   505	                      onClick={() => setFormData({...formData, type: type.value})}
   506	                    >
   507	                      <div className="radio-card-icon">{type.icon}</div>
   508	                      <div className="radio-card-content">
   509	                        <div className="radio-card-label">{type.label}</div>
   510	                        <div className="radio-card-desc">{type.description}</div>
   511	                      </div>
   512	                      <div className="radio-card-check">
   513	                        {formData.type === type.value && <span>✓</span>}
   514	                      </div>
   515	                    </div>
   516	                  ))}
   517	                </div>
   518	              </div>
   519	
   520	              {/* 折扣值 */}
   521	              <div className="form-section">
   522	                <div className="form-section-title">
   523	                  {getCurrentDiscountType().valueLabel} *
   524	                  <span className="form-section-hint">{getCurrentDiscountType().valueHelp}</span>
   525	                </div>
   526	                <NumberInput
   527	                  value={formData.discount_value}
   528	                  onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, discount_value: val})}
   529	                  min={0}
   530	                  max={formData.type === 'percentage' ? 100 : undefined}
   531	                  step={formData.type === 'percentage' ? 5 : 10}
   532	                  unit={getCurrentDiscountType().valueUnit}
   533	                  placeholder={getCurrentDiscountType().valuePlaceholder}
   534	                />
   535	                {formData.discount_value > 0 && (
   536	                  <div className="calc-preview">
   537	                    <div className="calc-preview-title">计算示例</div>
   538	                    <div className="calc-preview-content">
   539	                      {getCurrentDiscountType().exampleCalc(formData.discount_value, 100)}
   540	                    </div>
   541	                  </div>
   542	                )}
   543	              </div>
   544	
   545	              {/* 使用门槛 */}
   546	              <div className="form-section">
   547	                <div className="form-section-title">
   548	                  使用门槛
   549	                  <span className="form-section-hint">订单金额需达到此金额才能使用，设为0表示无门槛</span>
   550	                </div>
   551	                <NumberInput
   552	                  value={formData.min_purchase_amount}
   553	                  onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, min_purchase_amount: val})}
   554	                  min={0}
   555	                  step={10}
   556	                  unit="元"
   557	                />
   558	                {formData.min_purchase_amount > 0 && (
   559	                  <div className="form-hint" style={{marginTop: '8px'}}>
   560	                    订单满 ¥{formData.min_purchase_amount} 可用
   561	                  </div>
   562	                )}
   563	              </div>
   564	
   565	              {/* 发放方式 */}
   566	              <div className="form-section">
   567	                <div className="form-section-title">发放方式 *</div>
   568	                <div className="radio-card-group">
   569	                  {distributionTypes.map(type => (
   570	                    <div 
   571	                      key={type.value}
   572	                      className={`radio-card ${formData.distribution_type === type.value ? 'active' : ''}`}
   573	                      onClick={() => setFormData({
   574	                        ...formData, 
   575	                        distribution_type: type.value,
   576	                        is_invite_coupon: type.value === 'auto_invite'
   577	                      })}
   578	                    >
   579	                      <div className="radio-card-icon">{type.icon}</div>
   580	                      <div className="radio-card-content">
   581	                        <div className="radio-card-label">{type.label}</div>
   582	                        <div className="radio-card-desc">{type.description}</div>
   583	                      </div>
   584	                      <div className="radio-card-check">
   585	                        {formData.distribution_type === type.value && <span>✓</span>}
   586	                      </div>
   587	                    </div>
   588	                  ))}
   589	                </div>
   590	              </div>
   591	
   592	              {/* 其他设置 */}
   593	              <div className="form-section">
   594	                <div className="form-section-title">其他设置</div>
   595	                <div className="form-row">
   596	                  <div className="form-group">
   597	                    <label>有效天数</label>
   598	                    <NumberInput
   599	                      value={formData.valid_days}
   600	                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, valid_days: val})}
   601	                      min={1}
   602	                      step={7}
   603	                      unit="天"
   604	                    />
   605	                    <div className="form-hint">领取后的有效使用期限</div>
   606	                  </div>
   607	                  <div className="form-group">
   608	                    <label>每用户可用次数</label>
   609	                    <NumberInput
   610	                      value={formData.max_usage_per_user}
   611	                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, max_usage_per_user: val})}
   612	                      min={1}
   613	                      max={10}
   614	                      step={1}
   615	                      unit="次"
   616	                    />
   617	                    <div className="form-hint">每个用户最多可使用次数</div>
   618	                  </div>
   619	                </div>
   620	                <div className="form-group">
   621	                  <div className="checkbox-styled">
   622	                    <input
   623	                      type="checkbox"
   624	                      id="first_purchase_only"
   625	                      checked={formData.first_purchase_only}
   626	                      onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, first_purchase_only: e.target.checked})}
   627	                    />
   628	                    <label htmlFor="first_purchase_only">
   629	                      <span className="checkbox-box"></span>
   630	                      <div className="checkbox-content">
   631	                        <span className="checkbox-text">仅限首次购买</span>
   632	                        <span className="checkbox-hint">勾选后，仅从未购买过的用户可使用此券</span>
   633	                      </div>
   634	                    </label>
   635	                  </div>
   636	                </div>
   637	              </div>
   638	            </div>
   639	            <div className="modal-footer">
   640	              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}>
   641	                取消
   642	              </button>
   643	              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreateTemplate}>
   644	                创建折扣券
   645	              </button>
   646	            </div>
   647	          </div>
   648	        </div>
   649	      )}
   650	
   651	      {/* Edit Modal */}
   652	      {showEditModal && (
   653	        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)}>
   654	          <div className="modal-content" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
   655	            <div className="modal-header">
   656	              <h3>编辑折扣券</h3>
   657	              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)}>×</button>
   658	            </div>
   659	            <div className="modal-body">
   660	              <div className="form-section">
   661	                <div className="form-section-title">基本信息</div>
   662	                <div className="form-group">
   663	                  <label>折扣券名称</label>
   664	                  <input
   665	                    type="text"
   666	                    value={formData.name}
   667	                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, name: e.target.value})}
   668	                  />
   669	                </div>
   670	                <div className="form-group">
   671	                  <label>描述</label>
   672	                  <textarea
   673	                    value={formData.description}
   674	                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, description: e.target.value})}
   675	                  />
   676	                </div>
   677	              </div>
   678	              <div className="form-section">
   679	                <div className="form-section-title">使用规则</div>
   680	                <div className="form-row">
   681	                  <div className="form-group">
   682	                    <label>使用门槛</label>
   683	                    <NumberInput
   684	                      value={formData.min_purchase_amount}
   685	                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, min_purchase_amount: val})}
   686	                      min={0}
   687	                      step={10}
   688	                      unit="元"
   689	                    />
   690	                  </div>
   691	                  <div className="form-group">
   692	                    <label>有效天数</label>
   693	                    <NumberInput
   694	                      value={formData.valid_days}
   695	                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, valid_days: val})}
   696	                      min={1}
   697	                      step={7}
   698	                      unit="天"
   699	                    />
   700	                  </div>
   701	                </div>
   702	                <div className="form-group">
   703	                  <label>每用户可用次数</label>
   704	                  <div style={{maxWidth: '200px'}}>
   705	                    <NumberInput
   706	                      value={formData.max_usage_per_user}
   707	                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, max_usage_per_user: val})}
   708	                      min={1}
   709	                      max={10}
   710	                      step={1}
   711	                      unit="次"
   712	                    />
   713	                  </div>
   714	                </div>
   715	                <div className="form-group">
   716	                  <div className="checkbox-styled">
   717	                    <input
   718	                      type="checkbox"
   719	                      id="edit_first_purchase_only"
   720	                      checked={formData.first_purchase_only}
   721	                      onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, first_purchase_only: e.target.checked})}
   722	                    />
   723	                    <label htmlFor="edit_first_purchase_only">
   724	                      <span className="checkbox-box"></span>
   725	                      <div className="checkbox-content">
   726	                        <span className="checkbox-text">仅限首次购买</span>
   727	                        <span className="checkbox-hint">勾选后，仅从未购买过的用户可使用此券</span>
   728	                      </div>
   729	                    </label>
   730	                  </div>
   731	                </div>
   732	              </div>
   733	            </div>
   734	            <div className="modal-footer">
   735	              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)}>
   736	                取消
   737	              </button>
   738	              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleUpdateTemplate}>
   739	                保存修改
   740	              </button>
   741	            </div>
   742	          </div>
   743	        </div>
   744	      )}
   745	
   746	      {/* 删除确认弹窗 */}
   747	      {deleteModalVisible && (
   748	        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>
   749	          <div className="modal-content delete-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
   750	            <div className="modal-header">
   751	              <h3>确认删除</h3>
   752	              <button className="modal-close" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>&times;</button>
   753	            </div>
   754	            <div className="modal-body">
   755	              <p className="delete-warning">确定要删除这个折扣券吗？</p>
   756	              <p className="delete-hint">注意：已发放给用户或有批次记录的折扣券无法删除。</p>
   757	              {deleteError && (
   758	                <div className="delete-error">
   759	                  {deleteError}
   760	                </div>
   761	              )}
   762	            </div>
   763	            <div className="modal-footer">
   764	              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>
   765	                取消
   766	              </button>
   767	              <button 
   768	                className="btn btn-danger" 
   769	                onClick={handleConfirmDelete}
   770	                disabled={deleting}
   771	              >
   772	                {deleting ? '删除中...' : '确认删除'}
   773	              </button>
   774	            </div>
   775	          </div>
   776	        </div>
   777	      )}
   778	    </div>
   779	  );
   780	};
   781	
   782	export default CouponManagement;

    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

    27	
    28	const DashboardHome = () => {
    29	  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
    30	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    31	  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
    32	
    33	  useEffect(() => {
    34	    loadStatistics();
    35	    // 每30秒刷新一次统计数据
    36	    const interval = setInterval(loadStatistics, 30000);
    37	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
    38	  }, []);
    39	
    40	  const loadStatistics = async () => {
    41	    try {
    42	      setError(null);
    43	      const response = await adminAPI.getDashboardStatistics();
    44	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    45	        setStats(response.data.data);
    46	      } else {
    47	        setError(response.data.message || '加载统计数据失败');
    48	      }
    49	    } catch (err) {
    50	      console.error('Failed to load dashboard statistics:', err);
    51	      setError('加载统计数据失败');
    52	    } finally {
    53	      setLoading(false);
    54	    }
    55	  };
    56	
    57	  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    58	    return `¥${value.toFixed(2)}`;
    59	  };
    60	
    61	  const formatNumber = (value) => {
    62	    if (value >= 10000) {
    63	      return `${(value / 10000).toFixed(1)}万`;
    64	    }
    65	    return value.toString();
    66	  };
    67	
    68	  if (loading) {
    69	    return (
    70	      <div className="dashboard-home">
    71	        <div className="loading-skeleton">
    72	          <div className="skeleton-card" />
    73	          <div className="skeleton-card" />
    74	          <div className="skeleton-card" />
    75	        </div>
    76	      </div>
    77	    );
    78	  }
    79	
    80	  if (error) {
    81	    return (
    82	      <div className="dashboard-home">
    83	        <div className="error-message">
    84	          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
    85	            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7 4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-9a1 1 0 00-1 1v4a1 1 0 102 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd" />
    86	          </svg>
    87	          <p>{error}</p>
    88	          <button onClick={loadStatistics} className="btn btn-primary">重试</button>
    89	        </div>
    90	      </div>
    91	    );
    92	  }
    93	
    94	  if (!stats) return null;
    95	
    96	  return (

    98	      {/* 核心指标卡片 */}

   105	            </svg>

   109	            <h3 className="stat-value">{formatNumber(stats.total_users)}</h3>
   110	            <div className="stat-details">
   111	              <span className="stat-badge">今日 +{stats.new_users_today}</span>
   112	              <span className="stat-badge">7天 +{stats.new_users_7d}</span>

   115	            <div className="section-header">

文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/DistributedCoupons.js
