     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
    13	import './DistributedCoupons.css';
    14	
    15	const DistributedCoupons = () => {
    16	  const [coupons, setCoupons] = useState([]);
    17	  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
    18	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    19	  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    20	  const [pageSize] = useState(20);
    21	  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
    22	
    23	  // Filters
    24	  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    25	    templateId: '',
    26	    status: '',
    27	    userEmail: ''
    28	  });
    29	
    30	  useEffect(() => {
    31	    fetchTemplates();
    32	    fetchCoupons();
    33	  }, [page, filters]);
    34	
    35	  const fetchTemplates = async () => {
    36	    try {
    37	      const response = await adminAPI.getCouponTemplates(1, 100);
    38	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    39	        setTemplates(response.data.data.templates || []);
    40	      }
    41	    } catch (error) {
    42	      console.error('Failed to fetch templates:', error);
    43	    }
    44	  };
    45	
    46	  const fetchCoupons = async () => {
    47	    setLoading(true);
    48	    try {
    49	      const response = await adminAPI.getDistributedCoupons(
    50	        page,
    51	        pageSize,
    52	        filters.templateId,
    53	        filters.status,
    54	        filters.userEmail
    55	      );
    56	
    57	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    58	        setCoupons(response.data.data.coupons || []);
    59	        setTotal(response.data.data.total || 0);
    60	      }
    61	    } catch (error) {
    62	      console.error('Failed to fetch distributed coupons:', error);
    63	      showToast('获取折扣券列表失败', 'error');
    64	    } finally {
    65	      setLoading(false);
    66	    }
    67	  };
    68	
    69	  const handleFilterChange = (key, value) => {
    70	    setFilters({ ...filters, [key]: value });
    71	    setPage(1); // Reset to first page when filters change
    72	  };
    73	
    74	  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    75	    setFilters({
    76	      templateId: '',
    77	      status: '',
    78	      userEmail: ''
    79	    });
    80	    setPage(1);
    81	  };
    82	
    83	  const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
    84	    const statusMap = {
    85	      unused: { text: '未使用', className: 'status-unused' },
    86	      reserved: { text: '已预留', className: 'status-reserved' },
    87	      used: { text: '已使用', className: 'status-used' },
    88	      expired: { text: '已过期', className: 'status-expired' }
    89	    };
    90	    const config = statusMap[status] || { text: status, className: '' };
    91	    return <span className={`status-badge ${config.className}`}>{config.text}</span>;
    92	  };
    93	
    94	  const getDiscountDisplay = (template) => {
    95	    if (!template) return '-';
    96	
    97	    if (template.type === 'percentage') {
    98	      return `${template.discount_value}%`;
    99	    } else if (template.type === 'fixed') {
   100	      return `¥${template.discount_value}`;
   101	    } else if (template.type === 'price_off') {
   102	      return `满减¥${template.discount_value}`;
   103	    }
   104	    return '-';
   105	  };
   106	
   107	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
   108	    if (!dateString) return '-';
   109	    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
   110	  };
   111	
   112	  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);
   113	
   114	  return (
   115	    <div className="distributed-coupons-container">
   116	      <div className="page-header">
   117	        <h1>已发放折扣券列表</h1>
   118	        <p className="page-description">查看和管理所有已发放给用户的折扣券</p>
   119	      </div>
   120	
   121	      {/* Filters */}
   122	      <div className="filters-section">
   123	        <div className="filter-group">
   124	          <label>折扣券模板</label>
   125	          <select
   126	            value={filters.templateId}
   127	            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('templateId', e.target.value)}
   128	          >
   129	            <option value="">全部模板</option>
   130	            {templates.map((template) => (
   131	              <option key={template.id} value={template.id}>
   132	                {template.name} ({template.code})
   133	              </option>
   134	            ))}
   135	          </select>
   136	        </div>
   137	
   138	        <div className="filter-group">
   139	          <label>状态</label>
   140	          <select
   141	            value={filters.status}
   142	            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('status', e.target.value)}
   143	          >
   144	            <option value="">全部状态</option>
   145	            <option value="unused">未使用</option>
   146	            <option value="reserved">已预留</option>
   147	            <option value="used">已使用</option>
   148	            <option value="expired">已过期</option>
   149	          </select>
   150	        </div>
   151	
   152	        <div className="filter-group">
   153	          <label>用户邮箱</label>
   154	          <input
   155	            type="text"
   156	            placeholder="输入用户邮箱搜索"
   157	            value={filters.userEmail}
   158	            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('userEmail', e.target.value)}
   159	          />
   160	        </div>
   161	
   162	        <button className="btn-reset" onClick={handleResetFilters}>
   163	          重置筛选
   164	        </button>
   165	      </div>
   166	
   167	      {/* Statistics */}
   168	      <div className="statistics-bar">
   169	        <div className="stat-item">
   170	          <span className="stat-label">总计:</span>
   171	          <span className="stat-value">{total}</span>
   172	        </div>
   173	      </div>
   174	
   175	      {/* Table */}
   176	      {loading ? (
   177	        <div className="loading-container">
   178	          <div className="spinner"></div>
   179	          <p>加载中...</p>
   180	        </div>
   181	      ) : coupons.length === 0 ? (
   182	        <div className="empty-state">
   183	          <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
   184	            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" strokeWidth="2"/>
   185	            <path d="M12 8v4M12 16h.01" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round"/>
   186	          </svg>
   187	          <p>暂无折扣券数据</p>
   188	        </div>
   189	      ) : (
   190	        <>
   191	          <div className="table-container">
   192	            <table className="coupons-table">
   193	              <thead>
   194	                <tr>
   195	                  <th>折扣券代码</th>
   196	                  <th>模板名称</th>
   197	                  <th>折扣力度</th>
   198	                  <th>用户ID</th>
   199	                  <th>状态</th>
   200	                  <th>发放时间</th>
   201	                  <th>有效期至</th>
   202	                  <th>使用时间</th>
   203	                  <th>使用订单</th>
   204	                </tr>
   205	              </thead>
   206	              <tbody>
   207	                {coupons.map((coupon) => (
   208	                  <tr key={coupon.id}>
   209	                    <td className="coupon-code">{coupon.coupon_code}</td>
   210	                    <td>{coupon.template?.name || '-'}</td>
   211	                    <td className="discount-value">{getDiscountDisplay(coupon.template)}</td>
   212	                    <td>{coupon.user_id}</td>
   213	                    <td>{getStatusBadge(coupon.status)}</td>
   214	                    <td>{formatDate(coupon.created_at)}</td>
   215	                    <td>{formatDate(coupon.valid_until)}</td>
   216	                    <td>{formatDate(coupon.used_at)}</td>
   217	                    <td>{coupon.used_order_id || '-'}</td>
   218	                  </tr>
   219	                ))}
   220	              </tbody>
   221	            </table>
   222	          </div>
   223	
   224	          {/* Pagination */}
   225	          {totalPages > 1 && (
   226	            <div className="pagination">
   227	              <button
   228	                className="btn-page"
   229	                onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}
   230	                disabled={page === 1}
   231	              >
   232	                上一页
   233	              </button>
   234	              <span className="page-info">
   235	                第 {page} / {totalPages} 页，共 {total} 条
   236	              </span>
   237	              <button
   238	                className="btn-page"
   239	                onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}
   240	                disabled={page === totalPages}
   241	              >
   242	                下一页
   243	              </button>
   244	            </div>
   245	          )}
   246	        </>
   247	      )}
   248	    </div>
   249	  );
   250	};
   251	
   252	export default DistributedCoupons;

    10	import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

    15	const STATUS_MAP = {

    17	  processed: { label: '已处理', color: '#3b82f6' },
    18	  replied: { label: '已回复', color: '#22c55e' },

    22	// 获取完整的文件URL（处理相对路径）
    23	const getFullUrl = (url) => {
    24	  if (!url) return '';
    25	  // 如果已经是完整URL，直接返回
    26	  if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) {
    27	    return url;
    28	  }
    29	  // 相对路径，使用当前域名
    30	  return url;
    31	};

    33	const FeedbackManagement = () => {
    34	  const [feedbacks, setFeedbacks] = useState([]);
    35	  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
    36	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    37	  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({ page: 1, pageSize: 20, total: 0 });
    38	  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({ status: '', keyword: '' });
    39	  const [selectedFeedback, setSelectedFeedback] = useState(null);
    40	  const [showDetailModal, setShowDetailModal] = useState(false);
    41	  const [showReplyModal, setShowReplyModal] = useState(false);
    42	  const [replyContent, setReplyContent] = useState('');
    43	  const [replying, setReplying] = useState(false);
    44	  const [previewImage, setPreviewImage] = useState(null); // 图片预览状态
    45	
    46	  const fetchFeedbacks = useCallback(async () => {
    47	    setLoading(true);
    48	    try {
    49	      const response = await adminAPI.getFeedbacks({
    50	        page: pagination.page,
    51	        pageSize: pagination.pageSize,
    52	        ...filters,
    53	      });
    54	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    55	        setFeedbacks(response.data.data.list || []);
    56	        setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, total: response.data.data.total }));
    57	      }
    58	    } catch (error) {
    59	      showToast('获取反馈列表失败', 'error');
    60	    } finally {
    61	      setLoading(false);
    62	    }
    63	  }, [pagination.page, pagination.pageSize, filters]);
    64	
    65	  const fetchStats = async () => {
    66	    try {
    67	      const response = await adminAPI.getFeedbackStats();
    68	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    69	        setStats(response.data.data);
    70	      }
    71	    } catch (error) {
    72	      console.error('Failed to fetch stats:', error);
    73	    }
    74	  };
    75	
    76	  useEffect(() => {
    77	    fetchFeedbacks();
    78	  }, [fetchFeedbacks]);
    79	
    80	  useEffect(() => {
    81	    fetchStats();
    82	  }, []);
    83	
    84	  const handleStatusChange = async (id, newStatus) => {
    85	    try {
    86	      const response = await adminAPI.updateFeedbackStatus(id, newStatus);
    87	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    88	        showToast('状态更新成功', 'success');
    89	        fetchFeedbacks();
    90	        fetchStats();
    91	      } else {
    92	        showToast(response.data.message || '更新失败', 'error');
    93	      }
    94	    } catch (error) {
    95	      showToast('更新失败', 'error');
    96	    }
    97	  };
    98	
    99	  const handleReply = async () => {
   100	    if (!replyContent.trim()) {
   101	      showToast('请输入回复内容', 'error');
   102	      return;
   103	    }
   104	    setReplying(true);
   105	    try {
   106	      const response = await adminAPI.replyFeedback(selectedFeedback.id, replyContent);
   107	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   108	        showToast('回复成功，邮件已发送', 'success');
   109	        setShowReplyModal(false);
   110	        setReplyContent('');
   111	        setSelectedFeedback(null);
   112	        fetchFeedbacks();
   113	        fetchStats();
   114	      } else {
   115	        showToast(response.data.message || '回复失败', 'error');
   116	      }
   117	    } catch (error) {
   118	      showToast('回复失败', 'error');
   119	    } finally {
   120	      setReplying(false);
   121	    }
   122	  };
   123	
   124	  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
   125	    if (!window.confirm('确定要删除这条反馈吗？')) return;
   126	    try {
   127	      const response = await adminAPI.deleteFeedback(id);
   128	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   129	        showToast('删除成功', 'success');
   130	        fetchFeedbacks();
   131	        fetchStats();
   132	      } else {
   133	        showToast(response.data.message || '删除失败', 'error');
   134	      }
   135	    } catch (error) {
   136	      showToast('删除失败', 'error');
   137	    }
   138	  };
   139	
   140	  const openDetailModal = (feedback) => {

   142	    setShowDetailModal(true);
   143	  };
   144

   147	    setReplyContent('');
   148	    setShowReplyModal(true);
   149	  };
   150	
   151	  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
   152	    if (!dateStr) return '-';
   153	    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
   154	  };
   155	
   156	  const parseAttachments = (attachmentsStr) => {

   188	            <div className="stat-label">已回复</div>
   189	          </div>
   190	        </div>

   192	
   193	      <div className="filters-bar">
   194	        <select

   196	          onChange={(e) => {

   201	          <option value="">全部状态</option>

   204	          <option value="replied">已回复</option>

   337	                    }}
   338	                    className="status-select"
   339	                  >

   348	
   349	            <div className="detail-section">
   350	              <h4>反馈内容</h4>
   351	              <div className="content-box large">{selectedFeedback.content}</div>
   352	            </div>
   353	
   354	            {parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments).length > 0 && (
   355	              <div className="detail-section">
   356	                <h4>附件 ({parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments).length})</h4>
   357	                {/* 图片预览区域 */}

   359	                  <div className="attachment-images-preview">

   374	                  </div>

   376	                {/* 文件下载区域 */}
   377	                {parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments).filter(att => att.type === 'file').length > 0 && (
   378	                  <div className="attachment-files-list">
   379	                    {parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments)
   380	                      .filter(att => att.type === 'file')
   381	                      .map((att, idx) => (
   382	                        <a 
   383	                          key={idx} 
   384	                          href={getFullUrl(att.url)} 
   385	                          download={att.name}
   386	                          className="file-download-item"
   387	                        >
   388	                          <span className="file-icon">📄</span>
   389	                          <span className="file-info">
   390	                            <span className="file-name">{att.name}</span>
   391	                            {att.size && <span className="file-size">{(att.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB</span>}
   392	                          </span>
   393	                          <span className="download-icon">⬇️</span>
   394	                        </a>
   395	                      ))}
   396	                  </div>
   397	                )}
   398	              </div>
   399	            )}
   400	
   401	            {selectedFeedback.replyContent && (
   402	              <div className="detail-section">
   403	                <h4>回复记录</h4>
   404	                <div className="content-box reply-box large">{selectedFeedback.replyContent}</div>
   405	                <div className="reply-meta">
   406	                  <span>回复人: {selectedFeedback.repliedBy}</span>
   407	                  <span>回复时间: {formatDate(selectedFeedback.repliedAt)}</span>
   408	                </div>
   409	              </div>
   410	            )}
   411	
   412	            <div className="drawer-actions">
   413	              {selectedFeedback.status !== 'replied' && selectedFeedback.status !== 'closed' && (
   414	                <button className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setShowDetailModal(false); openReplyModal(selectedFeedback); }}>
   415	                  回复此反馈
   416	                </button>
   417	              )}
   418	              <button className="btn-danger" onClick={() => { handleDelete(selectedFeedback.id); setShowDetailModal(false); }}>
   419	                删除反馈
   420	              </button>
   421	            </div>
   422	          </div>
   423	        )}
   424	      </div>
   425	
   426	      {showReplyModal && selectedFeedback && (
   427	        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowReplyModal(false)}>
   428	          <div className="modal reply-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
   429	            <div className="modal-header">
   430	              <h3>回复反馈</h3>
   431	              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowReplyModal(false)}>×</button>
   432	            </div>
   433	            <div className="modal-body">
   434	              <div className="reply-info">
   435	                <p><strong>发送至:</strong> {selectedFeedback.email}</p>
   436	                <p><strong>原反馈:</strong> {selectedFeedback.content?.substring(0, 100)}...</p>
   437	              </div>
   438	              <textarea
   439	                placeholder="请输入回复内容..."
   440	                value={replyContent}
   441	                onChange={(e) => setReplyContent(e.target.value)}
   442	                rows={6}
   443	              />
   444	            </div>
   445	            <div className="modal-footer">
   446	              <button className="btn-cancel" onClick={() => setShowReplyModal(false)}>取消</button>
   447	              <button className="btn-submit" onClick={handleReply} disabled={replying}>
   448	                {replying ? '发送中...' : '发送回复'}
   449	              </button>
   450	            </div>
   451	          </div>
   452	        </div>
   453	      )}
   454	
   455	      {/* 图片预览弹窗 */}
   456	      {previewImage && (
   457	        <div className="image-preview-overlay" onClick={() => setPreviewImage(null)}>
   458	          <div className="image-preview-container">
   459	            <button className="preview-close-btn" onClick={() => setPreviewImage(null)}>×</button>
   460	            <img src={previewImage} alt="预览" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} />
   461	            <div className="preview-actions">
   462	              <a href={previewImage} download className="preview-download-btn" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
   463	                下载图片
   464	              </a>
   465	              <a href={previewImage} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="preview-open-btn" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
   466	                新窗口打开
   467	              </a>
   468	            </div>
   469	          </div>
   470	        </div>
   471	      )}
   472	    </div>
   473	  );
   474	};
   475

    12	import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
    13	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    14	import SliderCaptcha from '../components/SliderCaptcha';
    15	import './Login.css';
    16	
    17	const Login = () => {
    18	  const navigate = useNavigate();
    19	  const { login } = useAuth();
    20	  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    21	    username: '',
    22	    password: '',
    23	  });
    24	  const [error, setError] = useState('');
    25	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    26	  const [captchaVerified, setCaptchaVerified] = useState(false);
    27	  const captchaRef = useRef(null);
    28	
    29	  const handleChange = (e) => {
    30	    setFormData({
    31	      ...formData,
    32	      [e.target.name]: e.target.value,
    33	    });
    34	    setError('');
    35	  };
    36	
    37	  const handleCaptchaSuccess = () => {
    38	    setCaptchaVerified(true);
    39	  };
    40	
    41	  const handleCaptchaFail = () => {
    42	    setCaptchaVerified(false);
    43	  };
    44	
    45	  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    46	    e.preventDefault();
    47	    setError('');
    48	
    49	    if (!captchaVerified) {
    50	      setError('Please complete the captcha verification');
    51	      return;
    52	    }
    53	
    54	    setLoading(true);
    55	
    56	    try {
    57	      const response = await adminAPI.login(formData.username, formData.password);
    58	
    59	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
    60	        const { token, admin } = response.data.data;
    61	        login(token, admin);
    62	        navigate('/dashboard');
    63	      } else {
    64	        setError(response.data.message || 'Login failed');
    65	        // Reset captcha on login failure
    66	        setCaptchaVerified(false);
    67	        if (captchaRef.current && captchaRef.current.reset) {
    68	          captchaRef.current.reset();
    69	        }
    70	      }
    71	    } catch (err) {
    72	      setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'An error occurred during login');
    73	      // Reset captcha on error
    74	      setCaptchaVerified(false);
    75	      if (captchaRef.current && captchaRef.current.reset) {
    76	        captchaRef.current.reset();
    77	      }
    78	    } finally {
    79	      setLoading(false);
    80	    }
    81	  };
    82	
    83	  return (
    84	    <div className="login-container">
    85	      <div className="login-card fade-in">
    86	        <div className="login-header">
    87	          <div className="logo">
    88	            <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none">
    89	              <rect width="48" height="48" rx="12" fill="#2563eb"/>
    90	              <path d="M24 12L32 20H28V32H20V20H16L24 12Z" fill="white"/>
    91	              <rect x="16" y="34" width="16" height="2" fill="white"/>
    92	            </svg>
    93	          </div>
    94	          <h1>Scholar Admin</h1>
    95	          <p>Sign in to your account</p>
    96	        </div>
    97	
    98	        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="login-form">
    99	          <div className="form-group">
   100	            <label htmlFor="username">Username</label>
   101	            <input
   102	              type="text"
   103	              id="username"
   104	              name="username"
   105	              className="input"
   106	              placeholder="Enter your username"
   107	              value={formData.username}
   108	              onChange={handleChange}
   109	              required
   110	              autoFocus
   111	            />
   112	          </div>
   113	
   114	          <div className="form-group">
   115	            <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
   116	            <input
   117	              type="password"
   118	              id="password"
   119	              name="password"
   120	              className="input"
   121	              placeholder="Enter your password"
   122	              value={formData.password}
   123	              onChange={handleChange}
   124	              required
   125	            />
   126	          </div>
   127	
   128	          <SliderCaptcha
   129	            ref={captchaRef}
   130	            onSuccess={handleCaptchaSuccess}
   131	            onFail={handleCaptchaFail}
   132	          />
   133	
   134	          {error && (
   135	            <div className="error-message fade-in">
   136	              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
   137	                <path d="M8 0C3.6 0 0 3.6 0 8s3.6 8 8 8 8-3.6 8-8-3.6-8-8-8zm1 13H7v-2h2v2zm0-3H7V4h2v6z"/>
   138	              </svg>
   139	              {error}
   140	            </div>
   141	          )}
   142	
   143	          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary btn-full" disabled={loading || !captchaVerified}>
   144	            {loading ? (
   145	              <>
   146	                <span className="spinner"></span>
   147	                <span style={{ marginLeft: '0.5rem' }}>Signing in...</span>
   148	              </>
   149	            ) : (
   150	              'Sign In'
   151	            )}
   152	          </button>
   153	        </form>
   154	      </div>
   155	    </div>
   156	  );
   157	};
   158	
   159	export default Login;

   119	      );
   120	    }
   121	    if (order.email) {
   122	      details.push(
   123	        <div key="email" className="user-info-detail">
   124	          <span className="info-label">邮箱:</span> {order.email}
   125	        </div>
   126	      );
   127	    }
   128	    if (order.wechat_name) {
   129	      details.push(
   130	        <div key="wechat_name" className="user-info-detail">
   131	          <span className="info-label">微信:</span> {order.wechat_name}
   132	        </div>

   137	        <div key="wechat_union_id" className="user-info-detail">
   138	          <span className="info-label">UnionID:</span> {order.wechat_union_id}
   139	        </div>
   140	      );
   141	    }
   142	    if (order.github_name) {
   143	      details.push(
   144	        <div key="github_name" className="user-info-detail">
   145	          <span className="info-label">GitHub:</span> {order.github_name}
   146	        </div>
   147	      );
   148	    }
   149	
   150	    return (
   151	      <div className="user-info-cell">
   152	        {userInfo}
   153	        {details.length > 0 && (
   154	          <div className="user-info-details-wrapper">
   155	            {details.map((detail, index) => (
   156	              <React.Fragment key={index}>
   157	                {index > 0 && <div className="user-info-divider"></div>}

   176	          <div className="stat-details">
   177	            <span>{statistics.today_count} 笔订单</span>
   178	            <span>{statistics.today_users} 位用户</span>
   179	          </div>
   180	        </div>
   181	
   182	        <div className="stat-card stat-card-week">
   183	          <h3>本周</h3>
   184	          <div className="stat-value">{formatCurrency(statistics.week_amount)}</div>
   185	          <div className="stat-details">
   186	            <span>{statistics.week_count} 笔订单</span>

文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/PromptTemplates.js

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import './PromptTemplates.css';
    13	
    14	const PromptTemplates = () => {
    15	  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
    16	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    17	  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
    18	  const [editingTemplate, setEditingTemplate] = useState(null);
    19	  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    20	    name: '',
    21	    key: '',
    22	    template: '',
    23	    description: '',
    24	    is_active: true
    25	  });
    26	
    27	  useEffect(() => {
    28	    loadTemplates();
    29	  }, []);
    30	
    31	  const loadTemplates = async () => {
    32	    setLoading(true);
    33	    try {
    34	      const response = await adminAPI.getPromptTemplates();
    35	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    36	        setTemplates(response.data.data.templates || []);
    37	      }
    38	    } catch (error) {
    39	      console.error('Failed to load prompt templates:', error);
    40	      alert('加载提示词模板失败');
    41	    } finally {
    42	      setLoading(false);
    43	    }
    44	  };
    45	
    46	  const handleCreate = () => {
    47	    setEditingTemplate(null);
    48	    setFormData({
    49	      name: '',
    50	      key: '',
    51	      template: '',
    52	      description: '',
    53	      is_active: true
    54	    });
    55	    setShowModal(true);
    56	  };
    57	
    58	  const handleEdit = (template) => {
    59	    setEditingTemplate(template);
    60	    setFormData({
    61	      name: template.name,
    62	      key: template.key,
    63	      template: template.template,
    64	      description: template.description || '',
    65	      is_active: Boolean(template.is_active) // Convert 0/1 to false/true
    66	    });
    67	    setShowModal(true);
    68	  };
    69	
    70	  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    71	    e.preventDefault();
    72	
    73	    try {
    74	      if (editingTemplate) {
    75	        // Update existing template
    76	        const response = await adminAPI.updatePromptTemplate(editingTemplate.id, formData);
    77	        if (response.data.code === 0) {
    78	          alert('提示词模板更新成功');
    79	          setShowModal(false);
    80	          loadTemplates();
    81	        } else {
    82	          alert('更新失败: ' + response.data.message);
    83	        }
    84	      } else {
    85	        // Create new template
    86	        const response = await adminAPI.createPromptTemplate(formData);
    87	        if (response.data.code === 0) {
    88	          alert('提示词模板创建成功');
    89	          setShowModal(false);
    90	          loadTemplates();
    91	        } else {
    92	          alert('创建失败: ' + response.data.message);
    93	        }
    94	      }
    95	    } catch (error) {
    96	      console.error('Failed to save template:', error);
    97	      alert('保存失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    98	    }
    99	  };
   100	
   101	  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
   102	    if (!window.confirm('确定要删除这个提示词模板吗？')) {
   103	      return;
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    try {
   107	      const response = await adminAPI.deletePromptTemplate(id);
   108	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   109	        alert('删除成功');
   110	        loadTemplates();
   111	      } else {
   112	        alert('删除失败: ' + response.data.message);
   113	      }
   114	    } catch (error) {
   115	      console.error('Failed to delete template:', error);
   116	      alert('删除失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   117	    }
   118	  };
   119	
   120	  const handleToggleActive = async (template) => {
   121	    try {
   122	      const response = await adminAPI.updatePromptTemplate(template.id, {
   123	        name: template.name,
   124	        template: template.template,
   125	        description: template.description,
   126	        is_active: !template.is_active
   127	      });
   128	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   129	        loadTemplates();
   130	      } else {
   131	        alert('更新失败: ' + response.data.message);
   132	      }
   133	    } catch (error) {
   134	      console.error('Failed to toggle active:', error);
   135	      alert('更新失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
   136	    }
   137	  };
   138	
   139	  return (
   140	    <div className="prompt-templates-page">
   141	      <div className="page-header">
   142	        <h1>提示词模板管理</h1>
   143	        <button className="btn-primary" onClick={handleCreate}>
   144	          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
   145	            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M8 2a.5.5 0 01.5.5v5h5a.5.5 0 010 1h-5v5a.5.5 0 01-1 0v-5h-5a.5.5 0 010-1h5v-5A.5.5 0 018 2z"/>
   146	          </svg>
   147	          新建模板
   148	        </button>
   149	      </div>
   150	
   151	      {loading ? (
   152	        <div className="loading-container">
   153	          <div className="spinner"></div>
   154	          <p>加载中...</p>
   155	        </div>
   156	      ) : (
   157	        <div className="templates-grid">
   158	          {templates.map((template) => (
   159	            <div key={template.id} className={`template-card ${!template.is_active ? 'inactive' : ''}`}>
   160	              <div className="template-header">
   161	                <div className="template-title">
   162	                  <h3>{template.name}</h3>
   163	                  <span className={`badge ${template.is_active ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-secondary'}`}>
   164	                    {template.is_active ? '启用' : '停用'}
   165	                  </span>
   166	                </div>
   167	                <div className="template-actions">
   168	                  <button
   169	                    className="btn-icon"
   170	                    onClick={() => handleToggleActive(template)}
   171	                    title={template.is_active ? '停用' : '启用'}
   172	                  >
   173	                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
   174	                      <path d="M8 15A7 7 0 1 1 8 1a7 7 0 0 1 0 14zm0 1A8 8 0 1 0 8 0a8 8 0 0 0 0 16z"/>
   175	                      <path d="M10.97 4.97a.235.235 0 0 0-.02.022L7.477 9.417 5.384 7.323a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06 1.06L6.97 11.03a.75.75 0 0 0 1.079-.02l3.992-4.99a.75.75 0 0 0-1.071-1.05z"/>
   176	                    </svg>
   177	                  </button>
   178	                  <button className="btn-icon" onClick={() => handleEdit(template)}>
   179	                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
   180	                      <path d="M12.146.146a.5.5 0 0 1 .708 0l3 3a.5.5 0 0 1 0 .708l-10 10a.5.5 0 0 1-.168.11l-5 2a.5.5 0 0 1-.65-.65l2-5a.5.5 0 0 1 .11-.168l10-10zM11.207 2.5 13.5 4.793 14.793 3.5 12.5 1.207 11.207 2.5zm1.586 3L10.5 3.207 4 9.707V10h.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v.5h.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v.5h.293l6.5-6.5zm-9.761 5.175-.106.106-1.528 3.821 3.821-1.528.106-.106A.5.5 0 0 1 5 12.5V12h-.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5V11h-.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.468-.325z"/>
   181	                    </svg>
   182	                  </button>
   183	                  <button className="btn-icon btn-danger" onClick={() => handleDelete(template.id)}>
   184	                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
   185	                      <path d="M5.5 5.5A.5.5 0 0 1 6 6v6a.5.5 0 0 1-1 0V6a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5zm2.5 0a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v6a.5.5 0 0 1-1 0V6a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5zm3 .5a.5.5 0 0 0-1 0v6a.5.5 0 0 0 1 0V6z"/>
   186	                      <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M14.5 3a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H13v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4h-.5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1H6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h2a1 1 0 0 1 1 1h3.5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v1zM4.118 4 4 4.059V13a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h6a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4.059L11.882 4H4.118zM2.5 3V2h11v1h-11z"/>
   187	                    </svg>
   188	                  </button>
   189	                </div>
   190	              </div>
   191	
   192	              <div className="template-meta">
   193	                <span className="meta-item">
   194	                  <strong>Key:</strong> {template.key}
   195	                </span>
   196	              </div>
   197	
   198	              {template.description && (
   199	                <p className="template-description">{template.description}</p>
   200	              )}
   201	
   202	              <div className="template-preview">
   203	                <strong>模板内容预览：</strong>
   204	                <pre>{template.template.substring(0, 200)}...</pre>
   205	              </div>
   206	
   207	              <div className="template-footer">
   208	                <small>创建时间: {new Date(template.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</small>
   209	                <small>更新时间: {new Date(template.updated_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</small>
   210	              </div>
   211	            </div>
   212	          ))}
   213	        </div>
   214	      )}
   215	
   216	{showModal && (
   217	        <div className="modal-overlay">
   218	          <div className="modal-content modal-xlarge">
   219	            <div className="modal-header">
   220	              <h2>{editingTemplate ? '编辑提示词模板' : '新建提示词模板'}</h2>
   221	              <button className="btn-close" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
   222	                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
   223	                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
   224	                </svg>
   225	              </button>
   226	            </div>
   227	
   228	            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="modal-body">
   229	              {/* 基本信息区域 */}
   230	              <div className="form-section">
   231	                <div className="section-header">
   232	                  <h3>基本信息</h3>
   233	                  <p>设置模板的基本属性和标识</p>
   234	                </div>
   235	
   236	                <div className="form-row">
   237	                  <div className="form-group form-group-flex">
   238	                    <label>模板名称 <span className="required">*</span></label>
   239	                    <input
   240	                      type="text"
   241	                      className="form-control"
   242	                      value={formData.name}
   243	                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
   244	                      required
   245	                      placeholder="例如：论文分析总结提示词"
   246	                    />
   247	                  </div>
   248	
   249	                  <div className="form-group form-group-flex">
   250	                    <label>模板Key <span className="required">*</span></label>
   251	                    <input
   252	                      type="text"
   253	                      className="form-control"
   254	                      value={formData.key}
   255	                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, key: e.target.value })}
   256	                      required
   257	                      disabled={!!editingTemplate}
   258	                      placeholder="例如：paper_analysis"
   259	                    />
   260	                    {editingTemplate && (
   261	                      <small className="form-help">创建后不可修改</small>
   262	                    )}
   263	                  </div>
   264	                </div>
   265	
   266	                <div className="form-group">
   267	                  <label>模板描述</label>
   268	                  <input
   269	                    type="text"
   270	                    className="form-control"
   271	                    value={formData.description}
   272	                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
   273	                    placeholder="简短描述这个模板的用途，例如：用于分析搜索到的学术论文并生成结构化综述"
   274	                  />
   275	                </div>
   276	
   277	                <div className="form-group">
   278	                  <label className="checkbox-label">
   279	                    <input
   280	                      type="checkbox"
   281	                      checked={formData.is_active}
   282	                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, is_active: e.target.checked })}
   283	                    />
   284	                    <span>启用此模板</span>
   285	                  </label>
   286	                  <small className="form-help">停用的模板不会在系统中生效</small>
   287	                </div>
   288	              </div>
   289	
   290	              {/* 模板内容区域 */}
   291	              <div className="form-section">
   292	                <div className="section-header">
   293	                  <h3>模板内容 <span className="required">*</span></h3>
   294	                  <p>编写提示词模板，使用变量占位符实现动态内容</p>
   295	                </div>
   296	
   297	                {/* 变量快速插入工具 */}
   298	                <div className="variable-toolbar">
   299	                  <span className="toolbar-label">常用变量：</span>
   300	                  <button
   301	                    type="button"
   302	                    className="btn-variable"
   303	                    onClick={() => {
   304	                      const textarea = document.querySelector('.template-textarea');
   305	                      const cursorPos = textarea.selectionStart;
   306	                      const textBefore = formData.template.substring(0, cursorPos);
   307	                      const textAfter = formData.template.substring(cursorPos);
   308	                      setFormData({ ...formData, template: textBefore + '{{query}}' + textAfter });
   309	                    }}
   310	                  >
   311	                    <code>{'{{query}}'}</code>
   312	                    <span>搜索关键词</span>
   313	                  </button>
   314	                  <button
   315	                    type="button"
   316	                    className="btn-variable"
   317	                    onClick={() => {
   318	                      const textarea = document.querySelector('.template-textarea');
   319	                      const cursorPos = textarea.selectionStart;
   320	                      const textBefore = formData.template.substring(0, cursorPos);
   321	                      const textAfter = formData.template.substring(cursorPos);
   322	                      setFormData({ ...formData, template: textBefore + '{{papers}}' + textAfter });
   323	                    }}
   324	                  >
   325	                    <code>{'{{papers}}'}</code>
   326	                    <span>论文列表</span>
   327	                  </button>
   328	                </div>
   329	
   330	                <div className="form-group">
   331	                  <textarea
   332	                    className="form-control template-textarea"
   333	                    value={formData.template}
   334	                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, template: e.target.value })}
   335	                    required
   336	                    rows="18"
   337	                    placeholder="输入提示词模板内容...&#10;&#10;例如：&#10;你是一位专业的学术研究助手。用户搜索了关键词：「{{query}}」&#10;&#10;## 论文列表&#10;{{papers}}&#10;&#10;请对这些论文进行深入分析..."
   338	                  />
   339	                  <div className="template-stats">
   340	                    <span>字符数: {formData.template.length}</span>
   341	                    <span>行数: {formData.template.split('\n').length}</span>
   342	                    <span>变量: {(formData.template.match(/\{\{.*?\}\}/g) || []).length}</span>
   343	                  </div>
   344	                </div>
   345	
   346	                {/* 预览区域 */}
   347	                {formData.template && (
   348	                  <div className="template-preview-box">
   349	                    <div className="preview-header">
   350	                      <strong>模板预览</strong>
   351	                      <span className="preview-hint">变量会以高亮显示</span>
   352	                    </div>
   353	                    <div className="preview-content">
   354	                      {formData.template.split(/(\{\{.*?\}\})/).map((part, index) => {
   355	                        if (part.match(/\{\{.*?\}\}/)) {
   356	                          return <span key={index} className="variable-highlight">{part}</span>;
   357	                        }
   358	                        return part;
   359	                      })}
   360	                    </div>
   361	                  </div>
   362	                )}
   363	              </div>
   364	
   365	              <div className="modal-footer">
   366	                <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
   367	                  取消
   368	                </button>
   369	                <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">
   370	                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" style={{marginRight: '6px'}}>
   371	                    <path d="M12.736 3.97a.733.733 0 0 1 1.047 0c.286.289.29.756.01 1.05L7.88 12.01a.733.733 0 0 1-1.065.02L3.217 8.384a.757.757 0 0 1 0-1.06.733.733 0 0 1 1.047 0l3.052 3.093 5.4-6.425a.247.247 0 0 1 .02-.022Z"/>
   372	                  </svg>
   373	                  {editingTemplate ? '保存修改' : '创建模板'}
   374	                </button>
   375	              </div>
   376	            </form>
   377	          </div>
   378	        </div>
   379	      )}
   380	    </div>
   381	  );
   382	};
   383	
   384	export default PromptTemplates;

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司

     9	
    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
    13	import './SubscriptionPlans.css';
    14	
    15	const SubscriptionPlans = () => {
    16	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    17	  const [plans, setPlans] = useState([]);
    18	  const [editingPlan, setEditingPlan] = useState(null);
    19	  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
    20	  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    21	    plan_name: '',
    22	    price_monthly: 0,
    23	    current_price_monthly: 0,
    24	    price_yearly: 0,
    25	    current_price_yearly: 0,
    26	    yearly_discount_enabled: false,
    27	    yearly_discount_percent: 0,
    28	    features: {
    29	      normal_search: { limit: -1, period: 'day', description: '无限制' },
    30	      advanced_search_low: { limit: 5, period: 'day', description: '5/天' },
    31	      advanced_search_mid: { limit: 3, period: 'day', description: '3/天' },
    32	      advanced_search_high: { limit: 2, period: 'day', description: '2/天' },
    33	      ai_chat_normal: { limit: -1, period: 'day', description: '无限制' },
    34	      ai_chat_mid: { limit: 50, period: 'day', description: '50/天' },
    35	      ai_chat_high: { limit: 10, period: 'day', description: '10/天' },
    36	      advanced_search_data: { enabled: true, description: '可查看高级搜索历史数据' },
    37	      ai_history_data: { enabled: true, description: '可查看AI对话历史数据' },
    38	    },
    39	  });
    40	
    41	  useEffect(() => {
    42	    loadPlans();
    43	  }, []);
    44	
    45	  const loadPlans = async () => {
    46	    setLoading(true);
    47	    try {
    48	      const response = await adminAPI.getSubscriptionPlans();
    49	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    50	        setPlans(response.data.data);
    51	      }
    52	    } catch (err) {
    53	      showToast('加载套餐列表失败', 'error');
    54	    } finally {
    55	      setLoading(false);
    56	    }
    57	  };
    58	
    59	  const handleEdit = (plan) => {
    60	    setEditingPlan(plan);
    61	    setFormData({
    62	      plan_name: plan.plan_name,
    63	      price_monthly: plan.price_monthly,
    64	      current_price_monthly: plan.current_price_monthly || plan.price_monthly,
    65	      price_yearly: plan.price_yearly,
    66	      current_price_yearly: plan.current_price_yearly || plan.price_yearly,
    67	      yearly_discount_enabled: plan.yearly_discount_enabled || false,
    68	      yearly_discount_percent: plan.yearly_discount_percent || 0,
    69	      features: plan.features,
    70	    });
    71	    setShowModal(true);
    72	  };
    73	
    74	  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    75	    e.preventDefault();
    76	
    77	    if (!editingPlan) {
    78	      showToast('只能编辑现有套餐', 'error');
    79	      return;
    80	    }
    81	
    82	    // Calculate yearly price if discount is enabled
    83	    let currentPriceYearly = parseFloat(formData.current_price_yearly);
    84	    if (formData.yearly_discount_enabled) {
    85	      const monthlyPrice = parseFloat(formData.current_price_monthly);
    86	      const discountPercent = parseFloat(formData.yearly_discount_percent);
    87	      currentPriceYearly = monthlyPrice * 12 * (1 - discountPercent / 100);
    88	    }
    89	
    90	    const data = {
    91	      plan_name: formData.plan_name,
    92	      price_monthly: parseFloat(formData.price_monthly),
    93	      current_price_monthly: parseFloat(formData.current_price_monthly),
    94	      price_yearly: parseFloat(formData.price_yearly),
    95	      current_price_yearly: currentPriceYearly,
    96	      yearly_discount_enabled: formData.yearly_discount_enabled,
    97	      yearly_discount_percent: parseFloat(formData.yearly_discount_percent),
    98	      features: formData.features,
    99	    };
   100	
   101	    try {
   102	      const response = await adminAPI.updateSubscriptionPlan(editingPlan.id, data);
   103	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   104	        showToast('更新成功', 'success');
   105	        setShowModal(false);
   106	        loadPlans();
   107	      } else {
   108	        showToast(response.data.message || '更新失败', 'error');
   109	      }
   110	    } catch (err) {
   111	      showToast('更新失败', 'error');
   112	    }
   113	  };
   114	
   115	  const updateFeature = (featureKey, field, value) => {
   116	    setFormData({
   117	      ...formData,
   118	      features: {
   119	        ...formData.features,
   120	        [featureKey]: {
   121	          ...formData.features[featureKey],
   122	          [field]: value,
   123	        },
   124	      },
   125	    });
   126	  };
   127	
   128	  const getFeatureLabel = (key) => {
   129	    const labels = {
   130	      normal_search: '普通搜索',
   131	      advanced_search_low: '高级搜索 - 低级模型',
   132	      advanced_search_mid: '高级搜索 - 中级模型',
   133	      advanced_search_high: '高级搜索 - 高级模型',
   134	      ai_chat_normal: 'AI对话 - 低级模型',
   135	      ai_chat_mid: 'AI对话 - 中级模型',
   136	      ai_chat_high: 'AI对话 - 高级模型',
   137	      advanced_search_data: '高级搜索数据',
   138	      ai_history_data: 'AI对话历史数据',
   139	    };
   140	    return labels[key] || key;
   141	  };
   142	
   143	  const getPlanBadge = (planCode) => {
   144	    switch (planCode) {
   145	      case 'free':
   146	        return <span className="plan-badge badge-free">FREE</span>;
   147	      case 'pro':
   148	        return <span className="plan-badge badge-pro">PRO</span>;
   149	      case 'max':
   150	        return <span className="plan-badge badge-max">MAX</span>;
   151	      default:
   152	        return <span className="plan-badge">{planCode}</span>;
   153	    }
   154	  };
   155	
   156	  return (
   157	    <div className="subscription-plans">
   158	      <div className="page-header">
   159	        <h2>套餐管理</h2>
   160	      </div>
   161	
   162	      <div className="plans-grid">
   163	        {loading ? (
   164	          <div className="loading">加载中...</div>
   165	        ) : plans.length === 0 ? (
   166	          <div className="empty-state">暂无套餐</div>
   167	        ) : (
   168	          plans.map((plan) => (
   169	            <div key={plan.id} className={`plan-card plan-${plan.plan_code}`}>
   170	              <div className="plan-header">
   171	                {getPlanBadge(plan.plan_code)}
   172	                <h3>{plan.plan_name}</h3>
   173	              </div>
   174	              <div className="plan-pricing">
   175	                <div className="price-item">
   176	                  <span className="price-label">月付</span>
   177	                  <div className="price-values">
   178	                    {plan.price_monthly !== plan.current_price_monthly && (plan.price_monthly || 0) > 0 ? (
   179	                      <>
   180	                        <span className="price-original">¥{(plan.price_monthly || 0).toFixed(2)}</span>
   181	                        <span className="price-current">¥{(plan.current_price_monthly || 0).toFixed(2)}</span>
   182	                      </>
   183	                    ) : (
   184	                      <span className="price-value">¥{(plan.current_price_monthly || plan.price_monthly || 0).toFixed(2)}</span>
   185	                    )}
   186	                  </div>
   187	                </div>
   188	                <div className="price-item">
   189	                  <span className="price-label">年付</span>
   190	                  <div className="price-values">
   191	                    {plan.price_yearly !== plan.current_price_yearly && (plan.price_yearly || 0) > 0 ? (
   192	                      <>
   193	                        <span className="price-original">¥{(plan.price_yearly || 0).toFixed(2)}</span>
   194	                        <span className="price-current">¥{(plan.current_price_yearly || 0).toFixed(2)}</span>
   195	                      </>
   196	                    ) : (
   197	                      <span className="price-value">¥{(plan.current_price_yearly || plan.price_yearly || 0).toFixed(2)}</span>
   198	                    )}
   199	                    {plan.yearly_discount_enabled && (plan.yearly_discount_percent || 0) > 0 && (
   200	                      <span className="discount-badge">{(100 - (plan.yearly_discount_percent || 0)).toFixed(0)}折</span>
   201	                    )}
   202	                  </div>
   203	                </div>
   204	              </div>
   205	              <div className="plan-features">
   206	                <h4>功能限制</h4>
   207	                <ul>
   208	                  <li>普通搜索: {plan.features.normal_search.description}</li>
   209	                  <li>高级搜索 低级模型: {plan.features.advanced_search_low.description}</li>
   210	                  <li>高级搜索 中级模型: {plan.features.advanced_search_mid.description}</li>
   211	                  <li>高级搜索 高级模型: {plan.features.advanced_search_high.description}</li>
   212	                  <li>AI对话 低级模型: {plan.features.ai_chat_normal.description}</li>
   213	                  <li>AI对话 中级模型: {plan.features.ai_chat_mid.description}</li>
   214	                  <li>AI对话 高级模型: {plan.features.ai_chat_high.description}</li>
   215	                </ul>
   216	              </div>
   217	              <button className="btn btn-edit" onClick={() => handleEdit(plan)}>
   218	                编辑套餐
   219	              </button>
   220	            </div>
   221	          ))
   222	        )}
   223	      </div>
   224	
   225	      {showModal && (
   226	        <div className="modal-overlay">
   227	          <div className="modal-content modal-large">
   228	            <div className="modal-header">
   229	              <h3>编辑套餐: {editingPlan?.plan_name}</h3>
   230	              <button className="modal-close" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
   231	                ×
   232	              </button>
   233	            </div>
   234	            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
   235	              <div className="form-sections">
   236	                <div className="form-section">
   237	                  <h4>基本信息</h4>
   238	                  <div className="form-group">
   239	                    <label>套餐名称</label>
   240	                    <input
   241	                      type="text"
   242	                      value={formData.plan_name}
   243	                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, plan_name: e.target.value })}
   244	                      required
   245	                    />
   246	                  </div>
   247	                  <div className="pricing-section">
   248	                    <h5>月付定价</h5>
   249	                    <div className="form-row">
   250	                      <div className="form-group">
   251	                        <label>月付原价 (¥)</label>
   252	                        <input
   253	                          type="number"
   254	                          step="0.01"
   255	                          value={formData.price_monthly}
   256	                          onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, price_monthly: e.target.value })}
   257	                          required
   258	                        />
   259	                      </div>
   260	                      <div className="form-group">
   261	                        <label>月付实时价格 (¥)</label>
   262	                        <input
   263	                          type="number"
   264	                          step="0.01"
   265	                          value={formData.current_price_monthly}
   266	                          onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, current_price_monthly: e.target.value })}
   267	                          required
   268	                        />
   269	                      </div>
   270	                    </div>
   271	                  </div>
   272	
   273	                  <div className="pricing-section">
   274	                    <h5>年付定价</h5>
   275	                    <div className="form-group checkbox-group">
   276	                      <label className="checkbox-label">
   277	                        <input
   278	                          type="checkbox"
   279	                          checked={formData.yearly_discount_enabled}
   280	                          onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, yearly_discount_enabled: e.target.checked })}
   281	                        />
   282	                        <span>使用月付价格折扣计算</span>
   283	                      </label>
   284	                      <small className="hint-text">
   285	                        {formData.yearly_discount_enabled
   286	                          ? `年付价格将自动计算为: 月付实时价格 × 12 × (1 - ${formData.yearly_discount_percent}%)`
   287	                          : '取消勾选则使用直接定价'}
   288	                      </small>
   289	                    </div>
   290	
   291	                    {formData.yearly_discount_enabled ? (
   292	                      <div className="form-group">
   293	                        <label>折扣百分比 (%)</label>
   294	                        <input
   295	                          type="number"
   296	                          step="0.01"
   297	                          min="0"
   298	                          max="100"
   299	                          value={formData.yearly_discount_percent}
   300	                          onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, yearly_discount_percent: e.target.value })}
   301	                          required
   302	                        />
   303	                        <small className="hint-text">
   304	                          计算后的年付价格: ¥{(formData.current_price_monthly * 12 * (1 - formData.yearly_discount_percent / 100)).toFixed(2)}
   305	                        </small>
   306	                      </div>
   307	                    ) : (
   308	                      <div className="form-row">
   309	                        <div className="form-group">
   310	                          <label>年付原价 (¥)</label>
   311	                          <input
   312	                            type="number"
   313	                            step="0.01"
   314	                            value={formData.price_yearly}
   315	                            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, price_yearly: e.target.value })}
   316	                            required
   317	                          />
   318	                        </div>
   319	                        <div className="form-group">
   320	                          <label>年付实时价格 (¥)</label>
   321	                          <input
   322	                            type="number"
   323	                            step="0.01"
   324	                            value={formData.current_price_yearly}
   325	                            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, current_price_yearly: e.target.value })}
   326	                            required
   327	                          />
   328	                        </div>
   329	                      </div>
   330	                    )}
   331	                  </div>
   332	                </div>
   333	
   334	                <div className="form-section">
   335	                  <h4>功能配额</h4>
   336	                  <small className="section-hint">-1 表示无限制，其他数字表示每日限额</small>
   337	
   338	                  {Object.keys(formData.features).map((featureKey) => {
   339	                    const feature = formData.features[featureKey];
   340	
   341	                    // Handle boolean features (enabled/disabled)
   342	                    if (typeof feature.enabled === 'boolean') {
   343	                      return (
   344	                        <div key={featureKey} className="feature-item">
   345	                          <label className="feature-label">{getFeatureLabel(featureKey)}</label>
   346	                          <div className="feature-controls">
   347	                            <label className="checkbox-label">
   348	                              <input
   349	                                type="checkbox"
   350	                                checked={feature.enabled}
   351	                                onChange={(e) => updateFeature(featureKey, 'enabled', e.target.checked)}
   352	                              />
   353	                              <span>启用</span>
   354	                            </label>
   355	                            <input
   356	                              type="text"
   357	                              className="description-input"
   358	                              value={feature.description}
   359	                              onChange={(e) => updateFeature(featureKey, 'description', e.target.value)}
   360	                              placeholder="描述"
   361	                            />
   362	                          </div>
   363	                        </div>
   364	                      );
   365	                    }
   366	
   367	                    // Handle quota features (limit-based)
   368	                    return (
   369	                      <div key={featureKey} className="feature-item">
   370	                        <label className="feature-label">{getFeatureLabel(featureKey)}</label>
   371	                        <div className="feature-controls">
   372	                          <input
   373	                            type="number"
   374	                            className="limit-input"
   375	                            value={feature.limit}
   376	                            onChange={(e) => updateFeature(featureKey, 'limit', parseInt(e.target.value))}
   377	                            placeholder="限额"
   378	                          />
   379	                          <select
   380	                            className="period-select"
   381	                            value={feature.period}
   382	                            onChange={(e) => updateFeature(featureKey, 'period', e.target.value)}
   383	                          >
   384	                            <option value="day">每天</option>
   385	                            <option value="month">每月</option>
   386	                            <option value="year">每年</option>
   387	                          </select>
   388	                          <input
   389	                            type="text"
   390	                            className="description-input"
   391	                            value={feature.description}
   392	                            onChange={(e) => updateFeature(featureKey, 'description', e.target.value)}
   393	                            placeholder="描述"
   394	                          />
   395	                        </div>
   396	                      </div>
   397	                    );
   398	                  })}
   399	                </div>
   400	              </div>
   401	
   402	              <div className="modal-actions">
   403	                <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
   404	                  取消
   405	                </button>
   406	                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary">
   407	                  保存修改
   408	                </button>
   409	              </div>
   410	            </form>
   411	          </div>
   412	        </div>
   413	      )}
   414	    </div>
   415	  );
   416	};
   417	
   418	export default SubscriptionPlans;

   135	  const [realWechatOfficialConfig, setRealWechatOfficialConfig] = useState(null); // 存储真实敏感数据
   136	  const [isEditingWechatOfficial, setIsEditingWechatOfficial] = useState(false);
   137	  const [wechatOfficialConfig, setWechatOfficialConfig] = useState({
   138	    app_id: '',

   147

   149	  useEffect(() => {

   156

   175	        }
   176	        break;
   177	      case 'wechat-official':
   178	        loadWechatOfficialConfig();
   179	        break;
   180	      case 'email':
   181	        loadEmailConfig();
   182	        break;
   183	      case 'sms':
   184	        loadSMSConfig();
   185	        break;
   186	      case 'github':
   187	        loadGithubConfig();
   188	        break;
   189	      case 'privacy':
   190	        loadPrivacyPolicy();
   191	        break;
   192	      case 'terms':
   193	        loadTermsOfService();
   194	        break;
   195	      case 'system':
   196	        loadSystemConfig();
   197	        break;
   198	      default:
   199	        break;
   200	    }
   201	  };
   202	
   203	  // Password verification handlers
   204	  const handleVerified = async () => {
   205	    setIsVerified(true);
   206	    setShowVerifyModal(false);
   207	
   208	    // Load real email password if we're on email tab and config exists
   209	    if (activeTab === 'email' && savedEmailConfig && !realEmailPassword) {

   214	        }
   215	      } catch (err) {
   216	        console.error('Failed to load real password:', err);
   217	      }
   218	    }
   219	
   220	    // Load real SMS secret if we're on sms tab and config exists
   221	    if (activeTab === 'sms' && savedSMSConfig && !realSMSSecret) {
   222	      try {
   223	        const response = await adminAPI.getSMSConfig(true); // true = show_secret

   225	          setRealSMSSecret(response.data.data.access_secret);
   226	        }
   227	      } catch (err) {
   228	        console.error('Failed to load real secret:', err);

   230	    }

   238	        }
   239	      } catch (err) {
   240	        console.error('Failed to load real alipay keys:', err);
   241	      }
   242	    }

   252	          }
   253	        } catch (err) {
   254	          console.error('Failed to load real wechat pay keys:', err);

   264	          }
   265	        } catch (err) {
   266	          console.error('Failed to load real wechat oauth secret:', err);
   267	        }
   268	      }
   269	
   270	      // Load WeChat Official config
   271	      if (wechatSubTab === 'official' && savedWechatOfficialConfig && !realWechatOfficialConfig) {
   272	        try {
   273	          const response = await adminAPI.getWeChatOfficialConfig(true); // true = show_sensitive
   274	          if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   275	            setRealWechatOfficialConfig(response.data.data);
   276	          }
   277	        } catch (err) {
   278	          console.error('Failed to load real wechat official config:', err);
   279	        }
   280	      }
   281	    }
   282	
   283	    // Auto-expire verification after 5 minutes
   284	    setTimeout(() => {
   285	      setIsVerified(false);
   286	      setRealEmailPassword(null); // Clear real password when verification expires
   287	      setRealSMSSecret(null); // Clear real SMS secret when verification expires
   288	      // Reload configs to reset masked values
   289	      loadTabData();
   290	    }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
   291	  };
   292	
   293	  const handleRequestVerify = () => {
   294	    setShowVerifyModal(true);
   295	  };
   296	
   297	  // === 支付宝配置管理 ===
   298	  const loadAlipayConfigs = async () => {
   299	    setLoading(true);
   300	    try {
   301	      const response = await adminAPI.getAlipayConfigs();
   302	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   303	        setAlipayConfigs(response.data.data || []);
   304	      }
   305	    } catch (err) {
   306	      showToast('加载支付宝配置失败', 'error');
   307	    } finally {
   308	      setLoading(false);
   309	    }
   310	  };
   311	
   312	  const handleCreateAlipay = () => {
   313	    setEditingAlipay(null);
   314	    setAlipayForm({
   315	      app_id: '',
   316	      private_key: '',
   317	      alipay_public_key: '',
   318	      notify_url: `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/payment/alipay/notify`,
   319	      return_url: `${window.location.origin}/orders`,
   320	      is_sandbox: false,
   321	      is_active: false,
   322	    });
   323	    setShowAlipayModal(true);
   324	  };
   325	
   326	  const handleEditAlipay = (config) => {
   327	    setEditingAlipay(config);
   328	    setAlipayForm({
   329	      app_id: config.app_id,
   330	      private_key: config.private_key === '********' ? '' : config.private_key,
   331	      alipay_public_key: config.alipay_public_key === '********' ? '' : config.alipay_public_key,
   332	      notify_url: config.notify_url,
   333	      return_url: config.return_url || '',
   334	      is_sandbox: config.is_sandbox,
   335	      is_active: config.is_active,
   336	    });
   337	    setShowAlipayModal(true);
   338	  };
   339	
   340	  const handleSubmitAlipay = async (e) => {
   341	    e.preventDefault();
   342	    setLoading(true);
   343	
   344	    try {
   345	      let response;
   346	      if (editingAlipay) {
   347	        const updateData = { ...alipayForm };
   348	        if (!updateData.private_key) delete updateData.private_key;
   349	        if (!updateData.alipay_public_key) delete updateData.alipay_public_key;
   350	        response = await adminAPI.updateAlipayConfig(editingAlipay.id, updateData);
   351	      } else {
   352	        response = await adminAPI.createAlipayConfig(alipayForm);
   353	      }
   354	
   355	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   356	        showToast(editingAlipay ? '更新成功' : '创建成功', 'success');
   357	        setShowAlipayModal(false);
   358	        loadAlipayConfigs();
   359	      } else {

   904	  const handleGenerateToken = () => {
   905	    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
   906	    let token = '';
   907	    for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
   908	      token += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
   909	    }

   916	    let key = '';
   917	    for (let i = 0; i < 43; i++) {
   918	      key += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
   919	    }
   920	    setWechatOfficialConfig({ ...wechatOfficialConfig, encoding_aes_key: key });
   921	    showToast('EncodingAESKey已生成', 'success');
   922	  };

   952	    try {
   953	      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/config/privacy-policy');
   954	      const data = await response.json();
   955	      if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {

   958	          version: data.data.version || '',
   959	        });
   960	      }
   961	    } catch (err) {
   962	      console.error('Failed to load privacy policy:', err);
   963	    }
   964	  };

   967	    setPrivacyPolicy({
   968	      ...privacyPolicy,
   969	      [e.target.name]: e.target.value,
   970	    });
   971	  };
   972	
   973	  const handlePrivacyPolicySubmit = async (e) => {
   974	    e.preventDefault();
   975	    setLoading(true);
   976	
   977	    try {
   978	      const response = await adminAPI.updatePrivacyPolicy(
   979	        privacyPolicy.content,
   980	        privacyPolicy.version
   981	      );
   982	
   983	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   984	        showToast('隐私协议已成功更新', 'success');
   985	      } else {
   986	        showToast(response.data.message || '更新失败', 'error');
   987	      }
   988	    } catch (err) {
   989	      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '更新失败，请稍后重试', 'error');
   990	    } finally {
   991	      setLoading(false);

  2793	                </svg>

  2802	                      <ul className="tip-list">

  2855	                    <span className="toggle-title">邮箱验证码验证</span>

  2899	                      <input
  2900	                        type="text"
  2901	                        id="turnstileSiteKey"
  2902	                        className="input"
  2903	                        value={systemConfig.turnstileSiteKey}
  2904	                        onChange={(e) => setSystemConfig({
  2905	                          ...systemConfig,
  2906	                          turnstileSiteKey: e.target.value
  2907	                        })}
  2908	                        placeholder="1x00000000000000000000AA (测试密钥)"

  2914	                      <input
  2915	                        type="password"
  2916	                        id="turnstileSecretKey"
  2917	                        className="input"
  2918	                        value={systemConfig.turnstileSecretKey}
  2919	                        onChange={(e) => setSystemConfig({
  2920	                          ...systemConfig,
  2921	                          turnstileSecretKey: e.target.value
  2922	                        })}
  2923	                        placeholder="1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA (测试密钥)"
  2924	                      />
  2925	                      <small className="form-hint">从 Cloudflare Turnstile 控制台获取</small>
  2926	                    </div>
  2927	                  </div>
  2928	                </>
  2929	              )}
  2930	
  2931	              <div className="form-actions">
  2932	                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
  2933	                  {loading ? (
  2934	                    <>
  2935	                      <span className="spinner"></span>
  2936	                      <span className="text-gap-left">保存中...</span>
  2937	                    </>

  2939	                    '保存配置'
  2940	                  )}
  2941	                </button>
  2942	              </div>
  2943	            </form>

  2945	        )}
  2946	      </div>

  2948	      {/* Verify Password Modal */}
  2949	      <VerifyPasswordModal
  2950	        isOpen={showVerifyModal}
  2951	        onClose={() => setShowVerifyModal(false)}
  2952	        onVerified={handleVerified}
  2953	      />
  2954	    </div>
  2955	  );
  2956	};
