    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
    13	import './ThirdPartyAccounts.css';
    14	
    15	const ThirdPartyAccounts = () => {
    16	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    17	  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState([]);
    18	  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
    19	  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
    20	  const [editingAccount, setEditingAccount] = useState(null);
    21	  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('');
    22	  const [filterActive, setFilterActive] = useState(false);
    23	  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    24	    name: '',
    25	    type: 'semantic_scholar',
    26	    config: {
    27	      api_key: '',
    28	      base_url: '',
    29	      model_low: '',
    30	      model_mid: '',
    31	      model_high: '',
    32	    },
    33	    status: 1,
    34	    priority: 0,
    35	  });
    36	
    37	  useEffect(() => {
    38	    loadAccounts();
    39	    loadStats();
    40	  }, [filterType, filterActive]);
    41	
    42	  const loadAccounts = async () => {
    43	    setLoading(true);
    44	    try {
    45	      const response = await adminAPI.getThirdPartyAccounts(filterType, filterActive);
    46	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    47	        setAccounts(response.data.data.accounts || []);
    48	      }
    49	    } catch (err) {
    50	      showToast('加载账号列表失败', 'error');
    51	    } finally {
    52	      setLoading(false);
    53	    }
    54	  };
    55	
    56	  const loadStats = async () => {
    57	    try {
    58	      const response = await adminAPI.getThirdPartyAccountStats();
    59	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    60	        setStats(response.data.data);
    61	      }
    62	    } catch (err) {
    63	      console.error('Failed to load stats:', err);
    64	    }
    65	  };
    66	
    67	  const handleCreate = () => {
    68	    setEditingAccount(null);
    69	    setFormData({
    70	      name: '',
    71	      type: 'semantic_scholar',
    72	      config: {
    73	        api_key: '',
    74	        base_url: '',
    75	        model_low: '',
    76	        model_mid: '',
    77	        model_high: '',
    78	      },
    79	      status: 1,
    80	      priority: 0,
    81	    });
    82	    setShowModal(true);
    83	  };
    84	
    85	  const handleEdit = (account) => {
    86	    setEditingAccount(account);
    87	    setFormData({
    88	      name: account.name,
    89	      type: account.type,
    90	      config: account.config || {},
    91	      status: account.status,
    92	      priority: account.priority || 0,
    93	    });
    94	    setShowModal(true);
    95	  };
    96	
    97	  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    98	    if (!window.confirm('确认删除此账号？')) return;
    99	
   100	    try {
   101	      const response = await adminAPI.deleteThirdPartyAccount(id);
   102	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   103	        showToast('删除成功', 'success');
   104	        loadAccounts();
   105	        loadStats();
   106	      } else {
   107	        showToast(response.data.message || '删除失败', 'error');
   108	      }
   109	    } catch (err) {
   110	      showToast('删除失败', 'error');
   111	    }
   112	  };
   113	
   114	  const handleTest = async (id) => {
   115	    try {
   116	      const response = await adminAPI.testThirdPartyAccount(id);
   117	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   118	        showToast('测试成功: ' + response.data.data.message, 'success');
   119	      } else {
   120	        showToast('测试失败: ' + response.data.message, 'error');
   121	      }
   122	    } catch (err) {
   123	      showToast('测试失败', 'error');
   124	    }
   125	  };
   126	
   127	  const handleRefreshCache = async () => {
   128	    try {
   129	      const response = await adminAPI.refreshThirdPartyAccountCache();
   130	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   131	        showToast('缓存刷新成功', 'success');
   132	      } else {
   133	        showToast('刷新失败: ' + response.data.message, 'error');
   134	      }
   135	    } catch (err) {
   136	      showToast('刷新失败', 'error');
   137	    }
   138	  };
   139	
   140	  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
   141	    e.preventDefault();
   142	
   143	    // Prepare config based on account type
   144	    let config = {};
   145	    if (formData.type === 'semantic_scholar') {
   146	      if (!formData.config.api_key) {
   147	        showToast('请输入API Key', 'error');
   148	        return;
   149	      }
   150	      config = { api_key: formData.config.api_key };
   151	    } else if (formData.type === 'ai_model') {
   152	      if (!formData.config.base_url || !formData.config.api_key) {
   153	        showToast('请输入Base URL和API Key', 'error');
   154	        return;
   155	      }
   156	      config = {
   157	        base_url: formData.config.base_url,
   158	        api_key: formData.config.api_key,
   159	      };
   160	      // Add model codes if provided
   161	      if (formData.config.model_low) {
   162	        config.model_low = formData.config.model_low;
   163	      }
   164	      if (formData.config.model_mid) {
   165	        config.model_mid = formData.config.model_mid;
   166	      }
   167	      if (formData.config.model_high) {
   168	        config.model_high = formData.config.model_high;
   169	      }
   170	    }
   171	
   172	    const data = {
   173	      name: formData.name,
   174	      type: formData.type,
   175	      config,
   176	      status: formData.status,
   177	      priority: formData.priority,
   178	    };
   179	
   180	    try {
   181	      let response;
   182	      if (editingAccount) {
   183	        response = await adminAPI.updateThirdPartyAccount(editingAccount.id, data);
   184	      } else {
   185	        response = await adminAPI.createThirdPartyAccount(data);
   186	      }
   187	
   188	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   189	        showToast(editingAccount ? '更新成功' : '创建成功', 'success');
   190	        setShowModal(false);
   191	        loadAccounts();
   192	        loadStats();
   193	      } else {
   194	        showToast(response.data.message || '操作失败', 'error');
   195	      }
   196	    } catch (err) {
   197	      showToast('操作失败', 'error');
   198	    }
   199	  };
   200	
   201	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
   202	    if (!dateString) return '从未使用';
   203	    const date = new Date(dateString);
   204	    return date.toLocaleString('zh-CN');
   205	  };
   206	
   207	  // 格式化为相对时间（更友好的显示）
   208	  const formatRelativeTime = (dateString) => {
   209	    if (!dateString) return '从未使用';
   210	    
   211	    const date = new Date(dateString);
   212	    const now = new Date();
   213	    const diffMs = now - date;
   214	    const diffSeconds = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
   215	    const diffMinutes = Math.floor(diffSeconds / 60);
   216	    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMinutes / 60);
   217	    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHours / 24);
   218	    const diffWeeks = Math.floor(diffDays / 7);
   219	    const diffMonths = Math.floor(diffDays / 30);
   220	
   221	    if (diffSeconds < 30) {
   222	      return '刚刚';
   223	    } else if (diffSeconds < 60) {
   224	      return `${diffSeconds}秒前`;
   225	    } else if (diffMinutes < 60) {
   226	      return `${diffMinutes}分钟前`;
   227	    } else if (diffHours < 24) {
   228	      return `${diffHours}小时前`;
   229	    } else if (diffDays < 7) {
   230	      return `${diffDays}天前`;
   231	    } else if (diffWeeks < 4) {
   232	      return `${diffWeeks}周前`;
   233	    } else if (diffMonths < 12) {
   234	      return `${diffMonths}个月前`;
   235	    } else {
   236	      return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
   237	    }
   238	  };
   239	
   240	  // 格式化数字（添加千分位）
   241	  const formatNumber = (num) => {
   242	    if (num === undefined || num === null) return '0';
   243	    return num.toLocaleString('zh-CN');
   244	  };
   245	
   246	  const getAccountTypeLabel = (type) => {
   247	    switch (type) {
   248	      case 'semantic_scholar':
   249	        return <span className="type-badge type-scholar">Semantic Scholar</span>;
   250	      case 'ai_model':
   251	        return <span className="type-badge type-ai">AI模型</span>;
   252	      default:
   253	        return <span className="type-badge">{type}</span>;
   254	    }
   255	  };
   256	
   257	  const getStatusLabel = (status) => {
   258	    return status === 1 ? (
   259	      <span className="status-badge status-active">启用</span>
   260	    ) : (
   261	      <span className="status-badge status-inactive">停用</span>
   262	    );
   263	  };
   264	
   265	  const getModelCodesLabel = (config) => {
   266	    if (!config) return '-';
   267	    const models = [];
   268	    if (config.model_low) models.push(`Low: ${config.model_low}`);
   269	    if (config.model_mid) models.push(`Mid: ${config.model_mid}`);
   270	    if (config.model_high) models.push(`High: ${config.model_high}`);
   271	    return models.length > 0 ? models.join(' / ') : '-';
   272	  };
   273	
   274	  return (
   275	    <div className="third-party-accounts">
   276	      <div className="page-header">
   277	        <h2>第三方账号配置</h2>
   278	        <div className="header-actions">
   279	          <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={handleRefreshCache}>
   280	            刷新缓存
   281	          </button>
   282	          <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreate}>
   283	            添加账号
   284	          </button>
   285	        </div>
   286	      </div>
   287	
   288	      {stats && (
   289	        <>
   290	          {/* 总览统计 */}
   291	          <div className="stats-cards">
   292	            <div className="stat-card">
   293	              <div className="stat-label">总账号数</div>
   294	              <div className="stat-value">{stats.total || 0}</div>
   295	            </div>
   296	            <div className="stat-card">
   297	              <div className="stat-label">启用账号</div>
   298	              <div className="stat-value">{stats.active_count || 0}</div>
   299	            </div>
   300	            <div className="stat-card">
   301	              <div className="stat-label">总请求次数</div>
   302	              <div className="stat-value">{formatNumber(stats.total_usage || 0)}</div>
   303	            </div>
   304	          </div>
   305	
   306	          {/* 按类型统计 */}
   307	          {stats.type_stats && stats.type_stats.length > 0 && (
   308	            <div className="type-stats-section">
   309	              <h3 className="section-title">按类型统计</h3>
   310	              <div className="type-stats-cards">
   311	                {stats.type_stats.map((typeStat) => (
   312	                  <div key={typeStat.type} className={`type-stat-card type-stat-${typeStat.type}`}>
   313	                    <div className="type-stat-header">
   314	                      <span className="type-stat-name">{typeStat.type_name}</span>
   315	                      <span className="type-stat-badge">{typeStat.type}</span>
   316	                    </div>
   317	                    <div className="type-stat-body">
   318	                      <div className="type-stat-item">
   319	                        <span className="type-stat-label">账号数</span>
   320	                        <span className="type-stat-value">
   321	                          {typeStat.active_count} / {typeStat.total_count}
   322	                          <span className="type-stat-unit">启用/总数</span>
   323	                        </span>
   324	                      </div>
   325	                      <div className="type-stat-item">
   326	                        <span className="type-stat-label">总请求次数</span>
   327	                        <span className="type-stat-value">{formatNumber(typeStat.total_usage)}</span>
   328	                      </div>
   329	                      <div className="type-stat-item">
   330	                        <span className="type-stat-label">最后使用</span>
   331	                        <span className="type-stat-value type-stat-time" title={formatDate(typeStat.last_used_at)}>
   332	                          {formatRelativeTime(typeStat.last_used_at)}
   333	                        </span>
   334	                      </div>
   335	                    </div>
   336	                  </div>
   337	                ))}
   338	              </div>
   339	            </div>
   340	          )}
   341	        </>
   342	      )}
   343	
   344	      <div className="filters">
   345	        <select
   346	          value={filterType}
   347	          onChange={(e) => setFilterType(e.target.value)}
   348	          className="filter-select"
   349	        >
   350	          <option value="">全部类型</option>
   351	          <option value="semantic_scholar">Semantic Scholar</option>
   352	          <option value="ai_model">AI模型</option>
   353	        </select>
   354	        <label className="filter-checkbox">
   355	          <input
   356	            type="checkbox"
   357	            checked={filterActive}
   358	            onChange={(e) => setFilterActive(e.target.checked)}
   359	          />
   360	          <span>仅显示启用账号</span>
   361	        </label>
   362	      </div>
   363	
   364	      <div className="accounts-table-container">
   365	        {loading ? (
   366	          <div className="loading">加载中...</div>
   367	        ) : accounts.length === 0 ? (
   368	          <div className="empty-state">暂无账号</div>
   369	        ) : (
   370	          <table className="accounts-table">
   371	            <thead>
   372	              <tr>
   373	                <th>ID</th>
   374	                <th>名称</th>
   375	                <th>类型</th>
   376	                <th>优先级</th>
   377	                <th>模型编码</th>
   378	                <th>状态</th>
   379	                <th>使用次数</th>
   380	                <th>最后使用时间</th>
   381	                <th>创建时间</th>
   382	                <th>操作</th>
   383	              </tr>
   384	            </thead>
   385	            <tbody>
   386	              {accounts.map((account) => (
   387	                <tr key={account.id}>
   388	                  <td>{account.id}</td>
   389	                  <td>{account.name}</td>
   390	                  <td>{getAccountTypeLabel(account.type)}</td>
   391	                  <td>
   392	                    <span className={`priority-badge priority-${account.priority || 0}`}>
   393	                      {account.priority || 0}
   394	                    </span>
   395	                  </td>
   396	                  <td className="model-codes-cell">{account.type === 'ai_model' ? getModelCodesLabel(account.config) : '-'}</td>
   397	                  <td>{getStatusLabel(account.status)}</td>
   398	                  <td>{account.usage_count || 0}</td>
   399	                  <td>{formatDate(account.last_used_at)}</td>
   400	                  <td>{formatDate(account.created_at)}</td>
   401	                  <td>
   402	                    <div className="action-buttons">
   403	                      <button
   404	                        className="btn-action btn-test"
   405	                        onClick={() => handleTest(account.id)}
   406	                        title="测试"
   407	                      >
   408	                        测试
   409	                      </button>
   410	                      <button
   411	                        className="btn-action btn-edit"
   412	                        onClick={() => handleEdit(account)}
   413	                        title="编辑"
   414	                      >
   415	                        编辑
   416	                      </button>
   417	                      <button
   418	                        className="btn-action btn-delete"
   419	                        onClick={() => handleDelete(account.id)}
   420	                        title="删除"
   421	                      >
   422	                        删除
   423	                      </button>
   424	                    </div>
   425	                  </td>
   426	                </tr>
   427	              ))}
   428	            </tbody>
   429	          </table>
   430	        )}
   431	      </div>
   432	
   433	      {showModal && (
   434	        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
   435	          <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
   436	            <div className="modal-header">
   437	              <h3>{editingAccount ? '编辑账号' : '添加账号'}</h3>
   438	              <button className="modal-close" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
   439	                ×
   440	              </button>
   441	            </div>
   442	            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
   443	              <div className="modal-body" style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
   444	              <div className="form-group">
   445	                <label>账号名称</label>
   446	                <input
   447	                  type="text"
   448	                  value={formData.name}
   449	                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
   450	                  placeholder="请输入账号名称"
   451	                  required
   452	                />
   453	              </div>
   454	
   455	              <div className="form-group">
   456	                <label>账号类型</label>
   457	                <select
   458	                  value={formData.type}
   459	                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, type: e.target.value })}
   460	                  disabled={!!editingAccount}
   461	                  required
   462	                >
   463	                  <option value="semantic_scholar">Semantic Scholar</option>
   464	                  <option value="ai_model">AI模型</option>
   465	                </select>
   466	              </div>
   467	
   468	              {formData.type === 'semantic_scholar' && (
   469	                <div className="form-group">
   470	                  <label>API Key</label>
   471	                  <input
   472	                    type="text"
   473	                    value={formData.config.api_key || ''}
   474	                    onChange={(e) =>
   475	                      setFormData({
   476	                        ...formData,
   477	                        config: { ...formData.config, api_key: e.target.value },
   478	                      })
   479	                    }
   480	                    placeholder="请输入Semantic Scholar API Key"
   481	                    required
   482	                  />
   483	                </div>
   484	              )}
   485	
   486	              {formData.type === 'ai_model' && (
   487	                <>
   488	                  <div className="form-group">
   489	                    <label>Base URL</label>
   490	                    <input
   491	                      type="text"
   492	                      value={formData.config.base_url || ''}
   493	                      onChange={(e) =>
   494	                        setFormData({
   495	                          ...formData,
   496	                          config: { ...formData.config, base_url: e.target.value },
   497	                        })
   498	                      }
   499	                      placeholder="https://api.example.com"
   500	                      required
   501	                    />
   502	                  </div>
   503	                  <div className="form-group">
   504	                    <label>API Key</label>
   505	                    <input
   506	                      type="text"
   507	                      value={formData.config.api_key || ''}
   508	                      onChange={(e) =>
   509	                        setFormData({
   510	                          ...formData,
   511	                          config: { ...formData.config, api_key: e.target.value },
   512	                        })
   513	                      }
   514	                      placeholder="请输入API Key"
   515	                      required
   516	                    />
   517	                  </div>
   518	
   519	                  <div className="model-codes-section">
   520	                    <h4>模型编码配置</h4>
   521	                    <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '12px', marginBottom: '1rem', display: 'block' }}>
   522	                      为不同级别的任务配置对应的模型编码。至少配置一个模型编码。
   523	                    </small>
   524	
   525	                    <div className="form-group">
   526	                      <label>低级模型编码（Low）</label>
   527	                      <input
   528	                        type="text"
   529	                        value={formData.config.model_low || ''}
   530	                        onChange={(e) =>
   531	                          setFormData({
   532	                            ...formData,
   533	                            config: { ...formData.config, model_low: e.target.value },
   534	                          })
   535	                        }
   536	                        placeholder="例如: gpt-3.5-turbo, claude-3-haiku"
   537	                      />
   538	                      <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '4px', display: 'block' }}>
   539	                        用于普通任务和基础对话
   540	                      </small>
   541	                    </div>
   542	
   543	                    <div className="form-group">
   544	                      <label>中级模型编码（Mid）</label>
   545	                      <input
   546	                        type="text"
   547	                        value={formData.config.model_mid || ''}
   548	                        onChange={(e) =>
   549	                          setFormData({
   550	                            ...formData,
   551	                            config: { ...formData.config, model_mid: e.target.value },
   552	                          })
   553	                        }
   554	                        placeholder="例如: gpt-4, claude-3-sonnet"
   555	                      />
   556	                      <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '4px', display: 'block' }}>
   557	                        用于复杂分析和深度对话
   558	                      </small>
   559	                    </div>
   560	
   561	                    <div className="form-group">
   562	                      <label>高级模型编码（High）</label>
   563	                      <input
   564	                        type="text"
   565	                        value={formData.config.model_high || ''}
   566	                        onChange={(e) =>
   567	                          setFormData({
   568	                            ...formData,
   569	                            config: { ...formData.config, model_high: e.target.value },
   570	                          })
   571	                        }
   572	                        placeholder="例如: gpt-4-turbo, claude-3-opus"
   573	                      />
   574	                      <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '4px', display: 'block' }}>
   575	                        用于最高质量的任务和专业分析
   576	                      </small>
   577	                    </div>
   578	                  </div>
   579	                </>
   580	              )}
   581	
   582	              <div className="form-group">
   583	                <label>优先级</label>
   584	                <input
   585	                  type="number"
   586	                  value={formData.priority}
   587	                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, priority: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 })}
   588	                  min="0"
   589	                  placeholder="0"
   590	                />
   591	                <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '4px', display: 'block' }}>
   592	                  数字越小优先级越高，相同优先级的账号会随机选择
   593	                </small>
   594	              </div>
   595	
   596	              <div className="form-group">
   597	                <label>状态</label>
   598	                <select
   599	                  value={formData.status}
   600	                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, status: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
   601	                  required
   602	                >
   603	                  <option value="1">启用</option>
   604	                  <option value="0">停用</option>
   605	                </select>
   606	              </div>
   607	              </div>
   608	
   609	              <div className="modal-actions">
   610	                <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
   611	                  取消
   612	                </button>
   613	                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary">
   614	                  {editingAccount ? '保存' : '创建'}
   615	                </button>
   616	              </div>
   617	            </form>
   618	          </div>
   619	        </div>
   620	      )}
   621	    </div>
   622	  );
   623	};
   624	
   625	export default ThirdPartyAccounts;

    10	import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
    12	import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
    13	import UserStatisticsChart from '../components/UserStatisticsChart';
    14	import OnlineUserChart from '../components/OnlineUserChart';
    15	import UserDetailDrawer from '../components/UserDetailDrawer';
    16	import './UserManagement.css';
    17	
    18	const UserManagement = () => {
    19	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    20	  const [stats, setStats] = useState({
    21	    onlineUsers: 0,
    22	    todayRegistrations: 0,
    23	    weekRegistrations: 0,
    24	    monthRegistrations: 0,
    25	    yearRegistrations: 0,
    26	  });
    27	  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
    28	  const [onlineUsersList, setOnlineUsersList] = useState([]);
    29	  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({
    30	    page: 1,
    31	    pageSize: 20,
    32	    total: 0,
    33	  });
    34	  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({
    35	    sortBy: 'last_login_at',
    36	    sortOrder: 'desc',
    37	  });
    38	  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState('list'); // 'list' or 'online'
    39	  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState({ show: false, userId: null, userEmail: '' });
    40	  const [selectedUserId, setSelectedUserId] = useState(null);
    41	  const [grantModal, setGrantModal] = useState({ show: false, user: null });
    42	  const [grantForm, setGrantForm] = useState({ planCode: '', billingCycle: 'monthly', reason: '' });
    43	  const [subscriptionPlans, setSubscriptionPlans] = useState([]);
    44	  const [grantLoading, setGrantLoading] = useState(false);
    45	
    46	  useEffect(() => {
    47	    loadUserStatistics();
    48	    loadUserList();
    49	    loadSubscriptionPlans();
    50	  }, [pagination.page, sortConfig]);
    51	
    52	  const loadSubscriptionPlans = async () => {
    53	    try {
    54	      const response = await adminAPI.getSubscriptionPlans();
    55	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    56	        // Filter out free plan
    57	        const paidPlans = response.data.data.filter(plan => plan.plan_code !== 'FREE');
    58	        setSubscriptionPlans(paidPlans);
    59	      }
    60	    } catch (err) {
    61	      console.error('Failed to load subscription plans:', err);
    62	    }
    63	  };
    64	
    65	  const loadUserStatistics = async () => {
    66	    try {
    67	      const response = await adminAPI.getUserStatistics();
    68	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    69	        setStats({
    70	          onlineUsers: response.data.data.online_users || 0,
    71	          todayRegistrations: response.data.data.today_registrations || 0,
    72	          weekRegistrations: response.data.data.week_registrations || 0,
    73	          monthRegistrations: response.data.data.month_registrations || 0,
    74	          yearRegistrations: response.data.data.year_registrations || 0,
    75	        });
    76	      }
    77	    } catch (err) {
    78	      console.error('Failed to load user statistics:', err);
    79	    }
    80	  };
    81	
    82	  const loadUserList = async () => {
    83	    setLoading(true);
    84	    try {
    85	      const response = await adminAPI.getUserList(
    86	        pagination.page, 
    87	        pagination.pageSize,
    88	        sortConfig.sortBy,
    89	        sortConfig.sortOrder
    90	      );
    91	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
    92	        setUsers(response.data.data.users || []);
    93	        setPagination(prev => ({
    94	          ...prev,
    95	          total: response.data.data.total || 0,
    96	        }));
    97	      }
    98	    } catch (err) {
    99	      showToast('加载用户列表失败', 'error');
   100	    } finally {
   101	      setLoading(false);
   102	    }
   103	  };
   104	
   105	  const loadOnlineUsers = async () => {
   106	    setLoading(true);
   107	    try {
   108	      const response = await adminAPI.getOnlineUsers();
   109	      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
   110	        setOnlineUsersList(response.data.data.online_users || []);
   111	      }
   112	    } catch (err) {
   113	      showToast('加载在线用户失败', 'error');
   114	    } finally {
   115	      setLoading(false);
   116	    }
   117	  };
   118	
   119	  const handleViewChange = (view) => {
   120	    setActiveView(view);
   121	    if (view === 'online') {
   122	      loadOnlineUsers();
   123	    }
   124	  };
   125	
   126	  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
   127	    setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: newPage }));
   128	  };
   129	
   130	  const handleDeleteClick = (user) => {
   131	    setDeleteConfirm({
   132	      show: true,
   133	      userId: user.id,
   134	      userEmail: user.email || user.username || `用户ID: ${user.id}`,
   135	    });
   136	  };
   137	
   138	  const handleDeleteConfirm = async () => {
   139	    if (!deleteConfirm.userId) return;
   140	
   141	    try {
   142	      const response = await adminAPI.deleteUser(deleteConfirm.userId);
   143	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   144	        showToast('用户删除成功', 'success');
   145	        setDeleteConfirm({ show: false, userId: null, userEmail: '' });
   146	        // Refresh the user list and statistics
   147	        loadUserList();
   148	        loadUserStatistics();
   149	      } else {
   150	        showToast(response.data.message || '删除失败', 'error');
   151	      }
   152	    } catch (err) {
   153	      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '删除用户失败', 'error');
   154	    }
   155	  };
   156	
   157	  const handleDeleteCancel = () => {
   158	    setDeleteConfirm({ show: false, userId: null, userEmail: '' });
   159	  };
   160	
   161	  // Grant subscription handlers
   162	  const handleGrantClick = (user) => {
   163	    setGrantModal({ show: true, user });
   164	    setGrantForm({ planCode: subscriptionPlans[0]?.plan_code || '', billingCycle: 'monthly', reason: '' });
   165	  };
   166	
   167	  const handleGrantCancel = () => {
   168	    setGrantModal({ show: false, user: null });
   169	    setGrantForm({ planCode: '', billingCycle: 'monthly', reason: '' });
   170	  };
   171	
   172	  const handleGrantConfirm = async () => {
   173	    if (!grantModal.user || !grantForm.planCode) {
   174	      showToast('请选择会员套餐', 'error');
   175	      return;
   176	    }
   177	
   178	    setGrantLoading(true);
   179	    try {
   180	      const response = await adminAPI.grantSubscription(
   181	        grantModal.user.id,
   182	        grantForm.planCode,
   183	        grantForm.billingCycle,
   184	        grantForm.reason
   185	      );
   186	      if (response.data.code === 0) {
   187	        showToast('会员套餐发放成功', 'success');
   188	        handleGrantCancel();
   189	        // Refresh the user list
   190	        loadUserList();
   191	      } else {
   192	        showToast(response.data.message || '发放失败', 'error');
   193	      }
   194	    } catch (err) {
   195	      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '发放会员套餐失败', 'error');
   196	    } finally {
   197	      setGrantLoading(false);
   198	    }
   199	  };
   200	
   201	  // 格式化为相对时间
   202	  const formatRelativeTime = (dateString) => {
   203	    if (!dateString) return '从未登录';
   204	    const date = new Date(dateString);
   205	    const now = new Date();
   206	    const diffMs = now - date;
   207	    const diffSeconds = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
   208	    const diffMinutes = Math.floor(diffSeconds / 60);
   209	    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMinutes / 60);
   210	    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHours / 24);
   211	    const diffMonths = Math.floor(diffDays / 30);
   212	    const diffYears = Math.floor(diffDays / 365);
   213	
   214	    if (diffSeconds < 60) return '刚刚';
   215	    if (diffMinutes < 60) return `${diffMinutes}分钟前`;
   216	    if (diffHours < 24) {
   217	      if (diffMinutes >= 30 && diffHours < 1) return '半小时前';
   218	      return `${diffHours}小时前`;
   219	    }
   220	    if (diffDays < 30) return `${diffDays}天前`;
   221	    if (diffMonths < 12) return `${diffMonths}个月前`;
   222	    return `${diffYears}年前`;
   223	  };
   224	
   225	  // 格式化为精确时间
   226	  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
   227	    if (!dateString) return '从未登录';
   228	    const date = new Date(dateString);
   229	    return date.toLocaleString('zh-CN');
   230	  };
   231	
   232	  // 处理排序点击
   233	  const handleSort = (field) => {
   234	    setSortConfig(prev => ({
   235	      sortBy: field,
   236	      sortOrder: prev.sortBy === field && prev.sortOrder === 'desc' ? 'asc' : 'desc',
   237	    }));
   238	    // 重置到第一页
   239	    setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: 1 }));
   240	  };
   241	
   242	  // 获取排序图标
   243	  const getSortIcon = (field) => {
   244	    if (sortConfig.sortBy !== field) {
   245	      return <span className="sort-icon">↕</span>;
   246	    }
   247	    return sortConfig.sortOrder === 'desc' 
   248	      ? <span className="sort-icon active">↓</span> 
   249	      : <span className="sort-icon active">↑</span>;
   250	  };
   251	
   252	  const getUserStatusLabel = (status) => {
   253	    switch (status) {
   254	      case 1:
   255	        return <span className="status-badge status-active">正常</span>;
   256	      case 0:
   257	        return <span className="status-badge status-inactive">未激活</span>;
   258	      case 2:
   259	        return <span className="status-badge status-suspended">已封禁</span>;
   260	      default:
   261	        return <span className="status-badge">未知</span>;
   262	    }
   263	  };
   264	
   265	  // 渲染联系方式列（包含邮箱、手机号、微信、GitHub）
   266	  const renderSubscriptionPlan = (subscription) => {
   267	    if (!subscription) {
   268	      return <span className="plan-badge plan-free">免费</span>;
   269	    }
   270	
   271	    const planClass = `plan-badge plan-${subscription.plan_code}`;
   272	    return (
   273	      <span className={planClass}>
   274	        {subscription.plan_name || subscription.plan_code}
   275	      </span>
   276	    );
   277	  };
   278	
   279	  const renderSubscriptionExpiry = (subscription) => {
   280	    if (!subscription || !subscription.end_date) {
   281	      return <span className="expiry-none">-</span>;
   282	    }
   283	
   284	    const endDate = new Date(subscription.end_date);
   285	    const remainingDays = subscription.remaining_days;
   286	
   287	    let expiryClass = 'expiry-normal';
   288	    let warningIcon = null;
   289	
   290	    if (remainingDays <= 0) {
   291	      expiryClass = 'expiry-expired';
   292	      warningIcon = '❌';
   293	    } else if (remainingDays <= 3) {
   294	      expiryClass = 'expiry-critical';
   295	      warningIcon = '🔴';
   296	    } else if (remainingDays <= 7) {
   297	      expiryClass = 'expiry-warning';
   298	      warningIcon = '⚠️';
   299	    } else if (remainingDays <= 30) {
   300	      expiryClass = 'expiry-soon';
   301	    }
   302	
   303	    return (
   304	      <div className={`subscription-expiry ${expiryClass}`}>
   305	        <div className="expiry-date">
   306	          {warningIcon && <span className="expiry-icon">{warningIcon}</span>}
   307	          {endDate.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}
   308	        </div>
   309	        <div className="expiry-days">
   310	          剩余 {remainingDays} 天
   311	        </div>
   312	        {subscription.auto_renew && (
   313	          <div className="expiry-auto-renew">自动续费</div>
   314	        )}
   315	      </div>
   316	    );
   317	  };
   318	
   319	  const renderContactInfo = (user) => {
   320	    const contactInfo = [];
   321	
   322	    if (user.email) {
   323	      contactInfo.push(
   324	        <div key="email" className="contact-info-detail">
   325	          <span className="info-label">邮箱:</span> {user.email}
   326	        </div>
   327	      );
   328	    }
   329	    if (user.phone) {
   330	      contactInfo.push(
   331	        <div key="phone" className="contact-info-detail">
   332	          <span className="info-label">手机:</span> {user.phone}
   333	        </div>
   334	      );
   335	    }
   336	    if (user.wechat_name) {
   337	      contactInfo.push(
   338	        <div key="wechat_name" className="contact-info-detail">
   339	          <span className="info-label">微信:</span> {user.wechat_name}
   340	        </div>
   341	      );
   342	    } else if (user.wechat_openid) {
   343	      contactInfo.push(
   344	        <div key="wechat_openid" className="contact-info-detail">
   345	          <span className="info-label">微信:</span> 微信用户
   346	        </div>
   347	      );
   348	    }
   349	    if (user.wechat_union_id) {
   350	      contactInfo.push(
   351	        <div key="wechat_union_id" className="contact-info-detail">
   352	          <span className="info-label">UnionID:</span> {user.wechat_union_id}
   353	        </div>
   354	      );
   355	    }
   356	    if (user.github_login) {
   357	      contactInfo.push(
   358	        <div key="github_login" className="contact-info-detail">
   359	          <span className="info-label">GitHub:</span> {user.github_login}
   360	        </div>
   361	      );
   362	    }
   363	
   364	    if (contactInfo.length === 0) {
   365	      return <span className="empty-contact">-</span>;
   366	    }
   367	
   368	    return (
   369	      <div className="contact-info-cell">
   370	        {contactInfo.map((info, index) => (
   371	          <React.Fragment key={index}>
   372	            {index > 0 && <div className="contact-info-divider"></div>}
   373	            {info}
   374	          </React.Fragment>
   375	        ))}
   376	      </div>
   377	    );
   378	  };
   379	
   380	  const totalPages = Math.ceil(pagination.total / pagination.pageSize);
   381	
   382	  return (
   383	    <div className="user-management-container">
   384	      <div className="page-header">
   385	        <h1>用户管理</h1>
   386	        <p>查看和管理注册用户</p>
   387	      </div>
   388	
   389	      {/* Statistics Cards */}
   390	      <div className="stats-grid">
   391	        <div className="stat-card">
   392	          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-success">
   393	            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   394	              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
   395	              <path d="M12 6v6l4 2"></path>
   396	            </svg>
   397	          </div>
   398	          <div className="stat-content">
   399	            <div className="stat-label">在线用户</div>
   400	            <div className="stat-value">{stats.onlineUsers}</div>
   401	          </div>
   402	        </div>
   403	
   404	        <div className="stat-card">
   405	          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-primary">
   406	            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   407	              <path d="M12 2v20M17 5H9.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H6"></path>
   408	            </svg>
   409	          </div>
   410	          <div className="stat-content">
   411	            <div className="stat-label">今日注册</div>
   412	            <div className="stat-value">{stats.todayRegistrations}</div>
   413	          </div>
   414	        </div>
   415	
   416	        <div className="stat-card">
   417	          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-info">
   418	            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   419	              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
   420	              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"></line>
   421	              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"></line>
   422	              <line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"></line>
   423	            </svg>
   424	          </div>
   425	          <div className="stat-content">
   426	            <div className="stat-label">本周注册</div>
   427	            <div className="stat-value">{stats.weekRegistrations}</div>
   428	          </div>
   429	        </div>
   430	
   431	        <div className="stat-card">
   432	          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-warning">
   433	            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   434	              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
   435	              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"></line>
   436	              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"></line>
   437	            </svg>
   438	          </div>
   439	          <div className="stat-content">
   440	            <div className="stat-label">本月注册</div>
   441	            <div className="stat-value">{stats.monthRegistrations}</div>
   442	          </div>
   443	        </div>
   444	
   445	        <div className="stat-card">
   446	          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-danger">
   447	            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
   448	              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
   449	              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"></line>
   450	              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"></line>
   451	              <path d="M8 14h.01M12 14h.01M16 14h.01"></path>
   452	            </svg>
   453	          </div>
   454	          <div className="stat-content">
   455	            <div className="stat-label">今年注册</div>
   456	            <div className="stat-value">{stats.yearRegistrations}</div>
   457	          </div>
   458	        </div>
   459	      </div>
   460	
   461	      {/* Charts Section */}
   462	      <div className="charts-section">
   463	        <div className="chart-card">
   464	          <div className="chart-header">
   465	            <h3>用户注册趋势</h3>
   466	          </div>
   467	          <UserStatisticsChart />
   468	        </div>
   469	
   470	        <div className="chart-card">
   471	          <div className="chart-header">
   472	            <h3>在线用户趋势</h3>
   473	          </div>
   474	          <OnlineUserChart />
   475	        </div>
   476	      </div>
   477	
   478	      {/* View Toggle */}
   479	      <div className="view-toggle">
   480	        <button
   481	          className={`toggle-btn ${activeView === 'list' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   482	          onClick={() => handleViewChange('list')}
   483	        >
   484	          全部用户
   485	        </button>
   486	        <button
   487	          className={`toggle-btn ${activeView === 'online' ? 'active' : ''}`}
   488	          onClick={() => handleViewChange('online')}
   489	        >
   490	          在线用户
   491	        </button>
   492	      </div>
   493	
   494	      {/* User List */}
   495	      <div className="user-table-container">
   496	        {loading ? (
   497	          <div className="loading-container">
   498	            <span className="spinner"></span>
   499	            <p>加载中...</p>
   500	          </div>
   501	        ) : (
   502	          <>
   503	            {activeView === 'list' && (
   504	              <>
   505	                <table className="user-table">
   506	                  <thead>
   507	                    <tr>
   508	                      <th>用户</th>
   509	                      <th>联系方式</th>
   510	                      <th>会员信息</th>
   511	                      <th>邀请者</th>
   512	                      <th>状态</th>
   513	                      <th 
   514	                        className="sortable-header"
   515	                        onClick={() => handleSort('last_login_at')}
   516	                      >
   517	                        最后登录 {getSortIcon('last_login_at')}
   518	                      </th>
   519	                      <th 
   520	                        className="sortable-header"
   521	                        onClick={() => handleSort('created_at')}
   522	                      >
   523	                        注册时间 {getSortIcon('created_at')}
   524	                      </th>
   525	                      <th>操作</th>
   526	                    </tr>
   527	                  </thead>
   528	                  <tbody>
   529	                    {users.length > 0 ? (
   530	                      users.map(user => (
   531	                        <tr key={user.id}>
   532	                          <td>
   533	                            <div className="user-info-cell">
   534	                              <span className="user-id">#{user.id}</span>
   535	                              <span className="user-name">{user.username || '-'}</span>
   536	                            </div>
   537	                          </td>
   538	                          <td className="contact-info-td">{renderContactInfo(user)}</td>
   539	                          <td>
   540	                            <div className="subscription-info-cell">
   541	                              {renderSubscriptionPlan(user.subscription)}
   542	                              {renderSubscriptionExpiry(user.subscription)}
   543	                            </div>
   544	                          </td>
   545	                          <td>
   546	                            {user.invited_by ? (
   547	                              <div className="inviter-info-cell">
   548	                                <span className="inviter-id">#{user.invited_by.user_id}</span>
   549	                                <span className="inviter-name">{user.invited_by.username || '-'}</span>
   550	                              </div>
   551	                            ) : (
   552	                              <span className="no-inviter">-</span>
   553	                            )}
   554	                          </td>
   555	                          <td>{getUserStatusLabel(user.status)}</td>
   556	                          <td>
   557	                            <div className="login-info-cell">
   558	                              <div 
   559	                                className="relative-time" 
   560	                                title={formatDate(user.last_login_at)}
   561	                              >
   562	                                {formatRelativeTime(user.last_login_at)}
   563	                              </div>
   564	                              {user.last_login_ip && (
   565	                                <div className="ip-location-cell">
   566	                                  <div className="ip-address">{user.last_login_ip}</div>
   567	                                  {user.last_login_ip_info && (
   568	                                    <div className="location-info">{user.last_login_ip_info}</div>
   569	                                  )}
   570	                                </div>
   571	                              )}
   572	                            </div>
   573	                          </td>
   574	                          <td>
   575	                            <div 
   576	                              className="relative-time" 
   577	                              title={formatDate(user.created_at)}
   578	                            >
   579	                              {formatRelativeTime(user.created_at)}
   580	                            </div>
   581	                          </td>
   582	                          <td>
   583	                            <div className="action-buttons">
   584	                              <button
   585	                                className="action-btn view-btn"
   586	                                onClick={(e) => {
   587	                                  e.stopPropagation();
   588	                                  e.preventDefault();
   589	                                  setSelectedUserId(user.id);
   590	                                }}
   591	                                title="查看详情"
   592	                              >
   593	                                详情
   594	                              </button>
   595	                              <button
   596	                                className="action-btn grant-btn"
   597	                                onClick={(e) => {
   598	                                  e.stopPropagation();
   599	                                  e.preventDefault();
   600	                                  handleGrantClick(user);
   601	                                }}
   602	                                title="发放会员"
   603	                              >
   604	                                发放
   605	                              </button>
   606	                              <button
   607	                                className="action-btn delete-btn"
   608	                                onClick={(e) => {
   609	                                  e.stopPropagation();
   610	                                  e.preventDefault();
   611	                                  handleDeleteClick(user);
   612	                                }}
   613	                                title="删除用户"
   614	                              >
   615	                                删除
   616	                              </button>
   617	                            </div>
   618	                          </td>
   619	                        </tr>
   620	                      ))
   621	                    ) : (
   622	                      <tr>
   623	                        <td colSpan="8" className="no-data">暂无用户数据</td>
   624	                      </tr>
   625	                    )}
   626	                  </tbody>
   627	                </table>
   628	
   629	                {/* Pagination */}
   630	                {totalPages > 1 && (
   631	                  <div className="pagination">
   632	                    <button
   633	                      className="pagination-btn"
   634	                      onClick={() => handlePageChange(pagination.page - 1)}
   635	                      disabled={pagination.page === 1}
   636	                    >
   637	                      上一页
   638	                    </button>
   639	                    <span className="pagination-info">
   640	                      第 {pagination.page} / {totalPages} 页 (共 {pagination.total} 条)
   641	                    </span>
   642	                    <button
   643	                      className="pagination-btn"
   644	                      onClick={() => handlePageChange(pagination.page + 1)}
   645	                      disabled={pagination.page === totalPages}
   646	                    >
   647	                      下一页
   648	                    </button>
   649	                  </div>
   650	                )}
   651	              </>
   652	            )}
   653	
   654	            {activeView === 'online' && (
   655	              <table className="user-table">
   656	                <thead>
   657	                  <tr>
   658	                    <th>ID</th>
   659	                    <th>邮箱</th>
   660	                    <th>用户名</th>
   661	                    <th>最后活跃时间</th>
   662	                    <th>IP地址/地区</th>
   663	                    <th>设备信息</th>
   664	                  </tr>
   665	                </thead>
   666	                <tbody>
   667	                  {onlineUsersList.length > 0 ? (
   668	                    onlineUsersList.map((user, index) => (
   669	                      <tr key={user.id || index}>
   670	                        <td>{user.id}</td>
   671	                        <td>{user.email || '-'}</td>
   672	                        <td>{user.username || '-'}</td>
   673	                        <td>{formatDate(user.last_activity)}</td>
   674	                        <td>
   675	                          <div className="ip-location-cell">
   676	                            <div className="ip-address">{user.ip || '-'}</div>
   677	                            {user.location && (
   678	                              <div className="location-info">{user.location}</div>
   679	                            )}
   680	                          </div>
   681	                        </td>
   682	                        <td>
   683	                          <div className="device-info-cell">
   684	                            {user.device || '-'}
   685	                          </div>
   686	                        </td>
   687	                      </tr>
   688	                    ))
   689	                  ) : (
   690	                    <tr>
   691	                      <td colSpan="6" className="no-data">暂无在线用户</td>
   692	                    </tr>
   693	                  )}
   694	                </tbody>
   695	              </table>
   696	            )}
   697	          </>
   698	        )}
   699	      </div>
   700	
   701	      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
   702	      {deleteConfirm.show && (
   703	        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={handleDeleteCancel}>
   704	          <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
   705	            <div className="modal-header">
   706	              <h3>确认删除用户</h3>
   707	            </div>
   708	            <div className="modal-body">
   709	              <p>您确定要删除用户 <strong>{deleteConfirm.userEmail}</strong> 吗？</p>
   710	              <p className="warning-text">
   711	                ⚠️ 此操作将删除该用户的所有数据（除统计数据外），包括：
   712	              </p>
   713	              <ul className="delete-list">
   714	                <li>用户账号信息</li>
   715	                <li>登录认证信息</li>
   716	                <li>会话记录</li>
   717	                <li>对话历史和消息</li>
   718	                <li>订阅记录</li>
   719	                <li>订单和支付记录</li>
   720	                <li>使用配额记录</li>
   721	              </ul>
   722	              <p className="warning-text">此操作<strong>不可撤销</strong>！</p>
   723	            </div>
   724	            <div className="modal-footer">
   725	              <button className="modal-btn cancel-btn" onClick={handleDeleteCancel}>
   726	                取消
   727	              </button>
   728	              <button className="modal-btn confirm-btn danger-btn" onClick={handleDeleteConfirm}>
   729	                确认删除
   730	              </button>
   731	            </div>
   732	          </div>
   733	        </div>
   734	      )}
   735	
   736	      {/* User Detail Drawer */}
   737	      {selectedUserId && (
   738	        <UserDetailDrawer
   739	          userId={selectedUserId}
   740	          onClose={() => setSelectedUserId(null)}
   741	        />
   742	      )}
   743	
   744	      {/* Grant Subscription Modal */}
   745	      {grantModal.show && (
   746	        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={handleGrantCancel}>
   747	          <div className="modal-content grant-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
   748	            <div className="modal-header">
   749	              <h3>发放会员套餐</h3>
   750	            </div>
   751	            <div className="modal-body">
   752	              <p>为用户 <strong>{grantModal.user?.email || grantModal.user?.username || `ID: ${grantModal.user?.id}`}</strong> 发放会员套餐</p>
   753	              
   754	              <div className="form-group">
   755	                <label>选择套餐</label>
   756	                <select
   757	                  value={grantForm.planCode}
   758	                  onChange={(e) => setGrantForm({ ...grantForm, planCode: e.target.value })}
   759	                  className="form-select"
   760	                >
   761	                  <option value="">请选择套餐</option>
   762	                  {subscriptionPlans.map(plan => (
   763	                    <option key={plan.plan_code} value={plan.plan_code}>
   764	                      {plan.plan_name} - 月付 ¥{plan.current_price_monthly} / 年付 ¥{plan.current_price_yearly}
   765	                    </option>
   766	                  ))}
   767	                </select>
   768	              </div>
   769	
   770	              <div className="form-group">
   771	                <label>计费周期</label>
   772	                <div className="radio-group">
   773	                  <label className="radio-label">
   774	                    <input
   775	                      type="radio"
   776	                      name="billingCycle"
   777	                      value="monthly"
   778	                      checked={grantForm.billingCycle === 'monthly'}
   779	                      onChange={(e) => setGrantForm({ ...grantForm, billingCycle: e.target.value })}
   780	                    />
   781	                    <span>月付（1个月）</span>
   782	                  </label>
   783	                  <label className="radio-label">
   784	                    <input
   785	                      type="radio"
   786	                      name="billingCycle"
   787	                      value="yearly"
   788	                      checked={grantForm.billingCycle === 'yearly'}
   789	                      onChange={(e) => setGrantForm({ ...grantForm, billingCycle: e.target.value })}
   790	                    />
   791	                    <span>年付（12个月）</span>
   792	                  </label>
   793	                </div>
   794	              </div>
   795	
   796	              <div className="form-group">
   797	                <label>发放原因（选填）</label>
   798	                <textarea
   799	                  value={grantForm.reason}
   800	                  onChange={(e) => setGrantForm({ ...grantForm, reason: e.target.value })}
   801	                  className="form-textarea"
   802	                  placeholder="例如：活动赠送、客服补偿、测试账号等"
   803	                  rows={3}
   804	                />
   805	              </div>
   806	
   807	              <div className="grant-info-box">
   808	                <p className="info-title">📋 发放说明</p>
   809	                <ul>
   810	                  <li>系统将创建一笔订单记录，支付方式为"系统发放"</li>
   811	                  <li>订单金额显示为套餐原价，折扣为100%，实付金额为0</li>
   812	                  <li>用户会员状态将立即生效</li>
   813	                  <li>此操作会记录管理员ID和发放原因</li>
   814	                </ul>
   815	              </div>
   816	            </div>
   817	            <div className="modal-footer">
   818	              <button className="modal-btn cancel-btn" onClick={handleGrantCancel} disabled={grantLoading}>
   819	                取消
   820	              </button>
   821	              <button 
   822	                className="modal-btn confirm-btn primary-btn" 
   823	                onClick={handleGrantConfirm}
   824	                disabled={grantLoading || !grantForm.planCode}
   825	              >
   826	                {grantLoading ? '发放中...' : '确认发放'}
   827	              </button>
   828	            </div>
   829	          </div>
   830	        </div>
   831	      )}
   832	    </div>
   833	  );
   834	};
   835	
   836	export default UserManagement;

    12	// Use relative path so requests go through Nginx reverse proxy
    13	// In production, this will be '' (empty), making requests to /api/v1/*
    14	// In development, you can set REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 for direct backend access
    15	const API_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || '';
    16	
    17	const api = axios.create({
    18	  baseURL: `${API_URL}/api/v1`,
    19	  headers: {
    20	    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    21	  },
    22	});
    23	
    24	// Request interceptor to add auth token
    25	api.interceptors.request.use(
    26	  (config) => {
    27	    const token = localStorage.getItem('admin_token');
    28	    if (token) {
    29	      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    30	    }
    31	    return config;
    32	  },
    33	  (error) => {
    34	    return Promise.reject(error);
    35	  }
    36	);
    37	
    38	// Response interceptor to handle errors
    39	api.interceptors.response.use(
    40	  (response) => response,
    41	  (error) => {
    42	    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
    43	      // Unauthorized - clear token and redirect to login
    44	      localStorage.removeItem('admin_token');
    45	      localStorage.removeItem('admin_user');
    46	      window.location.href = '/login';
    47	    }
    48	    return Promise.reject(error);
    49	  }
    50	);
    51

文件: frontend-admin/src/utils/AuthContext.js
================================================================================

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    11	
    12	const AuthContext = createContext(null);
    13	
    14	export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
    15	  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
    16	  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
    17	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    18	
    19	  useEffect(() => {
    20	    // Check for existing token on mount
    21	    const token = localStorage.getItem('admin_token');
    22	    const userData = localStorage.getItem('admin_user');
    23	
    24	    if (token && userData) {
    25	      setIsAuthenticated(true);
    26	      setUser(JSON.parse(userData));
    27	    }
    28	    setLoading(false);
    29	  }, []);
    30	
    31	  const login = (token, userData) => {
    32	    localStorage.setItem('admin_token', token);
    33	    localStorage.setItem('admin_user', JSON.stringify(userData));
    34	    setIsAuthenticated(true);
    35	    setUser(userData);
    36	  };
    37	
    38	  const logout = () => {
    39	    localStorage.removeItem('admin_token');
    40	    localStorage.removeItem('admin_user');
    41	    setIsAuthenticated(false);
    42	    setUser(null);
    43	  };
    44	
    45	  const value = {
    46	    isAuthenticated,
    47	    user,
    48	    login,
    49	    logout,
    50	    loading,
    51	  };
    52	
    53	  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
    54	};
    55	
    56	export const useAuth = () => {
    57	  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
    58	  if (!context) {
    59	    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
    60	  }
    61	  return context;
    62	};

     1	/**
     2	 * ============================================================================
     3	 * Scholay学术 V1.0
     4	 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
     5	 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
     6	 * All Rights Reserved.
     7	 * ============================================================================
     8	 */
     9	
    10	// Production-safe logging utility
    11	// This utility will only log in development mode
    12	
    13	const isDevelopment = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' || process.env.REACT_APP_ENABLE_LOGS === 'true';
    14	
    15	export const logger = {
    16	  log: (...args) => {
    17	    if (isDevelopment) {
    18	      console.log(...args);
    19	    }
    20	  },
    21	  error: (...args) => {
    22	    // Always log errors, even in production
    23	    console.error(...args);
    24	  },
    25	  warn: (...args) => {
    26	    if (isDevelopment) {
    27	      console.warn(...args);
    28	    }
    29	  },
    30	  info: (...args) => {
    31	    if (isDevelopment) {
    32	      console.info(...args);
    33	    }
    34	  }
    35	};
    36	
    37	export default logger;

     1	-- ============================================================================

     7	
     8	-- ============================================
     9	-- Scholar Database Schema
    10	-- 此文件包含所有表结构、索引定义
    11	-- 注意: 仅包含DDL语句，不包含数据
    12	-- ============================================
    13	
    14	SET NAMES utf8mb4;
    15	SET CHARACTER SET utf8mb4;
    16	SET foreign_key_checks = 0;
    17	
    18	-- ============================================
    19	-- 核心用户和认证表
    20	-- ============================================
    21	
    22	-- 管理员用户表
    23	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `admin_users` (
    24	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    25	  `username` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    26	  `password_hash` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    27	  `email` VARCHAR(100),
    28	  `status` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1=active, 0=inactive',
    29	  `last_login_at` DATETIME,
    30	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    31	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    32	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    33	  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_username` (`username`),
    34	  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`)
    35	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='管理员用户表';
    36	
    37	-- 用户表（支持多种认证方式）
    38	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `users` (
    39	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    40	  `username` VARCHAR(50),
    41	  `email` VARCHAR(100),
    42	  `phone` VARCHAR(20),
    43	  `password_hash` VARCHAR(255),
    44	  `avatar_url` VARCHAR(255),
    45	  `bio` TEXT COMMENT '用户简介',
    46	  `location` VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '用户位置',
    47	  `website` VARCHAR(255) COMMENT '个人网站',
    48	  `status` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1=active, 0=inactive, 2=suspended',
    49	  `email_verified` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    50	  `phone_verified` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    51	  `subscription_plan` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free' COMMENT 'free, pro, max',
    52	  `subscription_expires_at` DATETIME COMMENT '订阅过期时间（免费用户为NULL）',
    53	  `last_login_at` DATETIME,
    54	  `last_login_ip` VARCHAR(45) COMMENT '最后登录IP',
    55	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    56	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    57	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    58	  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_username` (`username`),
    59	  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_email` (`email`),
    60	  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_phone` (`phone`),
    61	  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
    62	  INDEX `idx_subscription_plan` (`subscription_plan`),
    63	  INDEX `idx_location` (`location`),
    64	  INDEX `idx_last_login_at` (`last_login_at`)
    65	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户表';
    66	
    67	-- 用户认证提供者（OAuth、微信等）
    68	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_auth_providers` (
    69	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    70	  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    71	  `provider` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'email, phone, wechat, google等',
    72	  `provider_user_id` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '第三方平台用户ID（微信为openID）',
    73	  `provider_union_id` VARCHAR(255) COMMENT '第三方平台联合ID（微信UnionID，用于跨应用识别同一用户）',
    74	  `provider_data` JSON COMMENT '第三方平台额外数据',
    75	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    76	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    77	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    78	  UNIQUE KEY `uk_provider_user` (`provider`, `provider_user_id`),
    79	  UNIQUE KEY `uk_provider_union` (`provider`, `provider_union_id`),
    80	  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
    81	  INDEX `idx_union_id` (`provider_union_id`),
    82	  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_auth_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
    83	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户认证提供者';
    84	
    85	-- ============================================
    86	-- 会话和统计表
    87	-- ============================================
    88	
    89	-- 用户会话（在线状态跟踪）
    90	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_sessions` (
    91	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    92	  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    93	  `token` VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    94	  `ip` VARCHAR(45),
    95	  `user_agent` VARCHAR(500),
    96	  `last_activity` DATETIME NOT NULL,
    97	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    98	  `expires_at` DATETIME NOT NULL,
    99	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
   100	  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
   101	  INDEX `idx_token` (`token`(64)),  -- Optimized: index only first 64 chars to reduce storage overhead
   102	  -- Removed redundant single-column indexes that are covered by composite indexes
   103	  INDEX `idx_active_sessions` (`last_activity`, `expires_at`),
   104	  INDEX `idx_user_activity` (`user_id`, `last_activity` DESC),
   105	  FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
   106	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户会话';
   107	
   108	-- 用户统计（每日汇总数据）
   109	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_statistics` (
   110	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   111	  `date` DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '统计日期',
   112	  `new_users` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '当日新增用户',
   113	  `total_users` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '累计用户总数',
   114	  `peak_online_users` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '当日最高在线用户数',
   115	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   116	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   117	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
   118	  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_date` (`date`),
   119	  INDEX `idx_date` (`date`)
   120	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='每日用户统计';
   121	
   122	-- 在线用户快照（实时图表数据）
   123	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `online_user_snapshots` (
   124	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   125	  `timestamp` DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '快照时间',
   126	  `online_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '在线用户数',
   127	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   128	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
   129	  INDEX `idx_timestamp` (`timestamp`)
   130	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='在线用户快照';
   131	
   132	-- ============================================
   133	-- 对话和消息表
   134	-- ============================================
   135	
   136	-- 对话表
   137	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `conversations` (
   138	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   139	  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
   140	  `title` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '对话标题（从首条消息生成）',
   141	  `conversation_type` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'search' COMMENT 'chat或search',
   142	  `model_level` VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'low' COMMENT '模型级别: low, mid, high',
   143	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   144	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   145	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
   146	  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
   147	  INDEX `idx_updated_at` (`updated_at`),
   148	  INDEX `idx_conversation_type` (`conversation_type`),
   149	  INDEX `idx_user_type` (`user_id`, `conversation_type`),
   150	  INDEX `idx_user_updated` (`user_id`, `updated_at` DESC),
   151	  INDEX `idx_user_type_updated` (`user_id`, `conversation_type`, `updated_at` DESC),
   152	  FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
   153	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户对话历史';
   154	
   155	-- 对话消息表（支持消息链）
   156	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `conversation_messages` (
   157	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   158	  `message_id` VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL COMMENT '消息UUID',
   159	  `conversation_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
   160	  `parent_message_id` VARCHAR(36) COMMENT '父消息ID（支持分支）',
   161	  `role` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'user, assistant, system',
   162	  `content` TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '消息内容',
   163	  `search_query` VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '搜索查询（如果是搜索消息）',
   164	  `search_results` JSON COMMENT 'Semantic Scholar搜索结果',
   165	  `search_results_total` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '搜索结果总数',
   166	  `follow_up_questions` TEXT COMMENT '延伸思考问题（仅最新一轮assistant消息保存）',
   167	  `token_count` INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Token计数',
   168	  `model` VARCHAR(50) COMMENT 'AI模型',
   169	  `finish_reason` VARCHAR(20) COMMENT '完成原因',
   170	  `error` BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '是否出错',
   171	  `unfinished` BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '是否未完成',
   172	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   173	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   174	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
   175	  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_message_id` (`message_id`),
   176	  INDEX `idx_conversation_id` (`conversation_id`),
   177	  INDEX `idx_parent_message_id` (`parent_message_id`),
   178	  INDEX `idx_created_at` (`created_at`),
   179	  INDEX `idx_conversation_created` (`conversation_id`, `created_at`),
   180	  INDEX `idx_message_chain` (`conversation_id`, `parent_message_id`, `created_at`),
   181	  INDEX `idx_parent` (`parent_message_id`, `conversation_id`),
   182	  FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `conversations`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
   183	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='对话消息';
   184	
   185	-- ============================================
   186	-- 订阅和配额表
   187	-- ============================================
   188	
   189	-- 订阅计划表
   190	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `subscription_plans` (
   191	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   192	  `plan_code` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '计划代码: free, pro, max',
   193	  `plan_name` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '计划名称',
   194	  `price_monthly` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '月费原价',
   195	  `current_price_monthly` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '月费实时价格',
   196	  `price_yearly` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '年费原价',
   197	  `current_price_yearly` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '年费实时价格',
   198	  `yearly_discount_enabled` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '年费是否使用折扣计算: 1=使用折扣, 0=直接定价',
   199	  `yearly_discount_percent` DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '年费折扣百分比(0-100)',
   200	  `features` JSON NOT NULL COMMENT '计划功能和配额',
   201	  `is_active` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1=启用, 0=停用',
   202	  `sort_order` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '显示顺序',
   203	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   204	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   205	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
   206	  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_plan_code` (`plan_code`),
   207	  INDEX `idx_is_active` (`is_active`),
   208	  INDEX `idx_sort_order` (`sort_order`),
   209	  INDEX `idx_active_type` (`is_active`, `plan_code`)
   210	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='订阅计划';
   211	
   212	-- 用户订阅表
   213	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_subscriptions` (
   214	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   215	  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
   216	  `plan_code` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '计划代码',
   217	  `start_date` DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '开始日期',
   218	  `end_date` DATETIME COMMENT '结束日期',
   219	  `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' COMMENT 'active, expired, cancelled',
   220	  `auto_renew` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '1=自动续费',
   221	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   222	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   223	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
   224	  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
   225	  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
   226	  INDEX `idx_end_date` (`end_date`),
   227	  INDEX `idx_user_status` (`user_id`, `status`),
   228	  INDEX `idx_user_active` (`user_id`, `status`, `end_date`),
   229	  FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
   230	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户订阅记录';
   231	
   232	-- 使用配额表
   233	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `usage_quotas` (
   234	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   235	  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
   236	  `quota_date` DATE NOT NULL COMMENT '使用日期',
   237	  `normal_search_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '普通搜索次数',
   238	  `advanced_search_low_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '高级搜索(低)次数',
   239	  `advanced_search_mid_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '高级搜索(中)次数',

   241	  `ai_chat_normal_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'AI对话(普通)次数',
   242	  `ai_chat_mid_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'AI对话(中)次数',
   243	  `ai_chat_high_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'AI对话(高)次数',
   244	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   245	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

   258	-- 订单表
   259	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `orders` (
   260	  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   261	  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
   262	  `order_no` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '订单号',
   263	  `plan_code` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '订阅计划代码',
   264	  `plan_name` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '下单时的计划名称',
   265	  `billing_cycle` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'monthly或yearly',
   266	  `amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '订单原价（折扣前）',
   267	  `coupon_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED COMMENT '使用的折扣券ID',
   268	  `discount_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '折扣金额',
   269	  `final_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '最终支付金额（折扣后）',
   270	  `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending, paid, cancelled, refunded',
   271	  `payment_method` VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '支付方式',
   272	  `payment_time` DATETIME COMMENT '支付完成时间',
   273	  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   274	  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
   275	  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
   276	  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_order_no` (`order_no`),
   277	  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
   278	  INDEX `idx_coupon_id` (`coupon_id`),
   279	  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
   280	  INDEX `idx_created_at` (`created_at`),
   281	  INDEX `idx_user_created` (`user_id`, `created_at` DESC),
   282	  INDEX `idx_status_created` (`status`, `created_at` DESC),
   283	  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
   284	) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='订阅订单';

   327	  `fixed_valid_end` DATETIME COMMENT '固定有效结束时间',

   333	  `new_user_only` BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '仅限新用户',
   334	
   335	  -- 状态管理
   336	  `status` ENUM('draft', 'active', 'paused', 'expired') DEFAULT 'draft' COMMENT '状态',
   337	  `priority` INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',
